book.notes: Old Testament original is the Hebrew Masoretic text; New Testament original is the SBL Greek text. Transliteration is automatic and flagged. Hebrew verse numbering can differ from KJV numbering in a few psalms.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֗ים מְאַבְּדִ֧ים וּ/מְפִצִ֛ים אֶת צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hvy r'ym m'bdym vmptsym 't ts'n mr'yty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD .

verses.original: לָ֠/כֵן כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַֽל הָ/רֹעִים֮ הָ/רֹעִ֣ים אֶת עַמִּ/י֒ אַתֶּ֞ם הֲפִצֹתֶ֤ם אֶת צֹאנִ/י֙ וַ/תַּדִּח֔וּ/ם וְ/לֹ֥א פְקַדְתֶּ֖ם אֹתָ֑/ם הִנְ/נִ֨י פֹקֵ֧ד עֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם אֶת רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵי/כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'l hr'ym hr'ym 't 'my 'tm hptstm 't ts'ny vtdchvm vl' pqdtm 'tm hnny pqd 'lykhm 't r' m'llykhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י אֲקַבֵּץ֙ אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֣ית צֹאנִ֔/י מִ/כֹּל֙ הָ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר הִדַּ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖/ם שָׁ֑ם וַ/הֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י אֶתְ/הֶ֛ן עַל נְוֵ/הֶ֖ן וּ/פָר֥וּ וְ/רָבֽוּ
verses.translit: v'ny 'qbts 't sh'ryt ts'ny mkhl h'rtsvt 'shr hdchty 'tm shm vhshbty 'thn 'l nvhn vprv vrbv
verses.translation: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֧י עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם רֹעִ֖ים וְ/רָע֑וּ/ם וְ/לֹא יִֽירְא֨וּ ע֧וֹד וְ/לֹא יֵחַ֛תּוּ וְ/לֹ֥א יִפָּקֵ֖דוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqmty 'lyhm r'ym vr'vm vl' yyr'v 'vd vl' ychtv vl' ypqdv n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֥י לְ/דָוִ֖ד צֶ֣מַח צַדִּ֑יק וּ/מָ֤לַךְ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/הִשְׂכִּ֔יל וְ/עָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vhqmty ldvd tsmch tsdyq vmlkh mlkh vhshkhyl v'shh mshpt vtsdqh b'rts
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

verses.original: בְּ/יָמָי/ו֙ תִּוָּשַׁ֣ע יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִשְׁכֹּ֣ן לָ/בֶ֑טַח וְ/זֶה שְּׁמ֥/וֹ אֲֽשֶׁר יִקְרְא֖/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צִדְקֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: bymyv tvsh' yhvdh vyshr'l yshkhn lbtch vzh shmv 'shr yqr'v yhvh tsdqnv
verses.translation: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS. …: Heb. Jehovah-tsidkenu

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹא יֹ֤אמְרוּ עוֹד֙ חַי יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vl' y'mrv 'vd chy yhvh 'shr h'lh 't bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם חַי יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱלָה֩ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יא אֶת זֶ֨רַע בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹנָ/ה וּ/מִ/כֹּל֙ הָֽ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדַּחְתִּ֖י/ם שָׁ֑ם וְ/יָשְׁב֖וּ עַל אַדְמָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy 'm chy yhvh 'shr h'lh v'shr hby' 't zr' byt yshr'l m'rts tspvnh vmkhl h'rtsvt 'shr hdchtym shm vyshbv 'l 'dmtm
verses.translation: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.

verses.original: לַ/נְּבִאִ֞ים נִשְׁבַּ֧ר לִבִּ֣/י בְ/קִרְבִּ֗/י רָֽחֲפוּ֙ כָּל עַצְמוֹתַ֔/י הָיִ֨יתִי֙ כְּ/אִ֣ישׁ שִׁכּ֔וֹר וּ/כְ/גֶ֖בֶר עֲבָ֣ר/וֹ יָ֑יִן מִ/פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מִ/פְּנֵ֖י דִּבְרֵ֥י קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: lnb'ym nshbr lby bqrby rchpv khl 'tsmvty hyyty kh'ysh shkhvr vkhgbr 'brv yyn mpny yhvh vmpny dbry qdshv
verses.translation: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD , and because of the words of his holiness.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְנָֽאֲפִים֙ מָלְאָ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּֽי מִ/פְּנֵ֤י אָלָה֙ אָבְלָ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ יָבְשׁ֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וַ/תְּהִ֤י מְרֽוּצָתָ/ם֙ רָעָ֔ה וּ/גְבוּרָתָ֖/ם לֹא כֵֽן
verses.translit: khy mn'pym ml'h h'rts khy mpny 'lh 'blh h'rts ybshv n'vt mdbr vthy mrvtstm r'h vgbvrtm l' khn
verses.translation: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.

verses.original: כִּֽי גַם נָבִ֥יא גַם כֹּהֵ֖ן חָנֵ֑פוּ גַּם בְּ/בֵיתִ֛/י מָצָ֥אתִי רָעָתָ֖/ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy gm nby' gm khhn chnpv gm bbyty mts'ty r'tm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD .

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֩ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה דַרְכָּ֜/ם לָ/הֶ֗ם כַּ/חֲלַקְלַקּוֹת֙ בָּֽ/אֲפֵלָ֔ה יִדַּ֖חוּ וְ/נָ֣פְלוּ בָ֑/הּ כִּֽי אָבִ֨יא עֲלֵי/הֶ֥ם רָעָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖/ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn yhyh drkhm lhm khchlqlqvt b'plh ydchv vnplv bh khy 'by' 'lyhm r'h shnt pqdtm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/בִ/נְבִיאֵ֥י שֹׁמְר֖וֹן רָאִ֣יתִי תִפְלָ֑ה הִנַּבְּא֣וּ בַ/בַּ֔עַל וַ/יַּתְע֥וּ אֶת עַמִּ֖/י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vbnby'y shmrvn r'yty tplh hnb'v bb'l vyt'v 't 'my 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/נְבִאֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם רָאִ֣יתִי שַׁעֲרוּרָ֗ה נָא֞וֹף וְ/הָלֹ֤ךְ בַּ/שֶּׁ֨קֶר֙ וְ/חִזְּקוּ֙ יְדֵ֣י מְרֵעִ֔ים לְ/בִ֨לְתִּי שָׁ֔בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/רָֽעָת֑/וֹ הָֽיוּ לִ֤/י כֻלָּ/ם֙ כִּ/סְדֹ֔ם וְ/יֹשְׁבֶ֖י/הָ כַּ/עֲמֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vbnb'y yrvshlm r'yty sh'rvrh n'vf vhlkh bshqr vchzqv ydy mr'ym lblty shbv 'ysh mr'tv hyv ly khlm khsdm vyshbyh kh'mrh
verses.translation: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ עַל הַ/נְּבִאִ֔ים הִנְ/נִ֨י מַאֲכִ֤יל אוֹתָ/ם֙ לַֽעֲנָ֔ה וְ/הִשְׁקִתִ֖י/ם מֵי רֹ֑אשׁ כִּ֗י מֵ/אֵת֙ נְבִיאֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם יָצְאָ֥ה חֲנֻפָּ֖ה לְ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'l hnb'ym hnny m'khyl 'vtm l'nh vhshqtym my r'sh khy m't nby'y yrvshlm yts'h chnph lkhl h'rts
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַֽל תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ עַל דִּבְרֵ֤י הַ/נְּבִאִים֙ הַ/נִּבְּאִ֣ים לָ/כֶ֔ם מַהְבִּלִ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם חֲז֤וֹן לִבָּ/ם֙ יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ לֹ֖א מִ/פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'l tshm'v 'l dbry hnb'ym hnb'ym lkhm mhblym hmh 'tkhm chzvn lbm ydbrv l' mpy yhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD .

verses.original: אֹמְרִ֤ים אָמוֹר֙ לִֽ/מְנַאֲצַ֔/י דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׁל֖וֹם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם וְ֠/כֹל הֹלֵ֞ךְ בִּ/שְׁרִר֤וּת לִבּ/וֹ֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹֽא תָב֥וֹא עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם רָעָֽה
verses.translit: 'mrym 'mvr lmn'tsy dbr yhvh shlvm yhyh lkhm vkhl hlkh bshrrvt lbv 'mrv l' tbv' 'lykhm r'h
verses.translation: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֤י עָמַד֙ בְּ/ס֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה וְ/יֵ֖רֶא וְ/יִשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת דְּבָר֑/וֹ מִֽי הִקְשִׁ֥יב דבר/י דְּבָר֖/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: khy my 'md bsvd yhvh vyr' vyshm' 't dbrv my hqshyb dbry dbrv vyshm'
verses.translation: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD , and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it ?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה חֵמָה֙ יָֽצְאָ֔ה וְ/סַ֖עַר מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים יָחֽוּל
verses.translit: hnh s'rt yhvh chmh yts'h vs'r mtchvll 'l r'sh rsh'ym ychvl
verses.translation: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ אַף יְהוָ֔ה עַד עֲשֹׂת֥/וֹ וְ/עַד הֲקִימ֖/וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑/וֹ בְּ/אַֽחֲרִית֙ הַ/יָּמִ֔ים תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָ֖/הּ בִּינָֽה
verses.translit: l' yshvb 'f yhvh 'd 'shtv v'd hqymv mzmvt lbv b'chryt hymym ttbvnnv bh bynh
verses.translation: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.

verses.original: לֹא שָׁלַ֥חְתִּי אֶת הַ/נְּבִאִ֖ים וְ/הֵ֣ם רָ֑צוּ לֹא דִבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/הֵ֥ם נִבָּֽאוּ
verses.translit: l' shlchty 't hnb'ym vhm rtsv l' dbrty 'lyhm vhm nb'v
verses.translation: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

verses.original: וְ/אִֽם עָמְד֖וּ בְּ/סוֹדִ֑/י וְ/יַשְׁמִ֤עוּ דְבָרַ/י֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י וִֽ/ישִׁבוּ/ם֙ מִ/דַּרְכָּ֣/ם הָ/רָ֔ע וּ/מֵ/רֹ֖עַ מַֽעַלְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'm 'mdv bsvdy vyshm'v dbry 't 'my vyshbvm mdrkhm hr' vmr' m'llyhm
verses.translation: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

verses.original: הַ/אֱלֹהֵ֧י מִ/קָּרֹ֛ב אָ֖נִי נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֖י מֵ/רָחֹֽק
verses.translit: h'lhy mqrb 'ny n'm yhvh vl' 'lhy mrchq
verses.translation: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD , and not a God afar off?

verses.original: אִם יִסָּתֵ֨ר אִ֧ישׁ בַּ/מִּסְתָּרִ֛ים וַ/אֲנִ֥י לֹֽא אֶרְאֶ֖/נּוּ נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה הֲ/ל֨וֹא אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֧יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֲנִ֥י מָלֵ֖א נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'm ystr 'ysh bmstrym v'ny l' 'r'nv n'm yhvh hlv' 't hshmym v't h'rts 'ny ml' n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD . Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD .

verses.original: שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר אָֽמְרוּ֙ הַ/נְּבִאִ֔ים הַֽ/נִּבְּאִ֥ים בִּ/שְׁמִ֛/י שֶׁ֖קֶר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר חָלַ֖מְתִּי חָלָֽמְתִּי
verses.translit: shm'ty 't 'shr 'mrv hnb'ym hnb'ym bshmy shqr l'mr chlmty chlmty
verses.translation: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

verses.original: עַד מָתַ֗י הֲ/יֵ֛שׁ בְּ/לֵ֥ב הַ/נְּבִאִ֖ים נִבְּאֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁ֑קֶר וּ/נְבִיאֵ֖י תַּרְמִ֥ת לִבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'd mty hysh blb hnb'ym nb'y hshqr vnby'y trmt lbm
verses.translation: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;

verses.original: הַ/חֹשְׁבִ֗ים לְ/הַשְׁכִּ֤יחַ אֶת עַמִּ/י֙ שְׁמִ֔/י בַּ/חֲל֣וֹמֹתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְסַפְּר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁכְח֧וּ אֲבוֹתָ֛/ם אֶת שְׁמִ֖/י בַּ/בָּֽעַל
verses.translit: hchshbym lhshkhych 't 'my shmy bchlvmtm 'shr ysprv 'ysh lr'hv kh'shr shkhchv 'bvtm 't shmy bb'l
verses.translation: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.

verses.original: הַ/נָּבִ֞יא אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֤/וֹ חֲלוֹם֙ יְסַפֵּ֣ר חֲל֔וֹם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר דְּבָרִ/י֙ אִתּ֔/וֹ יְדַבֵּ֥ר דְּבָרִ֖/י אֱמֶ֑ת מַה לַ/תֶּ֥בֶן אֶת הַ/בָּ֖ר נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hnby' 'shr 'tv chlvm yspr chlvm v'shr dbry 'tv ydbr dbry 'mt mh ltbn 't hbr n'm yhvh
verses.translation: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD .

verses.original: הֲ/ל֨וֹא כֹ֧ה דְבָרִ֛/י כָּ/אֵ֖שׁ נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וּ/כְ/פַטִּ֖ישׁ יְפֹ֥צֵֽץ סָֽלַע
verses.translit: hlv' khh dbry kh'sh n'm yhvh vkhptysh yptsts sl'
verses.translation: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD ; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן הִנְ/נִ֥י עַל הַ/נְּבִאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה מְגַנְּבֵ֣י דְבָרַ֔/י אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/אֵ֥ת רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: lkhn hnny 'l hnb'ym n'm yhvh mgnby dbry 'ysh m't r'hv
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD , that steal my words every one from his neighbour.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֥י עַל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה הַ/לֹּקְחִ֣ים לְשׁוֹנָ֔/ם וַֽ/יִּנְאֲמ֖וּ נְאֻֽם
verses.translit: hnny 'l hnby'm n'm yhvh hlqchym lshvnm vyn'mv n'm
verses.translation: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD , that use their tongues, and say, He saith.

verses.original: הִ֠נְ/נִי עַֽל נִבְּאֵ֞י חֲלֹמ֥וֹת שֶׁ֨קֶר֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וַֽ/יְסַפְּרוּ/ם֙ וַ/יַּתְע֣וּ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י בְּ/שִׁקְרֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/בְ/פַחֲזוּתָ֑/ם וְ/אָנֹכִ֨י לֹֽא שְׁלַחְתִּ֜י/ם וְ/לֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֗י/ם וְ/הוֹעֵ֛יל לֹֽא יוֹעִ֥ילוּ לָֽ/עָם הַ/זֶּ֖ה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hnny 'l nb'y chlmvt shqr n'm yhvh vysprvm vyt'v 't 'my bshqryhm vbpchzvtm v'nkhy l' shlchtym vl' tsvytym vhv'yl l' yv'ylv l'm hzh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD , and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כִי יִשְׁאָלְ/ךָ֩ הָ/עָ֨ם הַ/זֶּ֜ה אֽוֹ הַ/נָּבִ֤יא אֽוֹ כֹהֵן֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מַה מַשָּׂ֖א יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ אֶת מַה מַשָּׂ֔א וְ/נָטַשְׁתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhy ysh'lkh h'm hzh 'v hnby' 'v khhn l'mr mh msh' yhvh v'mrt 'lyhm 't mh msh' vntshty 'tkhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the LORD ? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נָּבִ֤יא וְ/הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ וְ/הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר מַשָּׂ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֛י עַל הָ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/ה֖וּא וְ/עַל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhnby' vhkhhn vh'm 'shr y'mr msh' yhvh vpqdty 'l h'ysh hhv' v'l bytv
verses.translation: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD , I will even punish that man and his house.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֛וּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל רֵעֵ֖/הוּ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֑י/ו מֶה עָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מַה דִּבֶּ֖ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khh t'mrv 'ysh 'l r'hv v'ysh 'l 'chyv mh 'nh yhvh vmh dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?

verses.original: וּ/מַשָּׂ֥א יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א תִזְכְּרוּ ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י הַ/מַּשָּׂ֗א יִֽהְיֶה֙ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ דְּבָר֔/וֹ וַ/הֲפַכְתֶּ֗ם אֶת דִּבְרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַיִּ֔ים יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vmsh' yhvh l' tzkhrv 'vd khy hmsh' yhyh l'ysh dbrv vhpkhtm 't dbry 'lhym chyym yhvh tsb'vt 'lhynv
verses.translation: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man’s word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה תֹאמַ֖ר אֶל הַ/נָּבִ֑יא מֶה עָנָ֣/ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מַה דִּבֶּ֖ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khh t'mr 'l hnby' mh 'nkh yhvh vmh dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?

verses.original: וְ/אִם מַשָּׂ֣א יְהוָה֮ תֹּאמֵרוּ֒ לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה יַ֧עַן אֲמָרְ/כֶ֛ם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה מַשָּׂ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וָ/אֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵי/כֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תֹאמְר֖וּ מַשָּׂ֥א יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm msh' yhvh t'mrv lkhn khh 'mr yhvh y'n 'mrkhm 't hdbr hzh msh' yhvh v'shlch 'lykhm l'mr l' t'mrv msh' yhvh
verses.translation: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD ; therefore thus saith the LORD ; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD , and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD ;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן הִנְ/נִ֔י וְ/נָשִׁ֥יתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם נָשֹׁ֑א וְ/נָטַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֗ם וְ/אֶת הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָ/כֶ֛ם וְ/לַ/אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם מֵ/עַ֥ל פָּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: lkhn hnny vnshyty 'tkhm nsh' vntshty 'tkhm v't h'yr 'shr ntty lkhm vl'bvtykhm m'l pny
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם חֶרְפַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּ/כְלִמּ֣וּת עוֹלָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ
verses.translit: vntty 'lykhm chrpt 'vlm vkhlmvt 'vlm 'shr l' tshkhch
verses.translation: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.

verses.original: הִרְאַ/נִי֮ יְהוָה֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֗ה שְׁנֵי֙ דּוּדָאֵ֣י תְאֵנִ֔ים מוּעָדִ֕ים לִ/פְנֵ֖י הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֣י הַגְל֣וֹת נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֡ל אֶת יְכָנְיָ֣הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֩ וְ/אֶת שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה וְ/אֶת הֶ/חָרָ֤שׁ וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּסְגֵּר֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יְבִאֵ֖/ם בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: hr'ny yhvh vhnh shny dvd'y t'nym mv'dym lpny hykhl yhvh 'chry hglvt nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl 't ykhnyhv bn yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh v't shry yhvdh v't hchrsh v't hmsgr myrvshlm vyb'm bbl
verses.translation: The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the LORD , after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

verses.original: הַ/דּ֣וּד אֶחָ֗ד תְּאֵנִים֙ טֹב֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד כִּ/תְאֵנֵ֖י הַ/בַּכֻּר֑וֹת וְ/הַ/דּ֣וּד אֶחָ֗ד תְּאֵנִים֙ רָע֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תֵֽאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵ/רֹֽעַ
verses.translit: hdvd 'chd t'nym tbvt m'd kht'ny hbkhrvt vhdvd 'chd t'nym r'vt m'd 'shr l' t'khlnh mr'
verses.translation: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י מָֽה אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וָ/אֹמַ֖ר תְּאֵנִ֑ים הַ/תְּאֵנִ֤ים הַ/טֹּבוֹת֙ טֹב֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד וְ/הָֽ/רָעוֹת֙ רָע֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵ/רֹֽעַ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly mh 'th r'h yrmyhv v'mr t'nym ht'nym htbvt tbvt m'd vhr'vt r'vt m'd 'shr l' t'khlnh mr'
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּ/תְּאֵנִ֥ים הַ/טֹּב֖וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה כֵּֽן אַכִּ֞יר אֶת גָּל֣וּת יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁלַּ֜חְתִּי מִן הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֛ה אֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים לְ/טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l kht'nym htbvt h'lh khn 'khyr 't glvt yhvdh 'shr shlchty mn hmqvm hzh 'rts khshdym ltvbh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֨י עֵינִ֤/י עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/טוֹבָ֔ה וַ/הֲשִׁבֹתִ֖י/ם עַל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את וּ/בְנִיתִי/ם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א אֶהֱרֹ֔ס וּ/נְטַעְתִּ֖י/ם וְ/לֹ֥א אֶתּֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vshmty 'yny 'lyhm ltvbh vhshbtym 'l h'rts hz't vbnytym vl' 'hrs vnt'tym vl' 'tvsh
verses.translation: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּי֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם לֵ֜ב לָ/דַ֣עַת אֹתִ֗/י כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הָיוּ לִ֣/י לְ/עָ֔ם וְ/אָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִ֑ים כִּֽי יָשֻׁ֥בוּ אֵלַ֖/י בְּ/כָל לִבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vntty lhm lb ld't 'ty khy 'ny yhvh vhyv ly l'm v'nkhy 'hyh lhm l'lhym khy yshbv 'ly bkhl lbm
verses.translation: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the LORD : and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.

verses.original: וְ/כַ/תְּאֵנִים֙ הָֽ/רָע֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵ/רֹ֑עַ כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה כֵּ֣ן אֶ֠תֵּן אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֤ה וְ/אֶת שָׂרָי/ו֙ וְ/אֵ֣ת שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִים֙ בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vkht'nym hr'vt 'shr l' t'khlnh mr' khy khh 'mr yhvh khn 'tn 't tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh v't shryv v't sh'ryt yrvshlm hnsh'rym b'rts hz't vhyshbym b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD , So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:

verses.original: וּ/נְתַתִּי/ם֙ ל/זועה לְ/זַעֲוָ֣ה לְ/רָעָ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לְ/חֶרְפָּ֤ה וּ/לְ/מָשָׁל֙ לִ/שְׁנִינָ֣ה וְ/לִ/קְלָלָ֔ה בְּ/כָל הַ/מְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶֽׁר אַדִּיחֵ֥/ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vnttym lzv'h lz'vh lr'h lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts lchrph vlmshl lshnynh vlqllh bkhl hmqmvt 'shr 'dychm shm
verses.translation: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי בָ֔/ם אֶת הַ/חֶ֖רֶב אֶת הָ/רָעָ֣ב וְ/אֶת הַ/דָּ֑בֶר עַד תֻּמָּ/ם֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תִּי לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/לַ/אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vshlchty bm 't hchrb 't hr'b v't hdbr 'd tmm m'l h'dmh 'shr ntty lhm vl'bvtyhm
verses.translation: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֤ה עַֽל יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ עַל כָּל עַ֣ם יְהוּדָ֔ה בַּ/שָּׁנָה֙ הָֽ/רְבִעִ֔ית לִ/יהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הִ֗יא הַ/שָּׁנָה֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ית לִ/נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv 'l khl 'm yhvdh bshnh hrb'yt lyhvyqym bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh hy' hshnh hr'shnyt lnbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֜ר יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַ/נָּבִיא֙ עַל כָּל עַ֣ם יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/אֶ֛ל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: 'shr dbr yrmyhv hnby' 'l khl 'm yhvdh v'l khl yshby yrvshlm l'mr
verses.translation: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,

verses.original: מִן שְׁלֹ֣שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֡ה לְ/יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בֶן אָמוֹן֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְ/עַ֣ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֗ה זֶ֚ה שָׁלֹ֤שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י וָ/אֲדַבֵּ֧ר אֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם אַשְׁכֵּ֥ים וְ/דַבֵּ֖ר וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: mn shlsh 'shrh shnh ly'shyhv bn 'mvn mlkh yhvdh v'd hyvm hzh zh shlsh v'shrym shnh hyh dbr yhvh 'ly v'dbr 'lykhm 'shkhym vdbr vl' shm'tm
verses.translation: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁלַח֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵי/כֶ֜ם אֶֽת כָּל עֲבָדָ֧י/ו הַ/נְּבִאִ֛ים הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְ/שָׁלֹ֖חַ וְ/לֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא הִטִּיתֶ֥ם אֶֽת אָזְנְ/כֶ֖ם לִ/שְׁמֹֽעַ
verses.translit: vshlch yhvh 'lykhm 't khl 'bdyv hnb'ym hshkhm vshlch vl' shm'tm vl' htytm 't 'znkhm lshm'
verses.translation: And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.

verses.original: לֵ/אמֹ֗ר שֽׁוּבוּ נָ֞א אִ֣ישׁ מִ/דַּרְכּ֤/וֹ הָֽ/רָעָה֙ וּ/מֵ/רֹ֣עַ מַעַלְלֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/שְׁבוּ֙ עַל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָ/כֶ֖ם וְ/לַ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם לְ/מִן עוֹלָ֖ם וְ/עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: l'mr shvbv n' 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vmr' m'llykhm vshbv 'l h'dmh 'shr ntn yhvh lkhm vl'bvtykhm lmn 'vlm v'd 'vlm
verses.translation: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:

verses.original: וְ/אַל תֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְ/עָבְדָ֖/ם וּ/לְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא תַכְעִ֤יסוּ אוֹתִ/י֙ בְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א אָרַ֖ע לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'l tlkhv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym l'bdm vlhshtchvt lhm vl' tkh'ysv 'vty bm'shh ydykhm vl' 'r' lkhm
verses.translation: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא שְׁמַעְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה לְמַ֧עַן הכעסו/ני הַכְעִיסֵ֛/נִי בְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵי/כֶ֖ם לְ/רַ֥ע לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' shm'tm 'ly n'm yhvh lm'n hkh'svny hkh'ysny bm'shh ydykhm lr' lkhm
verses.translation: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD ; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת דְּבָרָֽ/י
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt y'n 'shr l' shm'tm 't dbry
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֣י שֹׁלֵ֡חַ וְ/לָקַחְתִּי֩ אֶת כָּל מִשְׁפְּח֨וֹת צָפ֜וֹן נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה וְ/אֶל נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֮ עַבְדִּ/י֒ וַ/הֲבִ֨אֹתִ֜י/ם עַל הָ/אָ֤רֶץ הַ/זֹּאת֙ וְ/עַל יֹ֣שְׁבֶ֔י/הָ וְ/עַ֛ל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה סָבִ֑יב וְ/הַ֣חֲרַמְתִּ֔י/ם וְ/שַׂמְתִּי/ם֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֣ה וְ/לִ/שְׁרֵקָ֔ה וּ/לְ/חָרְב֖וֹת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: hnny shlch vlqchty 't khl mshpchvt tspvn n'm yhvh v'l nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl 'bdy vhb'tym 'l h'rts hz't v'l yshbyh v'l khl hgvym h'lh sbyb vhchrmtym vshmtym lshmh vlshrqh vlchrbvt 'vlm
verses.translation: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD , and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.

verses.original: וְ/הַאֲבַדְתִּ֣י מֵ/הֶ֗ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְ/ק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְ/ק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה ק֥וֹל רֵחַ֖יִם וְ/א֥וֹר נֵֽר
verses.translit: vh'bdty mhm qvl shshvn vqvl shmchh qvl chtn vqvl khlh qvl rchym v'vr nr
verses.translation: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.

verses.original: וְ/הָֽיְתָה֙ כָּל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את לְ/חָרְבָּ֖ה לְ/שַׁמָּ֑ה וְ/עָ֨בְד֜וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ/אֵ֛לֶּה אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vhyth khl h'rts hz't lchrbh lshmh v'bdv hgvym h'lh 't mlkh bbl shb'ym shnh
verses.translation: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה כִ/מְלֹ֣אות שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֡ה אֶפְקֹ֣ד עַל מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֩ וְ/עַל הַ/גּ֨וֹי הַ/ה֧וּא נְאֻם יְהוָ֛ה אֶת עֲוֺנָ֖/ם וְ/עַל אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֥י אֹת֖/וֹ לְ/שִֽׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh khml'vt shb'ym shnh 'pqd 'l mlkh bbl v'l hgvy hhv' n'm yhvh 't 'vnm v'l 'rts khshdym vshmty 'tv lshmmvt 'vlm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD , for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.

verses.original: ו/הבאיתי וְ/הֵֽבֵאתִי֙ עַל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/הִ֔יא אֶת כָּל דְּבָרַ֖/י אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֣רְתִּי עָלֶ֑י/הָ אֵ֤ת כָּל הַ/כָּתוּב֙ בַּ/סֵּ֣פֶר הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נִבָּ֥א יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ עַל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vhb'yty vhb'ty 'l h'rts hhy' 't khl dbry 'shr dbrty 'lyh 't khl hkhtvb bspr hzh 'shr nb' yrmyhv 'l khl hgvym
verses.translation: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עָֽבְדוּ בָ֤/ם גַּם הֵ֨מָּה֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּ/מְלָכִ֖ים גְּדוֹלִ֑ים וְ/שִׁלַּמְתִּ֥י לָ/הֶ֛ם כְּ/פָעֳלָ֖/ם וּ/כְ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'bdv bm gm hmh gvym rbym vmlkhym gdvlym vshlmty lhm khp'lm vkhm'shh ydyhm
verses.translation: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵלַ֔/י קַ֠ח אֶת כּ֨וֹס הַ/יַּ֧יִן הַ/חֵמָ֛ה הַ/זֹּ֖את מִ/יָּדִ֑/י וְ/הִשְׁקִיתָ֤ה אֹת/וֹ֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י שֹׁלֵ֥חַ אוֹתְ/ךָ֖ אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'ly qch 't khvs hyyn hchmh hz't mydy vhshqyth 'tv 't khl hgvym 'shr 'nkhy shlch 'vtkh 'lyhm
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁת֕וּ וְ/הִֽתְגֹּֽעֲשׁ֖וּ וְ/הִתְהֹלָ֑לוּ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הַ/חֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י שֹׁלֵ֖חַ בֵּינֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshtv vhtg'shv vhthllv mpny hchrb 'shr 'nkhy shlch byntm
verses.translation: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקַּ֥ח אֶת הַ/כּ֖וֹס מִ/יַּ֣ד יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ/אַשְׁקֶה֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחַ֥/נִי יְהוָ֖ה אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'qch 't hkhvs myd yhvh v'shqh 't khl hgvym 'shr shlchny yhvh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Then took I the cup at the LORD’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:

verses.original: אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וְ/אֶת עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/אֶת מְלָכֶ֖י/הָ אֶת שָׂרֶ֑י/הָ לָ/תֵ֨ת אֹתָ֜/ם לְ/חָרְבָּ֧ה לְ/שַׁמָּ֛ה לִ/שְׁרֵקָ֥ה וְ/לִ/קְלָלָ֖ה כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 't yrvshlm v't 'ry yhvdh v't mlkhyh 't shryh ltt 'tm lchrbh lshmh lshrqh vlqllh khyvm hzh
verses.translation: To wit , Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;

verses.original: אֶת פַּרְעֹ֧ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֛יִם וְ/אֶת עֲבָדָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶת שָׂרָ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת כָּל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 't pr'h mlkh mtsrym v't 'bdyv v't shryv v't khl 'mv
verses.translation: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הָ/עֶ֔רֶב וְ/אֵ֕ת כָּל מַלְכֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הָ/ע֑וּץ וְ/אֵ֗ת כָּל מַלְכֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/אֶת אַשְׁקְל֤וֹן וְ/אֶת עַזָּה֙ וְ/אֶת עֶקְר֔וֹן וְ/אֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית אַשְׁדּֽוֹד
verses.translit: v't khl h'rb v't khl mlkhy 'rts h'vts v't khl mlkhy 'rts plshtym v't 'shqlvn v't 'zh v't 'qrvn v't sh'ryt 'shdvd
verses.translation: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,

verses.original: אֶת אֱד֥וֹם וְ/אֶת מוֹאָ֖ב וְ/אֶת בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: 't 'dvm v't mv'b v't bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל מַלְכֵי צֹ֔ר וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל מַלְכֵ֣י צִיד֑וֹן וְ/אֵת֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵ֥בֶר הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: v't khl mlkhy tsr v't khl mlkhy tsydvn v't mlkhy h'y 'shr b'br hym
verses.translation: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת דְּדָ֤ן וְ/אֶת תֵּימָא֙ וְ/אֶת בּ֔וּז וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל קְצוּצֵ֥י פֵאָֽה
verses.translit: v't ddn v't tym' v't bvz v't khl qtsvtsy p'h
verses.translation: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל מַלְכֵ֣י עֲרָ֑ב וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/עֶ֔רֶב הַ/שֹּׁכְנִ֖ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: v't khl mlkhy 'rb v't khl mlkhy h'rb hshkhnym bmdbr
verses.translation: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל מַלְכֵ֣י זִמְרִ֗י וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל מַלְכֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל מַלְכֵ֥י מָדָֽי
verses.translit: v't khl mlkhy zmry v't khl mlkhy 'ylm v't khl mlkhy mdy
verses.translation: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל מַלְכֵ֣י הַ/צָּפ֗וֹן הַ/קְּרֹבִ֤ים וְ/הָֽ/רְחֹקִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֔י/ו וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הַ/מַּמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה וּ/מֶ֥לֶךְ שֵׁשַׁ֖ךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֥ה אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v't khl mlkhy htspvn hqrbym vhrchqym 'ysh 'l 'chyv v't khl hmmlkhvt h'rts 'shr 'l pny h'dmh vmlkh shshkh yshth 'chryhm
verses.translation: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֡ם כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁת֤וּ וְ/שִׁכְרוּ֙ וּ/קְי֔וּ וְ/נִפְל֖וּ וְ/לֹ֣א תָק֑וּמוּ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הַ/חֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י שֹׁלֵ֖חַ בֵּינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l shtv vshkhrv vqyv vnplv vl' tqvmv mpny hchrb 'shr 'nkhy shlch bynykhm
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּ֧י יְמָאֲנ֛וּ לָ/קַֽחַת הַ/כּ֥וֹס מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֖ לִ/שְׁתּ֑וֹת וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שָׁת֥וֹ תִשְׁתּֽוּ
verses.translit: vhyh khy ym'nv lqcht hkhvs mydkh lshtvt v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shtv tshtv
verses.translation: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנֵּ֨ה בָ/עִ֜יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא שְׁמִ֣/י עָלֶ֗י/הָ אָֽנֹכִי֙ מֵחֵ֣ל לְ/הָרַ֔ע וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם הִנָּקֵ֣ה תִנָּק֑וּ לֹ֣א תִנָּק֔וּ כִּ֣י חֶ֗רֶב אֲנִ֤י קֹרֵא֙ עַל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: khy hnh b'yr 'shr nqr' shmy 'lyh 'nkhy mchl lhr' v'tm hnqh tnqv l' tnqv khy chrb 'ny qr' 'l khl yshby h'rts n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ תִּנָּבֵ֣א אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם יְהוָ֞ה מִ/מָּר֤וֹם יִשְׁאָג֙ וּ/מִ/מְּע֤וֹן קָדְשׁ/וֹ֙ יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֔/וֹ שָׁאֹ֤ג יִשְׁאַג֙ עַל נָוֵ֔/הוּ הֵידָד֙ כְּ/דֹרְכִ֣ים יַֽעֲנֶ֔ה אֶ֥ל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'th tnb' 'lyhm 't khl hdbrym h'lh v'mrt 'lyhm yhvh mmrvm ysh'g vmm'vn qdshv ytn qvlv sh'g ysh'g 'l nvhv hydd khdrkhym y'nh 'l khl yshby h'rts
verses.translation: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes , against all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.original: בָּ֤א שָׁאוֹן֙ עַד קְצֵ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽ/יהוָה֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם נִשְׁפָּ֥ט ה֖וּא לְ/כָל בָּשָׂ֑ר הָ/רְשָׁעִ֛ים נְתָנָ֥/ם לַ/חֶ֖רֶב נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: b' sh'vn 'd qtsh h'rts khy ryb lyhvh bgvym nshpt hv' lkhl bshr hrsh'ym ntnm lchrb n'm yhvh
verses.translation: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנֵּ֥ה רָעָ֛ה יֹצֵ֖את מִ/גּ֣וֹי אֶל גּ֑וֹי וְ/סַ֣עַר גָּד֔וֹל יֵע֖וֹר מִ/יַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnh r'h yts't mgvy 'l gvy vs'r gdvl y'vr myrkhty 'rts
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֞וּ חַֽלְלֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא מִ/קְצֵ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/עַד קְצֵ֣ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לֹ֣א יִסָּפְד֗וּ וְ/לֹ֤א יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְ/דֹ֛מֶן עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vhyv chlly yhvh byvm hhv' mqtsh h'rts v'd qtsh h'rts l' yspdv vl' y'spv vl' yqbrv ldmn 'l pny h'dmh yhyv
verses.translation: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.

verses.original: הֵילִ֨ילוּ הָ/רֹעִ֜ים וְ/זַעֲק֗וּ וְ/הִֽתְפַּלְּשׁוּ֙ אַדִּירֵ֣י הַ/צֹּ֔אן כִּֽי מָלְא֥וּ יְמֵי/כֶ֖ם לִ/טְב֑וֹחַ וּ/תְפוֹצ֣וֹתִי/כֶ֔ם וּ/נְפַלְתֶּ֖ם כִּ/כְלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה
verses.translit: hylylv hr'ym vz'qv vhtplshv 'dyry hts'n khy ml'v ymykhm ltbvch vtpvtsvtykhm vnpltm khkhly chmdh
verses.translation: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes , ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

verses.original: וְ/אָבַ֥ד מָנ֖וֹס מִן הָֽ/רֹעִ֑ים וּ/פְלֵיטָ֖ה מֵ/אַדִּירֵ֥י הַ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: v'bd mnvs mn hr'ym vplyth m'dyry hts'n
verses.translation: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

verses.original: ק֚וֹל צַעֲקַ֣ת הָֽ/רֹעִ֔ים וִֽ/ילְלַ֖ת אַדִּירֵ֣י הַ/צֹּ֑אן כִּֽי שֹׁדֵ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מַרְעִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: qvl ts'qt hr'ym vyllt 'dyry hts'n khy shdd yhvh 't mr'ytm
verses.translation: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.

verses.original: וְ/נָדַ֖מּוּ נְא֣וֹת הַ/שָּׁל֑וֹם מִ/פְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַף יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vndmv n'vt hshlvm mpny chrvn 'f yhvh
verses.translation: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD .

verses.original: עָזַ֥ב כַּ/כְּפִ֖יר סֻכּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי הָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצָ/ם֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵי֙ חֲר֣וֹן הַ/יּוֹנָ֔ה וּ/מִ/פְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'zb khkhpyr skhv khy hyth 'rtsm lshmh mpny chrvn hyvnh vmpny chrvn 'pv
verses.translation: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.

verses.original: בְּ/רֵאשִׁ֗ית מַמְלְכ֛וּת יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָה֙ הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: br'shyt mmlkhvt yhvyqym bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh hyh hdbr hzh m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD , saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עֲמֹד֮ בַּ/חֲצַ֣ר בֵּית יְהוָה֒ וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֞ עַל כָּל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה הַ/בָּאִים֙ לְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת בֵּית יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִ֖י/ךָ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם אַל תִּגְרַ֖ע דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'md bchtsr byt yhvh vdbrt 'l khl 'ry yhvdh hb'ym lhshtchvt byt yhvh 't khl hdbrym 'shr tsvytykh ldbr 'lyhm 'l tgr' dbr
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Stand in the court of the LORD’s house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD’s house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:

verses.original: אוּלַ֣י יִשְׁמְע֔וּ וְ/יָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִ/דַּרְכּ֣/וֹ הָ/רָעָ֑ה וְ/נִחַמְתִּ֣י אֶל הָ/רָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י חֹשֵׁב֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ/הֶ֔ם מִ/פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'vly yshm'v vyshbv 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vnchmty 'l hr'h 'shr 'nkhy chshb l'shvt lhm mpny r' m'llyhm
verses.translation: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔/י לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹרָתִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִ/פְנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh 'm l' tshm'v 'ly llkht btvrty 'shr ntty lpnykhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD ; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

verses.original: לִ/שְׁמֹ֗עַ עַל דִּבְרֵ֨י עֲבָדַ֣/י הַ/נְּבִאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁלֵ֣חַ אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְ/שָׁלֹ֖חַ וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: lshm' 'l dbry 'bdy hnb'ym 'shr 'nkhy shlch 'lykhm vhshkhm vshlch vl' shm'tm
verses.translation: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them , but ye have not hearkened;

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֛י אֶת הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּ֖ה כְּ/שִׁלֹ֑ה וְ/אֶת הָ/עִ֤יר ה/זאתה הַ/זֹּאת֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לִ/קְלָלָ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vntty 't hbyt hzh khshlh v't h'yr hz'th hz't 'tn lqllh lkhl gvyy h'rts
verses.translation: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֛וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְ/הַ/נְּבִאִ֖ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֑ם אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה בְּ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm'v hkhhnym vhnb'ym vkhl h'm 't yrmyhv mdbr 't hdbrym h'lh bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְּ/כַלּ֣וֹת יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ לְ/דַבֵּר֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לְ/דַבֵּ֖ר אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יִּתְפְּשׂ֨וּ אֹת֜/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְ/הַ/נְּבִאִ֛ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֥ם לֵ/אמֹ֖ר מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת
verses.translit: vyhy khkhlvt yrmyhv ldbr 't khl 'shr tsvh yhvh ldbr 'l khl h'm vytpshv 'tv hkhhnym vhnb'ym vkhl h'm l'mr mvt tmvt
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.

verses.original: מַדּוּעַ֩ נִבֵּ֨יתָ בְ/שֵׁם יְהוָ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כְּ/שִׁלוֹ֙ יִֽהְיֶה֙ הַ/בַּ֣יִת הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֛את תֶּחֱרַ֖ב מֵ/אֵ֣ין יוֹשֵׁ֑ב וַ/יִּקָּהֵ֧ל כָּל הָ/עָ֛ם אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בְּ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mdv' nbyt bshm yhvh l'mr khshlv yhyh hbyt hzh vh'yr hz't tchrb m'yn yvshb vyqhl khl h'm 'l yrmyhv bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD , saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֣וּ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֚ת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ מִ/בֵּית הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּֽשְׁב֛וּ בְּ/פֶ֥תַח שַֽׁעַר יְהוָ֖ה הֶ/חָדָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyshm'v shry yhvdh 't hdbrym h'lh vy'lv mbyt hmlkh byt yhvh vyshbv bptch sh'r yhvh hchdsh
verses.translation: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king’s house unto the house of the LORD , and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’s house .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְ/הַ/נְּבִאִים֙ אֶל הַ/שָּׂרִ֔ים וְ/אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מִשְׁפַּט מָ֨וֶת֙ לָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֤י נִבָּא֙ אֶל הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּ/אָזְנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv hkhhnym vhnb'ym 'l hshrym v'l khl h'm l'mr mshpt mvt l'ysh hzh khy nb' 'l h'yr hz't kh'shr shm'tm b'znykhm
verses.translation: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶל כָּל הַ/שָּׂרִ֔ים וְ/אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה שְׁלָחַ֗/נִי לְ/הִנָּבֵ֞א אֶל הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ וְ/אֶל הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'l khl hshrym v'l khl h'm l'mr yhvh shlchny lhnb' 'l hbyt hzh v'l h'yr hz't 't khl hdbrym 'shr shm'tm
verses.translation: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הֵיטִ֤יבוּ דַרְכֵי/כֶם֙ וּ/מַ֣עַלְלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/שִׁמְע֕וּ בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/יִנָּחֵ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th hytybv drkhykhm vm'llykhm vshm'v bqvl yhvh 'lhykhm vynchm yhvh 'l hr'h 'shr dbr 'lykhm
verses.translation: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֖י הִנְ/נִ֣י בְ/יֶדְ/כֶ֑ם עֲשׂוּ לִ֛/י כַּ/טּ֥וֹב וְ/כַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'ny hnny bydkhm 'shv ly khtvb vkhyshr b'ynykhm
verses.translation: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אִם מְמִתִ֣ים אַתֶּם֮ אֹתִ/י֒ כִּי דָ֣ם נָקִ֗י אַתֶּם֙ נֹתְנִ֣ים עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֶל הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֖את וְ/אֶל יֹשְׁבֶ֑י/הָ כִּ֣י בֶ/אֱמֶ֗ת שְׁלָחַ֤/נִי יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם לְ/דַבֵּר֙ בְּ/אָזְנֵי/כֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: 'kh yd' td'v khy 'm mmtym 'tm 'ty khy dm nqy 'tm ntnym 'lykhm v'l h'yr hz't v'l yshbyh khy b'mt shlchny yhvh 'lykhm ldbr b'znykhm 't khl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֔ם אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/אֶל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֑ים אֵין לָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַ/זֶּה֙ מִשְׁפַּט מָ֔וֶת כִּ֗י בְּ/שֵׁ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv hshrym vkhl h'm 'l hkhhnym v'l hnby'ym 'yn l'ysh hzh mshpt mvt khy bshm yhvh 'lhynv dbr 'lynv
verses.translation: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֣מוּ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִ/זִּקְנֵ֖י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֶל כָּל קְהַ֥ל הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyqmv 'nshym mzqny h'rts vy'mrv 'l khl qhl h'm l'mr
verses.translation: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,

verses.original: מיכיה מִיכָה֙ הַ/מּ֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔י הָיָ֣ה נִבָּ֔א בִּ/ימֵ֖י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל כָּל עַם֩ יְהוּדָ֨ה לֵ/אמֹ֜ר כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת צִיּ֞וֹן שָׂדֶ֤ה תֵֽחָרֵשׁ֙ וִ/ירוּשָׁלַ֨יִם֙ עִיִּ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְ/הַ֥ר הַ/בַּ֖יִת לְ/בָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר
verses.translit: mykhyh mykhh hmvrshty hyh nb' bymy chzqyhv mlkh yhvdh vy'mr 'l khl 'm yhvdh l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt tsyvn shdh tchrsh vyrvshlym 'yym thyh vhr hbyt lbmvt y'r
verses.translation: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

verses.original: הֶ/הָמֵ֣ת הֱ֠מִתֻ/הוּ חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְ/כָל יְהוּדָ֗ה הֲ/לֹא֮ יָרֵ֣א אֶת יְהוָה֒ וַ/יְחַל֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל הָ/רָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֣ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/אֲנַ֗חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים רָעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה עַל נַפְשׁוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: hhmt hmthv chzqyhv mlkh yhvdh vkhl yhvdh hl' yr' 't yhvh vychl 't pny yhvh vynchm yhvh 'l hr'h 'shr dbr 'lyhm v'nchnv 'shym r'h gdvlh 'l npshvtynv
verses.translation: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD , and besought the LORD , and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls. , and the: Heb. the face of the LORD , etc

verses.original: וְ/גַם אִ֗ישׁ הָיָ֤ה מִתְנַבֵּא֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֽוּרִיָּ֨הוּ֙ בֶּֽן שְׁמַעְיָ֔הוּ מִ/קִּרְיַ֖ת הַיְּעָרִ֑ים וַ/יִּנָּבֵ֞א עַל הָ/עִ֤יר הַ/זֹּאת֙ וְ/עַל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את כְּ/כֹ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vgm 'ysh hyh mtnb' bshm yhvh 'vryhv bn shm'yhv mqryt hy'rym vynb' 'l h'yr hz't v'l h'rts hz't khkhl dbry yrmyhv
verses.translation: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD , Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ יְ֠הוֹיָקִים וְ/כָל גִּבּוֹרָ֤י/ו וְ/כָל הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ אֶת דְּבָרָ֔י/ו וַ/יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ הֲמִית֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע אוּרִיָּ֨הוּ֙ וַ/יִּרָ֔א וַ/יִּבְרַ֖ח וַ/יָּבֹ֥א מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyshm' hmlkh yhvyqym vkhl gbvryv vkhl hshrym 't dbryv vybqsh hmlkh hmytv vyshm' 'vryhv vyr' vybrch vyb' mtsrym
verses.translation: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֛ים אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יִם אֵ֣ת אֶלְנָתָ֧ן בֶּן עַכְבּ֛וֹר וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אִתּ֖/וֹ אֶל מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh yhvyqym 'nshym mtsrym 't 'lntn bn 'khbvr v'nshym 'tv 'l mtsrym
verses.translation: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely , Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִ֨יאוּ אֶת אוּרִיָּ֜הוּ מִ/מִּצְרַ֗יִם וַ/יְבִאֻ֨/הוּ֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֔ים וַ/יַּכֵּ֖/הוּ בֶּ/חָ֑רֶב וַ/יַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת נִבְלָת֔/וֹ אֶל קִבְרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyvtsy'v 't 'vryhv mmtsrym vyb'hv 'l hmlkh yhvyqym vykhhv bchrb vyshlkh 't nbltv 'l qbry bny h'm
verses.translation: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

verses.original: אַ֗ךְ יַ֚ד אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁפָ֔ן הָיְתָ֖ה אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י תֵּת אֹת֥/וֹ בְ/יַד הָ/עָ֖ם לַ/הֲמִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'kh yd 'chyqm bn shpn hyth 't yrmyhv lblty tt 'tv byd h'm lhmytv
verses.translation: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

verses.original: בְּ/רֵאשִׁ֗ית מַמְלֶ֛כֶת יְהוֹיָקִ֥ם בֶּן יֹאושִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָ֞ה הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔ה מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: br'shyt mmlkht yhvyqm bn y'vshyhv mlkh yhvdh hyh hdbr hzh 'l yrmyh m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD , saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י עֲשֵׂ֣ה לְ/ךָ֔ מוֹסֵר֖וֹת וּ/מֹט֑וֹת וּ/נְתַתָּ֖/ם עַל צַוָּארֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'ly 'shh lkh mvsrvt vmtvt vnttm 'l tsv'rkh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck, said

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּחְתָּ/ם֩ אֶל מֶ֨לֶךְ אֱד֜וֹם וְ/אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֗ב וְ/אֶל מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וְ/אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ צֹ֖ר וְ/אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ צִיד֑וֹן בְּ/יַ֤ד מַלְאָכִים֙ הַ/בָּאִ֣ים יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֶל צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vshlchtm 'l mlkh 'dvm v'l mlkh mv'b v'l mlkh bny 'mvn v'l mlkh tsr v'l mlkh tsydvn byd ml'khym hb'ym yrvshlm 'l tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;

verses.original: וְ/צִוִּיתָ֣ אֹתָ֔/ם אֶל אֲדֹֽנֵי/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה תֹֽאמְר֖וּ אֶל אֲדֹֽנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vtsvyt 'tm 'l 'dnyhm l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l khh t'mrv 'l 'dnykhm
verses.translation: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֞י עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֶת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֶת הָ/אָדָ֤ם וְ/אֶת הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בְּ/כֹחִ/י֙ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל וּ/בִ/זְרוֹעִ֖/י הַ/נְּטוּיָ֑ה וּ/נְתַתִּ֕י/הָ לַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר יָשַׁ֥ר בְּ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'shyty 't h'rts 't h'dm v't hbhmh 'shr 'l pny h'rts bkhchy hgdvl vbzrv'y hntvyh vnttyh l'shr yshr b'yny
verses.translation: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ נָתַ֨תִּי֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/אֲרָצ֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה בְּ/יַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל עַבְדִּ֑/י וְ/גַם֙ אֶת חַיַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה נָתַ֥תִּי ל֖/וֹ לְ/עָבְדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'th 'nkhy ntty 't khl h'rtsvt h'lh byd nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl 'bdy vgm 't chyt hshdh ntty lv l'bdv
verses.translation: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.

verses.original: וְ/עָבְד֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/אֶת בְּנ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶֽת בֶּן בְּנ֑/וֹ עַ֣ד בֹּא עֵ֤ת אַרְצ/וֹ֙ גַּם ה֔וּא וְ/עָ֤בְדוּ ב/וֹ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּ/מְלָכִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים
verses.translit: v'bdv 'tv khl hgvym v't bnv v't bn bnv 'd b' 't 'rtsv gm hv' v'bdv bv gvym rbym vmlkhym gdlym
verses.translation: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה הַ/גּ֜וֹי וְ/הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יַעַבְד֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ אֶת נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/אֵ֨ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יִתֵּן֙ אֶת צַוָּאר֔/וֹ בְּ/עֹ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל בַּ/חֶרֶב֩ וּ/בָ/רָעָ֨ב וּ/בַ/דֶּ֜בֶר אֶפְקֹ֨ד עַל הַ/גּ֤וֹי הַ/הוּא֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה עַד תֻּמִּ֥/י אֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh hgvy vhmmlkhh 'shr l' y'bdv 'tv 't nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl v't 'shr l' ytn 't tsv'rv b'l mlkh bbl bchrb vbr'b vbdbr 'pqd 'l hgvy hhv' n'm yhvh 'd tmy 'tm bydv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD , with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

verses.original: וְ֠/אַתֶּם אַל תִּשְׁמְע֨וּ אֶל נְבִיאֵי/כֶ֜ם וְ/אֶל קֹֽסְמֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/אֶל֙ חֲלֹמֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֶל עֹֽנְנֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/אֶל כַּשָּׁפֵי/כֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁר הֵ֞ם אֹמְרִ֤ים אֲלֵי/כֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תַעַבְד֖וּ אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: v'tm 'l tshm'v 'l nby'ykhm v'l qsmykhm v'l chlmtykhm v'l 'nnykhm v'l khshpykhm 'shr hm 'mrym 'lykhm l'mr l' t'bdv 't mlkh bbl
verses.translation: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:

verses.original: כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖ם נִבְּאִ֣ים לָ/כֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן הַרְחִ֤יק אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל אַדְמַתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִדַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם וַ/אֲבַדְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: khy shqr hm nb'ym lkhm lm'n hrchyq 'tkhm m'l 'dmtkhm vhdchty 'tkhm v'bdtm
verses.translation: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/גּ֗וֹי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבִ֧יא אֶת צַוָּאר֛/וֹ בְּ/עֹ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וַֽ/עֲבָד֑/וֹ וְ/הִנַּחְתִּ֤י/ו עַל אַדְמָת/וֹ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וַֽ/עֲבָדָ֖/הּ וְ/יָ֥שַׁב בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhgvy 'shr yby' 't tsv'rv b'l mlkh bbl v'bdv vhnchtyv 'l 'dmtv n'm yhvh v'bdh vyshb bh
verses.translation: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD ; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל צִדְקִיָּ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי כְּ/כָל הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הָבִ֨יאוּ אֶת צַוְּארֵי/כֶ֜ם בְּ/עֹ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֗ל וְ/עִבְד֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/עַמּ֖/וֹ וִֽ/חְיֽוּ
verses.translit: v'l tsdqyh mlkh yhvdh dbrty khkhl hdbrym h'lh l'mr hby'v 't tsv'rykhm b'l mlkh bbl v'bdv 'tv v'mv vchyv
verses.translation: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה תָמ֨וּתוּ֙ אַתָּ֣ה וְ/עַמֶּ֔/ךָ בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב בָּ/רָעָ֣ב וּ/בַ/דָּ֑בֶר֙ כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל הַ/גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: lmh tmvtv 'th v'mkh bchrb br'b vbdbr kh'shr dbr yhvh 'l hgvy 'shr l' y'bd 't mlkh bbl
verses.translation: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

verses.original: וְ/אַֽל תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ אֶל דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/נְּבִאִ֗ים הָ/אֹמְרִ֤ים אֲלֵי/כֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תַעַבְד֖וּ אֶת מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖ם נִבְּאִ֥ים לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'l tshm'v 'l dbry hnb'ym h'mrym 'lykhm l'mr l' t'bdv 't mlkh bbl khy shqr hm nb'ym lkhm
verses.translation: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א שְׁלַחְתִּי/ם֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הֵ֛ם נִבְּאִ֥ים בִּ/שְׁמִ֖/י לַ/שָּׁ֑קֶר לְמַ֨עַן הַדִּיחִ֤/י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ וַ/אֲבַדְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֕ם וְ/הַ/נְּבִאִ֖ים הַֽ/נִּבְּאִ֥ים לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy l' shlchtym n'm yhvh vhm nb'ym bshmy lshqr lm'n hdychy 'tkhm v'bdtm 'tm vhnb'ym hnb'ym lkhm
verses.translation: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD , yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֩ וְ/אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֨ם הַ/זֶּ֜ה דִּבַּ֣רְתִּי לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ אַֽל תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ אֶל דִּבְרֵ֣י נְבִֽיאֵי/כֶ֗ם הַֽ/נִּבְּאִ֤ים לָ/כֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֨ה כְלֵ֧י בֵית יְהוָ֛ה מוּשָׁבִ֥ים מִ/בָּבֶ֖לָ/ה עַתָּ֣ה מְהֵרָ֑ה כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖מָּה נִבְּאִ֥ים לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'l hkhhnym v'l khl h'm hzh dbrty l'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'l tshm'v 'l dbry nby'ykhm hnb'ym lkhm l'mr hnh khly byt yhvh mvshbym mbblh 'th mhrh khy shqr hmh nb'ym lkhm
verses.translation: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD ; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD’s house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

verses.original: אַל תִּשְׁמְע֣וּ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם עִבְד֥וּ אֶת מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וִֽ/חְי֑וּ לָ֧/מָּה תִֽהְיֶ֛ה הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֖את חָרְבָּֽה
verses.translit: 'l tshm'v 'lyhm 'bdv 't mlkh bbl vchyv lmh thyh h'yr hz't chrbh
verses.translation: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?

verses.original: וְ/אִם נְבִאִ֣ים הֵ֔ם וְ/אִם יֵ֥שׁ דְּבַר יְהוָ֖ה אִתָּ֑/ם יִפְגְּעוּ נָא֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לְ/בִלְתִּי בֹ֜אוּ הַ/כֵּלִ֣ים הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֣ים בְּ/בֵית יְהוָ֗ה וּ/בֵ֨ית מֶ֧לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֛ה וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: v'm nb'ym hm v'm ysh dbr yhvh 'tm ypg'v n' byhvh tsb'vt lblty b'v hkhlym hnvtrym bbyt yhvh vbyt mlkh yhvdh vbyrvshlm bblh
verses.translation: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD , and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֶל הָֽ/עַמֻּדִ֔ים וְ/עַל הַ/יָּ֖ם וְ/עַל הַ/מְּכֹנ֑וֹת וְ/עַל֙ יֶ֣תֶר הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֖ים בָּ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'l h'mdym v'l hym v'l hmkhnvt v'l ytr hkhlym hnvtrym b'yr hz't
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא לְקָחָ֗/ם נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בַּ֠/גְלוֹת/וֹ אֶת יְכָונְיָ֨ה בֶן יְהוֹיָקִ֧ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֛ה מִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶ֑לָ/ה וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל חֹרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'shr l' lqchm nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl bglvtv 't ykhvnyh bn yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh myrvshlm bblh v't khl chry yhvdh vyrvshlm
verses.translation: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַל הַ/כֵּלִ֗ים הַ/נּֽוֹתָרִים֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וּ/בֵ֥ית מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'l hkhlym hnvtrym byt yhvh vbyt mlkh yhvdh vyrvshlm
verses.translation: Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the LORD , and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;

verses.original: בָּבֶ֥לָ/ה יוּבָ֖אוּ וְ/שָׁ֣מָּ/ה יִֽהְי֑וּ עַ֠ד י֣וֹם פָּקְדִ֤/י אֹתָ/ם֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הַֽעֲלִיתִי/ם֙ וַ/הֲשִׁ֣יבֹתִ֔י/ם אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: bblh yvb'v vshmh yhyv 'd yvm pqdy 'tm n'm yhvh vh'lytym vhshybtym 'l hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD ; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/הִ֗יא בְּ/רֵאשִׁית֙ מַמְלֶ֨כֶת֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה ב/שנת בַּ/שָּׁנָה֙ הָֽ/רְבִעִ֔ית בַּ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֑י אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֡/י חֲנַנְיָה֩ בֶן עַזּ֨וּר הַ/נָּבִ֜יא אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִ/גִּבְעוֹן֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְ/עֵינֵ֧י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hhy' br'shyt mmlkht tsdqyh mlkh yhvdh bshnt bshnh hrb'yt bchdsh hchmyshy 'mr 'ly chnnyh bn 'zvr hnby' 'shr mgb'vn bbyt yhvh l'yny hkhhnym vkhl h'm l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD , in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר שָׁבַ֞רְתִּי אֶת עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l l'mr shbrty 't 'l mlkh bbl
verses.translation: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.original: בְּ/ע֣וֹד שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֗ים אֲנִ֤י מֵשִׁיב֙ אֶל הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לָקַ֜ח נְבוּכַדנֶאצַּ֤ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ מִן הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וַ/יְבִיאֵ֖/ם בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: b'vd shntym ymym 'ny mshyb 'l hmqvm hzh 't khl khly byt yhvh 'shr lqch nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl mn hmqvm hzh vyby'm bbl
verses.translation: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’s house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת יְכָנְיָ֣ה בֶן יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְ֠הוּדָה וְ/אֶת כָּל גָּל֨וּת יְהוּדָ֜ה הַ/בָּאִ֣ים בָּבֶ֗לָ/ה אֲנִ֥י מֵשִׁ֛יב אֶל הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י אֶשְׁבֹּ֔ר אֶת עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: v't ykhnyh bn yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh v't khl glvt yhvdh hb'ym bblh 'ny mshyb 'l hmqvm hzh n'm yhvh khy 'shbr 't 'l mlkh bbl
verses.translation: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD : for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אֶל חֲנַנְיָ֖ה הַ/נָּבִ֑יא לְ/עֵינֵ֤י הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וּ/לְ/עֵינֵ֣י כָל הָ/עָ֔ם הָ/עֹמְדִ֖ים בְּ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyh hnby' 'l chnnyh hnby' l'yny hkhhnym vl'yny khl h'm h'mdym bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD ,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אָמֵ֕ן כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה יָקֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֶת דְּבָרֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִבֵּ֗אתָ לְ/הָשִׁ֞יב כְּלֵ֤י בֵית יְהוָה֙ וְ/כָל הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה מִ/בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyh hnby' 'mn khn y'shh yhvh yqm yhvh 't dbrykh 'shr nb't lhshyb khly byt yhvh vkhl hgvlh mbbl 'l hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’s house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.

verses.original: אַךְ שְׁמַֽע נָא֙ הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֣ר בְּ/אָזְנֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/בְ/אָזְנֵ֖י כָּל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: 'kh shm' n' hdbr hzh 'shr 'nkhy dbr b'znykh vb'zny khl h'm
verses.translation: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;

verses.original: הַ/נְּבִיאִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֧וּ לְ/פָנַ֛/י וּ/לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ מִן הָֽ/עוֹלָ֑ם וַ/יִּנָּ֨בְא֜וּ אֶל אֲרָצ֤וֹת רַבּוֹת֙ וְ/עַל מַמְלָכ֣וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת לְ/מִלְחָמָ֖ה וּ/לְ/רָעָ֥ה וּ/לְ/דָֽבֶר
verses.translit: hnby'ym 'shr hyv lpny vlpnykh mn h'vlm vynb'v 'l 'rtsvt rbvt v'l mmlkhvt gdlvt lmlchmh vlr'h vldbr
verses.translation: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

verses.original: הַ/נָּבִ֕יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנָּבֵ֖א לְ/שָׁל֑וֹם בְּ/בֹא֙ דְּבַ֣ר הַ/נָּבִ֗יא יִוָּדַע֙ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָח֥/וֹ יְהוָ֖ה בֶּ/אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: hnby' 'shr ynb' lshlvm bb' dbr hnby' yvd' hnby' 'shr shlchv yhvh b'mt
verses.translation: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח חֲנַנְיָ֤ה הַ/נָּבִיא֙ אֶת הַ/מּוֹטָ֔ה מֵ/עַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַ/נָּבִ֑יא וַֽ/יִּשְׁבְּרֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyqch chnnyh hnby' 't hmvth m'l tsv'r yrmyh hnby' vyshbrhv
verses.translation: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and brake it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חֲנַנְיָה֩ לְ/עֵינֵ֨י כָל הָ/עָ֜ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ כָּ֣כָה אֶשְׁבֹּ֞ר אֶת עֹ֣ל נְבֻֽכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֗ל בְּ/עוֹד֙ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֔ים מֵ/עַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וַ/יֵּ֛לֶךְ יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לְ/דַרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr chnnyh l'yny khl h'm l'mr khh 'mr yhvh khkhh 'shbr 't 'l nbkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl b'vd shntym ymym m'l tsv'r khl hgvym vylkh yrmyh hnby' ldrkhv
verses.translation: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD ; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֑ה אַ֠חֲרֵי שְׁב֞וֹר חֲנַנְיָ֤ה הַ/נָּבִיא֙ אֶת הַ/מּוֹטָ֔ה מֵ/עַ֗ל צַוַּ֛אר יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyh 'chry shbvr chnnyh hnby' 't hmvth m'l tsv'r yrmyh hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the prophet , after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

verses.original: הָלוֹךְ֩ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֨ אֶל חֲנַנְיָ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מוֹטֹ֥ת עֵ֖ץ שָׁבָ֑רְתָּ וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ תַחְתֵּי/הֶ֖ן מֹט֥וֹת בַּרְזֶֽל
verses.translit: hlvkh v'mrt 'l chnnyh l'mr khh 'mr yhvh mvtt 'ts shbrt v'shyt tchtyhn mtvt brzl
verses.translation: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD ; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֹ֣ל בַּרְזֶ֡ל נָתַ֜תִּי עַל צַוַּ֣אר כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה לַ/עֲבֹ֛ד אֶת נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וַ/עֲבָדֻ֑/הוּ וְ/גַ֛ם אֶת חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה נָתַ֥תִּי לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'l brzl ntty 'l tsv'r khl hgvym h'lh l'bd 't nbkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl v'bdhv vgm 't chyt hshdh ntty lv
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֧ה הַ/נָּבִ֛יא אֶל חֲנַנְיָ֥ה הַ/נָּבִ֖יא שְׁמַֽע נָ֣א חֲנַנְיָ֑ה לֹֽא שְׁלָחֲ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אַתָּ֗ה הִבְטַ֛חְתָּ אֶת הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה עַל שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyh hnby' 'l chnnyh hnby' shm' n' chnnyh l' shlchkh yhvh v'th hbtcht 't h'm hzh 'l shqr
verses.translation: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִי֙ מְשַֽׁלֵּֽחֲ/ךָ֔ מֵ/עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה הַ/שָּׁנָה֙ אַתָּ֣ה מֵ֔ת כִּֽי סָרָ֥ה דִבַּ֖רְתָּ אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny mshlchkh m'l pny h'dmh hshnh 'th mt khy srh dbrt 'l yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛מָת חֲנַנְיָ֥ה הַ/נָּבִ֖יא בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/הִ֑יא בַּ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: vymt chnnyh hnby' bshnh hhy' bchdsh hshby'y
verses.translation: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/סֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלַ֛ח יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַ/נָּבִ֖יא מִ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֶל יֶ֜תֶר זִקְנֵ֣י הַ/גּוֹלָ֗ה וְ/אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְ/אֶל הַ/נְּבִיאִים֙ וְ/אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶגְלָ֧ה נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֛ר מִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: v'lh dbry hspr 'shr shlch yrmyh hnby' myrvshlm 'l ytr zqny hgvlh v'l hkhhnym v'l hnby'ym v'l khl h'm 'shr hglh nbvkhdn'tsr myrvshlm bblh
verses.translation: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י צֵ֣את יְכָנְיָֽה הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ וְ/הַ/גְּבִירָ֨ה וְ/הַ/סָּרִיסִ֜ים שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֧ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְ/הֶ/חָרָ֥שׁ וְ/הַ/מַּסְגֵּ֖ר מִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'chry ts't ykhnyh hmlkh vhgbyrh vhsrysym shry yhvdh vyrvshlm vhchrsh vhmsgr myrvshlm
verses.translation: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)

verses.original: בְּ/יַד֙ אֶלְעָשָׂ֣ה בֶן שָׁפָ֔ן וּ/גְמַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן חִלְקִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֜ח צִדְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֛ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בָּבֶ֥לָ/ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: byd 'l'shh bn shpn vgmryh bn chlqyh 'shr shlch tsdqyh mlkh yhvdh 'l nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl bblh l'mr
verses.translation: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ/כָל הַ֨/גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הִגְלֵ֥יתִי מִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l lkhl hgvlh 'shr hglyty myrvshlm bblh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;

verses.original: בְּנ֥וּ בָתִּ֖ים וְ/שֵׁ֑בוּ וְ/נִטְע֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְ/אִכְל֖וּ אֶת פִּרְיָֽ/ן
verses.translit: bnv btym vshbv vnt'v gnvt v'khlv 't pryn
verses.translation: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;

verses.original: קְח֣וּ נָשִׁ֗ים וְ/הוֹלִידוּ֮ בָּנִ֣ים וּ/בָנוֹת֒ וּ/קְח֨וּ לִ/בְנֵי/כֶ֜ם נָשִׁ֗ים וְ/אֶת בְּנֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ תְּנ֣וּ לַֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְ/תֵלַ֖דְנָה בָּנִ֣ים וּ/בָנ֑וֹת וּ/רְבוּ שָׁ֖ם וְ/אַל תִּמְעָֽטוּ
verses.translit: qchv nshym vhvlydv bnym vbnvt vqchv lbnykhm nshym v't bnvtykhm tnv l'nshym vtldnh bnym vbnvt vrbv shm v'l tm'tv
verses.translation: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.

verses.original: וְ/דִרְשׁ֞וּ אֶת שְׁל֣וֹם הָ/עִ֗יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִגְלֵ֤יתִי אֶתְ/כֶם֙ שָׁ֔מָּ/ה וְ/הִתְפַּֽלְל֥וּ בַעֲדָ֖/הּ אֶל יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י בִ/שְׁלוֹמָ֔/הּ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vdrshv 't shlvm h'yr 'shr hglyty 'tkhm shmh vhtpllv b'dh 'l yhvh khy bshlvmh yhyh lkhm shlvm
verses.translation: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַל יַשִּׁ֧יאוּ לָ/כֶ֛ם נְבִֽיאֵי/כֶ֥ם אֲשֶׁר בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֖ם וְ/קֹֽסְמֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/אַֽל תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל חֲלֹמֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם מַחְלְמִֽים
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'l yshy'v lkhm nby'ykhm 'shr bqrbkhm vqsmykhm v'l tshm'v 'l chlmtykhm 'shr 'tm mchlmym
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ/שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֛ם נִבְּאִ֥ים לָ/כֶ֖ם בִּ/שְׁמִ֑/י לֹ֥א שְׁלַחְתִּ֖י/ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy bshqr hm nb'ym lkhm bshmy l' shlchtym n'm yhvh
verses.translation: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּֽי כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֠י לְ/פִ֞י מְלֹ֧את לְ/בָבֶ֛ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה אֶפְקֹ֣ד אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֤י עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ אֶת דְּבָרִ֣/י הַ/טּ֔וֹב לְ/הָשִׁ֣יב אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh khy lpy ml't lbbl shb'ym shnh 'pqd 'tkhm vhqmty 'lykhm 't dbry htvb lhshyb 'tkhm 'l hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD , That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אָנֹכִ֨י יָדַ֜עְתִּי אֶת הַ/מַּחֲשָׁבֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י חֹשֵׁ֥ב עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה מַחְשְׁב֤וֹת שָׁלוֹם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א לְ/רָעָ֔ה לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/כֶ֖ם אַחֲרִ֥ית וְ/תִקְוָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'nkhy yd'ty 't hmchshbt 'shr 'nkhy chshb 'lykhm n'm yhvh mchshbvt shlvm vl' lr'h ltt lkhm 'chryt vtqvh
verses.translation: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD , thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

verses.original: וּ/קְרָאתֶ֤ם אֹתִ/י֙ וַֽ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וְ/הִתְפַּלַּלְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָ֑/י וְ/שָׁמַעְתִּ֖י אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vqr'tm 'ty vhlkhtm vhtplltm 'ly vshm'ty 'lykhm
verses.translation: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.

verses.original: וּ/בִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֹתִ֖/י וּ/מְצָאתֶ֑ם כִּ֥י תִדְרְשֻׁ֖/נִי בְּ/כָל לְבַבְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbqshtm 'ty vmts'tm khy tdrshny bkhl lbbkhm
verses.translation: And ye shall seek me, and find me , when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

verses.original: וְ/נִמְצֵ֣אתִי לָ/כֶם֮ נְאֻם יְהוָה֒ וְ/שַׁבְתִּ֣י אֶת שבית/כם שְׁבוּתְ/כֶ֗ם וְ/קִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶ֠תְ/כֶם מִֽ/כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֞ם וּ/מִ/כָּל הַ/מְּקוֹמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִדַּ֧חְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם שָׁ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וַ/הֲשִׁבֹתִ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֶל הַ֨/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר הִגְלֵ֥יתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/שָּֽׁם
verses.translit: vnmts'ty lkhm n'm yhvh vshbty 't shbytkhm shbvtkhm vqbtsty 'tkhm mkhl hgvym vmkhl hmqvmvt 'shr hdchty 'tkhm shm n'm yhvh vhshbty 'tkhm 'l hmqvm 'shr hglyty 'tkhm mshm
verses.translation: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD : and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD ; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.

verses.original: כִּ֖י אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם הֵקִ֨ים לָ֧/נוּ יְהוָ֛ה נְבִאִ֖ים בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: khy 'mrtm hqym lnv yhvh nb'ym bblh
verses.translation: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;

verses.original: כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/יּוֹשֵׁב֙ אֶל כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֔ד וְ/אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם הַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֑את אֲחֵי/כֶ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא יָצְא֥וּ אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם בַּ/גּוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'l hmlkh hyvshb 'l khs' dvd v'l khl h'm hyvshb b'yr hz't 'chykhm 'shr l' yts'v 'tkhm bgvlh
verses.translation: Know that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְ/נִי֙ מְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ בָּ֔/ם אֶת הַ/חֶ֖רֶב אֶת הָ/רָעָ֣ב וְ/אֶת הַ/דָּ֑בֶר וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֗/ם כַּ/תְּאֵנִים֙ הַ/שֹּׁ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵ/רֹֽעַ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnny mshlch bm 't hchrb 't hr'b v't hdbr vntty 'vtm kht'nym hsh'rym 'shr l' t'khlnh mr'
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

verses.original: וְ/רָֽדַפְתִּי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶ֔ם בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב בָּ/רָעָ֣ב וּ/בַ/דָּ֑בֶר וּ/נְתַתִּ֨י/ם ל/זועה לְ/זַעֲוָ֜ה לְ/כֹ֣ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ לְ/אָלָ֤ה וּ/לְ/שַׁמָּה֙ וְ/לִ/שְׁרֵקָ֣ה וּ/לְ/חֶרְפָּ֔ה בְּ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר הִדַּחְתִּ֥י/ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vrdpty 'chryhm bchrb br'b vbdbr vnttym lzv'h lz'vh lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts l'lh vlshmh vlshrqh vlchrph bkhl hgvym 'shr hdchtym shm
verses.translation: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
