verses.original: תַּ֛חַת אֲשֶֽׁר לֹא שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶל דְּבָרַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתִּי אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם אֶת עֲבָדַ֤/י הַ/נְּבִאִים֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְ/שָׁלֹ֔חַ וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: tcht 'shr l' shm'v 'l dbry n'm yhvh 'shr shlchty 'lyhm 't 'bdy hnb'ym hshkhm vshlch vl' shm'tm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD , which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֑ה כָּל הַ֨/גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי מִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: v'tm shm'v dbr yhvh khl hgvlh 'shr shlchty myrvshlm bblh
verses.translation: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD , all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל אַחְאָ֤ב בֶּן קֽוֹלָיָה֙ וְ/אֶל צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן מַֽעֲשֵׂיָ֔ה הַֽ/נִּבְּאִ֥ים לָ/כֶ֛ם בִּ/שְׁמִ֖/י שָׁ֑קֶר הִנְ/נִ֣י נֹתֵ֣ן אֹתָ֗/ם בְּ/יַד֙ נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/הִכָּ֖/ם לְ/עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'l 'ch'b bn qvlyh v'l tsdqyhv bn m'shyh hnb'ym lkhm bshmy shqr hnny ntn 'tm byd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl vhkhm l'ynykhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;

verses.original: וְ/לֻקַּ֤ח מֵ/הֶם֙ קְלָלָ֔ה לְ/כֹל֙ גָּל֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/בָבֶ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יְשִֽׂמְ/ךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ כְּ/צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ וּ/כְ/אֶחָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר קָלָ֥/ם מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vlqch mhm qllh lkhl glvt yhvdh 'shr bbbl l'mr yshmkh yhvh khtsdqyhv vkh'chb 'shr qlm mlkh bbl b'sh
verses.translation: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

verses.original: יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשׂ֨וּ נְבָלָ֜ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַ/יְנַֽאֲפוּ֙ אֶת נְשֵׁ֣י רֵֽעֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יְדַבְּר֨וּ דָבָ֤ר בִּ/שְׁמִ/י֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר ל֣וֹא צִוִּיתִ֑/ם וְ/אָנֹכִ֛י הו ידע הַ/יּוֹדֵ֥עַ וָ/עֵ֖ד נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: y'n 'shr 'shv nblh byshr'l vyn'pv 't nshy r'yhm vydbrv dbr bshmy shqr 'shr lv' tsvytm v'nkhy hv yd' hyvd' v'd n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אֶל שְׁמַעְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נֶּחֱלָמִ֖י תֹּאמַ֥ר לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'l shm'yhv hnchlmy t'mr l'mr
verses.translation: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּה֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתָּ בְ/שִׁמְ/כָ֜ה סְפָרִ֗ים אֶל כָּל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/אֶל צְפַנְיָ֤ה בֶן מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/אֶ֥ל כָּל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l l'mr y'n 'shr 'th shlcht bshmkhh sprym 'l khl h'm 'shr byrvshlm v'l tspnyh bn m'shyh hkhhn v'l khl hkhhnym l'mr
verses.translation: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

verses.original: יְהוָ֞ה נְתָנְ/ךָ֣ כֹהֵ֗ן תַּ֚חַת יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן לִֽ/הְי֤וֹת פְּקִדִים֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְ/כָל אִ֥ישׁ מְשֻׁגָּ֖ע וּ/מִתְנַבֵּ֑א וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ה אֹת֛/וֹ אֶל הַ/מַּהְפֶּ֖כֶת וְ/אֶל הַ/צִּינֹֽק
verses.translit: yhvh ntnkh khhn tcht yhvyd' hkhhn lhyvt pqdym byt yhvh lkhl 'ysh mshg' vmtnb' vntth 'tv 'l hmhpkht v'l htsynq
verses.translation: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD , for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה לָ֚/מָּה לֹ֣א גָעַ֔רְתָּ בְּ/יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הָֽ/עֲנְּתֹתִ֑י הַ/מִּתְנַבֵּ֖א לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th lmh l' g'rt byrmyhv h'ntty hmtnb' lkhm
verses.translation: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַל כֵּ֞ן שָׁלַ֥ח אֵלֵ֛י/נוּ בָּבֶ֥ל לֵ/אמֹ֖ר אֲרֻכָּ֣ה הִ֑יא בְּנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְ/שֵׁ֔בוּ וְ/נִטְע֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְ/אִכְל֖וּ אֶת פְּרִי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: khy 'l khn shlch 'lynv bbl l'mr 'rkhh hy' bnv btym vshbv vnt'v gnvt v'khlv 't pryhn
verses.translation: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א צְפַנְיָ֥ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת הַ/סֵּ֣פֶר הַ/זֶּ֑ה בְּ/אָזְנֵ֖י יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִֽיא
verses.translit: vyqr' tspnyh hkhhn 't hspr hzh b'zny yrmyhv hnby'
verses.translation: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.original: שְׁלַ֤ח עַל כָּל הַ/גּוֹלָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל שְׁמַעְיָ֖ה הַ/נֶּחֱלָמִ֑י יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ נִבָּ֨א לָ/כֶ֜ם שְׁמַעְיָ֗ה וַֽ/אֲנִי֙ לֹ֣א שְׁלַחְתִּ֔י/ו וַ/יַּבְטַ֥ח אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם עַל שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: shlch 'l khl hgvlh l'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'l shm'yh hnchlmy y'n 'shr nb' lkhm shm'yh v'ny l' shlchtyv vybtch 'tkhm 'l shqr
verses.translation: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְ/נִ֨י פֹקֵ֜ד עַל שְׁמַעְיָ֣ה הַ/נֶּחֱלָמִי֮ וְ/עַל זַרְע/וֹ֒ לֹא יִהְיֶ֨ה ל֜/וֹ אִ֣ישׁ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּ/תוֹךְ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֗ה וְ/לֹֽא יִרְאֶ֥ה בַ/טּ֛וֹב אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶֽׂה לְ/עַמִּ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי סָרָ֥ה דִבֶּ֖ר עַל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny pqd 'l shm'yh hnchlmy v'l zr'v l' yhyh lv 'ysh yvshb btvkh h'm hzh vl' yr'h btvb 'shr 'ny 'shh l'my n'm yhvh khy srh dbr 'l yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD ; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD .

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD , saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כְּתָב לְ/ךָ֗ אֵ֧ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ אֶל סֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l l'mr khtb lkh 't khl hdbrym 'shr dbrty 'lykh 'l spr
verses.translation: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.

verses.original: כִּ֠י הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ֠/שַׁבְתִּי אֶת שְׁב֨וּת עַמִּ֧/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וִֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַ/הֲשִׁבֹתִ֗י/ם אֶל הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תִּי לַ/אֲבוֹתָ֖/ם וִֽ/ירֵשֽׁוּ/הָ
verses.translit: khy hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vshbty 't shbvt 'my yshr'l vyhvdh 'mr yhvh vhshbtym 'l h'rts 'shr ntty l'bvtm vyrshvh
verses.translation: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD : and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה הַ/דְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/אֶל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: v'lh hdbrym 'shr dbr yhvh 'l yshr'l v'l yhvdh
verses.translation: And these are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

verses.original: כִּי כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חֲרָדָ֖ה שָׁמָ֑עְנוּ פַּ֖חַד וְ/אֵ֥ין שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh qvl chrdh shm'nv pchd v'yn shlvm
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD ; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

verses.original: שַׁאֲלוּ נָ֣א וּ/רְא֔וּ אִם יֹלֵ֖ד זָכָ֑ר מַדּוּעַ֩ רָאִ֨יתִי כָל גֶּ֜בֶר יָדָ֤י/ו עַל חֲלָצָי/ו֙ כַּ/יּ֣וֹלֵדָ֔ה וְ/נֶהֶפְכ֥וּ כָל פָּנִ֖ים לְ/יֵרָקֽוֹן
verses.translit: sh'lv n' vr'v 'm yld zkhr mdv' r'yty khl gbr ydyv 'l chltsyv khyvldh vnhpkhv khl pnym lyrqvn
verses.translation: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

verses.original: ה֗וֹי כִּ֥י גָד֛וֹל הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא מֵ/אַ֣יִן כָּמֹ֑/הוּ וְ/עֵֽת צָרָ֥ה הִיא֙ לְ/יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּ/מִמֶּ֖/נָּה יִוָּשֵֽׁעַ
verses.translit: hvy khy gdvl hyvm hhv' m'yn khmhv v't tsrh hy' ly'qb vmmnh yvsh'
verses.translation: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אֶשְׁבֹּ֤ר עֻלּ/וֹ֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֔/ךָ וּ/מוֹסְרוֹתֶ֖י/ךָ אֲנַתֵּ֑ק וְ/לֹא יַעַבְדוּ ב֥/וֹ ע֖וֹד זָרִֽים
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tsb'vt 'shbr 'lv m'l tsv'rkh vmvsrvtykh 'ntq vl' y'bdv bv 'vd zrym
verses.translation: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:

verses.original: וְ/עָ֣בְד֔וּ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֵת֙ דָּוִ֣ד מַלְכָּ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָקִ֖ים לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'bdv 't yhvh 'lhyhm v't dvd mlkhm 'shr 'qym lhm
verses.translation: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֡ה אַל תִּירָא֩ עַבְדִּ֨/י יַעֲקֹ֤ב נְאֻם יְהֹוָה֙ וְ/אַל תֵּחַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י הִנְ/נִ֤י מוֹשִֽׁיעֲ/ךָ֙ מֵֽ/רָח֔וֹק וְ/אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֑/ם וְ/שָׁ֧ב יַעֲקֹ֛ב וְ/שָׁקַ֥ט וְ/שַׁאֲנַ֖ן וְ/אֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד
verses.translit: v'th 'l tyr' 'bdy y'qb n'm yhvh v'l tcht yshr'l khy hnny mvshy'kh mrchvq v't zr'kh m'rts shbym vshb y'qb vshqt vsh'nn v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD ; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.

verses.original: כִּֽי אִתְּ/ךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הֽוֹשִׁיעֶ֑/ךָ כִּי֩ אֶעֱשֶׂ֨ה כָלָ֜ה בְּ/כָֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֲפִצוֹתִ֣י/ךָ שָּׁ֗ם אַ֤ךְ אֹֽתְ/ךָ֙ לֹֽא אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה כָלָ֔ה וְ/יִסַּרְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְ/נַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֥א אֲנַקֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: khy 'tkh 'ny n'm yhvh lhvshy'kh khy ''shh khlh bkhl hgvym 'shr hptsvtykh shm 'kh 'tkh l' ''shh khlh vysrtykh lmshpt vnqh l' 'nqkh
verses.translation: For I am with thee, saith the LORD , to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אָנ֣וּשׁ לְ/שִׁבְרֵ֑/ךְ נַחְלָ֖ה מַכָּתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'nvsh lshbrkh nchlh mkhtkh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD , Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.

verses.original: אֵֽין דָּ֥ן דִּינֵ֖/ךְ לְ/מָז֑וֹר רְפֻא֥וֹת תְּעָלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'yn dn dynkh lmzvr rp'vt t'lh 'yn lkh
verses.translation: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.

verses.original: כָּל מְאַהֲבַ֣יִ/ךְ שְׁכֵח֔וּ/ךְ אוֹתָ֖/ךְ לֹ֣א יִדְרֹ֑שׁוּ כִּי֩ מַכַּ֨ת אוֹיֵ֤ב הִכִּיתִי/ךְ֙ מוּסַ֣ר אַכְזָרִ֔י עַ֚ל רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֵ֔/ךְ עָצְמ֖וּ חַטֹּאתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: khl m'hbykh shkhchvkh 'vtkh l' ydrshv khy mkht 'vyb hkhytykh mvsr 'khzry 'l rb 'vnkh 'tsmv cht'tykh
verses.translation: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.

verses.original: מַה תִּזְעַק֙ עַל שִׁבְרֵ֔/ךְ אָנ֖וּשׁ מַכְאֹבֵ֑/ךְ עַ֣ל רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֵ֗/ךְ עָֽצְמוּ֙ חַטֹּאתַ֔יִ/ךְ עָשִׂ֥יתִי אֵ֖לֶּה לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: mh tz'q 'l shbrkh 'nvsh mkh'bkh 'l rb 'vnkh 'tsmv cht'tykh 'shyty 'lh lkh
verses.translation: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כָּל אֹכְלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ יֵאָכֵ֔לוּ וְ/כָל צָרַ֥יִ/ךְ כֻּלָּ֖/ם בַּ/שְּׁבִ֣י יֵלֵ֑כוּ וְ/הָי֤וּ שֹׁאסַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ לִ/מְשִׁסָּ֔ה וְ/כָל בֹּזְזַ֖יִ/ךְ אֶתֵּ֥ן לָ/בַֽז
verses.translit: lkhn khl 'khlykh y'khlv vkhl tsrykh khlm bshby ylkhv vhyv sh'sykh lmshsh vkhl bzzykh 'tn lbz
verses.translation: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אַעֲלֶ֨ה אֲרֻכָ֥ה לָ֛/ךְ וּ/מִ/מַּכּוֹתַ֥יִ/ךְ אֶרְפָּאֵ֖/ךְ נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י נִדָּחָה֙ קָ֣רְאוּ לָ֔/ךְ צִיּ֣וֹן הִ֔יא דֹּרֵ֖שׁ אֵ֥ין לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy ''lh 'rkhh lkh vmmkhvtykh 'rp'kh n'm yhvh khy ndchh qr'v lkh tsyvn hy' drsh 'yn lh
verses.translation: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD ; because they called thee an Outcast, saying , This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְ/נִי שָׁב֙ שְׁבוּת֙ אָהֳלֵ֣י יַֽעֲק֔וֹב וּ/מִשְׁכְּנֹתָ֖י/ו אֲרַחֵ֑ם וְ/נִבְנְתָ֥ה עִיר֙ עַל תִּלָּ֔/הּ וְ/אַרְמ֖וֹן עַל מִשְׁפָּט֥/וֹ יֵשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnny shb shbvt 'hly y'qvb vmshkhntyv 'rchm vnbnth 'yr 'l tlh v'rmvn 'l mshptv yshb
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֥א מֵ/הֶ֛ם תּוֹדָ֖ה וְ/ק֣וֹל מְשַׂחֲקִ֑ים וְ/הִרְבִּתִי/ם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִמְעָ֔טוּ וְ/הִכְבַּדְתִּ֖י/ם וְ/לֹ֥א יִצְעָֽרוּ
verses.translit: vyts' mhm tvdh vqvl mshchqym vhrbtym vl' ym'tv vhkhbdtym vl' yts'rv
verses.translation: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֤וּ בָנָי/ו֙ כְּ/קֶ֔דֶם וַ/עֲדָת֖/וֹ לְ/פָנַ֣/י תִּכּ֑וֹן וּ/פָ֣קַדְתִּ֔י עַ֖ל כָּל לֹחֲצָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhyv bnyv khqdm v'dtv lpny tkhvn vpqdty 'l khl lchtsyv
verses.translation: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה אַדִּיר֜/וֹ מִמֶּ֗/נּוּ וּ/מֹֽשְׁל/וֹ֙ מִ/קִּרְבּ֣/וֹ יֵצֵ֔א וְ/הִקְרַבְתִּ֖י/ו וְ/נִגַּ֣שׁ אֵלָ֑/י כִּי֩ מִ֨י הוּא זֶ֜ה עָרַ֧ב אֶת לִבּ֛/וֹ לָ/גֶ֥שֶׁת אֵלַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh 'dyrv mmnv vmshlv mqrbv yts' vhqrbtyv vngsh 'ly khy my hv' zh 'rb 't lbv lgsht 'ly n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD .

verses.original: וִ/הְיִ֥יתֶם לִ֖/י לְ/עָ֑ם וְ/אָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vhyytm ly l'm v'nkhy 'hyh lkhm l'lhym
verses.translation: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה חֵמָה֙ יָֽצְאָ֔ה סַ֖עַר מִתְגּוֹרֵ֑ר עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים יָחֽוּל
verses.translit: hnh s'rt yhvh chmh yts'h s'r mtgvrr 'l r'sh rsh'ym ychvl
verses.translation: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.

verses.original: לֹ֣א יָשׁ֗וּב חֲרוֹן֙ אַף יְהוָ֔ה עַד עֲשֹׂת֥/וֹ וְ/עַד הֲקִימ֖/וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑/וֹ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֥ית הַ/יָּמִ֖ים תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: l' yshvb chrvn 'f yhvh 'd 'shtv v'd hqymv mzmvt lbv b'chryt hymym ttbvnnv bh
verses.translation: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done it , and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֤ת הַ/הִיא֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽהְיֶה֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים לְ/כֹ֖ל מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הֵ֖מָּה יִֽהְיוּ לִ֥/י לְ/עָֽם
verses.translit: b't hhy' n'm yhvh 'hyh l'lhym lkhl mshpchvt yshr'l vhmh yhyv ly l'm
verses.translation: At the same time, saith the LORD , will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מָצָ֥א חֵן֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר עַ֖ם שְׂרִ֣ידֵי חָ֑רֶב הָל֥וֹךְ לְ/הַרְגִּיע֖/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh mts' chn bmdbr 'm shrydy chrb hlvkh lhrgy'v yshr'l
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.

verses.original: מֵ/רָח֕וֹק יְהוָ֖ה נִרְאָ֣ה לִ֑/י וְ/אַהֲבַ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ אֲהַבְתִּ֔י/ךְ עַל כֵּ֖ן מְשַׁכְתִּ֥י/ךְ חָֽסֶד
verses.translit: mrchvq yhvh nr'h ly v'hbt 'vlm 'hbtykh 'l khn mshkhtykh chsd
verses.translation: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying , Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

verses.original: ע֤וֹד אֶבְנֵ/ךְ֙ וְֽ/נִבְנֵ֔ית בְּתוּלַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ע֚וֹד תַּעְדִּ֣י תֻפַּ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/יָצָ֖את בִּ/מְח֥וֹל מְשַׂחֲקִֽים
verses.translit: 'vd 'bnkh vnbnyt btvlt yshr'l 'vd t'dy tpykh vyts't bmchvl mshchqym
verses.translation: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.

verses.original: ע֚וֹד תִּטְּעִ֣י כְרָמִ֔ים בְּ/הָרֵ֖י שֹֽׁמְר֑וֹן נָטְע֥וּ נֹטְעִ֖ים וְ/חִלֵּֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'vd tt'y khrmym bhry shmrvn nt'v nt'ym vchllv
verses.translation: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֶשׁ י֔וֹם קָרְא֥וּ נֹצְרִ֖ים בְּ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם ק֚וּמוּ וְ/נַעֲלֶ֣ה צִיּ֔וֹן אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: khy ysh yvm qr'v ntsrym bhr 'prym qvmv vn'lh tsyvn 'l yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.

verses.original: כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה רָנּ֤וּ לְ/יַֽעֲקֹב֙ שִׂמְחָ֔ה וְ/צַהֲל֖וּ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם הַשְׁמִ֤יעוּ הַֽלְלוּ֙ וְ/אִמְר֔וּ הוֹשַׁ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶֽת עַמְּ/ךָ֔ אֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh rnv ly'qb shmchh vtshlv br'sh hgvym hshmy'v hllv v'mrv hvsh' yhvh 't 'mkh 't sh'ryt yshr'l
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD ; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD , save thy people, the remnant of Israel.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אוֹתָ֜/ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֗וֹן וְ/קִבַּצְתִּי/ם֮ מִ/יַּרְכְּתֵי אָרֶץ֒ בָּ֚/ם עִוֵּ֣ר וּ/פִסֵּ֔חַ הָרָ֥ה וְ/יֹלֶ֖דֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו קָהָ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל יָשׁ֥וּבוּ הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: hnny mby' 'vtm m'rts tspvn vqbtstym myrkhty 'rts bm 'vr vpsch hrh vyldt ychdv qhl gdvl yshvbv hnh
verses.translation: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.

verses.original: בִּ/בְכִ֣י יָבֹ֗אוּ וּֽ/בְ/תַחֲנוּנִים֮ אֽוֹבִילֵ/ם֒ אֽוֹלִיכֵ/ם֙ אֶל נַ֣חֲלֵי מַ֔יִם בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ יָשָׁ֔ר לֹ֥א יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ בָּ֑/הּ כִּֽי הָיִ֤יתִי לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/אָ֔ב וְ/אֶפְרַ֖יִם בְּכֹ֥רִ/י הֽוּא
verses.translit: bbkhy yb'v vbtchnvnym 'vbylm 'vlykhm 'l nchly mym bdrkh yshr l' ykhshlv bh khy hyyty lyshr'l l'b v'prym bkhry hv'
verses.translation: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ דְבַר יְהוָה֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ/אִיִּ֖ים מִ/מֶּרְחָ֑ק וְ/אִמְר֗וּ מְזָרֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְקַבְּצֶ֔/נּוּ וּ/שְׁמָר֖/וֹ כְּ/רֹעֶ֥ה עֶדְרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shm'v dbr yhvh gvym vhgydv b'yym mmrchq v'mrv mzrh yshr'l yqbtsnv vshmrv khr'h 'drv
verses.translation: Hear the word of the LORD , O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.

verses.original: כִּֽי פָדָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֑ב וּ/גְאָל֕/וֹ מִ/יַּ֖ד חָזָ֥ק מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: khy pdh yhvh 't y'qb vg'lv myd chzq mmnv
verses.translation: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.

verses.original: וּ/בָאוּ֮ וְ/רִנְּנ֣וּ בִ/מְרוֹם צִיּוֹן֒ וְ/נָהֲר֞וּ אֶל ט֣וּב יְהוָ֗ה עַל דָּגָן֙ וְ/עַל תִּירֹ֣שׁ וְ/עַל יִצְהָ֔ר וְ/עַל בְּנֵי צֹ֖אן וּ/בָקָ֑ר וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה נַפְשָׁ/ם֙ כְּ/גַ֣ן רָוֶ֔ה וְ/לֹא יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לְ/דַאֲבָ֖ה עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vb'v vrnnv bmrvm tsyvn vnhrv 'l tvb yhvh 'l dgn v'l tyrsh v'l ytshr v'l bny ts'n vbqr vhyth npshm khgn rvh vl' yvsypv ld'bh 'vd
verses.translation: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD , for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

verses.original: אָ֣ז תִּשְׂמַ֤ח בְּתוּלָה֙ בְּ/מָח֔וֹל וּ/בַחֻרִ֥ים וּ/זְקֵנִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וְ/הָפַכְתִּ֨י אֶבְלָ֤/ם לְ/שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְ/נִ֣חַמְתִּ֔י/ם וְ/שִׂמַּחְתִּ֖י/ם מִ/יגוֹנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'z tshmch btvlh bmchvl vbchrym vzqnym ychdv vhpkhty 'blm lshshvn vnchmtym vshmchtym mygvnm
verses.translation: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

verses.original: וְ/רִוֵּיתִ֛י נֶ֥פֶשׁ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים דָּ֑שֶׁן וְ/עַמִּ֛/י אֶת טוּבִ֥/י יִשְׂבָּ֖עוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vrvyty npsh hkhhnym dshn v'my 't tvby yshb'v n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בְּ/רָמָ֤ה נִשְׁמָע֙ נְהִי֙ בְּכִ֣י תַמְרוּרִ֔ים רָחֵ֖ל מְבַכָּ֣ה עַל בָּנֶ֑י/הָ מֵאֲנָ֛ה לְ/הִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל בָּנֶ֖י/הָ כִּ֥י אֵינֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh qvl brmh nshm' nhy bkhy tmrvrym rchl mbkhh 'l bnyh m'nh lhnchm 'l bnyh khy 'ynnv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה מִנְעִ֤י קוֹלֵ/ךְ֙ מִ/בֶּ֔כִי וְ/עֵינַ֖יִ/ךְ מִ/דִּמְעָ֑ה כִּי֩ יֵ֨שׁ שָׂכָ֤ר לִ/פְעֻלָּתֵ/ךְ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/שָׁ֖בוּ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh mn'y qvlkh mbkhy v'ynykh mdm'h khy ysh shkhr lp'ltkh n'm yhvh vshbv m'rts 'vyb
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD ; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

verses.original: וְ/יֵשׁ תִּקְוָ֥ה לְ/אַחֲרִיתֵ֖/ךְ נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/שָׁ֥בוּ בָנִ֖ים לִ/גְבוּלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vysh tqvh l'chrytkh n'm yhvh vshbv bnym lgbvlm
verses.translation: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD , that thy children shall come again to their own border.

verses.original: שָׁמ֣וֹעַ שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ מִתְנוֹדֵ֔ד יִסַּרְתַּ֨/נִי֙ וָֽ/אִוָּסֵ֔ר כְּ/עֵ֖גֶל לֹ֣א לֻמָּ֑ד הֲשִׁיבֵ֣/נִי וְ/אָשׁ֔וּבָה כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: shmv' shm'ty 'prym mtnvdd ysrtny v'vsr kh'gl l' lmd hshybny v'shvbh khy 'th yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the LORD my God.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַחֲרֵ֤י שׁוּבִ/י֙ נִחַ֔מְתִּי וְ/אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הִוָּ֣דְעִ֔/י סָפַ֖קְתִּי עַל יָרֵ֑ךְ בֹּ֚שְׁתִּי וְ/גַם נִכְלַ֔מְתִּי כִּ֥י נָשָׂ֖אתִי חֶרְפַּ֥ת נְעוּרָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'chry shvby nchmty v'chry hvd'y spqty 'l yrkh bshty vgm nkhlmty khy nsh'ty chrpt n'vry
verses.translation: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.

verses.original: הֲ/בֵן֩ יַקִּ֨יר לִ֜/י אֶפְרַ֗יִם אִ֚ם יֶ֣לֶד שַׁעֲשֻׁעִ֔ים כִּֽי מִ/דֵּ֤י דַבְּרִ/י֙ בּ֔/וֹ זָכֹ֥ר אֶזְכְּרֶ֖/נּוּ ע֑וֹד עַל כֵּ֗ן הָמ֤וּ מֵעַ/י֙ ל֔/וֹ רַחֵ֥ם אֲֽרַחֲמֶ֖/נּוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hbn yqyr ly 'prym 'm yld sh'sh'ym khy mdy dbry bv zkhr 'zkhrnv 'vd 'l khn hmv m'y lv rchm 'rchmnv n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הַצִּ֧יבִי לָ֣/ךְ צִיֻּנִ֗ים שִׂ֤מִי לָ/ךְ֙ תַּמְרוּרִ֔ים שִׁ֣תִי לִבֵּ֔/ךְ לַֽ/מְסִלָּ֖ה דֶּ֣רֶךְ הלכתי הָלָ֑כְתְּ שׁ֚וּבִי בְּתוּלַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֻׁ֖בִי אֶל עָרַ֥יִ/ךְ אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: htsyby lkh tsynym shmy lkh tmrvrym shty lbkh lmslh drkh hlkhty hlkht shvby btvlt yshr'l shby 'l 'rykh 'lh
verses.translation: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.

verses.original: עַד מָתַי֙ תִּתְחַמָּקִ֔י/ן הַ/בַּ֖ת הַ/שּֽׁוֹבֵבָ֑ה כִּֽי בָרָ֨א יְהוָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ נְקֵבָ֖ה תְּס֥וֹבֵֽב גָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: 'd mty ttchmqyn hbt hshvbbh khy br' yhvh chdshh b'rts nqbh tsvbb gbr
verses.translation: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ע֣וֹד יֹאמְר֞וּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה בְּ/אֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/בְ/עָרָ֔י/ו בְּ/שׁוּבִ֖/י אֶת שְׁבוּתָ֑/ם יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֧ יְהוָ֛ה נְוֵה צֶ֖דֶק הַ֥ר הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'vd y'mrv 't hdbr hzh b'rts yhvdh vb'ryv bshvby 't shbvtm ybrkhkh yhvh nvh tsdq hr hqdsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.

verses.original: וְ/יָ֥שְׁבוּ בָ֛/הּ יְהוּדָ֥ה וְ/כָל עָרָ֖י/ו יַחְדָּ֑ו אִכָּרִ֕ים וְ/נָסְע֖וּ בַּ/עֵֽדֶר
verses.translit: vyshbv bh yhvdh vkhl 'ryv ychdv 'khrym vns'v b'dr
verses.translation: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.

verses.original: כִּ֥י הִרְוֵ֖יתִי נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲיֵפָ֑ה וְ/כָל נֶ֥פֶשׁ דָּאֲבָ֖ה מִלֵּֽאתִי
verses.translit: khy hrvyty npsh 'yph vkhl npsh d'bh ml'ty
verses.translation: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.

verses.original: עַל זֹ֖את הֱקִיצֹ֣תִי וָ/אֶרְאֶ֑ה וּ/שְׁנָתִ֖/י עָ֥רְבָה לִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'l z't hqytsty v'r'h vshnty 'rbh ly
verses.translation: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/זָרַעְתִּ֗י אֶת בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה זֶ֥רַע אָדָ֖ם וְ/זֶ֥רַע בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vzr'ty 't byt yshr'l v't byt yhvdh zr' 'dm vzr' bhmh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר שָׁקַ֣דְתִּי עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם לִ/נְת֧וֹשׁ וְ/לִ/נְת֛וֹץ וְ/לַ/הֲרֹ֖ס וּ/לְ/הַאֲבִ֣יד וּ/לְ/הָרֵ֑עַ כֵּ֣ן אֶשְׁקֹ֧ד עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם לִ/בְנ֥וֹת וְ/לִ/נְט֖וֹעַ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr shqdty 'lyhm lntvsh vlntvts vlhrs vlh'byd vlhr' khn 'shqd 'lyhm lbnvt vlntv' n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD .

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם לֹא יֹאמְר֣וּ ע֔וֹד אָב֖וֹת אָ֣כְלוּ בֹ֑סֶר וְ/שִׁנֵּ֥י בָנִ֖ים תִּקְהֶֽינָה
verses.translit: bymym hhm l' y'mrv 'vd 'bvt 'khlv bsr vshny bnym tqhynh
verses.translation: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.

verses.original: כִּ֛י אִם אִ֥ישׁ בַּ/עֲוֺנ֖/וֹ יָמ֑וּת כָּל הָֽ/אָדָ֛ם הָ/אֹכֵ֥ל הַ/בֹּ֖סֶר תִּקְהֶ֥ינָה שִׁנָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy 'm 'ysh b'vnv ymvt khl h'dm h'khl hbsr tqhynh shnyv
verses.translation: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/כָרַתִּ֗י אֶת בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּרִ֥ית חֲדָשָֽׁה
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vkhrty 't byt yshr'l v't byt yhvdh bryt chdshh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

verses.original: לֹ֣א כַ/בְּרִ֗ית אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַ֨תִּי֙ אֶת אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם בְּ/יוֹם֙ הֶחֱזִיקִ֣/י בְ/יָדָ֔/ם לְ/הוֹצִיאָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁר הֵ֜מָּה הֵפֵ֣רוּ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֗/י וְ/אָנֹכִ֛י בָּעַ֥לְתִּי בָ֖/ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: l' khbryt 'shr khrty 't 'bvtm byvm hchzyqy bydm lhvtsy'm m'rts mtsrym 'shr hmh hprv 't bryty v'nkhy b'lty bm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD :

verses.original: כִּ֣י זֹ֣את הַ/בְּרִ֡ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶכְרֹת֩ אֶת בֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אַחֲרֵ֨י הַ/יָּמִ֤ים הָ/הֵם֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה נָתַ֤תִּי אֶת תּֽוֹרָתִ/י֙ בְּ/קִרְבָּ֔/ם וְ/עַל לִבָּ֖/ם אֶכְתֲּבֶ֑/נָּה וְ/הָיִ֤יתִי לָ/הֶם֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים וְ/הֵ֖מָּה יִֽהְיוּ לִ֥/י לְ/עָֽם
verses.translit: khy z't hbryt 'shr 'khrt 't byt yshr'l 'chry hymym hhm n'm yhvh ntty 't tvrty bqrbm v'l lbm 'khtbnh vhyyty lhm l'lhym vhmh yhyv ly l'm
verses.translation: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD , I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֧א יְלַמְּד֣וּ ע֗וֹד אִ֣ישׁ אֶת רֵעֵ֜/הוּ וְ/אִ֤ישׁ אֶת אָחִי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר דְּע֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי כוּלָּ/ם֩ יֵדְע֨וּ אוֹתִ֜/י לְ/מִ/קְטַנָּ֤/ם וְ/עַד גְּדוֹלָ/ם֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֤י אֶסְלַח֙ לַֽ/עֲוֺנָ֔/ם וּ/לְ/חַטָּאתָ֖/ם לֹ֥א אֶזְכָּר עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vl' ylmdv 'vd 'ysh 't r'hv v'ysh 't 'chyv l'mr d'v 't yhvh khy khvlm yd'v 'vty lmqtnm v'd gdvlm n'm yhvh khy 'slch l'vnm vlcht'tm l' 'zkhr 'vd
verses.translation: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD : for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD : for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה נֹתֵ֥ן שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ לְ/א֣וֹר יוֹמָ֔ם חֻקֹּ֛ת יָרֵ֥חַ וְ/כוֹכָבִ֖ים לְ/א֣וֹר לָ֑יְלָה רֹגַ֤ע הַ/יָּם֙ וַ/יֶּהֱמ֣וּ גַלָּ֔י/ו יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh ntn shmsh l'vr yvmm chqt yrch vkhvkhbym l'vr lylh rg' hym vyhmv glyv yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name:

verses.original: אִם יָמֻ֜שׁוּ הַ/חֻקִּ֥ים הָ/אֵ֛לֶּה מִ/לְּ/פָנַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה גַּם֩ זֶ֨רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל יִשְׁבְּת֗וּ מִֽ/הְי֥וֹת גּ֛וֹי לְ/פָנַ֖/י כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: 'm ymshv hchqym h'lh mlpny n'm yhvh gm zr' yshr'l yshbtv mhyvt gvy lpny khl hymym
verses.translation: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD , then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִם יִמַּ֤דּוּ שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִ/לְ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וְ/יֵחָקְר֥וּ מֽוֹסְדֵי אֶ֖רֶץ לְ/מָ֑טָּה גַּם אֲנִ֞י אֶמְאַ֨ס בְּ/כָל זֶ֧רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'm ymdv shmym mlm'lh vychqrv mvsdy 'rts lmth gm 'ny 'm's bkhl zr' yshr'l 'l khl 'shr 'shv n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/נִבְנְתָ֤ה הָ/עִיר֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה מִ/מִּגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵ֖ל שַׁ֥עַר הַ/פִּנָּֽה
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vnbnth h'yr lyhvh mmgdl chnn'l sh'r hpnh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֨א ע֜וֹד קוה קָ֤ו הַ/מִּדָּה֙ נֶגְדּ֔/וֹ עַ֖ל גִּבְעַ֣ת גָּרֵ֑ב וְ/נָסַ֖ב גֹּעָֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: vyts' 'vd qvh qv hmdh ngdv 'l gb't grb vnsb g'th
verses.translation: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הָ/עֵ֣מֶק הַ/פְּגָרִ֣ים וְ/הַ/דֶּ֡שֶׁן וְ/כָֽל ה/שרמות הַ/שְּׁדֵמוֹת֩ עַד נַ֨חַל קִדְר֜וֹן עַד פִּנַּ֨ת שַׁ֤עַר הַ/סּוּסִים֙ מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה לֹֽא יִנָּתֵ֧שׁ וְֽ/לֹא יֵהָרֵ֛ס ע֖וֹד לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vkhl h'mq hpgrym vhdshn vkhl hshrmvt hshdmvt 'd nchl qdrvn 'd pnt sh'r hsvsym mzrchh qdsh lyhvh l' yntsh vl' yhrs 'vd l'vlm
verses.translation: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD ; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֤ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה ב/שנת בַּ/שָּׁנָה֙ הָ/עֲשִׂרִ֔ית לְ/צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הִ֧יא הַ/שָּׁנָ֛ה שְׁמֹנֶֽה עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לִ/נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh bshnt bshnh h'shryt ltsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh hy' hshnh shmnh 'shrh shnh lnbvkhdr'tsr
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.

verses.original: וְ/אָ֗ז חֵ֚יל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל צָרִ֖ים עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֗יא הָיָ֤ה כָלוּא֙ בַּ/חֲצַ֣ר הַ/מַּטָּרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּֽית מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: v'z chyl mlkh bbl tsrym 'l yrvshlm vyrmyhv hnby' hyh khlv' bchtsr hmtrh 'shr byt mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah’s house.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כְּלָא֔/וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מַדּוּעַ֩ אַתָּ֨ה נִבָּ֜א לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֨י נֹתֵ֜ן אֶת הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֛את בְּ/יַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וּ/לְכָדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'shr khl'v tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh l'mr mdv' 'th nb' l'mr khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn 't h'yr hz't byd mlkh bbl vlkhdh
verses.translation: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;

verses.original: וְ/צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹ֥א יִמָּלֵ֖ט מִ/יַּ֣ד הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י הִנָּתֹ֤ן יִנָּתֵן֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/דִבֶּר פִּ֣י/ו עִם פִּ֔י/ו וְ/עֵינָ֖י/ו אֶת עינ/ו עֵינָ֥י/ו תִּרְאֶֽינָה
verses.translit: vtsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh l' ymlt myd hkhshdym khy hntn yntn byd mlkh bbl vdbr pyv 'm pyv v'ynyv 't 'ynv 'ynyv tr'ynh
verses.translation: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;

verses.original: וּ/בָבֶ֞ל יוֹלִ֤ךְ אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ וְ/שָׁ֣ם יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עַד פָּקְדִ֥/י אֹת֖/וֹ נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֧י תִֽלָּחֲמ֛וּ אֶת הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים לֹ֥א תַצְלִֽיחוּ
verses.translit: vbbl yvlkh 't tsdqyhv vshm yhyh 'd pqdy 'tv n'm yhvh khy tlchmv 't hkhshdym l' ttslychv
verses.translation: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD : though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ הָיָ֥ה דְּבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv hyh dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה חֲנַמְאֵ֗ל בֶּן שַׁלֻּם֙ דֹּֽדְ/ךָ֔ בָּ֥א אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר קְנֵ֣ה לְ/ךָ֗ אֶת שָׂדִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/עֲנָת֔וֹת כִּ֥י לְ/ךָ֛ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַ/גְּאֻלָּ֖ה לִ/קְנֽוֹת
verses.translit: hnh chnm'l bn shlm ddkh b' 'lykh l'mr qnh lkh 't shdy 'shr b'ntvt khy lkh mshpt hg'lh lqnvt
verses.translation: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it .

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֵ֠לַ/י חֲנַמְאֵ֨ל בֶּן דֹּדִ֜/י כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל חֲצַ֣ר הַ/מַּטָּרָה֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡/י קְנֵ֣ה נָ֠א אֶת שָׂדִ֨/י אֲשֶׁר בַּ/עֲנָת֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ין כִּֽי לְ/ךָ֞ מִשְׁפַּ֧ט הַ/יְרֻשָּׁ֛ה וּ/לְ/ךָ֥ הַ/גְּאֻלָּ֖ה קְנֵה לָ֑/ךְ וָ/אֵדַ֕ע כִּ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyb' 'ly chnm'l bn ddy khdbr yhvh 'l chtsr hmtrh vy'mr 'ly qnh n' 't shdy 'shr b'ntvt 'shr b'rts bnymyn khy lkh mshpt hyrshh vlkh hg'lh qnh lkh v'd' khy dbr yhvh hv'
verses.translation: So Hanameel mine uncle’s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD , and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶקְנֶה֙ אֶת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה מֵ/אֵ֛ת חֲנַמְאֵ֥ל בֶּן דֹּדִ֖/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/עֲנָת֑וֹת וָֽ/אֶשְׁקֲלָ/ה לּ/וֹ֙ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים וַ/עֲשָׂרָ֥ה הַ/כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: v'qnh 't hshdh m't chnm'l bn ddy 'shr b'ntvt v'shqlh lv 't hkhsf shb'h shqlym v'shrh hkhsf
verses.translation: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle’s son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

verses.original: וָ/אֶכְתֹּ֤ב בַּ/סֵּ֨פֶר֙ וָֽ/אֶחְתֹּ֔ם וָ/אָעֵ֖ד עֵדִ֑ים וָ/אֶשְׁקֹ֥ל הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף בְּ/מֹאזְנָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'khtb bspr v'chtm v''d 'dym v'shql hkhsf bm'znym
verses.translation: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it , and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקַּ֖ח אֶת סֵ֣פֶר הַ/מִּקְנָ֑ה אֶת הֶֽ/חָת֛וּם הַ/מִּצְוָ֥ה וְ/הַ/חֻקִּ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/גָּלֽוּי
verses.translit: v'qch 't spr hmqnh 't hchtvm hmtsvh vhchqym v't hglvy
verses.translation: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:

verses.original: וָ/אֶתֵּ֞ן אֶת הַ/סֵּ֣פֶר הַ/מִּקְנָ֗ה אֶל בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן מַחְסֵיָה֒ לְ/עֵינֵי֙ חֲנַמְאֵ֣ל דֹּדִ֔/י וּ/לְ/עֵינֵי֙ הָֽ/עֵדִ֔ים הַ/כֹּתְבִ֖ים בְּ/סֵ֣פֶר הַ/מִּקְנָ֑ה לְ/עֵינֵי֙ כָּל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בַּ/חֲצַ֥ר הַ/מַּטָּרָֽה
verses.translit: v'tn 't hspr hmqnh 'l brvkh bn nryh bn mchsyh l'yny chnm'l ddy vl'yny h'dym hkhtbym bspr hmqnh l'yny khl hyhvdym hyshbym bchtsr hmtrh
verses.translation: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle’s son , and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.

verses.original: וָֽ/אֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת בָּר֔וּךְ לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'tsvh 't brvkh l'ynyhm l'mr
verses.translation: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָק֣וֹחַ אֶת הַ/סְּפָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֡לֶּה אֵ֣ת סֵפֶר֩ הַ/מִּקְנָ֨ה הַ/זֶּ֜ה וְ/אֵ֣ת הֶ/חָת֗וּם וְ/אֵ֨ת סֵ֤פֶר הַ/גָּלוּי֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה וּ/נְתַתָּ֖/ם בִּ/כְלִי חָ֑רֶשׂ לְמַ֥עַן יַעַמְד֖וּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l lqvch 't hsprym h'lh 't spr hmqnh hzh v't hchtvm v't spr hglvy hzh vnttm bkhly chrsh lm'n y'mdv ymym rbym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ע֣וֹד יִקָּנ֥וּ בָתִּ֛ים וְ/שָׂד֥וֹת וּ/כְרָמִ֖ים בָּ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'vd yqnv btym vshdvt vkhrmym b'rts hz't
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל יְהוָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֤י תִתִּ/י֙ אֶת סֵ֣פֶר הַ/מִּקְנָ֔ה אֶל בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן נֵרִיָּ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'tpll 'l yhvh 'chry tty 't spr hmqnh 'l brvkh bn nryh l'mr
verses.translation: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD , saying,

verses.original: אֲהָהּ֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּ֣ה אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֗יתָ אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בְּ/כֹֽחֲ/ךָ֙ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל וּ/בִֽ/זְרֹעֲ/ךָ֖ הַ/נְּטוּיָ֑ה לֹֽא יִפָּלֵ֥א מִמְּ/ךָ֖ כָּל דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: 'hh 'dny yhvh hnh 'th 'shyt 't hshmym v't h'rts bkhchkh hgdvl vbzr'kh hntvyh l' ypl' mmkh khl dbr
verses.translation: Ah Lord GOD ! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:

verses.original: עֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד֙ לַֽ/אֲלָפִ֔ים וּ/מְשַׁלֵּם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֔וֹת אֶל חֵ֥יק בְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם הָ/אֵ֤ל הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ הַ/גִּבּ֔וֹר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'shh chsd l'lpym vmshlm 'vn 'bvt 'l chyq bnyhm 'chryhm h'l hgdvl hgbvr yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts, is his name,

verses.original: גְּדֹל֙ הָֽ/עֵצָ֔ה וְ/רַ֖ב הָ/עֲלִֽילִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר עֵינֶ֣י/ךָ פְקֻח֗וֹת עַל כָּל דַּרְכֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם לָ/תֵ֤ת לְ/אִישׁ֙ כִּ/דְרָכָ֔י/ו וְ/כִ/פְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: gdl h'tsh vrb h'lylyh 'shr 'ynykh pqchvt 'l khl drkhy bny 'dm ltt l'ysh khdrkhyv vkhpry m'llyv
verses.translation: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֠מְתָּ אֹת֨וֹת וּ/מֹפְתִ֤ים בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וּ/בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּ/בָֽ/אָדָ֑ם וַ/תַּעֲשֶׂה לְּ/ךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'shr shmt 'tvt vmptym b'rts mtsrym 'd hyvm hzh vbyshr'l vb'dm vt'shh lkh shm khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;

verses.original: וַ/תֹּצֵ֛א אֶת עַמְּ/ךָ֥ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּ/אֹת֣וֹת וּ/בְ/מוֹפְתִ֗ים וּ/בְ/יָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּ/בְ/אֶזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּ/בְ/מוֹרָ֖א גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vtts' 't 'mkh 't yshr'l m'rts mtsrym b'tvt vbmvptym vbyd chzqh vb'zrv' ntvyh vbmvr' gdvl
verses.translation: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;

verses.original: וַ/תִּתֵּ֤ן לָ/הֶם֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַ/אֲבוֹתָ֖/ם לָ/תֵ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vttn lhm 't h'rts hz't 'shr nshb't l'bvtm ltt lhm 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh
verses.translation: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ וַ/יִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֹתָ֗/הּ וְ/לֹֽא שָׁמְע֤וּ בְ/קוֹלֶ֨/ךָ֙ ו/ב/תרות/ך וּ/בְ/תוֹרָתְ/ךָ֣ לֹא הָלָ֔כוּ אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֧יתָה לָ/הֶ֛ם לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת לֹ֣א עָשׂ֑וּ וַ/תַּקְרֵ֣א אֹתָ֔/ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vyb'v vyrshv 'th vl' shm'v bqvlkh vbtrvtkh vbtvrtkh l' hlkhv 't khl 'shr tsvyth lhm l'shvt l' 'shv vtqr' 'tm 't khl hr'h hz't
verses.translation: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה הַ/סֹּלְל֗וֹת בָּ֣אוּ הָ/עִיר֮ לְ/לָכְדָ/הּ֒ וְ/הָ/עִ֣יר נִתְּנָ֗ה בְּ/יַ֤ד הַ/כַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַ/נִּלְחָמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔י/הָ מִ/פְּנֵ֛י הַ/חֶ֥רֶב וְ/הָ/רָעָ֖ב וְ/הַ/דָּ֑בֶר וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתָּ הָיָ֖ה וְ/הִנְּ/ךָ֥ רֹאֶֽה
verses.translit: hnh hsllvt b'v h'yr llkhdh vh'yr ntnh byd hkhshdym hnlchmym 'lyh mpny hchrb vhr'b vhdbr v'shr dbrt hyh vhnkh r'h
verses.translation: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it .

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ אֵלַ/י֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה קְנֵֽה לְ/ךָ֧ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֛ה בַּ/כֶּ֖סֶף וְ/הָעֵ֣ד עֵדִ֑ים וְ/הָ/עִ֥יר נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/כַּשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: v'th 'mrt 'ly 'dny yhvh qnh lkh hshdh bkhsf vh'd 'dym vh'yr ntnh byd hkhshdym
verses.translation: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD , Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י כָּל בָּשָׂ֑ר הֲֽ/מִמֶּ֔/נִּי יִפָּלֵ֖א כָּל דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: hnh 'ny yhvh 'lhy khl bshr hmmny ypl' khl dbr
verses.translation: Behold, I am the LORD , the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֕ן כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנְ/נִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ אֶת הָ/עִ֨יר הַ/זֹּ֜את בְּ/יַ֣ד הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים וּ/בְ/יַ֛ד נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וּ/לְכָדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn 't h'yr hz't byd hkhshdym vbyd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl vlkhdh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:

verses.original: וּ/בָ֣אוּ הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים הַ/נִּלְחָמִים֙ עַל הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/הִצִּ֜יתוּ אֶת הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֛את בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ וּ/שְׂרָפ֑וּ/הָ וְ/אֵ֣ת הַ/בָּתִּ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ קִטְּר֨וּ עַל גַּגּֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֜ם לַ/בַּ֗עַל וְ/הִסִּ֤כוּ נְסָכִים֙ לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vb'v hkhshdym hnlchmym 'l h'yr hz't vhtsytv 't h'yr hz't b'sh vshrpvh v't hbtym 'shr qtrv 'l ggvtyhm lb'l vhskhv nskhym l'lhym 'chrym lm'n hkh'sny
verses.translation: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.

verses.original: כִּֽי הָי֨וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּ/בְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אַ֣ךְ עֹשִׂ֥ים הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינַ֖/י מִ/נְּעֻרֹֽתֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּ֣י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַ֣ךְ מַכְעִסִ֥ים אֹתִ֛/י בְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy hyv bny yshr'l vbny yhvdh 'kh 'shym hr' b'yny mn'rtyhm khy bny yshr'l 'kh mkh'sym 'ty bm'shh ydyhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֧י עַל אַפִּ֣/י וְ/עַל חֲמָתִ֗/י הָ֤יְתָה לִּ/י֙ הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את לְ/מִן הַ/יּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔/הּ וְ/עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה לַ/הֲסִירָ֖/הּ מֵ/עַ֥ל פָּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'l 'py v'l chmty hyth ly h'yr hz't lmn hyvm 'shr bnv 'vth v'd hyvm hzh lhsyrh m'l pny
verses.translation: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,

verses.original: עַל֩ כָּל רָעַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּ/בְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְ/הַכְעִסֵ֔/נִי הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵי/הֶם֙ שָֽׂרֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּהֲנֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/נְבִֽיאֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'l khl r't bny yshr'l vbny yhvdh 'shr 'shv lhkh'sny hmh mlkhyhm shryhm khhnyhm vnby'yhm v'ysh yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm
verses.translation: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנ֥וּ אֵלַ֛/י עֹ֖רֶף וְ/לֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וְ/לַמֵּ֤ד אֹתָ/ם֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְ/לַמֵּ֔ד וְ/אֵינָ֥/ם שֹׁמְעִ֖ים לָ/קַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר
verses.translit: vypnv 'ly 'rf vl' pnym vlmd 'tm hshkhm vlmd v'ynm shm'ym lqcht mvsr
verses.translation: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them , yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵי/הֶ֗ם בַּ/בַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָֽא שְׁמִ֥/י עָלָ֖י/ו לְ/טַמְּאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshymv shqvtsyhm bbyt 'shr nqr' shmy 'lyv ltm'v
verses.translation: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְנוּ֩ אֶת בָּמ֨וֹת הַ/בַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/גֵ֣יא בֶן הִנֹּ֗ם לְ֠/הַעֲבִיר אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֣ם וְ/אֶת בְּנוֹתֵי/הֶם֮ לַ/מֹּלֶךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא צִוִּיתִ֗י/ם וְ/לֹ֤א עָֽלְתָה֙ עַל לִבִּ֔/י לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת הַ/תּוֹעֵבָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֑את לְמַ֖עַן החטי הַחֲטִ֥יא אֶת יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vybnv 't bmvt hb'l 'shr bgy' bn hnm lh'byr 't bnyhm v't bnvtyhm lmlkh 'shr l' tsvytym vl' 'lth 'l lby l'shvt htv'bh hz't lm'n hchty hchty' 't yhvdh
verses.translation: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה לָ/כֵ֛ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל הָ/עִ֨יר הַ/זֹּ֜את אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים נִתְּנָה֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב וּ/בָ/רָעָ֥ב וּ/בַ/דָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: v'th lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'l h'yr hz't 'shr 'tm 'mrym ntnh byd mlkh bbl bchrb vbr'b vbdbr
verses.translation: And now therefore thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֤י מְקַבְּצָ/ם֙ מִ/כָּל הָ֣/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִדַּחְתִּ֥י/ם שָׁ֛ם בְּ/אַפִּ֥/י וּ/בַ/חֲמָתִ֖/י וּ/בְ/קֶ֣צֶף גָּד֑וֹל וַ/הֲשִֽׁבֹתִי/ם֙ אֶל הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/הֹשַׁבְתִּ֖י/ם לָ/בֶֽטַח
verses.translit: hnny mqbtsm mkhl h'rtsvt 'shr hdchtym shm b'py vbchmty vbqtsf gdvl vhshbtym 'l hmqvm hzh vhshbtym lbtch
verses.translation: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:

verses.original: וְ/הָ֥יוּ לִ֖/י לְ/עָ֑ם וַ/אֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vhyv ly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י לָ/הֶ֜ם לֵ֤ב אֶחָד֙ וְ/דֶ֣רֶךְ אֶחָ֔ד לְ/יִרְאָ֥ה אוֹתִ֖/י כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֑ים לְ/ט֣וֹב לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vntty lhm lb 'chd vdrkh 'chd lyr'h 'vty khl hymym ltvb lhm vlbnyhm 'chryhm
verses.translation: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:

verses.original: וְ/כָרַתִּ֤י לָ/הֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא אָשׁוּב֙ מֵ/אַ֣חֲרֵי/הֶ֔ם לְ/הֵיטִיבִ֖/י אוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/אֶת יִרְאָתִ/י֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן בִּ/לְבָבָ֔/ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י ס֥וּר מֵ/עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vkhrty lhm bryt 'vlm 'shr l' 'shvb m'chryhm lhytyby 'vtm v't yr'ty 'tn blbbm lblty svr m'ly
verses.translation: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂשְׂתִּ֥י עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/הֵטִ֣יב אוֹתָ֑/ם וּ/נְטַעְתִּ֞י/ם בָּ/אָ֤רֶץ הַ/זֹּאת֙ בֶּ/אֱמֶ֔ת בְּ/כָל לִבִּ֖/י וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: vshshty 'lyhm lhtyb 'vtm vnt'tym b'rts hz't b'mt bkhl lby vbkhl npshy
verses.translation: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.

verses.original: כִּֽי כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֨אתִי֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֥ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את כֵּ֣ן אָנֹכִ֞י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh kh'shr hb'ty 'l h'm hzh 't khl hr'h hgdvlh hz't khn 'nkhy mby' 'lyhm 't khl htvbh 'shr 'nkhy dbr 'lyhm
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD ; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.

verses.original: וְ/נִקְנָ֥ה הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים שְׁמָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ מֵ/אֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ וּ/בְהֵמָ֔ה נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/כַּשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: vnqnh hshdh b'rts hz't 'shr 'tm 'mrym shmmh hy' m'yn 'dm vbhmh ntnh byd hkhshdym
verses.translation: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.original: שָׂד֞וֹת בַּ/כֶּ֣סֶף יִקְנ֗וּ וְ/כָת֨וֹב בַּ/סֵּ֥פֶר וְ/חָתוֹם֮ וְ/הָעֵ֣ד עֵדִים֒ בְּ/אֶ֨רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֜ן וּ/בִ/סְבִיבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֣י הָ/הָ֔ר וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֥י הַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֣י הַ/נֶּ֑גֶב כִּֽי אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת שְׁבוּתָ֖/ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shdvt bkhsf yqnv vkhtvb bspr vchtvm vh'd 'dym b'rts bnymn vbsbyby yrvshlm vb'ry yhvdh vb'ry hhr vb'ry hshplh vb'ry hngb khy 'shyb 't shbvtm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them , and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֧י דְבַר יְהוָ֛ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ שֵׁנִ֑ית וְ/הוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣/נּוּ עָצ֔וּר בַּ/חֲצַ֥ר הַ/מַּטָּרָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv shnyt vhv' 'vdnv 'tsvr bchtsr hmtrh l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עֹשָׂ֑/הּ יְהוָ֗ה יוֹצֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֛/הּ לַ/הֲכִינָ֖/הּ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'shh yhvh yvtsr 'vth lhkhynh yhvh shmv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD is his name; is: or, JEHOVAH , etc

verses.original: קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖/י וְ/אֶעֱנֶ֑/ךָּ וְ/אַגִּ֧ידָה לְּ/ךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּ/בְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: qr' 'ly v''nkh v'gydh lkh gdlvt vbtsrvt l' yd'tm
verses.translation: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל בָּתֵּי֙ הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/עַל בָּתֵּ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה הַ/נְּתֻצִ֕ים אֶל הַ/סֹּלְל֖וֹת וְ/אֶל הֶ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'l bty h'yr hz't v'l bty mlkhy yhvdh hnttsym 'l hsllvt v'l hchrb
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;

verses.original: בָּאִ֗ים לְ/הִלָּחֵם֙ אֶת הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּ/לְ/מַלְאָ/ם֙ אֶת פִּגְרֵ֣י הָ/אָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הִכֵּ֥יתִי בְ/אַפִּ֖/י וּ/בַ/חֲמָתִ֑/י וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִסְתַּ֤רְתִּי פָנַ/י֙ מֵ/הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את עַ֖ל כָּל רָעָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: b'ym lhlchm 't hkhshdym vlml'm 't pgry h'dm 'shr hkhyty b'py vbchmty v'shr hstrty pny mh'yr hz't 'l khl r'tm
verses.translation: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֧י מַעֲלֶה לָּ֛/הּ אֲרֻכָ֥ה וּ/מַרְפֵּ֖א וּ/רְפָאתִ֑י/ם וְ/גִלֵּיתִ֣י לָ/הֶ֔ם עֲתֶ֥רֶת שָׁל֖וֹם וֶ/אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: hnny m'lh lh 'rkhh vmrp' vrp'tym vglyty lhm 'trt shlvm v'mt
verses.translation: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.

verses.original: וַ/הֲשִֽׁבֹתִי֙ אֶת שְׁב֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת שְׁב֣וּת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/בְנִתִ֖י/ם כְּ/בָ/רִֽאשֹׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vhshbty 't shbvt yhvdh v't shbvt yshr'l vbntym khbr'shnh
verses.translation: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

verses.original: וְ/טִ֣הַרְתִּ֔י/ם מִ/כָּל עֲוֺנָ֖/ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ לִ֑/י וְ/סָלַחְתִּ֗י ל/כול לְ/כָל עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ לִ֔/י וַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽ/י
verses.translit: vthrtym mkhl 'vnm 'shr cht'v ly vslchty lkhvl lkhl 'vnvtyhm 'shr cht'v ly v'shr psh'v by
verses.translation: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֣יְתָה לִּ֗/י לְ/שֵׁ֤ם שָׂשׂוֹן֙ לִ/תְהִלָּ֣ה וּ/לְ/תִפְאֶ֔רֶת לְ/כֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁמְע֜וּ אֶת כָּל הַ/טּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽנֹכִי֙ עֹשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔/ם וּ/פָחֲד֣וּ וְ/רָֽגְז֗וּ עַ֤ל כָּל הַ/טּוֹבָה֙ וְ/עַ֣ל כָּל הַ/שָּׁל֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָֽנֹכִ֖י עֹ֥שֶׂה לָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhyth ly lshm shshvn lthlh vltp'rt lkhl gvyy h'rts 'shr yshm'v 't khl htvbh 'shr 'nkhy 'shh 'tm vpchdv vrgzv 'l khl htvbh v'l khl hshlvm 'shr 'nkhy 'shh lh
verses.translation: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עוֹד֮ יִשָּׁמַ֣ע בַּ/מָּקוֹם הַ/זֶּה֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֔ים חָרֵ֣ב ה֔וּא מֵ/אֵ֥ין אָדָ֖ם וּ/מֵ/אֵ֣ין בְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּ/עָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/בְ/חֻצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הַֽ/נְשַׁמּ֗וֹת מֵ/אֵ֥ין אָדָ֛ם וּ/מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב וּ/מֵ/אֵ֥ין בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'vd yshm' bmqvm hzh 'shr 'tm 'mrym chrb hv' m'yn 'dm vm'yn bhmh b'ry yhvdh vbchtsvt yrvshlm hnshmvt m'yn 'dm vm'yn yvshb vm'yn bhmh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,

verses.original: ק֣וֹל שָׂשׂ֞וֹן וְ/ק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֗ה ק֣וֹל חָתָן֮ וְ/ק֣וֹל כַּלָּה֒ ק֣וֹל אֹמְרִ֡ים הוֹדוּ֩ אֶת יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת כִּֽי ט֤וֹב יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֔/וֹ מְבִאִ֥ים תּוֹדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי אָשִׁ֧יב אֶת שְׁבוּת הָ/אָ֛רֶץ כְּ/בָ/רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: qvl shshvn vqvl shmchh qvl chtn vqvl khlh qvl 'mrym hvdv 't yhvh tsb'vt khy tvb yhvh khy l'vlm chsdv mb'ym tvdh byt yhvh khy 'shyb 't shbvt h'rts khbr'shnh 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD . For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ ע֞וֹד יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בַּ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֗ה הֶ/חָרֵ֛ב מֵֽ/אֵין אָדָ֥ם וְ/עַד בְּהֵמָ֖ה וּ/בְ/כָל עָרָ֑י/ו נְוֵ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים מַרְבִּצִ֖ים צֹֽאן
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'vd yhyh bmqvm hzh hchrb m'yn 'dm v'd bhmh vbkhl 'ryv nvh r'ym mrbtsym ts'n
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

verses.original: בְּ/עָרֵ֨י הָ/הָ֜ר בְּ/עָרֵ֤י הַ/שְּׁפֵלָה֙ וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֣י הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב וּ/בְ/אֶ֧רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֛ן וּ/בִ/סְבִיבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה עֹ֣ד תַּעֲבֹ֧רְנָה הַ/צֹּ֛אן עַל יְדֵ֥י מוֹנֶ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: b'ry hhr b'ry hshplh vb'ry hngb vb'rts bnymn vbsbyby yrvshlm vb'ry yhvdh 'd t'brnh hts'n 'l ydy mvnh 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them , saith the LORD .

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וַ/הֲקִֽמֹתִי֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/טּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתִּי אֶל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/עַל בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vhqmty 't hdbr htvb 'shr dbrty 'l byt yshr'l v'l byt yhvdh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֤ים הָ/הֵם֙ וּ/בָ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא אַצְמִ֥יחַ לְ/דָוִ֖ד צֶ֣מַח צְדָקָ֑ה וְ/עָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: bymym hhm vb't hhy' 'tsmych ldvd tsmch tsdqh v'shh mshpt vtsdqh b'rts
verses.translation: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֤ים הָ/הֵם֙ תִּוָּשַׁ֣ע יְהוּדָ֔ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן לָ/בֶ֑טַח וְ/זֶ֥ה אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָא לָ֖/הּ יְהוָ֥ה צִדְקֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: bymym hhm tvsh' yhvdh vyrvshlm tshkhvn lbtch vzh 'shr yqr' lh yhvh tsdqnv
verses.translation: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness. …: Heb. Jehovah-tsidkenu

verses.original: כִּי כֹ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֣ת לְ/דָוִ֔ד אִ֕ישׁ יֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל כִּסֵּ֥א בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh l' ykhrt ldvd 'ysh yshb 'l khs' byt yshr'l
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD ; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;

verses.original: וְ/לַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֥ת אִ֖ישׁ מִ/לְּ/פָנָ֑/י מַעֲלֶ֨ה עוֹלָ֜ה וּ/מַקְטִ֥יר מִנְחָ֛ה וְ/עֹ֥שֶׂה זֶּ֖בַח כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vlkhhnym hlvym l' ykhrt 'ysh mlpny m'lh 'vlh vmqtyr mnchh v'shh zbch khl hymym
verses.translation: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv l'mvr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם תָּפֵ֨רוּ֙ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֣/י הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖/י הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה וּ/לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י הֱי֥וֹת יֽוֹמָם וָ/לַ֖יְלָה בְּ/עִתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'm tprv 't bryty hyvm v't bryty hlylh vlblty hyvt yvmm vlylh b'tm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;

verses.original: גַּם בְּרִיתִ֤/י תֻפַר֙ אֶת דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔/י מִ/הְיֽוֹת ל֥/וֹ בֵ֖ן מֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל כִּסְא֑/וֹ וְ/אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֥ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים מְשָׁרְתָֽ/י
verses.translit: gm bryty tpr 't dvd 'bdy mhyvt lv bn mlkh 'l khs'v v't hlvym hkhhnym mshrty
verses.translation: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יִסָּפֵר֙ צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/לֹ֥א יִמַּ֖ד ח֣וֹל הַ/יָּ֑ם כֵּ֣ן אַרְבֶּ֗ה אֶת זֶ֨רַע֙ דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔/י וְ/אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָׁרְתֵ֥י אֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shr l' yspr tsb' hshmym vl' ymd chvl hym khn 'rbh 't zr' dvd 'bdy v't hlvym mshrty 'ty
verses.translation: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא רָאִ֗יתָ מָֽה הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ דִּבְּר֣וּ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/מִּשְׁפָּח֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּחַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בָּ/הֶ֖ם וַ/יִּמְאָסֵ֑/ם וְ/אֶת עַמִּ/י֙ יִנְאָצ֔וּ/ן מִֽ/הְי֥וֹת ע֖וֹד גּ֥וֹי לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hlv' r'yt mh h'm hzh dbrv l'mr shty hmshpchvt 'shr bchr yhvh bhm vym'sm v't 'my yn'tsvn mhyvt 'vd gvy lpnyhm
verses.translation: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם לֹ֥א בְרִיתִ֖/י יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לָ֑יְלָה חֻקּ֛וֹת שָׁמַ֥יִם וָ/אָ֖רֶץ לֹא שָֽׂמְתִּי
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'm l' bryty yvmm vlylh chqvt shmym v'rts l' shmty
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

verses.original: גַּם זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקוֹב֩ וְ/דָוִ֨ד עַבְדִּ֜/י אֶמְאַ֗ס מִ/קַּ֤חַת מִ/זַּרְע/וֹ֙ מֹֽשְׁלִ֔ים אֶל זֶ֥רַע אַבְרָהָ֖ם יִשְׂחָ֣ק וְ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּֽי אשוב אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת שְׁבוּתָ֖/ם וְ/רִחַמְתִּֽי/ם
verses.translit: gm zr' y'qvb vdvd 'bdy 'm's mqcht mzr'v mshlym 'l zr' 'brhm yshchq vy'qb khy 'shvb 'shyb 't shbvtm vrchmtym
verses.translation: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ/נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֣ל וְ/כָל חֵיל֡/וֹ וְ/כָל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת אֶרֶץ֩ מֶמְשֶׁ֨לֶת יָד֜/וֹ וְ/כָל הָ/עַמִּ֗ים נִלְחָמִ֧ים עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְ/עַל כָּל עָרֶ֖י/הָ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh vnbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl vkhl chylv vkhl mmlkhvt 'rts mmshlt ydv vkhl h'mym nlchmym 'l yrvshlm v'l khl 'ryh l'mr
verses.translation: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD , when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָלֹךְ֙ וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ אֶל צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֨י נֹתֵ֜ן אֶת הָ/עִ֤יר הַ/זֹּאת֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וּ/שְׂרָפָ֖/הּ בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hlkh v'mrt 'l tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh v'mrt 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn 't h'yr hz't byd mlkh bbl vshrph b'sh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֗ה לֹ֚א תִמָּלֵט֙ מִ/יָּד֔/וֹ כִּ֚י תָּפֹ֣שׂ תִּתָּפֵ֔שׂ וּ/בְ/יָד֖/וֹ תִּנָּתֵ֑ן וְֽ֠/עֵינֶי/ךָ אֶת עֵינֵ֨י מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל תִּרְאֶ֗ינָה וּ/פִ֛י/הוּ אֶת פִּ֥י/ךָ יְדַבֵּ֖ר וּ/בָבֶ֥ל תָּבֽוֹא
verses.translit: v'th l' tmlt mydv khy tpsh ttpsh vbydv tntn v'ynykh 't 'yny mlkh bbl tr'ynh vpyhv 't pykh ydbr vbbl tbv'
verses.translation: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.

verses.original: אַ֚ךְ שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ עָלֶ֔י/ךָ לֹ֥א תָמ֖וּת בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: 'kh shm' dbr yhvh tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh khh 'mr yhvh 'lykh l' tmvt bchrb
verses.translation: Yet hear the word of the LORD , O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:

verses.original: בְּ/שָׁל֣וֹם תָּמ֗וּת וּֽ/כְ/מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת אֲ֠בוֹתֶי/ךָ הַ/מְּלָכִ֨ים הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר הָי֣וּ לְ/פָנֶ֗י/ךָ כֵּ֚ן יִשְׂרְפוּ לָ֔/ךְ וְ/ה֥וֹי אָד֖וֹן יִסְפְּדוּ לָ֑/ךְ כִּֽי דָבָ֥ר אֲנִֽי דִבַּ֖רְתִּי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bshlvm tmvt vkhmshrpvt 'bvtykh hmlkhym hr'shnym 'shr hyv lpnykh khn yshrpv lkh vhvy 'dvn yspdv lkh khy dbr 'ny dbrty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying , Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אֶל צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה אֵ֛ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vydbr yrmyhv hnby' 'l tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh 't khl hdbrym h'lh byrvshlm
verses.translation: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

verses.original: וְ/חֵ֣יל מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֗ל נִלְחָמִים֙ עַל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/עַ֛ל כָּל עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה הַ/נּֽוֹתָר֑וֹת אֶל לָכִישׁ֙ וְ/אֶל עֲזֵקָ֔ה כִּ֣י הֵ֗נָּה נִשְׁאֲר֛וּ בְּ/עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עָרֵ֥י מִבְצָֽר
verses.translit: vchyl mlkh bbl nlchmym 'l yrvshlm v'l khl 'ry yhvdh hnvtrvt 'l lkhysh v'l 'zqh khy hnh nsh'rv b'ry yhvdh 'ry mbtsr
verses.translation: When the king of Babylon’s army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֡י כְּרֹת֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ בְּרִ֗ית אֶת כָּל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִ/קְרֹ֥א לָ/הֶ֖ם דְּרֽוֹר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh 'chry khrt hmlkh tsdqyhv bryt 't khl h'm 'shr byrvshlm lqr' lhm drvr
verses.translation: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD , after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;

verses.original: לְ֠/שַׁלַּח אִ֣ישׁ אֶת עַבְדּ֞/וֹ וְ/אִ֧ישׁ אֶת שִׁפְחָת֛/וֹ הָ/עִבְרִ֥י וְ/הָ/עִבְרִיָּ֖ה חָפְשִׁ֑ים לְ/בִלְתִּ֧י עֲבָד בָּ֛/ם בִּ/יהוּדִ֥י אָחִ֖י/הוּ אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: lshlch 'ysh 't 'bdv v'ysh 't shpchtv h'bry vh'bryh chpshym lblty 'bd bm byhvdy 'chyhv 'ysh
verses.translation: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit , of a Jew his brother.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְעוּ֩ כָל הַ/שָּׂרִ֨ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֜ם אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣אוּ בַ/בְּרִ֗ית לְ֠/שַׁלַּח אִ֣ישׁ אֶת עַבְדּ֞/וֹ וְ/אִ֤ישׁ אֶת שִׁפְחָת/וֹ֙ חָפְשִׁ֔ים לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י עֲבָד בָּ֖/ם ע֑וֹד וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֖וּ וַ/יְשַׁלֵּֽחוּ
verses.translit: vyshm'v khl hshrym vkhl h'm 'shr b'v bbryt lshlch 'ysh 't 'bdv v'ysh 't shpchtv chpshym lblty 'bd bm 'vd vyshm'v vyshlchv
verses.translation: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשׁ֨וּבוּ֙ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יָּשִׁ֗בוּ אֶת הָֽ/עֲבָדִים֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/שְּׁפָח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁלְּח֖וּ חָפְשִׁ֑ים ו/יכבישו/ם וַֽ/יִּכְבְּשׁ֔וּ/ם לַ/עֲבָדִ֖ים וְ/לִ/שְׁפָחֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyshvbv 'chry khn vyshbv 't h'bdym v't hshpchvt 'shr shlchv chpshym vykhbyshvm vykhbshvm l'bdym vlshpchvt
verses.translation: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD , saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָנֹכִ֗י כָּרַ֤תִּֽי בְרִית֙ אֶת אֲב֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/י֨וֹם הוֹצִאִ֤/י אוֹתָ/ם֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִ/בֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'nkhy khrty bryt 't 'bvtykhm byvm hvts'y 'vtm m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym l'mr
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,

verses.original: מִ/קֵּ֣ץ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֡ים תְּֽשַׁלְּח֡וּ אִישׁ֩ אֶת אָחִ֨י/ו הָ/עִבְרִ֜י אֲשֶֽׁר יִמָּכֵ֣ר לְ/ךָ֗ וַ/עֲבָֽדְ/ךָ֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְ/שִׁלַּחְתּ֥/וֹ חָפְשִׁ֖י מֵֽ/עִמָּ֑/ךְ וְ/לֹֽא שָׁמְע֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/לֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת אָזְנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: mqts shb' shnym tshlchv 'ysh 't 'chyv h'bry 'shr ymkhr lkh v'bdkh shsh shnym vshlchtv chpshy m'mkh vl' shm'v 'bvtykhm 'ly vl' htv 't 'znm
verses.translation: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.

verses.original: וַ/תָּשֻׁ֨בוּ אַתֶּ֜ם הַ/יּ֗וֹם וַ/תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ אֶת הַ/יָּשָׁר֙ בְּ/עֵינַ֔/י לִ/קְרֹ֥א דְר֖וֹר אִ֣ישׁ לְ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וַ/תִּכְרְת֤וּ בְרִית֙ לְ/פָנַ֔/י בַּ/בַּ֕יִת אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמִ֖/י עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vtshbv 'tm hyvm vt'shv 't hyshr b'yny lqr' drvr 'ysh lr'hv vtkhrtv bryt lpny bbyt 'shr nqr' shmy 'lyv
verses.translation: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

verses.original: וַ/תָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ וַ/תְּחַלְּל֣וּ אֶת שְׁמִ֔/י וַ/תָּשִׁ֗בוּ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת עַבְדּ/וֹ֙ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶת שִׁפְחָת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁר שִׁלַּחְתֶּ֥ם חָפְשִׁ֖ים לְ/נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וַ/תִּכְבְּשׁ֣וּ אֹתָ֔/ם לִֽ/הְי֣וֹת לָ/כֶ֔ם לַ/עֲבָדִ֖ים וְ/לִ/שְׁפָחֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtshbv vtchllv 't shmy vtshbv 'ysh 't 'bdv v'ysh 't shpchtv 'shr shlchtm chpshym lnpshm vtkhbshv 'tm lhyvt lkhm l'bdym vlshpchvt
verses.translation: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֮ כֹּה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ אַתֶּם֙ לֹֽא שְׁמַעְתֶּ֣ם אֵלַ֔/י לִ/קְרֹ֣א דְר֔וֹר אִ֥ישׁ לְ/אָחִ֖י/ו וְ/אִ֣ישׁ לְ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ הִנְ/נִ֣י קֹרֵא֩ לָ/כֶ֨ם דְּר֜וֹר נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה אֶל הַ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ אֶל הַ/דֶּ֣בֶר וְ/אֶל הָ/רָעָ֔ב וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ ל/זועה לְ/זַעֲוָ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'tm l' shm'tm 'ly lqr' drvr 'ysh l'chyv v'ysh lr'hv hnny qr' lkhm drvr n'm yhvh 'l hchrb 'l hdbr v'l hr'b vntty 'tkhm lzv'h lz'vh lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD , to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י אֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים הָ/עֹֽבְרִים֙ אֶת בְּרִתִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא הֵקִ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/בְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרְת֖וּ לְ/פָנָ֑/י הָ/עֵ֨גֶל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרְת֣וּ לִ/שְׁנַ֔יִם וַ/יַּעַבְר֖וּ בֵּ֥ין בְּתָרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vntty 't h'nshym h'brym 't brty 'shr l' hqymv 't dbry hbryt 'shr khrtv lpny h'gl 'shr khrtv lshnym vy'brv byn btryv
verses.translation: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,

verses.original: שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הַ/סָּֽרִסִים֙ וְ/הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וְ/כֹ֖ל עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ הָ/עֹ֣בְרִ֔ים בֵּ֖ין בִּתְרֵ֥י הָ/עֵֽגֶל
verses.translit: shry yhvdh vshry yrvshlm hsrsym vhkhhnym vkhl 'm h'rts h'brym byn btry h'gl
verses.translation: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אוֹתָ/ם֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/יַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָתָ/ם֙ לְ/מַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vntty 'vtm byd 'ybyhm vbyd mbqshy npshm vhyth nbltm lm'khl l'vf hshmym vlbhmt h'rts
verses.translation: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְ/אֶת שָׂרָ֗י/ו אֶתֵּן֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/יַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וּ/בְ/יַד חֵ֚יל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל הָ/עֹלִ֖ים מֵ/עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v't tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh v't shryv 'tn byd 'ybyhm vbyd mbqshy npshm vbyd chyl mlkh bbl h'lym m'lykhm
verses.translation: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which are gone up from you.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י מְצַוֶּ֜ה נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה וַ/הֲשִׁ֨בֹתִ֜י/ם אֶל הָ/עִ֤יר הַ/זֹּאת֙ וְ/נִלְחֲמ֣וּ עָלֶ֔י/הָ וּ/לְכָד֖וּ/הָ וּ/שְׂרָפֻ֣/הָ בָ/אֵ֑שׁ וְ/אֶת עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה אֶתֵּ֥ן שְׁמָמָ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֥ין יֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: hnny mtsvh n'm yhvh vhshbtym 'l h'yr hz't vnlchmv 'lyh vlkhdvh vshrph b'sh v't 'ry yhvdh 'tn shmmh m'yn yshb
