verses.translation: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD , and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה בִּ/ימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֧ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֛הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh bymy yhvyqym bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh l'mr
verses.translation: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

verses.original: הָלוֹךְ֮ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הָ/רֵכָבִים֒ וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֣ אוֹתָ֔/ם וַ/הֲבִֽאוֹתָ/ם֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה אֶל אַחַ֖ת הַ/לְּשָׁכ֑וֹת וְ/הִשְׁקִיתָ֥ אוֹתָ֖/ם יָֽיִן
verses.translit: hlvkh 'l byt hrkhbym vdbrt 'vtm vhb'vtm byt yhvh 'l 'cht hlshkhvt vhshqyt 'vtm yyn
verses.translation: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the LORD , into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקַּ֞ח אֶת יַאֲזַנְיָ֤ה בֶֽן יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן חֲבַצִּנְיָ֔ה וְ/אֶת אֶחָ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת כָּל בָּנָ֑י/ו וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל בֵּ֥ית הָ/רֵכָבִֽים
verses.translit: v'qch 't y'znyh bn yrmyhv bn chbtsnyh v't 'chyv v't khl bnyv v't khl byt hrkhbym
verses.translation: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

verses.original: וָ/אָבִ֤א אֹתָ/ם֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה אֶל לִשְׁכַּ֗ת בְּנֵ֛י חָנָ֥ן בֶּן יִגְדַּלְיָ֖הוּ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר אֵ֨צֶל֙ לִשְׁכַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִ/מַּ֗עַל לְ/לִשְׁכַּ֛ת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֥הוּ בֶן שַׁלֻּ֖ם שֹׁמֵ֥ר הַ/סַּֽף
verses.translit: v'b' 'tm byt yhvh 'l lshkht bny chnn bn ygdlyhv 'ysh h'lhym 'shr 'tsl lshkht hshrym 'shr mm'l llshkht m'shyhv bn shlm shmr hsf
verses.translation: And I brought them into the house of the LORD , into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:

verses.original: וָ/אֶתֵּ֞ן לִ/פְנֵ֣י בְּנֵ֣י בֵית הָ/רֵכָבִ֗ים גְּבִעִ֛ים מְלֵאִ֥ים יַ֖יִן וְ/כֹס֑וֹת וָ/אֹמַ֥ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם שְׁתוּ יָֽיִן
verses.translit: v'tn lpny bny byt hrkhbym gb'ym ml'ym yyn vkhsvt v'mr 'lyhm shtv yyn
verses.translation: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֣א נִשְׁתֶּה יָּ֑יִן כִּי֩ יוֹנָדָ֨ב בֶּן רֵכָ֜ב אָבִ֗י/נוּ צִוָּ֤ה עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֧א תִשְׁתּוּ יַ֛יִן אַתֶּ֥ם וּ/בְנֵי/כֶ֖ם עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv l' nshth yyn khy yvndb bn rkhb 'bynv tsvh 'lynv l'mr l' tshtv yyn 'tm vbnykhm 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye , nor your sons for ever:

verses.original: וּ/בַ֣יִת לֹֽא תִבְנ֗וּ וְ/זֶ֤רַע לֹֽא תִזְרָ֨עוּ֙ וְ/כֶ֣רֶם לֹֽא תִטָּ֔עוּ וְ/לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶ֖ה לָ/כֶ֑ם כִּ֠י בָּ/אֳהָלִ֤ים תֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ כָּל יְמֵי/כֶ֔ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּ יָמִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם גָּרִ֥ים שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vbyt l' tbnv vzr' l' tzr'v vkhrm l' tt'v vl' yhyh lkhm khy b'hlym tshbv khl ymykhm lm'n tchyv ymym rbym 'l pny h'dmh 'shr 'tm grym shm
verses.translation: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.

verses.original: וַ/נִּשְׁמַ֗ע בְּ/ק֨וֹל יְהוֹנָדָ֤ב בֶּן רֵכָב֙ אָבִ֔י/נוּ לְ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑/נוּ לְ/בִלְתִּ֤י שְׁתֽוֹת יַ֨יִן֙ כָּל יָמֵ֔י/נוּ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ נָשֵׁ֔י/נוּ בָּנֵ֖י/נוּ וּ/בְנֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vnshm' bqvl yhvndb bn rkhb 'bynv lkhl 'shr tsvnv lblty shtvt yyn khl ymynv 'nchnv nshynv bnynv vbntynv
verses.translation: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

verses.original: וּ/לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י בְּנ֥וֹת בָּתִּ֖ים לְ/שִׁבְתֵּ֑/נוּ וְ/כֶ֧רֶם וְ/שָׂדֶ֛ה וָ/זֶ֖רַע לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה לָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vlblty bnvt btym lshbtnv vkhrm vshdh vzr' l' yhyh lnv
verses.translation: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

verses.original: וַ/נֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽ/אֳהָלִ֑ים וַ/נִּשְׁמַ֣ע וַ/נַּ֔עַשׂ כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖/נוּ יוֹנָדָ֥ב אָבִֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vnshb b'hlym vnshm' vn'sh khkhl 'shr tsvnv yvndb 'bynv
verses.translation: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בַּ/עֲל֨וֹת נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֮ אֶל הָ/אָרֶץ֒ וַ/נֹּ֗אמֶר בֹּ֚אוּ וְ/נָב֣וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִ/פְּנֵי֙ חֵ֣יל הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּ/מִ/פְּנֵ֖י חֵ֣יל אֲרָ֑ם וַ/נֵּ֖שֶׁב בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy b'lvt nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl 'l h'rts vn'mr b'v vnbv' yrvshlm mpny chyl hkhshdym vmpny chyl 'rm vnshb byrvshlm
verses.translation: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָלֹ֤ךְ וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/לְ/יֽוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲ/ל֨וֹא תִקְח֥וּ מוּסָ֛ר לִ/שְׁמֹ֥עַ אֶל דְּבָרַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hlkh v'mrt l'ysh yhvdh vlyvshby yrvshlm hlv' tqchv mvsr lshm' 'l dbry n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD .

verses.original: הוּקַ֡ם אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב בֶּן רֵ֠כָב אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֨ה אֶת בָּנָ֜י/ו לְ/בִלְתִּ֣י שְׁתֽוֹת יַ֗יִן וְ/לֹ֤א שָׁתוּ֙ עַד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י שָֽׁמְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת מִצְוַ֣ת אֲבִי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אָ֨נֹכִ֜י דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֲלֵי/כֶם֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְ/דַבֵּ֔ר וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: hvqm 't dbry yhvndb bn rkhb 'shr tsvh 't bnyv lblty shtvt yyn vl' shtv 'd hyvm hzh khy shm'v 't mtsvt 'byhm v'nkhy dbrty 'lykhm hshkhm vdbr vl' shm'tm 'ly
verses.translation: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father’s commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁלַ֣ח אֲלֵי/כֶ֣ם אֶת כָּל עֲבָדַ֣/י הַ/נְּבִאִ֣ים הַשְׁכֵּ֣ים וְ/שָׁלֹ֣חַ לֵ/אמֹ֡ר שֻׁבוּ נָ֡א אִישׁ֩ מִ/דַּרְכּ֨/וֹ הָ/רָעָ֜ה וְ/הֵיטִ֣יבוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/אַל תֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ אַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ לְ/עָבְדָ֔/ם וּ/שְׁבוּ֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תִּי לָ/כֶ֖ם וְ/לַ/אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹ֤א הִטִּיתֶם֙ אֶֽת אָזְנְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'shlch 'lykhm 't khl 'bdy hnb'ym hshkhym vshlch l'mr shbv n' 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vhytybv m'llykhm v'l tlkhv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym l'bdm vshbv 'l h'dmh 'shr ntty lkhm vl'btykhm vl' htytm 't 'znkhm vl' shm'tm 'ly
verses.translation: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them , saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הֵקִ֗ימוּ בְּנֵי֙ יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב בֶּן רֵכָ֔ב אֶת מִצְוַ֥ת אֲבִי/הֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑/ם וְ/הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy hqymv bny yhvndb bn rkhb 't mtsvt 'byhm 'shr tsvm vh'm hzh l' shm'v 'ly
verses.translation: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:

verses.original: לָ֠/כֵן כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִ֧י מֵבִ֣יא אֶל יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/אֶ֤ל כָּל יֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם יַ֣עַן דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ וָ/אֶקְרָ֥א לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א עָנֽוּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny mby' 'l yhvdh v'l khl yvshby yrvshlm 't khl hr'h 'shr dbrty 'lyhm y'n dbrty 'lyhm vl' shm'v v'qr' lhm vl' 'nv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/בֵ֨ית הָ/רֵכָבִ֜ים אָמַ֣ר יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁמַעְתֶּ֔ם עַל מִצְוַ֖ת יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב אֲבִי/כֶ֑ם וַֽ/תִּשְׁמְרוּ֙ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתָ֔י/ו וַֽ/תַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖ה אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vlbyt hrkhbym 'mr yrmyhv khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l y'n 'shr shm'tm 'l mtsvt yhvndb 'bykhm vtshmrv 't khl mtsvtyv vt'shv khkhl 'shr tsvh 'tkhm
verses.translation: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֨ת אִ֜ישׁ לְ/יוֹנָדָ֧ב בֶּן רֵכָ֛ב עֹמֵ֥ד לְ/פָנַ֖/י כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l l' ykhrt 'ysh lyvndb bn rkhb 'md lpny khl hymym
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הָ/רְבִיעִ֔ת לִ/יהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָ֞ה הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hrby't lyhvyqym bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh hyh hdbr hzh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD , saying,

verses.original: קַח לְ/ךָ֮ מְגִלַּת סֵפֶר֒ וְ/כָתַבְתָּ֣ אֵלֶ֗י/הָ אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֧רְתִּי אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל וְ/עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/עַל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם מִ/יּ֞וֹם דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מִ/ימֵ֣י יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ וְ/עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: qch lkh mglt spr vkhtbt 'lyh 't khl hdbrym 'shr dbrty 'lykh 'l yshr'l v'l yhvdh v'l khl hgvym myvm dbrty 'lykh mymy y'shyhv v'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.

verses.original: אוּלַ֤י יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֖ב לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ/הֶ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן יָשׁ֗וּבוּ אִ֚ישׁ מִ/דַּרְכּ֣/וֹ הָ/רָעָ֔ה וְ/סָלַחְתִּ֥י לַ/עֲוֺנָ֖/ם וּ/לְ/חַטָּאתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'vly yshm'v byt yhvdh 't khl hr'h 'shr 'nkhy chshb l'shvt lhm lm'n yshvbv 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vslchty l'vnm vlcht'tm
verses.translation: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּן נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֨ב בָּר֜וּךְ מִ/פִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלָ֖י/ו עַל מְגִלַּת סֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: vyqr' yrmyhv 't brvkh bn nryh vykhtb brvkh mpy yrmyhv 't khl dbry yhvh 'shr dbr 'lyv 'l mglt spr
verses.translation: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD , which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַוֶּ֣ה יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת בָּר֖וּךְ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֣י עָצ֔וּר לֹ֣א אוּכַ֔ל לָ/ב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytsvh yrmyhv 't brvkh l'mr 'ny 'tsvr l' 'vkhl lbv' byt yhvh
verses.translation: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD :

verses.original: וּ/בָאתָ֣ אַתָּ֡ה וְ/קָרָ֣אתָ בַ/מְּגִלָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַֽבְתָּ מִ/פִּ/י֩ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה בְּ/אָזְנֵ֥י הָ/עָ֛ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/י֣וֹם צ֑וֹם וְ/גַ֨ם בְּ/אָזְנֵ֧י כָל יְהוּדָ֛ה הַ/בָּאִ֥ים מֵ/עָרֵי/הֶ֖ם תִּקְרָאֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vb't 'th vqr't bmglh 'shr khtbt mpy 't dbry yhvh b'zny h'm byt yhvh byvm tsvm vgm b'zny khl yhvdh hb'ym m'ryhm tqr'm
verses.translation: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD’s house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.

verses.original: אוּלַ֞י תִּפֹּ֤ל תְּחִנָּתָ/ם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/יָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִ/דַּרְכּ֣/וֹ הָ/רָעָ֑ה כִּֽי גָד֤וֹל הָ/אַף֙ וְ/הַ֣/חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'vly tpl tchntm lpny yhvh vyshbv 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h khy gdvl h'f vhchmh 'shr dbr yhvh 'l h'm hzh
verses.translation: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD , and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗עַשׂ בָּרוּךְ֙ בֶּן נֵ֣רִיָּ֔ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖/הוּ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֑יא לִ/קְרֹ֥א בַ/סֵּ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh brvkh bn nryh khkhl 'shr tsvhv yrmyhv hnby' lqr' bspr dbry yhvh byt yhvh
verses.translation: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ֠/חֲמִשִׁית לִ/יהוֹיָקִ֨ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/תְּשִׁעִ֔י קָרְא֨וּ צ֜וֹם לִ/פְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֗ם הַ/בָּאִ֛ים מֵ/עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hchmshyt lyhvyqym bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh bchdsh htsh'y qr'v tsvm lpny yhvh khl h'm byrvshlm vkhl h'm hb'ym m'ry yhvdh byrvshlm
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א בָר֥וּךְ בַּ/סֵּ֛פֶר אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/לִשְׁכַּ֡ת גְּמַרְיָהוּ֩ בֶן שָׁפָ֨ן הַ/סֹּפֵ֜ר בֶּ/חָצֵ֣ר הָ/עֶלְי֗וֹן פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֤עַר בֵּית יְהוָה֙ הֶֽ/חָדָ֔שׁ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֖י כָּל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyqr' brvkh bspr 't dbry yrmyhv byt yhvh blshkht gmryhv bn shpn hspr bchtsr h'lyvn ptch sh'r byt yhvh hchdsh b'zny khl h'm
verses.translation: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD , in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD’s house, in the ears of all the people.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּשְׁמַ֗ע מִכָ֨יְהוּ בֶן גְּמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן שָׁפָ֛ן אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֥ל הַ/סֵּֽפֶר
verses.translit: vyshm' mkhyhv bn gmryhv bn shpn 't khl dbry yhvh m'l hspr
verses.translation: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD ,

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤רֶד בֵּית הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל לִשְׁכַּ֣ת הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר וְ/הִ֨נֵּה שָׁ֔ם כָּל הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים יֽוֹשְׁבִ֑ים אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַ/סֹּפֵ֡ר וּ/דְלָיָ֣הוּ בֶן שְׁ֠מַעְיָהוּ וְ/אֶלְנָתָ֨ן בֶּן עַכְבּ֜וֹר וּ/גְמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן שָׁפָ֛ן וְ/צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן חֲנַנְיָ֖הוּ וְ/כָל הַ/שָּׂרִֽים
verses.translit: vyrd byt hmlkh 'l lshkht hspr vhnh shm khl hshrym yvshbym 'lyshm' hspr vdlyhv bn shm'yhv v'lntn bn 'khbvr vgmryhv bn shpn vtsdqyhv bn chnnyhv vkhl hshrym
verses.translation: Then he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֤ד לָ/הֶם֙ מִכָ֔יְהוּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמֵ֑עַ בִּ/קְרֹ֥א בָר֛וּךְ בַּ/סֵּ֖פֶר בְּ/אָזְנֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vygd lhm mkhyhv 't khl hdbrym 'shr shm' bqr' brvkh bspr b'zny h'm
verses.translation: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֨וּ כָל הַ/שָּׂרִ֜ים אֶל בָּר֗וּךְ אֶת יְהוּדִ֡י בֶּן נְ֠תַנְיָהוּ בֶּן שֶׁלֶמְיָ֣הוּ בֶן כּוּשִׁי֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ הַ/מְּגִלָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤אתָ בָּ/הּ֙ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם קָחֶ֥/נָּה בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֖ וָ/לֵ֑ךְ וַ֠/יִּקַּח בָּר֨וּךְ בֶּן נֵרִיָּ֤הוּ אֶת הַ/מְּגִלָּה֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֖א אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshlchv khl hshrym 'l brvkh 't yhvdy bn ntnyhv bn shlmyhv bn khvshy l'mr hmglh 'shr qr't bh b'zny h'm qchnh bydkh vlkh vyqch brvkh bn nryhv 't hmglh bydv vyb' 'lyhm
verses.translation: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔י/ו שֵׁ֣ב נָ֔א וּ/קְרָאֶ֖/נָּה בְּ/אָזְנֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א בָר֖וּךְ בְּ/אָזְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv shb n' vqr'nh b'znynv vyqr' brvkh b'znyhm
verses.translation: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/שָׁמְעָ/ם֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים פָּחֲד֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל בָּר֔וּךְ הַגֵּ֤יד נַגִּיד֙ לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'm 't khl hdbrym pchdv 'ysh 'l r'hv vy'mrv 'l brvkh hgyd ngyd lmlkh 't khl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.

verses.original: וְ/אֶ֨ת בָּר֔וּךְ שָׁאֲל֖וּ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הַגֶּד נָ֣א לָ֔/נוּ אֵ֗יךְ כָּתַ֛בְתָּ אֶת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה מִ/פִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: v't brvkh sh'lv l'mr hgd n' lnv 'ykh khtbt 't khl hdbrym h'lh mpyv
verses.translation: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ בָּר֔וּךְ מִ/פִּי/ו֙ יִקְרָ֣א אֵלַ֔/י אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/אֲנִ֛י כֹּתֵ֥ב עַל הַ/סֵּ֖פֶר בַּ/דְּיֽוֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm brvkh mpyv yqr' 'ly 't khl hdbrym h'lh v'ny khtb 'l hspr bdyv
verses.translation: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ אֶל בָּר֔וּךְ לֵ֥ךְ הִסָּתֵ֖ר אַתָּ֣ה וְ/יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אַל יֵדַ֖ע אֵיפֹ֥ה אַתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv hshrym 'l brvkh lkh hstr 'th vyrmyhv v'ysh 'l yd' 'yph 'tm
verses.translation: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ חָצֵ֔רָ/ה וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּגִלָּ֣ה הִפְקִ֔דוּ בְּ/לִשְׁכַּ֖ת אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַ/סֹּפֵ֑ר וַ/יַּגִּ֨ידוּ֙ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִֽים
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l hmlkh chtsrh v't hmglh hpqdv blshkht 'lyshm' hspr vygydv b'zny hmlkh 't khl hdbrym
verses.translation: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת יְהוּדִ֗י לָ/קַ֨חַת֙ אֶת הַ/מְּגִלָּ֔ה וַ/יִּ֨קָּחֶ֔/הָ מִ/לִּשְׁכַּ֖ת אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַ/סֹּפֵ֑ר וַ/יִּקְרָאֶ֤/הָ יְהוּדִי֙ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וּ/בְ/אָזְנֵי֙ כָּל הַ/שָּׂרִ֔ים הָ/עֹמְדִ֖ים מֵ/עַ֥ל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh 't yhvdy lqcht 't hmglh vyqchh mlshkht 'lyshm' hspr vyqr'h yhvdy b'zny hmlkh vb'zny khl hshrym h'mdym m'l hmlkh
verses.translation: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe’s chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב֙ בֵּ֣ית הַ/חֹ֔רֶף בַּ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ/תְּשִׁיעִ֑י וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֖ח לְ/פָנָ֥י/ו מְבֹעָֽרֶת
verses.translit: vhmlkh yvshb byt hchrf bchdsh htshy'y v't h'ch lpnyv mb'rt
verses.translation: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כִּ/קְר֣וֹא יְהוּדִ֗י שָׁלֹ֣שׁ דְּלָתוֹת֮ וְ/אַרְבָּעָה֒ יִֽקְרָעֶ֨/הָ֙ בְּ/תַ֣עַר הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר וְ/הַשְׁלֵ֕ךְ אֶל הָ/אֵ֖שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶל הָ/אָ֑ח עַד תֹּם֙ כָּל הַ/מְּגִלָּ֔ה עַל הָ/אֵ֖שׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הָ/אָֽח
verses.translit: vyhy khqrv' yhvdy shlsh dltvt v'rb'h yqr'h bt'r hspr vhshlkh 'l h'sh 'shr 'l h'ch 'd tm khl hmglh 'l h'sh 'shr 'l h'ch
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א פָחֲד֔וּ וְ/לֹ֥א קָרְע֖וּ אֶת בִּגְדֵי/הֶ֑ם הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֔י/ו הַ/שֹּׁ֣מְעִ֔ים אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vl' pchdv vl' qr'v 't bgdyhm hmlkh vkhl 'bdyv hshm'ym 't khl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.

verses.original: וְ/גַם֩ אֶלְנָתָ֨ן וּ/דְלָיָ֤הוּ וּ/גְמַרְיָ֨הוּ֙ הִפְגִּ֣עוּ בַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י שְׂרֹ֖ף אֶת הַ/מְּגִלָּ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vgm 'lntn vdlyhv vgmryhv hpg'v bmlkh lblty shrf 't hmglh vl' shm' 'lyhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַוֶּ֣ה הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ אֶת יְרַחְמְאֵ֨ל בֶּן הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ וְ/אֶת שְׂרָיָ֣הוּ בֶן עַזְרִיאֵ֗ל וְ/אֶת שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּֽן עַבְדְּאֵ֔ל לָ/קַ֨חַת֙ אֶת בָּר֣וּךְ הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר וְ/אֵ֖ת יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֑יא וַ/יַּסְתִּרֵ֖/ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytsvh hmlkh 't yrchm'l bn hmlkh v't shryhv bn 'zry'l v't shlmyhv bn 'bd'l lqcht 't brvkh hspr v't yrmyhv hnby' vystrm yhvh
verses.translation: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the LORD hid them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ אַחֲרֵ֣י שְׂרֹ֣ף הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶת הַ/מְּגִלָּה֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּתַ֥ב בָּר֛וּךְ מִ/פִּ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv 'chry shrf hmlkh 't hmglh v't hdbrym 'shr khtb brvkh mpy yrmyhv l'mr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

verses.original: שׁ֥וּב קַח לְ/ךָ֖ מְגִלָּ֣ה אַחֶ֑רֶת וּ/כְתֹ֣ב עָלֶ֗י/הָ אֵ֤ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִים֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֗וּ עַל הַ/מְּגִלָּה֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֖ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: shvb qch lkh mglh 'chrt vkhtb 'lyh 't khl hdbrym hr'shnym 'shr hyv 'l hmglh hr'shnh 'shr shrf yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אַ֠תָּה שָׂרַ֜פְתָּ אֶת הַ/מְּגִלָּ֤ה הַ/זֹּאת֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מַדּוּעַ֩ כָּתַ֨בְתָּ עָלֶ֜י/הָ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר בֹּֽא יָב֤וֹא מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ וְ/הִשְׁחִית֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/הִשְׁבִּ֥ית מִמֶּ֖/נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּ/בְהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: v'l yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh t'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'th shrpt 't hmglh hz't l'mr mdv' khtbt 'lyh l'mr b' ybv' mlkh bbl vhshchyt 't h'rts hz't vhshbyt mmnh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah, Thus saith the LORD ; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל יְהֽוֹיָקִים֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹא יִֽהְיֶה לּ֥/וֹ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֑ד וְ/נִבְלָת/וֹ֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה מֻשְׁלֶ֔כֶת לַ/חֹ֥רֶב בַּ/יּ֖וֹם וְ/לַ/קֶּ֥רַח בַּ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'l yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh l' yhyh lv yvshb 'l khs' dvd vnbltv thyh mshlkht lchrb byvm vlqrch blylh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

verses.original: וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֨י עָלָ֧י/ו וְ/עַל זַרְע֛/וֹ וְ/עַל עֲבָדָ֖י/ו אֶת עֲוֺנָ֑/ם וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֣י עֲ֠לֵי/הֶם וְ/עַל יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וְ/אֶל אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֧ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: vpqdty 'lyv v'l zr'v v'l 'bdyv 't 'vnm vhb'ty 'lyhm v'l yshby yrvshlm v'l 'ysh yhvdh 't khl hr'h 'shr dbrty 'lyhm vl' shm'v
verses.translation: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.

verses.original: וְ/יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ לָקַ֣ח מְגִלָּ֣ה אַחֶ֗רֶת וַֽ/יִּתְּנָ/הּ֮ אֶל בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן נֵרִיָּהוּ֮ הַ/סֹּפֵר֒ וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֤ב עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ מִ/פִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/סֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֛ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ וְ/ע֨וֹד נוֹסַ֧ף עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם דְּבָרִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים כָּ/הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vyrmyhv lqch mglh 'chrt vytnh 'l brvkh bn nryhv hspr vykhtb 'lyh mpy yrmyhv 't khl dbry hspr 'shr shrf yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh b'sh v'vd nvsf 'lyhm dbrym rbym khhmh
verses.translation: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨מְלָךְ מֶ֔לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בֶּן יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ תַּ֗חַת כָּנְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן יְה֣וֹיָקִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלִ֛יךְ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vymlkh mlkh tsdqyhv bn y'shyhv tcht khnyhv bn yhvyqym 'shr hmlykh nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl b'rts yhvdh
verses.translation: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ע ה֥וּא וַ/עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וְ/עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֶל דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/יַ֖ד יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִֽיא
verses.translit: vl' shm' hv' v'bdyv v'm h'rts 'l dbry yhvh 'shr dbr byd yrmyhv hnby'
verses.translation: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the LORD , which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת יְהוּכַ֣ל בֶּן שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְ/אֶת צְפַנְיָ֤הוּ בֶן מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִתְפַּלֶּל נָ֣א בַעֲדֵ֔/נוּ אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh tsdqyhv 't yhvkhl bn shlmyh v't tspnyhv bn m'shyh hkhhn 'l yrmyhv hnby' l'mr htpll n' b'dnv 'l yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the LORD our God for us.

verses.original: וְ/יִרְמְיָ֕הוּ בָּ֥א וְ/יֹצֵ֖א בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עָ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא נָתְנ֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ בֵּ֥ית ה/כליא הַ/כְּלֽוּא
verses.translit: vyrmyhv b' vyts' btvkh h'm vl' ntnv 'tv byt hkhly' hkhlv'
verses.translation: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.

verses.original: וְ/חֵ֥יל פַּרְעֹ֖ה יָצָ֣א מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֨וּ הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַ/צָּרִ֤ים עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶת שִׁמְעָ֔/ם וַ/יֵּ֣עָל֔וּ מֵ/עַ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vchyl pr'h yts' mmtsrym vyshm'v hkhshdym htsrym 'l yrvshlm 't shm'm vy'lv m'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh’s army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הַ/שֹּׁלֵ֧חַ אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם אֵלַ֖/י לְ/דָרְשֵׁ֑/נִי הִנֵּ֣ה חֵ֣יל פַּרְעֹ֗ה הַ/יֹּצֵ֤א לָ/כֶם֙ לְ/עֶזְרָ֔ה שָׁ֥ב לְ/אַרְצ֖/וֹ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l khh t'mrv 'l mlkh yhvdh hshlch 'tkhm 'ly ldrshny hnh chyl pr'h hyts' lkhm l'zrh shb l'rtsv mtsrym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֨בוּ֙ הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְ/נִלְחֲמ֖וּ עַל הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֑את וּ/לְכָדֻ֖/הָ וּ/שְׂרָפֻ֥/הָ בָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vshbv hkhshdym vnlchmv 'l h'yr hz't vlkhdh vshrph b'sh
verses.translation: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל תַּשִּׁ֤אוּ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵי/כֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הָלֹ֛ךְ יֵלְכ֥וּ מֵ/עָלֵ֖י/נוּ הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּי לֹ֖א יֵלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l tsh'v npshtykhm l'mr hlkh ylkhv m'lynv hkhshdym khy l' ylkhv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם הִכִּיתֶ֞ם כָּל חֵ֤יל כַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַ/נִּלְחָמִ֣ים אִתְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/נִ֨שְׁאֲרוּ בָ֔/ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְדֻקָּרִ֑ים אִ֤ישׁ בְּ/אָהֳל/וֹ֙ יָק֔וּמוּ וְ/שָֽׂרְפ֛וּ אֶת הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֖את בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: khy 'm hkhytm khl chyl khshdym hnlchmym 'tkhm vnsh'rv bm 'nshym mdqrym 'ysh b'hlv yqvmv vshrpv 't h'yr hz't b'sh
verses.translation: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained but wounded men among them, yet should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה בְּ/הֵֽעָלוֹת֙ חֵ֣יל הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים מֵ/עַ֖ל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מִ/פְּנֵ֖י חֵ֥יל פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vhyh bh'lvt chyl hkhshdym m'l yrvshlm mpny chyl pr'h
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לָ/לֶ֖כֶת אֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן לַ/חֲלִ֥ק מִ/שָּׁ֖ם בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyts' yrmyhv myrvshlm llkht 'rts bnymn lchlq mshm btvkh h'm
verses.translation: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי ה֞וּא בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וְ/שָׁם֙ בַּ֣עַל פְּקִדֻ֔ת וּ/שְׁמ/וֹ֙ יִרְאִיָּ֔יה בֶּן שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖ה בֶּן חֲנַנְיָ֑ה וַ/יִּתְפֹּ֞שׂ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַ/נָּבִיא֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אֶל הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים אַתָּ֥ה נֹפֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy hv' bsh'r bnymn vshm b'l pqdt vshmv yr'yyh bn shlmyh bn chnnyh vytpsh 't yrmyhv hnby' l'mr 'l hkhshdym 'th npl
verses.translation: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ שֶׁ֗קֶר אֵינֶ֤/נִּי נֹפֵל֙ עַל הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתְפֹּ֤שׂ יִרְאִיָּיה֙ בְּ/יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וַ/יְבִאֵ֖/הוּ אֶל הַ/שָּׂרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv shqr 'ynny npl 'l hkhshdym vl' shm' 'lyv vytpsh yr'yyh byrmyhv vyb'hv 'l hshrym
verses.translation: Then said Jeremiah, It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְצְפ֧וּ הַ/שָּׂרִ֛ים עַֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ וְ/הִכּ֣וּ אֹת֑/וֹ וְ/נָתְנ֨וּ אוֹת֜/וֹ בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֵס֗וּר בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר כִּֽי אֹת֥/וֹ עָשׂ֖וּ לְ/בֵ֥ית הַ/כֶּֽלֶא
verses.translit: vyqtspv hshrym 'l yrmyhv vhkhv 'tv vntnv 'vtv byt h'svr byt yhvntn hspr khy 'tv 'shv lbyt hkhl'
verses.translation: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בָ֧א יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל בֵּ֥ית הַ/בּ֖וֹר וְ/אֶל הַֽ/חֲנֻ֑יוֹת וַ/יֵּֽשֶׁב שָׁ֥ם יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: khy b' yrmyhv 'l byt hbvr v'l hchnyvt vyshb shm yrmyhv ymym rbym
verses.translation: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַ/יִּקָּחֵ֗/הוּ וַ/יִּשְׁאָלֵ֨/הוּ הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ בְּ/בֵית/וֹ֙ בַּ/סֵּ֔תֶר וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הֲ/יֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֖ר מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ יֵ֔שׁ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר בְּ/יַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל תִּנָּתֵֽן
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh tsdqyhv vyqchhv vysh'lhv hmlkh bbytv bstr vy'mr hysh dbr m't yhvh vy'mr yrmyhv ysh vy'mr byd mlkh bbl tntn
verses.translation: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from the LORD ? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֑הוּ מֶה֩ חָטָ֨אתִֽי לְ/ךָ֤ וְ/לַ/עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּֽי נְתַתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖/י אֶל בֵּ֥ית הַ/כֶּֽלֶא
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'l hmlkh tsdqyhv mh cht'ty lkh vl'bdykh vl'm hzh khy nttm 'vty 'l byt hkhl'
verses.translation: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?

verses.original: ו/אי/ו וְ/אַיֵּה֙ נְבִ֣יאֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר נִבְּא֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹֽא יָבֹ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/עַ֖ל הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: v'yv v'yh nby'ykhm 'shr nb'v lkhm l'mr l' yb' mlkh bbl 'lykhm v'l h'rts hz't
verses.translation: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה שְֽׁמַֽע נָ֖א אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ תִּפָּל נָ֤א תְחִנָּתִ/י֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אַל תְּשִׁבֵ֗/נִי בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר וְ/לֹ֥א אָמ֖וּת שָֽׁם
verses.translit: v'th shm' n' 'dny hmlkh tpl n' tchnty lpnykh v'l tshbny byt yhvntn hspr vl' 'mvt shm
verses.translation: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַוֶּ֞ה הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יַּפְקִ֣דוּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ בַּ/חֲצַ֣ר הַ/מַּטָּרָה֒ וְ/נָתֹן֩ ל֨/וֹ כִכַּר לֶ֤חֶם לַ/יּוֹם֙ מִ/ח֣וּץ הָ/אֹפִ֔ים עַד תֹּ֥ם כָּל הַ/לֶּ֖חֶם מִן הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּ/חֲצַ֖ר הַ/מַּטָּרָֽה
verses.translit: vytsvh hmlkh tsdqyhv vypqdv 't yrmyhv bchtsr hmtrh vntn lv khkhr lchm lyvm mchvts h'pym 'd tm khl hlchm mn h'yr vyshb yrmyhv bchtsr hmtrh
verses.translation: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֞ע שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בֶן מַתָּ֗ן וּ/גְדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן פַּשְׁח֔וּר וְ/יוּכַל֙ בֶּן שֶׁ֣לֶמְיָ֔הוּ וּ/פַשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן מַלְכִּיָּ֑ה אֶ֨ת הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ מְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyshm' shptyh bn mtn vgdlyhv bn pshchvr vyvkhl bn shlmyhv vpshchvr bn mlkhyh 't hdbrym 'shr yrmyhv mdbr 'l khl h'm l'mr
verses.translation: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,

verses.original: כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ הַ/יֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב בָּ/רָעָ֣ב וּ/בַ/דָּ֑בֶר וְ/הַ/יֹּצֵ֤א אֶל הַ/כַּשְׂדִּים֙ יחיה וְ/חָיָ֔ה וְ/הָיְתָה לּ֥/וֹ נַפְשׁ֛/וֹ לְ/שָׁלָ֖ל וָ/חָֽי
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hyshb b'yr hz't ymvt bchrb br'b vbdbr vhyts' 'l hkhshdym ychyh vchyh vhyth lv npshv lshll vchy
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.

verses.original: כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנָּתֹ֨ן תִּנָּתֵ֜ן הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֗את בְּ/יַ֛ד חֵ֥יל מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וּ/לְכָדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hntn tntn h'yr hz't byd chyl mlkh bbl vlkhdh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which shall take it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ הַ/שָּׂרִ֜ים אֶל הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ י֣וּמַת נָא֮ אֶת הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/זֶּה֒ כִּֽי עַל כֵּ֡ן הֽוּא מְרַפֵּ֡א אֶת יְדֵי֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֜ה הַֽ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֗את וְ/אֵת֙ יְדֵ֣י כָל הָ/עָ֔ם לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כַּ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֣י הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/זֶּ֗ה אֵינֶ֨/נּוּ דֹרֵ֧שׁ לְ/שָׁל֛וֹם לָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה כִּ֥י אִם לְ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv hshrym 'l hmlkh yvmt n' 't h'ysh hzh khy 'l khn hv' mrp' 't ydy 'nshy hmlchmh hnsh'rym b'yr hz't v't ydy khl h'm ldbr 'lyhm khdbrym h'lh khy h'ysh hzh 'ynnv drsh lshlvm l'm hzh khy 'm lr'h
verses.translation: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ הִנֵּה ה֖וּא בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי אֵ֣ין הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ יוּכַ֥ל אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh tsdqyhv hnh hv' bydkhm khy 'yn hmlkh yvkhl 'tkhm dbr
verses.translation: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king is not he that can do any thing against you.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֣וּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֨כוּ אֹת֜/וֹ אֶל הַ/בּ֣וֹר מַלְכִּיָּ֣הוּ בֶן הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר֙ בַּ/חֲצַ֣ר הַ/מַּטָּרָ֔ה וַ/יְשַׁלְּח֥וּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בַּ/חֲבָלִ֑ים וּ/בַ/בּ֤וֹר אֵֽין מַ֨יִם֙ כִּ֣י אִם טִ֔יט וַ/יִּטְבַּ֥ע יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בַּ/טִּֽיט
verses.translit: vyqchv 't yrmyhv vyshlkhv 'tv 'l hbvr mlkhyhv bn hmlkh 'shr bchtsr hmtrh vyshlchv 't yrmyhv bchblym vbbvr 'yn mym khy 'm tyt vytb' yrmyhv btyt
verses.translation: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that was in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֡ע עֶֽבֶד מֶ֨לֶךְ הַ/כּוּשִׁ֜י אִ֣ישׁ סָרִ֗יס וְ/הוּא֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי נָתְנ֥וּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֶל הַ/בּ֑וֹר וְ/הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/שַׁ֥עַר בִּנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: vyshm' 'bd mlkh hkhvshy 'ysh srys vhv' bbyt hmlkh khy ntnv 't yrmyhv 'l hbvr vhmlkh yvshb bsh'r bnymn
verses.translation: Now when Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א עֶֽבֶד מֶ֖לֶךְ מִ/בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyts' 'bd mlkh mbyt hmlkh vydbr 'l hmlkh l'mr
verses.translation: Ebed-melech went forth out of the king’s house, and spake to the king, saying,

verses.original: אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ הֵרֵ֜עוּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְ/יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִ֖יכוּ אֶל הַ/בּ֑וֹר וַ/יָּ֤מָת תַּחְתָּי/ו֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הָֽ/רָעָ֔ב כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין הַ/לֶּ֛חֶם ע֖וֹד בָּ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: 'dny hmlkh hr'v h'nshym h'lh 't khl 'shr 'shv lyrmyhv hnby' 't 'shr hshlykhv 'l hbvr vymt tchtyv mpny hr'b khy 'yn hlchm 'vd b'yr
verses.translation: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַוֶּ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֛ת עֶֽבֶד מֶ֥לֶךְ הַ/כּוּשִׁ֖י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר קַ֣ח בְּ/יָדְ/ךָ֤ מִ/זֶּה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְֽ/הַעֲלִ֜יתָ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֧הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֛יא מִן הַ/בּ֖וֹר בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vytsvh hmlkh 't 'bd mlkh hkhvshy l'mr qch bydkh mzh shlshym 'nshym vh'lyt 't yrmyhv hnby' mn hbvr btrm ymvt
verses.translation: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח עֶֽבֶד מֶ֨לֶךְ אֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּ/יָד֗/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֤א בֵית הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל תַּ֣חַת הָ/אוֹצָ֔ר וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח מִ/שָּׁם֙ בְּלוֹיֵ֣ ה/סחבות סְחָב֔וֹת וּ/בְלוֹיֵ֖ מְלָחִ֑ים וַ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֧/ם אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל הַ/בּ֖וֹר בַּ/חֲבָלִֽים
verses.translit: vyqch 'bd mlkh 't h'nshym bydv vyb' byt hmlkh 'l tcht h'vtsr vyqch mshm blvy hschbvt schbvt vblvy mlchym vyshlchm 'l yrmyhv 'l hbvr bchblym
verses.translation: So Ebed-melech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר עֶבֶד מֶ֨לֶךְ הַ/כּוּשִׁ֜י אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ שִׂ֣ים נָ֠א בְּלוֹאֵ֨י הַ/סְּחָב֤וֹת וְ/הַ/מְּלָחִים֙ תַּ֚חַת אַצִּל֣וֹת יָדֶ֔י/ךָ מִ/תַּ֖חַת לַ/חֲבָלִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bd mlkh hkhvshy 'l yrmyhv shym n' blv'y hschbvt vhmlchym tcht 'tslvt ydykh mtcht lchblym vy'sh yrmyhv khn
verses.translation: And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְשְׁכ֤וּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ בַּֽ/חֲבָלִ֔ים וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ מִן הַ/בּ֑וֹר וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּ/חֲצַ֖ר הַ/מַּטָּרָֽה
verses.translit: vymshkhv 't yrmyhv bchblym vy'lv 'tv mn hbvr vyshb yrmyhv bchtsr hmtrh
verses.translation: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַ/נָּבִיא֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו אֶל מָבוֹא֙ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ שֹׁאֵ֨ל אֲנִ֤י אֹֽתְ/ךָ֙ דָּבָ֔ר אַל תְּכַחֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖/נִּי דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh tsdqyhv vyqch 't yrmyhv hnby' 'lyv 'l mbv' hshlyshy 'shr bbyt yhvh vy'mr hmlkh 'l yrmyhv sh'l 'ny 'tkh dbr 'l tkhchd mmny dbr
verses.translation: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the LORD : and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶל צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּ֚י אַגִּ֣יד לְ/ךָ֔ הֲ/ל֖וֹא הָמֵ֣ת תְּמִיתֵ֑/נִי וְ/כִי֙ אִיעָ֣צְ/ךָ֔ לֹ֥א תִשְׁמַ֖ע אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'l tsdqyhv khy 'gyd lkh hlv' hmt tmytny vkhy 'y'tskh l' tshm' 'ly
verses.translation: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare it unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֞ע הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֛הוּ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בַּ/סֵּ֣תֶר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר חַי יְהוָ֞ה את אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשָׂה לָ֨/נוּ אֶת הַ/נֶּ֤פֶשׁ הַ/זֹּאת֙ אִם אֲמִיתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/אִם אֶתֶּנְ/ךָ֗ בְּ/יַד֙ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְבַקְשִׁ֖ים אֶת נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyshb' hmlkh tsdqyhv 'l yrmyhv bstr l'mr chy yhvh 't 'shr 'shh lnv 't hnpsh hz't 'm 'mytkh v'm 'tnkh byd h'nshym h'lh 'shr mbqshym 't npshkh
verses.translation: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As the LORD liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ אֶל צִדְקִיָּ֡הוּ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם יָצֹ֨א תֵצֵ֜א אֶל שָׂרֵ֤י מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ וְ/חָיְתָ֣ה נַפְשֶׁ֔/ךָ וְ/הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את לֹ֥א תִשָּׂרֵ֖ף בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ וְ/חָיִ֖תָה אַתָּ֥ה וּ/בֵיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'l tsdqyhv khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'm yts' tts' 'l shry mlkh bbl vchyth npshkh vh'yr hz't l' tshrf b'sh vchyth 'th vbytkh
verses.translation: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus saith the LORD , the God of hosts, the God of Israel; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon’s princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and thou shalt live, and thine house:

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ם לֹֽא תֵצֵ֗א אֶל שָׂרֵי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/נִתְּנָ֞ה הָ/עִ֤יר הַ/זֹּאת֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּ/שְׂרָפ֖וּ/הָ בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה לֹֽא תִמָּלֵ֥ט מִ/יָּדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'm l' tts' 'l shry mlkh bbl vntnh h'yr hz't byd hkhshdym vshrpvh b'sh v'th l' tmlt mydm
verses.translation: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ אֲנִ֧י דֹאֵ֣ג אֶת הַ/יְּהוּדִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽפְלוּ֙ אֶל הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים פֶּֽן יִתְּנ֥וּ אֹתִ֛/י בְּ/יָדָ֖/ם וְ/הִתְעַלְּלוּ בִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh tsdqyhv 'l yrmyhv 'ny d'g 't hyhvdym 'shr nplv 'l hkhshdym pn ytnv 'ty bydm vht'llv by
verses.translation: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֹ֣א יִתֵּ֑נוּ שְֽׁמַֽע נָ֣א בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֗ה לַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ דֹּבֵ֣ר אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/יִ֥יטַב לְ/ךָ֖ וּ/תְחִ֥י נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv l' ytnv shm' n' bqvl yhvh l'shr 'ny dbr 'lykh vyytb lkh vtchy npshkh
verses.translation: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver thee . Obey, I beseech thee, the voice of the LORD , which I speak unto thee: so it shall be well unto thee, and thy soul shall live.

verses.original: וְ/אִם מָאֵ֥ן אַתָּ֖ה לָ/צֵ֑את זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִרְאַ֖/נִי יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm m'n 'th lts't zh hdbr 'shr hr'ny yhvh
verses.translation: But if thou refuse to go forth, this is the word that the LORD hath shewed me:

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה כָל הַ/נָּשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁאֲרוּ֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה מוּצָא֕וֹת אֶל שָׂרֵ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וְ/הֵ֣נָּה אֹמְר֗וֹת הִסִּית֜וּ/ךָ וְ/יָכְל֤וּ לְ/ךָ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י שְׁלֹמֶ֔/ךָ הָטְבְּע֥וּ בַ/בֹּ֛ץ רַגְלֶ֖/ךָ נָסֹ֥גוּ אָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: vhnh khl hnshym 'shr nsh'rv bbyt mlkh yhvdh mvts'vt 'l shry mlkh bbl vhnh 'mrvt hsytvkh vykhlv lkh 'nshy shlmkh htb'v bbts rglkh nsgv 'chvr
verses.translation: And, behold, all the women that are left in the king of Judah’s house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women shall say, Thy friends have set thee on, and have prevailed against thee: thy feet are sunk in the mire, and they are turned away back.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל נָשֶׁ֣י/ךָ וְ/אֶת בָּנֶ֗י/ךָ מֽוֹצִאִים֙ אֶל הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְ/אַתָּ֖ה לֹא תִמָּלֵ֣ט מִ/יָּדָ֑/ם כִּ֣י בְ/יַ֤ד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ תִּתָּפֵ֔שׂ וְ/אֶת הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֖את תִּשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: v't khl nshykh v't bnykh mvts'ym 'l hkhshdym v'th l' tmlt mydm khy byd mlkh bbl ttpsh v't h'yr hz't tshrf b'sh
verses.translation: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans: and thou shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אִ֛ישׁ אַל יֵדַ֥ע בַּ/דְּבָֽרִים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/לֹ֥א תָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mr tsdqyhv 'l yrmyhv 'ysh 'l yd' bdbrym h'lh vl' tmvt
verses.translation: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִשְׁמְע֣וּ הַ/שָּׂרִים֮ כִּֽי דִבַּ֣רְתִּי אִתָּ/ךְ֒ וּ/בָ֣אוּ אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ וְֽ/אָמְר֪וּ אֵלֶ֟י/ךָ הַגִּֽידָ/ה נָּ֨א לָ֜/נוּ מַה דִּבַּ֧רְתָּ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אַל תְּכַחֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ וְ/לֹ֣א נְמִיתֶ֑/ךָ וּ/מַה דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vkhy yshm'v hshrym khy dbrty 'tkh vb'v 'lykh v'mrv 'lykh hgydh n' lnv mh dbrt 'l hmlkh 'l tkhchd mmnv vl' nmytkh vmh dbr 'lykh hmlkh
verses.translation: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee, and they come unto thee, and say unto thee, Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put thee to death; also what the king said unto thee:

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם מַפִּיל אֲנִ֥י תְחִנָּתִ֖/י לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ לְ/בִלְתִּ֧י הֲשִׁיבֵ֛/נִי בֵּ֥ית יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן לָ/מ֥וּת שָֽׁם
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm mpyl 'ny tchnty lpny hmlkh lblty hshybny byt yhvntn lmvt shm
verses.translation: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ כָל הַ/שָּׂרִ֤ים אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ וַ/יִּשְׁאֲל֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ וַ/יַּגֵּ֤ד לָ/הֶם֙ כְּ/כָל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יַּחֲרִ֣שׁוּ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹֽא נִשְׁמַ֖ע הַ/דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vyb'v khl hshrym 'l yrmyhv vysh'lv 'tv vygd lhm khkhl hdbrym h'lh 'shr tsvh hmlkh vychrshv mmnv khy l' nshm' hdbr
verses.translation: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ בַּ/חֲצַ֣ר הַ/מַּטָּרָ֔ה עַד י֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר נִלְכְּדָ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/הָיָ֕ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִלְכְּדָ֖ה יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyshb yrmyhv bchtsr hmtrh 'd yvm 'shr nlkhdh yrvshlm vhyh kh'shr nlkhdh yrvshlm
verses.translation: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was there when Jerusalem was taken.

verses.original: בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ֠/תְּשִׁעִית לְ/צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/עֲשִׂרִ֗י בָּ֠א נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֨ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֤ל וְ/כָל חֵיל/וֹ֙ אֶל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יָּצֻ֖רוּ עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: bshnh htsh'yt ltsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh bchdsh h'shry b' nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl vkhl chylv 'l yrvshlm vytsrv 'lyh
verses.translation: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.

verses.original: בְּ/עַשְׁתֵּֽי עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ לְ/צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הָ/רְבִיעִ֖י בְּ/תִשְׁעָ֣ה לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָבְקְעָ֖ה הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: b'shty 'shrh shnh ltsdqyhv bchdsh hrby'y btsh'h lchdsh hbq'h h'yr
verses.translation: And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, the city was broken up.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ כֹּ֚ל שָׂרֵ֣י מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר הַ/תָּ֑וֶךְ נֵרְגַ֣ל שַׂר אֶ֠צֶר סַֽמְגַּר נְב֞וּ שַׂר סְכִ֣ים רַב סָרִ֗יס נֵרְגַ֤ל שַׂר אֶ֨צֶר֙ רַב מָ֔ג וְ/כָל שְׁאֵרִ֔ית שָׂרֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: vyb'v khl shry mlkh bbl vyshbv bsh'r htvkh nrgl shr 'tsr smgr nbv shr skhym rb srys nrgl shr 'tsr rb mg vkhl sh'ryt shry mlkh bbl
verses.translation: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, even Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag, with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֠אָ/ם צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְ/כֹ֣ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה וַֽ֠/יִּבְרְחוּ וַ/יֵּצְא֨וּ לַ֤יְלָה מִן הָ/עִיר֙ דֶּ֚רֶךְ גַּ֣ן הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּ/שַׁ֖עַר בֵּ֣ין הַ/חֹמֹתָ֑יִם וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א דֶּ֥רֶךְ הָ/עֲרָבָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr r'm tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh vkhl 'nshy hmlchmh vybrchv vyts'v lylh mn h'yr drkh gn hmlkh bsh'r byn hchmtym vyts' drkh h'rbh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדְּפ֨וּ חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּ֜ים אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֗ם וַ/יַּשִּׂ֣גוּ אֶת צִדְקִיָּהוּ֮ בְּ/עַֽרְב֣וֹת יְרֵחוֹ֒ וַ/יִּקְח֣וּ אֹת֗/וֹ וַֽ֠/יַּעֲלֻ/הוּ אֶל נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל רִבְלָ֖תָ/ה בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ מִשְׁפָּטִֽים
verses.translit: vyrdpv chyl khshdym 'chryhm vyshgv 't tsdqyhv b'rbvt yrchv vyqchv 'tv vy'lhv 'l nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl rblth b'rts chmt vydbr 'tv mshptym
verses.translation: But the Chaldeans’ army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁחַט֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל אֶת בְּנֵ֧י צִדְקִיָּ֛הוּ בְּ/רִבְלָ֖ה לְ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל חֹרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה שָׁחַ֖ט מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: vyshcht mlkh bbl 't bny tsdqyhv brblh l'ynyv v't khl chry yhvdh shcht mlkh bbl
verses.translation: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עֵינֵ֥י צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ עִוֵּ֑ר וַ/יַּאַסְרֵ֨/הוּ֙ בַּֽ/נְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם לָ/בִ֥יא אֹת֖/וֹ בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: v't 'yny tsdqyhv 'vr vy'srhv bnchshtym lby' 'tv bblh
verses.translation: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בֵּ֤ית הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית הָ/עָ֔ם שָׂרְפ֥וּ הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ וְ/אֶת חֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם נָתָֽצוּ
verses.translit: v't byt hmlkh v't byt h'm shrpv hkhshdym b'sh v't chmvt yrvshlm nttsv
verses.translation: And the Chaldeans burned the king’s house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ יֶ֨תֶר הָ/עָ֜ם הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּ/עִ֗יר וְ/אֶת הַ/נֹּֽפְלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפְל֣וּ עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֛ת יֶ֥תֶר הָ/עָ֖ם הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֑ים הֶגְלָ֛ה נְבֽוּזַר אֲדָ֥ן רַב טַבָּחִ֖ים בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: v't ytr h'm hnsh'rym b'yr v't hnplym 'shr nplv 'lyv v't ytr h'm hnsh'rym hglh nbvzr 'dn rb tbchym bbl
verses.translation: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/דַּלִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵין לָ/הֶם֙ מְא֔וּמָה הִשְׁאִ֛יר נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֥ן רַב טַבָּחִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן לָ/הֶ֛ם כְּרָמִ֥ים וִֽ/יגֵבִ֖ים בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vmn h'm hdlym 'shr 'yn lhm m'vmh hsh'yr nbvzr'dn rb tbchym b'rts yhvdh vytn lhm khrmym vygbym byvm hhv'
verses.translation: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֛ו נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל עַֽל יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ בְּ/יַ֛ד נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֥ן רַב טַבָּחִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytsv nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl 'l yrmyhv byd nbvzr'dn rb tbchym l'mr
verses.translation: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard, saying,

verses.original: קָחֶ֗/נּוּ וְ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ שִׂ֣ים עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/אַל תַּ֥עַשׂ ל֖/וֹ מְא֣וּמָה רָּ֑ע כִּ֗י אם כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ כֵּ֖ן עֲשֵׂ֥ה עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: qchnv v'ynykh shym 'lyv v'l t'sh lv m'vmh r' khy 'm kh'shr ydbr 'lykh khn 'shh 'mv
verses.translation: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָ֣ן רַב טַבָּחִ֗ים וּ/נְבֽוּשַׁזְבָּן֙ רַב סָרִ֔יס וְ/נֵרְגַ֥ל שַׂר אֶ֖צֶר רַב מָ֑ג וְ/כֹ֖ל רַבֵּ֥י מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: vyshlch nbvzr'dn rb tbchym vnbvshzbn rb srys vnrgl shr 'tsr rb mg vkhl rby mlkh bbl
verses.translation: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban, Rab-saris, and Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag, and all the king of Babylon’s princes;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלְחוּ֩ וַ/יִּקְח֨וּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ מֵ/חֲצַ֣ר הַ/מַּטָּרָ֗ה וַ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁפָ֔ן לְ/הוֹצִאֵ֖/הוּ אֶל הַ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyshlchv vyqchv 't yrmyhv mchtsr hmtrh vytnv 'tv 'l gdlyhv bn 'chyqm bn shpn lhvts'hv 'l hbyt vyshb btvkh h'm
verses.translation: Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he dwelt among the people.

verses.original: וְ/אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הָיָ֣ה דְבַר יְהוָ֑ה בִּֽ/הְיֹת֣/וֹ עָצ֔וּר בַּ/חֲצַ֥ר הַ/מַּטָּרָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'l yrmyhv hyh dbr yhvh bhytv 'tsvr bchtsr hmtrh l'mr
verses.translation: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

verses.original: הָל֣וֹךְ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֡ לְ/עֶבֶד מֶ֨לֶךְ הַ/כּוּשִׁ֜י לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִי֩ מבי מֵבִ֨יא אֶת דְּבָרַ֜/י אֶל הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֛את לְ/רָעָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א לְ/טוֹבָ֑ה וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: hlvkh v'mrt l'bd mlkh hkhvshy l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny mby mby' 't dbry 'l h'yr hz't lr'h vl' ltvbh vhyv lpnykh byvm hhv'
verses.translation: Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in that day before thee.

verses.original: וְ/הִצַּלְתִּ֥י/ךָ בַ/יּוֹם הַ/ה֖וּא נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה יָג֖וֹר מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhtsltykh byvm hhv' n'm yhvh vl' tntn byd h'nshym 'shr 'th ygvr mpnyhm
verses.translation: But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the LORD : and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מַלֵּט֙ אֲמַלֶּטְ/ךָ֔ וּ/בַ/חֶ֖רֶב לֹ֣א תִפֹּ֑ל וְ/הָיְתָ֨ה לְ/ךָ֤ נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֙ לְ/שָׁלָ֔ל כִּֽי בָטַ֥חְתָּ בִּ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy mlt 'mltkh vbchrb l' tpl vhyth lkh npshkh lshll khy btcht by n'm yhvh
verses.translation: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֤ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אַחַ֣ר שַׁלַּ֣ח אֹת֗/וֹ נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֛ן רַב טַבָּחִ֖ים מִן הָֽ/רָמָ֑ה בְּ/קַחְתּ֣/וֹ אֹת֗/וֹ וְ/הֽוּא אָס֤וּר בָּֽ/אזִקִּים֙ בְּ/ת֨וֹךְ כָּל גָּל֤וּת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה הַ/מֻּגְלִ֖ים בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh 'chr shlch 'tv nbvzr'dn rb tbchym mn hrmh bqchtv 'tv vhv' 'svr b'zqym btvkh khl glvt yrvshlm vyhvdh hmglym bblh
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD , after that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח רַב טַבָּחִ֖ים לְ/יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ דִּבֶּר֙ אֶת הָ/רָעָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyqch rb tbchym lyrmyhv vy'mr 'lyv yhvh 'lhykh dbr 't hr'h hz't 'l hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֥א וַ/יַּ֛עַשׂ יְהוָ֖ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר כִּֽי חֲטָאתֶ֤ם לַֽ/יהוָה֙ וְ/לֹֽא שְׁמַעְתֶּ֣ם בְּ/קוֹל֔/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם דבר הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyb' vy'sh yhvh kh'shr dbr khy cht'tm lyhvh vl' shm'tm bqvlv vhyh lkhm dbr hdbr hzh
verses.translation: Now the LORD hath brought it , and done according as he hath said: because ye have sinned against the LORD , and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה הִנֵּ֧ה פִתַּחְתִּ֣י/ךָ הַ/יּ֗וֹם מִֽן הָ/אזִקִּים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל יָדֶ/ךָ֒ אִם ט֨וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֜י/ךָ לָ/ב֧וֹא אִתִּ֣/י בָבֶ֗ל בֹּ֚א וְ/אָשִׂ֤ים אֶת עֵינִ/י֙ עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אִם רַ֧ע בְּ/עֵינֶ֛י/ךָ לָ/בֽוֹא אִתִּ֥/י בָבֶ֖ל חֲדָ֑ל רְאֵה֙ כָּל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ אֶל ט֨וֹב וְ/אֶל הַ/יָּשָׁ֧ר בְּ/עֵינֶ֛י/ךָ לָ/לֶ֥כֶת שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לֵֽךְ
verses.translit: v'th hnh ptchtykh hyvm mn h'zqym 'shr 'l ydkh 'm tvb b'ynykh lbv' 'ty bbl b' v'shym 't 'yny 'lykh v'm r' b'ynykh lbv' 'ty bbl chdl r'h khl h'rts lpnykh 'l tvb v'l hyshr b'ynykh llkht shmh lkh
verses.translation: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.

verses.original: וְ/עוֹדֶ֣/נּוּ לֹֽא יָשׁ֗וּב וְ/שֻׁ֡בָ/ה אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֣ה בֶן אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁפָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ הִפְקִ֨יד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/שֵׁ֤ב אִתּ/וֹ֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עָ֔ם א֠וֹ אֶל כָּל הַ/יָּשָׁ֧ר בְּ/עֵינֶ֛י/ךָ לָ/לֶ֖כֶת לֵ֑ךְ וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֧/וֹ רַב טַבָּחִ֛ים אֲרֻחָ֥ה וּ/מַשְׂאֵ֖ת וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: v'vdnv l' yshvb vshbh 'l gdlyh bn 'chyqm bn shpn 'shr hpqyd mlkh bbl b'ry yhvdh vshb 'tv btvkh h'm 'v 'l khl hyshr b'ynykh llkht lkh vytn lv rb tbchym 'rchh vmsh't vyshlchhv
verses.translation: Now while he was not yet gone back, he said , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֧א יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֥ה בֶן אֲחִיקָ֖ם הַ/מִּצְפָּ֑תָ/ה וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב אִתּ/וֹ֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עָ֔ם הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyb' yrmyhv 'l gdlyh bn 'chyqm hmtspth vyshb 'tv btvkh h'm hnsh'rym b'rts
verses.translation: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְעוּ֩ כָל שָׂרֵ֨י הַ/חֲיָלִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה הֵ֚מָּה וְ/אַנְשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם כִּֽי הִפְקִ֧יד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֥הוּ בֶן אֲחִיקָ֖ם בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/כִ֣י הִפְקִ֣יד אִתּ֗/וֹ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְ/נָשִׁים֙ וָ/טָ֔ף וּ/מִ/דַּלַּ֣ת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא הָגְל֖וּ בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshm'v khl shry hchylym 'shr bshdh hmh v'nshyhm khy hpqyd mlkh bbl 't gdlyhv bn 'chyqm b'rts vkhy hpqyd 'tv 'nshym vnshym vtf vmdlt h'rts m'shr l' hglv bblh
verses.translation: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed unto him men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon;

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֖ה הַ/מִּצְפָּ֑תָ/ה וְ/יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֡הוּ וְ/יוֹחָנָ֣ן וְ/יוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנֵֽי קָ֠רֵחַ וּ/שְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן תַּנְחֻ֜מֶת וּ/בְנֵ֣י עופי עֵיפַ֣י הַ/נְּטֹפָתִ֗י וִֽ/יזַנְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן הַ/מַּ֣עֲכָתִ֔י הֵ֖מָּה וְ/אַנְשֵׁי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l gdlyh hmtspth vyshm''l bn ntnyhv vyvchnn vyvntn bny qrch vshryh bn tnchmt vbny 'vpy 'ypy hntpty vyznyhv bn hm'khty hmh v'nshyhm
verses.translation: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֨ע לָ/הֶ֜ם גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ בֶן אֲחִיקָ֤ם בֶּן שָׁפָן֙ וּ/לְ/אַנְשֵׁי/הֶ֣ם לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַל תִּֽירְא֖וּ מֵ/עֲב֣וֹד הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים שְׁב֣וּ בָ/אָ֗רֶץ וְ/עִבְד֛וּ אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְ/יִיטַ֥ב לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshb' lhm gdlyhv bn 'chyqm bn shpn vl'nshyhm l'mr 'l tyr'v m'bvd hkhshdym shbv b'rts v'bdv 't mlkh bbl vyytb lkhm
verses.translation: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י הִנְ/נִ֤י יֹשֵׁב֙ בַּ/מִּצְפָּ֔ה לַֽ/עֲמֹד֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֖אוּ אֵלֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/אַתֶּ֡ם אִסְפוּ֩ יַ֨יִן וְ/קַ֜יִץ וְ/שֶׁ֗מֶן וְ/שִׂ֨מוּ֙ בִּ/כְלֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/שְׁב֖וּ בְּ/עָרֵי/כֶ֥ם אֲשֶׁר תְּפַשְׂתֶּֽם
verses.translit: v'ny hnny yshb bmtsph l'md lpny hkhshdym 'shr yb'v 'lynv v'tm 'spv yyn vqyts vshmn vshmv bkhlykhm vshbv b'rykhm 'shr tpshtm
verses.translation: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but ye, gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם כָּֽל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר בְּ/מוֹאָ֣ב וּ/בִ/בְנֵֽי עַמּ֨וֹן וּ/בֶ/אֱד֜וֹם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּ/כָל הָֽ/אֲרָצוֹת֙ שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּֽי נָתַ֧ן מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל שְׁאֵרִ֖ית לִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה וְ/כִי֙ הִפְקִ֣יד עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן אֲחִיקָ֥ם בֶּן שָׁפָֽן
verses.translit: vgm khl hyhvdym 'shr bmv'b vbbny 'mvn vb'dvm v'shr bkhl h'rtsvt shm'v khy ntn mlkh bbl sh'ryt lyhvdh vkhy hpqyd 'lyhm 't gdlyhv bn 'chyqm bn shpn
verses.translation: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֣בוּ כָל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֗ים מִ/כָּל הַ/מְּקֹמוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִדְּחוּ שָׁ֔ם וַ/יָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶֽרֶץ יְהוּדָ֛ה אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ הַ/מִּצְפָּ֑תָ/ה וַ/יַּאַסְפ֛וּ יַ֥יִן וָ/קַ֖יִץ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyshbv khl hyhvdym mkhl hmqmvt 'shr ndchv shm vyb'v 'rts yhvdh 'l gdlyhv hmtspth vy'spv yyn vqyts hrbh m'd
verses.translation: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

verses.original: וְ/יֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ וְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/חֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה בָּ֥אוּ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ הַ/מִּצְפָּֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: vyvchnn bn qrch vkhl shry hchylym 'shr bshdh b'v 'l gdlyhv hmtspth
verses.translation: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו הֲ/יָדֹ֤עַ תֵּדַע֙ כִּ֞י בַּעֲלִ֣יס מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֗וֹן שָׁלַח֙ אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֔ה לְ/הַכֹּתְ/ךָ֖ נָ֑פֶשׁ וְ/לֹא הֶאֱמִ֣ין לָ/הֶ֔ם גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן אֲחִיקָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv hyd' td' khy b'lys mlkh bny 'mvn shlch 't yshm''l bn ntnyh lhkhtkh npsh vl' h'myn lhm gdlyhv bn 'chyqm
verses.translation: And said unto him, Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן קָרֵ֡חַ אָמַ֣ר אֶל גְּדַלְיָהוּ֩ בַ/סֵּ֨תֶר בַּ/מִּצְפָּ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אֵ֤לְכָה נָּא֙ וְ/אַכֶּה֙ אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֔ה וְ/אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע לָ֧/מָּה יַכֶּ֣/כָּה נֶּ֗פֶשׁ וְ/נָפֹ֨צוּ֙ כָּל יְהוּדָ֔ה הַ/נִּקְבָּצִ֣ים אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אָבְדָ֖ה שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyvchnn bn qrch 'mr 'l gdlyhv bstr bmtsph l'mr 'lkhh n' v'khh 't yshm''l bn ntnyh v'ysh l' yd' lmh ykhkhh npsh vnptsv khl yhvdh hnqbtsym 'lykh v'bdh sh'ryt yhvdh
verses.translation: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray thee, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: wherefore should he slay thee, that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר גְּדַלְיָ֤הוּ בֶן אֲחִיקָם֙ אֶל יוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ אַֽל תעש תַּעֲשֵׂ֖ה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּֽי שֶׁ֛קֶר אַתָּ֥ה דֹבֵ֖ר אֶל יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל
verses.translit: vy'mr gdlyhv bn 'chyqm 'l yvchnn bn qrch 'l t'sh t'shh 't hdbr hzh khy shqr 'th dbr 'l yshm''l
verses.translation: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, Thou shalt not do this thing: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י בָּ֣א יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֣ה בֶן אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע מִ/זֶּ֣רַע הַ֠/מְּלוּכָה וְ/רַבֵּ֨י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ וַ/עֲשָׂרָ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אִתּ֛/וֹ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֥הוּ בֶן אֲחִיקָ֖ם הַ/מִּצְפָּ֑תָ/ה וַ/יֹּ֨אכְלוּ שָׁ֥ם לֶ֛חֶם יַחְדָּ֖ו בַּ/מִּצְפָּֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bchdsh hshby'y b' yshm''l bn ntnyh bn 'lyshm' mzr' hmlvkhh vrby hmlkh v'shrh 'nshym 'tv 'l gdlyhv bn 'chyqm hmtspth vy'khlv shm lchm ychdv bmtsph
verses.translation: Now it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקָם֩ יִשְׁמָעֵ֨אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֜ה וַ/עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים אֲשֶׁר הָי֣וּ אִתּ֗/וֹ וַ֠/יַּכּוּ אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ בֶן אֲחִיקָ֧ם בֶּן שָׁפָ֛ן בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב וַ/יָּ֣מֶת אֹת֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁר הִפְקִ֥יד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyqm yshm''l bn ntnyh v'shrt h'nshym 'shr hyv 'tv vykhv 't gdlyhv bn 'chyqm bn shpn bchrb vymt 'tv 'shr hpqyd mlkh bbl b'rts
verses.translation: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר הָי֨וּ אִתּ֤/וֹ אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ בַּ/מִּצְפָּ֔ה וְ/אֶת הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצְאוּ שָׁ֑ם אֵ֚ת אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה הִכָּ֖ה יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל
verses.translit: v't khl hyhvdym 'shr hyv 'tv 't gdlyhv bmtsph v't hkhshdym 'shr nmts'v shm 't 'nshy hmlchmh hkhh yshm''l
verses.translation: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖י לְ/הָמִ֣ית אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֑הוּ וְ/אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֥א יָדָֽע
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshny lhmyt 't gdlyhv v'ysh l' yd'
verses.translation: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it ,

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ אֲ֠נָשִׁים מִ/שְּׁכֶ֞ם מִ/שִּׁל֤וֹ וּ/מִ/שֹּֽׁמְרוֹן֙ שְׁמֹנִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ מְגֻלְּחֵ֥י זָקָ֛ן וּ/קְרֻעֵ֥י בְגָדִ֖ים וּ/מִתְגֹּֽדְדִ֑ים וּ/מִנְחָ֤ה וּ/לְבוֹנָה֙ בְּ/יָדָ֔/ם לְ/הָבִ֖יא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v 'nshym mshkhm mshlv vmshmrvn shmnym 'ysh mglchy zqn vqr'y bgdym vmtgddym vmnchh vlbvnh bydm lhby' byt yhvh
verses.translation: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring them to the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ֠/יֵּצֵא יִשְׁמָעֵ֨אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֤ה לִ/קְרָאתָ/ם֙ מִן הַ/מִּצְפָּ֔ה הֹלֵ֥ךְ הָלֹ֖ךְ וּ/בֹכֶ֑ה וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כִּ/פְגֹ֣שׁ אֹתָ֔/ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם בֹּ֖אוּ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֥הוּ בֶן אֲחִיקָֽם
verses.translit: vyts' yshm''l bn ntnyh lqr'tm mn hmtsph hlkh hlkh vbkhh vyhy khpgsh 'tm vy'mr 'lyhm b'v 'l gdlyhv bn 'chyqm
verses.translation: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כְּ/בוֹאָ֖/ם אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יִּשְׁחָטֵ֞/ם יִשְׁמָעֵ֤אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָה֙ אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/בּ֔וֹר ה֖וּא וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khbv'm 'l tvkh h'yr vyshchtm yshm''l bn ntnyh 'l tvkh hbvr hv' vh'nshym 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: And it was so , when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that were with him.

verses.original: וַ/עֲשָׂרָ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֜ים נִמְצְאוּ בָ֗/ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ אַל תְּמִתֵ֔/נוּ כִּֽי יֶשׁ לָ֤/נוּ מַטְמֹנִים֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה חִטִּ֥ים וּ/שְׂעֹרִ֖ים וְ/שֶׁ֣מֶן וּ/דְבָ֑שׁ וַ/יֶּחְדַּ֕ל וְ/לֹ֥א הֱמִיתָ֖/ם בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'shrh 'nshym nmts'v bm vy'mrv 'l yshm''l 'l tmtnv khy ysh lnv mtmnym bshdh chtym vsh'rym vshmn vdbsh vychdl vl' hmytm btvkh 'chyhm
verses.translation: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בּ֗וֹר אֲשֶׁר֩ הִשְׁלִ֨יךְ שָׁ֤ם יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל פִּגְרֵ֣י הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִכָּה֙ בְּ/יַד גְּדַלְיָ֔הוּ ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֔א מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בַּעְשָׁ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֹת֗/וֹ מִלֵּ֛א יִשְׁמָעֵ֥אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֖הוּ חֲלָלִֽים
verses.translit: vhbvr 'shr hshlykh shm yshm''l 't khl pgry h'nshym 'shr hkhh byd gdlyhv hv' 'shr 'shh hmlkh 's' mpny b'sh' mlkh yshr'l 'tv ml' yshm''l bn ntnyhv chllym
verses.translation: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣שְׁבְּ יִ֠שְׁמָעֵאל אֶת כָּל שְׁאֵרִ֨ית הָ/עָ֜ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/מִּצְפָּ֗ה אֶת בְּנ֤וֹת הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל הָ/עָם֙ הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בַּ/מִּצְפָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִפְקִ֗יד נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָן֙ רַב טַבָּחִ֔ים אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן אֲחִיקָ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׁבֵּ/ם֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֔ה וַ/יֵּ֕לֶךְ לַ/עֲבֹ֖ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyshb yshm''l 't khl sh'ryt h'm 'shr bmtsph 't bnvt hmlkh v't khl h'm hnsh'rym bmtsph 'shr hpqyd nbvzr'dn rb tbchym 't gdlyhv bn 'chyqm vyshbm yshm''l bn ntnyh vylkh l'br 'l bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַע֙ יוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ וְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/חֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑/וֹ אֵ֤ת כָּל הָֽ/רָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' yvchnn bn qrch vkhl shry hchylym 'shr 'tv 't khl hr'h 'shr 'shh yshm''l bn ntnyh
verses.translation: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת כָּל הָ֣/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַ/יֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְצְא֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ אֶל מַ֥יִם רַבִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/גִבְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyqchv 't khl h'nshym vylkhv lhlchm 'm yshm''l bn ntnyh vymts'v 'tv 'l mym rbym 'shr bgb'vn
verses.translation: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּ/רְא֤וֹת כָּל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל אֶת יֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/חֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׂמָֽחוּ
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt khl h'm 'shr 't yshm''l 't yvchnn bn qrch v't khl shry hchylym 'shr 'tv vyshmchv
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.

verses.original: וַ/יָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר שָׁבָ֥ה יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל מִן הַ/מִּצְפָּ֑ה וַ/יָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ וַ/יֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ אֶל יֽוֹחָנָ֖ן בֶּן קָרֵֽחַ
verses.translit: vysbv khl h'm 'shr shbh yshm''l mn hmtsph vyshbv vylkhv 'l yvchnn bn qrch
verses.translation: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֗ה נִמְלַט֙ בִּ/שְׁמֹנָ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִ/פְּנֵ֖י יֽוֹחָנָ֑ן וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ אֶל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyshm''l bn ntnyh nmlt bshmnh 'nshym mpny yvchnn vylkh 'l bny 'mvn
verses.translation: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ יוֹחָנָ֨ן בֶּן קָרֵ֜חַ וְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֧י הַ/חֲיָלִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֗/וֹ אֵ֣ת כָּל שְׁאֵרִ֤ית הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵ֠שִׁיב מֵ/אֵ֨ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֤אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָה֙ מִן הַ/מִּצְפָּ֔ה אַחַ֣ר הִכָּ֔ה אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֖ה בֶּן אֲחִיקָ֑ם גְּבָרִ֞ים אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְ/נָשִׁ֤ים וְ/טַף֙ וְ/סָ֣רִסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵשִׁ֖יב מִ/גִּבְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyqch yvchnn bn qrch vkhl shry hchylym 'shr 'tv 't khl sh'ryt h'm 'shr hshyb m't yshm''l bn ntnyh mn hmtsph 'chr hkhh 't gdlyh bn 'chyqm gbrym 'nshy hmlchmh vnshym vtf vsrsym 'shr hshyb mgb'vn
verses.translation: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֗וּ וַ/יֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּ/גֵר֣וּת כמו/הם כִּמְהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר אֵ֖צֶל בֵּ֣ית לָ֑חֶם לָ/לֶ֖כֶת לָ/ב֥וֹא מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vylkhv vyshbv bgrvt khmvhm khmhm 'shr 'tsl byt lchm llkht lbv' mtsrym
verses.translation: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Beth-lehem, to go to enter into Egypt,

verses.original: מִ/פְּנֵי֙ הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים כִּ֥י יָרְא֖וּ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי הִכָּ֞ה יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֗ה אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן אֲחִיקָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הִפְקִ֥יד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: mpny hkhshdym khy yr'v mpnyhm khy hkhh yshm''l bn ntnyh 't gdlyhv bn 'chyqm 'shr hpqyd mlkh bbl b'rts
verses.translation: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּגְּשׁוּ֙ כָּל שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/חֲיָלִ֔ים וְ/יֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ וִֽ/יזַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן הוֹשַֽׁעְיָ֑ה וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם מִ/קָּטֹ֥ן וְ/עַד גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vygshv khl shry hchylym vyvchnn bn qrch vyznyh bn hvsh'yh vkhl h'm mqtn v'd gdvl
