verses.translation: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֞וּ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֗יא תִּפָּל נָ֤א תְחִנָּתֵ֨/נוּ֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל בַּעֲדֵ֨/נוּ֙ אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּעַ֖ד כָּל הַ/שְּׁאֵרִ֣ית הַ/זֹּ֑את כִּֽי נִשְׁאַ֤רְנוּ מְעַט֙ מֵֽ/הַרְבֵּ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ רֹא֥וֹת אֹתָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l yrmyhv hnby' tpl n' tchntnv lpnykh vhtpll b'dnv 'l yhvh 'lhykh b'd khl hsh'ryt hz't khy nsh'rnv m't mhrbh kh'shr 'ynykh r'vt 'tnv
verses.translation: And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech thee, our supplication be accepted before thee, and pray for us unto the LORD thy God, even for all this remnant; (for we are left but a few of many, as thine eyes do behold us:)

verses.original: וְ/יַגֶּד לָ֨/נוּ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֶת הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֵֽלֶךְ בָּ֑/הּ וְ/אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vygd lnv yhvh 'lhykh 't hdrkh 'shr nlkh bh v't hdbr 'shr n'shh
verses.translation: That the LORD thy God may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַ/נָּבִיא֙ שָׁמַ֔עְתִּי הִנְ/נִ֧י מִתְפַּלֵּ֛ל אֶל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם כְּ/דִבְרֵי/כֶ֑ם וְֽ/הָיָ֡ה כָּֽל הַ/דָּבָר֩ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲנֶ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶתְ/כֶם֙ אַגִּ֣יד לָ/כֶ֔ם לֹֽא אֶמְנַ֥ע מִ/כֶּ֖ם דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm yrmyhv hnby' shm'ty hnny mtpll 'l yhvh 'lhykhm khdbrykhm vhyh khl hdbr 'shr y'nh yhvh 'tkhm 'gyd lkhm l' 'mn' mkhm dbr
verses.translation: Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray unto the LORD your God according to your words; and it shall come to pass, that whatsoever thing the LORD shall answer you, I will declare it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ אָמְר֣וּ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ יְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔/נוּ לְ/עֵ֖ד אֱמֶ֣ת וְ/נֶאֱמָ֑ן אִם לֹ֡א כְּֽ/כָל הַ֠/דָּבָר אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽשְׁלָחֲ/ךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ אֵלֵ֖י/נוּ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vhmh 'mrv 'l yrmyhv yhy yhvh bnv l'd 'mt vn'mn 'm l' khkhl hdbr 'shr yshlchkh yhvh 'lhykh 'lynv khn n'shh
verses.translation: Then they said to Jeremiah, The LORD be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the LORD thy God shall send thee to us.

verses.original: אִם ט֣וֹב וְ/אִם רָ֔ע בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אנו אֲנַ֜חְנוּ שֹׁלְחִ֥ים אֹתְ/ךָ֛ אֵלָ֖י/ו נִשְׁמָ֑ע לְמַ֨עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽיטַב לָ֔/נוּ כִּ֣י נִשְׁמַ֔ע בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: 'm tvb v'm r' bqvl yhvh 'lhynv 'shr 'nv 'nchnv shlchym 'tkh 'lyv nshm' lm'n 'shr yytb lnv khy nshm' bqvl yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send thee; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י מִ/קֵּ֖ץ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת יָמִ֑ים וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyhy mqts 'shrt ymym vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv
verses.translation: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֗א אֶל יֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ וְ/אֶ֛ל כָּל שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/חֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑/וֹ וּ/לְ/כָ֨ל הָ/עָ֔ם לְ/מִ/קָּטֹ֥ן וְ/עַד גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vyqr' 'l yvchnn bn qrch v'l khl shry hchylym 'shr 'tv vlkhl h'm lmqtn v'd gdvl
verses.translation: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר שְׁלַחְתֶּ֤ם אֹתִ/י֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו לְ/הַפִּ֥יל תְּחִנַּתְ/כֶ֖ם לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr shlchtm 'ty 'lyv lhpyl tchntkhm lpnyv
verses.translation: And said unto them, Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel, unto whom ye sent me to present your supplication before him;

verses.original: אִם שׁ֤וֹב תֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את וּ/בָנִ֤יתִי אֶתְ/כֶם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א אֶהֱרֹ֔ס וְ/נָטַעְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֣א אֶתּ֑וֹשׁ כִּ֤י נִחַ֨מְתִּי֙ אֶל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'm shvb tshbv b'rts hz't vbnyty 'tkhm vl' 'hrs vnt'ty 'tkhm vl' 'tvsh khy nchmty 'l hr'h 'shr 'shyty lkhm
verses.translation: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.

verses.original: אַל תִּֽירְא֗וּ מִ/פְּנֵי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֥ם יְרֵאִ֖ים מִ/פָּנָ֑י/ו אַל תִּֽירְא֤וּ מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי אִתְּ/כֶ֣ם אָ֔נִי לְ/הוֹשִׁ֧יעַ אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם וּ/לְ/הַצִּ֥יל אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/יָּדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l tyr'v mpny mlkh bbl 'shr 'tm yr'ym mpnyv 'l tyr'v mmnv n'm yhvh khy 'tkhm 'ny lhvshy' 'tkhm vlhtsyl 'tkhm mydv
verses.translation: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom ye are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the LORD : for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

verses.original: וְ/אֶתֵּ֥ן לָ/כֶ֛ם רַחֲמִ֖ים וְ/רִחַ֣ם אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הֵשִׁ֥יב אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֶל אַדְמַתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tn lkhm rchmym vrchm 'tkhm vhshyb 'tkhm 'l 'dmtkhm
verses.translation: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.

verses.original: וְ/אִם אֹמְרִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לֹ֥א נֵשֵׁ֖ב בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את לְ/בִלְתִּ֣י שְׁמֹ֔עַ בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'm 'mrym 'tm l' nshb b'rts hz't lblty shm' bqvl yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the LORD your God,

verses.original: לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לֹ֚א כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ נָב֔וֹא אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא נִרְאֶה֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָ֖ר לֹ֣א נִשְׁמָ֑ע וְ/לַ/לֶּ֥חֶם לֹֽא נִרְעָ֖ב וְ/שָׁ֥ם נֵשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: l'mr l' khy 'rts mtsrym nbv' 'shr l' nr'h mlchmh vqvl shvpr l' nshm' vllchm l' nr'b vshm nshb
verses.translation: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה לָ/כֵ֛ן שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם אַ֠תֶּם שׂ֣וֹם תְּשִׂמ֤וּ/ן פְּנֵי/כֶם֙ לָ/בֹ֣א מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/בָאתֶ֖ם לָ/ג֥וּר שָֽׁם
verses.translit: v'th lkhn shm'v dbr yhvh sh'ryt yhvdh khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'm 'tm shvm tshmvn pnykhm lb' mtsrym vb'tm lgvr shm
verses.translation: And now therefore hear the word of the LORD , ye remnant of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; If ye wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה הַ/חֶ֗רֶב אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יְרֵאִ֣ים מִמֶּ֔/נָּה שָׁ֛ם תַּשִּׂ֥יג אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הָ/רָעָ֞ב אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֣ם דֹּאֲגִ֣ים מִמֶּ֗/נּוּ שָׁ֣ם יִדְבַּ֧ק אַחֲרֵי/כֶ֛ם מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/שָׁ֥ם תָּמֻֽתוּ
verses.translit: vhyth hchrb 'shr 'tm yr'ym mmnh shm tshyg 'tkhm b'rts mtsrym vhr'b 'shr 'tm d'gym mmnv shm ydbq 'chrykhm mtsrym vshm tmtv
verses.translation: Then it shall come to pass, that the sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof ye were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there ye shall die.

verses.original: וְ/יִֽהְי֣וּ כָל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֨מוּ אֶת פְּנֵי/הֶ֜ם לָ/ב֤וֹא מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לָ/ג֣וּר שָׁ֔ם יָמ֕וּתוּ בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב בָּ/רָעָ֣ב וּ/בַ/דָּ֑בֶר וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ שָׂרִ֣יד וּ/פָלִ֔יט מִ/פְּנֵי֙ הָֽ/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י מֵבִ֥יא עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhyv khl h'nshym 'shr shmv 't pnyhm lbv' mtsrym lgvr shm ymvtv bchrb br'b vbdbr vl' yhyh lhm shryd vplyt mpny hr'h 'shr 'ny mby' 'lyhm
verses.translation: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ נִתַּ֨ךְ אַפִּ֜/י וַ/חֲמָתִ֗/י עַל יֹֽשְׁבֵי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כֵּ֣ן תִּתַּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִ/י֙ עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/בֹאֲ/כֶ֖ם מִצְרָ֑יִם וִ/הְיִיתֶ֞ם לְ/אָלָ֤ה וּ/לְ/שַׁמָּה֙ וְ/לִ/קְלָלָ֣ה וּ/לְ/חֶרְפָּ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא תִרְא֣וּ ע֔וֹד אֶת הַ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l kh'shr ntkh 'py vchmty 'l yshby yrvshlm khn ttkh chmty 'lykhm bb'khm mtsrym vhyytm l'lh vlshmh vlqllh vlchrph vl' tr'v 'vd 't hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As mine anger and my fury hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt: and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.

verses.original: דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה אַל תָּבֹ֖אוּ מִצְרָ֑יִם יָדֹ֨עַ֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּי הַעִידֹ֥תִי בָ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: dbr yhvh 'lykhm sh'ryt yhvdh 'l tb'v mtsrym yd' td'v khy h'ydty bkhm hyvm
verses.translation: The LORD hath said concerning you, O ye remnant of Judah; Go ye not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.

verses.original: כִּ֣י התעתי/ם הִתְעֵיתֶם֮ בְּ/נַפְשֽׁוֹתֵי/כֶם֒ כִּֽי אַתֶּ֞ם שְׁלַחְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִ֗/י אֶל יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲדֵ֔/נוּ אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וּ/כְ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֹאמַ֜ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛י/נוּ כֵּ֥ן הַגֶּד לָ֖/נוּ וְ/עָשִֽׂינוּ
verses.translit: khy ht'tym ht'ytm bnpshvtykhm khy 'tm shlchtm 'ty 'l yhvh 'lhykhm l'mr htpll b'dnv 'l yhvh 'lhynv vkhkhl 'shr y'mr yhvh 'lhynv khn hgd lnv v'shynv
verses.translation: For ye dissembled in your hearts, when ye sent me unto the LORD your God, saying, Pray for us unto the LORD our God; and according unto all that the LORD our God shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do it .

verses.original: וָ/אַגִּ֥ד לָ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּ֑וֹם וְ/לֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֗ם בְּ/קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחַ֥/נִי אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'gd lkhm hyvm vl' shm'tm bqvl yhvh 'lhykhm vlkhl 'shr shlchny 'lykhm
verses.translation: And now I have this day declared it to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor any thing for the which he hath sent me unto you.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּ֗י בַּ/חֶ֛רֶב בָּ/רָעָ֥ב וּ/בַ/דֶּ֖בֶר תָּמ֑וּתוּ בַּ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲפַצְתֶּ֔ם לָ/ב֖וֹא לָ/ג֥וּר שָֽׁם
verses.translit: v'th yd' td'v khy bchrb br'b vbdbr tmvtv bmqvm 'shr chptstm lbv' lgvr shm
verses.translation: Now therefore know certainly that ye shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither ye desire to go and to sojourn.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כְּ/כַלּ֨וֹת יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֗ם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר שְׁלָח֛/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyhy khkhlvt yrmyhv ldbr 'l khl h'm 't khl dbry yhvh 'lhyhm 'shr shlchv yhvh 'lhyhm 'lyhm 't khl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר עֲזַרְיָ֤ה בֶן הוֹשַֽׁעְיָה֙ וְ/יוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ וְ/כָל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַ/זֵּדִ֑ים אֹמְרִ֣ים אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ שֶׁ֚קֶר אַתָּ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֔ר לֹ֣א שְׁלָחֲ/ךָ֞ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹֽא תָבֹ֥אוּ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָ/ג֥וּר שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'zryh bn hvsh'yh vyvchnn bn qrch vkhl h'nshym hzdym 'mrym 'l yrmyhv shqr 'th mdbr l' shlchkh yhvh 'lhynv l'mr l' tb'v mtsrym lgvr shm
verses.translation: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the LORD our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:

verses.original: כִּ֗י בָּרוּךְ֙ בֶּן נֵ֣רִיָּ֔ה מַסִּ֥ית אֹתְ/ךָ֖ בָּ֑/נוּ לְמַעַן֩ תֵּ֨ת אֹתָ֤/נוּ בְ/יַֽד הַ/כַּשְׂדִּים֙ לְ/הָמִ֣ית אֹתָ֔/נוּ וּ/לְ/הַגְל֥וֹת אֹתָ֖/נוּ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: khy brvkh bn nryh msyt 'tkh bnv lm'n tt 'tnv byd hkhshdym lhmyt 'tnv vlhglvt 'tnv bbl
verses.translation: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא שָׁמַע֩ יוֹחָנָ֨ן בֶּן קָרֵ֜חַ וְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֧י הַ/חֲיָלִ֛ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה לָ/שֶׁ֖בֶת בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vl' shm' yvchnn bn qrch vkhl shry hchylym vkhl h'm bqvl yhvh lshbt b'rts yhvdh
verses.translation: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the LORD , to dwell in the land of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח יוֹחָנָ֤ן בֶּן קָרֵ֨חַ֙ וְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/חֲיָלִ֔ים אֵ֖ת כָּל שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֗בוּ מִ/כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִדְּחוּ שָׁ֔ם לָ/ג֖וּר בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch yvchnn bn qrch vkhl shry hchylym 't khl sh'ryt yhvdh 'shr shbv mkhl hgvym 'shr ndchv shm lgvr b'rts yhvdh
verses.translation: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;

verses.original: אֶֽת הַ֠/גְּבָרִים וְ/אֶת הַ/נָּשִׁ֣ים וְ/אֶת הַ/טַּף֮ וְ/אֶת בְּנ֣וֹת הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֒ וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/נֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִנִּ֨יחַ֙ נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֣ן רַב טַבָּחִ֔ים אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁפָ֑ן וְ/אֵת֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא וְ/אֶת בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּן נֵרִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: 't hgbrym v't hnshym v't htf v't bnvt hmlkh v't khl hnpsh 'shr hnych nbvzr'dn rb tbchym 't gdlyhv bn 'chyqm bn shpn v't yrmyhv hnby' v't brvkh bn nryhv
verses.translation: Even men, and women, and children, and the king’s daughters, and every person that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד תַּחְפַּנְחֵֽס
verses.translit: vyb'v 'rts mtsrym khy l' shm'v bqvl yhvh vyb'v 'd tchpnchs
verses.translation: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the LORD : thus came they even to Tahpanhes.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בְּ/תַחְפַּנְחֵ֖ס לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv btchpnchs l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

verses.original: קַ֣ח בְּ/יָדְ/ךָ֞ אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֗וֹת וּ/טְמַנְתָּ֤/ם בַּ/מֶּ֨לֶט֙ בַּ/מַּלְבֵּ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּ/פֶ֥תַח בֵּית פַּרְעֹ֖ה בְּ/תַחְפַּנְחֵ֑ס לְ/עֵינֵ֖י אֲנָשִׁ֥ים יְהוּדִֽים
verses.translit: qch bydkh 'bnym gdlvt vtmntm bmlt bmlbn 'shr bptch byt pr'h btchpnchs l'yny 'nshym yhvdym
verses.translation: Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֡ם כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְ/נִ֤י שֹׁלֵ֨חַ֙ וְ֠/לָקַחְתִּי אֶת נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֤ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ עַבְדִּ֔/י וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֣י כִסְא֔/וֹ מִ/מַּ֛עַל לָ/אֲבָנִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֣ר טָמָ֑נְתִּי וְ/נָטָ֥ה אֶת שפרור/ו שַׁפְרִיר֖/וֹ עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny shlch vlqchty 't nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl 'bdy vshmty khs'v mm'l l'bnym h'lh 'shr tmnty vnth 't shprvrv shpryrv 'lyhm
verses.translation: And say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

verses.original: ו/בא/ה וּ/בָ֕א וְ/הִכָּ֖ה אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֧ר לַ/מָּ֣וֶת לַ/מָּ֗וֶת וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר לַ/שְּׁבִי֙ לַ/שֶּׁ֔בִי וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַ/חֶ֖רֶב לֶ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vb'h vb' vhkhh 't 'rts mtsrym 'shr lmvt lmvt v'shr lshby lshby v'shr lchrb lchrb
verses.translation: And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.

verses.original: וְ/הִצַּ֣תִּי אֵ֗שׁ בְּ/בָתֵּי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/שְׂרָפָ֖/ם וְ/שָׁבָ֑/ם וְ/עָטָה֩ אֶת אֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם כַּ/אֲשֶׁר יַעְטֶ֤ה הָֽ/רֹעֶה֙ אֶת בִּגְד֔/וֹ וְ/יָצָ֥א מִ/שָּׁ֖ם בְּ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vhtsty 'sh bbty 'lhy mtsrym vshrpm vshbm v'th 't 'rts mtsrym kh'shr y'th hr'h 't bgdv vyts' mshm bshlvm
verses.translation: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁבַּ֗ר אֶֽת מַצְּבוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/אֶת בָּתֵּ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽי מִצְרַ֖יִם יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vshbr 't mtsbvt byt shmsh 'shr b'rts mtsrym v't bty 'lhy mtsrym yshrf b'sh
verses.translation: He shall break also the images of Beth-shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶ֚ל כָּל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֤ים בְּ/מִגְדֹּל֙ וּ/בְ/תַחְפַּנְחֵ֣ס וּ/בְ/נֹ֔ף וּ/בְ/אֶ֥רֶץ פַּתְר֖וֹס לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv 'l khl hyhvdym hyshbym b'rts mtsrym hyshbym bmgdl vbtchpnchs vbnf vb'rts ptrvs l'mr
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֗ם אֵ֤ת כָּל הָֽ/רָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֨אתִי֙ עַל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/הִנָּ֤/ם חָרְבָּה֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אֵ֥ין בָּ/הֶ֖ם יוֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'tm r'ytm 't khl hr'h 'shr hb'ty 'l yrvshlm v'l khl 'ry yhvdh vhnm chrbh hyvm hzh v'yn bhm yvshb
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and, behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwelleth therein,

verses.original: מִ/פְּנֵ֣י רָעָתָ֗/ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְ/הַכְעִסֵ֔/נִי לָ/לֶ֣כֶת לְ/קַטֵּ֔ר לַ/עֲבֹ֖ד לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יְדָע֔וּ/ם הֵ֖מָּה אַתֶּ֥ם וַ/אֲבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: mpny r'tm 'shr 'shv lhkh'sny llkht lqtr l'bd l'lhym 'chrym 'shr l' yd'vm hmh 'tm v'btykhm
verses.translation: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, and to serve other gods, whom they knew not, neither they, ye, nor your fathers.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵי/כֶם֙ אֶת כָּל עֲבָדַ֣/י הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים הַשְׁכֵּ֥ים וְ/שָׁלֹ֖חַ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אַל נָ֣א תַעֲשׂ֗וּ אֵ֛ת דְּבַֽר הַ/תֹּעֵבָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵֽאתִי
verses.translit: v'shlch 'lykhm 't khl 'bdy hnby'ym hshkhym vshlch l'mr 'l n' t'shv 't dbr ht'bh hz't 'shr shn'ty
verses.translation: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them , saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְ/לֹא הִטּ֣וּ אֶת אָזְנָ֔/ם לָ/שׁ֖וּב מֵ/רָֽעָתָ֑/ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י קַטֵּ֖ר לֵ/אלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: vl' shm'v vl' htv 't 'znm lshvb mr'tm lblty qtr l'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתַּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִ/י֙ וְ/אַפִּ֔/י וַ/תִּבְעַר֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/בְ/חֻצ֖וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/תִּהְיֶ֛ינָה לְ/חָרְבָּ֥ה לִ/שְׁמָמָ֖ה כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vttkh chmty v'py vtb'r b'ry yhvdh vbchtsvt yrvshlm vthyynh lchrbh lshmmh khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as at this day.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָ/מָה֩ אַתֶּ֨ם עֹשִׂ֜ים רָעָ֤ה גְדוֹלָה֙ אֶל נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵ/כֶ֔ם לְ/הַכְרִ֨ית לָ/כֶ֧ם אִישׁ וְ/אִשָּׁ֛ה עוֹלֵ֥ל וְ/יוֹנֵ֖ק מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י הוֹתִ֥יר לָ/כֶ֖ם שְׁאֵרִֽית
verses.translit: v'th khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l lmh 'tm 'shym r'h gdvlh 'l npshtkhm lhkhryt lkhm 'ysh v'shh 'vll vyvnq mtvkh yhvdh lblty hvtyr lkhm sh'ryt
verses.translation: Therefore now thus saith the LORD , the God of hosts, the God of Israel; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;

verses.original: לְ/הַכְעִסֵ֨/נִי֙ בְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְדֵי/כֶ֔ם לְ/קַטֵּ֞ר לֵ/אלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֥ם בָּאִ֖ים לָ/ג֣וּר שָׁ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן֙ הַכְרִ֣ית לָ/כֶ֔ם וּ/לְמַ֤עַן הֱיֽוֹתְ/כֶם֙ לִ/קְלָלָ֣ה וּ/לְ/חֶרְפָּ֔ה בְּ/כֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lhkh'sny bm'shy ydykhm lqtr l'lhym 'chrym b'rts mtsrym 'shr 'tm b'ym lgvr shm lm'n hkhryt lkhm vlm'n hyvtkhm lqllh vlchrph bkhl gvyy h'rts
verses.translation: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye be gone to dwell, that ye might cut yourselves off, and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

verses.original: הַֽ/שְׁכַחְתֶּם֩ אֶת רָע֨וֹת אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֜ם וְ/אֶת רָע֣וֹת מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/אֵת֙ רָע֣וֹת נָשָׁ֔י/ו וְ/אֵת֙ רָעֹ֣תֵ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת רָעֹ֣ת נְשֵׁי/כֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/בְ/חֻצ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: hshkhchtm 't r'vt 'bvtykhm v't r'vt mlkhy yhvdh v't r'vt nshyv v't r'tkhm v't r't nshykhm 'shr 'shv b'rts yhvdh vbchtsvt yrvshlm
verses.translation: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.original: לֹ֣א דֻכְּא֔וּ עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/לֹ֣א יָרְא֗וּ וְ/לֹֽא הָלְכ֤וּ בְ/תֽוֹרָתִ/י֙ וּ/בְ/חֻקֹּתַ֔/י אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תִּי לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' dkh'v 'd hyvm hzh vl' yr'v vl' hlkhv btvrty vbchqty 'shr ntty lpnykhm vlpny 'bvtykhm
verses.translation: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִ֨י שָׂ֥ם פָּנַ֛/י בָּ/כֶ֖ם לְ/רָעָ֑ה וּ/לְ/הַכְרִ֖ית אֶת כָּל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny shm pny bkhm lr'h vlhkhryt 't khl yhvdh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֞י אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֨מוּ פְנֵי/הֶ֜ם לָ/ב֣וֹא אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַיִם֮ לָ/ג֣וּר שָׁם֒ וְ/תַ֨מּוּ כֹ֜ל בְּ/אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם יִפֹּ֗לוּ בַּ/חֶ֤רֶב בָּֽ/רָעָב֙ יִתַּ֔מּוּ מִ/קָּטֹן֙ וְ/עַד גָּד֔וֹל בַּ/חֶ֥רֶב וּ/בָ/רָעָ֖ב יָמֻ֑תוּ וְ/הָיוּ֙ לְ/אָלָ֣ה לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה וְ/לִ/קְלָלָ֖ה וּ/לְ/חֶרְפָּֽה
verses.translit: vlqchty 't sh'ryt yhvdh 'shr shmv pnyhm lbv' 'rts mtsrym lgvr shm vtmv khl b'rts mtsrym yplv bchrb br'b ytmv mqtn v'd gdvl bchrb vbr'b ymtv vhyv l'lh lshmh vlqllh vlchrph
verses.translation: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

verses.original: וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֗י עַ֤ל הַ/יּֽוֹשְׁבִים֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקַ֖דְתִּי עַל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בַּ/חֶ֥רֶב בָּ/רָעָ֖ב וּ/בַ/דָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: vpqdty 'l hyvshbym b'rts mtsrym kh'shr pqdty 'l yrvshlm bchrb br'b vbdbr
verses.translation: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֨א יִהְיֶ֜ה פָּלִ֤יט וְ/שָׂרִיד֙ לִ/שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה הַ/בָּאִ֥ים לָ/גֽוּר שָׁ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/לָ/שׁ֣וּב אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר הֵ֜מָּה מְנַשְּׂאִ֤ים אֶת נַפְשָׁ/ם֙ לָ/שׁוּב֙ לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת שָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י לֹֽא יָשׁ֖וּבוּ כִּ֥י אִם פְּלֵטִֽים
verses.translit: vl' yhyh plyt vshryd lsh'ryt yhvdh hb'ym lgvr shm b'rts mtsrym vlshvb 'rts yhvdh 'shr hmh mnsh'ym 't npshm lshvb lshbt shm khy l' yshvbv khy 'm pltym
verses.translation: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲנ֣וּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ כָּל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הַ/יֹּֽדְעִים֙ כִּֽי מְקַטְּר֤וֹת נְשֵׁי/הֶם֙ לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְ/כָל הַ/נָּשִׁ֥ים הָ/עֹמְד֖וֹת קָהָ֣ל גָּד֑וֹל וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֛ם הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּ/פַתְר֥וֹס לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'nv 't yrmyhv khl h'nshym hyd'ym khy mqtrvt nshyhm l'lhym 'chrym vkhl hnshym h'mdvt qhl gdvl vkhl h'm hyshbym b'rts mtsrym bptrvs l'mr
verses.translation: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֥רְתָּ אֵלֵ֖י/נוּ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ שֹׁמְעִ֖ים אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr dbrt 'lynv bshm yhvh 'ynnv shm'ym 'lykh
verses.translation: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD , we will not hearken unto thee.

verses.original: כִּ֩י עָשֹׂ֨ה נַעֲשֶׂ֜ה אֶֽת כָּל הַ/דָּבָ֣ר אֲשֶׁר יָצָ֣א מִ/פִּ֗י/נוּ לְ/קַטֵּ֞ר לִ/מְלֶ֣כֶת הַ/שָּׁמַיִם֮ וְ/הַסֵּֽיךְ לָ֣/הּ נְסָכִים֒ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֜ינוּ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ וַ/אֲבֹתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ מְלָכֵ֣י/נוּ וְ/שָׂרֵ֔י/נוּ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/בְ/חֻצ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/נִּֽשְׂבַּֽע לֶ֨חֶם֙ וַ/נִּֽהְיֶ֣ה טוֹבִ֔ים וְ/רָעָ֖ה לֹ֥א רָאִֽינוּ
verses.translit: khy 'shh n'shh 't khl hdbr 'shr yts' mpynv lqtr lmlkht hshmym vhsykh lh nskhym kh'shr 'shynv 'nchnv v'btynv mlkhynv vshrynv b'ry yhvdh vbchtsvt yrvshlm vnshb' lchm vnhyh tvbym vr'h l' r'ynv
verses.translation: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.

verses.original: וּ/מִן אָ֡ז חָדַ֜לְנוּ לְ/קַטֵּ֨ר לִ/מְלֶ֧כֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֛יִם וְ/הַסֵּֽךְ לָ֥/הּ נְסָכִ֖ים חָסַ֣רְנוּ כֹ֑ל וּ/בַ/חֶ֥רֶב וּ/בָ/רָעָ֖ב תָּֽמְנוּ
verses.translit: vmn 'z chdlnv lqtr lmlkht hshmym vhskh lh nskhym chsrnv khl vbchrb vbr'b tmnv
verses.translation: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things , and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי אֲנַ֤חְנוּ מְקַטְּרִים֙ לִ/מְלֶ֣כֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וּ/לְ/הַסֵּ֥ךְ לָ֖/הּ נְסָכִ֑ים הֲ/מִֽ/בַּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֲנָשֵׁ֗י/נוּ עָשִׂ֨ינוּ לָ֤/הּ כַּוָּנִים֙ לְ/הַ֣עֲצִבָ֔/ה וְ/הַסֵּ֥ךְ לָ֖/הּ נְסָכִֽים
verses.translit: vkhy 'nchnv mqtrym lmlkht hshmym vlhskh lh nskhym hmbl'dy 'nshynv 'shynv lh khvnym lh'tsbh vhskh lh nskhym
verses.translation: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֑ם עַל הַ/גְּבָרִ֤ים וְ/עַל הַ/נָּשִׁים֙ וְ/עַל כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם הָ/עֹנִ֥ים אֹת֛/וֹ דָּבָ֖ר לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'l khl h'm 'l hgbrym v'l hnshym v'l khl h'm h'nym 'tv dbr l'mr
verses.translation: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא אֶת הַ/קִּטֵּ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר קִטַּרְתֶּ֜ם בְּ/עָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/בְ/חֻצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אַתֶּ֧ם וַ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֛ם מַלְכֵי/כֶ֥ם וְ/שָׂרֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֹתָ/ם֙ זָכַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַֽ/תַּעֲלֶ֖ה עַל לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hlv' 't hqtr 'shr qtrtm b'ry yhvdh vbchtsvt yrvshlm 'tm v'bvtykhm mlkhykhm vshrykhm v'm h'rts 'tm zkhr yhvh vt'lh 'l lbv
verses.translation: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the LORD remember them, and came it not into his mind?

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יוּכַל֩ יְהוָ֨ה ע֜וֹד לָ/שֵׂ֗את מִ/פְּנֵי֙ רֹ֣עַ מַעַלְלֵי/כֶ֔ם מִ/פְּנֵ֥י הַ/תּוֹעֵבֹ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וַ/תְּהִ֣י אַ֠רְצְ/כֶם לְ/חָרְבָּ֨ה וּ/לְ/שַׁמָּ֧ה וְ/לִ/קְלָלָ֛ה מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּ/הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vl' yvkhl yhvh 'vd lsh't mpny r' m'llykhm mpny htv'bt 'shr 'shytm vthy 'rtskhm lchrbh vlshmh vlqllh m'yn yvshb khhyvm hzh
verses.translation: So that the LORD could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.

verses.original: מִ/פְּנֵי֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר קִטַּרְתֶּ֜ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר חֲטָאתֶ֣ם לַ/יהוָ֗ה וְ/לֹ֤א שְׁמַעְתֶּם֙ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וּ/בְ/תֹרָת֧/וֹ וּ/בְ/חֻקֹּתָ֛י/ו וּ/בְ/עֵדְוֺתָ֖י/ו לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֑ם עַל כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֥את אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם הָ/רָעָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: mpny 'shr qtrtm v'shr cht'tm lyhvh vl' shm'tm bqvl yhvh vbtrtv vbchqtyv vb'dvtyv l' hlkhtm 'l khn qr't 'tkhm hr'h hz't khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the LORD , and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD , nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/אֶ֖ל כָּל הַ/נָּשִׁ֑ים שִׁמְעוּ֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה כָּל יְהוּדָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'l khl h'm v'l khl hnshym shm'v dbr yhvh khl yhvdh 'shr b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the LORD , all Judah that are in the land of Egypt:

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָֽה צְבָאוֹת֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אַתֶּ֨ם וּ/נְשֵׁי/כֶ֜ם וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה בְּ/פִי/כֶם֮ וּ/בִ/ידֵי/כֶ֣ם מִלֵּאתֶ֣ם לֵ/אמֹר֒ עָשֹׂ֨ה נַעֲשֶׂ֜ה אֶת נְדָרֵ֗י/נוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָדַ֨רְנוּ֙ לְ/קַטֵּר֙ לִ/מְלֶ֣כֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וּ/לְ/הַסֵּ֥ךְ לָ֖/הּ נְסָכִ֑ים הָקֵ֤ים תָּקִ֨ימְנָה֙ אֶת נִדְרֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/עָשֹׂ֥ה תַעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה אֶת נִדְרֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l l'mr 'tm vnshykhm vtdbrnh bpykhm vbydykhm ml'tm l'mr 'shh n'shh 't ndrynv 'shr ndrnv lqtr lmlkht hshmym vlhskh lh nskhym hqym tqymnh 't ndrykhm v'shh t'shynh 't ndrykhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֔ה כָּל יְהוּדָ֕ה הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הִנְ/נִ֨י נִשְׁבַּ֜עְתִּי בִּ/שְׁמִ֤/י הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם יִהְיֶה֩ ע֨וֹד שְׁמִ֜/י נִקְרָ֣א בְּ/פִ֣י כָּל אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֹמֵ֛ר חַי אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: lkhn shm'v dbr yhvh khl yhvdh hyshbym b'rts mtsrym hnny nshb'ty bshmy hgdvl 'mr yhvh 'm yhyh 'vd shmy nqr' bpy khl 'ysh yhvdh 'mr chy 'dny yhvh bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Therefore hear ye the word of the LORD , all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the LORD , that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord GOD liveth.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י שֹׁקֵ֧ד עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם לְ/רָעָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א לְ/טוֹבָ֑ה וְ/תַמּוּ֩ כָל אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם בַּ/חֶ֥רֶב וּ/בָ/רָעָ֖ב עַד כְּלוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hnny shqd 'lyhm lr'h vl' ltvbh vtmv khl 'ysh yhvdh 'shr b'rts mtsrym bchrb vbr'b 'd khlvtm
verses.translation: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.

verses.original: וּ/פְלִיטֵ֨י חֶ֜רֶב יְשֻׁב֨וּ/ן מִן אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָ֖ה מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר וְֽ/יָדְע֞וּ כָּל שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה הַ/בָּאִ֤ים לְ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לָ/ג֣וּר שָׁ֔ם דְּבַר מִ֥י יָק֖וּם מִמֶּ֥/נִּי וּ/מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vplyty chrb yshbvn mn 'rts mtsrym 'rts yhvdh mty mspr vyd'v khl sh'ryt yhvdh hb'ym l'rts mtsrym lgvr shm dbr my yqvm mmny vmhm
verses.translation: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.

verses.original: וְ/זֹאת לָ/כֶ֤ם הָ/אוֹת֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי פֹקֵ֥ד אֲנִ֛י עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם בַּ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּי֩ ק֨וֹם יָק֧וּמוּ דְבָרַ֛/י עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם לְ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vz't lkhm h'vt n'm yhvh khy pqd 'ny 'lykhm bmqvm hzh lm'n td'v khy qvm yqvmv dbry 'lykhm lr'h
verses.translation: And this shall be a sign unto you, saith the LORD , that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְ/נִ֣י נֹ֠תֵן אֶת פַּרְעֹ֨ה חָפְרַ֤ע מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד אֹֽיְבָ֔י/ו וּ/בְ/יַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֜תִּי אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה בְּ/יַ֨ד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל אֹיְב֖/וֹ וּ/מְבַקֵּ֥שׁ נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn 't pr'h chpr' mlkh mtsrym byd 'ybyv vbyd mbqshy npshv kh'shr ntty 't tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh byd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl 'ybv vmbqsh npshv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אֶל בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּֽן נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה בְּ/כָתְב/וֹ֩ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֨ים הָ/אֵ֤לֶּה עַל סֵ֨פֶר֙ מִ/פִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּ/שָּׁנָה֙ הָֽ/רְבִעִ֔ית לִ/יהוֹיָקִ֧ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֛הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr dbr yrmyhv hnby' 'l brvkh bn nryh bkhtbv 't hdbrym h'lh 'l spr mpy yrmyhv bshnh hrb'yt lyhvyqym bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh l'mr
verses.translation: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָלֶ֖י/ךָ בָּרֽוּךְ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'lykh brvkh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch;

verses.original: אָמַ֨רְתָּ֙ אֽוֹי נָ֣א לִ֔/י כִּֽי יָסַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה יָג֖וֹן עַל מַכְאֹבִ֑/י יָגַ֨עְתִּי֙ בְּ/אַנְחָתִ֔/י וּ/מְנוּחָ֖ה לֹ֥א מָצָֽאתִי
verses.translit: 'mrt 'vy n' ly khy ysf yhvh ygvn 'l mkh'by yg'ty b'nchty vmnvchh l' mts'ty
verses.translation: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה תֹּאמַ֣ר אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֤ה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִ֨יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י הֹרֵ֔ס וְ/אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר נָטַ֖עְתִּי אֲנִ֣י נֹתֵ֑שׁ וְ/אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ הִֽיא
verses.translit: khh t'mr 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh hnh 'shr bnyty 'ny hrs v't 'shr nt'ty 'ny ntsh v't khl h'rts hy'
verses.translation: Thus shalt thou say unto him, The LORD saith thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֛ה תְּבַקֶּשׁ לְ/ךָ֥ גְדֹל֖וֹת אַל תְּבַקֵּ֑שׁ כִּ֡י הִנְ/נִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא רָעָ֤ה עַל כָּל בָּשָׂר֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י לְ/ךָ֤ אֶֽת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֙ לְ/שָׁלָ֔ל עַ֥ל כָּל הַ/מְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּֽלֶךְ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: v'th tbqsh lkh gdlvt 'l tbqsh khy hnny mby' r'h 'l khl bshr n'm yhvh vntty lkh 't npshkh lshll 'l khl hmqmvt 'shr tlkh shm
verses.translation: And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the LORD : but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֧ה דְבַר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא עַל הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: 'shr hyh dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv hnby' 'l hgvym
verses.translation: The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;

verses.original: לְ/מִצְרַ֗יִם עַל חֵ֨יל פַּרְעֹ֤ה נְכוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה עַל נְהַר פְּרָ֖ת בְּ/כַרְכְּמִ֑שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכָּ֗ה נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ הָֽ/רְבִיעִ֔ית לִ/יהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: lmtsrym 'l chyl pr'h nkhv mlkh mtsrym 'shr hyh 'l nhr prt bkhrkhmsh 'shr hkhh nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl bshnt hrby'yt lyhvyqym bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.

verses.original: עִרְכ֤וּ מָגֵן֙ וְ/צִנָּ֔ה וּ/גְשׁ֖וּ לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: 'rkhv mgn vtsnh vgshv lmlchmh
verses.translation: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.

verses.original: אִסְר֣וּ הַ/סּוּסִ֗ים וַֽ/עֲלוּ֙ הַ/פָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וְ/הִֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּ/כ֥וֹבָעִ֑ים מִרְקוּ֙ הָֽ/רְמָחִ֔ים לִבְשׁ֖וּ הַ/סִּרְיֹנֹֽת
verses.translit: 'srv hsvsym v'lv hprshym vhtytsbv bkhvb'ym mrqv hrmchym lbshv hsrynt
verses.translation: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.

verses.original: מַדּ֣וּעַ רָאִ֗יתִי הֵ֣מָּה חַתִּים֮ נְסֹגִ֣ים אָחוֹר֒ וְ/גִבּוֹרֵי/הֶ֣ם יֻכַּ֔תּוּ וּ/מָנ֥וֹס נָ֖סוּ וְ/לֹ֣א הִפְנ֑וּ מָג֥וֹר מִ/סָּבִ֖יב נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mdv' r'yty hmh chtym nsgym 'chvr vgbvryhm ykhtv vmnvs nsv vl' hpnv mgvr msbyb n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for fear was round about, saith the LORD .

verses.original: אַל יָנ֣וּס הַ/קַּ֔ל וְ/אַל יִמָּלֵ֖ט הַ/גִּבּ֑וֹר צָפ֨וֹנָ/ה֙ עַל יַ֣ד נְהַר פְּרָ֔ת כָּשְׁל֖וּ וְ/נָפָֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'l ynvs hql v'l ymlt hgbvr tspvnh 'l yd nhr prt khshlv vnplv
verses.translation: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.

verses.original: מִי זֶ֖ה כַּ/יְאֹ֣ר יַֽעֲלֶ֑ה כַּ/נְּהָר֕וֹת יִֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ מֵימָֽי/ו
verses.translit: my zh khy'r y'lh khnhrvt ytg'shv mymyv
verses.translation: Who is this that cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?

verses.original: מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ כַּ/יְאֹ֣ר יַֽעֲלֶ֔ה וְ/כַ/נְּהָר֖וֹת יִתְגֹּ֣עֲשׁוּ מָ֑יִם וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אַֽעֲלֶה֙ אֲכַסֶּה אֶ֔רֶץ אֹבִ֥ידָה עִ֖יר וְ/יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: mtsrym khy'r y'lh vkhnhrvt ytg'shv mym vy'mr ''lh 'khsh 'rts 'bydh 'yr vyshby bh
verses.translation: Egypt riseth up like a flood, and his waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.original: עֲל֤וּ הַ/סּוּסִים֙ וְ/הִתְהֹלְל֣וּ הָ/רֶ֔כֶב וְ/יֵצְא֖וּ הַ/גִּבּוֹרִ֑ים כּ֤וּשׁ וּ/פוּט֙ תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י מָגֵ֔ן וְ/לוּדִ֕ים תֹּפְשֵׂ֖י דֹּ֥רְכֵי קָֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: 'lv hsvsym vhthllv hrkhb vyts'v hgbvrym khvsh vpvt tpshy mgn vlvdym tpshy drkhy qsht
verses.translation: Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.

verses.original: וְֽ/הַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא לַ/אדֹנָ֧/י יְהוִ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת י֤וֹם נְקָמָה֙ לְ/הִנָּקֵ֣ם מִ/צָּרָ֔י/ו וְ/אָכְלָ֥ה חֶ֨רֶב֙ וְ/שָׂ֣בְעָ֔ה וְ/רָוְתָ֖ה מִ/דָּמָ֑/ם כִּ֣י זֶ֠בַח לַ/אדֹנָ֨/י יְהוִ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ צָפ֖וֹן אֶל נְהַר פְּרָֽת
verses.translit: vhyvm hhv' l'dny yhvh tsb'vt yvm nqmh lhnqm mtsryv v'khlh chrb vshb'h vrvth mdmm khy zbch l'dny yhvh tsb'vt b'rts tspvn 'l nhr prt
verses.translation: For this is the day of the Lord GOD of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord GOD of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

verses.original: עֲלִ֤י גִלְעָד֙ וּ/קְחִ֣י צֳרִ֔י בְּתוּלַ֖ת בַּת מִצְרָ֑יִם לַ/שָּׁוְא֙ הרביתי הִרְבֵּ֣ית רְפֻא֔וֹת תְּעָלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'ly gl'd vqchy tsry btvlt bt mtsrym lshv' hrbyty hrbyt rp'vt t'lh 'yn lkh
verses.translation: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines; for thou shalt not be cured.

verses.original: שָׁמְע֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ קְלוֹנֵ֔/ךְ וְ/צִוְחָתֵ֖/ךְ מָלְאָ֣ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי גִבּ֤וֹר בְּ/גִבּוֹר֙ כָּשָׁ֔לוּ יַחְדָּ֖יו נָפְל֥וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shm'v gvym qlvnkh vtsvchtkh ml'h h'rts khy gbvr bgbvr khshlv ychdyv nplv shnyhm
verses.translation: The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty, and they are fallen both together.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֑יא לָ/ב֗וֹא נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל לְ/הַכּ֖וֹת אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv hnby' lbv' nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl lhkhvt 't 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: The word that the LORD spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.

verses.original: הַגִּ֤ידוּ בְ/מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ וְ/הַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ בְ/מִגְדּ֔וֹל וְ/הַשְׁמִ֥יעוּ בְ/נֹ֖ף וּ/בְ/תַחְפַּנְחֵ֑ס אִמְר֗וּ הִתְיַצֵּב֙ וְ/הָכֵ֣ן לָ֔/ךְ כִּֽי אָכְלָ֥ה חֶ֖רֶב סְבִיבֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hgydv bmtsrym vhshmy'v bmgdvl vhshmy'v bnf vbtchpnchs 'mrv htytsb vhkhn lkh khy 'khlh chrb sbybykh
verses.translation: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.

verses.original: מַדּ֖וּעַ נִסְחַ֣ף אַבִּירֶ֑י/ךָ לֹ֣א עָמַ֔ד כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הֲדָפֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mdv' nschf 'byrykh l' 'md khy yhvh hdpv
verses.translation: Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.

verses.original: הִרְבָּ֖ה כּוֹשֵׁ֑ל גַּם נָפַ֞ל אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֗/הוּ וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ ק֣וּמָ/ה וְ/נָשֻׁ֣בָה אֶל עַמֵּ֗/נוּ וְ/אֶל אֶ֨רֶץ֙ מֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֔/נוּ מִ/פְּנֵ֖י חֶ֥רֶב הַ/יּוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: hrbh khvshl gm npl 'ysh 'l r'hv vy'mrv qvmh vnshbh 'l 'mnv v'l 'rts mvldtnv mpny chrb hyvnh
verses.translation: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.

verses.original: קָרְא֖וּ שָׁ֑ם פַּרְעֹ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ שָׁא֔וֹן הֶעֱבִ֖יר הַ/מּוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: qr'v shm pr'h mlkh mtsrym sh'vn h'byr hmv'd
verses.translation: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.

verses.original: חַי אָ֨נִי֙ נְאֻם הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑/וֹ כִּ֚י כְּ/תָב֣וֹר בֶּֽ/הָרִ֔ים וּ/כְ/כַרְמֶ֖ל בַּ/יָּ֥ם יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: chy 'ny n'm hmlkh yhvh tsb'vt shmv khy khtbvr bhrym vkhkhrml bym ybv'
verses.translation: As I live, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.

verses.original: כְּלֵ֤י גוֹלָה֙ עֲשִׂ֣י לָ֔/ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי נֹף֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְ/נִצְּתָ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: khly gvlh 'shy lkh yvshbt bt mtsrym khy nf lshmh thyh vntsth m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.

verses.original: עֶגְלָ֥ה יְפֵֽה פִיָּ֖ה מִצְרָ֑יִם קֶ֥רֶץ מִ/צָּפ֖וֹן בָּ֥א בָֽא
verses.translit: 'glh yph pyh mtsrym qrts mtspvn b' b'
verses.translation: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.

verses.original: גַּם שְׂכִרֶ֤י/הָ בְ/קִרְבָּ/הּ֙ כְּ/עֶגְלֵ֣י מַרְבֵּ֔ק כִּֽי גַם הֵ֧מָּה הִפְנ֛וּ נָ֥סוּ יַחְדָּ֖יו לֹ֣א עָמָ֑דוּ כִּ֣י י֥וֹם אֵידָ֛/ם בָּ֥א עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: gm shkhryh bqrbh kh'gly mrbq khy gm hmh hpnv nsv ychdyv l' 'mdv khy yvm 'ydm b' 'lyhm 't pqdtm
verses.translation: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.

verses.original: קוֹלָ֖/הּ כַּ/נָּחָ֣שׁ יֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי בְ/חַ֣יִל יֵלֵ֔כוּ וּ/בְ/קַרְדֻּמּוֹת֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ֔/הּ כְּ/חֹטְבֵ֖י עֵצִֽים
verses.translit: qvlh khnchsh ylkh khy bchyl ylkhv vbqrdmvt b'v lh khchtby 'tsym
verses.translation: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.

verses.original: כָּרְת֤וּ יַעְרָ/הּ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֖י לֹ֣א יֵֽחָקֵ֑ר כִּ֤י רַבּוּ֙ מֵֽ/אַרְבֶּ֔ה וְ/אֵ֥ין לָ/הֶ֖ם מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: khrtv y'rh n'm yhvh khy l' ychqr khy rbv m'rbh v'yn lhm mspr
verses.translation: They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD , though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.

verses.original: הֹבִ֖ישָׁה בַּת מִצְרָ֑יִם נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּ/יַ֥ד עַם צָפֽוֹן
verses.translit: hbyshh bt mtsrym ntnh byd 'm tspvn
verses.translation: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

verses.original: אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְ/נִ֤י פוֹקֵד֙ אֶל אָמ֣וֹן מִ/נֹּ֔א וְ/עַל פַּרְעֹה֙ וְ/עַל מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/עַל אֱלֹהֶ֖י/הָ וְ/עַל מְלָכֶ֑י/הָ וְ/עַ֨ל פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/עַ֥ל הַ/בֹּטְחִ֖ים בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny pvqd 'l 'mvn mn' v'l pr'h v'l mtsrym v'l 'lhyh v'l mlkhyh v'l pr'h v'l hbtchym bv
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:

verses.original: וּ/נְתַתִּ֗י/ם בְּ/יַד֙ מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֔/ם וּ/בְ/יַ֛ד נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וּ/בְ/יַד עֲבָדָ֑י/ו וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֛ן תִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן כִּֽ/ימֵי קֶ֖דֶם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnttym byd mbqshy npshm vbyd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl vbyd 'bdyv v'chry khn tshkhn khymy qdm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ֠/אַתָּה אַל תִּירָ֞א עַבְדִּ֤/י יַֽעֲקֹב֙ וְ/אַל תֵּחַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י הִנְ/נִ֤י מוֹשִֽׁעֲ/ךָ֙ מֵֽ/רָח֔וֹק וְ/אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֑/ם וְ/שָׁ֧ב יַעֲק֛וֹב וְ/שָׁקַ֥ט וְ/שַׁאֲנַ֖ן וְ/אֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד
verses.translit: v'th 'l tyr' 'bdy y'qb v'l tcht yshr'l khy hnny mvsh'kh mrchvq v't zr'kh m'rts shbym vshb y'qvb vshqt vsh'nn v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

verses.original: אַ֠תָּה אַל תִּירָ֞א עַבְדִּ֤/י יַֽעֲקֹב֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אִתְּ/ךָ֖ אָ֑נִי כִּי֩ אֶעֱשֶׂ֨ה כָלָ֜ה בְּ/כָֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִדַּחְתִּ֣י/ךָ שָׁ֗מָּ/ה וְ/אֹֽתְ/ךָ֙ לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה כָלָ֔ה וְ/יִסַּרְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְ/נַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֥א אֲנַקֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'th 'l tyr' 'bdy y'qb n'm yhvh khy 'tkh 'ny khy ''shh khlh bkhl hgvym 'shr hdchtykh shmh v'tkh l' ''shh khlh vysrtykh lmshpt vnqh l' 'nqkh
verses.translation: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD : for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֧ה דְבַר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא אֶל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים בְּ/טֶ֛רֶם יַכֶּ֥ה פַרְעֹ֖ה אֶת עַזָּֽה
verses.translit: 'shr hyh dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv hnby' 'l plshtym btrm ykhh pr'h 't 'zh
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנֵּה מַ֜יִם עֹלִ֤ים מִ/צָּפוֹן֙ וְ/הָיוּ֙ לְ/נַ֣חַל שׁוֹטֵ֔ף וְ/יִשְׁטְפוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ וּ/מְלוֹאָ֔/הּ עִ֖יר וְ/יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑/הּ וְ/זָֽעֲקוּ֙ הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם וְ/הֵילִ֕ל כֹּ֖ל יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnh mym 'lym mtspvn vhyv lnchl shvtf vyshtpv 'rts vmlv'h 'yr vyshby bh vz'qv h'dm vhyll khl yvshb h'rts
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.

verses.original: מִ/קּ֗וֹל שַֽׁעֲטַת֙ פַּרְס֣וֹת אַבִּירָ֔י/ו מֵ/רַ֣עַשׁ לְ/רִכְבּ֔/וֹ הֲמ֖וֹן גַּלְגִּלָּ֑י/ו לֹֽא הִפְנ֤וּ אָבוֹת֙ אֶל בָּנִ֔ים מֵֽ/רִפְי֖וֹן יָדָֽיִם
verses.translit: mqvl sh'tt prsvt 'byryv mr'sh lrkhbv hmvn glglyv l' hpnv 'bvt 'l bnym mrpyvn ydym
verses.translation: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses , at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;

verses.original: עַל הַ/יּ֗וֹם הַ/בָּא֙ לִ/שְׁד֣וֹד אֶת כָּל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְ/הַכְרִ֤ית לְ/צֹר֙ וּ/לְ/צִיד֔וֹן כֹּ֖ל שָׂרִ֣יד עֹזֵ֑ר כִּֽי שֹׁדֵ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים שְׁאֵרִ֖ית אִ֥י כַפְתּֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'l hyvm hb' lshdvd 't khl plshtym lhkhryt ltsr vltsydvn khl shryd 'zr khy shdd yhvh 't plshtym sh'ryt 'y khptvr
verses.translation: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.

verses.original: בָּ֤אָה קָרְחָה֙ אֶל עַזָּ֔ה נִדְמְתָ֥ה אַשְׁקְל֖וֹן שְׁאֵרִ֣ית עִמְקָ֑/ם עַד מָתַ֖י תִּתְגּוֹדָֽדִי
verses.translit: b'h qrchh 'l 'zh ndmth 'shqlvn sh'ryt 'mqm 'd mty ttgvddy
verses.translation: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?

verses.original: ה֗וֹי חֶ֚רֶב לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה עַד אָ֖נָה לֹ֣א תִשְׁקֹ֑טִי הֵאָֽסְפִי֙ אַל תַּעְרֵ֔/ךְ הֵרָגְעִ֖י וָ/דֹֽמִּי
verses.translit: hvy chrb lyhvh 'd 'nh l' tshqty h'spy 'l t'rkh hrg'y vdmy
verses.translation: O thou sword of the LORD , how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.

verses.original: אֵ֣יךְ תִּשְׁקֹ֔טִי וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה צִוָּה לָ֑/הּ אֶֽל אַשְׁקְל֛וֹן וְ/אֶל ח֥וֹף הַ/יָּ֖ם שָׁ֥ם יְעָדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'ykh tshqty vyhvh tsvh lh 'l 'shqlvn v'l chvf hym shm y'dh
verses.translation: How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.

verses.original: לְ/מוֹאָ֡ב כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וֹי אֶל נְבוֹ֙ כִּ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔דָה הֹבִ֥ישָׁה נִלְכְּדָ֖ה קִרְיָתָ֑יִם הֹבִ֥ישָׁה הַ/מִּשְׂגָּ֖ב וָ/חָֽתָּה
verses.translit: lmv'b khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hvy 'l nbv khy shddh hbyshh nlkhdh qrytym hbyshh hmshgb vchth
verses.translation: Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.

verses.original: אֵ֣ין עוֹד֮ תְּהִלַּ֣ת מוֹאָב֒ בְּ/חֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן חָשְׁב֤וּ עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ רָעָ֔ה לְכ֖וּ וְ/נַכְרִיתֶ֣/נָּה מִ/גּ֑וֹי גַּם מַדְמֵ֣ן תִּדֹּ֔מִּי אַחֲרַ֖יִ/ךְ תֵּ֥לֶךְ חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: 'yn 'vd thlt mv'b bchshbvn chshbv 'lyh r'h lkhv vnkhrytnh mgvy gm mdmn tdmy 'chrykh tlkh chrb
verses.translation: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.

verses.original: ק֥וֹל צְעָקָ֖ה מֵ/חֹֽרוֹנָ֑יִם שֹׁ֖ד וָ/שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: qvl ts'qh mchrvnym shd vshbr gdvl
verses.translation: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.

verses.original: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה מוֹאָ֑ב הִשְׁמִ֥יעוּ זְּעָקָ֖ה צעורי/ה צְעִירֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: nshbrh mv'b hshmy'v z'qh ts'vryh ts'yryh
verses.translation: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

verses.original: כִּ֚י מַעֲלֵ֣ה ה/לחות הַ/לּוּחִ֔ית בִּ/בְכִ֖י יַֽעֲלֶה בֶּ֑כִי כִּ֚י בְּ/מוֹרַ֣ד חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם צָרֵ֥י צַֽעֲקַת שֶׁ֖בֶר שָׁמֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: khy m'lh hlchvt hlvchyt bbkhy y'lh bkhy khy bmvrd chvrnym tsry ts'qt shbr shm'v
verses.translation: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.

verses.original: נֻ֖סוּ מַלְּט֣וּ נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֑ם וְ/תִֽהְיֶ֕ינָה כַּ/עֲרוֹעֵ֖ר בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: nsv mltv npshkhm vthyynh kh'rv'r bmdbr
verses.translation: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

verses.original: כִּ֠י יַ֣עַן בִּטְחֵ֤/ךְ בְּ/מַעֲשַׂ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וּ/בְ/א֣וֹצְרוֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ גַּם אַ֖תְּ תִּלָּכֵ֑דִי וְ/יָצָ֤א כמיש כְמוֹשׁ֙ בַּ/גּוֹלָ֔ה כֹּהֲנָ֥י/ו וְ/שָׂרָ֖י/ו יחד יַחְדָּֽיו
verses.translit: khy y'n btchkh bm'shykh vb'vtsrvtykh gm 't tlkhdy vyts' khmysh khmvsh bgvlh khhnyv vshryv ychd ychdyv
verses.translation: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.

verses.original: וְ/יָבֹ֨א שֹׁדֵ֜ד אֶל כָּל עִ֗יר וְ/עִיר֙ לֹ֣א תִמָּלֵ֔ט וְ/אָבַ֥ד הָ/עֵ֖מֶק וְ/נִשְׁמַ֣ד הַ/מִּישֹׁ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' shdd 'l khl 'yr v'yr l' tmlt v'bd h'mq vnshmd hmyshr 'shr 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD hath spoken.

verses.original: תְּנוּ צִ֣יץ לְ/מוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י נָצֹ֖א תֵּצֵ֑א וְ/עָרֶ֨י/הָ֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ינָה מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּ/הֵֽן
verses.translit: tnv tsyts lmv'b khy nts' tts' v'ryh lshmh thyynh m'yn yvshb bhn
verses.translation: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.

verses.original: אָר֗וּר עֹשֶׂ֛ה מְלֶ֥אכֶת יְהוָ֖ה רְמִיָּ֑ה וְ/אָר֕וּר מֹנֵ֥עַ חַרְבּ֖/וֹ מִ/דָּֽם
verses.translit: 'rvr 'shh ml'kht yhvh rmyh v'rvr mn' chrbv mdm
verses.translation: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.

verses.original: שַׁאֲנַ֨ן מוֹאָ֜ב מִ/נְּעוּרָ֗י/ו וְ/שֹׁקֵ֥ט הוּא֙ אֶל שְׁמָרָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹֽא הוּרַ֤ק מִ/כְּלִי֙ אֶל כֶּ֔לִי וּ/בַ/גּוֹלָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָלָ֑ךְ עַל כֵּ֗ן עָמַ֤ד טַעְמ/וֹ֙ בּ֔/וֹ וְ/רֵיח֖/וֹ לֹ֥א נָמָֽר
verses.translit: sh'nn mv'b mn'vryv vshqt hv' 'l shmryv vl' hvrq mkhly 'l khly vbgvlh l' hlkh 'l khn 'md t'mv bv vrychv l' nmr
verses.translation: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן הִנֵּ֖ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּי ל֥/וֹ צֹעִ֖ים וְ/צֵעֻ֑/הוּ וְ/כֵלָ֣י/ו יָרִ֔יקוּ וְ/נִבְלֵי/הֶ֖ם יְנַפֵּֽצוּ
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vshlchty lv ts'ym vts'hv vkhlyv yryqv vnblyhm ynptsv
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.

verses.original: וּ/בֹ֥שׁ מוֹאָ֖ב מִ/כְּמ֑וֹשׁ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר בֹּ֨שׁוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/בֵּ֥ית אֵ֖ל מִבְטֶחָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbsh mv'b mkhmvsh kh'shr bshv byt yshr'l mbyt 'l mbtchm
verses.translation: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth-el their confidence.

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ תֹּֽאמְר֔וּ גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וְ/אַנְשֵׁי חַ֖יִל לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: 'ykh t'mrv gbvrym 'nchnv v'nshy chyl lmlchmh
verses.translation: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?

verses.original: שֻׁדַּ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ וְ/עָרֶ֣י/הָ עָלָ֔ה וּ/מִבְחַ֥ר בַּֽחוּרָ֖י/ו יָרְד֣וּ לַ/טָּ֑בַח נְאֻ֨ם הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shdd mv'b v'ryh 'lh vmbchr bchvryv yrdv ltbch n'm hmlkh yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: קָר֥וֹב אֵיד מוֹאָ֖ב לָ/ב֑וֹא וְ/רָ֣עָת֔/וֹ מִהֲרָ֖ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: qrvb 'yd mv'b lbv' vr'tv mhrh m'd
verses.translation: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

verses.original: נֻ֤דוּ ל/וֹ֙ כָּל סְבִיבָ֔י/ו וְ/כֹ֖ל יֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמ֑/וֹ אִמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֤ה נִשְׁבַּר֙ מַטֵּה עֹ֔ז מַקֵּ֖ל תִּפְאָרָֽה
verses.translit: ndv lv khl sbybyv vkhl yd'y shmv 'mrv 'ykhh nshbr mth 'z mql tp'rh
verses.translation: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!

verses.original: רְדִ֤י מִ/כָּבוֹד֙ ישבי וּ/שְׁבִ֣י בַ/צָּמָ֔א יֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת דִּיב֑וֹן כִּֽי שֹׁדֵ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ עָ֣לָה בָ֔/ךְ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: rdy mkhbvd yshby vshby btsm' yshbt bt dybvn khy shdd mv'b 'lh bkh shcht mbtsrykh
verses.translation: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.

verses.original: אֶל דֶּ֛רֶךְ עִמְדִ֥י וְ/צַפִּ֖י יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת עֲרוֹעֵ֑ר שַׁאֲלִי נָ֣ס וְ/נִמְלָ֔טָה אִמְרִ֖י מַה נִּֽהְיָֽתָה
verses.translit: 'l drkh 'mdy vtspy yvshbt 'rv'r sh'ly ns vnmlth 'mry mh nhyth
verses.translation: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?

verses.original: הֹבִ֥ישׁ מוֹאָ֛ב כִּֽי חַ֖תָּה הילילי הֵילִ֣ילוּ ו/זעקי וּֽ/זְעָ֑קוּ הַגִּ֣ידוּ בְ/אַרְנ֔וֹן כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: hbysh mv'b khy chth hylyly hylylv vz'qy vz'qv hgydv b'rnvn khy shdd mv'b
verses.translation: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,

verses.original: וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֥ט בָּ֖א אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/מִּישֹׁ֑ר אֶל חֹל֥וֹן וְ/אֶל יַ֖הְצָ/ה וְ/עַל מופעת מֵיפָֽעַת
verses.translit: vmshpt b' 'l 'rts hmyshr 'l chlvn v'l yhtsh v'l mvp't myp't
verses.translation: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,

verses.original: וְ/עַל דִּיב֣וֹן וְ/עַל נְב֔וֹ וְ/עַל בֵּ֖ית דִּבְלָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'l dybvn v'l nbv v'l byt dbltym
verses.translation: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,

verses.original: וְ/עַ֧ל קִרְיָתַ֛יִם וְ/עַל בֵּ֥ית גָּמ֖וּל וְ/עַל בֵּ֥ית מְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'l qrytym v'l byt gmvl v'l byt m'vn
verses.translation: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,

verses.original: וְ/עַל קְרִיּ֖וֹת וְ/עַל בָּצְרָ֑ה וְ/עַ֗ל כָּל עָרֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב הָ/רְחֹק֖וֹת וְ/הַ/קְּרֹבֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'l qryvt v'l btsrh v'l khl 'ry 'rts mv'b hrchqvt vhqrbvt
verses.translation: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

verses.original: נִגְדְּעָה֙ קֶ֣רֶן מוֹאָ֔ב וּ/זְרֹע֖/וֹ נִשְׁבָּ֑רָה נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: ngd'h qrn mv'b vzr'v nshbrh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הַשְׁכִּירֻ֕/הוּ כִּ֥י עַל יְהוָ֖ה הִגְדִּ֑יל וְ/סָפַ֤ק מוֹאָב֙ בְּ/קִיא֔/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֥ה לִ/שְׂחֹ֖ק גַּם הֽוּא
verses.translit: hshkhyrhv khy 'l yhvh hgdyl vspq mv'b bqy'v vhyh lshchq gm hv'
verses.translation: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the LORD : Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ם ל֣וֹא הַ/שְּׂחֹ֗ק הָיָ֤ה לְ/ךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם בְּ/גַנָּבִ֖ים נמצאה נִמְצָ֑א כִּֽי מִ/דֵּ֧י דְבָרֶ֥י/ךָ בּ֖/וֹ תִּתְנוֹדָֽד
verses.translit: v'm lv' hshchq hyh lkh yshr'l 'm bgnbym nmts'h nmts' khy mdy dbrykh bv ttnvdd
verses.translation: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.

verses.original: עִזְב֤וּ עָרִים֙ וְ/שִׁכְנ֣וּ בַּ/סֶּ֔לַע יֹשְׁבֵ֖י מוֹאָ֑ב וִֽ/הְי֣וּ כְ/יוֹנָ֔ה תְּקַנֵּ֖ן בְּ/עֶבְרֵ֥י פִי פָֽחַת
verses.translit: 'zbv 'rym vshkhnv bsl' yshby mv'b vhyv khyvnh tqnn b'bry py pcht
verses.translation: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole’s mouth.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּאֶ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד גָּבְה֧/וֹ וּ/גְאוֹנ֛/וֹ וְ/גַאֲוָת֖/וֹ וְ/רֻ֥ם לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shm'nv g'vn mv'b g'h m'd gbhv vg'vnv vg'vtv vrm lbv
verses.translation: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה עֶבְרָת֖/וֹ וְ/לֹא כֵ֑ן בַּדָּ֖י/ו לֹא כֵ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: 'ny yd'ty n'm yhvh 'brtv vl' khn bdyv l' khn 'shv
verses.translation: I know his wrath, saith the LORD ; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it .

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֙ עַל מוֹאָ֣ב אֲיֵלִ֔יל וּ/לְ/מוֹאָ֥ב כֻּלֹּ֖/ה אֶזְעָ֑ק אֶל אַנְשֵׁ֥י קִֽיר חֶ֖רֶשׂ יֶהְגֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'l khn 'l mv'b 'ylyl vlmv'b khlh 'z'q 'l 'nshy qyr chrsh yhgh
verses.translation: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.

verses.original: מִ/בְּכִ֨י יַעְזֵ֤ר אֶבְכֶּה לָּ/ךְ֙ הַ/גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה נְטִֽישֹׁתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ עָ֣בְרוּ יָ֔ם עַ֛ד יָ֥ם יַעְזֵ֖ר נָגָ֑עוּ עַל קֵיצֵ֥/ךְ וְ/עַל בְּצִירֵ֖/ךְ שֹׁדֵ֥ד נָפָֽל
verses.translit: mbkhy y'zr 'bkhh lkh hgpn shbmh ntyshtykh 'brv ym 'd ym y'zr ng'v 'l qytskh v'l btsyrkh shdd npl
verses.translation: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

verses.original: וְ/נֶאֶסְפָ֨ה שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָ/גִ֛יל מִ/כַּרְמֶ֖ל וּ/מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב וְ/יַ֨יִן֙ מִ/יקָבִ֣ים הִשְׁבַּ֔תִּי לֹֽא יִדְרֹ֣ךְ הֵידָ֔ד הֵידָ֖ד לֹ֥א הֵידָֽד
verses.translit: vn'sph shmchh vgyl mkhrml vm'rts mv'b vyyn myqbym hshbty l' ydrkh hydd hydd l' hydd
verses.translation: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.

verses.original: מִ/זַּעֲקַ֨ת חֶשְׁבּ֜וֹן עַד אֶלְעָלֵ֗ה עַד יַ֨הַץ֙ נָתְנ֣וּ קוֹלָ֔/ם מִ/צֹּ֨עַר֙ עַד חֹ֣רֹנַ֔יִם עֶגְלַ֖ת שְׁלִֽשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֚י גַּם מֵ֣י נִמְרִ֔ים לִ/מְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: mz'qt chshbvn 'd 'l'lh 'd yhts ntnv qvlm mts'r 'd chrnym 'glt shlshyh khy gm my nmrym lmshmvt yhyv
verses.translation: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י לְ/מוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה מַעֲלֶ֣ה בָמָ֔ה וּ/מַקְטִ֖יר לֵ/אלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhshbty lmv'b n'm yhvh m'lh bmh vmqtyr l'lhyv
verses.translation: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD , him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֞ן לִבִּ֤/י לְ/מוֹאָב֙ כַּ/חֲלִלִ֣ים יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְ/לִבִּ/י֙ אֶל אַנְשֵׁ֣י קִֽיר חֶ֔רֶשׂ כַּ/חֲלִילִ֖ים יֶהֱמֶ֑ה עַל כֵּ֛ן יִתְרַ֥ת עָשָׂ֖ה אָבָֽדוּ
verses.translit: 'l khn lby lmv'b khchllym yhmh vlby 'l 'nshy qyr chrsh khchlylym yhmh 'l khn ytrt 'shh 'bdv
verses.translation: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל רֹאשׁ֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְ/כָל זָקָ֖ן גְּרֻעָ֑ה עַ֤ל כָּל יָדַ֨יִם֙ גְּדֻדֹ֔ת וְ/עַל מָתְנַ֖יִם שָֽׂק
verses.translit: khy khl r'sh qrchh vkhl zqn gr'h 'l khl ydym gddt v'l mtnym shq
verses.translation: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

verses.original: עַ֣ל כָּל גַּגּ֥וֹת מוֹאָ֛ב וּ/בִ/רְחֹבֹתֶ֖י/הָ כֻּלֹּ֣/ה מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּֽי שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי אֶת מוֹאָ֗ב כִּ/כְלִ֛י אֵֽין חֵ֥פֶץ בּ֖/וֹ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'l khl ggvt mv'b vbrchbtyh khlh mspd khy shbrty 't mv'b khkhly 'yn chpts bv n'm yhvh
verses.translation: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the LORD .

verses.original: אֵ֥יךְ חַ֨תָּה֙ הֵילִ֔ילוּ אֵ֛יךְ הִפְנָה עֹ֥רֶף מוֹאָ֖ב בּ֑וֹשׁ וְ/הָיָ֥ה מוֹאָ֛ב לִ/שְׂחֹ֥ק וְ/לִ/מְחִתָּ֖ה לְ/כָל סְבִיבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'ykh chth hylylv 'ykh hpnh 'rf mv'b bvsh vhyh mv'b lshchq vlmchth lkhl sbybyv
verses.translation: They shall howl, saying , How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.

verses.original: כִּי כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה כַ/נֶּ֖שֶׁר יִדְאֶ֑ה וּ/פָרַ֥שׂ כְּנָפָ֖י/ו אֶל מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh hnh khnshr yd'h vprsh khnpyv 'l mv'b
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD ; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.

verses.original: נִלְכְּדָה֙ הַ/קְּרִיּ֔וֹת וְ/הַ/מְּצָד֖וֹת נִתְפָּ֑שָׂה וְֽ֠/הָיָה לֵ֞ב גִּבּוֹרֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא כְּ/לֵ֖ב אִשָּׁ֥ה מְצֵרָֽה
verses.translit: nlkhdh hqryvt vhmtsdvt ntpshh vhyh lb gbvry mv'b byvm hhv' khlb 'shh mtsrh
verses.translation: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁמַ֥ד מוֹאָ֖ב מֵ/עָ֑ם כִּ֥י עַל יְהוָ֖ה הִגְדִּֽיל
verses.translit: vnshmd mv'b m'm khy 'l yhvh hgdyl
verses.translation: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the LORD .

verses.original: פַּ֥חַד וָ/פַ֖חַת וָ/פָ֑ח עָלֶ֛י/ךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב מוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: pchd vpcht vpch 'lykh yvshb mv'b n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD .

verses.original: ה/ניס הַ/נָּ֞ס מִ/פְּנֵ֤י הַ/פַּ֨חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל הַ/פַּ֔חַת וְ/הָֽ/עֹלֶה֙ מִן הַ/פַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּ/פָּ֑ח כִּֽי אָבִ֨יא אֵלֶ֧י/הָ אֶל מוֹאָ֛ב שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖/ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hnys hns mpny hpchd ypl 'l hpcht vh'lh mn hpcht ylkhd bpch khy 'by' 'lyh 'l mv'b shnt pqdtm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD .

verses.original: בְּ/צֵ֥ל חֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עָמְד֖וּ מִ/כֹּ֣חַ נָסִ֑ים כִּֽי אֵ֞שׁ יָצָ֣א מֵ/חֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן וְ/לֶֽהָבָה֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ין סִיח֔וֹן וַ/תֹּ֨אכַל֙ פְּאַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/קָדְקֹ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוֹן
verses.translit: btsl chshbvn 'mdv mkhch nsym khy 'sh yts' mchshbvn vlhbh mbyn sychvn vt'khl p't mv'b vqdqd bny sh'vn
verses.translation: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

verses.original: אוֹי לְ/ךָ֣ מוֹאָ֔ב אָבַ֖ד עַם כְּמ֑וֹשׁ כִּֽי לֻקְּח֤וּ בָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בַּ/שֶּׁ֔בִי וּ/בְנֹתֶ֖י/ךָ בַּ/שִּׁבְיָֽה
verses.translit: 'vy lkh mv'b 'bd 'm khmvsh khy lqchv bnykh bshby vbntykh bshbyh
verses.translation: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבְתִּ֧י שְׁבוּת מוֹאָ֛ב בְּ/אַחֲרִ֥ית הַ/יָּמִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה עַד הֵ֖נָּה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vshbty shbvt mv'b b'chryt hymym n'm yhvh 'd hnh mshpt mv'b
verses.translation: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD . Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י עַמּ֗וֹן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲ/בָנִ֥ים אֵין֙ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם יוֹרֵ֖שׁ אֵ֣ין ל֑/וֹ מַדּ֗וּעַ יָרַ֤שׁ מַלְכָּ/ם֙ אֶת גָּ֔ד וְ/עַמּ֖/וֹ בְּ/עָרָ֥י/ו יָשָֽׁב
verses.translit: lbny 'mvn khh 'mr yhvh hbnym 'yn lyshr'l 'm yvrsh 'yn lv mdv' yrsh mlkhm 't gd v'mv b'ryv yshb
verses.translation: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD ; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֡ן הִנֵּה֩ יָמִ֨ים בָּאִ֜ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה וְ֠/הִשְׁמַעְתִּי אֶל רַבַּ֨ת בְּנֵי עַמּ֜וֹן תְּרוּעַ֣ת מִלְחָמָ֗ה וְ/הָֽיְתָה֙ לְ/תֵ֣ל שְׁמָמָ֔ה וּ/בְנֹתֶ֖י/הָ בָּ/אֵ֣שׁ תִּצַּ֑תְנָה וְ/יָרַ֧שׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת יֹרְשָׁ֖י/ו אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vhshm'ty 'l rbt bny 'mvn trv't mlchmh vhyth ltl shmmh vbntyh b'sh ttstnh vyrsh yshr'l 't yrshyv 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הֵילִ֨ילִי חֶשְׁבּ֜וֹן כִּ֣י שֻׁדְּדָה עַ֗י צְעַקְנָה֮ בְּנ֣וֹת רַבָּה֒ חֲגֹ֣רְנָה שַׂקִּ֔ים סְפֹ֕דְנָה וְ/הִתְשׁוֹטַ֖טְנָה בַּ/גְּדֵר֑וֹת כִּ֤י מַלְכָּ/ם֙ בַּ/גּוֹלָ֣ה יֵלֵ֔ךְ כֹּהֲנָ֥י/ו וְ/שָׂרָ֖י/ו יַחְדָּֽיו
verses.translit: hylyly chshbvn khy shddh 'y ts'qnh bnvt rbh chgrnh shqym spdnh vhtshvttnh bgdrvt khy mlkhm bgvlh ylkh khhnyv vshryv ychdyv
verses.translation: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.

verses.original: מַה תִּתְהַֽלְלִי֙ בָּֽ/עֲמָקִ֔ים זָ֣ב עִמְקֵ֔/ךְ הַ/בַּ֖ת הַ/שּֽׁוֹבֵבָ֑ה הַ/בֹּֽטְחָה֙ בְּ/אֹ֣צְרֹתֶ֔י/הָ מִ֖י יָב֥וֹא אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: mh tthlly b'mqym zb 'mqkh hbt hshvbbh hbtchh b'tsrtyh my ybv' 'ly
verses.translation: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying , Who shall come unto me?

verses.original: הִנְ/נִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא עָלַ֜יִ/ךְ פַּ֗חַד נְאֻם אֲדֹנָ֧/י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת מִ/כָּל סְבִיבָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/נִדַּחְתֶּם֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֥ין מְקַבֵּ֖ץ לַ/נֹּדֵֽד
verses.translit: hnny mby' 'lykh pchd n'm 'dny yhvh tsb'vt mkhl sbybykh vndchtm 'ysh lpnyv v'yn mqbts lndd
verses.translation: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן אָשִׁ֛יב אֶת שְׁב֥וּת בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֖וֹן נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'chry khn 'shyb 't shbvt bny 'mvn n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD .

verses.original: לֶ/אֱד֗וֹם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הַ/אֵ֥ין ע֛וֹד חָכְמָ֖ה בְּ/תֵימָ֑ן אָבְדָ֤ה עֵצָה֙ מִ/בָּנִ֔ים נִסְרְחָ֖ה חָכְמָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: l'dvm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt h'yn 'vd chkhmh btymn 'bdh 'tsh mbnym nsrchh chkhmtm
verses.translation: Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

verses.original: נֻ֤סוּ הָפְנוּ֙ הֶעְמִ֣יקוּ לָ/שֶׁ֔בֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּדָ֑ן כִּ֣י אֵ֥יד עֵשָׂ֛ו הֵבֵ֥אתִי עָלָ֖י/ו עֵ֥ת פְּקַדְתִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: nsv hpnv h'myqv lshbt yshby ddn khy 'yd 'shv hb'ty 'lyv 't pqdtyv
verses.translation: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.

verses.original: אִם בֹּֽצְרִים֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ֔/ךְ לֹ֥א יַשְׁאִ֖רוּ עֽוֹלֵל֑וֹת אִם גַּנָּבִ֥ים בַּ/לַּ֖יְלָה הִשְׁחִ֥יתוּ דַיָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'm btsrym b'v lkh l' ysh'rv 'vllvt 'm gnbym blylh hshchytv dym
verses.translation: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֲנִ֞י חָשַׂ֣פְתִּי אֶת עֵשָׂ֗ו גִּלֵּ֨יתִי֙ אֶת מִסְתָּרָ֔י/ו וְ/נֶחְבָּ֖ה לֹ֣א יוּכָ֑ל שֻׁדַּ֥ד זַרְע֛/וֹ וְ/אֶחָ֥י/ו וּ/שְׁכֵנָ֖י/ו וְ/אֵינֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: khy 'ny chshpty 't 'shv glyty 't mstryv vnchbh l' yvkhl shdd zr'v v'chyv vshkhnyv v'ynnv
verses.translation: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.

verses.original: עָזְבָ֥/ה יְתֹמֶ֖י/ךָ אֲנִ֣י אֲחַיֶּ֑ה וְ/אַלְמְנֹתֶ֖י/ךָ עָלַ֥/י תִּבְטָֽחוּ
verses.translit: 'zbh ytmykh 'ny 'chyh v'lmntykh 'ly tbtchv
verses.translation: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

verses.original: כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִ֠נֵּה אֲשֶׁר אֵ֨ין מִשְׁפָּטָ֜/ם לִ/שְׁתּ֤וֹת הַ/כּוֹס֙ שָׁת֣וֹ יִשְׁתּ֔וּ וְ/אַתָּ֣ה ה֔וּא נָקֹ֖ה תִּנָּקֶ֑ה לֹ֣א תִנָּקֶ֔ה כִּ֥י שָׁתֹ֖ה תִּשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh hnh 'shr 'yn mshptm lshtvt hkhvs shtv yshtv v'th hv' nqh tnqh l' tnqh khy shth tshth
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD ; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it .

verses.original: כִּ֣י בִ֤/י נִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי לְ/שַׁמָּ֧ה לְ/חֶרְפָּ֛ה לְ/חֹ֥רֶב וְ/לִ/קְלָלָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה בָצְרָ֑ה וְ/כָל עָרֶ֥י/הָ תִהְיֶ֖ינָה לְ/חָרְב֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khy by nshb'ty n'm yhvh khy lshmh lchrph lchrb vlqllh thyh btsrh vkhl 'ryh thyynh lchrbvt 'vlm
verses.translation: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD , that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

verses.original: שְׁמוּעָ֤ה שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/צִ֖יר בַּ/גּוֹיִ֣ם שָׁל֑וּחַ הִֽתְקַבְּצוּ֙ וּ/בֹ֣אוּ עָלֶ֔י/הָ וְ/ק֖וּמוּ לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: shmv'h shm'ty m't yhvh vtsyr bgvym shlvch htqbtsv vb'v 'lyh vqvmv lmlchmh
verses.translation: I have heard a rumour from the LORD , and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying , Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֥ה קָטֹ֛ן נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם בָּז֖וּי בָּ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: khy hnh qtn nttykh bgvym bzvy b'dm
verses.translation: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.

verses.original: תִּֽפְלַצְתְּ/ךָ֞ הִשִּׁ֤יא אֹתָ/ךְ֙ זְד֣וֹן לִבֶּ֔/ךָ שֹֽׁכְנִי֙ בְּ/חַגְוֵ֣י הַ/סֶּ֔לַע תֹּפְשִׂ֖י מְר֣וֹם גִּבְעָ֑ה כִּֽי תַגְבִּ֤יהַ כַּ/נֶּ֨שֶׁר֙ קִנֶּ֔/ךָ מִ/שָּׁ֥ם אֽוֹרִידְ/ךָ֖ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: tpltstkh hshy' 'tkh zdvn lbkh shkhny bchgvy hsl' tpshy mrvm gb'h khy tgbyh khnshr qnkh mshm 'vrydkh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה אֱד֖וֹם לְ/שַׁמָּ֑ה כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְ/יִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל כָּל מַכּוֹתֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: vhyth 'dvm lshmh khl 'br 'lyh yshm vyshrq 'l khl mkhvth
verses.translation: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

verses.original: כְּֽ/מַהְפֵּכַ֞ת סְדֹ֧ם וַ/עֲמֹרָ֛ה וּ/שְׁכֵנֶ֖י/הָ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא יֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְ/לֹֽא יָג֥וּר בָּ֖/הּ בֶּן אָדָֽם
verses.translit: khmhpkht sdm v'mrh vshkhnyh 'mr yhvh l' yshb shm 'ysh vl' ygvr bh bn 'dm
verses.translation: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD , no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.

verses.original: הִ֠נֵּה כְּ/אַרְיֵ֞ה יַעֲלֶ֨ה מִ/גְּא֣וֹן הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֮ אֶל נְוֵ֣ה אֵיתָן֒ כִּֽי אַרְגִּ֤יעָה אֲרִיצֶ֨/נּוּ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/הָ וּ/מִ֥י בָח֖וּר אֵלֶ֣י/הָ אֶפְקֹ֑ד כִּ֣י מִ֤י כָמ֨וֹ/נִי֙ וּ/מִ֣י יֹעִידֶ֔/נִּי וּ/מִי זֶ֣ה רֹעֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲמֹ֖ד לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: hnh kh'ryh y'lh mg'vn hyrdn 'l nvh 'ytn khy 'rgy'h 'rytsnv m'lyh vmy bchvr 'lyh 'pqd khy my khmvny vmy y'ydny vmy zh r'h 'shr y'md lpny
verses.translation: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן שִׁמְע֣וּ עֲצַת יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָעַץ֙ אֶל אֱד֔וֹם וּ/מַ֨חְשְׁבוֹתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָשַׁ֖ב אֶל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י תֵימָ֑ן אִם לֹ֤א יִסְחָבוּ/ם֙ צְעִירֵ֣י הַ/צֹּ֔אן אִם לֹ֥א יַשִּׁ֛ים עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם נְוֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: lkhn shm'v 'tst yhvh 'shr y'ts 'l 'dvm vmchshbvtyv 'shr chshb 'l yshby tymn 'm l' yschbvm ts'yry hts'n 'm l' yshym 'lyhm nvhm
verses.translation: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD , that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

verses.original: מִ/קּ֣וֹל נִפְלָ֔/ם רָעֲשָׁ֖ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ צְעָקָ֕ה בְּ/יַם ס֖וּף נִשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: mqvl nplm r'shh h'rts ts'qh bym svf nshm' qvlh
verses.translation: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה כַ/נֶּ֨שֶׁר֙ יַעֲלֶ֣ה וְ/יִדְאֶ֔ה וְ/יִפְרֹ֥שׂ כְּנָפָ֖י/ו עַל בָּצְרָ֑ה וְֽ֠/הָיָה לֵ֞ב גִּבּוֹרֵ֤י אֱדוֹם֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא כְּ/לֵ֖ב אִשָּׁ֥ה מְצֵרָֽה
verses.translit: hnh khnshr y'lh vyd'h vyprsh khnpyv 'l btsrh vhyh lb gbvry 'dvm byvm hhv' khlb 'shh mtsrh
verses.translation: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

verses.original: לְ/דַמֶּ֗שֶׂק בּ֤וֹשָֽׁה חֲמָת֙ וְ/אַרְפָּ֔ד כִּי שְׁמֻעָ֥ה רָעָ֛ה שָׁמְע֖וּ נָמֹ֑גוּ בַּ/יָּ֣ם דְּאָגָ֔ה הַשְׁקֵ֖ט לֹ֥א יוּכָֽל
