verses.translit: ldmshq bvshh chmt v'rpd khy shm'h r'h shm'v nmgv bym d'gh hshqt l' yvkhl
verses.translation: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

verses.original: רָפְתָ֥ה דַמֶּ֛שֶׂק הִפְנְתָ֥ה לָ/נ֖וּס וְ/רֶ֣טֶט הֶחֱזִ֑יקָה צָרָ֧ה וַ/חֲבָלִ֛ים אֲחָזַ֖תָּ/ה כַּ/יּוֹלֵדָֽה
verses.translit: rpth dmshq hpnth lnvs vrtt hchzyqh tsrh vchblym 'chzth khyvldh
verses.translation: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

verses.original: אֵ֥יךְ לֹֽא עֻזְּבָ֖ה עִ֣יר תהלה תְּהִלָּ֑ת קִרְיַ֖ת מְשׂוֹשִֽׂ/י
verses.translit: 'ykh l' 'zbh 'yr thlh thlt qryt mshvshy
verses.translation: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן יִפְּל֥וּ בַחוּרֶ֖י/הָ בִּ/רְחֹבֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/כָל אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֤ה יִדַּ֨מּוּ֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: lkhn yplv bchvryh brchbtyh vkhl 'nshy hmlchmh ydmv byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/הִצַּ֥תִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּ/חוֹמַ֣ת דַּמָּ֑שֶׂק וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בֶּן הֲדָֽד
verses.translit: vhtsty 'sh bchvmt dmshq v'khlh 'rmnvt bn hdd
verses.translation: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.

verses.original: לְ/קֵדָ֣ר וּֽ/לְ/מַמְלְכ֣וֹת חָצ֗וֹר אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִכָּה֙ נבוכדראצור נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה ק֚וּמוּ עֲל֣וּ אֶל קֵדָ֔ר וְ/שָׁדְד֖וּ אֶת בְּנֵי קֶֽדֶם
verses.translit: lqdr vlmmlkhvt chtsvr 'shr hkhh nbvkhdr'tsvr nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl khh 'mr yhvh qvmv 'lv 'l qdr vshddv 't bny qdm
verses.translation: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD ; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

verses.original: אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֤ם וְ/צֹאנָ/ם֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ יְרִיעוֹתֵי/הֶ֧ם וְ/כָל כְּלֵי/הֶ֛ם וּ/גְמַלֵּי/הֶ֖ם יִשְׂא֣וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/קָרְא֧וּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם מָג֖וֹר מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: 'hlyhm vts'nm yqchv yry'vtyhm vkhl khlyhm vgmlyhm ysh'v lhm vqr'v 'lyhm mgvr msbyb
verses.translation: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.

verses.original: נֻסוּ֩ נֻּ֨דוּ מְאֹ֜ד הֶעְמִ֧יקוּ לָ/שֶׁ֛בֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֥י חָצ֖וֹר נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי יָעַ֨ץ עֲלֵי/כֶ֜ם נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֤ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ עֵצָ֔ה וְ/חָשַׁ֥ב עלי/הם עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם מַחֲשָׁבָֽה
verses.translit: nsv ndv m'd h'myqv lshbt yshby chtsvr n'm yhvh khy y'ts 'lykhm nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl 'tsh vchshb 'lyhm 'lykhm mchshbh
verses.translation: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD ; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

verses.original: ק֣וּמוּ עֲל֗וּ אֶל גּ֥וֹי שְׁלֵ֛יו יוֹשֵׁ֥ב לָ/בֶ֖טַח נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה לֹא דְלָתַ֧יִם וְ/לֹֽא בְרִ֛יחַ ל֖/וֹ בָּדָ֥ד יִשְׁכֹּֽנוּ
verses.translit: qvmv 'lv 'l gvy shlyv yvshb lbtch n'm yhvh l' dltym vl' brych lv bdd yshkhnv
verses.translation: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD , which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֨וּ גְמַלֵּי/הֶ֜ם לָ/בַ֗ז וַ/הֲמ֤וֹן מִקְנֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/שָׁלָ֔ל וְ/זֵרִתִ֥י/ם לְ/כָל ר֖וּחַ קְצוּצֵ֣י פֵאָ֑ה וּ/מִ/כָּל עֲבָרָ֛י/ו אָבִ֥יא אֶת אֵידָ֖/ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyv gmlyhm lbz vhmvn mqnyhm lshll vzrtym lkhl rvch qtsvtsy p'h vmkhl 'bryv 'by' 't 'ydm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֨ה חָצ֜וֹר לִ/מְע֥וֹן תַּנִּ֛ים שְׁמָמָ֖ה עַד עוֹלָ֑ם לֹֽא יֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְ/לֹֽא יָג֥וּר בָּ֖/הּ בֶּן אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vhyth chtsvr lm'vn tnym shmmh 'd 'vlm l' yshb shm 'ysh vl' ygvr bh bn 'dm
verses.translation: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֧ה דְבַר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא אֶל עֵילָ֑ם בְּ/רֵאשִׁ֗ית מַלְכ֛וּת צִדְקִיָּ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: 'shr hyh dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv hnby' 'l 'ylm br'shyt mlkhvt tsdqyh mlkh yhvdh l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְ/נִ֥י שֹׁבֵ֖ר אֶת קֶ֣שֶׁת עֵילָ֑ם רֵאשִׁ֖ית גְּבוּרָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnny shbr 't qsht 'ylm r'shyt gbvrtm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֨י אֶל עֵילָ֜ם אַרְבַּ֣ע רוּח֗וֹת מֵֽ/אַרְבַּע֙ קְצ֣וֹת הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/זֵ֣רִתִ֔י/ם לְ/כֹ֖ל הָ/רֻח֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה הַ/גּ֔וֹי אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא יָב֥וֹא שָׁ֖ם נִדְּחֵ֥י עולם עֵילָֽם
verses.translit: vhb'ty 'l 'ylm 'rb' rvchvt m'rb' qtsvt hshmym vzrtym lkhl hrchvt h'lh vl' yhyh hgvy 'shr l' ybv' shm ndchy 'vlm 'ylm
verses.translation: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

verses.original: וְ/הַחְתַּתִּ֣י אֶת עֵ֠ילָם לִ/פְנֵ֨י אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֜ם וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֗/ם וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֨י עֲלֵי/הֶ֧ם רָעָ֛ה אֶת חֲר֥וֹן אַפִּ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶם֙ אֶת הַ/חֶ֔רֶב עַ֥ד כַּלּוֹתִ֖/י אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhchtty 't 'ylm lpny 'ybyhm vlpny mbqshy npshm vhb'ty 'lyhm r'h 't chrvn 'py n'm yhvh vshlchty 'chryhm 't hchrb 'd khlvty 'vtm
verses.translation: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the LORD ; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֥י כִסְאִ֖/י בְּ/עֵילָ֑ם וְ/הַאֲבַדְתִּ֥י מִ/שָּׁ֛ם מֶ֥לֶךְ וְ/שָׂרִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshmty khs'y b'ylm vh'bdty mshm mlkh vshrym n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בְּ/אַחֲרִ֣ית הַ/יָּמִ֗ים אשוב אָשִׁ֛יב אֶת שבית שְׁב֥וּת עֵילָ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh b'chryt hymym 'shvb 'shyb 't shbyt shbvt 'ylm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים בְּ/יַ֖ד יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִֽיא
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'l bbl 'l 'rts khshdym byd yrmyhv hnby'
verses.translation: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.original: הַגִּ֨ידוּ בַ/גּוֹיִ֤ם וְ/הַשְׁמִ֨יעוּ֙ וּֽ/שְׂאוּ נֵ֔ס הַשְׁמִ֖יעוּ אַל תְּכַחֵ֑דוּ אִמְרוּ֩ נִלְכְּדָ֨ה בָבֶ֜ל הֹבִ֥ישׁ בֵּל֙ חַ֣ת מְרֹדָ֔ךְ הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ עֲצַבֶּ֔י/הָ חַ֖תּוּ גִּלּוּלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: hgydv bgvym vhshmy'v vsh'v ns hshmy'v 'l tkhchdv 'mrv nlkhdh bbl hbysh bl cht mrdkh hbyshv 'tsbyh chtv glvlyh
verses.translation: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עָלָה֩ עָלֶ֨י/הָ גּ֜וֹי מִ/צָּפ֗וֹן הֽוּא יָשִׁ֤ית אֶת אַרְצָ/הּ֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּ֑/הּ מֵ/אָדָ֥ם וְ/עַד בְּהֵמָ֖ה נָ֥דוּ הָלָֽכוּ
verses.translit: khy 'lh 'lyh gvy mtspvn hv' yshyt 't 'rtsh lshmh vl' yhyh yvshb bh m'dm v'd bhmh ndv hlkhv
verses.translation: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֨ים הָ/הֵ֜מָּה וּ/בָ/עֵ֤ת הַ/הִיא֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה יָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הֵ֥מָּה וּ/בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֑ו הָל֤וֹךְ וּ/בָכוֹ֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ וְ/אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם יְבַקֵּֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: bymym hhmh vb't hhy' n'm yhvh yb'v bny yshr'l hmh vbny yhvdh ychdv hlvkh vbkhv ylkhv v't yhvh 'lhyhm ybqshv
verses.translation: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD , the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.

verses.original: צִיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֔לוּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ הֵ֣נָּה פְנֵי/הֶ֑ם בֹּ֚אוּ וְ/נִלְו֣וּ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ
verses.translit: tsyvn ysh'lv drkh hnh pnyhm b'v vnlvv 'l yhvh bryt 'vlm l' tshkhch
verses.translation: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying , Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.

verses.original: צֹ֤אן אֹֽבְדוֹת֙ היה הָי֣וּ עַמִּ֔/י רֹעֵי/הֶ֣ם הִתְע֔וּ/ם הָרִ֖ים שובבים שֽׁוֹבְב֑וּ/ם מֵ/הַ֤ר אֶל גִּבְעָה֙ הָלָ֔כוּ שָׁכְח֖וּ רִבְצָֽ/ם
verses.translit: ts'n 'bdvt hyh hyv 'my r'yhm ht'vm hrym shvbbym shvbbvm mhr 'l gb'h hlkhv shkhchv rbtsm
verses.translation: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

verses.original: כָּל מוֹצְאֵי/הֶ֣ם אֲכָל֔וּ/ם וְ/צָרֵי/הֶ֥ם אָמְר֖וּ לֹ֣א נֶאְשָׁ֑ם תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטְא֤וּ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ נְוֵה צֶ֔דֶק וּ/מִקְוֵ֥ה אֲבֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl mvts'yhm 'khlvm vtsryhm 'mrv l' n'shm tcht 'shr cht'v lyhvh nvh tsdq vmqvh 'bvtyhm yhvh
verses.translation: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD , the habitation of justice, even the LORD , the hope of their fathers.

verses.original: נֻ֚דוּ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וּ/מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים יצאו צֵ֑אוּ וִ/הְי֕וּ כְּ/עַתּוּדִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵי צֹֽאן
verses.translit: ndv mtvkh bbl vm'rts khshdym yts'v ts'v vhyv kh'tvdym lpny ts'n
verses.translation: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֡י מֵעִיר֩ וּ/מַעֲלֶ֨ה עַל בָּבֶ֜ל קְהַל גּוֹיִ֤ם גְּדֹלִים֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וְ/עָ֣רְכוּ לָ֔/הּ מִ/שָּׁ֖ם תִּלָּכֵ֑ד חִצָּי/ו֙ כְּ/גִבּ֣וֹר מַשְׁכִּ֔יל לֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב רֵיקָֽם
verses.translit: khy hnh 'nkhy m'yr vm'lh 'l bbl qhl gvym gdlym m'rts tspvn v'rkhv lh mshm tlkhd chtsyv khgbvr mshkhyl l' yshvb ryqm
verses.translation: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה כַשְׂדִּ֖ים לְ/שָׁלָ֑ל כָּל שֹׁלְלֶ֥י/הָ יִשְׂבָּ֖עוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyth khshdym lshll khl shllyh yshb'v n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֤י תשמחי תִשְׂמְחוּ֙ כִּ֣י תעלזי תַֽעֲלְז֔וּ שֹׁסֵ֖י נַחֲלָתִ֑/י כִּ֤י תפושי תָפ֨וּשׁוּ֙ כְּ/עֶגְלָ֣ה דָשָׁ֔ה ו/תצהלי וְ/תִצְהֲל֖וּ כָּ/אֲבִּרִֽים
verses.translit: khy tshmchy tshmchv khy t'lzy t'lzv shsy nchlty khy tpvshy tpvshv kh'glh dshh vttshly vttshlv kh'brym
verses.translation: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;

verses.original: בּ֤וֹשָׁה אִמְּ/כֶם֙ מְאֹ֔ד חָפְרָ֖ה יֽוֹלַדְתְּ/כֶ֑ם הִנֵּה֙ אַחֲרִ֣ית גּוֹיִ֔ם מִדְבָּ֖ר צִיָּ֥ה וַ/עֲרָבָֽה
verses.translit: bvshh 'mkhm m'd chprh yvldtkhm hnh 'chryt gvym mdbr tsyh v'rbh
verses.translation: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

verses.original: מִ/קֶּ֤צֶף יְהוָה֙ לֹ֣א תֵשֵׁ֔ב וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה שְׁמָמָ֖ה כֻּלָּ֑/הּ כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עַל בָּבֶ֔ל יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְ/יִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל כָּל מַכּוֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: mqtsf yhvh l' tshb vhyth shmmh khlh khl 'br 'l bbl yshm vyshrq 'l khl mkhvtyh
verses.translation: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

verses.original: עִרְכ֨וּ עַל בָּבֶ֤ל סָבִיב֙ כָּל דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת יְד֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י/הָ אַֽל תַּחְמְל֖וּ אֶל חֵ֑ץ כִּ֥י לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה חָטָֽאָה
verses.translit: 'rkhv 'l bbl sbyb khl drkhy qsht ydv 'lyh 'l tchmlv 'l chts khy lyhvh cht'h
verses.translation: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD .

verses.original: הָרִ֨יעוּ עָלֶ֤י/הָ סָבִיב֙ נָתְנָ֣ה יָדָ֔/הּ נָֽפְלוּ֙ אשויתי/ה אָשְׁיוֹתֶ֔י/הָ נֶהֶרְס֖וּ חֽוֹמוֹתֶ֑י/הָ כִּי֩ נִקְמַ֨ת יְהוָ֥ה הִיא֙ הִנָּ֣קְמוּ בָ֔/הּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה עֲשׂוּ לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hry'v 'lyh sbyb ntnh ydh nplv 'shvytyh 'shyvtyh nhrsv chvmvtyh khy nqmt yhvh hy' hnqmv bh kh'shr 'shth 'shv lh
verses.translation: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the LORD : take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.

verses.original: כִּרְת֤וּ זוֹרֵ֨עַ֙ מִ/בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/תֹפֵ֥שׂ מַגָּ֖ל בְּ/עֵ֣ת קָצִ֑יר מִ/פְּנֵי֙ חֶ֣רֶב הַ/יּוֹנָ֔ה אִ֤ישׁ אֶל עַמּ/וֹ֙ יִפְנ֔וּ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ לְ/אַרְצ֖/וֹ יָנֻֽסוּ
verses.translit: khrtv zvr' mbbl vtpsh mgl b't qtsyr mpny chrb hyvnh 'ysh 'l 'mv ypnv v'ysh l'rtsv ynsv
verses.translation: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.

verses.original: שֶׂ֧ה פְזוּרָ֛ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲרָי֣וֹת הִדִּ֑יחוּ הָ/רִאשׁ֤וֹן אֲכָל/וֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְ/זֶ֤ה הָ/אַחֲרוֹן֙ עִצְּמ֔/וֹ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: shh pzvrh yshr'l 'ryvt hdychv hr'shvn 'khlv mlkh 'shvr vzh h'chrvn 'tsmv nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl
verses.translation: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִ֥י פֹקֵ֛ד אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְ/אֶל אַרְצ֑/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקַ֖דְתִּי אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny pqd 'l mlkh bbl v'l 'rtsv kh'shr pqdty 'l mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

verses.original: וְ/שֹׁבַבְתִּ֤י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל נָוֵ֔/הוּ וְ/רָעָ֥ה הַ/כַּרְמֶ֖ל וְ/הַ/בָּשָׁ֑ן וּ/בְ/הַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֛יִם וְ/הַ/גִּלְעָ֖ד תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vshbbty 't yshr'l 'l nvhv vr'h hkhrml vhbshn vbhr 'prym vhgl'd tshb' npshv
verses.translation: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵם֩ וּ/בָ/עֵ֨ת הַ/הִ֜יא נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה יְבֻקַּ֞שׁ אֶת עֲוֺ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אֵינֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/אֶת חַטֹּ֥את יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א תִמָּצֶ֑אינָה כִּ֥י אֶסְלַ֖ח לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַשְׁאִֽיר
verses.translit: bymym hhm vb't hhy' n'm yhvh ybqsh 't 'vn yshr'l v'ynnv v't cht't yhvdh vl' tmts'ynh khy 'slch l'shr 'sh'yr
verses.translation: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

verses.original: עַל הָ/אָ֤רֶץ מְרָתַ֨יִם֙ עֲלֵ֣ה עָלֶ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶל יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּק֑וֹד חֲרֹ֨ב וְ/הַחֲרֵ֤ם אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶם֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וַ/עֲשֵׂ֕ה כְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l h'rts mrtym 'lh 'lyh v'l yvshby pqvd chrb vhchrm 'chryhm n'm yhvh v'shh khkhl 'shr tsvytykh
verses.translation: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD , and do according to all that I have commanded thee.

verses.original: ק֥וֹל מִלְחָמָ֖ה בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/שֶׁ֖בֶר גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: qvl mlchmh b'rts vshbr gdvl
verses.translation: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

verses.original: אֵ֤יךְ נִגְדַּע֙ וַ/יִּשָּׁבֵ֔ר פַּטִּ֖ישׁ כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֧ה לְ/שַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: 'ykh ngd' vyshbr ptysh khl h'rts 'ykh hyth lshmh bbl bgvym
verses.translation: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

verses.original: יָקֹ֨שְׁתִּי לָ֤/ךְ וְ/גַם נִלְכַּדְתְּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/אַ֖תְּ לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עַתְּ נִמְצֵאת֙ וְ/גַם נִתְפַּ֔שְׂתְּ כִּ֥י בַֽ/יהוָ֖ה הִתְגָּרִֽית
verses.translit: yqshty lkh vgm nlkhdt bbl v't l' yd't nmts't vgm ntpsht khy byhvh htgryt
verses.translation: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD .

verses.original: פָּתַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת א֣וֹצָר֔/וֹ וַ/יּוֹצֵ֖א אֶת כְּלֵ֣י זַעְמ֑/וֹ כִּי מְלָאכָ֣ה הִ֗יא לַֽ/אדֹנָ֧/י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: ptch yhvh 't 'vtsrv vyvts' 't khly z'mv khy ml'khh hy' l'dny yhvh tsb'vt b'rts khshdym
verses.translation: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

verses.original: בֹּֽאוּ לָ֤/הּ מִ/קֵּץ֙ פִּתְח֣וּ מַאֲבֻסֶ֔י/הָ סָלּ֥וּ/הָ כְמוֹ עֲרֵמִ֖ים וְ/הַחֲרִימ֑וּ/הָ אַל תְּהִי לָ֖/הּ שְׁאֵרִֽית
verses.translit: b'v lh mqts ptchv m'bsyh slvh khmv 'rmym vhchrymvh 'l thy lh sh'ryt
verses.translation: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.

verses.original: חִרְבוּ֙ כָּל פָּרֶ֔י/הָ יֵרְד֖וּ לַ/טָּ֑בַח ה֣וֹי עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּֽי בָ֥א יוֹמָ֖/ם עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: chrbv khl pryh yrdv ltbch hvy 'lyhm khy b' yvmm 't pqdtm
verses.translation: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

verses.original: ק֥וֹל נָסִ֛ים וּ/פְלֵטִ֖ים מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ בָּבֶ֑ל לְ/הַגִּ֣יד בְּ/צִיּ֗וֹן אֶת נִקְמַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: qvl nsym vpltym m'rts bbl lhgyd btsyvn 't nqmt yhvh 'lhynv nqmt hykhlv
verses.translation: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.

verses.original: הַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ אֶל בָּבֶ֣ל רַ֠בִּים כָּל דֹּ֨רְכֵי קֶ֜שֶׁת חֲנ֧וּ עָלֶ֣י/הָ סָבִ֗יב אַל יְהִי לָ/הּ֙ פְּלֵטָ֔ה שַׁלְּמוּ לָ֣/הּ כְּ/פָעֳלָ֔/הּ כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה עֲשׂוּ לָ֑/הּ כִּ֧י אֶל יְהוָ֛ה זָ֖דָה אֶל קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hshmy'v 'l bbl rbym khl drkhy qsht chnv 'lyh sbyb 'l yhy lh plth shlmv lh khp'lh khkhl 'shr 'shth 'shv lh khy 'l yhvh zdh 'l qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD , against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן יִפְּל֥וּ בַחוּרֶ֖י/הָ בִּ/רְחֹבֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/כָל אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִלְחַמְתָּ֥/הּ יִדַּ֛מּוּ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn yplv bchvryh brchbtyh vkhl 'nshy mlchmth ydmv byvm hhv' n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֤י אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ זָד֔וֹן נְאֻם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת כִּ֛י בָּ֥א יוֹמְ/ךָ֖ עֵ֥ת פְּקַדְתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hnny 'lykh zdvn n'm 'dny yhvh tsb'vt khy b' yvmkh 't pqdtykh
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.

verses.original: וְ/כָשַׁ֤ל זָדוֹן֙ וְ/נָפַ֔ל וְ/אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ מֵקִ֑ים וְ/הִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּ/עָרָ֔י/ו וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה כָּל סְבִיבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vkhshl zdvn vnpl v'yn lv mqym vhtsty 'sh b'ryv v'khlh khl sbybtyv
verses.translation: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עֲשׁוּקִ֛ים בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל וּ/בְנֵי יְהוּדָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֑ו וְ/כָל שֹֽׁבֵי/הֶם֙ הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ בָ֔/ם מֵאֲנ֖וּ שַׁלְּחָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'shvqym bny yshr'l vbny yhvdh ychdv vkhl shbyhm hchzyqv bm m'nv shlchm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.

verses.original: גֹּאֲלָ֣/ם חָזָ֗ק יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שְׁמ֔/וֹ רִ֥יב יָרִ֖יב אֶת רִיבָ֑/ם לְמַ֨עַן֙ הִרְגִּ֣יעַ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הִרְגִּ֖יז לְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: g'lm chzq yhvh tsb'vt shmv ryb yryb 't rybm lm'n hrgy' 't h'rts vhrgyz lyshby bbl
verses.translation: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

verses.original: חֶ֥רֶב עַל כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֶל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וְ/אֶל שָׂרֶ֖י/הָ וְ/אֶל חֲכָמֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: chrb 'l khshdym n'm yhvh v'l yshby bbl v'l shryh v'l chkhmyh
verses.translation: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD , and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men .

verses.original: חֶ֥רֶב אֶל הַ/בַּדִּ֖ים וְ/נֹאָ֑לוּ חֶ֥רֶב אֶל גִּבּוֹרֶ֖י/הָ וָ/חָֽתּוּ
verses.translit: chrb 'l hbdym vn'lv chrb 'l gbvryh vchtv
verses.translation: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

verses.original: חֶ֜רֶב אֶל סוּסָ֣י/ו וְ/אֶל רִכְבּ֗/וֹ וְ/אֶל כָּל הָ/עֶ֛רֶב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/תוֹכָ֖/הּ וְ/הָי֣וּ לְ/נָשִׁ֑ים חֶ֥רֶב אֶל אוֹצְרֹתֶ֖י/הָ וּ/בֻזָּֽזוּ
verses.translit: chrb 'l svsyv v'l rkhbv v'l khl h'rb 'shr btvkhh vhyv lnshym chrb 'l 'vtsrtyh vbzzv
verses.translation: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.

verses.original: חֹ֥רֶב אֶל מֵימֶ֖י/הָ וְ/יָבֵ֑שׁוּ כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ פְּסִלִים֙ הִ֔יא וּ/בָ/אֵימִ֖ים יִתְהֹלָֽלוּ
verses.translit: chrb 'l mymyh vybshv khy 'rts pslym hy' vb'ymym ythllv
verses.translation: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן יֵשְׁב֤וּ צִיִּים֙ אֶת אִיִּ֔ים וְ/יָ֥שְׁבוּ בָ֖/הּ בְּנ֣וֹת יַֽעֲנָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא תֵשֵׁ֥ב עוֹד֙ לָ/נֶ֔צַח וְ/לֹ֥א תִשְׁכּ֖וֹן עַד דּ֥וֹר וָ/דֽוֹר
verses.translit: lkhn yshbv tsyym 't 'yym vyshbv bh bnvt y'nh vl' tshb 'vd lntsch vl' tshkhvn 'd dvr vdvr
verses.translation: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there , and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

verses.original: כְּ/מַהְפֵּכַ֨ת אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת סְדֹ֧ם וְ/אֶת עֲמֹרָ֛ה וְ/אֶת שְׁכֵנֶ֖י/הָ נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא יֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְ/לֹֽא יָג֥וּר בָּ֖/הּ בֶּן אָדָֽם
verses.translit: khmhpkht 'lhym 't sdm v't 'mrh v't shkhnyh n'm yhvh l' yshb shm 'ysh vl' ygvr bh bn 'dm
verses.translation: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD ; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה עַ֥ם בָּ֖א מִ/צָּפ֑וֹן וְ/ג֤וֹי גָּדוֹל֙ וּ/מְלָכִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים יֵעֹ֖רוּ מִ/יַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hnh 'm b' mtspvn vgvy gdvl vmlkhym rbym y'rv myrkhty 'rts
verses.translation: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

verses.original: קֶ֣שֶׁת וְ/כִידֹ֞ן יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ אַכְזָרִ֥י הֵ֨מָּה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ קוֹלָ/ם֙ כַּ/יָּ֣ם יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְ/עַל סוּסִ֖ים יִרְכָּ֑בוּ עָר֗וּךְ כְּ/אִישׁ֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ בַּת בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: qsht vkhydn ychzyqv 'khzry hmh vl' yrchmv qvlm khym yhmh v'l svsym yrkhbv 'rvkh kh'ysh lmlchmh 'lykh bt bbl
verses.translation: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֧ע מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת שִׁמְעָ֖/ם וְ/רָפ֣וּ יָדָ֑י/ו צָרָה֙ הֶחֱזִיקַ֔תְ/הוּ חִ֖יל כַּ/יּוֹלֵדָֽה
verses.translit: shm' mlkh bbl 't shm'm vrpv ydyv tsrh hchzyqthv chyl khyvldh
verses.translation: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.

verses.original: הִ֠נֵּה כְּ/אַרְיֵ֞ה יַעֲלֶ֨ה מִ/גְּא֣וֹן הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֮ אֶל נְוֵ֣ה אֵיתָן֒ כִּֽי אַרְגִּ֤עָה ארוצ/ם אֲרִיצֵ/ם֙ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/הָ וּ/מִ֥י בָח֖וּר אֵלֶ֣י/הָ אֶפְקֹ֑ד כִּ֣י מִ֤י כָמ֨וֹ/נִי֙ וּ/מִ֣י יוֹעִדֶ֔/נִּי וּ/מִֽי זֶ֣ה רֹעֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲמֹ֖ד לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: hnh kh'ryh y'lh mg'vn hyrdn 'l nvh 'ytn khy 'rg'h 'rvtsm 'rytsm m'lyh vmy bchvr 'lyh 'pqd khy my khmvny vmy yv'dny vmy zh r'h 'shr y'md lpny
verses.translation: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן שִׁמְע֣וּ עֲצַת יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָעַץ֙ אֶל בָּבֶ֔ל וּ/מַ֨חְשְׁבוֹתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָשַׁ֖ב אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים אִם לֹ֤א יִסְחָבוּ/ם֙ צְעִירֵ֣י הַ/צֹּ֔אן אִם לֹ֥א יַשִּׁ֛ים עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם נָוֶֽה
verses.translit: lkhn shm'v 'tst yhvh 'shr y'ts 'l bbl vmchshbvtyv 'shr chshb 'l 'rts khshdym 'm l' yschbvm ts'yry hts'n 'm l' yshym 'lyhm nvh
verses.translation: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD , that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.

verses.original: מִ/קּוֹל֙ נִתְפְּשָׂ֣ה בָבֶ֔ל נִרְעֲשָׁ֖ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וּ/זְעָקָ֖ה בַּ/גּוֹיִ֥ם נִשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: mqvl ntpshh bbl nr'shh h'rts vz'qh bgvym nshm'
verses.translation: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִי֙ מֵעִ֣יר עַל בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/אֶל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י לֵ֣ב קָמָ֑י ר֖וּחַ מַשְׁחִֽית
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnny m'yr 'l bbl v'l yshby lb qmy rvch mshchyt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּ֨י לְ/בָבֶ֤ל זָרִים֙ וְ/זֵר֔וּ/הָ וִ/יבֹקְק֖וּ אֶת אַרְצָ֑/הּ כִּֽי הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֛י/הָ מִ/סָּבִ֖יב בְּ/י֥וֹם רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vshlchty lbbl zrym vzrvh vybqqv 't 'rtsh khy hyv 'lyh msbyb byvm r'h
verses.translation: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

verses.original: אֶֽל יִדְרֹ֤ךְ ידרך הַ/דֹּרֵךְ֙ קַשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֶל יִתְעַ֖ל בְּ/סִרְיֹנ֑/וֹ וְ/אַֽל תַּחְמְלוּ֙ אֶל בַּ֣חֻרֶ֔י/הָ הַחֲרִ֖ימוּ כָּל צְבָאָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'l ydrkh ydrkh hdrkh qshtv v'l yt'l bsrynv v'l tchmlv 'l bchryh hchrymv khl tsb'h
verses.translation: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.

verses.original: וְ/נָפְל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וּ/מְדֻקָּרִ֖ים בְּ/חוּצוֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vnplv chllym b'rts khshdym vmdqrym bchvtsvtyh
verses.translation: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא אַלְמָ֨ן יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ מֵֽ/אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו מֵֽ/יְהוָ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת כִּ֤י אַרְצָ/ם֙ מָלְאָ֣ה אָשָׁ֔ם מִ/קְּד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy l' 'lmn yshr'l vyhvdh m'lhyv myhvh tsb'vt khy 'rtsm ml'h 'shm mqdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: נֻ֣סוּ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֗ל וּ/מַלְּטוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ אַל תִּדַּ֖מּוּ בַּ/עֲוֺנָ֑/הּ כִּי֩ עֵ֨ת נְקָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה גְּמ֕וּל ה֥וּא מְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: nsv mtvkh bbl vmltv 'ysh npshv 'l tdmv b'vnh khy 't nqmh hy' lyhvh gmvl hv' mshlm lh
verses.translation: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD’s vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.

verses.original: כּוֹס זָהָ֤ב בָּבֶל֙ בְּ/יַד יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁכֶּ֖רֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ מִ/יֵּינָ/הּ֙ שָׁת֣וּ גוֹיִ֔ם עַל כֵּ֖ן יִתְהֹלְל֥וּ גוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: khvs zhb bbl byd yhvh mshkhrt khl h'rts myynh shtv gvym 'l khn ythllv gvym
verses.translation: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD’s hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

verses.original: פִּתְאֹ֛ם נָפְלָ֥ה בָבֶ֖ל וַ/תִּשָּׁבֵ֑ר הֵילִ֣ילוּ עָלֶ֗י/הָ קְח֤וּ צֳרִי֙ לְ/מַכְאוֹבָ֔/הּ אוּלַ֖י תֵּרָפֵֽא
verses.translit: pt'm nplh bbl vtshbr hylylv 'lyh qchv tsry lmkh'vbh 'vly trp'
verses.translation: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.

verses.original: רפאנו רִפִּ֣ינוּ אֶת בָּבֶל֙ וְ/לֹ֣א נִרְפָּ֔תָה עִזְב֕וּ/הָ וְ/נֵלֵ֖ךְ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/אַרְצ֑/וֹ כִּֽי נָגַ֤ע אֶל הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִשְׁפָּטָ֔/הּ וְ/נִשָּׂ֖א עַד שְׁחָקִֽים
verses.translit: rp'nv rpynv 't bbl vl' nrpth 'zbvh vnlkh 'ysh l'rtsv khy ng' 'l hshmym mshpth vnsh' 'd shchqym
verses.translation: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

verses.original: הוֹצִ֥יא יְהוָ֖ה אֶת צִדְקֹתֵ֑י/נוּ בֹּ֚אוּ וּ/נְסַפְּרָ֣ה בְ/צִיּ֔וֹן אֶֽת מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: hvtsy' yhvh 't tsdqtynv b'v vnsprh btsyvn 't m'shh yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.

verses.original: הָבֵ֣רוּ הַ/חִצִּים֮ מִלְא֣וּ הַ/שְּׁלָטִים֒ הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת ר֨וּחַ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י כִּֽי עַל בָּבֶ֥ל מְזִמָּת֖/וֹ לְ/הַשְׁחִיתָ֑/הּ כִּֽי נִקְמַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ הִ֔יא נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hbrv hchtsym ml'v hshltym h'yr yhvh 't rvch mlkhy mdy khy 'l bbl mzmtv lhshchyth khy nqmt yhvh hy' nqmt hykhlv
verses.translation: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD , the vengeance of his temple.

verses.original: אֶל חוֹמֹ֨ת בָּבֶ֜ל שְׂאוּ נֵ֗ס הַחֲזִ֨יקוּ֙ הַ/מִּשְׁמָ֔ר הָקִ֨ימוּ֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים הָכִ֖ינוּ הָ/אֹֽרְבִ֑ים כִּ֚י גַּם זָמַ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה גַּם עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: 'l chvmt bbl sh'v ns hchzyqv hmshmr hqymv shmrym hkhynv h'rbym khy gm zmm yhvh gm 'shh 't 'shr dbr 'l yshby bbl
verses.translation: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.

verses.original: שכנתי שֹׁכַנְתְּ֙ עַל מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים רַבַּ֖ת אֽוֹצָרֹ֑ת בָּ֥א קִצֵּ֖/ךְ אַמַּ֥ת בִּצְעֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: shkhnty shkhnt 'l mym rbym rbt 'vtsrt b' qtskh 'mt bts'kh
verses.translation: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּ/נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ כִּ֣י אִם מִלֵּאתִ֤י/ךְ אָדָם֙ כַּ/יֶּ֔לֶק וְ/עָנ֥וּ עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ הֵידָֽד
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh tsb'vt bnpshv khy 'm ml'tykh 'dm khylq v'nv 'lykh hydd
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying , Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּ/כֹח֔/וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּ/חָכְמָת֑/וֹ וּ/בִ/תְבוּנָת֖/וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'shh 'rts bkhchv mkhyn tbl bchkhmtv vbtbvntv nth shmym
verses.translation: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.

verses.original: לְ/ק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜/וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֨יִם֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יַּ֥עַל נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִ/קְצֵה אָ֑רֶץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַ/מָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֥צֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵ/אֹצְרֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: lqvl ttv hmvn mym bshmym vy'l nsh'ym mqtsh 'rts brqym lmtr 'shh vyts' rvch m'tsrtyv
verses.translation: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

verses.original: נִבְעַ֤ר כָּל אָדָם֙ מִ/דַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כָּל צֹרֵ֖ף מִ/פָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹא ר֥וּחַ בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: nb'r khl 'dm md't hbysh khl tsrf mpsl khy shqr nskhv vl' rvch bm
verses.translation: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

verses.original: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּ/עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖/ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ
verses.translit: hbl hmh m'shh t't'ym b't pqdtm y'bdv
verses.translation: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

verses.original: לֹֽא כְ/אֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲק֗וֹב כִּֽי יוֹצֵ֤ר הַ/כֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְ/שֵׁ֖בֶט נַחֲלָת֑/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' kh'lh chlq y'qvb khy yvtsr hkhl hv' vshbt nchltv yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.

verses.original: מַפֵּץ אַתָּ֣ה לִ֔/י כְּלֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ/נִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְ/ךָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/הִשְׁחַתִּ֥י בְ/ךָ֖ מַמְלָכֽוֹת
verses.translit: mpts 'th ly khly mlchmh vnptsty bkh gvym vhshchty bkh mmlkhvt
verses.translation: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;

verses.original: וְ/נִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְ/ךָ֔ ס֖וּס וְ/רֹֽכְב֑/וֹ וְ/נִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְ/ךָ֔ רֶ֖כֶב וְ/רֹכְבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vnptsty bkh svs vrkhbv vnptsty bkh rkhb vrkhbv
verses.translation: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;

verses.original: וְ/נִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְ/ךָ֙ אִ֣ישׁ וְ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וְ/נִפַּצְתִּ֥י בְ/ךָ֖ זָקֵ֣ן וָ/נָ֑עַר וְ/נִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְ/ךָ֔ בָּח֖וּר וּ/בְתוּלָֽה
verses.translit: vnptsty bkh 'ysh v'shh vnptsty bkh zqn vn'r vnptsty bkh bchvr vbtvlh
verses.translation: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

verses.original: וְ/נִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְ/ךָ֙ רֹעֶ֣ה וְ/עֶדְר֔/וֹ וְ/נִפַּצְתִּ֥י בְ/ךָ֖ אִכָּ֣ר וְ/צִמְדּ֑/וֹ וְ/נִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְ/ךָ֔ פַּח֖וֹת וּ/סְגָנִֽים
verses.translit: vnptsty bkh r'h v'drv vnptsty bkh 'khr vtsmdv vnptsty bkh pchvt vsgnym
verses.translation: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּמְתִּ֨י לְ/בָבֶ֜ל וּ/לְ/כֹ֣ל יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֗ים אֵ֧ת כָּל רָעָתָ֛/ם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֥וּ בְ/צִיּ֖וֹן לְ/עֵֽינֵי/כֶ֑ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshlmty lbbl vlkhl yvshby khshdym 't khl r'tm 'shr 'shv btsyvn l'ynykhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י אֵלֶ֜י/ךָ הַ֤ר הַ/מַּשְׁחִית֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה הַ/מַּשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/נָטִ֨יתִי אֶת יָדִ֜/י עָלֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/גִלְגַּלְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ מִן הַ/סְּלָעִ֔ים וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לְ/הַ֥ר שְׂרֵפָֽה
verses.translit: hnny 'lykh hr hmshchyt n'm yhvh hmshchyt 't khl h'rts vntyty 't ydy 'lykh vglgltykh mn hsl'ym vnttykh lhr shrph
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD , which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יִקְח֤וּ מִמְּ/ךָ֙ אֶ֣בֶן לְ/פִנָּ֔ה וְ/אֶ֖בֶן לְ/מֽוֹסָד֑וֹת כִּֽי שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֛ם תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vl' yqchv mmkh 'bn lpnh v'bn lmvsdvt khy shmmvt 'vlm thyh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD .

verses.original: שְׂאוּ נֵ֣ס בָּ/אָ֗רֶץ תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֤ר בַּ/גּוֹיִם֙ קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם הַשְׁמִ֧יעוּ עָלֶ֛י/הָ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת אֲרָרַ֖ט מִנִּ֣י וְ/אַשְׁכְּנָ֑ז פִּקְד֤וּ עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ טִפְסָ֔ר הַֽעֲלוּ ס֖וּס כְּ/יֶ֥לֶק סָמָֽר
verses.translit: sh'v ns b'rts tq'v shvpr bgvym qdshv 'lyh gvym hshmy'v 'lyh mmlkhvt 'rrt mny v'shkhnz pqdv 'lyh tpsr h'lv svs khylq smr
verses.translation: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.

verses.original: קַדְּשׁ֨וּ עָלֶ֤י/הָ גוֹיִם֙ אֶת מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י אֶת פַּחוֹתֶ֖י/הָ וְ/אֶת כָּל סְגָנֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: qdshv 'lyh gvym 't mlkhy mdy 't pchvtyh v't khl sgnyh v't khl 'rts mmshltv
verses.translation: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.

verses.original: וַ/תִּרְעַ֥שׁ הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וַ/תָּחֹ֑ל כִּ֣י קָ֤מָה עַל בָּבֶל֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה לָ/שׂ֞וּם אֶת אֶ֧רֶץ בָּבֶ֛ל לְ/שַׁמָּ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: vtr'sh h'rts vtchl khy qmh 'l bbl mchshbvt yhvh lshvm 't 'rts bbl lshmh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.

verses.original: חָדְלוּ֩ גִבּוֹרֵ֨י בָבֶ֜ל לְ/הִלָּחֵ֗ם יָֽשְׁבוּ֙ בַּ/מְּצָד֔וֹת נָשְׁתָ֥ה גְבוּרָתָ֖/ם הָי֣וּ לְ/נָשִׁ֑ים הִצִּ֥יתוּ מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶ֖י/הָ נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ בְרִיחֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: chdlv gbvry bbl lhlchm yshbv bmtsdvt nshth gbvrtm hyv lnshym htsytv mshkhntyh nshbrv brychyh
verses.translation: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.

verses.original: רָ֤ץ לִ/קְרַאת רָץ֙ יָר֔וּץ וּ/מַגִּ֖יד לִ/קְרַ֣את מַגִּ֑יד לְ/הַגִּיד֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּֽי נִלְכְּדָ֥ה עִיר֖/וֹ מִ/קָּצֶֽה
verses.translit: rts lqr't rts yrvts vmgyd lqr't mgyd lhgyd lmlkh bbl khy nlkhdh 'yrv mqtsh
verses.translation: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מַּעְבָּר֣וֹת נִתְפָּ֔שׂוּ וְ/אֶת הָ/אֲגַמִּ֖ים שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָ/אֵ֑שׁ וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה נִבְהָֽלוּ
verses.translit: vhm'brvt ntpshv v't h'gmym shrpv b'sh v'nshy hmlchmh nbhlv
verses.translation: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּת בָּבֶ֕ל כְּ/גֹ֖רֶן עֵ֣ת הִדְרִיכָ֑/הּ ע֣וֹד מְעַ֔ט וּ/בָ֥אָה עֵֽת הַ/קָּצִ֖יר לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l bt bbl khgrn 't hdrykhh 'vd m't vb'h 't hqtsyr lh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

verses.original: אכל/נו אֲכָלַ֣/נִי הממ/נו הֲמָמַ֗/נִי נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֮ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶל֒ הציג/נו הִצִּיגַ֨/נִי֙ כְּלִ֣י רִ֔יק בלע/נו בְּלָעַ֨/נִי֙ כַּ/תַּנִּ֔ין מִלָּ֥א כְרֵשׂ֖/וֹ מֵֽ/עֲדָנָ֑/י הדיח/נו הֱדִיחָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'khlnv 'khlny hmmnv hmmny nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl htsygnv htsygny khly ryq bl'nv bl'ny khtnyn ml' khrshv m'dny hdychnv hdychny
verses.translation: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.

verses.original: חֲמָסִ֤/י וּ/שְׁאֵרִ/י֙ עַל בָּבֶ֔ל תֹּאמַ֖ר יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן וְ/דָמִ/י֙ אֶל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֔ים תֹּאמַ֖ר יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: chmsy vsh'ry 'l bbl t'mr yshbt tsyvn vdmy 'l yshby khshdym t'mr yrvshlm
verses.translation: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִי רָב֙ אֶת רִיבֵ֔/ךְ וְ/נִקַּמְתִּ֖י אֶת נִקְמָתֵ֑/ךְ וְ/הַחֲרַבְתִּי֙ אֶת יַמָּ֔/הּ וְ/הֹבַשְׁתִּ֖י אֶת מְקוֹרָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny rb 't rybkh vnqmty 't nqmtkh vhchrbty 't ymh vhbshty 't mqvrh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָה֩ בָבֶ֨ל לְ/גַלִּ֧ים מְעוֹן תַּנִּ֛ים שַׁמָּ֥ה וּ/שְׁרֵקָ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: vhyth bbl lglym m'vn tnym shmh vshrqh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.

verses.original: יַחְדָּ֖ו כַּ/כְּפִרִ֣ים יִשְׁאָ֑גוּ נָעֲר֖וּ כְּ/גוֹרֵ֥י אֲרָיֽוֹת
verses.translit: ychdv khkhprym ysh'gv n'rv khgvry 'ryvt
verses.translation: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.

verses.original: בְּ/חֻמָּ֞/ם אָשִׁ֣ית אֶת מִשְׁתֵּי/הֶ֗ם וְ/הִשְׁכַּרְתִּי/ם֙ לְמַ֣עַן יַעֲלֹ֔זוּ וְ/יָשְׁנ֥וּ שְׁנַת עוֹלָ֖ם וְ/לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bchmm 'shyt 't mshtyhm vhshkhrtym lm'n y'lzv vyshnv shnt 'vlm vl' yqytsv n'm yhvh
verses.translation: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD .

verses.original: אֽוֹרִידֵ֖/ם כְּ/כָרִ֣ים לִ/טְב֑וֹחַ כְּ/אֵילִ֖ים עִם עַתּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: 'vrydm khkhrym ltbvch kh'ylym 'm 'tvdym
verses.translation: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ נִלְכְּדָ֣ה שֵׁשַׁ֔ךְ וַ/תִּתָּפֵ֖שׂ תְּהִלַּ֣ת כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֧ה לְ/שַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: 'ykh nlkhdh shshkh vttpsh thlt khl h'rts 'ykh hyth lshmh bbl bgvym
verses.translation: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!

verses.original: עָלָ֥ה עַל בָּבֶ֖ל הַ/יָּ֑ם בַּ/הֲמ֥וֹן גַּלָּ֖י/ו נִכְסָֽתָה
verses.translit: 'lh 'l bbl hym bhmvn glyv nkhsth
verses.translation: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.

verses.original: הָי֤וּ עָרֶ֨י/הָ֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה אֶ֖רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וַ/עֲרָבָ֑ה אֶ֗רֶץ לֹֽא יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּ/הֵן֙ כָּל אִ֔ישׁ וְ/לֹֽא יַעֲבֹ֥ר בָּ/הֵ֖ן בֶּן אָדָֽם
verses.translit: hyv 'ryh lshmh 'rts tsyh v'rbh 'rts l' yshb bhn khl 'ysh vl' y'br bhn bn 'dm
verses.translation: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.

verses.original: וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֨י עַל בֵּ֜ל בְּ/בָבֶ֗ל וְ/הֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶת בִּלְע/וֹ֙ מִ/פִּ֔י/ו וְ/לֹֽא יִנְהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֛י/ו ע֖וֹד גּוֹיִ֑ם גַּם חוֹמַ֥ת בָּבֶ֖ל נָפָֽלָה
verses.translit: vpqdty 'l bl bbbl vhts'ty 't bl'v mpyv vl' ynhrv 'lyv 'vd gvym gm chvmt bbl nplh
verses.translation: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

verses.original: צְא֤וּ מִ/תּוֹכָ/הּ֙ עַמִּ֔/י וּ/מַלְּט֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ מֵ/חֲר֖וֹן אַף יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: ts'v mtvkhh 'my vmltv 'ysh 't npshv mchrvn 'f yhvh
verses.translation: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/פֶן יֵרַ֤ךְ לְבַבְ/כֶם֙ וְ/תִֽירְא֔וּ בַּ/שְּׁמוּעָ֖ה הַ/נִּשְׁמַ֣עַת בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וּ/בָ֧א בַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁמוּעָ֗ה וְ/אַחֲרָ֤י/ו בַּ/שָּׁנָה֙ הַ/שְּׁמוּעָ֔ה וְ/חָמָ֣ס בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/מֹשֵׁ֖ל עַל מֹשֵֽׁל
verses.translit: vpn yrkh lbbkhm vtyr'v bshmv'h hnshm't b'rts vb' bshnh hshmv'h v'chryv bshnh hshmv'h vchms b'rts vmshl 'l mshl
verses.translation: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֔ים וּ/פָקַדְתִּי֙ עַל פְּסִילֵ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וְ/כָל אַרְצָ֖/הּ תֵּב֑וֹשׁ וְ/כָל חֲלָלֶ֖י/הָ יִפְּל֥וּ בְ/תוֹכָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym vpqdty 'l psyly bbl vkhl 'rtsh tbvsh vkhl chllyh yplv btvkhh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

verses.original: וְ/רִנְּנ֤וּ עַל בָּבֶל֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ/הֶ֑ם כִּ֧י מִ/צָּפ֛וֹן יָבוֹא לָ֥/הּ הַ/שּׁוֹדְדִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vrnnv 'l bbl shmym v'rts vkhl 'shr bhm khy mtspvn ybv' lh hshvddym n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD .

verses.original: גַּם בָּבֶ֕ל לִ/נְפֹּ֖ל חַֽלְלֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גַּם לְ/בָבֶ֥ל נָפְל֖וּ חַֽלְלֵ֥י כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: gm bbl lnpl chlly yshr'l gm lbbl nplv chlly khl h'rts
verses.translation: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

verses.original: פְּלֵטִ֣ים מֵ/חֶ֔רֶב הִלְכ֖וּ אַֽל תַּעֲמֹ֑דוּ זִכְר֤וּ מֵֽ/רָחוֹק֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תַּעֲלֶ֥ה עַל לְבַבְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: pltym mchrb hlkhv 'l t'mdv zkhrv mrchvq 't yhvh vyrvshlm t'lh 'l lbbkhm
verses.translation: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

verses.original: בֹּ֚שְׁנוּ כִּֽי שָׁמַ֣עְנוּ חֶרְפָּ֔ה כִּסְּתָ֥ה כְלִמָּ֖ה פָּנֵ֑י/נוּ כִּ֚י בָּ֣אוּ זָרִ֔ים עַֽל מִקְדְּשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bshnv khy shm'nv chrph khsth khlmh pnynv khy b'v zrym 'l mqdshy byt yhvh
verses.translation: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’s house.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֖י עַל פְּסִילֶ֑י/הָ וּ/בְ/כָל אַרְצָ֖/הּ יֶאֱנֹ֥ק חָלָֽל
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vpqdty 'l psylyh vbkhl 'rtsh y'nq chll
verses.translation: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

verses.original: כִּֽי תַעֲלֶ֤ה בָבֶל֙ הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/כִ֥י תְבַצֵּ֖ר מְר֣וֹם עֻזָּ֑/הּ מֵ/אִתִּ֗/י יָבֹ֧אוּ שֹׁדְדִ֛ים לָ֖/הּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy t'lh bbl hshmym vkhy tbtsr mrvm 'zh m'ty yb'v shddym lh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD .

verses.original: ק֥וֹל זְעָקָ֖ה מִ/בָּבֶ֑ל וְ/שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: qvl z'qh mbbl vshbr gdvl m'rts khshdym
verses.translation: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:

verses.original: כִּֽי שֹׁדֵ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/אִבַּ֥ד מִמֶּ֖/נָּה ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל וְ/הָמ֤וּ גַלֵּי/הֶם֙ כְּ/מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים נִתַּ֥ן שְׁא֖וֹן קוֹלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy shdd yhvh 't bbl v'bd mmnh qvl gdvl vhmv glyhm khmym rbym ntn sh'vn qvlm
verses.translation: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:

verses.original: כִּי֩ בָ֨א עָלֶ֤י/הָ עַל בָּבֶל֙ שׁוֹדֵ֔ד וְ/נִלְכְּדוּ֙ גִּבּוֹרֶ֔י/הָ חִתְּתָ֖ה קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֑/ם כִּ֣י אֵ֧ל גְּמֻל֛וֹת יְהוָ֖ה שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: khy b' 'lyh 'l bbl shvdd vnlkhdv gbvryh chtth qshtvtm khy 'l gmlvt yhvh shlm yshlm
verses.translation: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.

verses.original: וְ֠/הִשְׁכַּרְתִּי שָׂרֶ֨י/הָ וַ/חֲכָמֶ֜י/הָ פַּחוֹתֶ֤י/הָ וּ/סְגָנֶ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/גִבּוֹרֶ֔י/הָ וְ/יָשְׁנ֥וּ שְׁנַת עוֹלָ֖ם וְ/לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ נְאֻ֨ם הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhshkhrty shryh vchkhmyh pchvtyh vsgnyh vgbvryh vyshnv shnt 'vlm vl' yqytsv n'm hmlkh yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men , her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת חֹ֠מוֹת בָּבֶ֤ל הָֽ/רְחָבָה֙ עַרְעֵ֣ר תִּתְעַרְעָ֔ר וּ/שְׁעָרֶ֥י/הָ הַ/גְּבֹהִ֖ים בָּ/אֵ֣שׁ יִצַּ֑תּוּ וְ/יִֽגְע֨וּ עַמִּ֧ים בְּ/דֵי רִ֛יק וּ/לְאֻמִּ֥ים בְּ/דֵי אֵ֖שׁ וְ/יָעֵֽפוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt chmvt bbl hrchbh 'r'r tt'r'r vsh'ryh hgbhym b'sh ytstv vyg'v 'mym bdy ryq vl'mym bdy 'sh vy'pv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֗יא אֶת שְׂרָיָ֣ה בֶן נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן מַחְסֵיָה֒ בְּ/לֶכְתּ֞/וֹ אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּ/שְׁנַ֥ת הָ/רְבִעִ֖ית לְ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וּ/שְׂרָיָ֖ה שַׂ֥ר מְנוּחָֽה
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr tsvh yrmyhv hnby' 't shryh bn nryh bn mchsyh blkhtv 't tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh bbl bshnt hrb'yt lmlkhv vshryh shr mnvchh
verses.translation: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֣ב יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֧ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר תָּב֥וֹא אֶל בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל סֵ֣פֶר אֶחָ֑ד אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה הַ/כְּתֻבִ֖ים אֶל בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: vykhtb yrmyhv 't khl hr'h 'shr tbv' 'l bbl 'l spr 'chd 't khl hdbrym h'lh hkhtbym 'l bbl
verses.translation: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֶל שְׂרָיָ֑ה כְּ/בֹאֲ/ךָ֣ בָבֶ֔ל וְֽ/רָאִ֔יתָ וְֽ/קָרָ֔אתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'l shryh khb'kh bbl vr'yt vqr't 't khl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ יְהוָה֙ אַתָּ֨ה דִבַּ֜רְתָּ אֶל הַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ לְ/הַכְרִית֔/וֹ לְ/בִלְתִּ֤י הֱיֽוֹת בּ/וֹ֙ יוֹשֵׁ֔ב לְ/מֵ/אָדָ֖ם וְ/עַד בְּהֵמָ֑ה כִּֽי שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: v'mrt yhvh 'th dbrt 'l hmqvm hzh lhkhrytv lblty hyvt bv yvshb lm'dm v'd bhmh khy shmmvt 'vlm thyh
verses.translation: Then shalt thou say, O LORD , thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ כְּ/כַלֹּ֣תְ/ךָ֔ לִ/קְרֹ֖א אֶת הַ/סֵּ֣פֶר הַ/זֶּ֑ה תִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָי/ו֙ אֶ֔בֶן וְ/הִשְׁלַכְתּ֖/וֹ אֶל תּ֥וֹךְ פְּרָֽת
verses.translit: vhyh khkhltkh lqr' 't hspr hzh tqshr 'lyv 'bn vhshlkhtv 'l tvkh prt
verses.translation: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ כָּ֠כָה תִּשְׁקַ֨ע בָּבֶ֤ל וְ/לֹֽא תָקוּם֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הָ/רָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא עָלֶ֖י/הָ וְ/יָעֵ֑פוּ עַד הֵ֖נָּה דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: v'mrt khkhh tshq' bbl vl' tqvm mpny hr'h 'shr 'nkhy mby' 'lyh vy'pv 'd hnh dbry yrmyhv
verses.translation: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/אַחַ֤ת שָׁנָה֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/אַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ חמיטל חֲמוּטַ֥ל בַּֽת יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִ/לִּבְנָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'shrym v'cht shnh tsdqyhv bmlkhv v'cht 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv chmytl chmvtl bt yrmyhv mlbnh
verses.translation: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוֹיָקִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shh yhvyqym
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD , according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַל אַ֣ף יְהוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם וִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה עַד הִשְׁלִיכ֥/וֹ אוֹתָ֖/ם מֵ/עַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְרֹ֥ד צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּ/מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: khy 'l 'f yhvh hyth byrvshlm vyhvdh 'd hshlykhv 'vtm m'l pnyv vymrd tsdqyhv bmlkh bbl
verses.translation: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ בַ/שָּׁנָ֨ה הַ/תְּשִׁעִ֜ית לְ/מָלְכ֗/וֹ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/עֲשִׂירִי֮ בֶּ/עָשׂ֣וֹר לַ/חֹדֶשׁ֒ בָּ֠א נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֨ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל ה֤וּא וְ/כָל חֵיל/וֹ֙ עַל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ עָלֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יִּבְנ֥וּ עָלֶ֛י/הָ דָּיֵ֖ק סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh htsh'yt lmlkhv bchdsh h'shyry b'shvr lchdsh b' nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl hv' vkhl chylv 'l yrvshlm vychnv 'lyh vybnv 'lyh dyq sbyb
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֥א הָ/עִ֖יר בַּ/מָּצ֑וֹר עַ֚ד עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vtb' h'yr bmtsvr 'd 'shty 'shrh shnh lmlkh tsdqyhv
verses.translation: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

verses.original: בַּ/חֹ֤דֶשׁ הָֽ/רְבִיעִי֙ בְּ/תִשְׁעָ֣ה לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָ/רָעָ֖ב בָּ/עִ֑יר וְ/לֹא הָיָ֥ה לֶ֖חֶם לְ/עַ֥ם הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: bchdsh hrby'y btsh'h lchdsh vychzq hr'b b'yr vl' hyh lchm l'm h'rts
verses.translation: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

verses.original: וַ/תִּבָּקַ֣ע הָ/עִ֗יר וְ/כָל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֡ה יִבְרְחוּ֩ וַ/יֵּצְא֨וּ מֵ/הָ/עִ֜יר לַ֗יְלָה דֶּ֜רֶךְ שַׁ֤עַר בֵּין הַ/חֹמֹתַ֨יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל גַּ֣ן הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/כַשְׂדִּ֥ים עַל הָ/עִ֖יר סָבִ֑יב וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הָ/עֲרָבָֽה
verses.translit: vtbq' h'yr vkhl 'nshy hmlchmh ybrchv vyts'v mh'yr lylh drkh sh'r byn hchmtym 'shr 'l gn hmlkh vkhshdym 'l h'yr sbyb vylkhv drkh h'rbh
verses.translation: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדְּפ֤וּ חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יַּשִּׂ֥יגוּ אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֣ת יְרֵח֑וֹ וְ/כָל חֵיל֔/וֹ נָפֹ֖צוּ מֵ/עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyrdpv chyl khshdym 'chry hmlkh vyshygv 't tsdqyhv b'rbt yrchv vkhl chylv nptsv m'lyv
verses.translation: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְפְּשׂוּ֙ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יַּעֲל֨וּ אֹת֜/וֹ אֶל מֶ֧לֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל רִבְלָ֖תָ/ה בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ מִשְׁפָּטִֽים
verses.translit: vytpshv 't hmlkh vy'lv 'tv 'l mlkh bbl rblth b'rts chmt vydbr 'tv mshptym
verses.translation: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁחַ֧ט מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת בְּנֵ֥י צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ לְ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וְ/גַ֛ם אֶת כָּל שָׂרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה שָׁחַ֥ט בְּ/רִבְלָֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshcht mlkh bbl 't bny tsdqyhv l'ynyv vgm 't khl shry yhvdh shcht brblth
verses.translation: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עֵינֵ֥י צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ עִוֵּ֑ר וַ/יַּאַסְרֵ֣/הוּ בַֽ/נְחֻשְׁתַּ֗יִם וַ/יְבִאֵ֤/הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ בָּבֶ֔לָ/ה וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֥/הוּ ב/בית בֵֽית הַ/פְּקֻדֹּ֖ת עַד י֥וֹם מוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't 'yny tsdqyhv 'vr vy'srhv bnchshtym vyb'hv mlkh bbl bblh vytnhv bbyt byt hpqdt 'd yvm mvtv
verses.translation: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֹ֤דֶשׁ הַֽ/חֲמִישִׁי֙ בֶּ/עָשׂ֣וֹר לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ הִ֗יא שְׁנַת֙ תְּשַֽׁע עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל בָּ֗א נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָן֙ רַב טַבָּחִ֔ים עָמַ֛ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vbchdsh hchmyshy b'shvr lchdsh hy' shnt tsh' 'shrh shnh lmlkh nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl b' nbvzr'dn rb tbchym 'md lpny mlkh bbl byrvshlm
verses.translation: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֶת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל בָּתֵּ֧י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְ/אֶת כָּל בֵּ֥ית הַ/גָּד֖וֹל שָׂרַ֥ף בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyshrf 't byt yhvh v't byt hmlkh v't khl bty yrvshlm v't khl byt hgdvl shrf b'sh
verses.translation: And burned the house of the LORD , and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men , burned he with fire:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל חֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סָבִ֑יב נָֽתְצוּ֙ כָּל חֵ֣יל כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶת רַב טַבָּחִֽים
verses.translit: v't khl chmvt yrvshlm sbyb nttsv khl chyl khshdym 'shr 't rb tbchym
verses.translation: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/דַּלּ֨וֹת הָ/עָ֜ם וְֽ/אֶת יֶ֥תֶר הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּ/עִ֗יר וְ/אֶת הַ/נֹּֽפְלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽפְלוּ֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/אֵ֖ת יֶ֣תֶר הָֽ/אָמ֑וֹן הֶגְלָ֕ה נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב טַבָּחִֽים
verses.translit: vmdlvt h'm v't ytr h'm hnsh'rym b'yr v't hnplym 'shr nplv 'l mlkh bbl v't ytr h'mvn hglh nbvzr'dn rb tbchym
verses.translation: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/דַּלּ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ הִשְׁאִ֕יר נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב טַבָּחִ֑ים לְ/כֹרְמִ֖ים וּ/לְ/יֹגְבִֽים
verses.translit: vmdlvt h'rts hsh'yr nbvzr'dn rb tbchym lkhrmym vlygbym
verses.translation: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עַמּוּדֵ֨י הַ/נְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/בֵית יְהוָ֗ה וְֽ/אֶת הַ/מְּכֹנ֞וֹת וְ/אֶת יָ֧ם הַ/נְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/בֵית יְהוָ֖ה שִׁבְּר֣וּ כַשְׂדִּ֑ים וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת כָּל נְחֻשְׁתָּ֖/ם בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: v't 'mvdy hnchsht 'shr lbyt yhvh v't hmkhnvt v't ym hnchsht 'shr bbyt yhvh shbrv khshdym vysh'v 't khl nchshtm bblh
verses.translation: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD , and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD , the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ֠/סִּרוֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּעִ֨ים וְ/אֶת הַֽ/מְזַמְּר֜וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְרָקֹ֣ת וְ/אֶת הַ/כַּפּ֗וֹת וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל כְּלֵ֧י הַ/נְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְת֥וּ בָ/הֶ֖ם לָקָֽחוּ
verses.translit: v't hsrvt v't hy'ym v't hmzmrvt v't hmzrqt v't hkhpvt v't khl khly hnchsht 'shr yshrtv bhm lqchv
verses.translation: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ֠/סִּפִּים וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּחְתּ֨וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְרָק֜וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/סִּיר֣וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּנֹר֗וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/כַּפּוֹת֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּנַקִי֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר זָהָב֙ זָהָ֔ב וַ/אֲשֶׁר כֶּ֖סֶף כָּ֑סֶף לָקַ֖ח רַב טַבָּחִֽים
verses.translit: v't hspym v't hmchtvt v't hmzrqvt v't hsyrvt v't hmnrvt v't hkhpvt v't hmnqyvt 'shr zhb zhb v'shr khsf khsf lqch rb tbchym
verses.translation: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.

verses.original: הָ/עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֗יִם הַ/יָּ֤ם אֶחָד֙ וְ/הַ/בָּקָ֞ר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֤ר נְחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר תַּ֣חַת הַ/מְּכֹנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לֹא הָיָ֣ה מִשְׁקָ֔ל לִ/נְחֻשְׁתָּ֖/ם כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: h'mvdym shnym hym 'chd vhbqr shnym 'shr nchsht 'shr tcht hmkhnvt 'shr 'shh hmlkh shlmh lbyt yhvh l' hyh mshql lnchshtm khl hkhlym h'lh
verses.translation: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD : the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עַמּוּדִ֗ים שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה אַמָּה֙ קומה קוֹמַת֙ הָ/עַמֻּ֣ד הָ/אֶחָ֔ד וְ/ח֛וּט שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה יְסֻבֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/עָבְי֛/וֹ אַרְבַּ֥ע אַצְבָּע֖וֹת נָבֽוּב
verses.translit: vh'mvdym shmnh 'shrh 'mh qvmh qvmt h'md h'chd vchvt shtym 'shrh 'mh ysbnv v'byv 'rb' 'tsb'vt nbvb
verses.translation: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.

verses.original: וְ/כֹתֶ֨רֶת עָלָ֜י/ו נְחֹ֗שֶׁת וְ/קוֹמַ֨ת הַ/כֹּתֶ֥רֶת הָ/אַחַת֮ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּוֹת֒ וּ/שְׂבָכָ֨ה וְ/רִמּוֹנִ֧ים עַֽל הַ/כּוֹתֶ֛רֶת סָבִ֖יב הַ/כֹּ֣ל נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְ/כָ/אֵ֛לֶּה לַֽ/עַמּ֥וּד הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖י וְ/רִמּוֹנִֽים
verses.translit: vkhtrt 'lyv nchsht vqvmt hkhtrt h'cht chmsh 'mvt vshbkhh vrmvnym 'l hkhvtrt sbyb hkhl nchsht vkh'lh l'mvd hshny vrmvnym
verses.translation: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ הָֽ/רִמֹּנִ֔ים תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֖ה ר֑וּחָ/ה כָּל הָ/רִמּוֹנִ֥ים מֵאָ֛ה עַל הַ/שְּׂבָכָ֖ה סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyhyv hrmnym tsh'ym vshshh rvchh khl hrmvnym m'h 'l hshbkhh sbyb
verses.translation: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח רַב טַבָּחִ֗ים אֶת שְׂרָיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ וְ/אֶת צְפַנְיָ֖ה כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/מִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְ/אֶת שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַ/סַּֽף
verses.translit: vyqch rb tbchym 't shryh khhn hr'sh v't tspnyh khhn hmshnh v't shlsht shmry hsf
verses.translation: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

verses.original: וּ/מִן הָ/עִ֡יר לָקַח֩ סָרִ֨יס אֶחָ֜ד אֲֽשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה פָקִ֣יד עַל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְ/שִׁבְעָ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵ/רֹאֵ֤י פְנֵי הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצְא֣וּ בָ/עִ֔יר וְ/אֵ֗ת סֹפֵר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַ/צָּבָ֔א הַ/מַּצְבִּ֖א אֶת עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מֵ/עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ הַֽ/נִּמְצְאִ֖ים בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vmn h'yr lqch srys 'chd 'shr hyh pqyd 'l 'nshy hmlchmh vshb'h 'nshym mr'y pny hmlkh 'shr nmts'v b'yr v't spr shr htsb' hmtsb' 't 'm h'rts vshshym 'ysh m'm h'rts hnmts'ym btvkh h'yr
verses.translation: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king’s person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אוֹתָ֔/ם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב טַבָּחִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֧לֶךְ אוֹתָ֛/ם אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל רִבְלָֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: vyqch 'vtm nbvzr'dn rb tbchym vylkh 'vtm 'l mlkh bbl rblth
verses.translation: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֶּ֣ה אוֹתָ/ם֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֧ל וַ/יְמִתֵ֛/ם בְּ/רִבְלָ֖ה בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַ/יִּ֥גֶל יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vykhh 'vtm mlkh bbl vymtm brblh b'rts chmt vygl yhvdh m'l 'dmtv
verses.translation: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶגְלָ֖ה נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֑ר בִּ/שְׁנַת שֶׁ֕בַע יְהוּדִ֕ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: zh h'm 'shr hglh nbvkhdr'tsr bshnt shb' yhvdym shlsht 'lpym v'shrym vshlshh
verses.translation: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֛ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לִ/נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֑ר מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bshnt shmvnh 'shrh lnbvkhdr'tsr myrvshlm npsh shmnh m'vt shlshym vshnym
verses.translation: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת שָׁלֹ֣שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֮ לִ/נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֒ הֶגְלָ֗ה נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָן֙ רַב טַבָּחִ֔ים יְהוּדִ֕ים נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה כָּל נֶ֕פֶשׁ אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: bshnt shlsh v'shrym lnbvkhdr'tsr hglh nbvzr'dn rb tbchym yhvdym npsh shb' m'vt 'rb'ym vchmshh khl npsh 'rb't 'lpym vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ בִ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וָ/שֶׁ֜בַע שָׁנָ֗ה לְ/גָלוּת֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ן מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה בִּ/שְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ חֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ נָשָׂ֡א אֱוִ֣יל מְרֹדַךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת מַלְכֻת֗/וֹ אֶת רֹאשׁ֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יֹּצֵ֥א אוֹת֖/וֹ מִ/בֵּ֥ית ה/כליא הַ/כְּלֽוּא
verses.translit: vyhy bshlshym vshb' shnh lglvt yhvykhn mlkh yhvdh bshnym 'shr chdsh b'shrym vchmshh lchdsh nsh' 'vyl mrdkh mlkh bbl bshnt mlkhtv 't r'sh yhvykhyn mlkh yhvdh vyts' 'vtv mbyt hkhly' hkhlv'
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ טֹב֑וֹת וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶת כִּסְא֔/וֹ מִ/מַּ֗עַל לְ/כִסֵּ֧א מלכים הַ/מְּלָכִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ בְּ/בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: vydbr 'tv tbvt vytn 't khs'v mm'l lkhs' mlkhym hmlkhym 'shr 'tv bbbl
verses.translation: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

verses.original: וְ/שִׁנָּ֕ה אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י כִלְא֑/וֹ וְ/אָכַ֨ל לֶ֧חֶם לְ/פָנָ֛י/ו תָּמִ֖יד כָּל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽ/ו
verses.translit: vshnh 't bgdy khl'v v'khl lchm lpnyv tmyd khl ymy chyv
verses.translation: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

verses.original: וַ/אֲרֻחָת֗/וֹ אֲרֻחַת֩ תָּמִ֨יד נִתְּנָה לּ֜/וֹ מֵ/אֵ֧ת מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל דְּבַר י֥וֹם בְּ/יוֹמ֖/וֹ עַד י֣וֹם מוֹת֑/וֹ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'rchtv 'rcht tmyd ntnh lv m't mlkh bbl dbr yvm byvmv 'd yvm mvtv khl ymy chyyv
verses.translation: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

verses.original: אֵיכָ֣ה יָשְׁבָ֣ה בָדָ֗ד הָ/עִיר֙ רַבָּ֣תִי עָ֔ם הָיְתָ֖ה כְּ/אַלְמָנָ֑ה רַּבָּ֣תִי בַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם שָׂרָ֨תִי֙ בַּ/מְּדִינ֔וֹת הָיְתָ֖ה לָ/מַֽס
verses.translit: 'ykhh yshbh bdd h'yr rbty 'm hyth kh'lmnh rbty bgvym shrty bmdynvt hyth lms
verses.translation: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

verses.original: בָּכ֨וֹ תִבְכֶּ֜ה בַּ/לַּ֗יְלָה וְ/דִמְעָתָ/הּ֙ עַ֣ל לֶֽחֱיָ֔/הּ אֵֽין לָ֥/הּ מְנַחֵ֖ם מִ/כָּל אֹהֲבֶ֑י/הָ כָּל רֵעֶ֨י/הָ֙ בָּ֣גְדוּ בָ֔/הּ הָ֥יוּ לָ֖/הּ לְ/אֹיְבִֽים
verses.translit: bkhv tbkhh blylh vdm'th 'l lchyh 'yn lh mnchm mkhl 'hbyh khl r'yh bgdv bh hyv lh l'ybym
verses.translation: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

verses.original: גָּֽלְתָ֨ה יְהוּדָ֤ה מֵ/עֹ֨נִי֙ וּ/מֵ/רֹ֣ב עֲבֹדָ֔ה הִ֚יא יָשְׁבָ֣ה בַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם לֹ֥א מָצְאָ֖ה מָנ֑וֹחַ כָּל רֹדְפֶ֥י/הָ הִשִּׂיג֖וּ/הָ בֵּ֥ין הַ/מְּצָרִֽים
verses.translit: glth yhvdh m'ny vmrb 'bdh hy' yshbh bgvym l' mts'h mnvch khl rdpyh hshygvh byn hmtsrym
verses.translation: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

verses.original: דַּרְכֵ֨י צִיּ֜וֹן אֲבֵל֗וֹת מִ/בְּלִי֙ בָּאֵ֣י מוֹעֵ֔ד כָּל שְׁעָרֶ֨י/הָ֙ שֽׁוֹמֵמִ֔ין כֹּהֲנֶ֖י/הָ נֶאֱנָחִ֑ים בְּתוּלֹתֶ֥י/הָ נּוּג֖וֹת וְ/הִ֥יא מַר לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: drkhy tsyvn 'blvt mbly b'y mv'd khl sh'ryh shvmmyn khhnyh n'nchym btvltyh nvgvt vhy' mr lh
verses.translation: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.

verses.original: הָי֨וּ צָרֶ֤י/הָ לְ/רֹאשׁ֙ אֹיְבֶ֣י/הָ שָׁל֔וּ כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה הוֹגָ֖/הּ עַ֣ל רֹב פְּשָׁעֶ֑י/הָ עוֹלָלֶ֛י/הָ הָלְכ֥וּ שְׁבִ֖י לִ/פְנֵי צָֽר
verses.translit: hyv tsryh lr'sh 'ybyh shlv khy yhvh hvgh 'l rb psh'yh 'vllyh hlkhv shby lpny tsr
verses.translation: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א מן בת מִ/בַּת צִיּ֖וֹן כָּל הֲדָרָ֑/הּ הָי֣וּ שָׂרֶ֗י/הָ כְּ/אַיָּלִים֙ לֹא מָצְא֣וּ מִרְעֶ֔ה וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ בְ/לֹא כֹ֖חַ לִ/פְנֵ֥י רוֹדֵֽף
verses.translit: vyts' mn bt mbt tsyvn khl hdrh hyv shryh kh'ylym l' mts'v mr'h vylkhv bl' khch lpny rvdf
verses.translation: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

verses.original: זָֽכְרָ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם יְמֵ֤י עָנְיָ/הּ֙ וּ/מְרוּדֶ֔י/הָ כֹּ֚ל מַחֲמֻדֶ֔י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ מִ֣/ימֵי קֶ֑דֶם בִּ/נְפֹ֧ל עַמָּ֣/הּ בְּ/יַד צָ֗ר וְ/אֵ֤ין עוֹזֵר֙ לָ֔/הּ רָא֣וּ/הָ צָרִ֔ים שָׂחֲק֖וּ עַ֥ל מִשְׁבַּתֶּֽ/הָ
verses.translit: zkhrh yrvshlm ymy 'nyh vmrvdyh khl mchmdyh 'shr hyv mymy qdm bnpl 'mh byd tsr v'yn 'vzr lh r'vh tsrym shchqv 'l mshbth
verses.translation: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.

verses.original: חֵ֤טְא חָֽטְאָה֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַל כֵּ֖ן לְ/נִידָ֣ה הָיָ֑תָה כָּֽל מְכַבְּדֶ֤י/הָ הִזִּיל֨וּ/הָ֙ כִּי רָא֣וּ עֶרְוָתָ֔/הּ גַּם הִ֥יא נֶאֶנְחָ֖ה וַ/תָּ֥שָׁב אָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: cht' cht'h yrvshlm 'l khn lnydh hyth khl mkhbdyh hzylvh khy r'v 'rvth gm hy' n'nchh vtshb 'chvr
verses.translation: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

verses.original: טֻמְאָתָ֣/הּ בְּ/שׁוּלֶ֗י/הָ לֹ֤א זָֽכְרָה֙ אַחֲרִיתָ֔/הּ וַ/תֵּ֣רֶד פְּלָאִ֔ים אֵ֥ין מְנַחֵ֖ם לָ֑/הּ רְאֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת עָנְיִ֔/י כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֖יל אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: tm'th bshvlyh l' zkhrh 'chryth vtrd pl'ym 'yn mnchm lh r'h yhvh 't 'nyy khy hgdyl 'vyb
verses.translation: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD , behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself .

verses.original: יָד/וֹ֙ פָּ֣רַשׂ צָ֔ר עַ֖ל כָּל מַחֲמַדֶּ֑י/הָ כִּֽי רָאֲתָ֤ה גוֹיִם֙ בָּ֣אוּ מִקְדָּשָׁ֔/הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֔יתָה לֹא יָבֹ֥אוּ בַ/קָּהָ֖ל לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: ydv prsh tsr 'l khl mchmdyh khy r'th gvym b'v mqdshh 'shr tsvyth l' yb'v bqhl lkh
verses.translation: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.

verses.original: כָּל עַמָּ֤/הּ נֶאֱנָחִים֙ מְבַקְּשִׁ֣ים לֶ֔חֶם נָתְנ֧וּ מחמודי/הם מַחֲמַדֵּי/הֶ֛ם בְּ/אֹ֖כֶל לְ/הָשִׁ֣יב נָ֑פֶשׁ רְאֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ וְֽ/הַבִּ֔יטָ/ה כִּ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי זוֹלֵלָֽה
verses.translit: khl 'mh n'nchym mbqshym lchm ntnv mchmvdyhm mchmdyhm b'khl lhshyb npsh r'h yhvh vhbyth khy hyyty zvllh
verses.translation: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD , and consider; for I am become vile.

verses.original: ל֣וֹא אֲלֵי/כֶם֮ כָּל עֹ֣בְרֵי דֶרֶךְ֒ הַבִּ֣יטוּ וּ/רְא֗וּ אִם יֵ֤שׁ מַכְאוֹב֙ כְּ/מַכְאֹבִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר עוֹלַ֖ל לִ֑/י אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹגָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/י֖וֹם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lv' 'lykhm khl 'bry drkh hbytv vr'v 'm ysh mkh'vb khmkh'by 'shr 'vll ly 'shr hvgh yhvh byvm chrvn 'pv
verses.translation: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

verses.original: מִ/מָּר֛וֹם שָֽׁלַח אֵ֥שׁ בְּ/עַצְמֹתַ֖/י וַ/יִּרְדֶּ֑/נָּה פָּרַ֨שׂ רֶ֤שֶׁת לְ/רַגְלַ/י֙ הֱשִׁיבַ֣/נִי אָח֔וֹר נְתָנַ֨/נִי֙ שֹֽׁמֵמָ֔ה כָּל הַ/יּ֖וֹם דָּוָֽה
verses.translit: mmrvm shlch 'sh b'tsmty vyrdnh prsh rsht lrgly hshybny 'chvr ntnny shmmh khl hyvm dvh
verses.translation: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.

verses.original: נִשְׂקַד֩ עֹ֨ל פְּשָׁעַ֜/י בְּ/יָד֗/וֹ יִשְׂתָּֽרְג֛וּ עָל֥וּ עַל צַוָּארִ֖/י הִכְשִׁ֣יל כֹּחִ֑/י נְתָנַ֣/נִי אֲדֹנָ֔/י בִּ/ידֵ֖י לֹא אוּכַ֥ל קֽוּם
verses.translit: nshqd 'l psh'y bydv yshtrgv 'lv 'l tsv'ry hkhshyl khchy ntnny 'dny bydy l' 'vkhl qvm
verses.translation: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.

verses.original: סִלָּ֨ה כָל אַבִּירַ֤/י אֲדֹנָ/י֙ בְּ/קִרְבִּ֔/י קָרָ֥א עָלַ֛/י מוֹעֵ֖ד לִ/שְׁבֹּ֣ר בַּחוּרָ֑/י גַּ֚ת דָּרַ֣ךְ אֲדֹנָ֔/י לִ/בְתוּלַ֖ת בַּת יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: slh khl 'byry 'dny bqrby qr' 'ly mv'd lshbr bchvry gt drkh 'dny lbtvlt bt yhvdh
verses.translation: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.

verses.original: עַל אֵ֣לֶּה אֲנִ֣י בוֹכִיָּ֗ה עֵינִ֤/י עֵינִ/י֙ יֹ֣רְדָה מַּ֔יִם כִּֽי רָחַ֥ק מִמֶּ֛/נִּי מְנַחֵ֖ם מֵשִׁ֣יב נַפְשִׁ֑/י הָי֤וּ בָנַ/י֙ שֽׁוֹמֵמִ֔ים כִּ֥י גָבַ֖ר אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: 'l 'lh 'ny bvkhyh 'yny 'yny yrdh mym khy rchq mmny mnchm mshyb npshy hyv bny shvmmym khy gbr 'vyb
verses.translation: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.

verses.original: פֵּֽרְשָׂ֨ה צִיּ֜וֹן בְּ/יָדֶ֗י/הָ אֵ֤ין מְנַחֵם֙ לָ֔/הּ צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב סְבִיבָ֣י/ו צָרָ֑י/ו הָיְתָ֧ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם לְ/נִדָּ֖ה בֵּינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: prshh tsyvn bydyh 'yn mnchm lh tsvh yhvh ly'qb sbybyv tsryv hyth yrvshlm lndh bynyhm
verses.translation: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.

verses.original: צַדִּ֥יק ה֛וּא יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י פִ֣י/הוּ מָרִ֑יתִי שִׁמְעוּ נָ֣א כָל עמים הָֽ/עַמִּ֗ים וּ/רְאוּ֙ מַכְאֹבִ֔/י בְּתוּלֹתַ֥/י וּ/בַחוּרַ֖/י הָלְכ֥וּ בַ/שֶּֽׁבִי
verses.translit: tsdyq hv' yhvh khy pyhv mryty shm'v n' khl 'mym h'mym vr'v mkh'by btvlty vbchvry hlkhv bshby
verses.translation: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

verses.original: קָרָ֤אתִי לַֽ/מְאַהֲבַ/י֙ הֵ֣מָּה רִמּ֔וּ/נִי כֹּהֲנַ֥/י וּ/זְקֵנַ֖/י בָּ/עִ֣יר גָּוָ֑עוּ כִּֽי בִקְשׁ֥וּ אֹ֨כֶל֙ לָ֔/מוֹ וְ/יָשִׁ֖יבוּ אֶת נַפְשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: qr'ty lm'hby hmh rmvny khhny vzqny b'yr gv'v khy bqshv 'khl lmv vyshybv 't npshm
verses.translation: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
