verses.original: רְאֵ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה כִּֽי צַר לִ/י֙ מֵעַ֣/י חֳמַרְמָ֔רוּ נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ לִבִּ/י֙ בְּ/קִרְבִּ֔/י כִּ֥י מָר֖וֹ מָרִ֑יתִי מִ/ח֥וּץ שִׁכְּלָה חֶ֖רֶב בַּ/בַּ֥יִת כַּ/מָּֽוֶת
verses.translit: r'h yhvh khy tsr ly m'y chmrmrv nhpkh lby bqrby khy mrv mryty mchvts shkhlh chrb bbyt khmvt
verses.translation: Behold, O LORD ; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

verses.original: שָׁמְע֞וּ כִּ֧י נֶאֱנָחָ֣ה אָ֗נִי אֵ֤ין מְנַחֵם֙ לִ֔/י כָּל אֹ֨יְבַ֜/י שָׁמְע֤וּ רָֽעָתִ/י֙ שָׂ֔שׂוּ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ הֵבֵ֥אתָ יוֹם קָרָ֖אתָ וְ/יִֽהְי֥וּ כָמֽוֹ/נִי
verses.translit: shm'v khy n'nchh 'ny 'yn mnchm ly khl 'yby shm'v r'ty shshv khy 'th 'shyt hb't yvm qr't vyhyv khmvny
verses.translation: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.

verses.original: תָּבֹ֨א כָל רָעָתָ֤/ם לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/עוֹלֵ֣ל לָ֔/מוֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עוֹלַ֛לְתָּ לִ֖/י עַ֣ל כָּל פְּשָׁעָ֑/י כִּֽי רַבּ֥וֹת אַנְחֹתַ֖/י וְ/לִבִּ֥/י דַוָּֽי
verses.translit: tb' khl r'tm lpnykh v'vll lmv kh'shr 'vllt ly 'l khl psh'y khy rbvt 'nchty vlby dvy
verses.translation: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

verses.original: אֵיכָה֩ יָעִ֨יב בְּ/אַפּ֤/וֹ אֲדֹנָ/י֙ אֶת בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן הִשְׁלִ֤יךְ מִ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔רֶץ תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹא זָכַ֥ר הֲדֹם רַגְלָ֖י/ו בְּ/י֥וֹם אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'ykhh y'yb b'pv 'dny 't bt tsyvn hshlykh mshmym 'rts tp'rt yshr'l vl' zkhr hdm rglyv byvm 'pv
verses.translation: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

verses.original: בִּלַּ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֜/י לא וְ/לֹ֣א חָמַ֗ל אֵ֚ת כָּל נְא֣וֹת יַעֲקֹ֔ב הָרַ֧ס בְּ/עֶבְרָת֛/וֹ מִבְצְרֵ֥י בַת יְהוּדָ֖ה הִגִּ֣יעַ לָ/אָ֑רֶץ חִלֵּ֥ל מַמְלָכָ֖ה וְ/שָׂרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: bl' 'dny l' vl' chml 't khl n'vt y'qb hrs b'brtv mbtsry bt yhvdh hgy' l'rts chll mmlkhh vshryh
verses.translation: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.

verses.original: גָּדַ֣ע בָּֽ/חֳרִי אַ֗ף כֹּ֚ל קֶ֣רֶן יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵשִׁ֥יב אָח֛וֹר יְמִינ֖/וֹ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וַ/יִּבְעַ֤ר בְּ/יַעֲקֹב֙ כְּ/אֵ֣שׁ לֶֽהָבָ֔ה אָכְלָ֖ה סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: gd' bchry 'f khl qrn yshr'l hshyb 'chvr ymynv mpny 'vyb vyb'r by'qb kh'sh lhbh 'khlh sbyb
verses.translation: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.

verses.original: דָּרַ֨ךְ קַשְׁתּ֜/וֹ כְּ/אוֹיֵ֗ב נִצָּ֤ב יְמִינ/וֹ֙ כְּ/צָ֔ר וַֽ/יַּהֲרֹ֔ג כֹּ֖ל מַחֲמַדֵּי עָ֑יִן בְּ/אֹ֨הֶל֙ בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן שָׁפַ֥ךְ כָּ/אֵ֖שׁ חֲמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: drkh qshtv kh'vyb ntsb ymynv khtsr vyhrg khl mchmdy 'yn b'hl bt tsyvn shpkh kh'sh chmtv
verses.translation: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.

verses.original: הָיָ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤/י כְּ/אוֹיֵב֙ בִּלַּ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלַּע֙ כָּל אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָ֑י/ו וַ/יֶּ֨רֶב֙ בְּ/בַת יְהוּדָ֔ה תַּאֲנִיָּ֖ה וַ/אֲנִיָּֽה
verses.translit: hyh 'dny kh'vyb bl' yshr'l bl' khl 'rmnvtyh shcht mbtsryv vyrb bbt yhvdh t'nyh v'nyh
verses.translation: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחְמֹ֤ס כַּ/גַּן֙ שֻׂכּ֔/וֹ שִׁחֵ֖ת מוֹעֲד֑/וֹ שִׁכַּ֨ח יְהוָ֤ה בְּ/צִיּוֹן֙ מוֹעֵ֣ד וְ/שַׁבָּ֔ת וַ/יִּנְאַ֥ץ בְּ/זַֽעַם אַפּ֖/וֹ מֶ֥לֶךְ וְ/כֹהֵֽן
verses.translit: vychms khgn shkhv shcht mv'dv shkhch yhvh btsyvn mv'd vshbt vyn'ts bz'm 'pv mlkh vkhhn
verses.translation: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

verses.original: זָנַ֨ח אֲדֹנָ֤/י מִזְבְּח/וֹ֙ נִאֵ֣ר מִקְדָּשׁ֔/וֹ הִסְגִּיר֙ בְּ/יַד אוֹיֵ֔ב חוֹמֹ֖ת אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑י/הָ ק֛וֹל נָתְנ֥וּ בְּ/בֵית יְהוָ֖ה כְּ/י֥וֹם מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: znch 'dny mzbchv n'r mqdshv hsgyr byd 'vyb chvmt 'rmnvtyh qvl ntnv bbyt yhvh khyvm mv'd
verses.translation: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD , as in the day of a solemn feast.

verses.original: חָשַׁ֨ב יְהוָ֤ה לְ/הַשְׁחִית֙ חוֹמַ֣ת בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן נָ֣טָה קָ֔ו לֹא הֵשִׁ֥יב יָד֖/וֹ מִ/בַּלֵּ֑עַ וַ/יַּֽאֲבֶל חֵ֥ל וְ/חוֹמָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֥ו אֻמְלָֽלוּ
verses.translit: chshb yhvh lhshchyt chvmt bt tsyvn nth qv l' hshyb ydv mbl' vy'bl chl vchvmh ychdv 'mllv
verses.translation: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

verses.original: טָבְע֤וּ בָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ שְׁעָרֶ֔י/הָ אִבַּ֥ד וְ/שִׁבַּ֖ר בְּרִיחֶ֑י/הָ מַלְכָּ֨/הּ וְ/שָׂרֶ֤י/הָ בַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֵ֣ין תּוֹרָ֔ה גַּם נְבִיאֶ֕י/הָ לֹא מָצְא֥וּ חָז֖וֹן מֵ/יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: tb'v b'rts sh'ryh 'bd vshbr brychyh mlkhh vshryh bgvym 'yn tvrh gm nby'yh l' mts'v chzvn myhvh
verses.translation: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD .

verses.original: יֵשְׁב֨וּ לָ/אָ֤רֶץ יִדְּמוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י בַת צִיּ֔וֹן הֶֽעֱל֤וּ עָפָר֙ עַל רֹאשָׁ֔/ם חָגְר֖וּ שַׂקִּ֑ים הוֹרִ֤ידוּ לָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ רֹאשָׁ֔/ן בְּתוּלֹ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: yshbv l'rts ydmv zqny bt tsyvn h'lv 'pr 'l r'shm chgrv shqym hvrydv l'rts r'shn btvlt yrvshlm
verses.translation: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

verses.original: כָּל֨וּ בַ/דְּמָע֤וֹת עֵינַ/י֙ חֳמַרְמְר֣וּ מֵעַ֔/י נִשְׁפַּ֤ךְ לָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ כְּבֵדִ֔/י עַל שֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת עַמִּ֑/י בֵּֽ/עָטֵ֤ף עוֹלֵל֙ וְ/יוֹנֵ֔ק בִּ/רְחֹב֖וֹת קִרְיָֽה
verses.translit: khlv bdm'vt 'yny chmrmrv m'y nshpkh l'rts khbdy 'l shbr bt 'my b'tf 'vll vyvnq brchbvt qryh
verses.translation: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

verses.original: לְ/אִמֹּתָ/ם֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ אַיֵּ֖ה דָּגָ֣ן וָ/יָ֑יִן בְּ/הִֽתְעַטְּפָ֤/ם כֶּֽ/חָלָל֙ בִּ/רְחֹב֣וֹת עִ֔יר בְּ/הִשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשָׁ֔/ם אֶל חֵ֖יק אִמֹּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: l'mtm y'mrv 'yh dgn vyyn bht'tpm khchll brchbvt 'yr bhshtpkh npshm 'l chyq 'mtm
verses.translation: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

verses.original: מָֽה אֲעִידֵ֞/ךְ מָ֣ה אֲדַמֶּה לָּ֗/ךְ הַ/בַּת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מָ֤ה אַשְׁוֶה לָּ/ךְ֙ וַ/אֲנַֽחֲמֵ֔/ךְ בְּתוּלַ֖ת בַּת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי גָד֥וֹל כַּ/יָּ֛ם שִׁבְרֵ֖/ךְ מִ֥י יִרְפָּא לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: mh ''ydkh mh 'dmh lkh hbt yrvshlm mh 'shvh lkh v'nchmkh btvlt bt tsyvn khy gdvl khym shbrkh my yrp' lkh
verses.translation: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?

verses.original: נְבִיאַ֗יִ/ךְ חָ֤זוּ לָ/ךְ֙ שָׁ֣וְא וְ/תָפֵ֔ל וְ/לֹֽא גִלּ֥וּ עַל עֲוֺנֵ֖/ךְ לְ/הָשִׁ֣יב שבית/ך שְׁבוּתֵ֑/ךְ וַ/יֶּ֣חֱזוּ לָ֔/ךְ מַשְׂא֥וֹת שָׁ֖וְא וּ/מַדּוּחִֽים
verses.translit: nby'ykh chzv lkh shv' vtpl vl' glv 'l 'vnkh lhshyb shbytkh shbvtkh vychzv lkh msh'vt shv' vmdvchym
verses.translation: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.

verses.original: סָֽפְק֨וּ עָלַ֤יִ/ךְ כַּפַּ֨יִם֙ כָּל עֹ֣בְרֵי דֶ֔רֶךְ שָֽׁרְקוּ֙ וַ/יָּנִ֣עוּ רֹאשָׁ֔/ם עַל בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲ/זֹ֣את הָ/עִ֗יר שֶׁ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כְּלִ֣ילַת יֹ֔פִי מָשׂ֖וֹשׂ לְ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: spqv 'lykh khpym khl 'bry drkh shrqv vyn'v r'shm 'l bt yrvshlm hz't h'yr shy'mrv khlylt ypy mshvsh lkhl h'rts
verses.translation: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

verses.original: פָּצ֨וּ עָלַ֤יִ/ךְ פִּי/הֶם֙ כָּל א֣וֹיְבַ֔יִ/ךְ שָֽׁרְקוּ֙ וַ/יַּֽחַרְקוּ שֵׁ֔ן אָמְר֖וּ בִּלָּ֑עְנוּ אַ֣ךְ זֶ֥ה הַ/יּ֛וֹם שֶׁ/קִּוִּינֻ֖/הוּ מָצָ֥אנוּ רָאִֽינוּ
verses.translit: ptsv 'lykh pyhm khl 'vybykh shrqv vychrqv shn 'mrv bl'nv 'kh zh hyvm shqvynhv mts'nv r'ynv
verses.translation: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it .

verses.original: עָשָׂ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר זָמָ֗ם בִּצַּ֤ע אֶמְרָת/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה מִֽ/ימֵי קֶ֔דֶם הָרַ֖ס וְ/לֹ֣א חָמָ֑ל וַ/יְשַׂמַּ֤ח עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אוֹיֵ֔ב הֵרִ֖ים קֶ֥רֶן צָרָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'shh yhvh 'shr zmm bts' 'mrtv 'shr tsvh mymy qdm hrs vl' chml vyshmch 'lykh 'vyb hrym qrn tsrykh
verses.translation: The LORD hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.

verses.original: צָעַ֥ק לִבָּ֖/ם אֶל אֲדֹנָ֑/י חוֹמַ֣ת בַּת צִ֠יּוֹן הוֹרִ֨ידִי כַ/נַּ֤חַל דִּמְעָה֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לַ֔יְלָה אַֽל תִּתְּנִ֤י פוּגַת֙ לָ֔/ךְ אַל תִּדֹּ֖ם בַּת עֵינֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: ts'q lbm 'l 'dny chvmt bt tsyvn hvrydy khnchl dm'h yvmm vlylh 'l ttny pvgt lkh 'l tdm bt 'ynkh
verses.translation: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

verses.original: ק֣וּמִי רֹ֣נִּי ב/ליל בַ/לַּ֗יְלָה לְ/רֹאשׁ֙ אַשְׁמֻר֔וֹת שִׁפְכִ֤י כַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ לִבֵּ֔/ךְ נֹ֖כַח פְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֑/י שְׂאִ֧י אֵלָ֣י/ו כַּפַּ֗יִ/ךְ עַל נֶ֨פֶשׁ֙ עֽוֹלָלַ֔יִ/ךְ הָ/עֲטוּפִ֥ים בְּ/רָעָ֖ב בְּ/רֹ֥אשׁ כָּל חוּצֽוֹת
verses.translit: qvmy rny blyl blylh lr'sh 'shmrvt shpkhy khmym lbkh nkhch pny 'dny sh'y 'lyv khpykh 'l npsh 'vllykh h'tvpym br'b br'sh khl chvtsvt
verses.translation: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

verses.original: רְאֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ וְֽ/הַבִּ֔יטָ/ה לְ/מִ֖י עוֹלַ֣לְתָּ כֹּ֑ה אִם תֹּאכַ֨לְנָה נָשִׁ֤ים פִּרְיָ/ם֙ עֹלֲלֵ֣י טִפֻּחִ֔ים אִם יֵהָרֵ֛ג בְּ/מִקְדַּ֥שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖/י כֹּהֵ֥ן וְ/נָבִֽיא
verses.translit: r'h yhvh vhbyth lmy 'vllt khh 'm t'khlnh nshym prym 'lly tpchym 'm yhrg bmqdsh 'dny khhn vnby'
verses.translation: Behold, O LORD , and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

verses.original: שָׁכְב֨וּ לָ/אָ֤רֶץ חוּצוֹת֙ נַ֣עַר וְ/זָקֵ֔ן בְּתוּלֹתַ֥/י וּ/בַחוּרַ֖/י נָפְל֣וּ בֶ/חָ֑רֶב הָרַ֨גְתָּ֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם אַפֶּ֔/ךָ טָבַ֖חְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ
verses.translit: shkhbv l'rts chvtsvt n'r vzqn btvlty vbchvry nplv bchrb hrgt byvm 'pkh tbcht l' chmlt
verses.translation: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.

verses.original: תִּקְרָא֩ כְ/י֨וֹם מוֹעֵ֤ד מְגוּרַ/י֙ מִ/סָּבִ֔יב וְ/לֹ֥א הָיָ֛ה בְּ/י֥וֹם אַף יְהוָ֖ה פָּלִ֣יט וְ/שָׂרִ֑יד אֲשֶׁר טִפַּ֥חְתִּי וְ/רִבִּ֖יתִי אֹיְבִ֥/י כִלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: tqr' khyvm mv'd mgvry msbyb vl' hyh byvm 'f yhvh plyt vshryd 'shr tpchty vrbyty 'yby khlm
verses.translation: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD’s anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י הַ/גֶּ֨בֶר֙ רָאָ֣ה עֳנִ֔י בְּ/שֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'ny hgbr r'h 'ny bshbt 'brtv
verses.translation: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

verses.original: אוֹתִ֥/י נָהַ֛ג וַ/יֹּלַ֖ךְ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְ/לֹא אֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'vty nhg vylkh chshkh vl' 'vr
verses.translation: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בִּ֥/י יָשֻׁ֛ב יַהֲפֹ֥ךְ יָד֖/וֹ כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'kh by yshb yhpkh ydv khl hyvm
verses.translation: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

verses.original: בִּלָּ֤ה בְשָׂרִ/י֙ וְ/עוֹרִ֔/י שִׁבַּ֖ר עַצְמוֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: blh bshry v'vry shbr 'tsmvty
verses.translation: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

verses.original: בָּנָ֥ה עָלַ֛/י וַ/יַּקַּ֖ף רֹ֥אשׁ וּ/תְלָאָֽה
verses.translit: bnh 'ly vyqf r'sh vtl'h
verses.translation: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

verses.original: בְּ/מַחֲשַׁכִּ֥ים הוֹשִׁיבַ֖/נִי כְּ/מֵתֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: bmchshkhym hvshybny khmty 'vlm
verses.translation: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

verses.original: גָּדַ֧ר בַּעֲדִ֛/י וְ/לֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א הִכְבִּ֥יד נְחָשְׁתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: gdr b'dy vl' 'ts' hkhbyd nchshty
verses.translation: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם כִּ֤י אֶזְעַק֙ וַ/אֲשַׁוֵּ֔עַ שָׂתַ֖ם תְּפִלָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: gm khy 'z'q v'shv' shtm tplty
verses.translation: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

verses.original: גָּדַ֤ר דְּרָכַ/י֙ בְּ/גָזִ֔ית נְתִיבֹתַ֖/י עִוָּֽה
verses.translit: gdr drkhy bgzyt ntybty 'vh
verses.translation: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

verses.original: דֹּ֣ב אֹרֵ֥ב הוּא֙ לִ֔/י אריה אֲרִ֖י בְּ/מִסְתָּרִֽים
verses.translit: db 'rb hv' ly 'ryh 'ry bmstrym
verses.translation: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

verses.original: דְּרָכַ֥/י סוֹרֵ֛ר וַֽ/יְפַשְּׁחֵ֖/נִי שָׂמַ֥/נִי שֹׁמֵֽם
verses.translit: drkhy svrr vypshchny shmny shmm
verses.translation: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

verses.translit: drkh qshtv vytsybny khmtr' lchts
verses.translation: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

verses.original: הֵבִיא֙ בְּ/כִלְיוֹתָ֔/י בְּנֵ֖י אַשְׁפָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hby' bkhlyvty bny 'shptv
verses.translation: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

verses.original: הָיִ֤יתִי שְּׂחֹק֙ לְ/כָל עַמִּ֔/י נְגִינָתָ֖/ם כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: hyyty shchq lkhl 'my ngyntm khl hyvm
verses.translation: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

verses.original: הִשְׂבִּיעַ֥/נִי בַ/מְּרוֹרִ֖ים הִרְוַ֥/נִי לַעֲנָֽה
verses.translit: hshby'ny bmrvrym hrvny l'nh
verses.translation: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

verses.translit: vygrs bchtsts shny hkhpyshny b'pr
verses.translation: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

verses.original: וַ/תִּזְנַ֧ח מִ/שָּׁל֛וֹם נַפְשִׁ֖/י נָשִׁ֥יתִי טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: vtznch mshlvm npshy nshyty tvbh
verses.translation: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַר֙ אָבַ֣ד נִצְחִ֔/י וְ/תוֹחַלְתִּ֖/י מֵ/יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'mr 'bd ntschy vtvchlty myhvh
verses.translation: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD :

verses.original: זְכָר עָנְיִ֥/י וּ/מְרוּדִ֖/י לַעֲנָ֥ה וָ/רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: zkhr 'nyy vmrvdy l'nh vr'sh
verses.translation: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

verses.original: זָכ֣וֹר תִּזְכּ֔וֹר ו/תשיח וְ/תָשׁ֥וֹחַ עָלַ֖/י נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: zkhvr tzkhvr vtshych vtshvch 'ly npshy
verses.translation: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

verses.original: זֹ֛את אָשִׁ֥יב אֶל לִבִּ֖/י עַל כֵּ֥ן אוֹחִֽיל
verses.translit: z't 'shyb 'l lby 'l khn 'vchyl
verses.translation: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

verses.original: חַֽסְדֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ כִּ֣י לֹא תָ֔מְנוּ כִּ֥י לֹא כָל֖וּ רַחֲמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: chsdy yhvh khy l' tmnv khy l' khlv rchmyv
verses.translation: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

verses.original: חֲדָשִׁים֙ לַ/בְּקָרִ֔ים רַבָּ֖ה אֱמוּנָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: chdshym lbqrym rbh 'mvntkh
verses.translation: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

verses.original: חֶלְקִ֤/י יְהוָה֙ אָמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔/י עַל כֵּ֖ן אוֹחִ֥יל לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: chlqy yhvh 'mrh npshy 'l khn 'vchyl lv
verses.translation: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

verses.original: ט֤וֹב יְהוָה֙ לְ/קוָֹ֔/ו לְ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ תִּדְרְשֶֽׁ/נּוּ
verses.translit: tvb yhvh lqvv lnpsh tdrshnv
verses.translation: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

verses.original: ט֤וֹב וְ/יָחִיל֙ וְ/דוּמָ֔ם לִ/תְשׁוּעַ֖ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: tvb vychyl vdvmm ltshv't yhvh
verses.translation: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD .

verses.original: ט֣וֹב לַ/גֶּ֔בֶר כִּֽי יִשָּׂ֥א עֹ֖ל בִּ/נְעוּרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: tvb lgbr khy ysh' 'l bn'vryv
verses.translation: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

verses.original: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּדָד֙ וְ/יִדֹּ֔ם כִּ֥י נָטַ֖ל עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: yshb bdd vydm khy ntl 'lyv
verses.translation: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

verses.original: יִתֵּ֤ן בֶּֽ/עָפָר֙ פִּ֔י/הוּ אוּלַ֖י יֵ֥שׁ תִּקְוָֽה
verses.translit: ytn b'pr pyhv 'vly ysh tqvh
verses.translation: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

verses.original: יִתֵּ֧ן לְ/מַכֵּ֛/הוּ לֶ֖חִי יִשְׂבַּ֥ע בְּ/חֶרְפָּֽה
verses.translit: ytn lmkhhv lchy yshb' bchrph
verses.translation: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֥א יִזְנַ֛ח לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם אֲדֹנָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy l' yznch l'vlm 'dny
verses.translation: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם הוֹגָ֔ה וְ/רִחַ֖ם כְּ/רֹ֥ב חסד/ו חֲסָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy 'm hvgh vrchm khrb chsdv chsdyv
verses.translation: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א עִנָּה֙ מִ/לִּבּ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּגֶּ֖ה בְנֵי אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: khy l' 'nh mlbv vygh bny 'ysh
verses.translation: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

verses.original: לְ/דַכֵּא֙ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָ֔י/ו כֹּ֖ל אֲסִ֥ירֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: ldkh' tcht rglyv khl 'syry 'rts
verses.translation: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

verses.original: לְ/הַטּוֹת֙ מִשְׁפַּט גָּ֔בֶר נֶ֖גֶד פְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: lhtvt mshpt gbr ngd pny 'lyvn
verses.translation: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

verses.original: לְ/עַוֵּ֤ת אָדָם֙ בְּ/רִיב֔/וֹ אֲדֹנָ֖/י לֹ֥א רָאָֽה
verses.translit: l'vt 'dm brybv 'dny l' r'h
verses.translation: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

verses.original: מִ֣י זֶ֤ה אָמַר֙ וַ/תֶּ֔הִי אֲדֹנָ֖/י לֹ֥א צִוָּֽה
verses.translit: my zh 'mr vthy 'dny l' tsvh
verses.translation: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

verses.original: מִ/פִּ֤י עֶלְיוֹן֙ לֹ֣א תֵצֵ֔א הָ/רָע֖וֹת וְ/הַ/טּֽוֹב
verses.translit: mpy 'lyvn l' tts' hr'vt vhtvb
verses.translation: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

verses.original: מַה יִּתְאוֹנֵן֙ אָדָ֣ם חָ֔י גֶּ֖בֶר עַל חטא/ו חֲטָאָֽי/ו
verses.translit: mh yt'vnn 'dm chy gbr 'l cht'v cht'yv
verses.translation: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

verses.original: נַחְפְּשָׂ֤ה דְרָכֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וְֽ/נַחְקֹ֔רָה וְ/נָשׁ֖וּבָה עַד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: nchpshh drkhynv vnchqrh vnshvbh 'd yhvh
verses.translation: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD .

verses.original: נִשָּׂ֤א לְבָבֵ֨/נוּ֙ אֶל כַּפָּ֔יִם אֶל אֵ֖ל בַּ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: nsh' lbbnv 'l khpym 'l 'l bshmym
verses.translation: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

verses.original: נַ֤חְנוּ פָשַׁ֨עְנוּ֙ וּ/מָרִ֔ינוּ אַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א סָלָֽחְתָּ
verses.translit: nchnv psh'nv vmrynv 'th l' slcht
verses.translation: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

verses.original: סַכֹּ֤תָה בָ/אַף֙ וַֽ/תִּרְדְּפֵ֔/נוּ הָרַ֖גְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ
verses.translit: skhth b'f vtrdpnv hrgt l' chmlt
verses.translation: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

verses.original: סַכּ֤וֹתָה בֶֽ/עָנָן֙ לָ֔/ךְ מֵ/עֲב֖וֹר תְּפִלָּֽה
verses.translit: skhvth b'nn lkh m'bvr tplh
verses.translation: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

verses.original: סְחִ֧י וּ/מָא֛וֹס תְּשִׂימֵ֖/נוּ בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הָ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: schy vm'vs tshymnv bqrb h'mym
verses.translation: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

verses.original: פָּצ֥וּ עָלֵ֛י/נוּ פִּי/הֶ֖ם כָּל אֹיְבֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: ptsv 'lynv pyhm khl 'ybynv
verses.translation: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

verses.original: פַּ֧חַד וָ/פַ֛חַת הָ֥יָה לָ֖/נוּ הַ/שֵּׁ֥את וְ/הַ/שָּֽׁבֶר
verses.translit: pchd vpcht hyh lnv hsh't vhshbr
verses.translation: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

verses.original: פַּלְגֵי מַ֨יִם֙ תֵּרַ֣ד עֵינִ֔/י עַל שֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: plgy mym trd 'yny 'l shbr bt 'my
verses.translation: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.original: עֵינִ֧/י נִגְּרָ֛ה וְ/לֹ֥א תִדְמֶ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֥ין הֲפֻגֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'yny ngrh vl' tdmh m'yn hpgvt
verses.translation: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

verses.original: עַד יַשְׁקִ֣יף וְ/יֵ֔רֶא יְהוָ֖ה מִ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'd yshqyf vyr' yhvh mshmym
verses.translation: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.

verses.original: עֵינִ/י֙ עֽוֹלְלָ֣ה לְ/נַפְשִׁ֔/י מִ/כֹּ֖ל בְּנ֥וֹת עִירִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'yny 'vllh lnpshy mkhl bnvt 'yry
verses.translation: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

verses.original: צ֥וֹד צָד֛וּ/נִי כַּ/צִּפּ֖וֹר אֹיְבַ֥/י חִנָּֽם
verses.translit: tsvd tsdvny khtspvr 'yby chnm
verses.translation: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

verses.original: צָֽמְת֤וּ בַ/בּוֹר֙ חַיָּ֔/י וַ/יַּדּוּ אֶ֖בֶן בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: tsmtv bbvr chyy vydv 'bn by
verses.translation: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

verses.original: צָֽפוּ מַ֥יִם עַל רֹאשִׁ֖/י אָמַ֥רְתִּי נִגְזָֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: tspv mym 'l r'shy 'mrty ngzrty
verses.translation: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

verses.original: קָרָ֤אתִי שִׁמְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/בּ֖וֹר תַּחְתִּיּֽוֹת
verses.translit: qr'ty shmkh yhvh mbvr tchtyvt
verses.translation: I called upon thy name, O LORD , out of the low dungeon.

verses.original: קוֹלִ֖/י שָׁמָ֑עְתָּ אַל תַּעְלֵ֧ם אָזְנְ/ךָ֛ לְ/רַוְחָתִ֖/י לְ/שַׁוְעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: qvly shm't 'l t'lm 'znkh lrvchty lshv'ty
verses.translation: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

verses.original: קָרַ֨בְתָּ֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם אֶקְרָאֶ֔/ךָּ אָמַ֖רְתָּ אַל תִּירָֽא
verses.translit: qrbt byvm 'qr'kh 'mrt 'l tyr'
verses.translation: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

verses.original: רַ֧בְתָּ אֲדֹנָ֛/י רִיבֵ֥י נַפְשִׁ֖/י גָּאַ֥לְתָּ חַיָּֽ/י
verses.translit: rbt 'dny ryby npshy g'lt chyy
verses.translation: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

verses.original: רָאִ֤יתָה יְהוָה֙ עַוָּ֣תָתִ֔/י שָׁפְטָ֖/ה מִשְׁפָּטִֽ/י
verses.translit: r'yth yhvh 'vtty shpth mshpty
verses.translation: O LORD , thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

verses.original: רָאִ֨יתָה֙ כָּל נִקְמָתָ֔/ם כָּל מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖/ם לִֽ/י
verses.translit: r'yth khl nqmtm khl mchshbtm ly
verses.translation: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֤עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתָ/ם֙ יְהוָ֔ה כָּל מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖/ם עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: shm't chrptm yhvh khl mchshbtm 'ly
verses.translation: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD , and all their imaginations against me;

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֤י קָמַ/י֙ וְ/הֶגְיוֹנָ֔/ם עָלַ֖/י כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: shpty qmy vhgyvnm 'ly khl hyvm
verses.translation: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

verses.original: שִׁבְתָּ֤/ם וְ/קִֽימָתָ/ם֙ הַבִּ֔יטָ/ה אֲנִ֖י מַנְגִּינָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: shbtm vqymtm hbyth 'ny mngyntm
verses.translation: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

verses.original: תָּשִׁ֨יב לָ/הֶ֥ם גְּמ֛וּל יְהוָ֖ה כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: tshyb lhm gmvl yhvh khm'shh ydyhm
verses.translation: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD , according to the work of their hands.

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֤ן לָ/הֶם֙ מְגִנַּת לֵ֔ב תַּאֲלָֽתְ/ךָ֖ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: ttn lhm mgnt lb t'ltkh lhm
verses.translation: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

verses.original: תִּרְדֹּ֤ף בְּ/אַף֙ וְ/תַשְׁמִידֵ֔/ם מִ/תַּ֖חַת שְׁמֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: trdf b'f vtshmydm mtcht shmy yhvh
verses.translation: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD .

verses.original: אֵיכָה֙ יוּעַ֣ם זָהָ֔ב יִשְׁנֶ֖א הַ/כֶּ֣תֶם הַ/טּ֑וֹב תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֨כְנָה֙ אַבְנֵי קֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּ/רֹ֖אשׁ כָּל חוּצֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'ykhh yv'm zhb yshn' hkhtm htvb tshtpkhnh 'bny qdsh br'sh khl chvtsvt
verses.translation: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י צִיּוֹן֙ הַ/יְקָרִ֔ים הַ/מְסֻלָּאִ֖ים בַּ/פָּ֑ז אֵיכָ֤ה נֶחְשְׁבוּ֙ לְ/נִבְלֵי חֶ֔רֶשׂ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י יוֹצֵֽר
verses.translit: bny tsyvn hyqrym hmsl'ym bpz 'ykhh nchshbv lnbly chrsh m'shh ydy yvtsr
verses.translation: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

verses.original: גַּם תנין תַּנִּים֙ חָ֣לְצוּ שַׁ֔ד הֵינִ֖יקוּ גּוּרֵי/הֶ֑ן בַּת עַמִּ֣/י לְ/אַכְזָ֔ר כי ענים כַּ/יְעֵנִ֖ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: gm tnyn tnym chltsv shd hynyqv gvryhn bt 'my l'khzr khy 'nym khy'nym bmdbr
verses.translation: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

verses.original: דָּבַ֨ק לְשׁ֥וֹן יוֹנֵ֛ק אֶל חכּ֖/וֹ בַּ/צָּמָ֑א עֽוֹלָלִים֙ שָׁ֣אֲלוּ לֶ֔חֶם פֹּרֵ֖שׂ אֵ֥ין לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: dbq lshvn yvnq 'l chkhv btsm' 'vllym sh'lv lchm prsh 'yn lhm
verses.translation: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

verses.original: הָ/אֹֽכְלִים֙ לְ/מַ֣עֲדַנִּ֔ים נָשַׁ֖מּוּ בַּ/חוּצ֑וֹת הָ/אֱמֻנִים֙ עֲלֵ֣י תוֹלָ֔ע חִבְּק֖וּ אַשְׁפַּתּֽוֹת
verses.translit: h'khlym lm'dnym nshmv bchvtsvt h'mnym 'ly tvl' chbqv 'shptvt
verses.translation: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְדַּל֙ עֲוֺ֣ן בַּת עַמִּ֔/י מֵֽ/חַטַּ֖את סְדֹ֑ם הַֽ/הֲפוּכָ֣ה כְמוֹ רָ֔גַע וְ/לֹא חָ֥לוּ בָ֖/הּ יָדָֽיִם
verses.translit: vygdl 'vn bt 'my mcht't sdm hhpvkhh khmv rg' vl' chlv bh ydym
verses.translation: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

verses.original: זַכּ֤וּ נְזִירֶ֨י/הָ֙ מִ/שֶּׁ֔לֶג צַח֖וּ מֵ/חָלָ֑ב אָ֤דְמוּ עֶ֨צֶם֙ מִ/פְּנִינִ֔ים סַפִּ֖יר גִּזְרָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: zkhv nzyryh mshlg tschv mchlb 'dmv 'tsm mpnynym spyr gzrtm
verses.translation: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

verses.original: חָשַׁ֤ךְ מִ/שְּׁחוֹר֙ תָּֽאֳרָ֔/ם לֹ֥א נִכְּר֖וּ בַּ/חוּצ֑וֹת צָפַ֤ד עוֹרָ/ם֙ עַל עַצְמָ֔/ם יָבֵ֖שׁ הָיָ֥ה כָ/עֵֽץ
verses.translit: chshkh mshchvr t'rm l' nkhrv bchvtsvt tspd 'vrm 'l 'tsmm ybsh hyh kh'ts
verses.translation: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

verses.original: טוֹבִ֤ים הָיוּ֙ חַלְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב מֵֽ/חַלְלֵ֖י רָעָ֑ב שֶׁ֣/הֵ֤ם יָז֨וּבוּ֙ מְדֻקָּרִ֔ים מִ/תְּנוּבֹ֖ת שָׂדָֽי
verses.translit: tvbym hyv chlly chrb mchlly r'b shhm yzvbv mdqrym mtnvbt shdy
verses.translation: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.

verses.original: יְדֵ֗י נָשִׁים֙ רַחֲמָ֣נִיּ֔וֹת בִּשְּׁל֖וּ יַלְדֵי/הֶ֑ן הָי֤וּ לְ/בָרוֹת֙ לָ֔/מוֹ בְּ/שֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: ydy nshym rchmnyvt bshlv yldyhn hyv lbrvt lmv bshbr bt 'my
verses.translation: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.original: כִּלָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת חֲמָת֔/וֹ שָׁפַ֖ךְ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּצֶּת אֵ֣שׁ בְּ/צִיּ֔וֹן וַ/תֹּ֖אכַל יְסוֹדֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khlh yhvh 't chmtv shpkh chrvn 'pv vytst 'sh btsyvn vt'khl ysvdtyh
verses.translation: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.

verses.original: לֹ֤א הֶאֱמִ֨ינוּ֙ מַלְכֵי אֶ֔רֶץ ו/כל כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י תֵבֵ֑ל כִּ֤י יָבֹא֙ צַ֣ר וְ/אוֹיֵ֔ב בְּ/שַׁעֲרֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: l' h'mynv mlkhy 'rts vkhl khl yshby tbl khy yb' tsr v'vyb bsh'ry yrvshlm
verses.translation: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.original: מֵֽ/חַטֹּ֣את נְבִיאֶ֔י/הָ עֲוֺנ֖וֹת כֹּהֲנֶ֑י/הָ הַ/שֹּׁפְכִ֥ים בְּ/קִרְבָּ֖/הּ דַּ֥ם צַדִּיקִֽים
verses.translit: mcht't nby'yh 'vnvt khhnyh hshpkhym bqrbh dm tsdyqym
verses.translation: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

verses.original: נָע֤וּ עִוְרִים֙ בַּֽ/חוּצ֔וֹת נְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ בַּ/דָּ֑ם בְּ/לֹ֣א יֽוּכְל֔וּ יִגְּע֖וּ בִּ/לְבֻשֵׁי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: n'v 'vrym bchvtsvt ng'lv bdm bl' yvkhlv yg'v blbshyhm
verses.translation: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.

verses.original: ס֣וּרוּ טָמֵ֞א קָ֣רְאוּ לָ֗/מוֹ ס֤וּרוּ ס֨וּרוּ֙ אַל תִּגָּ֔עוּ כִּ֥י נָצ֖וּ גַּם נָ֑עוּ אָֽמְרוּ֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יפוּ לָ/גֽוּר
verses.translit: svrv tm' qr'v lmv svrv svrv 'l tg'v khy ntsv gm n'v 'mrv bgvym l' yvsypv lgvr
verses.translation: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there .

verses.original: פְּנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ חִלְּקָ֔/ם לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יף לְ/הַבִּיטָ֑/ם פְּנֵ֤י כֹהֲנִים֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔אוּ זקנים וּ/זְקֵנִ֖ים לֹ֥א חָנָֽנוּ
verses.translit: pny yhvh chlqm l' yvsyf lhbytm pny khhnym l' nsh'v zqnym vzqnym l' chnnv
verses.translation: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

verses.original: עוד/ינה עוֹדֵ֨י/נוּ֙ תִּכְלֶ֣ינָה עֵינֵ֔י/נוּ אֶל עֶזְרָתֵ֖/נוּ הָ֑בֶל בְּ/צִפִּיָּתֵ֣/נוּ צִפִּ֔ינוּ אֶל גּ֖וֹי לֹ֥א יוֹשִֽׁעַ
verses.translit: 'vdynh 'vdynv tkhlynh 'ynynv 'l 'zrtnv hbl btspytnv tspynv 'l gvy l' yvsh'
verses.translation: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .

verses.original: צָד֣וּ צְעָדֵ֔י/נוּ מִ/לֶּ֖כֶת בִּ/רְחֹבֹתֵ֑י/נוּ קָרַ֥ב קִצֵּ֛י/נוּ מָלְא֥וּ יָמֵ֖י/נוּ כִּי בָ֥א קִצֵּֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: tsdv ts'dynv mlkht brchbtynv qrb qtsynv ml'v ymynv khy b' qtsynv
verses.translation: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

verses.original: קַלִּ֤ים הָיוּ֙ רֹדְפֵ֔י/נוּ מִ/נִּשְׁרֵ֖י שָׁמָ֑יִם עַל הֶ/הָרִ֣ים דְּלָקֻ֔/נוּ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר אָ֥רְבוּ לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: qlym hyv rdpynv mnshry shmym 'l hhrym dlqnv bmdbr 'rbv lnv
verses.translation: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

verses.original: ר֤וּחַ אַפֵּ֨י/נוּ֙ מְשִׁ֣יחַ יְהוָ֔ה נִלְכַּ֖ד בִּ/שְׁחִיתוֹתָ֑/ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְנוּ בְּ/צִלּ֖/וֹ נִֽחְיֶ֥ה בַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: rvch 'pynv mshych yhvh nlkhd bshchytvtm 'shr 'mrnv btslv nchyh bgvym
verses.translation: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD , was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

verses.original: שִׂ֤ישִׂי וְ/שִׂמְחִי֙ בַּת אֱד֔וֹם יושבתי יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ ע֑וּץ גַּם עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ תַּעֲבָר כּ֔וֹס תִּשְׁכְּרִ֖י וְ/תִתְעָרִֽי
verses.translit: shyshy vshmchy bt 'dvm yvshbty yvshbt b'rts 'vts gm 'lykh t'br khvs tshkhry vtt'ry
verses.translation: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

verses.original: תַּם עֲוֺנֵ/ךְ֙ בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יף לְ/הַגְלוֹתֵ֑/ךְ פָּקַ֤ד עֲוֺנֵ/ךְ֙ בַּת אֱד֔וֹם גִּלָּ֖ה עַל חַטֹּאתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: tm 'vnkh bt tsyvn l' yvsyf lhglvtkh pqd 'vnkh bt 'dvm glh 'l cht'tykh
verses.translation: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.

verses.original: זְכֹ֤ר יְהוָה֙ מֶֽה הָ֣יָה לָ֔/נוּ הביט הַבִּ֖יטָ/ה וּ/רְאֵ֥ה אֶת חֶרְפָּתֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: zkhr yhvh mh hyh lnv hbyt hbyth vr'h 't chrptnv
verses.translation: Remember, O LORD , what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

verses.original: נַחֲלָתֵ֨/נוּ֙ נֶֽהֶפְכָ֣ה לְ/זָרִ֔ים בָּתֵּ֖י/נוּ לְ/נָכְרִֽים
verses.translit: nchltnv nhpkhh lzrym btynv lnkhrym
verses.translation: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

verses.original: יְתוֹמִ֤ים הָיִ֨ינוּ֙ אין וְ/אֵ֣ין אָ֔ב אִמֹּתֵ֖י/נוּ כְּ/אַלְמָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: ytvmym hyynv 'yn v'yn 'b 'mtynv kh'lmnvt
verses.translation: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

verses.original: מֵימֵ֨י/נוּ֙ בְּ/כֶ֣סֶף שָׁתִ֔ינוּ עֵצֵ֖י/נוּ בִּ/מְחִ֥יר יָבֹֽאוּ
verses.translit: mymynv bkhsf shtynv 'tsynv bmchyr yb'v
verses.translation: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.

verses.original: עַ֤ל צַוָּארֵ֨/נוּ֙ נִרְדָּ֔פְנוּ יָגַ֖עְנוּ לא וְ/לֹ֥א הֽוּנַ֖ח לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'l tsv'rnv nrdpnv yg'nv l' vl' hvnch lnv
verses.translation: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.

verses.original: מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ נָתַ֣נּוּ יָ֔ד אַשּׁ֖וּר לִ/שְׂבֹּ֥עַֽ לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: mtsrym ntnv yd 'shvr lshb' lchm
verses.translation: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

verses.original: אֲבֹתֵ֤י/נוּ חָֽטְאוּ֙ אינ/ם וְ/אֵינָ֔/ם אנחנו וַ/אֲנַ֖חְנוּ עֲוֺנֹתֵי/הֶ֥ם סָבָֽלְנוּ
verses.translit: 'btynv cht'v 'ynm v'ynm 'nchnv v'nchnv 'vntyhm sblnv
verses.translation: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

verses.original: עֲבָדִים֙ מָ֣שְׁלוּ בָ֔/נוּ פֹּרֵ֖ק אֵ֥ין מִ/יָּדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'bdym mshlv bnv prq 'yn mydm
verses.translation: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

verses.original: בְּ/נַפְשֵׁ֨/נוּ֙ נָבִ֣יא לַחְמֵ֔/נוּ מִ/פְּנֵ֖י חֶ֥רֶב הַ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: bnpshnv nby' lchmnv mpny chrb hmdbr
verses.translation: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

verses.original: עוֹרֵ֨/נוּ֙ כְּ/תַנּ֣וּר נִכְמָ֔רוּ מִ/פְּנֵ֖י זַלְעֲפ֥וֹת רָעָֽב
verses.translit: 'vrnv khtnvr nkhmrv mpny zl'pvt r'b
verses.translation: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

verses.original: נָשִׁים֙ בְּ/צִיּ֣וֹן עִנּ֔וּ בְּתֻלֹ֖ת בְּ/עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: nshym btsyvn 'nv btlt b'ry yhvdh
verses.translation: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.

verses.original: שָׂרִים֙ בְּ/יָדָ֣/ם נִתְל֔וּ פְּנֵ֥י זְקֵנִ֖ים לֹ֥א נֶהְדָּֽרוּ
verses.translit: shrym bydm ntlv pny zqnym l' nhdrv
verses.translation: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

verses.original: בַּחוּרִים֙ טְח֣וֹן נָשָׂ֔אוּ וּ/נְעָרִ֖ים בָּ/עֵ֥ץ כָּשָֽׁלוּ
verses.translit: bchvrym tchvn nsh'v vn'rym b'ts khshlv
verses.translation: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

verses.original: זְקֵנִים֙ מִ/שַּׁ֣עַר שָׁבָ֔תוּ בַּחוּרִ֖ים מִ/נְּגִינָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: zqnym msh'r shbtv bchvrym mngyntm
verses.translation: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

verses.original: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ לִבֵּ֔/נוּ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְ/אֵ֖בֶל מְחֹלֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: shbt mshvsh lbnv nhpkh l'bl mchlnv
verses.translation: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

verses.original: נָֽפְלָה֙ עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשֵׁ֔/נוּ אֽוֹי נָ֥א לָ֖/נוּ כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ
verses.translit: nplh 'trt r'shnv 'vy n' lnv khy cht'nv
verses.translation: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

verses.original: עַל זֶ֗ה הָיָ֤ה דָוֶה֙ לִבֵּ֔/נוּ עַל אֵ֖לֶּה חָשְׁכ֥וּ עֵינֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: 'l zh hyh dvh lbnv 'l 'lh chshkhv 'ynynv
verses.translation: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.

verses.original: עַ֤ל הַר צִיּוֹן֙ שֶׁ/שָּׁמֵ֔ם שׁוּעָלִ֖ים הִלְּכוּ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l hr tsyvn shshmm shv'lym hlkhv bv
verses.translation: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֔ב כִּסְאֲ/ךָ֖ לְ/דֹ֥ר וָ/דֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'th yhvh l'vlm tshb khs'kh ldr vdvr
verses.translation: Thou, O LORD , remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה לָ/נֶ֨צַח֙ תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֔/נוּ תַּֽעַזְבֵ֖/נוּ לְ/אֹ֥רֶךְ יָמִֽים
verses.translit: lmh lntsch tshkhchnv t'zbnv l'rkh ymym
verses.translation: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

verses.original: הֲשִׁיבֵ֨/נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ ו/נשוב וְֽ/נָשׁ֔וּבָה חַדֵּ֥שׁ יָמֵ֖י/נוּ כְּ/קֶֽדֶם
verses.translit: hshybnv yhvh 'lykh vnshvb vnshvbh chdsh ymynv khqdm
verses.translation: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD , and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם מָאֹ֣ס מְאַסְתָּ֔/נוּ קָצַ֥פְתָּ עָלֵ֖י/נוּ עַד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: khy 'm m's m'stnv qtspt 'lynv 'd m'd
verses.translation: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בִּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה בָּֽ/רְבִיעִי֙ בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ וַ/אֲנִ֥י בְ/תֽוֹךְ הַ/גּוֹלָ֖ה עַל נְהַר כְּבָ֑ר נִפְתְּחוּ֙ הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וָ/אֶרְאֶ֖ה מַרְא֥וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy bshlshym shnh brby'y bchmshh lchdsh v'ny btvkh hgvlh 'l nhr khbr nptchv hshmym v'r'h mr'vt 'lhym
verses.translation: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month , in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

verses.original: בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הִ֚יא הַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֔ית לְ/גָל֖וּת הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ יוֹיָכִֽין
verses.translit: bchmshh lchdsh hy' hshnh hchmyshyt lglvt hmlkh yvykhyn
verses.translation: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,

verses.original: הָיֹ֣ה הָיָ֣ה דְבַר יְ֠הוָה אֶל יְחֶזְקֵ֨אל בֶּן בּוּזִ֧י הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים עַל נְהַר כְּבָ֑ר וַ/תְּהִ֥י עָלָ֛י/ו שָׁ֖ם יַד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hyh hyh dbr yhvh 'l ychzq'l bn bvzy hkhhn b'rts khshdym 'l nhr khbr vthy 'lyv shm yd yhvh
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֡רֶא וְ/הִנֵּה֩ ר֨וּחַ סְעָרָ֜ה בָּאָ֣ה מִן הַ/צָּפ֗וֹן עָנָ֤ן גָּדוֹל֙ וְ/אֵ֣שׁ מִתְלַקַּ֔חַת וְ/נֹ֥גַֽהּ ל֖/וֹ סָבִ֑יב וּ/מִ֨/תּוֹכָ֔/הּ כְּ/עֵ֥ין הַ/חַשְׁמַ֖ל מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: v'r' vhnh rvch s'rh b'h mn htspvn 'nn gdvl v'sh mtlqcht vngh lv sbyb vmtvkhh kh'yn hchshml mtvkh h'sh
verses.translation: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

verses.original: וּ/מִ֨/תּוֹכָ֔/הּ דְּמ֖וּת אַרְבַּ֣ע חַיּ֑וֹת וְ/זֶה֙ מַרְאֵֽי/הֶ֔ן דְּמ֥וּת אָדָ֖ם לָ/הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: vmtvkhh dmvt 'rb' chyvt vzh mr'yhn dmvt 'dm lhnh
verses.translation: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה פָנִ֖ים לְ/אֶחָ֑ת וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְ/אַחַ֥ת לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'rb'h pnym l'cht v'rb' khnpym l'cht lhm
verses.translation: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

verses.original: וְ/רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם רֶ֣גֶל יְשָׁרָ֑ה וְ/כַ֣ף רַגְלֵי/הֶ֗ם כְּ/כַף֙ רֶ֣גֶל עֵ֔גֶל וְ/נֹ֣צְצִ֔ים כְּ/עֵ֖ין נְחֹ֥שֶׁת קָלָֽל
verses.translit: vrglyhm rgl yshrh vkhf rglyhm khkhf rgl 'gl vntstsym kh'yn nchsht qll
verses.translation: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.

verses.original: ו/יד/ו וִ/ידֵ֣י אָדָ֗ם מִ/תַּ֨חַת֙ כַּנְפֵי/הֶ֔ם עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣עַת רִבְעֵי/הֶ֑ם וּ/פְנֵי/הֶ֥ם וְ/כַנְפֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vydv vydy 'dm mtcht khnpyhm 'l 'rb't rb'yhm vpnyhm vkhnpyhm l'rb'tm
verses.translation: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

verses.original: חֹֽבְרֹ֛ת אִשָּׁ֥ה אֶל אֲחוֹתָ֖/הּ כַּנְפֵי/הֶ֑ם לֹא יִסַּ֣בּוּ בְ/לֶכְתָּ֔/ן אִ֛ישׁ אֶל עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖י/ו יֵלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: chbrt 'shh 'l 'chvth khnpyhm l' ysbv blkhtn 'ysh 'l 'br pnyv ylkhv
verses.translation: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

verses.original: וּ/דְמ֣וּת פְּנֵי/הֶם֮ פְּנֵ֣י אָדָם֒ וּ/פְנֵ֨י אַרְיֵ֤ה אֶל הַ/יָּמִין֙ לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֔/ם וּ/פְנֵי שׁ֥וֹר מֵֽ/הַ/שְּׂמֹ֖אול לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֑/ן וּ/פְנֵי נֶ֖שֶׁר לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּֽ/ן
verses.translit: vdmvt pnyhm pny 'dm vpny 'ryh 'l hymyn l'rb'tm vpny shvr mhshm'vl l'rb'tn vpny nshr l'rb'tn
verses.translation: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

verses.original: וּ/פְנֵי/הֶ֕ם וְ/כַנְפֵי/הֶ֥ם פְּרֻד֖וֹת מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה לְ/אִ֗ישׁ שְׁ֚תַּיִם חֹבְר֣וֹת אִ֔ישׁ וּ/שְׁתַּ֣יִם מְכַסּ֔וֹת אֵ֖ת גְּוִיֹתֵי/הֶֽנָה
verses.translit: vpnyhm vkhnpyhm prdvt mlm'lh l'ysh shtym chbrvt 'ysh vshtym mkhsvt 't gvytyhnh
verses.translation: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֛ישׁ אֶל עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖י/ו יֵלֵ֑כוּ אֶ֣ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶה שָׁ֨מָּ/ה הָ/ר֤וּחַ לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּ/לֶכְתָּֽ/ן
verses.translit: v'ysh 'l 'br pnyv ylkhv 'l 'shr yhyh shmh hrvch llkht ylkhv l' ysbv blkhtn
verses.translation: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.

verses.original: וּ/דְמ֨וּת הַ/חַיּ֜וֹת מַרְאֵי/הֶ֣ם כְּ/גַחֲלֵי אֵ֗שׁ בֹּֽעֲרוֹת֙ כְּ/מַרְאֵ֣ה הַ/לַּפִּדִ֔ים הִ֕יא מִתְהַלֶּ֖כֶת בֵּ֣ין הַ/חַיּ֑וֹת וְ/נֹ֣גַהּ לָ/אֵ֔שׁ וּ/מִן הָ/אֵ֖שׁ יוֹצֵ֥א בָרָֽק
verses.translit: vdmvt hchyvt mr'yhm khgchly 'sh b'rvt khmr'h hlpdym hy' mthlkht byn hchyvt vngh l'sh vmn h'sh yvts' brq
verses.translation: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/חַיּ֖וֹת רָצ֣וֹא וָ/שׁ֑וֹב כְּ/מַרְאֵ֖ה הַ/בָּזָֽק
verses.translit: vhchyvt rtsv' vshvb khmr'h hbzq
verses.translation: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֖רֶא הַ/חַיּ֑וֹת וְ/הִנֵּה֩ אוֹפַ֨ן אֶחָ֥ד בָּ/אָ֛רֶץ אֵ֥צֶל הַ/חַיּ֖וֹת לְ/אַרְבַּ֥עַת פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'r' hchyvt vhnh 'vpn 'chd b'rts 'tsl hchyvt l'rb't pnyv
verses.translation: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.

verses.original: מַרְאֵ֨ה הָ/אוֹפַנִּ֤ים וּ/מַעֲשֵׂי/הֶם֙ כְּ/עֵ֣ין תַּרְשִׁ֔ישׁ וּ/דְמ֥וּת אֶחָ֖ד לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֑/ן וּ/מַרְאֵי/הֶם֙ וּ/מַ֣עֲשֵׂי/הֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יִהְיֶ֥ה הָ/אוֹפַ֖ן בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/אוֹפָֽן
verses.translit: mr'h h'vpnym vm'shyhm kh'yn trshysh vdmvt 'chd l'rb'tn vmr'yhm vm'shyhm kh'shr yhyh h'vpn btvkh h'vpn
verses.translation: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

verses.original: עַל אַרְבַּ֥עַת רִבְעֵי/הֶ֖ן בְּ/לֶכְתָּ֣/ם יֵלֵ֑כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּ/לֶכְתָּֽ/ן
verses.translit: 'l 'rb't rb'yhn blkhtm ylkhv l' ysbv blkhtn
verses.translation: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֨בֵּי/הֶ֔ן וְ/גֹ֥בַהּ לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/יִרְאָ֣ה לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/גַבֹּתָ֗/ם מְלֵאֹ֥ת עֵינַ֛יִם סָבִ֖יב לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּֽ/ן
verses.translit: vgbyhn vgbh lhm vyr'h lhm vgbtm ml't 'ynym sbyb l'rb'tn
verses.translation: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ הַֽ/חַיּ֔וֹת יֵלְכ֥וּ הָ/אוֹפַנִּ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑/ם וּ/בְ/הִנָּשֵׂ֤א הַֽ/חַיּוֹת֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ יִנָּשְׂא֖וּ הָ/אוֹפַנִּֽים
verses.translit: vblkht hchyvt ylkhv h'vpnym 'tslm vbhnsh' hchyvt m'l h'rts ynsh'v h'vpnym
verses.translation: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

verses.original: עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶה שָּׁ֨ם הָ/ר֤וּחַ לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ שָׁ֥מָּ/ה הָ/ר֖וּחַ לָ/לֶ֑כֶת וְ/הָ/אוֹפַנִּ֗ים יִנָּשְׂאוּ֙ לְ/עֻמָּתָ֔/ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַ/חַיָּ֖ה בָּ/אוֹפַנִּֽים
verses.translit: 'l 'shr yhyh shm hrvch llkht ylkhv shmh hrvch llkht vh'vpnym ynsh'v l'mtm khy rvch hchyh b'vpnym
verses.translation: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

verses.original: בְּ/לֶכְתָּ֣/ם יֵלֵ֔כוּ וּ/בְ/עָמְדָ֖/ם יַֽעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּֽ/בְ/הִנָּשְׂאָ֞/ם מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ יִנָּשְׂא֤וּ הָ/אֽוֹפַנִּים֙ לְ/עֻמָּתָ֔/ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַ/חַיָּ֖ה בָּ/אוֹפַנִּֽים
verses.translit: blkhtm ylkhv vb'mdm y'mdv vbhnsh'm m'l h'rts ynsh'v h'vpnym l'mtm khy rvch hchyh b'vpnym
verses.translation: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

verses.original: וּ/דְמ֞וּת עַל רָאשֵׁ֤י הַ/חַיָּה֙ רָקִ֔יעַ כְּ/עֵ֖ין הַ/קֶּ֣רַח הַ/נּוֹרָ֑א נָט֥וּי עַל רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vdmvt 'l r'shy hchyh rqy' kh'yn hqrch hnvr' ntvy 'l r'shyhm mlm'lh
verses.translation: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

verses.original: וְ/תַ֨חַת֙ הָ/רָקִ֔יעַ כַּנְפֵי/הֶ֣ם יְשָׁר֔וֹת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל אֲחוֹתָ֑/הּ לְ/אִ֗ישׁ שְׁתַּ֤יִם מְכַסּוֹת֙ לָ/הֵ֔נָּה וּ/לְ/אִ֗ישׁ שְׁתַּ֤יִם מְכַסּוֹת֙ לָ/הֵ֔נָּה אֵ֖ת גְּוִיֹּתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vtcht hrqy' khnpyhm yshrvt 'shh 'l 'chvth l'ysh shtym mkhsvt lhnh vl'ysh shtym mkhsvt lhnh 't gvytyhm
verses.translation: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת ק֣וֹל כַּנְפֵי/הֶ֡ם כְּ/קוֹל֩ מַ֨יִם רַבִּ֤ים כְּ/קוֹל שַׁדַּי֙ בְּ/לֶכְתָּ֔/ם ק֥וֹל הֲמֻלָּ֖ה כְּ/ק֣וֹל מַחֲנֶ֑ה בְּ/עָמְדָ֖/ם תְּרַפֶּ֥ינָה כַנְפֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: v'shm' 't qvl khnpyhm khqvl mym rbym khqvl shdy blkhtm qvl hmlh khqvl mchnh b'mdm trpynh khnpyhn
verses.translation: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי ק֕וֹל מֵ/עַ֕ל לָ/רָקִ֖יעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל רֹאשָׁ֑/ם בְּ/עָמְדָ֖/ם תְּרַפֶּ֥ינָה כַנְפֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vyhy qvl m'l lrqy' 'shr 'l r'shm b'mdm trpynh khnpyhn
verses.translation: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּ֗עַל לָ/רָקִ֨יעַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל רֹאשָׁ֔/ם כְּ/מַרְאֵ֥ה אֶֽבֶן סַפִּ֖יר דְּמ֣וּת כִּסֵּ֑א וְ/עַל֙ דְּמ֣וּת הַ/כִּסֵּ֔א דְּמ֞וּת כְּ/מַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֛ם עָלָ֖י/ו מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vmm'l lrqy' 'shr 'l r'shm khmr'h 'bn spyr dmvt khs' v'l dmvt hkhs' dmvt khmr'h 'dm 'lyv mlm'lh
verses.translation: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֣רֶא כְּ/עֵ֣ין חַשְׁמַ֗ל כְּ/מַרְאֵה אֵ֤שׁ בֵּֽית לָ/הּ֙ סָבִ֔יב מִ/מַּרְאֵ֥ה מָתְנָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וּ/מִ/מַּרְאֵ֤ה מָתְנָי/ו֙ וּ/לְ/מַ֔טָּה רָאִ֨יתִי֙ כְּ/מַרְאֵה אֵ֔שׁ וְ/נֹ֥גַֽהּ ל֖/וֹ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: v'r' kh'yn chshml khmr'h 'sh byt lh sbyb mmr'h mtnyv vlm'lh vmmr'h mtnyv vlmth r'yty khmr'h 'sh vngh lv sbyb
verses.translation: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.

verses.original: כְּ/מַרְאֵ֣ה הַ/קֶּ֡שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה בֶ/עָנָ֜ן בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/גֶּ֗שֶׁם כֵּ֣ן מַרְאֵ֤ה הַ/נֹּ֨גַהּ֙ סָבִ֔יב ה֕וּא מַרְאֵ֖ה דְּמ֣וּת כְּבוֹד יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ/אֶרְאֶה֙ וָ/אֶפֹּ֣ל עַל פָּנַ֔/י וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֖ע ק֥וֹל מְדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: khmr'h hqsht 'shr yhyh b'nn byvm hgshm khn mr'h hngh sbyb hv' mr'h dmvt khbvd yhvh v'r'h v'pl 'l pny v'shm' qvl mdbr
verses.translation: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD . And when I saw it , I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י בֶּן אָדָם֙ עֲמֹ֣ד עַל רַגְלֶ֔י/ךָ וַ/אֲדַבֵּ֖ר אֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm 'md 'l rglykh v'dbr 'tkh
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֧בֹא בִ֣/י ר֗וּחַ כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלַ֔/י וַ/תַּעֲמִדֵ֖/נִי עַל רַגְלָ֑/י וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֕ע אֵ֖ת מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vtb' by rvch kh'shr dbr 'ly vt'mdny 'l rgly v'shm' 't mdbr 'ly
verses.translation: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י בֶּן אָדָם֙ שׁוֹלֵ֨חַ אֲנִ֤י אֽוֹתְ/ךָ֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל גּוֹיִ֥ם הַ/מּוֹרְדִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָרְדוּ בִ֑/י הֵ֤מָּה וַ/אֲבוֹתָ/ם֙ פָּ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֔/י עַד עֶ֖צֶם הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm shvlch 'ny 'vtkh 'l bny yshr'l 'l gvym hmvrdym 'shr mrdv by hmh v'bvtm psh'v by 'd 'tsm hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בָּנִ֗ים קְשֵׁ֤י פָנִים֙ וְ/חִזְקֵי לֵ֔ב אֲנִ֛י שׁוֹלֵ֥חַ אוֹתְ/ךָ֖ אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִֽה
verses.translit: vhbnym qshy pnym vchzqy lb 'ny shvlch 'vtkh 'lyhm v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ אִם יִשְׁמְע֣וּ וְ/אִם יֶחְדָּ֔לוּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵ֑מָּה וְ/יָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י נָבִ֖יא הָיָ֥ה בְ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhmh 'm yshm'v v'm ychdlv khy byt mry hmh vyd'v khy nby' hyh btvkhm
verses.translation: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָ֠דָם אַל תִּירָ֨א מֵ/הֶ֜ם וּ/מִ/דִּבְרֵי/הֶ֣ם אַל תִּירָ֗א כִּ֣י סָרָבִ֤ים וְ/סַלּוֹנִים֙ אוֹתָ֔/ךְ וְ/אֶל עַקְרַבִּ֖ים אַתָּ֣ה יוֹשֵׁ֑ב מִ/דִּבְרֵי/הֶ֤ם אַל תִּירָא֙ וּ/מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֣ם אַל תֵּחָ֔ת כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm 'l tyr' mhm vmdbryhm 'l tyr' khy srbym vslvnym 'vtkh v'l 'qrbym 'th yvshb mdbryhm 'l tyr' vmpnyhm 'l tcht khy byt mry hmh
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

verses.original: וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֶת דְּבָרַ/י֙ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אִֽם יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְ/אִם יֶחְדָּ֑לוּ כִּ֥י מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vdbrt 't dbry 'lyhm 'm yshm'v v'm ychdlv khy mry hmh
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם שְׁמַע֙ אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ אַל תְּהִי מֶ֖רִי כְּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑רִי פְּצֵ֣ה פִ֔י/ךָ וֶ/אֱכֹ֕ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm shm' 't 'shr 'ny mdbr 'lykh 'l thy mry khbyt hmry ptsh pykh v'khl 't 'shr 'ny ntn 'lykh
verses.translation: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.

verses.original: וָ/אֶרְאֶ֕ה וְ/הִנֵּה יָ֖ד שְׁלוּחָ֣ה אֵלָ֑/י וְ/הִנֵּה ב֖/וֹ מְגִלַּת סֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: v'r'h vhnh yd shlvchh 'ly vhnh bv mglt spr
verses.translation: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אוֹתָ/הּ֙ לְ/פָנַ֔/י וְ/הִ֥יא כְתוּבָ֖ה פָּנִ֣ים וְ/אָח֑וֹר וְ/כָת֣וּב אֵלֶ֔י/הָ קִנִ֥ים וָ/הֶ֖גֶה וָ/הִֽי
verses.translit: vyprsh 'vth lpny vhy' khtvbh pnym v'chvr vkhtvb 'lyh qnym vhgh vhy
verses.translation: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י בֶּן אָדָ֕ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָ֖א אֱכ֑וֹל אֱכוֹל֙ אֶת הַ/מְּגִלָּ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/לֵ֥ךְ דַּבֵּ֖ר אֶל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm 't 'shr tmts' 'khvl 'khvl 't hmglh hz't vlkh dbr 'l byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.

verses.original: וָ/אֶפְתַּ֖ח אֶת פִּ֑/י וַ/יַּ֣אֲכִלֵ֔/נִי אֵ֖ת הַ/מְּגִלָּ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: v'ptch 't py vy'khlny 't hmglh hz't
verses.translation: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י בֶּן אָדָם֙ בִּטְנְ/ךָ֤ תַֽאֲכֵל֙ וּ/מֵעֶ֣י/ךָ תְמַלֵּ֔א אֵ֚ת הַ/מְּגִלָּ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֣ן אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וָ/אֹ֣כְלָ֔/ה וַ/תְּהִ֥י בְּ/פִ֖/י כִּ/דְבַ֥שׁ לְ/מָתֽוֹק
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm btnkh t'khl vm'ykh tml' 't hmglh hz't 'shr 'ny ntn 'lykh v'khlh vthy bpy khdbsh lmtvq
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י בֶּן אָדָ֗ם לֶךְ בֹּא֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֥ בִ/דְבָרַ֖/י אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm lkh b' 'l byt yshr'l vdbrt bdbry 'lyhm
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.

verses.original: כִּ֡י לֹא֩ אֶל עַ֨ם עִמְקֵ֥י שָׂפָ֛ה וְ/כִבְדֵ֥י לָשׁ֖וֹן אַתָּ֣ה שָׁל֑וּחַ אֶל בֵּ֖ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy l' 'l 'm 'mqy shph vkhbdy lshvn 'th shlvch 'l byt yshr'l
verses.translation: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;

verses.original: לֹ֣א אֶל עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים עִמְקֵ֤י שָׂפָה֙ וְ/כִבְדֵ֣י לָשׁ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא תִשְׁמַ֖ע דִּבְרֵי/הֶ֑ם אִם לֹ֤א אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ שְׁלַחְתִּ֔י/ךָ הֵ֖מָּה יִשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: l' 'l 'mym rbym 'mqy shph vkhbdy lshvn 'shr l' tshm' dbryhm 'm l' 'lyhm shlchtykh hmh yshm'v 'lykh
verses.translation: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.

verses.original: וּ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹ֤א יֹאבוּ֙ לִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ כִּֽי אֵינָ֥/ם אֹבִ֖ים לִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלָ֑/י כִּ֚י כָּל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חִזְקֵי מֵ֥צַח וּ/קְשֵׁי לֵ֖ב הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vbyt yshr'l l' y'bv lshm' 'lykh khy 'ynm 'bym lshm' 'ly khy khl byt yshr'l chzqy mtsch vqshy lb hmh
verses.translation: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֧תִּי אֶת פָּנֶ֛י/ךָ חֲזָקִ֖ים לְ/עֻמַּ֣ת פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֶֽת מִצְחֲ/ךָ֥ חָזָ֖ק לְ/עֻמַּ֥ת מִצְחָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hnh ntty 't pnykh chzqym l'mt pnyhm v't mtschkh chzq l'mt mtschm
verses.translation: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.

verses.original: כְּ/שָׁמִ֛יר חָזָ֥ק מִ/צֹּ֖ר נָתַ֣תִּי מִצְחֶ֑/ךָ לֹֽא תִירָ֤א אוֹתָ/ם֙ וְ/לֹא תֵחַ֣ת מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּ֛י בֵּֽית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: khshmyr chzq mtsr ntty mtschkh l' tyr' 'vtm vl' tcht mpnyhm khy byt mry hmh
verses.translation: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י בֶּן אָדָ֕ם אֶת כָּל דְּבָרַ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ קַ֥ח בִּֽ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ וּ/בְ/אָזְנֶ֥י/ךָ שְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm 't khl dbry 'shr 'dbr 'lykh qch blbbkh vb'znykh shm'
verses.translation: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.

verses.original: וְ/לֵ֨ךְ בֹּ֤א אֶל הַ/גּוֹלָה֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֑ה אִֽם יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְ/אִם יֶחְדָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: vlkh b' 'l hgvlh 'l bny 'mkh vdbrt 'lyhm v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'm yshm'v v'm ychdlv
verses.translation: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשָּׂאֵ֣/נִי ר֔וּחַ וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֣ע אַחֲרַ֔/י ק֖וֹל רַ֣עַשׁ גָּד֑וֹל בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה מִ/מְּקוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtsh'ny rvch v'shm' 'chry qvl r'sh gdvl brvkh khbvd yhvh mmqvmv
verses.translation: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying , Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.

verses.original: וְ/ק֣וֹל כַּנְפֵ֣י הַ/חַיּ֗וֹת מַשִּׁיקוֹת֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אֶל אֲחוֹתָ֔/הּ וְ/ק֥וֹל הָ/אוֹפַנִּ֖ים לְ/עֻמָּתָ֑/ם וְ/ק֖וֹל רַ֥עַשׁ גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vqvl khnpy hchyvt mshyqvt 'shh 'l 'chvth vqvl h'vpnym l'mtm vqvl r'sh gdvl
verses.translation: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.

verses.original: וְ/ר֥וּחַ נְשָׂאַ֖תְ/נִי וַ/תִּקָּחֵ֑/נִי וָ/אֵלֵ֥ךְ מַר֙ בַּ/חֲמַ֣ת רוּחִ֔/י וְ/יַד יְהוָ֥ה עָלַ֖/י חָזָֽקָה
verses.translit: vrvch nsh'tny vtqchny v'lkh mr bchmt rvchy vyd yhvh 'ly chzqh
verses.translation: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.

verses.original: וָ/אָב֨וֹא אֶל הַ/גּוֹלָ֜ה תֵּ֣ל אָ֠בִיב הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֤ים אֶֽל נְהַר כְּבָר֙ ו/אשר וָֽ/אֵשֵׁ֔ב הֵ֖מָּה יוֹשְׁבִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם וָ/אֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁ֛ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים מַשְׁמִ֥ים בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'bv' 'l hgvlh tl 'byb hyshbym 'l nhr khbr v'shr v'shb hmh yvshbym shm v'shb shm shb't ymym mshmym btvkhm
verses.translation: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י מִ/קְצֵ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy mqtsh shb't ymym vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם צֹפֶ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֤ מִ/פִּ/י֙ דָּבָ֔ר וְ/הִזְהַרְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖/ם מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: bn 'dm tsph nttykh lbyt yshr'l vshm't mpy dbr vhzhrt 'vtm mmny
verses.translation: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

verses.original: בְּ/אָמְרִ֤/י לָֽ/רָשָׁע֙ מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת וְ/לֹ֣א הִזְהַרְתּ֗/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א דִבַּ֛רְתָּ לְ/הַזְהִ֥יר רָשָׁ֛ע מִ/דַּרְכּ֥/וֹ הָ/רְשָׁעָ֖ה לְ/חַיֹּת֑/וֹ ה֤וּא רָשָׁע֙ בַּ/עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְ/דָמ֖/וֹ מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֥ אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ
verses.translit: b'mry lrsh' mvt tmvt vl' hzhrtv vl' dbrt lhzhyr rsh' mdrkhv hrsh'h lchytv hv' rsh' b'vnv ymvt vdmv mydkh 'bqsh
verses.translation: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ כִּֽי הִזְהַ֣רְתָּ רָשָׁ֔ע וְ/לֹא שָׁב֙ מֵֽ/רִשְׁע֔/וֹ וּ/מִ/דַּרְכּ֖/וֹ הָ/רְשָׁעָ֑ה ה֚וּא בַּ/עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְ/אַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ
verses.translit: v'th khy hzhrt rsh' vl' shb mrsh'v vmdrkhv hrsh'h hv' b'vnv ymvt v'th 't npshkh htslt
verses.translation: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/שׁ֨וּב צַדִּ֤יק מִ/צִּדְק/וֹ֙ וְ/עָ֣שָׂה עָ֔וֶל וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י מִכְשׁ֛וֹל לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו ה֣וּא יָמ֑וּת כִּ֣י לֹ֤א הִזְהַרְתּ/וֹ֙ בְּ/חַטָּאת֣/וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְ/לֹ֣א תִזָּכַ֗רְןָ צִדְקֹתָ/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְ/דָמ֖/וֹ מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֥ אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ
verses.translit: vbshvb tsdyq mtsdqv v'shh 'vl vntty mkhshvl lpnyv hv' ymvt khy l' hzhrtv bcht'tv ymvt vl' tzkhrn tsdqtv 'shr 'shh vdmv mydkh 'bqsh
verses.translation: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה כִּ֧י הִזְהַרְתּ֣/וֹ צַדִּ֗יק לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י חֲטֹ֛א צַדִּ֖יק וְ/ה֣וּא לֹא חָטָ֑א חָי֤וֹ יִֽחְיֶה֙ כִּ֣י נִזְהָ֔ר וְ/אַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ
verses.translit: v'th khy hzhrtv tsdyq lblty cht' tsdyq vhv' l' cht' chyv ychyh khy nzhr v'th 't npshkh htslt
verses.translation: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man , that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֥י עָלַ֛/י שָׁ֖ם יַד יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י ק֥וּם צֵא֙ אֶל הַ/בִּקְעָ֔ה וְ/שָׁ֖ם אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אוֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vthy 'ly shm yd yhvh vy'mr 'ly qvm ts' 'l hbq'h vshm 'dbr 'vtkh
verses.translation: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

verses.original: וָ/אָקוּם֮ וָ/אֵצֵ֣א אֶל הַ/בִּקְעָה֒ וְ/הִנֵּה שָׁ֤ם כְּבוֹד יְהוָה֙ עֹמֵ֔ד כַּ/כָּב֕וֹד אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי עַל נְהַר כְּבָ֑ר וָ/אֶפֹּ֖ל עַל פָּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'qvm v'ts' 'l hbq'h vhnh shm khbvd yhvh 'md khkhbvd 'shr r'yty 'l nhr khbr v'pl 'l pny
verses.translation: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹא בִ֣/י ר֔וּחַ וַ/תַּעֲמִדֵ֖/נִי עַל רַגְלָ֑/י וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר אֹתִ/י֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י בֹּ֥א הִסָּגֵ֖ר בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ בֵּיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vtb' by rvch vt'mdny 'l rgly vydbr 'ty vy'mr 'ly b' hsgr btvkh bytkh
verses.translation: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם הִנֵּ֨ה נָתְנ֤וּ עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ עֲבוֹתִ֔ים וַ/אֲסָר֖וּ/ךָ בָּ/הֶ֑ם וְ/לֹ֥א תֵצֵ֖א בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm hnh ntnv 'lykh 'bvtym v'srvkh bhm vl' tts' btvkhm
verses.translation: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

verses.original: וּ/לְשֽׁוֹנְ/ךָ֙ אַדְבִּ֣יק אֶל חִכֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/נֶֽאֱלַ֔מְתָּ וְ/לֹא תִֽהְיֶ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/אִ֣ישׁ מוֹכִ֑יחַ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vlshvnkh 'dbyq 'l chkhkh vn'lmt vl' thyh lhm l'ysh mvkhych khy byt mry hmh
verses.translation: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/דַבְּרִ֤/י אֽוֹתְ/ךָ֙ אֶפְתַּ֣ח אֶת פִּ֔י/ךָ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֑ה הַ/שֹּׁמֵ֤עַ יִשְׁמָע֙ וְ/הֶ/חָדֵ֣ל יֶחְדָּ֔ל כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vbdbry 'vtkh 'ptch 't pykh v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hshm' yshm' vhchdl ychdl khy byt mry hmh
verses.translation: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֤ה בֶן אָדָם֙ קַח לְ/ךָ֣ לְבֵנָ֔ה וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ה אוֹתָ֖/הּ לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/חַקּוֹתָ֥ עָלֶ֛י/הָ עִ֖יר אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm qch lkh lbnh vntth 'vth lpnykh vchqvt 'lyh 'yr 't yrvshlm
verses.translation: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֨ה עָלֶ֜י/הָ מָצ֗וֹר וּ/בָנִ֤יתָ עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ דָּיֵ֔ק וְ/שָׁפַכְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖י/הָ סֹֽלְלָ֑ה וְ/נָתַתָּ֨ה עָלֶ֧י/הָ מַחֲנ֛וֹת וְ/שִׂים עָלֶ֥י/הָ כָּרִ֖ים סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vntth 'lyh mtsvr vbnyt 'lyh dyq vshpkht 'lyh sllh vntth 'lyh mchnvt vshym 'lyh khrym sbyb
verses.translation: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֤ה קַח לְ/ךָ֙ מַחֲבַ֣ת בַּרְזֶ֔ל וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה אוֹתָ/הּ֙ קִ֣יר בַּרְזֶ֔ל בֵּינְ/ךָ֖ וּ/בֵ֣ין הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/הֲכִינֹתָה֩ אֶת פָּנֶ֨י/ךָ אֵלֶ֜י/הָ וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה בַ/מָּצוֹר֙ וְ/צַרְתָּ֣ עָלֶ֔י/הָ א֥וֹת הִ֖יא לְ/בֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'th qch lkh mchbt brzl vntth 'vth qyr brzl bynkh vbyn h'yr vhkhynth 't pnykh 'lyh vhyth bmtsvr vtsrt 'lyh 'vt hy' lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֤ה שְׁכַב֙ עַל צִדְּ/ךָ֣ הַ/שְּׂמָאלִ֔י וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת עֲוֺ֥ן בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלָ֑י/ו מִסְפַּ֤ר הַ/יָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עָלָ֔י/ו תִּשָּׂ֖א אֶת עֲוֺנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th shkhb 'l tsdkh hshm'ly vshmt 't 'vn byt yshr'l 'lyv mspr hymym 'shr tshkhb 'lyv tsh' 't 'vnm
verses.translation: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י נָתַ֤תִּֽי לְ/ךָ֙ אֶת שְׁנֵ֣י עֲוֺנָ֔/ם לְ/מִסְפַּ֣ר יָמִ֔ים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת וְ/תִשְׁעִ֖ים י֑וֹם וְ/נָשָׂ֖אתָ עֲוֺ֥ן בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'ny ntty lkh 't shny 'vnm lmspr ymym shlsh m'vt vtsh'ym yvm vnsh't 'vn byt yshr'l
verses.translation: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/כִלִּיתָ֣ אֶת אֵ֗לֶּה וְ/שָׁ֨כַבְתָּ֜ עַל צִדְּ/ךָ֤ ה/ימיני הַ/יְמָנִי֙ שֵׁנִ֔ית וְ/נָשָׂ֖אתָ אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן בֵּית יְהוּדָ֑ה אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם י֧וֹם לַ/שָּׁנָ֛ה י֥וֹם לַ/שָּׁנָ֖ה נְתַתִּ֥י/ו לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vkhlyt 't 'lh vshkhbt 'l tsdkh hymyny hymny shnyt vnsh't 't 'vn byt yhvdh 'rb'ym yvm yvm lshnh yvm lshnh nttyv lkh
verses.translation: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל מְצ֤וֹר יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ תָּכִ֣ין פָּנֶ֔י/ךָ וּֽ/זְרֹעֲ/ךָ֖ חֲשׂוּפָ֑ה וְ/נִבֵּאתָ֖ עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'l mtsvr yrvshlm tkhyn pnykh vzr'kh chshvph vnb't 'lyh
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי עָלֶ֖י/ךָ עֲבוֹתִ֑ים וְ/לֹֽא תֵהָפֵ֤ךְ מִֽ/צִּדְּ/ךָ֙ אֶל צִדֶּ֔/ךָ עַד כַּלּוֹתְ/ךָ֖ יְמֵ֥י מְצוּרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhnh ntty 'lykh 'bvtym vl' thpkh mtsdkh 'l tsdkh 'd khlvtkh ymy mtsvrkh
verses.translation: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה קַח לְ/ךָ֡ חִטִּ֡ין וּ֠/שְׂעֹרִים וּ/פ֨וֹל וַ/עֲדָשִׁ֜ים וְ/דֹ֣חַן וְ/כֻסְּמִ֗ים וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה אוֹתָ/ם֙ בִּ/כְלִ֣י אֶחָ֔ד וְ/עָשִׂ֧יתָ אוֹתָ֛/ם לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/לָ֑חֶם מִסְפַּ֨ר הַ/יָּמִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֣ה שׁוֹכֵ֣ב עַֽל צִדְּ/ךָ֗ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֧וֹת וְ/תִשְׁעִ֛ים י֖וֹם תֹּאכֲלֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: v'th qch lkh chtyn vsh'rym vpvl v'dshym vdchn vkhsmym vntth 'vtm bkhly 'chd v'shyt 'vtm lkh llchm mspr hymym 'shr 'th shvkhb 'l tsdkh shlsh m'vt vtsh'ym yvm t'khlnv
verses.translation: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.

verses.original: וּ/מַאֲכָֽלְ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכֲלֶ֔/נּוּ בְּ/מִשְׁק֕וֹל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שֶׁ֖קֶל לַ/יּ֑וֹם מֵ/עֵ֥ת עַד עֵ֖ת תֹּאכֲלֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vm'khlkh 'shr t'khlnv bmshqvl 'shrym shql lyvm m't 'd 't t'khlnv
verses.translation: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.

verses.original: וּ/מַ֛יִם בִּ/מְשׂוּרָ֥ה תִשְׁתֶּ֖ה שִׁשִּׁ֣ית הַ/הִ֑ין מֵ/עֵ֥ת עַד עֵ֖ת תִּשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: vmym bmshvrh tshth shshyt hhyn m't 'd 't tshth
verses.translation: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.

verses.original: וְ/עֻגַ֥ת שְׂעֹרִ֖ים תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֑/נָּה וְ/הִ֗יא בְּ/גֶֽלְלֵי֙ צֵאַ֣ת הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם תְּעֻגֶ֖/נָה לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'gt sh'rym t'khlnh vhy' bglly ts't h'dm t'gnh l'ynyhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה כָּ֣כָה יֹאכְל֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת לַחְמָ֖/ם טָמֵ֑א בַּ/גּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַדִּיחֵ֖/ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh khkhh y'khlv bny yshr'l 't lchmm tm' bgvym 'shr 'dychm shm
verses.translation: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖/י לֹ֣א מְטֻמָּאָ֑ה וּ/נְבֵלָ֨ה וּ/טְרֵפָ֤ה לֹֽא אָכַ֨לְתִּי֙ מִ/נְּעוּרַ֣/י וְ/עַד עַ֔תָּה וְ/לֹא בָ֥א בְּ/פִ֖/י בְּשַׂ֥ר פִּגּֽוּל
verses.translit: v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh hnh npshy l' mtm'h vnblh vtrph l' 'khlty mn'vry v'd 'th vl' b' bpy bshr pgvl
verses.translation: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD ! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י רְאֵ֗ה נָתַ֤תִּֽי לְ/ךָ֙ אֶת צפועי צְפִיעֵ֣י הַ/בָּקָ֔ר תַּ֖חַת גֶּלְלֵ֣י הָֽ/אָדָ֑ם וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶֽת לַחְמְ/ךָ֖ עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly r'h ntty lkh 't tspv'y tspy'y hbqr tcht glly h'dm v'shyt 't lchmkh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow’s dung for man’s dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י בֶּן אָדָם֙ הִנְ/נִ֨י שֹׁבֵ֤ר מַטֵּה לֶ֨חֶם֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/אָכְלוּ לֶ֥חֶם בְּ/מִשְׁקָ֖ל וּ/בִ/דְאָגָ֑ה וּ/מַ֕יִם בִּ/מְשׂוּרָ֥ה וּ/בְ/שִׁמָּמ֖וֹן יִשְׁתּֽוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm hnny shbr mth lchm byrvshlm v'khlv lchm bmshql vbd'gh vmym bmshvrh vbshmmvn yshtv
verses.translation: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:

verses.original: לְמַ֥עַן יַחְסְר֖וּ לֶ֣חֶם וָ/מָ֑יִם וְ/נָשַׁ֨מּוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ וְ/אָחִ֔י/ו וְ/נָמַ֖קּוּ בַּ/עֲוֺנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lm'n ychsrv lchm vmym vnshmv 'ysh v'chyv vnmqv b'vnm
verses.translation: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֨ה בֶן אָדָ֜ם קַח לְ/ךָ֣ חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּ֗ה תַּ֤עַר הַ/גַּלָּבִים֙ תִּקָּחֶ֣/נָּה לָּ֔/ךְ וְ/הַעֲבַרְתָּ֥ עַל רֹאשְׁ/ךָ֖ וְ/עַל זְקָנֶ֑/ךָ וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֥ לְ/ךָ֛ מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִשְׁקָ֖ל וְ/חִלַּקְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm qch lkh chrb chdh t'r hglbym tqchnh lkh vh'brt 'l r'shkh v'l zqnkh vlqcht lkh m'zny mshql vchlqtm
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber’s razor, and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair .

verses.original: שְׁלִשִׁ֗ית בָּ/א֤וּר תַּבְעִיר֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עִ֔יר כִּ/מְלֹ֖את יְמֵ֣י הַ/מָּצ֑וֹר וְ/לָֽקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֗ית תַּכֶּ֤ה בַ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ סְבִ֣יבוֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁית֙ תִּזְרֶ֣ה לָ/ר֔וּחַ וְ/חֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shlshyt b'vr tb'yr btvkh h'yr khml't ymy hmtsvr vlqcht 't hshlshyt tkhh bchrb sbybvtyh vhshlshyt tzrh lrvch vchrb 'ryq 'chryhm
verses.translation: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֥ מִ/שָּׁ֖ם מְעַ֣ט בְּ/מִסְפָּ֑ר וְ/צַרְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖/ם בִּ/כְנָפֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vlqcht mshm m't bmspr vtsrt 'vtm bkhnpykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/הֶם֙ ע֣וֹד תִּקָּ֔ח וְ/הִשְׁלַכְתָּ֤ אוֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הָ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/שָׂרַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ מִמֶּ֥/נּוּ תֵצֵא אֵ֖שׁ אֶל כָּל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vmhm 'vd tqch vhshlkht 'vtm 'l tvkh h'sh vshrpt 'tm b'sh mmnv tts' 'sh 'l khl byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֔ה זֹ֚את יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם שַׂמְתִּ֑י/הָ וּ/סְבִיבוֹתֶ֖י/הָ אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh z't yrvshlm btvkh hgvym shmtyh vsbybvtyh 'rtsvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.

verses.original: וַ/תֶּ֨מֶר אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֤/י לְ/רִשְׁעָה֙ מִן הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/אֶ֨ת חֻקּוֹתַ֔/י מִן הָ/אֲרָצ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבוֹתֶ֑י/הָ כִּ֤י בְ/מִשְׁפָּטַ/י֙ מָאָ֔סוּ וְ/חֻקּוֹתַ֖/י לֹא הָלְכ֥וּ בָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vtmr 't mshpty lrsh'h mn hgvym v't chqvty mn h'rtsvt 'shr sbybvtyh khy bmshpty m'sv vchqvty l' hlkhv bhm
verses.translation: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה יַ֤עַן הֲמָנְ/כֶם֙ מִן הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/חֻקּוֹתַ/י֙ לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י לֹ֣א עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וּֽ/כְ/מִשְׁפְּטֵ֧י הַ/גּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם לֹ֥א עֲשִׂיתֶֽם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n hmnkhm mn hgvym 'shr sbybvtykhm bchqvty l' hlkhtm v't mshpty l' 'shytm vkhmshpty hgvym 'shr sbybvtykhm l' 'shytm
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֥י עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ גַּם אָ֑נִי וְ/עָשִׂ֧יתִי בְ/תוֹכֵ֛/ךְ מִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים לְ/עֵינֵ֥י הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh gm 'ny v'shyty btvkhkh mshptym l'yny hgvym
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I, even I, am against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.
