verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתִי בָ֗/ךְ אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְ/אֵ֛ת אֲשֶֽׁר לֹֽא אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה כָמֹ֖/הוּ ע֑וֹד יַ֖עַן כָּל תּוֹעֲבֹתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'shyty bkh 't 'shr l' 'shyty v't 'shr l' ''shh khmhv 'vd y'n khl tv'btykh
verses.translation: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן אָב֞וֹת יֹאכְל֤וּ בָנִים֙ בְּ/תוֹכֵ֔/ךְ וּ/בָנִ֖ים יֹאכְל֣וּ אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתִי בָ/ךְ֙ שְׁפָטִ֔ים וְ/זֵרִיתִ֥י אֶת כָּל שְׁאֵרִיתֵ֖/ךְ לְ/כָל רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: lkhn 'bvt y'khlv bnym btvkhkh vbnym y'khlv 'bvtm v'shyty bkh shptym vzryty 't khl sh'rytkh lkhl rvch
verses.translation: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן חַי אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ אִם לֹ֗א יַ֚עַן אֶת מִקְדָּשִׁ֣/י טִמֵּ֔את בְּ/כָל שִׁקּוּצַ֖יִ/ךְ וּ/בְ/כָל תּוֹעֲבֹתָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/גַם אֲנִ֤י אֶגְרַע֙ וְ/לֹא תָח֣וֹס עֵינִ֔/י וְ/גַם אֲנִ֖י לֹ֥א אֶחְמֽוֹל
verses.translit: lkhn chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm l' y'n 't mqdshy tm't bkhl shqvtsykh vbkhl tv'btykh vgm 'ny 'gr' vl' tchvs 'yny vgm 'ny l' 'chmvl
verses.translation: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD ; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.

verses.original: שְׁלִשִׁתֵ֞/יךְ בַּ/דֶּ֣בֶר יָמ֗וּתוּ וּ/בָֽ/רָעָב֙ יִכְל֣וּ בְ/תוֹכֵ֔/ךְ וְ/הַ֨/שְּׁלִשִׁ֔ית בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב יִפְּל֣וּ סְבִיבוֹתָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁית֙ לְ/כָל ר֣וּחַ אֱזָרֶ֔ה וְ/חֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shlshtykh bdbr ymvtv vbr'b ykhlv btvkhkh vhshlshyt bchrb yplv sbybvtykh vhshlyshyt lkhl rvch 'zrh vchrb 'ryq 'chryhm
verses.translation: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

verses.original: וְ/כָלָ֣ה אַפִּ֗/י וַ/הֲנִחוֹתִ֧י חֲמָתִ֛/י בָּ֖/ם וְ/הִנֶּחָ֑מְתִּי וְֽ/יָדְע֞וּ כִּי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ בְּ/קִנְאָתִ֔/י בְּ/כַלּוֹתִ֥/י חֲמָתִ֖/י בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vkhlh 'py vhnchvty chmty bm vhnchmty vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh dbrty bqn'ty bkhlvty chmty bm
verses.translation: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.

verses.original: וְ/אֶתְּנֵ/ךְ֙ לְ/חָרְבָּ֣ה וּ/לְ/חֶרְפָּ֔ה בַּ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבוֹתָ֑יִ/ךְ לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל עוֹבֵֽר
verses.translit: v'tnkh lchrbh vlchrph bgvym 'shr sbybvtykh l'yny khl 'vbr
verses.translation: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.

verses.original: וְֽ/הָ֨יְתָ֜ה חֶרְפָּ֤ה וּ/גְדוּפָה֙ מוּסָ֣ר וּ/מְשַׁמָּ֔ה לַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבוֹתָ֑יִ/ךְ בַּ/עֲשׂוֹתִ/י֩ בָ֨/ךְ שְׁפָטִ֜ים בְּ/אַ֤ף וּ/בְ/חֵמָה֙ וּ/בְ/תֹכְח֣וֹת חֵמָ֔ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: vhyth chrph vgdvph mvsr vmshmh lgvym 'shr sbybvtykh b'shvty bkh shptym b'f vbchmh vbtkhchvt chmh 'ny yhvh dbrty
verses.translation: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken it .

verses.original: בְּֽ/שַׁלְּחִ֡/י אֶת חִצֵּי֩ הָ/רָעָ֨ב הָ/רָעִ֤ים בָּ/הֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לְ/מַשְׁחִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אוֹתָ֖/ם לְ/שַֽׁחֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/רָעָב֙ אֹסֵ֣ף עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/שָׁבַרְתִּ֥י לָ/כֶ֖ם מַטֵּה לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: bshlchy 't chtsy hr'b hr'ym bhm 'shr hyv lmshchyt 'shr 'shlch 'vtm lshchtkhm vr'b 'sf 'lykhm vshbrty lkhm mth lchm
verses.translation: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּ֣י עֲ֠לֵי/כֶם רָעָ֞ב וְ/חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ וְ/שִׁכְּלֻ֔/ךְ וְ/דֶ֥בֶר וָ/דָ֖ם יַעֲבָר בָּ֑/ךְ וְ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ אָבִ֣יא עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: vshlchty 'lykhm r'b vchyh r'h vshkhlkh vdbr vdm y'br bkh vchrb 'by' 'lykh 'ny yhvh dbrty
verses.translation: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken it .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ אֶל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הִנָּבֵ֖א אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: bn 'dm shym pnykh 'l hry yshr'l vhnb' 'lyhm
verses.translation: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,

verses.original: וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְ֠הוִה לֶ/הָרִ֨ים וְ/לַ/גְּבָע֜וֹת לָ/אֲפִיקִ֣ים ו/ל/גאית וְ/לַ/גֵּאָי֗וֹת הִנְ/נִ֨י אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְ/אִבַּדְתִּ֖י בָּמֽוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mrt hry yshr'l shm'v dbr 'dny yhvh khh 'mr 'dny yhvh lhrym vlgb'vt l'pyqym vlg'yt vlg'yvt hnny 'ny mby' 'lykhm chrb v'bdty bmvtykhm
verses.translation: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD ; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.

verses.original: וְ/נָשַׁ֨מּוּ֙ מִזְבְּח֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נִשְׁבְּר֖וּ חַמָּֽנֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הִפַּלְתִּי֙ חַלְלֵי/כֶ֔ם לִ/פְנֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vnshmv mzbchvtykhm vnshbrv chmnykhm vhplty chllykhm lpny glvlykhm
verses.translation: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֗י אֶת פִּגְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ/פְנֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/זֵרִיתִי֙ אֶת עַצְמ֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם סְבִיב֖וֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vntty 't pgry bny yshr'l lpny glvlyhm vzryty 't 'tsmvtykhm sbybvt mzbchvtykhm
verses.translation: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.

verses.original: בְּ/כֹל֙ מוֹשְׁב֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם הֶ/עָרִ֣ים תֶּחֱרַ֔בְנָה וְ/הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת תִּישָׁ֑מְנָה לְמַעַן֩ יֶחֶרְב֨וּ וְ/יֶאְשְׁמ֜וּ מִזְבְּחֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/נִשְׁבְּר֤וּ וְ/נִשְׁבְּתוּ֙ גִּלּ֣וּלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נִגְדְּעוּ֙ חַמָּ֣נֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נִמְח֖וּ מַעֲשֵׂי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: bkhl mvshbvtykhm h'rym tchrbnh vhbmvt tyshmnh lm'n ychrbv vy'shmv mzbchvtykhm vnshbrv vnshbtv glvlykhm vngd'v chmnykhm vnmchv m'shykhm
verses.translation: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

verses.original: וְ/נָפַ֥ל חָלָ֖ל בְּ/תֽוֹכְ/כֶ֑ם וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnpl chll btvkhkhm vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הוֹתַרְתִּ֗י בִּ/הְי֥וֹת לָ/כֶ֛ם פְּלִ֥יטֵי חֶ֖רֶב בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם בְּ/הִזָּרֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם בָּ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhvtrty bhyvt lkhm plyty chrb bgvym bhzrvtykhm b'rtsvt
verses.translation: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.

verses.original: וְ/זָכְר֨וּ פְלִֽיטֵי/כֶ֜ם אוֹתִ֗/י בַּ/גּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבּוּ שָׁם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֜רְתִּי אֶת לִבָּ֣/ם הַ/זּוֹנֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁר סָר֙ מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י וְ/אֵת֙ עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֔ם הַ/זֹּנ֕וֹת אַחֲרֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/נָקֹ֨טּוּ֙ בִּ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם אֶל הָֽ/רָעוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֔וּ לְ/כֹ֖ל תּוֹעֲבֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vzkhrv plytykhm 'vty bgvym 'shr nshbv shm 'shr nshbrty 't lbm hzvnh 'shr sr m'ly v't 'ynyhm hznvt 'chry glvlyhm vnqtv bpnyhm 'l hr'vt 'shr 'shv lkhl tv'btyhm
verses.translation: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֤א אֶל חִנָּם֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ/הֶ֖ם הָ/רָעָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh l' 'l chnm dbrty l'shvt lhm hr'h hz't
verses.translation: And they shall know that I am the LORD , and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הַכֵּ֨ה בְ/כַפְּ/ךָ֜ וּ/רְקַ֤ע בְּ/רַגְלְ/ךָ֙ וֶֽ/אֱמָר אָ֔ח אֶ֛ל כָּל תּוֹעֲב֥וֹת רָע֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֗ר בַּ/חֶ֛רֶב בָּ/רָעָ֥ב וּ/בַ/דֶּ֖בֶר יִפֹּֽלוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hkhh bkhpkh vrq' brglkh v'mr 'ch 'l khl tv'bvt r'vt byt yshr'l 'shr bchrb br'b vbdbr yplv
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

verses.original: הָ/רָח֞וֹק בַּ/דֶּ֣בֶר יָמ֗וּת וְ/הַ/קָּרוֹב֙ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יִפּ֔וֹל וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁאָר֙ וְ/הַ/נָּצ֔וּר בָּ/רָעָ֖ב יָמ֑וּת וְ/כִלֵּיתִ֥י חֲמָתִ֖/י בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: hrchvq bdbr ymvt vhqrvb bchrb ypvl vhnsh'r vhntsvr br'b ymvt vkhlyty chmty bm
verses.translation: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.

verses.original: וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בִּֽ/הְי֣וֹת חַלְלֵי/הֶ֗ם בְּ/תוֹךְ֙ גִּלּ֣וּלֵי/הֶ֔ם סְבִיב֖וֹת מִזְבְּחֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם אֶל֩ כָּל גִּבְעָ֨ה רָמָ֜ה בְּ/כֹ֣ל רָאשֵׁ֣י הֶ/הָרִ֗ים וְ/תַ֨חַת כָּל עֵ֤ץ רַֽעֲנָן֙ וְ/תַ֨חַת֙ כָּל אֵלָ֣ה עֲבֻתָּ֔ה מְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתְנוּ שָׁם֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ לְ/כֹ֖ל גִּלּוּלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh bhyvt chllyhm btvkh glvlyhm sbybvt mzbchvtyhm 'l khl gb'h rmh bkhl r'shy hhrym vtcht khl 'ts r'nn vtcht khl 'lh 'bth mqvm 'shr ntnv shm rych nychch lkhl glvlyhm
verses.translation: Then shall ye know that I am the LORD , when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.

verses.original: וְ/נָטִ֤יתִי אֶת יָדִ/י֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י אֶת הָ/אָ֜רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֤ה וּ/מְשַׁמָּה֙ מִ/מִּדְבַּ֣ר דִּבְלָ֔תָ/ה בְּ/כֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vntyty 't ydy 'lyhm vntty 't h'rts shmmh vmshmh mmdbr dblth bkhl mvshbvtyhm vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם כֹּה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֧/י יְהוִ֛ה לְ/אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל קֵ֑ץ בָּ֣א הַ/קֵּ֔ץ עַל ארבעת אַרְבַּ֖ע כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l'dmt yshr'l qts b' hqts 'l 'rb't 'rb' khnpvt h'rts
verses.translation: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.

verses.translit: 'th hqts 'lykh vshlchty 'py bkh vshpttykh khdrkhykh vntty 'lykh 't khl tv'btykh
verses.translation: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֛/י עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ וְ/לֹ֣א אֶחְמ֑וֹל כִּ֣י דְרָכַ֜יִ/ךְ עָלַ֣יִ/ךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְ/תוֹעֲבוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בְּ/תוֹכֵ֣/ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vl' tchvs 'yny 'lykh vl' 'chmvl khy drkhykh 'lykh 'tn vtv'bvtykh btvkhkh thyyn vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה רָעָ֛ה אַחַ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִנֵּ֥ה בָאָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh r'h 'cht r'h hnh b'h
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.

verses.original: קֵ֣ץ בָּ֔א בָּ֥א הַ/קֵּ֖ץ הֵקִ֣יץ אֵלָ֑יִ/ךְ הִנֵּ֖ה בָּאָֽה
verses.translit: qts b' b' hqts hqyts 'lykh hnh b'h
verses.translation: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.

verses.original: בָּ֧אָה הַ/צְּפִירָ֛ה אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָ/אָ֑רֶץ בָּ֣א הָ/עֵ֗ת קָר֛וֹב הַ/יּ֥וֹם מְהוּמָ֖ה וְ/לֹא הֵ֥ד הָרִֽים
verses.translit: b'h htspyrh 'lykh yvshb h'rts b' h't qrvb hyvm mhvmh vl' hd hrym
verses.translation: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.

verses.original: עַתָּ֣ה מִ/קָּר֗וֹב אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ חֲמָתִ/י֙ עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/כִלֵּיתִ֤י אַפִּ/י֙ בָּ֔/ךְ וּ/שְׁפַטְתִּ֖י/ךְ כִּ/דְרָכָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל תּוֹעֲבוֹתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'th mqrvb 'shpvkh chmty 'lykh vkhlyty 'py bkh vshpttykh khdrkhykh vntty 'lykh 't khl tv'bvtykh
verses.translation: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖/י וְ/לֹ֣א אֶחְמ֑וֹל כִּ/דְרָכַ֜יִ/ךְ עָלַ֣יִ/ךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְ/תוֹעֲבוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בְּ/תוֹכֵ֣/ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מַכֶּֽה
verses.translit: vl' tchvs 'yny vl' 'chmvl khdrkhykh 'lykh 'tn vtv'bvtykh btvkhkh thyyn vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh mkhh
verses.translation: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/יּ֖וֹם הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֑ה יָֽצְאָה֙ הַ/צְּפִרָ֔ה צָ֚ץ הַ/מַּטֶּ֔ה פָּרַ֖ח הַ/זָּדֽוֹן
verses.translit: hnh hyvm hnh b'h yts'h htsprh tsts hmth prch hzdvn
verses.translation: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.

verses.original: הֶ/חָמָ֥ס קָ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּה רֶ֑שַׁע לֹא מֵ/הֶ֞ם וְ/לֹ֧א מֵ/הֲמוֹנָ֛/ם וְ/לֹ֥א מֶ/הֱמֵ/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹא נֹ֥הַּ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hchms qm lmth rsh' l' mhm vl' mhmvnm vl' mhmhm vl' nh bhm
verses.translation: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain , nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.

verses.original: בָּ֤א הָ/עֵת֙ הִגִּ֣יעַ הַ/יּ֔וֹם הַ/קּוֹנֶה֙ אַל יִשְׂמָ֔ח וְ/הַ/מּוֹכֵ֖ר אַל יִתְאַבָּ֑ל כִּ֥י חָר֖וֹן אֶל כָּל הֲמוֹנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: b' h't hgy' hyvm hqvnh 'l yshmch vhmvkhr 'l yt'bl khy chrvn 'l khl hmvnh
verses.translation: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ/מּוֹכֵ֗ר אֶל הַ/מִּמְכָּר֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְ/ע֥וֹד בַּ/חַיִּ֖ים חַיָּתָ֑/ם כִּֽי חָז֤וֹן אֶל כָּל הֲמוֹנָ/הּ֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְ/אִ֧ישׁ בַּ/עֲוֺנ֛/וֹ חַיָּת֖/וֹ לֹ֥א יִתְחַזָּֽקוּ
verses.translit: khy hmvkhr 'l hmmkhr l' yshvb v'vd bchyym chytm khy chzvn 'l khl hmvnh l' yshvb v'ysh b'vnv chytv l' ytchzqv
verses.translation: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

verses.original: תָּקְע֤וּ בַ/תָּק֨וֹעַ֙ וְ/הָכִ֣ין הַ/כֹּ֔ל וְ/אֵ֥ין הֹלֵ֖ךְ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֥י חֲרוֹנִ֖/י אֶל כָּל הֲמוֹנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: tq'v btqv' vhkhyn hkhl v'yn hlkh lmlchmh khy chrvny 'l khl hmvnh
verses.translation: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

verses.original: הַ/חֶ֣רֶב בַּ/ח֔וּץ וְ/הַ/דֶּ֥בֶר וְ/הָ/רָעָ֖ב מִ/בָּ֑יִת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶה֙ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּת וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ/עִ֔יר רָעָ֥ב וָ/דֶ֖בֶר יֹאכֲלֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: hchrb bchvts vhdbr vhr'b mbyt 'shr bshdh bchrb ymvt v'shr b'yr r'b vdbr y'khlnv
verses.translation: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.

verses.original: וּ/פָֽלְטוּ֙ פְּלִ֣יטֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הָי֣וּ אֶל הֶ/הָרִ֗ים כְּ/יוֹנֵ֧י הַ/גֵּאָי֛וֹת כֻּלָּ֖/ם הֹמ֑וֹת אִ֖ישׁ בַּ/עֲוֺנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vpltv plytyhm vhyv 'l hhrym khyvny hg'yvt khlm hmvt 'ysh b'vnv
verses.translation: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/יָּדַ֖יִם תִּרְפֶּ֑ינָה וְ/כָל בִּרְכַּ֖יִם תֵּלַ֥כְנָה מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: khl hydym trpynh vkhl brkhym tlkhnh mym
verses.translation: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.

verses.original: וְ/חָגְר֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים וְ/כִסְּתָ֥ה אוֹתָ֖/ם פַּלָּצ֑וּת וְ/אֶ֤ל כָּל פָּנִים֙ בּוּשָׁ֔ה וּ/בְ/כָל רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם קָרְחָֽה
verses.translit: vchgrv shqym vkhsth 'vtm pltsvt v'l khl pnym bvshh vbkhl r'shyhm qrchh
verses.translation: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.

verses.original: כַּסְפָּ֞/ם בַּ/חוּצ֣וֹת יַשְׁלִ֗יכוּ וּ/זְהָבָ/ם֮ לְ/נִדָּ֣ה יִֽהְיֶה֒ כַּסְפָּ֨/ם וּ/זְהָבָ֜/ם לֹֽא יוּכַ֣ל לְ/הַצִּילָ֗/ם בְּ/יוֹם֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה נַפְשָׁ/ם֙ לֹ֣א יְשַׂבֵּ֔עוּ וּ/מֵעֵי/הֶ֖ם לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑אוּ כִּֽי מִכְשׁ֥וֹל עֲוֺנָ֖/ם הָיָֽה
verses.translit: khspm bchvtsvt yshlykhv vzhbm lndh yhyh khspm vzhbm l' yvkhl lhtsylm byvm 'brt yhvh npshm l' yshb'v vm'yhm l' yml'v khy mkhshvl 'vnm hyh
verses.translation: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD : they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

verses.original: וּ/צְבִ֤י עֶדְי/וֹ֙ לְ/גָא֣וֹן שָׂמָ֔/הוּ וְ/צַלְמֵ֧י תוֹעֲבֹתָ֛/ם שִׁקּוּצֵי/הֶ֖ם עָ֣שׂוּ ב֑/וֹ עַל כֵּ֛ן נְתַתִּ֥י/ו לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/נִדָּֽה
verses.translit: vtsby 'dyv lg'vn shmhv vtslmy tv'btm shqvtsyhm 'shv bv 'l khn nttyv lhm lndh
verses.translation: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.

verses.original: וּ/נְתַתִּ֤י/ו בְּ/יַֽד הַ/זָּרִים֙ לָ/בַ֔ז וּ/לְ/רִשְׁעֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/שָׁלָ֑ל ו/חלל/ה וְ/חִלְּלֽוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: vnttyv byd hzrym lbz vlrsh'y h'rts lshll vchllh vchllvhv
verses.translation: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.

verses.original: וַ/הֲסִבּוֹתִ֤י פָנַ/י֙ מֵ/הֶ֔ם וְ/חִלְּל֖וּ אֶת צְפוּנִ֑/י וּ/בָאוּ בָ֥/הּ פָּרִיצִ֖ים וְ/חִלְּלֽוּ/הָ
verses.translit: vhsbvty pny mhm vchllv 't tspvny vb'v bh prytsym vchllvh
verses.translation: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֖ה הָֽ/רַתּ֑וֹק כִּ֣י הָ/אָ֗רֶץ מָֽלְאָה֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּמִ֔ים וְ/הָ/עִ֖יר מָלְאָ֥ה חָמָֽס
verses.translit: 'shh hrtvq khy h'rts ml'h mshpt dmym vh'yr ml'h chms
verses.translation: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

verses.original: וְ/הֵֽבֵאתִי֙ רָעֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם וְ/יָרְשׁ֖וּ אֶת בָּֽתֵּי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּא֣וֹן עַזִּ֔ים וְ/נִחֲל֖וּ מְקַֽדְשֵׁי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhb'ty r'y gvym vyrshv 't btyhm vhshbty g'vn 'zym vnchlv mqdshyhm
verses.translation: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

verses.original: קְפָ֖דָה בָ֑א וּ/בִקְשׁ֥וּ שָׁל֖וֹם וָ/אָֽיִן
verses.translit: qpdh b' vbqshv shlvm v'yn
verses.translation: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.

verses.original: הֹוָ֤ה עַל הֹוָה֙ תָּב֔וֹא וּ/שְׁמֻעָ֥ה אֶל שְׁמוּעָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה וּ/בִקְשׁ֤וּ חָזוֹן֙ מִ/נָּבִ֔יא וְ/תוֹרָה֙ תֹּאבַ֣ד מִ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/עֵצָ֖ה מִ/זְּקֵנִֽים
verses.translit: hvh 'l hvh tbv' vshm'h 'l shmv'h thyh vbqshv chzvn mnby' vtvrh t'bd mkhhn v'tsh mzqnym
verses.translation: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.

verses.original: הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ יִתְאַבָּ֗ל וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וִ/ידֵ֥י עַם הָ/אָ֖רֶץ תִּבָּהַ֑לְנָה מִ/דַּרְכָּ֞/ם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה אוֹתָ/ם֙ וּ/בְ/מִשְׁפְּטֵי/הֶ֣ם אֶשְׁפְּטֵ֔/ם וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hmlkh yt'bl vnshy' ylbsh shmmh vydy 'm h'rts tbhlnh mdrkhm ''shh 'vtm vbmshptyhm 'shptm vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֗ית בַּ/שִּׁשִּׁי֙ בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ אֲנִי֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּ/בֵיתִ֔/י וְ/זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יוֹשְׁבִ֣ים לְ/פָנָ֑/י וַ/תִּפֹּ֤ל עָלַ/י֙ שָׁ֔ם יַ֖ד אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hshshyt bshshy bchmshh lchdsh 'ny yvshb bbyty vzqny yhvdh yvshbym lpny vtpl 'ly shm yd 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.

verses.original: וָ/אֶרְאֶ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה דְמוּת֙ כְּ/מַרְאֵה אֵ֔שׁ מִ/מַּרְאֵ֥ה מָתְנָ֛י/ו וּ/לְ/מַ֖טָּה אֵ֑שׁ וּ/מִ/מָּתְנָ֣י/ו וּ/לְ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כְּ/מַרְאֵה זֹ֖הַר כְּ/עֵ֥ין הַ/חַשְׁמַֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: v'r'h vhnh dmvt khmr'h 'sh mmr'h mtnyv vlmth 'sh vmmtnyv vlm'lh khmr'h zhr kh'yn hchshmlh
verses.translation: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ תַּבְנִ֣ית יָ֔ד וַ/יִּקָּחֵ֖/נִי בְּ/צִיצִ֣ת רֹאשִׁ֑/י וַ/תִּשָּׂ֣א אֹתִ֣/י ר֣וּחַ בֵּֽין הָ/אָ֣רֶץ וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/שָּׁמַ֡יִם וַ/תָּבֵא֩ אֹתִ֨/י יְרוּשָׁלְַ֜מָ/ה בְּ/מַרְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל פֶּ֜תַח שַׁ֤עַר הַ/פְּנִימִית֙ הַ/פּוֹנֶ֣ה צָפ֔וֹנָ/ה אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֣ם מוֹשַׁ֔ב סֵ֖מֶל הַ/קִּנְאָ֥ה הַ/מַּקְנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch tbnyt yd vyqchny btsytst r'shy vtsh' 'ty rvch byn h'rts vbyn hshmym vtb' 'ty yrvshlmh bmr'vt 'lhym 'l ptch sh'r hpnymyt hpvnh tspvnh 'shr shm mvshb sml hqn'h hmqnh
verses.translation: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.

verses.original: וְ/הִ֨נֵּה שָׁ֔ם כְּב֖וֹד אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּ/מַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי בַּ/בִּקְעָֽה
verses.translit: vhnh shm khbvd 'lhy yshr'l khmr'h 'shr r'yty bbq'h
verses.translation: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שָׂא נָ֥א עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ דֶּ֣רֶךְ צָפ֑וֹנָ/ה וָ/אֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַ/י֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ צָפ֔וֹנָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה מִ/צָּפוֹן֙ לְ/שַׁ֣עַר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ סֵ֛מֶל הַ/קִּנְאָ֥ה הַ/זֶּ֖ה בַּ/בִּאָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm sh' n' 'ynykh drkh tspvnh v'sh' 'yny drkh tspvnh vhnh mtspvn lsh'r hmzbch sml hqn'h hzh bb'h
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הֲ/רֹאֶ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה מ/הם מָ֣ה הֵ֣ם עֹשִׂ֑ים תּוֹעֵב֨וֹת גְּדֹל֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֹשִׂ֣ים פֹּ֗ה לְ/רָֽחֳקָה֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל מִקְדָּשִׁ֔/י וְ/עוֹד֙ תָּשׁ֣וּב תִּרְאֶ֔ה תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm hr'h 'th mhm mh hm 'shym tv'bvt gdlvt 'shr byt yshr'l 'shym ph lrchqh m'l mqdshy v'vd tshvb tr'h tv'bvt gdlvt
verses.translation: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֹתִ֖/י אֶל פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽ/חָצֵ֑ר וָ/אֶרְאֶ֕ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה חֹר אֶחָ֖ד בַּ/קִּֽיר
verses.translit: vyb' 'ty 'l ptch hchtsr v'r'h vhnh chr 'chd bqyr
verses.translation: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י בֶּן אָדָ֖ם חֲתָר נָ֣א בַ/קִּ֑יר וָ/אֶחְתֹּ֣ר בַּ/קִּ֔יר וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה פֶּ֥תַח אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm chtr n' bqyr v'chtr bqyr vhnh ptch 'chd
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י בֹּ֤א וּ/רְאֵה֙ אֶת הַ/תּוֹעֵב֣וֹת הָ/רָע֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם עֹשִׂ֖ים פֹּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly b' vr'h 't htv'bvt hr'vt 'shr hm 'shym ph
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.

verses.original: וָ/אָבוֹא֮ וָֽ/אֶרְאֶה֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה כָל תַּבְנִ֜ית רֶ֤מֶשׂ וּ/בְהֵמָה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶץ וְ/כָל גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מְחֻקֶּ֥ה עַל הַ/קִּ֖יר סָבִ֥יב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: v'bv' v'r'h vhnh khl tbnyt rmsh vbhmh shqts vkhl glvly byt yshr'l mchqh 'l hqyr sbyb sbyb
verses.translation: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֣ישׁ מִ/זִּקְנֵ֣י בֵֽית יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וְ/יַאֲזַנְיָ֨הוּ בֶן שָׁפָ֜ן עֹמֵ֤ד בְּ/תוֹכָ/ם֙ עֹמְדִ֣ים לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אִ֥ישׁ מִקְטַרְתּ֖/וֹ בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וַ/עֲתַ֥ר עֲנַֽן הַ/קְּטֹ֖רֶת עֹלֶֽה
verses.translit: vshb'ym 'ysh mzqny byt yshr'l vy'znyhv bn shpn 'md btvkhm 'mdym lpnyhm v'ysh mqtrtv bydv v'tr 'nn hqtrt 'lh
verses.translation: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ/י֮ הֲ/רָאִ֣יתָ בֶן אָדָם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר זִקְנֵ֤י בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּ/חֹ֔שֶׁךְ אִ֖ישׁ בְּ/חַדְרֵ֣י מַשְׂכִּית֑/וֹ כִּ֣י אֹמְרִ֗ים אֵ֤ין יְהוָה֙ רֹאֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔/נוּ עָזַ֥ב יְהוָ֖ה אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hr'yt bn 'dm 'shr zqny byt yshr'l 'shym bchshkh 'ysh bchdry mshkhytv khy 'mrym 'yn yhvh r'h 'tnv 'zb yhvh 't h'rts
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'vd tshvb tr'h tv'bvt gdlvt 'shr hmh 'shym
verses.translation: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֣א אֹתִ֗/י אֶל פֶּ֨תַח֙ שַׁ֣עַר בֵּית יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶל הַ/צָּפ֑וֹנָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּה שָׁם֙ הַ/נָּשִׁ֣ים יֹֽשְׁב֔וֹת מְבַכּ֖וֹת אֶת הַ/תַּמּֽוּז
verses.translit: vyb' 'ty 'l ptch sh'r byt yhvh 'shr 'l htspvnh vhnh shm hnshym yshbvt mbkhvt 't htmvz
verses.translation: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֖/י הֲ/רָאִ֣יתָ בֶן אָדָ֑ם ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת מֵ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hr'yt bn 'dm 'vd tshvb tr'h tv'bvt gdlvt m'lh
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this , O son of man? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֣א אֹתִ֗/י אֶל חֲצַ֣ר בֵּית יְהוָה֮ הַ/פְּנִימִית֒ וְ/הִנֵּה פֶ֜תַח הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֗ה בֵּ֤ין הָֽ/אוּלָם֙ וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ אֲחֹ֨רֵי/הֶ֜ם אֶל הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ וּ/פְנֵי/הֶ֣ם קֵ֔דְמָ/ה וְ/הֵ֛מָּה מִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֥ם קֵ֖דְמָ/ה לַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vyb' 'ty 'l chtsr byt yhvh hpnymyt vhnh ptch hykhl yhvh byn h'vlm vbyn hmzbch kh'shrym vchmshh 'ysh 'chryhm 'l hykhl yhvh vpnyhm qdmh vhmh mshtchvytm qdmh lshmsh
verses.translation: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD , between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD , and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ/י֮ הֲ/רָאִ֣יתָ בֶן אָדָם֒ הֲ/נָקֵל֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה מֵ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת אֶת הַ/תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשׂוּ פֹ֑ה כִּֽי מָלְא֨וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֜רֶץ חָמָ֗ס וַ/יָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ לְ/הַכְעִיסֵ֔/נִי וְ/הִנָּ֛/ם שֹׁלְחִ֥ים אֶת הַ/זְּמוֹרָ֖ה אֶל אַפָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hr'yt bn 'dm hnql lbyt yhvdh m'shvt 't htv'bvt 'shr 'shv ph khy ml'v 't h'rts chms vyshbv lhkh'ysny vhnm shlchym 't hzmvrh 'l 'pm
verses.translation: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this , O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִי֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה בְ/חֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖/י וְ/לֹ֣א אֶחְמֹ֑ל וְ/קָרְא֤וּ בְ/אָזְנַ/י֙ ק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל וְ/לֹ֥א אֶשְׁמַ֖ע אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vgm 'ny ''shh bchmh l' tchvs 'yny vl' 'chml vqr'v b'zny qvl gdvl vl' 'shm' 'vtm
verses.translation: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א בְ/אָזְנַ֗/י ק֤וֹל גָּדוֹל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר קָרְב֖וּ פְּקֻדּ֣וֹת הָ/עִ֑יר וְ/אִ֛ישׁ כְּלִ֥י מַשְׁחֵת֖/וֹ בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqr' b'zny qvl gdvl l'mr qrbv pqdvt h'yr v'ysh khly mshchtv bydv
verses.translation: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה שִׁשָּׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֡ים בָּאִ֣ים מִ/דֶּרֶךְ שַׁ֨עַר הָ/עֶלְי֜וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָפְנֶ֣ה צָפ֗וֹנָ/ה וְ/אִ֨ישׁ כְּלִ֤י מַפָּצ/וֹ֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וְ/אִישׁ אֶחָ֤ד בְּ/תוֹכָ/ם֙ לָבֻ֣שׁ בַּדִּ֔ים וְ/קֶ֥סֶת הַ/סֹּפֵ֖ר בְּ/מָתְנָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ וַ/יַּ֣עַמְד֔וּ אֵ֖צֶל מִזְבַּ֥ח הַ/נְּחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vhnh shshh 'nshym b'ym mdrkh sh'r h'lyvn 'shr mpnh tspvnh v'ysh khly mptsv bydv v'ysh 'chd btvkhm lbsh bdym vqst hspr bmtnyv vyb'v vy'mdv 'tsl mzbch hnchsht
verses.translation: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.

verses.original: וּ/כְב֣וֹד אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַעֲלָה֙ מֵ/עַ֤ל הַ/כְּרוּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה עָלָ֔י/ו אֶ֖ל מִפְתַּ֣ן הַ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/יִּקְרָ֗א אֶל הָ/אִישׁ֙ הַ/לָּבֻ֣שׁ הַ/בַּדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר קֶ֥סֶת הַ/סֹּפֵ֖ר בְּ/מָתְנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vkhbvd 'lhy yshr'l n'lh m'l hkhrvb 'shr hyh 'lyv 'l mptn hbyt vyqr' 'l h'ysh hlbsh hbdym 'shr qst hspr bmtnyv
verses.translation: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer’s inkhorn by his side;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אל/ו אֵלָ֔י/ו עֲבֹר֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עִ֔יר בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/הִתְוִ֨יתָ תָּ֜ו עַל מִצְח֣וֹת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַ/נֶּֽאֱנָחִים֙ וְ/הַ/נֶּ֣אֱנָקִ֔ים עַ֚ל כָּל הַ/תּ֣וֹעֵב֔וֹת הַֽ/נַּעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lv 'lyv 'br btvkh h'yr btvkh yrvshlm vhtvyt tv 'l mtschvt h'nshym hn'nchym vhn'nqym 'l khl htv'bvt hn'shvt btvkhh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אָמַ֣ר בְּ/אָזְנַ֔/י עִבְר֥וּ בָ/עִ֛יר אַחֲרָ֖י/ו וְ/הַכּ֑וּ על אַל תָּחֹ֥ס עיני/כם עֵינְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/אַל תַּחְמֹֽלוּ
verses.translit: vl'lh 'mr b'zny 'brv b'yr 'chryv vhkhv 'l 'l tchs 'ynykhm 'ynkhm v'l tchmlv
verses.translation: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:

verses.original: זָקֵ֡ן בָּח֣וּר וּ/בְתוּלָה֩ וְ/טַ֨ף וְ/נָשִׁ֜ים תַּהַרְג֣וּ לְ/מַשְׁחִ֗ית וְ/עַל כָּל אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר עָלָ֤י/ו הַ/תָּו֙ אַל תִּגַּ֔שׁוּ וּ/מִ/מִּקְדָּשִׁ֖/י תָּחֵ֑לּוּ וַ/יָּחֵ֨לּוּ֙ בָּ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הַ/זְּקֵנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: zqn bchvr vbtvlh vtf vnshym thrgv lmshchyt v'l khl 'ysh 'shr 'lyv htv 'l tgshv vmmqdshy tchlv vychlv b'nshym hzqnym 'shr lpny hbyt
verses.translation: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם טַמְּא֣וּ אֶת הַ/בַּ֗יִת וּ/מַלְא֧וּ אֶת הַ/חֲצֵר֛וֹת חֲלָלִ֖ים צֵ֑אוּ וְ/יָצְא֖וּ וְ/הִכּ֥וּ בָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm tm'v 't hbyt vml'v 't hchtsrvt chllym ts'v vyts'v vhkhv b'yr
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כְּ/הַכּוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/נֵֽאשֲׁאַ֖ר אָ֑נִי וָ/אֶפְּלָ֨/ה עַל פָּנַ֜/י וָ/אֶזְעַ֗ק וָֽ/אֹמַר֙ אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הֲ/מַשְׁחִ֣ית אַתָּ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/שָׁפְכְּ/ךָ֥ אֶת חֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy khhkhvtm vn'sh'r 'ny v'plh 'l pny v'z'q v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh hmshchyt 'th 't khl sh'ryt yshr'l bshpkhkh 't chmtkh 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD ! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י עֲוֺ֨ן בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ גָּדוֹל֙ בִּ/מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַ/תִּמָּלֵ֤א הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ דָּמִ֔ים וְ/הָ/עִ֖יר מָלְאָ֣ה מֻטֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י אָמְר֗וּ עָזַ֤ב יְהוָה֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/אֵ֥ין יְהוָ֖ה רֹאֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'vn byt yshr'l vyhvdh gdvl bm'd m'd vtml' h'rts dmym vh'yr ml'h mth khy 'mrv 'zb yhvh 't h'rts v'yn yhvh r'h
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֨ם אֲנִ֔י לֹא תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖/י וְ/לֹ֣א אֶחְמֹ֑ל דַּרְכָּ֖/ם בְּ/רֹאשָׁ֥/ם נָתָֽתִּי
verses.translit: vgm 'ny l' tchvs 'yny vl' 'chml drkhm br'shm ntty
verses.translation: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֞ה הָ/אִ֣ישׁ לְבֻ֣שׁ הַ/בַּדִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הַ/קֶּ֨סֶת֙ בְּ/מָתְנָ֔י/ו מֵשִׁ֥יב דָּבָ֖ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר עָשִׂ֕יתִי כ/אשר כְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vhnh h'ysh lbsh hbdym 'shr hqst bmtnyv mshyb dbr l'mr 'shyty kh'shr khkhl 'shr tsvytny
verses.translation: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.

verses.original: וָ/אֶרְאֶ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֶל הָ/רָקִ֨יעַ֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/כְּרֻבִ֔ים כְּ/אֶ֣בֶן סַפִּ֔יר כְּ/מַרְאֵ֖ה דְּמ֣וּת כִּסֵּ֑א נִרְאָ֖ה עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'r'h vhnh 'l hrqy' 'shr 'l r'sh hkhrbym kh'bn spyr khmr'h dmvt khs' nr'h 'lyhm
verses.translation: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר אֶל הָ/אִ֣ישׁ לְבֻ֣שׁ הַ/בַּדִּ֗ים וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר בֹּא֩ אֶל בֵּינ֨וֹת לַ/גַּלְגַּ֜ל אֶל תַּ֣חַת לַ/כְּר֗וּב וּ/מַלֵּ֨א חָפְנֶ֤י/ךָ גַֽחֲלֵי אֵשׁ֙ מִ/בֵּינ֣וֹת לַ/כְּרֻבִ֔ים וּ/זְרֹ֖ק עַל הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יָּבֹ֖א לְ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l h'ysh lbsh hbdym vy'mr b' 'l bynvt lglgl 'l tcht lkhrvb vml' chpnykh gchly 'sh mbynvt lkhrbym vzrq 'l h'yr vyb' l'yny
verses.translation: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כְּרֻבִ֗ים עֹֽמְדִ֛ים מִ/ימִ֥ין לַ/בַּ֖יִת בְּ/בֹא֣/וֹ הָ/אִ֑ישׁ וְ/הֶ/עָנָ֣ן מָלֵ֔א אֶת הֶ/חָצֵ֖ר הַ/פְּנִימִֽית
verses.translit: vhkhrbym 'mdym mymyn lbyt bb'v h'ysh vh'nn ml' 't hchtsr hpnymyt
verses.translation: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤רָם כְּבוֹד יְהוָה֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/כְּר֔וּב עַ֖ל מִפְתַּ֣ן הַ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֤א הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ אֶת הֶ֣/עָנָ֔ן וְ/הֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ מָֽלְאָ֔ה אֶת נֹ֖גַהּ כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyrm khbvd yhvh m'l hkhrvb 'l mptn hbyt vyml' hbyt 't h'nn vhchtsr ml'h 't ngh khbvd yhvh
verses.translation: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.

verses.original: וְ/קוֹל֙ כַּנְפֵ֣י הַ/כְּרוּבִ֔ים נִשְׁמַ֕ע עַד הֶ/חָצֵ֖ר הַ/חִיצֹנָ֑ה כְּ/ק֥וֹל אֵל שַׁדַּ֖י בְּ/דַבְּרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vqvl khnpy hkhrvbym nshm' 'd hchtsr hchytsnh khqvl 'l shdy bdbrv
verses.translation: And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/צַוֺּת/וֹ֙ אֶת הָ/אִ֤ישׁ לְבֻֽשׁ הַ/בַּדִּים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר קַ֥ח אֵשׁ֙ מִ/בֵּינ֣וֹת לַ/גַּלְגַּ֔ל מִ/בֵּינ֖וֹת לַ/כְּרוּבִ֑ים וַ/יָּבֹא֙ וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֔ד אֵ֖צֶל הָ/אוֹפָֽן
verses.translit: vyhy btsvtv 't h'ysh lbsh hbdym l'mr qch 'sh mbynvt lglgl mbynvt lkhrvbym vyb' vy'md 'tsl h'vpn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ הַ/כְּר֨וּב אֶת יָד֜/וֹ מִ/בֵּינ֣וֹת לַ/כְּרוּבִ֗ים אֶל הָ/אֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בֵּינ֣וֹת הַ/כְּרֻבִ֔ים וַ/יִּשָּׂא֙ וַ/יִּתֵּ֔ן אֶל חָפְנֵ֖י לְבֻ֣שׁ הַ/בַּדִּ֑ים וַ/יִּקַּ֖ח וַ/יֵּצֵֽא
verses.translit: vyshlch hkhrvb 't ydv mbynvt lkhrvbym 'l h'sh 'shr bynvt hkhrbym vysh' vytn 'l chpny lbsh hbdym vyqch vyts'
verses.translation: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof , and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it , and went out.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֖א לַ/כְּרֻבִ֑ים תַּבְנִית֙ יַד אָדָ֔ם תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyr' lkhrbym tbnyt yd 'dm tcht khnpyhm
verses.translation: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.

verses.original: וָ/אֶרְאֶ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה אוֹפַנִּים֮ אֵ֣צֶל הַ/כְּרוּבִים֒ אוֹפַ֣ן אֶחָ֗ד אֵ֚צֶל הַ/כְּר֣וּב אֶחָ֔ד וְ/אוֹפַ֣ן אֶחָ֔ד אֵ֖צֶל הַ/כְּר֣וּב אֶחָ֑ד וּ/מַרְאֵה֙ הָ/א֣וֹפַנִּ֔ים כְּ/עֵ֖ין אֶ֥בֶן תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ
verses.translit: v'r'h vhnh 'rb'h 'vpnym 'tsl hkhrvbym 'vpn 'chd 'tsl hkhrvb 'chd v'vpn 'chd 'tsl hkhrvb 'chd vmr'h h'vpnym kh'yn 'bn trshysh
verses.translation: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.

verses.original: וּ/מַ֨רְאֵי/הֶ֔ם דְּמ֥וּת אֶחָ֖ד לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֑/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יִהְיֶ֥ה הָ/אוֹפַ֖ן בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/אוֹפָֽן
verses.translit: vmr'yhm dmvt 'chd l'rb'tm kh'shr yhyh h'vpn btvkh h'vpn
verses.translation: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.

verses.original: בְּ/לֶכְתָּ֗/ם אֶל אַרְבַּ֤עַת רִבְעֵי/הֶם֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּ/לֶכְתָּ֑/ם כִּ֣י הַ/מָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִפְנֶ֤ה הָ/רֹאשׁ֙ אַחֲרָ֣י/ו יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּ/לֶכְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: blkhtm 'l 'rb't rb'yhm ylkhv l' ysbv blkhtm khy hmqvm 'shr ypnh hr'sh 'chryv ylkhv l' ysbv blkhtm
verses.translation: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.

verses.original: וְ/כָל בְּשָׂרָ/ם֙ וְ/גַבֵּ/הֶ֔ם וִֽ/ידֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/כַנְפֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הָ/אֽוֹפַנִּ֗ים מְלֵאִ֤ים עֵינַ֨יִם֙ סָבִ֔יב לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֖/ם אוֹפַנֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl bshrm vgbhm vydyhm vkhnpyhm vh'vpnym ml'ym 'ynym sbyb l'rb'tm 'vpnyhm
verses.translation: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.

verses.original: לָ/א֖וֹפַנִּ֑ים לָ/הֶ֛ם קוֹרָ֥א הַ/גַּלְגַּ֖ל בְּ/אָזְנָֽ/י
verses.translit: l'vpnym lhm qvr' hglgl b'zny
verses.translation: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה פָנִ֖ים לְ/אֶחָ֑ד פְּנֵ֨י הָ/אֶחָ֜ד פְּנֵ֣י הַ/כְּר֗וּב וּ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/שֵּׁנִי֙ פְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁי֙ פְּנֵ֣י אַרְיֵ֔ה וְ/הָ/רְבִיעִ֖י פְּנֵי נָֽשֶׁר
verses.translit: v'rb'h pnym l'chd pny h'chd pny hkhrvb vpny hshny pny 'dm vhshlyshy pny 'ryh vhrby'y pny nshr
verses.translation: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרֹ֖מּוּ הַ/כְּרוּבִ֑ים הִ֣יא הַ/חַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי בִּֽ/נְהַר כְּבָֽר
verses.translit: vyrmv hkhrvbym hy' hchyh 'shr r'yty bnhr khbr
verses.translation: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ הַ/כְּרוּבִ֔ים יֵלְכ֥וּ הָ/אוֹפַנִּ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑/ם וּ/בִ/שְׂאֵ֨ת הַ/כְּרוּבִ֜ים אֶת כַּנְפֵי/הֶ֗ם לָ/רוּם֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לֹא יִסַּ֧בּוּ הָ/אוֹפַנִּ֛ים גַּם הֵ֖ם מֵ/אֶצְלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vblkht hkhrvbym ylkhv h'vpnym 'tslm vbsh't hkhrvbym 't khnpyhm lrvm m'l h'rts l' ysbv h'vpnym gm hm m'tslm
verses.translation: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.

verses.original: בְּ/עָמְדָ֣/ם יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ וּ/בְ/רוֹמָ֖/ם יֵר֣וֹמּוּ אוֹתָ֑/ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַ/חַיָּ֖ה בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: b'mdm y'mdv vbrvmm yrvmv 'vtm khy rvch hchyh bhm
verses.translation: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מֵ/עַ֖ל מִפְתַּ֣ן הַ/בָּ֑יִת וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֖ד עַל הַ/כְּרוּבִֽים
verses.translit: vyts' khbvd yhvh m'l mptn hbyt vy'md 'l hkhrvbym
verses.translation: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂא֣וּ הַ/כְּרוּבִ֣ים אֶת כַּ֠נְפֵי/הֶם וַ/יֵּר֨וֹמּוּ מִן הָ/אָ֤רֶץ לְ/עֵינַ/י֙ בְּ/צֵאתָ֔/ם וְ/הָ/אֽוֹפַנִּ֖ים לְ/עֻמָּתָ֑/ם וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֗ד פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֤עַר בֵּית יְהוָה֙ הַ/קַּדְמוֹנִ֔י וּ/כְב֧וֹד אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vysh'v hkhrvbym 't khnpyhm vyrvmv mn h'rts l'yny bts'tm vh'vpnym l'mtm vy'md ptch sh'r byt yhvh hqdmvny vkhbvd 'lhy yshr'l 'lyhm mlm'lh
verses.translation: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

verses.original: הִ֣יא הַ/חַיָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֛יתִי תַּ֥חַת אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּֽ/נְהַר כְּבָ֑ר וָ/אֵדַ֕ע כִּ֥י כְרוּבִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: hy' hchyh 'shr r'yty tcht 'lhy yshr'l bnhr khbr v'd' khy khrvbym hmh
verses.translation: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.

verses.original: אַרְבָּעָ֨ה אַרְבָּעָ֤ה פָנִים֙ לְ/אֶחָ֔ד וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְ/אֶחָ֑ד וּ/דְמוּת֙ יְדֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'rb'h 'rb'h pnym l'chd v'rb' khnpym l'chd vdmvt ydy 'dm tcht khnpyhm
verses.translation: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

verses.original: וּ/דְמ֣וּת פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם הֵ֣מָּה הַ/פָּנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָאִ֨יתִי֙ עַל נְהַר כְּבָ֔ר מַרְאֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/אוֹתָ֑/ם אִ֛ישׁ אֶל עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖י/ו יֵלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: vdmvt pnyhm hmh hpnym 'shr r'yty 'l nhr khbr mr'yhm v'vtm 'ysh 'l 'br pnyv ylkhv
verses.translation: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשָּׂ֨א אֹתִ֜/י ר֗וּחַ וַ/תָּבֵ֣א אֹ֠תִ/י אֶל שַׁ֨עַר בֵּית יְהוָ֤ה הַ/קַּדְמוֹנִי֙ הַ/פּוֹנֶ֣ה קָדִ֔ימָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּה֙ בְּ/פֶ֣תַח הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ וָ/אֶרְאֶ֨ה בְ/תוֹכָ֜/ם אֶת יַאֲזַנְיָ֧ה בֶן עַזֻּ֛ר וְ/אֶת פְּלַטְיָ֥הוּ בֶן בְּנָיָ֖הוּ שָׂרֵ֖י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vtsh' 'ty rvch vtb' 'ty 'l sh'r byt yhvh hqdmvny hpvnh qdymh vhnh bptch hsh'r 'shrym vchmshh 'ysh v'r'h btvkhm 't y'znyh bn 'zr v't pltyhv bn bnyhv shry h'm
verses.translation: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD’s house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י בֶּן אָדָ֕ם אֵ֣לֶּה הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֞ים הַ/חֹשְׁבִ֥ים אָ֛וֶן וְ/הַ/יֹּעֲצִ֥ים עֲצַת רָ֖ע בָּ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm 'lh h'nshym hchshbym 'vn vhy'tsym 'tst r' b'yr hz't
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:

verses.original: הָ/אֹ֣מְרִ֔ים לֹ֥א בְ/קָר֖וֹב בְּנ֣וֹת בָּתִּ֑ים הִ֣יא הַ/סִּ֔יר וַ/אֲנַ֖חְנוּ הַ/בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: h'mrym l' bqrvb bnvt btym hy' hsyr v'nchnv hbshr
verses.translation: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֖ן הִנָּבֵ֣א עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם הִנָּבֵ֖א בֶּן אָדָֽם
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' 'lyhm hnb' bn 'dm
verses.translation: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

verses.original: וַ/תִּפֹּ֣ל עָלַ/י֮ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָה֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י אֱמֹר֙ כֹּה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כֵּ֥ן אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/מַעֲל֥וֹת רֽוּחֲ/כֶ֖ם אֲנִ֥י יְדַעְתִּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vtpl 'ly rvch yhvh vy'mr 'ly 'mr khh 'mr yhvh khn 'mrtm byt yshr'l vm'lvt rvchkhm 'ny yd'tyh
verses.translation: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD ; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.

verses.original: הִרְבֵּיתֶ֥ם חַלְלֵי/כֶ֖ם בָּ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֑את וּ/מִלֵּאתֶ֥ם חוּצֹתֶ֖י/הָ חָלָֽל
verses.translit: hrbytm chllykhm b'yr hz't vml'tm chvtstyh chll
verses.translation: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ חַלְלֵי/כֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שַׂמְתֶּ֣ם בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/הּ הֵ֥מָּה הַ/בָּשָׂ֖ר וְ/הִ֣יא הַ/סִּ֑יר וְ/אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם הוֹצִ֥יא מִ/תּוֹכָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh chllykhm 'shr shmtm btvkhh hmh hbshr vhy' hsyr v'tkhm hvtsy' mtvkhh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

verses.original: חֶ֖רֶב יְרֵאתֶ֑ם וְ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ אָבִ֣יא עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: chrb yr'tm vchrb 'by' 'lykhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/הוֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מִ/תּוֹכָ֔/הּ וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/יַד זָרִ֑ים וְ/עָשִׂ֛יתִי בָ/כֶ֖ם שְׁפָטִֽים
verses.translit: vhvts'ty 'tkhm mtvkhh vntty 'tkhm byd zrym v'shyty bkhm shptym
verses.translation: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

verses.original: בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב תִּפֹּ֔לוּ עַל גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶשְׁפּ֣וֹט אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bchrb tplv 'l gbvl yshr'l 'shpvt 'tkhm vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: הִ֗יא לֹֽא תִהְיֶ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ לְ/סִ֔יר וְ/אַתֶּ֛ם תִּהְי֥וּ בְ/תוֹכָ֖/הּ לְ/בָשָׂ֑ר אֶל גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hy' l' thyh lkhm lsyr v'tm thyv btvkhh lbshr 'l gbvl yshr'l 'shpt 'tkhm
verses.translation: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:

verses.original: וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּ/חֻקַּ/י֙ לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י לֹ֣א עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וּֽ/כְ/מִשְׁפְּטֵ֧י הַ/גּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם עֲשִׂיתֶֽם
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh 'shr bchqy l' hlkhtm vmshpty l' 'shytm vkhmshpty hgvym 'shr sbybvtykhm 'shytm
verses.translation: And ye shall know that I am the LORD : for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כְּ/הִנָּ֣בְאִ֔/י וּ/פְלַטְיָ֥הוּ בֶן בְּנָיָ֖ה מֵ֑ת וָ/אֶפֹּ֨ל עַל פָּנַ֜/י וָ/אֶזְעַ֣ק קוֹל גָּד֗וֹל וָ/אֹמַר֙ אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה כָּלָה֙ אַתָּ֣ה עֹשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy khhnb'y vpltyhv bn bnyh mt v'pl 'l pny v'z'q qvl gdvl v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh khlh 'th 'shh 't sh'ryt yshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD ! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם אַחֶ֤י/ךָ אַחֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י גְאֻלָּתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/כָל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּ֑/ה אֲשֶׁר֩ אָמְר֨וּ לָ/הֶ֜ם יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם רַֽחֲקוּ֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לָ֥/נוּ הִ֛יא נִתְּנָ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/מוֹרָשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bn 'dm 'chykh 'chykh 'nshy g'ltkh vkhl byt yshr'l khlh 'shr 'mrv lhm yshby yrvshlm rchqv m'l yhvh lnv hy' ntnh h'rts lmvrshh
verses.translation: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD : unto us is this land given in possession.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן אֱמֹ֗ר כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ כִּ֤י הִרְחַקְתִּי/ם֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/כִ֥י הֲפִֽיצוֹתִ֖י/ם בָּ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת וָ/אֱהִ֤י לָ/הֶם֙ לְ/מִקְדָּ֣שׁ מְעַ֔ט בָּ/אֲרָצ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥אוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr khh 'mr 'dny yhvh khy hrchqtym bgvym vkhy hpytsvtym b'rtsvt v'hy lhm lmqdsh m't b'rtsvt 'shr b'v shm
verses.translation: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן אֱמֹ֗ר כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ וְ/קִבַּצְתִּ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מִן הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים וְ/אָסַפְתִּ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם מִן הָ֣/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפֹצוֹתֶ֖ם בָּ/הֶ֑ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vqbtsty 'tkhm mn h'mym v'spty 'tkhm mn h'rtsvt 'shr nptsvtm bhm vntty lkhm 't 'dmt yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֖אוּ שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וְ/הֵסִ֜ירוּ אֶת כָּל שִׁקּוּצֶ֛י/הָ וְ/אֶת כָּל תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶ֖י/הָ מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vb'v shmh vhsyrv 't khl shqvtsyh v't khl tv'bvtyh mmnh
verses.translation: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י לָ/הֶם֙ לֵ֣ב אֶחָ֔ד וְ/ר֥וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֑ם וַ/הֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י לֵ֤ב הָ/אֶ֨בֶן֙ מִ/בְּשָׂרָ֔/ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vntty lhm lb 'chd vrvch chdshh 'tn bqrbkhm vhsrty lb h'bn mbshrm vntty lhm lb bshr
verses.translation: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן֙ בְּ/חֻקֹּתַ֣/י יֵלֵ֔כוּ וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֥/י יִשְׁמְר֖וּ וְ/עָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֑/ם וְ/הָיוּ לִ֣/י לְ/עָ֔ם וַ/אֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: lm'n bchqty ylkhv v't mshpty yshmrv v'shv 'tm vhyv ly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל לֵ֧ב שִׁקּוּצֵי/הֶ֛ם וְ/תוֹעֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם לִבָּ֣/ם הֹלֵ֑ךְ דַּרְכָּ/ם֙ בְּ/רֹאשָׁ֣/ם נָתַ֔תִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: v'l lb shqvtsyhm vtv'bvtyhm lbm hlkh drkhm br'shm ntty n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂא֤וּ הַ/כְּרוּבִים֙ אֶת כַּנְפֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הָ/אֽוֹפַנִּ֖ים לְ/עֻמָּתָ֑/ם וּ/כְב֧וֹד אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vysh'v hkhrvbym 't khnpyhm vh'vpnym l'mtm vkhbvd 'lhy yshr'l 'lyhm mlm'lh
verses.translation: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מֵ/עַ֖ל תּ֣וֹךְ הָ/עִ֑יר וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹד֙ עַל הָ/הָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִ/קֶּ֥דֶם לָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vy'l khbvd yhvh m'l tvkh h'yr vy'md 'l hhr 'shr mqdm l'yr
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

verses.original: וְ/ר֣וּחַ נְשָׂאַ֗תְ/נִי וַ/תְּבִיאֵ֤/נִי כַשְׂדִּ֨ימָ/ה֙ אֶל הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה בַּ/מַּרְאֶ֖ה בְּ/ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י הַ/מַּרְאֶ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִֽיתִי
verses.translit: vrvch nsh'tny vtby'ny khshdymh 'l hgvlh bmr'h brvch 'lhym vy'l m'ly hmr'h 'shr r'yty
verses.translation: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

verses.original: וָ/אֲדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל הַ/גּוֹלָ֑ה אֵ֛ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶרְאָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'dbr 'l hgvlh 't khl dbry yhvh 'shr hr'ny
verses.translation: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ בֵּית הַ/מֶּ֖רִי אַתָּ֣ה יֹשֵׁ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֵינַיִם֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם לִ/רְא֜וֹת וְ/לֹ֣א רָא֗וּ אָזְנַ֨יִם לָ/הֶ֤ם לִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽם
verses.translit: bn 'dm btvkh byt hmry 'th yshb 'shr 'ynym lhm lr'vt vl' r'v 'znym lhm lshm' vl' shm'v khy byt mry hm
verses.translation: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְ/ךָ֙ כְּלֵ֣י גוֹלָ֔ה וּ/גְלֵ֥ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְ/עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/גָלִ֨יתָ מִ/מְּקוֹמְ/ךָ֜ אֶל מָק֤וֹם אַחֵר֙ לְ/עֵ֣ינֵי/הֶ֔ם אוּלַ֣י יִרְא֔וּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm 'shh lkh khly gvlh vglh yvmm l'ynyhm vglyt mmqvmkh 'l mqvm 'chr l'ynyhm 'vly yr'v khy byt mry hmh
verses.translation: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹצֵאתָ֨ כֵלֶ֜י/ךָ כִּ/כְלֵ֥י גוֹלָ֛ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְ/עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אַתָּ֗ה תֵּצֵ֤א בָ/עֶ֨רֶב֙ לְ/עֵ֣ינֵי/הֶ֔ם כְּ/מוֹצָאֵ֖י גּוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vhvts't khlykh khkhly gvlh yvmm l'ynyhm v'th tts' b'rb l'ynyhm khmvts'y gvlh
verses.translation: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.

verses.original: לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֖ם חֲתָר לְ/ךָ֣ בַ/קִּ֑יר וְ/הוֹצֵאתָ֖ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'ynyhm chtr lkh bqyr vhvts't bv
verses.translation: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.

verses.original: לְ/עֵ֨ינֵי/הֶ֜ם עַל כָּתֵ֤ף תִּשָּׂא֙ בָּ/עֲלָטָ֣ה תוֹצִ֔יא פָּנֶ֣י/ךָ תְכַסֶּ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א תִרְאֶ֖ה אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי מוֹפֵ֥ת נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לְ/בֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: l'ynyhm 'l khtf tsh' b'lth tvtsy' pnykh tkhsh vl' tr'h 't h'rts khy mvpt nttykh lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.

verses.original: וָ/אַ֣עַשׂ כֵּן֮ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צֻוֵּיתִי֒ כֵּ֠לַ/י הוֹצֵ֜אתִי כִּ/כְלֵ֤י גוֹלָה֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וּ/בָ/עֶ֛רֶב חָתַֽרְתִּי לִ֥/י בַ/קִּ֖יר בְּ/יָ֑ד בָּ/עֲלָטָ֥ה הוֹצֵ֛אתִי עַל כָּתֵ֥ף נָשָׂ֖אתִי לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v''sh khn kh'shr tsvyty khly hvts'ty khkhly gvlh yvmm vb'rb chtrty ly bqyr byd b'lth hvts'ty 'l khtf nsh'ty l'ynyhm
verses.translation: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֧י דְבַר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖/י בַּ/בֹּ֥קֶר לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly bbqr l'mr
verses.translation: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הֲ/לֹ֨א אָמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑רִי מָ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה עֹשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: bn 'dm hl' 'mrv 'lykh byt yshr'l byt hmry mh 'th 'shh
verses.translation: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֑ה הַ/נָּשִׂ֞יא הַ/מַּשָּׂ֤א הַ/זֶּה֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/כָל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁר הֵ֥מָּה בְ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'mr 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnshy' hmsh' hzh byrvshlm vkhl byt yshr'l 'shr hmh btvkhm
verses.translation: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.

verses.original: אֱמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י מֽוֹפֶתְ/כֶ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתִי כֵּ֚ן יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָ/הֶ֔ם בַּ/גּוֹלָ֥ה בַ/שְּׁבִ֖י יֵלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: 'mr 'ny mvptkhm kh'shr 'shyty khn y'shh lhm bgvlh bshby ylkhv
verses.translation: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נָּשִׂ֨יא אֲשֶׁר בְּ/תוֹכָ֜/ם אֶל כָּתֵ֤ף יִשָּׂא֙ בָּ/עֲלָטָ֣ה וְ/יֵצֵ֔א בַּ/קִּ֥יר יַחְתְּר֖וּ לְ/ה֣וֹצִיא ב֑/וֹ פָּנָ֣י/ו יְכַסֶּ֔ה יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא יִרְאֶ֥ה לַ/עַ֛יִן ה֖וּא אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhnshy' 'shr btvkhm 'l khtf ysh' b'lth vyts' bqyr ychtrv lhvtsy' bv pnyv ykhsh y'n 'shr l' yr'h l'yn hv' 't h'rts
verses.translation: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.

verses.original: וּ/פָרַשְׂתִּ֤י אֶת רִשְׁתִּ/י֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/נִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּ/מְצֽוּדָתִ֑/י וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֨י אֹת֤/וֹ בָבֶ֨לָ/ה֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְ/אוֹתָ֥/הּ לֹֽא יִרְאֶ֖ה וְ/שָׁ֥ם יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vprshty 't rshty 'lyv vntpsh bmtsvdty vhb'ty 'tv bblh 'rts khshdym v'vth l' yr'h vshm ymvt
verses.translation: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר סְבִיבֹתָ֥י/ו עזר/ה עֶזְר֛/וֹ וְ/כָל אֲגַפָּ֖י/ו אֱזָרֶ֣ה לְ/כָל ר֑וּחַ וְ/חֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr sbybtyv 'zrh 'zrv vkhl 'gpyv 'zrh lkhl rvch vchrb 'ryq 'chryhm
verses.translation: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בַּ/הֲפִיצִ֤/י אוֹתָ/ם֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/זֵרִיתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖/ם בָּ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh bhpytsy 'vtm bgvym vzryty 'vtm b'rtsvt
verses.translation: And they shall know that I am the LORD , when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹתַרְתִּ֤י מֵ/הֶם֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר מֵ/חֶ֖רֶב מֵ/רָעָ֣ב וּ/מִ/דָּ֑בֶר לְמַ֨עַן יְסַפְּר֜וּ אֶת כָּל תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם בַּ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhvtrty mhm 'nshy mspr mchrb mr'b vmdbr lm'n ysprv 't khl tv'bvtyhm bgvym 'shr b'v shm vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם לַחְמְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/רַ֣עַשׁ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּ/מֵימֶ֕י/ךָ בְּ/רָגְזָ֥ה וּ/בִ/דְאָגָ֖ה תִּשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: bn 'dm lchmkh br'sh t'khl vmymykh brgzh vbd'gh tshth
verses.translation: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶל עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֡רֶץ כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨/י יְהוִ֜ה לְ/יוֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶל אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַחְמָ/ם֙ בִּ/דְאָגָ֣ה יֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּ/מֵֽימֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּ/שִׁמָּמ֣וֹן יִשְׁתּ֑וּ לְמַ֜עַן תֵּשַׁ֤ם אַרְצָ/הּ֙ מִ/מְּלֹאָ֔/הּ מֵ/חֲמַ֖ס כָּֽל הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'mrt 'l 'm h'rts khh 'mr 'dny yhvh lyvshby yrvshlm 'l 'dmt yshr'l lchmm bd'gh y'khlv vmymyhm bshmmvn yshtv lm'n tshm 'rtsh mml'h mchms khl hyshbym bh
verses.translation: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.

verses.original: וְ/הֶ/עָרִ֤ים הַ/נּֽוֹשָׁבוֹת֙ תֶּחֱרַ֔בְנָה וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vh'rym hnvshbvt tchrbnh vh'rts shmmh thyh vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם מָֽה הַ/מָּשָׁ֤ל הַ/זֶּה֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם עַל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יַֽאַרְכוּ֙ הַ/יָּמִ֔ים וְ/אָבַ֖ד כָּל חָזֽוֹן
verses.translit: bn 'dm mh hmshl hzh lkhm 'l 'dmt yshr'l l'mr y'rkhv hymym v'bd khl chzvn
verses.translation: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ הִשְׁבַּ֨תִּי֙ אֶת הַ/מָּשָׁ֣ל הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא יִמְשְׁל֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ ע֖וֹד בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֚י אִם דַּבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם קָֽרְבוּ֙ הַ/יָּמִ֔ים וּ/דְבַ֖ר כָּל חָזֽוֹן
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hshbty 't hmshl hzh vl' ymshlv 'tv 'vd byshr'l khy 'm dbr 'lyhm qrbv hymym vdbr khl chzvn
verses.translation: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד כָּל חֲז֥וֹן שָׁ֖וְא וּ/מִקְסַ֣ם חָלָ֑ק בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy l' yhyh 'vd khl chzvn shv' vmqsm chlq btvkh byt yshr'l
verses.translation: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲדַבֵּר֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וְ/יֵ֣עָשֶׂ֔ה לֹ֥א תִמָּשֵׁ֖ךְ ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י בִֽ/ימֵי/כֶ֞ם בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֗רִי אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וַ/עֲשִׂיתִ֔י/ו נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh 'dbr 't 'shr 'dbr dbr vy'shh l' tmshkh 'vd khy bymykhm byt hmry 'dbr dbr v'shytyv n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: For I am the LORD : I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם הִנֵּ֤ה בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹֽמְרִ֔ים הֶ/חָז֛וֹן אֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא חֹזֶ֖ה לְ/יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וּ/לְ/עִתִּ֥ים רְחוֹק֖וֹת ה֥וּא נִבָּֽא
verses.translit: bn 'dm hnh byt yshr'l 'mrym hchzvn 'shr hv' chzh lymym rbym vl'tym rchvqvt hv' nb'
verses.translation: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come , and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה לֹא תִמָּשֵׁ֥ךְ ע֖וֹד כָּל דְּבָרָ֑/י אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וְ/יֵ֣עָשֶׂ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l' tmshkh 'vd khl dbry 'shr 'dbr dbr vy'shh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵ֛א אֶל נְבִיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַ/נִּבָּאִ֑ים וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִ/נְבִיאֵ֣י מִ/לִּבָּ֔/ם שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'dm hnb' 'l nby'y yshr'l hnb'ym v'mrt lnby'y mlbm shm'v dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD ;

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה ה֖וֹי עַל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֣ים הַ/נְּבָלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹלְכִ֛ים אַחַ֥ר רוּחָ֖/ם וּ/לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י רָאֽוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hvy 'l hnby'ym hnblym 'shr hlkhym 'chr rvchm vlblty r'v
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

verses.original: כְּ/שֻׁעָלִ֖ים בָּ/חֳרָב֑וֹת נְבִיאֶ֥י/ךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָיֽוּ
verses.translit: khsh'lym bchrbvt nby'ykh yshr'l hyv
verses.translation: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

verses.original: לֹ֤א עֲלִיתֶם֙ בַּ/פְּרָצ֔וֹת וַ/תִּגְדְּר֥וּ גָדֵ֖ר עַל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַ/עֲמֹ֥ד בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה בְּ/י֥וֹם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: l' 'lytm bprtsvt vtgdrv gdr 'l byt yshr'l l'md bmlchmh byvm yhvh
verses.translation: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD .

verses.original: חָ֤זוּ שָׁוְא֙ וְ/קֶ֣סֶם כָּזָ֔ב הָ/אֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שְׁלָחָ֑/ם וְ/יִֽחֲל֖וּ לְ/קַיֵּ֥ם דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: chzv shv' vqsm khzb h'mrym n'm yhvh vyhvh l' shlchm vychlv lqym dbr
verses.translation: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֤וֹא מַֽחֲזֵה שָׁוְא֙ חֲזִיתֶ֔ם וּ/מִקְסַ֥ם כָּזָ֖ב אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם וְ/אֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וַ/אֲנִ֖י לֹ֥א דִבַּֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: hlv' mchzh shv' chzytm vmqsm khzb 'mrtm v'mrym n'm yhvh v'ny l' dbrty
verses.translation: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith it; albeit I have not spoken?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְ/כֶ֣ם שָׁ֔וְא וַ/חֲזִיתֶ֖ם כָּזָ֑ב לָ/כֵן֙ הִנְ/נִ֣י אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n dbrkhm shv' vchzytm khzb lkhn hnny 'lykhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה יָדִ֗/י אֶֽל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֞ים הַ/חֹזִ֣ים שָׁוְא֮ וְ/הַ/קֹּסְמִ֣ים כָּזָב֒ בְּ/ס֧וֹד עַמִּ֣/י לֹֽא יִהְי֗וּ וּ/בִ/כְתָ֤ב בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֣א יִכָּתֵ֔בוּ וְ/אֶל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑אוּ וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vhyth ydy 'l hnby'ym hchzym shv' vhqsmym khzb bsvd 'my l' yhyv vbkhtb byt yshr'l l' ykhtbv v'l 'dmt yshr'l l' yb'v vyd'tm khy 'ny 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD .

verses.original: יַ֣עַן וּ/בְ/יַ֜עַן הִטְע֧וּ אֶת עַמִּ֛/י לֵ/אמֹ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם וְ/אֵ֣ין שָׁל֑וֹם וְ/הוּא֙ בֹּ֣נֶה חַ֔יִץ וְ/הִנָּ֛/ם טָחִ֥ים אֹת֖/וֹ תָּפֵֽל
verses.translit: y'n vby'n ht'v 't 'my l'mr shlvm v'yn shlvm vhv' bnh chyts vhnm tchym 'tv tpl
verses.translation: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:

verses.original: אֱמֹ֛ר אֶל טָחֵ֥י תָפֵ֖ל וְ/יִפֹּ֑ל הָיָ֣ה גֶּ֣שֶׁם שׁוֹטֵ֗ף וְ/אַתֵּ֜נָה אַבְנֵ֤י אֶלְגָּבִישׁ֙ תִּפֹּ֔לְנָה וְ/ר֥וּחַ סְעָר֖וֹת תְּבַקֵּֽעַ
verses.translit: 'mr 'l tchy tpl vypl hyh gshm shvtf v'tnh 'bny 'lgbysh tplnh vrvch s'rvt tbq'
verses.translation: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter , that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it .

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה נָפַ֣ל הַ/קִּ֑יר הֲ/לוֹא֙ יֵאָמֵ֣ר אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם אַיֵּ֥ה הַ/טִּ֖יחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר טַחְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vhnh npl hqyr hlv' y'mr 'lykhm 'yh htych 'shr tchtm
verses.translation: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it ?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וּ/בִקַּעְתִּ֥י רֽוּחַ סְעָר֖וֹת בַּֽ/חֲמָתִ֑/י וְ/גֶ֤שֶׁם שֹׁטֵף֙ בְּ/אַפִּ֣/י יִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְ/אַבְנֵ֥י אֶלְגָּבִ֖ישׁ בְּ/חֵמָ֥ה לְ/כָלָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vbq'ty rvch s'rvt bchmty vgshm shtf b'py yhyh v'bny 'lgbysh bchmh lkhlh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it .

verses.original: וְ/הָ֨רַסְתִּ֜י אֶת הַ/קִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר טַחְתֶּ֥ם תָּפֵ֛ל וְ/הִגַּעְתִּ֥י/הוּ אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/נִגְלָ֣ה יְסֹד֑/וֹ וְ/נָֽפְלָה֙ וּ/כְלִיתֶ֣ם בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/הּ וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhrsty 't hqyr 'shr tchtm tpl vhg'tyhv 'l h'rts vnglh ysdv vnplh vkhlytm btvkhh vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter , and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כִלֵּיתִ֤י אֶת חֲמָתִ/י֙ בַּ/קִּ֔יר וּ/בַ/טָּחִ֥ים אֹת֖/וֹ תָּפֵ֑ל וְ/אֹמַ֤ר לָ/כֶם֙ אֵ֣ין הַ/קִּ֔יר וְ/אֵ֖ין הַ/טָּחִ֥ים אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhlyty 't chmty bqyr vbtchym 'tv tpl v'mr lkhm 'yn hqyr v'yn htchym 'tv
verses.translation: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter , and will say unto you, The wall is no more , neither they that daubed it;

verses.original: נְבִיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַֽ/נִבְּאִים֙ אֶל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/הַ/חֹזִ֥ים לָ֖/הּ חֲז֣וֹן שָׁלֹ֑ם וְ/אֵ֣ין שָׁלֹ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִֽה
verses.translit: nby'y yshr'l hnb'ym 'l yrvshlm vhchzym lh chzvn shlm v'yn shlm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: To wit , the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶל בְּנ֣וֹת עַמְּ/ךָ֔ הַ/מִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וֹת מִֽ/לִּבְּ/הֶ֑ן וְ/הִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm shym pnykh 'l bnvt 'mkh hmtnb'vt mlbhn vhnb' 'lyhn
verses.translation: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הוֹי֩ לִֽ/מְתַפְּר֨וֹת כְּסָת֜וֹת עַ֣ל כָּל אַצִּילֵ֣י יָדַ֗/י וְ/עֹשׂ֧וֹת הַ/מִּסְפָּח֛וֹת עַל רֹ֥אשׁ כָּל קוֹמָ֖ה לְ/צוֹדֵ֣ד נְפָשׁ֑וֹת הַ/נְּפָשׁוֹת֙ תְּצוֹדֵ֣דְנָה לְ/עַמִּ֔/י וּ/נְפָשׁ֖וֹת לָ/כֶ֥נָה תְחַיֶּֽינָה
verses.translit: v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hvy lmtprvt khstvt 'l khl 'tsyly ydy v'shvt hmspchvt 'l r'sh khl qvmh ltsvdd npshvt hnpshvt ttsvddnh l'my vnpshvt lkhnh tchyynh
verses.translation: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?

verses.original: וַ/תְּחַלֶּלְ֨נָה אֹתִ֜/י אֶל עַמִּ֗/י בְּ/שַׁעֲלֵ֣י שְׂעֹרִים֮ וּ/בִ/פְת֣וֹתֵי לֶחֶם֒ לְ/הָמִ֤ית נְפָשׁוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא תְמוּתֶ֔נָה וּ/לְ/חַיּ֥וֹת נְפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא תִֽחְיֶ֑ינָה בְּ/כַ֨זֶּבְ/כֶ֔ם לְ/עַמִּ֖/י שֹׁמְעֵ֥י כָזָֽב
verses.translit: vtchllnh 'ty 'l 'my bsh'ly sh'rym vbptvty lchm lhmyt npshvt 'shr l' tmvtnh vlchyvt npshvt 'shr l' tchyynh bkhzbkhm l'my shm'y khzb
verses.translation: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְ/נִ֤י אֶל כִּסְּתוֹתֵי/כֶ֨נָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַ֠תֵּנָה מְצֹדְד֨וֹת שָׁ֤ם אֶת הַ/נְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לְ/פֹ֣רְח֔וֹת וְ/קָרַעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔/ם מֵ/עַ֖ל זְרוֹעֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּי֙ אֶת הַ/נְּפָשׁ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם מְצֹדְד֥וֹת אֶת נְפָשִׁ֖ים לְ/פֹרְחֹֽת
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'l khstvtykhnh 'shr 'tnh mtsddvt shm 't hnpshvt lprchvt vqr'ty 'tm m'l zrv'tykhm vshlchty 't hnpshvt 'shr 'tm mtsddvt 't npshym lprcht
verses.translation: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.

verses.original: וְ/קָרַעְתִּ֞י אֶת מִסְפְּחֹֽתֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/הִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת עַמִּ/י֙ מִ/יֶּדְ/כֶ֔ן וְ/לֹֽא יִהְי֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶ֖ן לִ/מְצוּדָ֑ה וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vqr'ty 't mspchtykhm vhtslty 't 'my mydkhn vl' yhyv 'vd bydkhn lmtsvdh vyd'tn khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: יַ֣עַן הַכְא֤וֹת לֵב צַדִּיק֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַ/אֲנִ֖י לֹ֣א הִכְאַבְתִּ֑י/ו וּ/לְ/חַזֵּק֙ יְדֵ֣י רָשָׁ֔ע לְ/בִלְתִּי שׁ֛וּב מִ/דַּרְכּ֥/וֹ הָ/רָ֖ע לְ/הַחֲיֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: y'n hkh'vt lb tsdyq shqr v'ny l' hkh'btyv vlchzq ydy rsh' lblty shvb mdrkhv hr' lhchytv
verses.translation: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן שָׁ֚וְא לֹ֣א תֶחֱזֶ֔ינָה וְ/קֶ֖סֶם לֹא תִקְסַ֣מְנָה ע֑וֹד וְ/הִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת עַמִּ/י֙ מִ/יֶּדְ/כֶ֔ן וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn shv' l' tchzynh vqsm l' tqsmnh 'vd vhtslty 't 'my mydkhn vyd'tn khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּב֤וֹא אֵלַ/י֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִ/זִּקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vybv' 'ly 'nshym mzqny yshr'l vyshbv lpny
verses.translation: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ הֶעֱל֤וּ גִלּֽוּלֵי/הֶם֙ עַל לִבָּ֔/ם וּ/מִכְשׁ֣וֹל עֲוֺנָ֔/ם נָתְנ֖וּ נֹ֣כַח פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם הַ/אִדָּרֹ֥שׁ אִדָּרֵ֖שׁ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: bn 'dm h'nshym h'lh h'lv glvlyhm 'l lbm vmkhshvl 'vnm ntnv nkhch pnyhm h'drsh 'drsh lhm
verses.translation: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
