verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן דַּבֵּר א֠וֹתָ/ם וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ מִ/בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲלֶ֨ה אֶת גִּלּוּלָ֜י/ו אֶל לִבּ֗/וֹ וּ/מִכְשׁ֤וֹל עֲוֺנ/וֹ֙ יָשִׂים֙ נֹ֣כַח פָּנָ֔י/ו וּ/בָ֖א אֶל הַ/נָּבִ֑יא אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה נַעֲנֵ֧יתִי ל֦/וֹ ב/ה בָ֖א בְּ/רֹ֥ב גִּלּוּלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: lkhn dbr 'vtm v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l 'shr y'lh 't glvlyv 'l lbv vmkhshvl 'vnv yshym nkhch pnyv vb' 'l hnby' 'ny yhvh n'nyty lv bh b' brb glvlyv
verses.translation: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;

verses.original: לְמַ֛עַן תְּפֹ֥שׂ אֶת בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/לִבָּ֑/ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָזֹ֨רוּ֙ מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י בְּ/גִלּֽוּלֵי/הֶ֖ם כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: lm'n tpsh 't byt yshr'l blbm 'shr nzrv m'ly bglvlyhm khlm
verses.translation: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֶל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה שׁ֣וּבוּ וְ/הָשִׁ֔יבוּ מֵ/עַ֖ל גִּלּֽוּלֵי/כֶ֑ם וּ/מֵ/עַ֥ל כָּל תּוֹעֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם הָשִׁ֥יבוּ פְנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr 'l byt yshr'l khh 'mr 'dny yhvh shvbv vhshybv m'l glvlykhm vm'l khl tv'btykhm hshybv pnykhm
verses.translation: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִ/בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּ/מֵ/הַ/גֵּר֮ אֲשֶׁר יָג֣וּר בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְ/יִנָּזֵ֣ר מֵֽ/אַחֲרַ֗/י וְ/יַ֤עַל גִּלּוּלָי/ו֙ אֶל לִבּ֔/וֹ וּ/מִכְשׁ֣וֹל עֲוֺנ֔/וֹ יָשִׂ֖ים נֹ֣כַח פָּנָ֑י/ו וּ/בָ֤א אֶל הַ/נָּבִיא֙ לִ/דְרָשׁ ל֣/וֹ בִ֔/י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה נַֽעֲנֶה לּ֖/וֹ בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l vmhgr 'shr ygvr byshr'l vynzr m'chry vy'l glvlyv 'l lbv vmkhshvl 'vnv yshym nkhch pnyv vb' 'l hnby' ldrsh lv by 'ny yhvh n'nh lv by
verses.translation: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י פָנַ֜/י בָּ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֗וּא וַ/הֲשִֽׂמֹתִ֨י/הוּ֙ לְ/א֣וֹת וְ/לִ/מְשָׁלִ֔ים וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֖י/ו מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ עַמִּ֑/י וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vntty pny b'ysh hhv' vhshmtyhv l'vt vlmshlym vhkhrtyv mtvkh 'my vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נָּבִ֤יא כִֽי יְפֻתֶּה֙ וְ/דִבֶּ֣ר דָּבָ֔ר אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ פִּתֵּ֔יתִי אֵ֖ת הַ/נָּבִ֣יא הַ/ה֑וּא וְ/נָטִ֤יתִי אֶת יָדִ/י֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/הִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔י/ו מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhnby' khy ypth vdbr dbr 'ny yhvh ptyty 't hnby' hhv' vntyty 't ydy 'lyv vhshmdtyv mtvkh 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

verses.original: וְ/נָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָ֑/ם כַּֽ/עֲוֺן֙ הַ/דֹּרֵ֔שׁ כַּ/עֲוֺ֥ן הַ/נָּבִ֖יא יִֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vnsh'v 'vnm kh'vn hdrsh kh'vn hnby' yhyh
verses.translation: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;

verses.original: לְ֠מַעַן לֹֽא יִתְע֨וּ ע֤וֹד בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אַֽחֲרַ֔/י וְ/לֹֽא יִטַּמְּא֥וּ ע֖וֹד בְּ/כָל פִּשְׁעֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הָ֥יוּ לִ֣/י לְ/עָ֗ם וַֽ/אֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: lm'n l' yt'v 'vd byt yshr'l m'chry vl' ytm'v 'vd bkhl psh'yhm vhyv ly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם אֶ֚רֶץ כִּ֤י תֶחֱטָא לִ/י֙ לִ/מְעָל מַ֔עַל וְ/נָטִ֤יתִי יָדִ/י֙ עָלֶ֔י/הָ וְ/שָׁבַ֥רְתִּי לָ֖/הּ מַטֵּה לָ֑חֶם וְ/הִשְׁלַחְתִּי בָ֣/הּ רָעָ֔ב וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖/נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּ/בְהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'dm 'rts khy tcht' ly lm'l m'l vntyty ydy 'lyh vshbrty lh mth lchm vhshlchty bh r'b vhkhrty mmnh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:

verses.original: וְ֠/הָיוּ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/הּ נֹ֖חַ דנאל דָּנִיֵּ֣אל וְ/אִיּ֑וֹב הֵ֤מָּה בְ/צִדְקָתָ/ם֙ יְנַצְּל֣וּ נַפְשָׁ֔/ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vhyv shlsht h'nshym h'lh btvkhh nch dn'l dny'l v'yvb hmh btsdqtm yntslv npshm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: לֽוּ חַיָּ֥ה רָעָ֛ה אַעֲבִ֥יר בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/שִׁכְּלָ֑תָּ/ה וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה שְׁמָמָה֙ מִ/בְּלִ֣י עוֹבֵ֔ר מִ/פְּנֵ֖י הַ/חַיָּֽה
verses.translit: lv chyh r'h ''byr b'rts vshkhlth vhyth shmmh mbly 'vbr mpny hchyh
verses.translation: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:

verses.original: שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ/אֵלֶּה֮ בְּ/תוֹכָ/הּ֒ חַי אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה אִם בָּנִ֥ים וְ/אִם בָּנ֖וֹת יַצִּ֑ילוּ הֵ֤מָּה לְ/בַדָּ/ם֙ יִנָּצֵ֔לוּ וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ תִּהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמָמָֽה
verses.translit: shlsht h'nshym h'lh btvkhh chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm bnym v'm bnvt ytsylv hmh lbdm yntslv vh'rts thyh shmmh
verses.translation: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.

verses.original: א֛וֹ חֶ֥רֶב אָבִ֖יא עַל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/הִ֑יא וְ/אָמַרְתִּ֗י חֶ֚רֶב תַּעֲבֹ֣ר בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖/נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּ/בְהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: 'v chrb 'by' 'l h'rts hhy' v'mrty chrb t'br b'rts vhkhrty mmnh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ/אֵלֶּה֮ בְּ/תוֹכָ/הּ֒ חַי אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה לֹ֥א יַצִּ֖ילוּ בָּנִ֣ים וּ/בָנ֑וֹת כִּ֛י הֵ֥ם לְ/בַדָּ֖/ם יִנָּצֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: vshlsht h'nshym h'lh btvkhh chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh l' ytsylv bnym vbnvt khy hm lbdm yntslv
verses.translation: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.

verses.original: א֛וֹ דֶּ֥בֶר אֲשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/הִ֑יא וְ/שָׁפַכְתִּ֨י חֲמָתִ֤/י עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ בְּ/דָ֔ם לְ/הַכְרִ֥ית מִמֶּ֖/נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּ/בְהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: 'v dbr 'shlch 'l h'rts hhy' vshpkhty chmty 'lyh bdm lhkhryt mmnh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:

verses.original: וְ/נֹ֨חַ דנאל דָּנִיֵּ֣אל וְ/אִיּוֹב֮ בְּ/תוֹכָ/הּ֒ חַי אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה אִם בֵּ֥ן אִם בַּ֖ת יַצִּ֑ילוּ הֵ֥מָּה בְ/צִדְקָתָ֖/ם יַצִּ֥ילוּ נַפְשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vnch dn'l dny'l v'yvb btvkhh chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm bn 'm bt ytsylv hmh btsdqtm ytsylv npshm
verses.translation: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD , they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה אַ֣ף כִּֽי אַרְבַּ֣עַת שְׁפָטַ֣/י הָ/רָעִ֡ים חֶ֠רֶב וְ/רָעָ֞ב וְ/חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ וָ/דֶ֔בֶר שִׁלַּ֖חְתִּי אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְ/הַכְרִ֥ית מִמֶּ֖/נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּ/בְהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'f khy 'rb't shpty hr'ym chrb vr'b vchyh r'h vdbr shlchty 'l yrvshlm lhkhryt mmnh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה נֽוֹתְרָה בָּ֜/הּ פְּלֵטָ֗ה הַֽ/מּוּצָאִים֮ בָּנִ֣ים וּ/בָנוֹת֒ הִנָּ/ם֙ יוֹצְאִ֣ים אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/רְאִיתֶ֥ם אֶת דַּרְכָּ֖/ם וְ/אֶת עֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/נִחַמְתֶּ֗ם עַל הָֽ/רָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֨אתִי֙ עַל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵבֵ֖אתִי עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vhnh nvtrh bh plth hmvts'ym bnym vbnvt hnm yvts'ym 'lykhm vr'ytm 't drkhm v't 'lylvtm vnchmtm 'l hr'h 'shr hb'ty 'l yrvshlm 't khl 'shr hb'ty 'lyh
verses.translation: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.

verses.original: וְ/נִחֲמ֣וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם כִּֽי תִרְא֥וּ אֶת דַּרְכָּ֖/ם וְ/אֶת עֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑/ם וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּי֩ לֹ֨א חִנָּ֤ם עָשִׂ֨יתִי֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֣יתִי בָ֔/הּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִֽה
verses.translit: vnchmv 'tkhm khy tr'v 't drkhm v't 'lylvtm vyd'tm khy l' chnm 'shyty 't khl 'shr 'shyty bh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם מַה יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה עֵץ הַ/גֶּ֖פֶן מִ/כָּל עֵ֑ץ הַ/זְּמוֹרָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בַּ/עֲצֵ֥י הַ/יָּֽעַר
verses.translit: bn 'dm mh yhyh 'ts hgpn mkhl 'ts hzmvrh 'shr hyh b'tsy hy'r
verses.translation: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

verses.original: הֲ/יֻקַּ֤ח מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ עֵ֔ץ לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת לִ/מְלָאכָ֑ה אִם יִקְח֤וּ מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ יָתֵ֔ד לִ/תְל֥וֹת עָלָ֖י/ו כָּל כֶּֽלִי
verses.translit: hyqch mmnv 'ts l'shvt lml'khh 'm yqchv mmnv ytd ltlvt 'lyv khl khly
verses.translation: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה לָ/אֵ֖שׁ נִתַּ֣ן לְ/אָכְלָ֑ה אֵת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י קְצוֹתָ֜י/ו אָכְלָ֤ה הָ/אֵשׁ֙ וְ/תוֹכ֣/וֹ נָחָ֔ר הֲ/יִצְלַ֖ח לִ/מְלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: hnh l'sh ntn l'khlh 't shny qtsvtyv 'khlh h'sh vtvkhv nchr hytslch lml'khh
verses.translation: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ בִּֽ/הְיוֹת֣/וֹ תָמִ֔ים לֹ֥א יֵֽעָשֶׂ֖ה לִ/מְלָאכָ֑ה אַ֣ף כִּי אֵ֤שׁ אֲכָלַ֨תְ/הוּ֙ וַ/יֵּחָ֔ר וְ/נַעֲשָׂ֥ה ע֖וֹד לִ/מְלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: hnh bhyvtv tmym l' y'shh lml'khh 'f khy 'sh 'khlthv vychr vn'shh 'vd lml'khh
verses.translation: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֵץ הַ/גֶּ֨פֶן֙ בְּ/עֵ֣ץ הַ/יַּ֔עַר אֲשֶׁר נְתַתִּ֥י/ו לָ/אֵ֖שׁ לְ/אָכְלָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן נָתַ֔תִּי אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh kh'shr 'ts hgpn b'ts hy'r 'shr nttyv l'sh l'khlh khn ntty 't yshby yrvshlm
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת פָּנַ/י֙ בָּ/הֶ֔ם מֵ/הָ/אֵ֣שׁ יָצָ֔אוּ וְ/הָ/אֵ֖שׁ תֹּֽאכְלֵ֑/ם וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/שׂוּמִ֥/י אֶת פָּנַ֖/י בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vntty 't pny bhm mh'sh yts'v vh'sh t'khlm vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh bshvmy 't pny bhm
verses.translation: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the LORD , when I set my face against them.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֑ה יַ֚עַן מָ֣עֲלוּ מַ֔עַל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vntty 't h'rts shmmh y'n m'lv m'l n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הוֹדַ֥ע אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֶת תּוֹעֲבֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: bn 'dm hvd' 't yrvshlm 't tv'btyh
verses.translation: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ לִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מְכֹרֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וּ/מֹ֣לְדֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ מֵ/אֶ֖רֶץ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֑י אָבִ֥י/ךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י וְ/אִמֵּ֥/ךְ חִתִּֽית
verses.translit: v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh lyrvshlm mkhrtykh vmldtykh m'rts hkhn'ny 'bykh h'mry v'mkh chtyt
verses.translation: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.

verses.original: וּ/מוֹלְדוֹתַ֗יִ/ךְ בְּ/י֨וֹם הוּלֶּ֤דֶת אֹתָ/ךְ֙ לֹֽא כָרַּ֣ת שָׁרֵּ֔/ךְ וּ/בְ/מַ֥יִם לֹֽא רֻחַ֖צְתְּ לְ/מִשְׁעִ֑י וְ/הָמְלֵ֨חַ֙ לֹ֣א הֻמְלַ֔חַתְּ וְ/הָחְתֵּ֖ל לֹ֥א חֻתָּֽלְתְּ
verses.translit: vmvldvtykh byvm hvldt 'tkh l' khrt shrkh vbmym l' rchtst lmsh'y vhmlch l' hmlcht vhchtl l' chtlt
verses.translation: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

verses.original: לֹא חָ֨סָה עָלַ֜יִ/ךְ עַ֗יִן לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ֛/ךְ אַחַ֥ת מֵ/אֵ֖לֶּה לְ/חֻמְלָ֣ה עָלָ֑יִ/ךְ וַֽ/תֻּשְׁלְכִ֞י אֶל פְּנֵ֤י הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ בְּ/גֹ֣עַל נַפְשֵׁ֔/ךְ בְּ/י֖וֹם הֻלֶּ֥דֶת אֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: l' chsh 'lykh 'yn l'shvt lkh 'cht m'lh lchmlh 'lykh vtshlkhy 'l pny hshdh bg'l npshkh byvm hldt 'tkh
verses.translation: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

verses.original: וָ/אֶעֱבֹ֤ר עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וָֽ/אֶרְאֵ֔/ךְ מִתְבּוֹסֶ֖סֶת בְּ/דָמָ֑יִ/ךְ וָ/אֹ֤מַר לָ/ךְ֙ בְּ/דָמַ֣יִ/ךְ חֲיִ֔י וָ/אֹ֥מַר לָ֖/ךְ בְּ/דָמַ֥יִ/ךְ חֲיִֽי
verses.translit: v''br 'lykh v'r'kh mtbvsst bdmykh v'mr lkh bdmykh chyy v'mr lkh bdmykh chyy
verses.translation: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.

verses.original: רְבָבָ֗ה כְּ/צֶ֤מַח הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ נְתַתִּ֔י/ךְ וַ/תִּרְבִּי֙ וַֽ/תִּגְדְּלִ֔י וַ/תָּבֹ֖אִי בַּ/עֲדִ֣י עֲדָיִ֑ים שָׁדַ֤יִם נָכֹ֨נוּ֙ וּ/שְׂעָרֵ֣/ךְ צִמֵּ֔חַ וְ/אַ֖תְּ עֵרֹ֥ם וְ/עֶרְיָֽה
verses.translit: rbbh khtsmch hshdh nttykh vtrby vtgdly vtb'y b'dy 'dyym shdym nkhnv vsh'rkh tsmch v't 'rm v'ryh
verses.translation: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.

verses.original: וָ/אֶעֱבֹ֨ר עָלַ֜יִ/ךְ וָ/אֶרְאֵ֗/ךְ וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה עִתֵּ/ךְ֙ עֵ֣ת דֹּדִ֔ים וָ/אֶפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפִ/י֙ עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ וָ/אֲכַסֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתֵ֑/ךְ וָ/אֶשָּׁ֣בַֽע לָ֠/ךְ וָ/אָב֨וֹא בִ/בְרִ֜ית אֹתָ֗/ךְ נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה וַ/תִּ֥הְיִי לִֽ/י
verses.translit: v''br 'lykh v'r'kh vhnh 'tkh 't ddym v'prsh khnpy 'lykh v'khsh 'rvtkh v'shb' lkh v'bv' bbryt 'tkh n'm 'dny yhvh vthyy ly
verses.translation: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD , and thou becamest mine.

verses.translit: v'rchtskh bmym v'shtf dmykh m'lykh v'skhkh bshmn
verses.translation: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

verses.translit: v'lbyshkh rqmh v'n'lkh tchsh v'chbshkh bshsh v'khskh mshy
verses.translation: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers’ skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.

verses.original: וָ/אֶעְדֵּ֖/ךְ עֶ֑דִי וָ/אֶתְּנָ֤/ה צְמִידִים֙ עַל יָדַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/רָבִ֖יד עַל גְּרוֹנֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v''dkh 'dy v'tnh tsmydym 'l ydykh vrbyd 'l grvnkh
verses.translation: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתֵּ֥ן נֶ֨זֶם֙ עַל אַפֵּ֔/ךְ וַ/עֲגִילִ֖ים עַל אָזְנָ֑יִ/ךְ וַ/עֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת בְּ/רֹאשֵֽׁ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'tn nzm 'l 'pkh v'gylym 'l 'znykh v'trt tp'rt br'shkh
verses.translation: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.

verses.original: וַ/תַּעְדִּ֞י זָהָ֣ב וָ/כֶ֗סֶף וּ/מַלְבּוּשֵׁ/ךְ֙ ששי שֵׁ֤שׁ וָ/מֶ֨שִׁי֙ וְ/רִקְמָ֔ה סֹ֧לֶת וּ/דְבַ֛שׁ וָ/שֶׁ֖מֶן אכלתי אָכָ֑לְתְּ וַ/תִּ֨יפִי֙ בִּ/מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַֽ/תִּצְלְחִ֖י לִ/מְלוּכָֽה
verses.translit: vt'dy zhb vkhsf vmlbvshkh shshy shsh vmshy vrqmh slt vdbsh vshmn 'khlty 'khlt vtypy bm'd m'd vttslchy lmlvkhh
verses.translation: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨צֵא לָ֥/ךְ שֵׁ֛ם בַּ/גּוֹיִ֖ם בְּ/יָפְיֵ֑/ךְ כִּ֣י כָּלִ֣יל ה֗וּא בַּֽ/הֲדָרִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֣מְתִּי עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vyts' lkh shm bgvym bypykh khy khlyl hv' bhdry 'shr shmty 'lykh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/תִּבְטְחִ֣י בְ/יָפְיֵ֔/ךְ וַ/תִּזְנִ֖י עַל שְׁמֵ֑/ךְ וַ/תִּשְׁפְּכִ֧י אֶת תַּזְנוּתַ֛יִ/ךְ עַל כָּל עוֹבֵ֖ר ל/וֹ יֶֽהִי
verses.translit: vtbtchy bypykh vtzny 'l shmkh vtshpkhy 't tznvtykh 'l khl 'vbr lv yhy
verses.translation: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְחִ֣י מִ/בְּגָדַ֗יִ/ךְ וַ/תַּֽעֲשִׂי לָ/ךְ֙ בָּמ֣וֹת טְלֻא֔וֹת וַ/תִּזְנִ֖י עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם לֹ֥א בָא֖וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vtqchy mbgdykh vt'shy lkh bmvt tl'vt vtzny 'lyhm l' b'vt vl' yhyh
verses.translation: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so .

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְחִ֞י כְּלֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗/ךְ מִ/זְּהָבִ֤/י וּ/מִ/כַּסְפִּ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔/ךְ וַ/תַּעֲשִׂי לָ֖/ךְ צַלְמֵ֣י זָכָ֑ר וַ/תִּזְנִי בָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vtqchy khly tp'rtkh mzhby vmkhspy 'shr ntty lkh vt'shy lkh tslmy zkhr vtzny bm
verses.translation: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְחִ֛י אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י רִקְמָתֵ֖/ךְ וַ/תְּכַסִּ֑י/ם וְ/שַׁמְנִ/י֙ וּ/קְטָרְתִּ֔/י נתתי נָתַ֖תְּ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vtqchy 't bgdy rqmtkh vtkhsym vshmny vqtrty ntty ntt lpnyhm
verses.translation: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.

verses.original: וְ/לַחְמִ/י֩ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֨תִּי לָ֜/ךְ סֹ֣לֶת וָ/שֶׁ֤מֶן וּ/דְבַשׁ֙ הֶֽאֱכַלְתִּ֔י/ךְ וּ/נְתַתִּ֧י/הוּ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֛ם לְ/רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ וַ/יֶּ֑הִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vlchmy 'shr ntty lkh slt vshmn vdbsh h'khltykh vnttyhv lpnyhm lrych nychch vyhy n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְחִ֞י אֶת בָּנַ֤יִ/ךְ וְ/אֶת בְּנוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלַ֣דְתְּ לִ֔/י וַ/תִּזְבָּחִ֥י/ם לָ/הֶ֖ם לֶ/אֱכ֑וֹל הַ/מְעַ֖ט מ/תזנת/ך מִ/תַּזְנוּתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vtqchy 't bnykh v't bnvtykh 'shr yldt ly vtzbchym lhm l'khvl hm't mtzntkh mtznvtykh
verses.translation: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,

verses.original: וַֽ/תִּשְׁחֲטִ֖י אֶת בָּנָ֑/י וַֽ/תִּתְּנִ֔י/ם בְּ/הַעֲבִ֥יר אוֹתָ֖/ם לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vtshchty 't bny vttnym bh'byr 'vtm lhm
verses.translation: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֤ת כָּל תּוֹעֲבֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וְ/תַזְנֻתַ֔יִ/ךְ לֹ֥א זכרתי זָכַ֖רְתְּ אֶת יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִ/ךְ בִּֽ/הְיוֹתֵ/ךְ֙ עֵרֹ֣ם וְ/עֶרְיָ֔ה מִתְבּוֹסֶ֥סֶת בְּ/דָמֵ֖/ךְ הָיִֽית
verses.translit: v't khl tv'btykh vtzntykh l' zkhrty zkhrt 't ymy n'vrykh bhyvtkh 'rm v'ryh mtbvsst bdmkh hyyt
verses.translation: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י אַחֲרֵ֖י כָּל רָעָתֵ֑/ךְ א֣וֹי א֣וֹי לָ֔/ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khl r'tkh 'vy 'vy lkh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD ;)

verses.original: וַ/תִּבְנִי לָ֖/ךְ גֶּ֑ב וַ/תַּעֲשִׂי לָ֥/ךְ רָמָ֖ה בְּ/כָל רְחֽוֹב
verses.translit: vtbny lkh gb vt'shy lkh rmh bkhl rchvb
verses.translation: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.

verses.original: אֶל כָּל רֹ֣אשׁ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בָּנִית֙ רָֽמָתֵ֔/ךְ וַ/תְּתַֽעֲבִי֙ אֶת יָפְיֵ֔/ךְ וַ/תְּפַשְּׂקִ֥י אֶת רַגְלַ֖יִ/ךְ לְ/כָל עוֹבֵ֑ר וַ/תַּרְבִּ֖י אֶת תזנת/ך תַּזְנוּתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'l khl r'sh drkh bnyt rmtkh vtt'by 't ypykh vtpshqy 't rglykh lkhl 'vbr vtrby 't tzntkh tznvtykh
verses.translation: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.

verses.original: וַ/תִּזְנִ֧י אֶל בְּנֵֽי מִצְרַ֛יִם שְׁכֵנַ֖יִ/ךְ גִּדְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֑ר וַ/תַּרְבִּ֥י אֶת תַּזְנֻתֵ֖/ךְ לְ/הַכְעִיסֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vtzny 'l bny mtsrym shkhnykh gdly bshr vtrby 't tzntkh lhkh'ysny
verses.translation: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה נָטִ֤יתִי יָדִ/י֙ עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ וָ/אֶגְרַ֖ע חֻקֵּ֑/ךְ וָ/אֶתְּנֵ֞/ךְ בְּ/נֶ֤פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הַ/נִּכְלָמ֖וֹת מִ/דַּרְכֵּ֥/ךְ זִמָּֽה
verses.translit: vhnh ntyty ydy 'lykh v'gr' chqkh v'tnkh bnpsh shn'vtykh bnvt plshtym hnkhlmvt mdrkhkh zmh
verses.translation: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food , and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.

verses.original: וַ/תִּזְנִי֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר מִ/בִּלְתִּ֖י שָׂבְעָתֵ֑/ךְ וַ/תִּזְנִ֕י/ם וְ/גַ֖ם לֹ֥א שָׂבָֽעַתְּ
verses.translit: vtzny 'l bny 'shvr mblty shb'tkh vtznym vgm l' shb't
verses.translation: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.

verses.original: וַ/תַּרְבִּ֧י אֶת תַּזְנוּתֵ֛/ךְ אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן כַּשְׂדִּ֑ימָ/ה וְ/גַם בְּ/זֹ֖את לֹ֥א שָׂבָֽעַתְּ
verses.translit: vtrby 't tznvtkh 'l 'rts khn'n khshdymh vgm bz't l' shb't
verses.translation: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.

verses.original: מָ֤ה אֲמֻלָה֙ לִבָּתֵ֔/ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה בַּ/עֲשׂוֹתֵ/ךְ֙ אֶת כָּל אֵ֔לֶּה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אִשָּֽׁה זוֹנָ֖ה שַׁלָּֽטֶת
verses.translit: mh 'mlh lbtkh n'm 'dny yhvh b'shvtkh 't khl 'lh m'shh 'shh zvnh shltt
verses.translation: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD , seeing thou doest all these things , the work of an imperious whorish woman;

verses.original: בִּ/בְנוֹתַ֤יִ/ךְ גַּבֵּ/ךְ֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ כָּל דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/רָמָתֵ֥/ךְ עשיתי עָשִׂ֖ית בְּ/כָל רְח֑וֹב וְ/לֹא הייתי הָיִ֥ית כַּ/זּוֹנָ֖ה לְ/קַלֵּ֥ס אֶתְנָֽן
verses.translit: bbnvtykh gbkh br'sh khl drkh vrmtkh 'shyty 'shyt bkhl rchvb vl' hyyty hyyt khzvnh lqls 'tnn
verses.translation: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;

verses.original: הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה הַ/מְּנָאָ֑פֶת תַּ֣חַת אִישָׁ֔/הּ תִּקַּ֖ח אֶת זָרִֽים
verses.translit: h'shh hmn'pt tcht 'yshh tqch 't zrym
verses.translation: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!

verses.original: לְ/כָל זֹנ֖וֹת יִתְּנוּ נֵ֑דֶה וְ/אַ֨תְּ נָתַ֤תְּ אֶת נְדָנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ לְ/כָל מְאַֽהֲבַ֔יִ/ךְ וַ/תִּשְׁחֳדִ֣י אוֹתָ֗/ם לָ/ב֥וֹא אֵלַ֛יִ/ךְ מִ/סָּבִ֖יב בְּ/תַזְנוּתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: lkhl znvt ytnv ndh v't ntt 't ndnykh lkhl m'hbykh vtshchdy 'vtm lbv' 'lykh msbyb btznvtykh
verses.translation: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי בָ֨/ךְ הֵ֤פֶךְ מִן הַ/נָּשִׁים֙ בְּ/תַזְנוּתַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/אַחֲרַ֖יִ/ךְ לֹ֣א זוּנָּ֑ה וּ/בְ/תִתֵּ֣/ךְ אֶתְנָ֗ן וְ/אֶתְנַ֛ן לֹ֥א נִתַּן לָ֖/ךְ וַ/תְּהִ֥י לְ/הֶֽפֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhy bkh hpkh mn hnshym btznvtykh v'chrykh l' zvnh vbttkh 'tnn v'tnn l' ntn lkh vthy lhpkh
verses.translation: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן זוֹנָ֔ה שִׁמְעִ֖י דְּבַר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn zvnh shm'y dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD :

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה יַ֣עַן הִשָּׁפֵ֤ךְ נְחֻשְׁתֵּ/ךְ֙ וַ/תִּגָּלֶ֣ה עֶרְוָתֵ֔/ךְ בְּ/תַזְנוּתַ֖יִ/ךְ עַל מְאַהֲבָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/עַל֙ כָּל גִּלּוּלֵ֣י תוֹעֲבוֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/כִ/דְמֵ֣י בָנַ֔יִ/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תְּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n hshpkh nchshtkh vtglh 'rvtkh btznvtykh 'l m'hbykh v'l khl glvly tv'bvtykh vkhdmy bnykh 'shr ntt lhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;

verses.original: לָ֠/כֵן הִנְ/נִ֨י מְקַבֵּ֤ץ אֶת כָּל מְאַהֲבַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָרַ֣בְתְּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהַ֔בְתְּ עַ֖ל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את וְ/קִבַּצְתִּי֩ אֹתָ֨/ם עָלַ֜יִ/ךְ מִ/סָּבִ֗יב וְ/גִלֵּיתִ֤י עֶרְוָתֵ/ךְ֙ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם וְ/רָא֖וּ אֶת כָּל עֶרְוָתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lkhn hnny mqbts 't khl m'hbykh 'shr 'rbt 'lyhm v't khl 'shr 'hbt 'l khl 'shr shn't vqbtsty 'tm 'lykh msbyb vglyty 'rvtkh 'lhm vr'v 't khl 'rvtkh
verses.translation: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁפַטְתִּי/ךְ֙ מִשְׁפְּטֵ֣י נֹאֲפ֔וֹת וְ/שֹׁפְכֹ֖ת דָּ֑ם וּ/נְתַתִּ֕י/ךְ דַּ֥ם חֵמָ֖ה וְ/קִנְאָֽה
verses.translit: vshpttykh mshpty n'pvt vshpkht dm vnttykh dm chmh vqn'h
verses.translation: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י אוֹתָ֜/ךְ בְּ/יָדָ֗/ם וְ/הָרְס֤וּ גַבֵּ/ךְ֙ וְ/נִתְּצ֣וּ רָמֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/הִפְשִׁ֤יטוּ אוֹתָ/ךְ֙ בְּגָדַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/לָקְח֖וּ כְּלֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֑/ךְ וְ/הִנִּיח֖וּ/ךְ עֵירֹ֥ם וְ/עֶרְיָֽה
verses.translit: vntty 'vtkh bydm vhrsv gbkh vnttsv rmtykh vhpshytv 'vtkh bgdykh vlqchv khly tp'rtkh vhnychvkh 'yrm v'ryh
verses.translation: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱל֤וּ עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ קָהָ֔ל וְ/רָגְמ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖/ךְ בָּ/אָ֑בֶן וּ/בִתְּק֖וּ/ךְ בְּ/חַרְבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vh'lv 'lykh qhl vrgmv 'vtkh b'bn vbtqvkh bchrbvtm
verses.translation: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

verses.original: וְ/שָׂרְפ֤וּ בָתַּ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/עָשׂוּ בָ֣/ךְ שְׁפָטִ֔ים לְ/עֵינֵ֖י נָשִׁ֣ים רַבּ֑וֹת וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּי/ךְ֙ מִ/זּוֹנָ֔ה וְ/גַם אֶתְנַ֖ן לֹ֥א תִתְּנִי עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vshrpv btykh b'sh v'shv bkh shptym l'yny nshym rbvt vhshbtykh mzvnh vgm 'tnn l' ttny 'vd
verses.translation: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.

verses.original: וַ/הֲנִחֹתִ֤י חֲמָתִ/י֙ בָּ֔/ךְ וְ/סָ֥רָה קִנְאָתִ֖/י מִמֵּ֑/ךְ וְ/שָׁ֣קַטְתִּ֔י וְ/לֹ֥א אֶכְעַ֖ס עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vhnchty chmty bkh vsrh qn'ty mmkh vshqtty vl' 'kh's 'vd
verses.translation: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא זכרתי זָכַרְתְּ֙ אֶת יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרַ֔יִ/ךְ וַ/תִּרְגְּזִי לִ֖/י בְּ/כָל אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/גַם אֲנִ֨י הֵ֜א דַּרְכֵּ֣/ךְ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ נָתַ֗תִּי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וְ/לֹ֤א עשיתי עָשִׂית֙ אֶת הַ/זִּמָּ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל תּוֹעֲבֹתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: y'n 'shr l' zkhrty zkhrt 't ymy n'vrykh vtrgzy ly bkhl 'lh vgm 'ny h' drkhkh br'sh ntty n'm 'dny yhvh vl' 'shyty 'shyt 't hzmh 'l khl tv'btykh
verses.translation: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD : and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.

verses.translit: hnh khl hmshl 'lykh ymshl l'mr kh'mh bth
verses.translation: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.

verses.original: בַּת אִמֵּ֣/ךְ אַ֔תְּ גֹּעֶ֥לֶת אִישָׁ֖/הּ וּ/בָנֶ֑י/הָ וַ/אֲח֨וֹת אֲחוֹתֵ֜/ךְ אַ֗תְּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר גָּֽעֲ֨לוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁי/הֶ֣ן וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֔ן אִמְּ/כֶ֣ן חִתִּ֔ית וַ/אֲבִי/כֶ֖ן אֱמֹרִֽי
verses.translit: bt 'mkh 't g'lt 'yshh vbnyh v'chvt 'chvtkh 't 'shr g'lv 'nshyhn vbnyhn 'mkhn chtyt v'bykhn 'mry
verses.translation: Thou art thy mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחוֹתֵ֨/ךְ הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֤ה שֹֽׁמְרוֹן֙ הִ֣יא וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ הַ/יּוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת עַל שְׂמֹאולֵ֑/ךְ וַ/אֲחוֹתֵ֞/ךְ הַ/קְּטַנָּ֣ה מִמֵּ֗/ךְ הַ/יּוֹשֶׁ֨בֶת֙ מִֽ/ימִינֵ֔/ךְ סְדֹ֖ם וּ/בְנוֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'chvtkh hgdvlh shmrvn hy' vbnvtyh hyvshbt 'l shm'vlkh v'chvtkh hqtnh mmkh hyvshbt mymynkh sdm vbnvtyh
verses.translation: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א בְ/דַרְכֵי/הֶן֙ הָלַ֔כְתְּ וּ/בְ/תוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ן עשיתי עָשִׂ֑ית כִּ/מְעַ֣ט קָ֔ט וַ/תַּשְׁחִ֥תִי מֵ/הֵ֖ן בְּ/כָל דְּרָכָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vl' bdrkhyhn hlkht vbtv'bvtyhn 'shyty 'shyt khm't qt vtshchty mhn bkhl drkhykh
verses.translation: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing , thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.

verses.original: חַי אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה אִם עָֽשְׂתָה֙ סְדֹ֣ם אֲחוֹתֵ֔/ךְ הִ֖יא וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֑י/הָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ית אַ֖תְּ וּ/בְנוֹתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm 'shth sdm 'chvtkh hy' vbnvtyh kh'shr 'shyt 't vbnvtykh
verses.translation: As I live, saith the Lord GOD , Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

verses.original: הִנֵּה זֶ֣ה הָיָ֔ה עֲוֺ֖ן סְדֹ֣ם אֲחוֹתֵ֑/ךְ גָּא֨וֹן שִׂבְעַת לֶ֜חֶם וְ/שַׁלְוַ֣ת הַשְׁקֵ֗ט הָ֤יָה לָ/הּ֙ וְ/לִ/בְנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/יַד עָנִ֥י וְ/אֶבְי֖וֹן לֹ֥א הֶחֱזִֽיקָה
verses.translit: hnh zh hyh 'vn sdm 'chvtkh g'vn shb't lchm vshlvt hshqt hyh lh vlbnvtyh vyd 'ny v'byvn l' hchzyqh
verses.translation: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

verses.original: וַֽ/תִּגְבְּהֶ֔ינָה וַ/תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה תוֹעֵבָ֖ה לְ/פָנָ֑/י וָ/אָסִ֥יר אֶתְ/הֶ֖ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִֽיתִי
verses.translit: vtgbhynh vt'shynh tv'bh lpny v'syr 'thn kh'shr r'yty
verses.translation: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good .

verses.original: וְ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן כַּ/חֲצִ֥י חַטֹּאתַ֖יִ/ךְ לֹ֣א חָטָ֑אָה וַ/תַּרְבִּ֤י אֶת תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ מֵ/הֵ֔נָּה וַ/תְּצַדְּקִי֙ אֶת אחות/ך אֲחוֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ בְּ/כָל תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עשיתי עָשִֽׂית
verses.translit: vshmrvn khchtsy cht'tykh l' cht'h vtrby 't tv'bvtykh mhnh vttsdqy 't 'chvtkh 'chvtykh bkhl tv'bvtykh 'shr 'shyty 'shyt
verses.translation: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.

verses.translit: gm 't sh'y khlmtkh 'shr pllt l'chvtkh bcht'tykh 'shr ht'bt mhn ttsdqnh mmkh vgm 't bvshy vsh'y khlmtkh btsdqtkh 'chyvtkh
verses.translation: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת שְׁבִ֣יתְ/הֶ֔ן אֶת שבית שְׁב֤וּת סְדֹם֙ וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת שבית שְׁב֥וּת שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֑י/הָ ו/שבית וּ/שְׁב֥וּת שְׁבִיתַ֖יִ/ךְ בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/הְנָה
verses.translit: vshbty 't shbythn 't shbyt shbvt sdm vbnvtyh v't shbyt shbvt shmrvn vbnvtyh vshbyt vshbvt shbytykh btvkhhnh
verses.translation: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן֙ תִּשְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֔/ךְ וְ/נִכְלַ֕מְתְּ מִ/כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית בְּ/נַחֲמֵ֖/ךְ אֹתָֽ/ן
verses.translit: lm'n tsh'y khlmtkh vnkhlmt mkhl 'shr 'shyt bnchmkh 'tn
verses.translation: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחוֹתַ֗יִ/ךְ סְדֹ֤ם וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ תָּשֹׁ֣בְןָ לְ/קַדְמָתָ֔/ן וְ/שֹֽׁמְרוֹן֙ וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ תָּשֹׁ֖בְןָ לְ/קַדְמָתָ֑/ן וְ/אַתְּ֙ וּ/בְנוֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ תְּשֻׁבֶ֖ינָה לְ/קַדְמַתְ/כֶֽן
verses.translit: v'chvtykh sdm vbnvtyh tshbn lqdmtn vshmrvn vbnvtyh tshbn lqdmtn v't vbnvtykh tshbynh lqdmtkhn
verses.translation: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.

verses.original: וְ/ל֤וֹא הָֽיְתָה֙ סְדֹ֣ם אֲחוֹתֵ֔/ךְ לִ/שְׁמוּעָ֖ה בְּ/פִ֑י/ךְ בְּ/י֖וֹם גְּאוֹנָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vlv' hyth sdm 'chvtkh lshmv'h bpykh byvm g'vnykh
verses.translation: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

verses.original: בְּ/טֶרֶם֮ תִּגָּלֶ֣ה רָעָתֵ/ךְ֒ כְּמ֗וֹ עֵ֚ת חֶרְפַּ֣ת בְּנוֹת אֲרָ֔ם וְ/כָל סְבִיבוֹתֶ֖י/הָ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים הַ/שָּׁאט֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖/ךְ מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: btrm tglh r'tkh khmv 't chrpt bnvt 'rm vkhl sbybvtyh bnvt plshtym hsh'tvt 'vtkh msbyb
verses.translation: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.

verses.original: אֶת זִמָּתֵ֥/ךְ וְ/אֶת תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ אַ֣תְּ נְשָׂאתִ֑י/ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 't zmtkh v't tv'bvtykh 't nsh'tym n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה ו/עשית וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתִי אוֹתָ֖/ךְ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית אֲשֶׁר בָּזִ֥ית אָלָ֖ה לְ/הָפֵ֥ר בְּרִֽית
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh v'shyt v'shyty 'vtkh kh'shr 'shyt 'shr bzyt 'lh lhpr bryt
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

verses.original: וְ/זָכַרְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֛/י אוֹתָ֖/ךְ בִּ/ימֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִ/ךְ וַ/הֲקִמוֹתִ֥י לָ֖/ךְ בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vzkhrty 'ny 't bryty 'vtkh bymy n'vrykh vhqmvty lkh bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

verses.original: וְ/זָכַ֣רְתְּ אֶת דְּרָכַיִ/ךְ֮ וְ/נִכְלַמְתְּ֒ בְּ/קַחְתֵּ֗/ךְ אֶת אֲחוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ הַ/גְּדֹל֣וֹת מִמֵּ֔/ךְ אֶל הַ/קְּטַנּ֖וֹת מִמֵּ֑/ךְ וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י אֶתְ/הֶ֥ן לָ֛/ךְ לְ/בָנ֖וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א מִ/בְּרִיתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vzkhrt 't drkhykh vnkhlmt bqchtkh 't 'chvtykh hgdlvt mmkh 'l hqtnvt mmkh vntty 'thn lkh lbnvt vl' mbrytkh
verses.translation: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִימוֹתִ֥י אֲנִ֛י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖/י אִתָּ֑/ךְ וְ/יָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqymvty 'ny 't bryty 'tkh vyd't khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD :

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן תִּזְכְּרִי֙ וָ/בֹ֔שְׁתְּ וְ/לֹ֨א יִֽהְיֶה לָּ֥/ךְ עוֹד֙ פִּתְח֣וֹן פֶּ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י כְּלִמָּתֵ֑/ךְ בְּ/כַפְּרִ/י לָ/ךְ֙ לְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ית נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: lm'n tzkhry vbsht vl' yhyh lkh 'vd ptchvn ph mpny khlmtkh bkhpry lkh lkhl 'shr 'shyt n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם ח֥וּד חִידָ֖ה וּ/מְשֹׁ֣ל מָשָׁ֑ל אֶל בֵּ֖ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bn 'dm chvd chydh vmshl mshl 'l byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הַ/נֶּ֤שֶׁר הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ גְּד֤וֹל הַ/כְּנָפַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֣רֶךְ הָ/אֵ֔בֶר מָלֵא֙ הַ/נּוֹצָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר ל֖/וֹ הָֽ/רִקְמָ֑ה בָּ֚א אֶל הַ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן וַ/יִּקַּ֖ח אֶת צַמֶּ֥רֶת הָ/אָֽרֶז
verses.translit: v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnshr hgdvl gdvl hkhnpym 'rkh h'br ml' hnvtsh 'shr lv hrqmh b' 'l hlbnvn vyqch 't tsmrt h'rz
verses.translation: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:

verses.original: אֵ֛ת רֹ֥אשׁ יְנִֽיקוֹתָ֖י/ו קָטָ֑ף וַ/יְבִיאֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בְּ/עִ֥יר רֹכְלִ֖ים שָׂמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 't r'sh ynyqvtyv qtf vyby'hv 'l 'rts khn'n b'yr rkhlym shmv
verses.translation: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֙ מִ/זֶּ֣רַע הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/הוּ בִּ/שְׂדֵה זָ֑רַע קָ֚ח עַל מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים צַפְצָפָ֖ה שָׂמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqch mzr' h'rts vytnhv bshdh zr' qch 'l mym rbym tsptsph shmv
verses.translation: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְמַ֡ח וַ/יְהִי֩ לְ/גֶ֨פֶן סֹרַ֜חַת שִׁפְלַ֣ת קוֹמָ֗ה לִ/פְנ֤וֹת דָּלִיּוֹתָי/ו֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו וְ/שָׁרָשָׁ֖י/ו תַּחְתָּ֣י/ו יִֽהְי֑וּ וַ/תְּהִ֣י לְ/גֶ֔פֶן וַ/תַּ֣עַשׂ בַּדִּ֔ים וַ/תְּשַׁלַּ֖ח פֹּארֽוֹת
verses.translit: vytsmch vyhy lgpn srcht shplt qvmh lpnvt dlyvtyv 'lyv vshrshyv tchtyv yhyv vthy lgpn vt'sh bdym vtshlch p'rvt
verses.translation: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י נֶֽשֶׁר אֶחָד֙ גָּד֔וֹל גְּד֥וֹל כְּנָפַ֖יִם וְ/רַב נוֹצָ֑ה וְ/הִנֵּה֩ הַ/גֶּ֨פֶן הַ/זֹּ֜את כָּֽפְנָ֧ה שָׁרֳשֶׁ֣י/הָ עָלָ֗י/ו וְ/דָֽלִיּוֹתָי/ו֙ שִׁלְחָה לּ֔/וֹ לְ/הַשְׁק֣וֹת אוֹתָ֔/הּ מֵ/עֲרֻג֖וֹת מַטָּעָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyhy nshr 'chd gdvl gdvl khnpym vrb nvtsh vhnh hgpn hz't khpnh shrshyh 'lyv vdlyvtyv shlchh lv lhshqvt 'vth m'rgvt mt'h
verses.translation: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

verses.original: אֶל שָׂ֥דֶה טּ֛וֹב אֶל מַ֥יִם רַבִּ֖ים הִ֣יא שְׁתוּלָ֑ה לַ/עֲשׂ֤וֹת עָנָף֙ וְ/לָ/שֵׂ֣את פֶּ֔רִי לִ/הְי֖וֹת לְ/גֶ֥פֶן אַדָּֽרֶת
verses.translit: 'l shdh tvb 'l mym rbym hy' shtvlh l'shvt 'nf vlsh't pry lhyvt lgpn 'drt
verses.translation: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

verses.original: אֱמֹ֗ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִ֖ה תִּצְלָ֑ח הֲ/לוֹא֩ אֶת שָׁרָשֶׁ֨י/הָ יְנַתֵּ֜ק וְ/אֶת פִּרְיָ֣/הּ יְקוֹסֵ֣ס וְ/יָבֵ֗שׁ כָּל טַרְפֵּ֤י צִמְחָ/הּ֙ תִּיבָ֔שׁ וְ/לֹֽא בִ/זְרֹ֤עַ גְּדוֹלָה֙ וּ/בְ/עַם רָ֔ב לְ/מַשְׂא֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖/הּ מִ/שָּׁרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: 'mr khh 'mr 'dny yhvh ttslch hlv' 't shrshyh yntq v't pryh yqvss vybsh khl trpy tsmchh tybsh vl' bzr' gdvlh vb'm rb lmsh'vt 'vth mshrshyh
verses.translation: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה שְׁתוּלָ֖ה הֲ/תִצְלָ֑ח הֲ/לוֹא֩ כְ/גַ֨עַת בָּ֜/הּ ר֤וּחַ הַ/קָּדִים֙ תִּיבַ֣שׁ יָבֹ֔שׁ עַל עֲרֻגֹ֥ת צִמְחָ֖/הּ תִּיבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vhnh shtvlh httslch hlv' khg't bh rvch hqdym tybsh ybsh 'l 'rgt tsmchh tybsh
verses.translation: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: אֱמָר נָא֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔רִי הֲ/לֹ֥א יְדַעְתֶּ֖ם מָה אֵ֑לֶּה אֱמֹ֗ר הִנֵּה בָ֨א מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֤ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אֶת מַלְכָּ/הּ֙ וְ/אֶת שָׂרֶ֔י/הָ וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אוֹתָ֛/ם אֵלָ֖י/ו בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: 'mr n' lbyt hmry hl' yd'tm mh 'lh 'mr hnh b' mlkh bbl yrvshlm vyqch 't mlkhh v't shryh vyb' 'vtm 'lyv bblh
verses.translation: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean ? tell them , Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֙ מִ/זֶּ֣רַע הַ/מְּלוּכָ֔ה וַ/יִּכְרֹ֥ת אִתּ֖/וֹ בְּרִ֑ית וַ/יָּבֵ֤א אֹת/וֹ֙ בְּ/אָלָ֔ה וְ/אֶת אֵילֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לָקָֽח
verses.translit: vyqch mzr' hmlvkhh vykhrt 'tv bryt vyb' 'tv b'lh v't 'yly h'rts lqch
verses.translation: And hath taken of the king’s seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:

verses.original: לִֽ/הְיוֹת֙ מַמְלָכָ֣ה שְׁפָלָ֔ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י הִתְנַשֵּׂ֑א לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת בְּרִית֖/וֹ לְ/עָמְדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lhyvt mmlkhh shplh lblty htnsh' lshmr 't brytv l'mdh
verses.translation: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְרָד בּ֗/וֹ לִ/שְׁלֹ֤חַ מַלְאָכָי/ו֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָֽ/תֶת ל֥/וֹ סוּסִ֖ים וְ/עַם רָ֑ב הֲ/יִצְלָ֤ח הֲ/יִמָּלֵט֙ הָ/עֹשֵׂ֣ה אֵ֔לֶּה וְ/הֵפֵ֥ר בְּרִ֖ית וְ/נִמְלָֽט
verses.translit: vymrd bv lshlch ml'khyv mtsrym ltt lv svsym v'm rb hytslch hymlt h'shh 'lh vhpr bryt vnmlt
verses.translation: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things ? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?

verses.original: חַי אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ אִם לֹ֗א בִּ/מְקוֹם֙ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/מַּמְלִ֣יךְ אֹת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּזָה֙ אֶת אָ֣לָת֔/וֹ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵפֵ֖ר אֶת בְּרִית֑/וֹ אִתּ֥/וֹ בְ/תוֹךְ בָּבֶ֖ל יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm l' bmqvm hmlkh hmmlykh 'tv 'shr bzh 't 'ltv v'shr hpr 't brytv 'tv btvkh bbl ymvt
verses.translation: As I live, saith the Lord GOD , surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא֩ בְ/חַ֨יִל גָּד֜וֹל וּ/בְ/קָהָ֣ל רָ֗ב יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה אוֹת֤/וֹ פַרְעֹה֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה בִּ/שְׁפֹּ֥ךְ סֹלְלָ֖ה וּ/בִ/בְנ֣וֹת דָּיֵ֑ק לְ/הַכְרִ֖ית נְפָשׁ֥וֹת רַבּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vl' bchyl gdvl vbqhl rb y'shh 'vtv pr'h bmlchmh bshpkh sllh vbbnvt dyq lhkhryt npshvt rbvt
verses.translation: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:

verses.original: וּ/בָזָ֥ה אָלָ֖ה לְ/הָפֵ֣ר בְּרִ֑ית וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֥ן יָד֛/וֹ וְ/כָל אֵ֥לֶּה עָשָׂ֖ה לֹ֥א יִמָּלֵֽט
verses.translit: vbzh 'lh lhpr bryt vhnh ntn ydv vkhl 'lh 'shh l' ymlt
verses.translation: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things , he shall not escape.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֮ חַי אָנִי֒ אִם לֹ֗א אָֽלָתִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּזָ֔ה וּ/בְרִיתִ֖/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵפִ֑יר וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/ו בְּ/רֹאשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh chy 'ny 'm l' 'lty 'shr bzh vbryty 'shr hpyr vnttyv br'shv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.

verses.original: וּ/פָרַשְׂתִּ֤י עָלָי/ו֙ רִשְׁתִּ֔/י וְ/נִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּ/מְצֽוּדָתִ֑/י וַ/הֲבִיאוֹתִ֣י/הוּ בָבֶ֗לָ/ה וְ/נִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֤י אִתּ/וֹ֙ שָׁ֔ם מַעֲל֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָֽעַל בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vprshty 'lyv rshty vntpsh bmtsvdty vhby'vtyhv bblh vnshptty 'tv shm m'lv 'shr m'l by
verses.translation: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל מברח/ו מִבְרָחָ֤י/ו בְּ/כָל אֲגַפָּי/ו֙ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים לְ/כָל ר֣וּחַ יִפָּרֵ֑שׂוּ וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: v't khl mbrchv mbrchyv bkhl 'gpyv bchrb yplv vhnsh'rym lkhl rvch yprshv vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh dbrty
verses.translation: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken it .

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וְ/לָקַ֣חְתִּי אָ֗נִי מִ/צַּמֶּ֧רֶת הָ/אֶ֛רֶז הָ/רָמָ֖ה וְ/נָתָ֑תִּי מֵ/רֹ֤אשׁ יֹֽנְקוֹתָי/ו֙ רַ֣ךְ אֶקְטֹ֔ף וְ/שָׁתַ֣לְתִּי אָ֔נִי עַ֥ל הַר גָּבֹ֖הַ וְ/תָלֽוּל
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vlqchty 'ny mtsmrt h'rz hrmh vntty mr'sh ynqvtyv rkh 'qtf vshtlty 'ny 'l hr gbh vtlvl
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:

verses.original: בְּ/הַ֨ר מְר֤וֹם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶשְׁתֳּלֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/נָשָׂ֤א עָנָף֙ וְ/עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֔רִי וְ/הָיָ֖ה לְ/אֶ֣רֶז אַדִּ֑יר וְ/שָׁכְנ֣וּ תַחְתָּ֗י/ו כֹּ֚ל צִפּ֣וֹר כָּל כָּנָ֔ף בְּ/צֵ֥ל דָּלִיּוֹתָ֖י/ו תִּשְׁכֹּֽנָּה
verses.translit: bhr mrvm yshr'l 'shtlnv vnsh' 'nf v'shh pry vhyh l'rz 'dyr vshkhnv tchtyv khl tspvr khl khnf btsl dlyvtyv tshkhnh
verses.translation: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

verses.original: וְֽ/יָדְע֞וּ כָּל עֲצֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ הִשְׁפַּ֣לְתִּי עֵ֣ץ גָּבֹ֗הַ הִגְבַּ֨הְתִּי֙ עֵ֣ץ שָׁפָ֔ל הוֹבַ֨שְׁתִּי֙ עֵ֣ץ לָ֔ח וְ/הִפְרַ֖חְתִּי עֵ֣ץ יָבֵ֑שׁ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְ/עָשִֽׂיתִי
verses.translit: vyd'v khl 'tsy hshdh khy 'ny yhvh hshplty 'ts gbh hgbhty 'ts shpl hvbshty 'ts lch vhprchty 'ts ybsh 'ny yhvh dbrty v'shyty
verses.translation: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done it .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,

verses.original: מַה לָּ/כֶ֗ם אַתֶּם֙ מֹֽשְׁלִים֙ אֶת הַ/מָּשָׁ֣ל הַ/זֶּ֔ה עַל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אָבוֹת֙ יֹ֣אכְלוּ בֹ֔סֶר וְ/שִׁנֵּ֥י הַ/בָּנִ֖ים תִּקְהֶֽינָה
verses.translit: mh lkhm 'tm mshlym 't hmshl hzh 'l 'dmt yshr'l l'mr 'bvt y'khlv bsr vshny hbnym tqhynh
verses.translation: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?

verses.original: חַי אָ֕נִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה אִם יִֽהְיֶ֨ה לָ/כֶ֜ם ע֗וֹד מְשֹׁ֛ל הַ/מָּשָׁ֥ל הַ/זֶּ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm yhyh lkhm 'vd mshl hmshl hzh byshr'l
verses.translation: As I live, saith the Lord GOD , ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן כָּל הַ/נְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לִ֣/י הֵ֔נָּה כְּ/נֶ֧פֶשׁ הָ/אָ֛ב וּ/כְ/נֶ֥פֶשׁ הַ/בֵּ֖ן לִ/י הֵ֑נָּה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/חֹטֵ֖את הִ֥יא תָמֽוּת
verses.translit: hn khl hnpshvt ly hnh khnpsh h'b vkhnpsh hbn ly hnh hnpsh hcht't hy' tmvt
verses.translation: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֖ישׁ כִּי יִהְיֶ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: v'ysh khy yhyh tsdyq v'shh mshpt vtsdqh
verses.translation: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

verses.original: אֶל הֶֽ/הָרִים֙ לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל וְ/עֵינָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א אֶל גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אֶת אֵ֤שֶׁת רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ לֹ֣א טִמֵּ֔א וְ/אֶל אִשָּׁ֥ה נִדָּ֖ה לֹ֥א יִקְרָֽב
verses.translit: 'l hhrym l' 'khl v'ynyv l' nsh' 'l glvly byt yshr'l v't 'sht r'hv l' tm' v'l 'shh ndh l' yqrb
verses.translation: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,

verses.original: וְ/אִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א יוֹנֶ֔ה חֲבֹלָת֥/וֹ חוֹב֙ יָשִׁ֔יב גְּזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א יִגְזֹ֑ל לַחְמ/וֹ֙ לְ/רָעֵ֣ב יִתֵּ֔ן וְ/עֵירֹ֖ם יְכַסֶּה בָּֽגֶד
verses.translit: v'ysh l' yvnh chbltv chvb yshyb gzlh l' ygzl lchmv lr'b ytn v'yrm ykhsh bgd
verses.translation: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

verses.original: בַּ/נֶּ֣שֶׁךְ לֹֽא יִתֵּ֗ן וְ/תַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔ח מֵ/עָ֖וֶל יָשִׁ֣יב יָד֑/וֹ מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ לְ/אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: bnshkh l' ytn vtrbyt l' yqch m'vl yshyb ydv mshpt 'mt y'shh byn 'ysh l'ysh
verses.translation: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,

verses.original: בְּ/חֻקּוֹתַ֧/י יְהַלֵּ֛ךְ וּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֥/י שָׁמַ֖ר לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת אֱמֶ֑ת צַדִּ֥יק הוּא֙ חָיֹ֣ה יִֽחְיֶ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: bchqvty yhlkh vmshpty shmr l'shvt 'mt tsdyq hv' chyh ychyh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/הוֹלִ֥יד בֵּן פָּרִ֖יץ שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ דָּ֑ם וְ/עָ֣שָׂה אָ֔ח מֵ/אַחַ֖ד מֵ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vhvlyd bn pryts shpkh dm v'shh 'ch m'chd m'lh
verses.translation: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things ,

verses.original: וְ/ה֕וּא אֶת כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶל הֶֽ/הָרִים֙ אָכַ֔ל וְ/אֶת אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖/הוּ טִמֵּֽא
verses.translit: vhv' 't khl 'lh l' 'shh khy gm 'l hhrym 'khl v't 'sht r'hv tm'
verses.translation: And that doeth not any of those duties , but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,

verses.original: עָנִ֤י וְ/אֶבְיוֹן֙ הוֹנָ֔ה גְּזֵל֣וֹת גָּזָ֔ל חֲבֹ֖ל לֹ֣א יָשִׁ֑יב וְ/אֶל הַ/גִּלּוּלִים֙ נָשָׂ֣א עֵינָ֔י/ו תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: 'ny v'byvn hvnh gzlvt gzl chbl l' yshyb v'l hglvlym nsh' 'ynyv tv'bh 'shh
verses.translation: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,

verses.original: בַּ/נֶּ֧שֶׁךְ נָתַ֛ן וְ/תַרְבִּ֥ית לָקַ֖ח וָ/חָ֑י לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֗ה אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/תּוֹעֵב֤וֹת הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ עָשָׂ֔ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת דָּמָ֖י/ו בּ֥/וֹ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: bnshkh ntn vtrbyt lqch vchy l' ychyh 't khl htv'bvt h'lh 'shh mvt yvmt dmyv bv yhyh
verses.translation: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֙ הוֹלִ֣יד בֵּ֔ן וַ/יַּ֕רְא אֶת כָּל חַטֹּ֥את אָבִ֖י/ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַ/יִּרְאֶ֕ה וְ/לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כָּ/הֵֽן
verses.translit: vhnh hvlyd bn vyr' 't khl cht't 'byv 'shr 'shh vyr'h vl' y'shh khhn
verses.translation: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father’s sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,

verses.original: עַל הֶֽ/הָרִים֙ לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל וְ/עֵינָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א אֶל גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶת אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖/הוּ לֹ֥א טִמֵּֽא
verses.translit: 'l hhrym l' 'khl v'ynyv l' nsh' 'l glvly byt yshr'l 't 'sht r'hv l' tm'
verses.translation: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour’s wife,

verses.original: וְ/אִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א הוֹנָ֔ה חֲבֹל֙ לֹ֣א חָבָ֔ל וּ/גְזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א גָזָ֑ל לַחְמ/וֹ֙ לְ/רָעֵ֣ב נָתָ֔ן וְ/עֵר֖וֹם כִּסָּה בָֽגֶד
verses.translit: v'ysh l' hvnh chbl l' chbl vgzlh l' gzl lchmv lr'b ntn v'rvm khsh bgd
verses.translation: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,

verses.original: מֵ/עָנִ֞י הֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗/וֹ נֶ֤שֶׁךְ וְ/תַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א לָקָ֔ח מִשְׁפָּטַ֣/י עָשָׂ֔ה בְּ/חֻקּוֹתַ֖/י הָלָ֑ךְ ה֗וּא לֹ֥א יָמ֛וּת בַּ/עֲוֺ֥ן אָבִ֖י/ו חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: m'ny hshyb ydv nshkh vtrbyt l' lqch mshpty 'shh bchqvty hlkh hv' l' ymvt b'vn 'byv chyh ychyh
verses.translation: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

verses.original: אָבִ֞י/ו כִּֽי עָ֣שַׁק עֹ֗שֶׁק גָּזַל֙ גֵּ֣זֶל אָ֔ח וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא ט֛וֹב עָשָׂ֖ה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ עַמָּ֑י/ו וְ/הִנֵּה מֵ֖ת בַּ/עֲוֺנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'byv khy 'shq 'shq gzl gzl 'ch v'shr l' tvb 'shh btvkh 'myv vhnh mt b'vnv
verses.translation: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַדֻּ֛עַ לֹא נָשָׂ֥א הַ/בֵּ֖ן בַּ/עֲוֺ֣ן הָ/אָ֑ב וְ/הַ/בֵּ֞ן מִשְׁפָּ֧ט וּ/צְדָקָ֣ה עָשָׂ֗ה אֵ֣ת כָּל חֻקּוֹתַ֥/י שָׁמַ֛ר וַ/יַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖/ם חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: v'mrtm md' l' nsh' hbn b'vn h'b vhbn mshpt vtsdqh 'shh 't khl chqvty shmr vy'shh 'tm chyh ychyh
verses.translation: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

verses.original: הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/חֹטֵ֖את הִ֣יא תָמ֑וּת בֵּ֞ן לֹא יִשָּׂ֣א בַּ/עֲוֺ֣ן הָ/אָ֗ב וְ/אָב֙ לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ בַּ/עֲוֺ֣ן הַ/בֵּ֔ן צִדְקַ֤ת הַ/צַּדִּיק֙ עָלָ֣י/ו תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְ/רִשְׁעַ֥ת רשע הָ/רָשָׁ֖ע עָלָ֥י/ו תִּֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: hnpsh hcht't hy' tmvt bn l' ysh' b'vn h'b v'b l' ysh' b'vn hbn tsdqt htsdyq 'lyv thyh vrsh't rsh' hrsh' 'lyv thyh
verses.translation: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/רָשָׁ֗ע כִּ֤י יָשׁוּב֙ מִ/כָּל חטאת/ו חַטֹּאתָי/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְ/שָׁמַר֙ אֶת כָּל חֻקּוֹתַ֔/י וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/צְדָקָ֑ה חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vhrsh' khy yshvb mkhl cht'tv cht'tyv 'shr 'shh vshmr 't khl chqvty v'shh mshpt vtsdqh chyh ychyh l' ymvt
verses.translation: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

verses.original: כָּל פְּשָׁעָי/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה לֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ל֑/וֹ בְּ/צִדְקָת֥/וֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה יִֽחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: khl psh'yv 'shr 'shh l' yzkhrv lv btsdqtv 'shr 'shh ychyh
verses.translation: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

verses.original: הֶ/חָפֹ֤ץ אֶחְפֹּץ֙ מ֣וֹת רָשָׁ֔ע נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה הֲ/ל֛וֹא בְּ/שׁוּב֥/וֹ מִ/דְּרָכָ֖י/ו וְ/חָיָֽה
verses.translit: hchpts 'chpts mvt rsh' n'm 'dny yhvh hlv' bshvbv mdrkhyv vchyh
verses.translation: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD : and not that he should return from his ways, and live?

verses.original: וּ/בְ/שׁ֨וּב צַדִּ֤יק מִ/צִּדְקָת/וֹ֙ וְ/עָ֣שָׂה עָ֔וֶל כְּ/כֹ֨ל הַ/תּוֹעֵב֜וֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֧ה הָ/רָשָׁ֛ע יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה וָ/חָ֑י כָּל צדקת/ו צִדְקֹתָ֤י/ו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה֙ לֹ֣א תִזָּכַ֔רְנָה בְּ/מַעֲל֧/וֹ אֲשֶׁר מָעַ֛ל וּ/בְ/חַטָּאת֥/וֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָ֖א בָּ֥/ם יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vbshvb tsdyq mtsdqtv v'shh 'vl khkhl htv'bvt 'shr 'shh hrsh' y'shh vchy khl tsdqtv tsdqtyv 'shr 'shh l' tzkhrnh bm'lv 'shr m'l vbcht'tv 'shr cht' bm ymvt
verses.translation: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑/י שִׁמְעוּ נָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲ/דַרְכִּ/י֙ לֹ֣א יִתָּכֵ֔ן הֲ/לֹ֥א דַרְכֵי/כֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽנוּ
verses.translit: v'mrtm l' ytkhn drkh 'dny shm'v n' byt yshr'l hdrkhy l' ytkhn hl' drkhykhm l' ytkhnv
verses.translation: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

verses.original: בְּ/שׁוּב צַדִּ֧יק מִ/צִּדְקָת֛/וֹ וְ/עָ֥שָׂה עָ֖וֶל וּ/מֵ֣ת עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם בְּ/עַוְל֥/וֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: bshvb tsdyq mtsdqtv v'shh 'vl vmt 'lyhm b'vlv 'shr 'shh ymvt
verses.translation: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/שׁ֣וּב רָשָׁ֗ע מֵֽ/רִשְׁעָת/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/צְדָקָ֑ה ה֖וּא אֶת נַפְשׁ֥/וֹ יְחַיֶּֽה
verses.translit: vbshvb rsh' mrsh'tv 'shr 'shh vy'sh mshpt vtsdqh hv' 't npshv ychyh
verses.translation: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְאֶ֣ה ו/ישוב וַ/יָּ֔שָׁב מִ/כָּל פְּשָׁעָ֖י/ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה חָי֥וֹ יִחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vyr'h vyshvb vyshb mkhl psh'yv 'shr 'shh chyv ychyh l' ymvt
verses.translation: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

verses.original: וְ/אָֽמְרוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑/י הַ/דְּרָכַ֞/י לֹ֤א יִתָּֽכְנּוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲ/לֹ֥א דַרְכֵי/כֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽן
verses.translit: v'mrv byt yshr'l l' ytkhn drkh 'dny hdrkhy l' ytkhnv byt yshr'l hl' drkhykhm l' ytkhn
verses.translation: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּ/דְרָכָ֜י/ו אֶשְׁפֹּ֤ט אֶתְ/כֶם֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה שׁ֤וּבוּ וְ/הָשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ מִ/כָּל פִּשְׁעֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֛ם לְ/מִכְשׁ֖וֹל עָוֺֽן
verses.translit: lkhn 'ysh khdrkhyv 'shpt 'tkhm byt yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh shvbv vhshybv mkhl psh'ykhm vl' yhyh lkhm lmkhshvl 'vn
verses.translation: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD . Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

verses.original: הַשְׁלִ֣יכוּ מֵ/עֲלֵי/כֶ֗ם אֶת כָּל פִּשְׁעֵי/כֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֣ם בָּ֔/ם וַ/עֲשׂ֥וּ לָ/כֶ֛ם לֵ֥ב חָדָ֖שׁ וְ/ר֣וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְ/לָ֥/מָּה תָמֻ֖תוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hshlykhv m'lykhm 't khl psh'ykhm 'shr psh'tm bm v'shv lkhm lb chdsh vrvch chdshh vlmh tmtv byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אֶחְפֹּץ֙ בְּ/מ֣וֹת הַ/מֵּ֔ת נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה וְ/הָשִׁ֖יבוּ וִֽ/חְיֽוּ
verses.translit: khy l' 'chpts bmvt hmt n'm 'dny yhvh vhshybv vchyv
verses.translation: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD : wherefore turn yourselves , and live ye.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ שָׂ֣א קִינָ֔ה אֶל נְשִׂיאֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'th sh' qynh 'l nshy'y yshr'l
verses.translation: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ מָ֤ה אִמְּ/ךָ֙ לְבִיָּ֔א בֵּ֥ין אֲרָי֖וֹת רָבָ֑צָה בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ כְּפִרִ֖ים רִבְּתָ֥ה גוּרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'mrt mh 'mkh lby' byn 'ryvt rbtsh btvkh khprym rbth gvryh
verses.translation: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֛עַל אֶחָ֥ד מִ/גֻּרֶ֖י/הָ כְּפִ֣יר הָיָ֑ה וַ/יִּלְמַ֥ד לִ/טְרָף טֶ֖רֶף אָדָ֥ם אָכָֽל
verses.translit: vt'l 'chd mgryh khpyr hyh vylmd ltrf trf 'dm 'khl
verses.translation: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלָ֛י/ו גּוֹיִ֖ם בְּ/שַׁחְתָּ֣/ם נִתְפָּ֑שׂ וַ/יְבִאֻ֥/הוּ בַֽ/חַחִ֖ים אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyshm'v 'lyv gvym bshchtm ntpsh vyb'hv bchchym 'l 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא֙ כִּ֣י נֽוֹחֲלָ֔ה אָבְדָ֖ה תִּקְוָתָ֑/הּ וַ/תִּקַּ֛ח אֶחָ֥ד מִ/גֻּרֶ֖י/הָ כְּפִ֥יר שָׂמָֽתְ/הוּ
verses.translit: vtr' khy nvchlh 'bdh tqvth vtqch 'chd mgryh khpyr shmthv
verses.translation: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּ/תוֹךְ אֲרָי֖וֹת כְּפִ֣יר הָיָ֑ה וַ/יִּלְמַ֥ד לִ/טְרָף טֶ֖רֶף אָדָ֥ם אָכָֽל
verses.translit: vythlkh btvkh 'ryvt khpyr hyh vylmd ltrf trf 'dm 'khl
verses.translation: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨דַע֙ אַלְמְנוֹתָ֔י/ו וְ/עָרֵי/הֶ֖ם הֶחֱרִ֑יב וַ/תֵּ֤שַׁם אֶ֨רֶץ֙ וּ/מְלֹאָ֔/הּ מִ/קּ֖וֹל שַׁאֲגָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyd' 'lmnvtyv v'ryhm hchryb vtshm 'rts vml'h mqvl sh'gtv
verses.translation: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ עָלָ֥י/ו גּוֹיִ֛ם סָבִ֖יב מִ/מְּדִינ֑וֹת וַֽ/יִּפְרְשׂ֥וּ עָלָ֛י/ו רִשְׁתָּ֖/ם בְּ/שַׁחְתָּ֥/ם נִתְפָּֽשׂ
verses.translit: vytnv 'lyv gvym sbyb mmdynvt vyprshv 'lyv rshtm bshchtm ntpsh
verses.translation: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנֻ֤/הוּ בַ/סּוּגַר֙ בַּֽ/חַחִ֔ים וַ/יְבִאֻ֖/הוּ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל יְבִאֻ֨/הוּ֙ בַּ/מְּצֹד֔וֹת לְמַ֗עַן לֹא יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹל֛/וֹ ע֖וֹד אֶל הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytnhv bsvgr bchchym vyb'hv 'l mlkh bbl yb'hv bmtsdvt lm'n l' yshm' qvlv 'vd 'l hry yshr'l
verses.translation: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

verses.original: אִמְּ/ךָ֥ כַ/גֶּ֛פֶן בְּ/דָמְ/ךָ֖ עַל מַ֣יִם שְׁתוּלָ֑ה פֹּֽרִיָּה֙ וַֽ/עֲנֵפָ֔ה הָיְתָ֖ה מִ/מַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: 'mkh khgpn bdmkh 'l mym shtvlh pryh v'nph hyth mmym rbym
verses.translation: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ לָ֞/הּ מַטּ֣וֹת עֹ֗ז אֶל שִׁבְטֵי֙ מֹֽשְׁלִ֔ים וַ/תִּגְבַּ֥הּ קֽוֹמָת֖/וֹ עַל בֵּ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֑ים וַ/יֵּרָ֣א בְ/גָבְה֔/וֹ בְּ/רֹ֖ב דָּלִיֹּתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhyv lh mtvt 'z 'l shbty mshlym vtgbh qvmtv 'l byn 'btym vyr' bgbhv brb dlytyv
verses.translation: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

verses.original: וַ/תֻּתַּ֤שׁ בְּ/חֵמָה֙ לָ/אָ֣רֶץ הֻשְׁלָ֔כָה וְ/ר֥וּחַ הַ/קָּדִ֖ים הוֹבִ֣ישׁ פִּרְיָ֑/הּ הִתְפָּרְק֧וּ וְ/יָבֵ֛שׁוּ מַטֵּ֥ה עֻזָּ֖/הּ אֵ֥שׁ אֲכָלָֽתְ/הוּ
verses.translit: vttsh bchmh l'rts hshlkhh vrvch hqdym hvbysh pryh htprqv vybshv mth 'zh 'sh 'khlthv
verses.translation: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה שְׁתוּלָ֣ה בַ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ צִיָּ֥ה וְ/צָמָֽא
verses.translit: v'th shtvlh bmdbr b'rts tsyh vtsm'
verses.translation: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּצֵ֨א אֵ֜שׁ מִ/מַּטֵּ֤ה בַדֶּ֨י/הָ֙ פִּרְיָ֣/הּ אָכָ֔לָה וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה בָ֛/הּ מַטֵּה עֹ֖ז שֵׁ֣בֶט לִ/מְשׁ֑וֹל קִ֥ינָה הִ֖יא וַ/תְּהִ֥י לְ/קִינָֽה
verses.translit: vtts' 'sh mmth bdyh pryh 'khlh vl' hyh bh mth 'z shbt lmshvl qynh hy' vthy lqynh
verses.translation: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗ית בַּֽ/חֲמִשִׁי֙ בֶּ/עָשׂ֣וֹר לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ בָּ֧אוּ אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מִ/זִּקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִ/דְרֹ֣שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hshby'yt bchmshy b'shvr lchdsh b'v 'nshym mzqny yshr'l ldrsh 't yhvh vyshbv lpny
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month , the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD , and sat before me.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶת זִקְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הֲ/לִ/דְרֹ֥שׁ אֹתִ֖/י אַתֶּ֣ם בָּאִ֑ים חַי אָ֨נִי֙ אִם אִדָּרֵ֣שׁ לָ/כֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: bn 'dm dbr 't zqny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hldrsh 'ty 'tm b'ym chy 'ny 'm 'drsh lkhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord GOD , I will not be enquired of by you.

verses.original: הֲ/תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֹתָ֔/ם הֲ/תִשְׁפּ֖וֹט בֶּן אָדָ֑ם אֶת תּוֹעֲבֹ֥ת אֲבוֹתָ֖/ם הוֹדִיעֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: htshpt 'tm htshpvt bn 'dm 't tv'bt 'bvtm hvdy'm
verses.translation: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them ? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ בְּ/יוֹם֙ בָּחֳרִ֣/י בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וָ/אֶשָּׂ֣א יָדִ֗/י לְ/זֶ֨רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וָ/אִוָּדַ֥ע לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָ/אֶשָּׂ֨א יָדִ֤/י לָ/הֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh byvm bchry byshr'l v'sh' ydy lzr' byt y'qb v'vd' lhm b'rts mtsrym v'sh' ydy lhm l'mr 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the LORD your God;

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא נָשָׂ֤אתִי יָדִ/י֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם לְ/הֽוֹצִיאָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶל אֶ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁר תַּ֣רְתִּי לָ/הֶ֗ם זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּ/דְבַ֔שׁ צְבִ֥י הִ֖יא לְ/כָל הָ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: byvm hhv' nsh'ty ydy lhm lhvtsy'm m'rts mtsrym 'l 'rts 'shr trty lhm zbt chlb vdbsh tsby hy' lkhl h'rtsvt
verses.translation: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם אִ֣ישׁ שִׁקּוּצֵ֤י עֵינָי/ו֙ הַשְׁלִ֔יכוּ וּ/בְ/גִלּוּלֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם אַל תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mr 'lhm 'ysh shqvtsy 'ynyv hshlykhv vbglvly mtsrym 'l ttm'v 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְרוּ בִ֗/י וְ/לֹ֤א אָבוּ֙ לִּ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלַ֔/י אִ֣ישׁ אֶת שִׁקּוּצֵ֤י עֵֽינֵי/הֶם֙ לֹ֣א הִשְׁלִ֔יכוּ וְ/אֶת גִּלּוּלֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֣א עָזָ֑בוּ וָ/אֹמַ֞ר לִ/שְׁפֹּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֣/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם לְ/כַלּ֤וֹת אַפִּ/י֙ בָּ/הֶ֔ם בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vymrv by vl' 'bv lshm' 'ly 'ysh 't shqvtsy 'ynyhm l' hshlykhv v't glvly mtsrym l' 'zbv v'mr lshpkh chmty 'lyhm lkhlvt 'py bhm btvkh 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וָ/אַ֨עַשׂ֙ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֔/י לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י הֵחֵ֛ל לְ/עֵינֵ֥י הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר הֵ֣מָּה בְ/תוֹכָ֑/ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נוֹדַ֤עְתִּי אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/עֵ֣ינֵי/הֶ֔ם לְ/הוֹצִיאָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v''sh lm'n shmy lblty hchl l'yny hgvym 'shr hmh btvkhm 'shr nvd'ty 'lyhm l'ynyhm lhvtsy'm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were , in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וָ/אֽוֹצִיאֵ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָ/אֲבִאֵ֖/ם אֶל הַ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: v'vtsy'm m'rts mtsrym v'b'm 'l hmdbr
verses.translation: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתֵּ֤ן לָ/הֶם֙ אֶת חֻקּוֹתַ֔/י וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י הוֹדַ֣עְתִּי אוֹתָ֑/ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אוֹתָ֛/ם הָ/אָדָ֖ם וָ/חַ֥י בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tn lhm 't chqvty v't mshpty hvd'ty 'vtm 'shr y'shh 'vtm h'dm vchy bhm
verses.translation: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֤ם אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתַ/י֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ/הֶ֔ם לִ/הְי֣וֹת לְ/א֔וֹת בֵּינִ֖/י וּ/בֵֽינֵי/הֶ֑ם לָ/דַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vgm 't shbtvty ntty lhm lhyvt l'vt byny vbynyhm ld't khy 'ny yhvh mqdshm
verses.translation: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְרוּ בִ֨/י בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר בְּ/חֻקּוֹתַ֨/י לֹא הָלָ֜כוּ וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֣/י מָאָ֗סוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה אֹתָ֤/ם הָֽ/אָדָם֙ וָ/חַ֣י בָּ/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖/י חִלְּל֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וָ/אֹמַ֞ר לִ/שְׁפֹּ֨ךְ חֲמָתִ֧/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר לְ/כַלּוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vymrv by byt yshr'l bmdbr bchqvty l' hlkhv v't mshpty m'sv 'shr y'shh 'tm h'dm vchy bhm v't shbtty chllv m'd v'mr lshpkh chmty 'lyhm bmdbr lkhlvtm
verses.translation: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

verses.original: וָ/אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑/י לְ/בִלְתִּ֤י הֵחֵל֙ לְ/עֵינֵ֣י הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצֵאתִ֖י/ם לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v''shh lm'n shmy lblty hchl l'yny hgvym 'shr hvts'tym l'ynyhm
verses.translation: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִ֗י נָשָׂ֧אתִי יָדִ֛/י לָ/הֶ֖ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר לְ/בִלְתִּי֩ הָבִ֨יא אוֹתָ֜/ם אֶל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֗תִּי זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּ/דְבַ֔שׁ צְבִ֥י הִ֖יא לְ/כָל הָ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vgm 'ny nsh'ty ydy lhm bmdbr lblty hby' 'vtm 'l h'rts 'shr ntty zbt chlb vdbsh tsby hy' lkhl h'rtsvt
verses.translation: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them , flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;

verses.original: יַ֜עַן בְּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֣/י מָאָ֗סוּ וְ/אֶת חֻקּוֹתַ/י֙ לֹא הָלְכ֣וּ בָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖/י חִלֵּ֑לוּ כִּ֛י אַחֲרֵ֥י גִלּוּלֵי/הֶ֖ם לִבָּ֥/ם הֹלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: y'n bmshpty m'sv v't chqvty l' hlkhv bhm v't shbtvty chllv khy 'chry glvlyhm lbm hlkh
verses.translation: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֧חָס עֵינִ֛/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מִֽ/שַּׁחֲתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹֽא עָשִׂ֧יתִי אוֹתָ֛/ם כָּלָ֖ה בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vtchs 'yny 'lyhm mshchtm vl' 'shyty 'vtm khlh bmdbr
verses.translation: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֤ר אֶל בְּנֵי/הֶם֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּ/חוּקֵּ֤י אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ אַל תֵּלֵ֔כוּ וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפְּטֵי/הֶ֖ם אַל תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ וּ/בְ/גִלּוּלֵי/הֶ֖ם אַל תִּטַּמָּֽאוּ
verses.translit: v'mr 'l bnyhm bmdbr bchvqy 'bvtykhm 'l tlkhv v't mshptyhm 'l tshmrv vbglvlyhm 'l ttm'v
verses.translation: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/חֻקּוֹתַ֖/י לֵ֑כוּ וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֥/י שִׁמְר֖וּ וַ/עֲשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm bchqvty lkhv v't mshpty shmrv v'shv 'vtm
verses.translation: I am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖/י קַדֵּ֑שׁוּ וְ/הָי֤וּ לְ/אוֹת֙ בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵֽינֵי/כֶ֔ם לָ/דַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v't shbtvty qdshv vhyv l'vt byny vbynykhm ld't khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְרוּ בִ֣/י הַ/בָּנִ֗ים בְּ/חֻקּוֹתַ֣/י לֹֽא הָ֠לָכוּ וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֨/י לֹא שָׁמְר֜וּ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת אוֹתָ֗/ם אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה אוֹתָ֤/ם הָֽ/אָדָם֙ וָ/חַ֣י בָּ/הֶ֔ם אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖/י חִלֵּ֑לוּ וָ/אֹמַ֞ר לִ/שְׁפֹּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֣/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם לְ/כַלּ֥וֹת אַפִּ֛/י בָּ֖/ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vymrv by hbnym bchqvty l' hlkhv v't mshpty l' shmrv l'shvt 'vtm 'shr y'shh 'vtm h'dm vchy bhm 't shbtvty chllv v'mr lshpkh chmty 'lyhm lkhlvt 'py bm bmdbr
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/הֲשִׁבֹ֨תִי֙ אֶת יָדִ֔/י וָ/אַ֖עַשׂ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑/י לְ/בִלְתִּ֤י הֵחֵל֙ לְ/עֵינֵ֣י הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אוֹתָ֖/ם לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhshbty 't ydy v''sh lm'n shmy lblty hchl l'yny hgvym 'shr hvts'ty 'vtm l'ynyhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.

verses.original: גַּם אֲנִ֗י נָשָׂ֧אתִי אֶת יָדִ֛/י לָ/הֶ֖ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר לְ/הָפִ֤יץ אֹתָ/ם֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וּ/לְ/זָר֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖/ם בָּ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: gm 'ny nsh'ty 't ydy lhm bmdbr lhpyts 'tm bgvym vlzrvt 'vtm b'rtsvt
verses.translation: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;

verses.original: יַ֜עַן מִשְׁפָּטַ֤/י לֹֽא עָשׂוּ֙ וְ/חֻקּוֹתַ֣/י מָאָ֔סוּ וְ/אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖/י חִלֵּ֑לוּ וְ/אַחֲרֵי֙ גִּלּוּלֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם הָי֖וּ עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: y'n mshpty l' 'shv vchqvty m'sv v't shbtvty chllv v'chry glvly 'bvtm hyv 'ynyhm
