verses.translation: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ/הֶ֔ם חֻקִּ֖ים לֹ֣א טוֹבִ֑ים וּ/מִ֨שְׁפָּטִ֔ים לֹ֥א יִֽחְי֖וּ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vgm 'ny ntty lhm chqym l' tvbym vmshptym l' ychyv bhm
verses.translation: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;

verses.original: וָ/אֲטַמֵּ֤א אוֹתָ/ם֙ בְּ/מַתְּנוֹתָ֔/ם בְּ/הַעֲבִ֖יר כָּל פֶּ֣טֶר רָ֑חַם לְמַ֣עַן אֲשִׁמֵּ֔/ם לְמַ֨עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽדְע֔וּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'tm' 'vtm bmtnvtm bh'byr khl ptr rchm lm'n 'shmm lm'n 'shr yd'v 'shr 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶל בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בֶּן אָדָ֔ם וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה ע֗וֹד זֹ֚את גִּדְּפ֤וּ אוֹתִ/י֙ אֲב֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/מַעֲלָ֥/ם בִּ֖/י מָֽעַל
verses.translit: lkhn dbr 'l byt yshr'l bn 'dm v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'vd z't gdpv 'vty 'bvtykhm bm'lm by m'l
verses.translation: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

verses.original: וָ/אֲבִיאֵ/ם֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתִי֙ אֶת יָדִ֔/י לָ/תֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖/הּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּרְאוּ֩ כָל גִּבְעָ֨ה רָמָ֜ה וְ/כָל עֵ֣ץ עָבֹ֗ת וַ/יִּזְבְּחוּ שָׁ֤ם אֶת זִבְחֵי/הֶם֙ וַ/יִּתְּנוּ שָׁם֙ כַּ֣עַס קָרְבָּנָ֔/ם וַ/יָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שָׁ֗ם רֵ֚יחַ נִיח֣וֹחֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּסִּ֥יכוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת נִסְכֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'by'm 'l h'rts 'shr nsh'ty 't ydy ltt 'vth lhm vyr'v khl gb'h rmh vkhl 'ts 'bt vyzbchv shm 't zbchyhm vytnv shm kh's qrbnm vyshymv shm rych nychvchyhm vysykhv shm 't nskhyhm
verses.translation: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם מָ֣ה הַ/בָּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֥ם הַ/בָּאִ֖ים שָׁ֑ם וַ/יִּקָּרֵ֤א שְׁמָ/הּ֙ בָּמָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'mr 'lhm mh hbmh 'shr 'tm hb'ym shm vyqr' shmh bmh 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֶל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הַ/בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֣ם נִטְמְאִ֑ים וְ/אַחֲרֵ֥י שִׁקּוּצֵי/הֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִֽים
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr 'l byt yshr'l khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hbdrkh 'bvtykhm 'tm ntm'ym v'chry shqvtsyhm 'tm znym
verses.translation: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׂאֵ֣ת מַתְּנֹֽתֵי/כֶ֡ם בְּֽ/הַעֲבִיר֩ בְּנֵי/כֶ֨ם בָּ/אֵ֜שׁ אַתֶּם֩ נִטְמְאִ֤֨ים לְ/כָל גִּלּֽוּלֵי/כֶם֙ עַד הַ/יּ֔וֹם וַ/אֲנִ֛י אִדָּרֵ֥שׁ לָ/כֶ֖ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חַי אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה אִם אִדָּרֵ֖שׁ לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbsh't mtntykhm bh'byr bnykhm b'sh 'tm ntm'ym lkhl glvlykhm 'd hyvm v'ny 'drsh lkhm byt yshr'l chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm 'drsh lkhm
verses.translation: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord GOD , I will not be enquired of by you.

verses.original: וְ/הָֽ/עֹלָה֙ עַל ר֣וּחֲ/כֶ֔ם הָי֖וֹ לֹ֣א תִֽהְיֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים נִֽהְיֶ֤ה כַ/גּוֹיִם֙ כְּ/מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הָ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת לְ/שָׁרֵ֖ת עֵ֥ץ וָ/אָֽבֶן
verses.translit: vh'lh 'l rvchkhm hyv l' thyh 'shr 'tm 'mrym nhyh khgvym khmshpchvt h'rtsvt lshrt 'ts v'bn
verses.translation: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

verses.original: חַי אָ֕נִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה אִם לֹ֠א בְּ/יָ֨ד חֲזָקָ֜ה וּ/בִ/זְר֧וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֛ה וּ/בְ/חֵמָ֥ה שְׁפוּכָ֖ה אֶמְל֥וֹךְ עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm l' byd chzqh vbzrv' ntvyh vbchmh shpvkhh 'mlvkh 'lykhm
verses.translation: As I live, saith the Lord GOD , surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:

verses.original: וְ/הוֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מִן הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים וְ/קִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם מִן הָ֣/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפוֹצֹתֶ֖ם בָּ֑/ם בְּ/יָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּ/בִ/זְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּ/בְ/חֵמָ֖ה שְׁפוּכָֽה
verses.translit: vhvts'ty 'tkhm mn h'mym vqbtsty 'tkhm mn h'rtsvt 'shr npvtstm bm byd chzqh vbzrv' ntvyh vbchmh shpvkhh
verses.translation: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֶל מִדְבַּ֖ר הָֽ/עַמִּ֑ים וְ/נִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֤י אִתְּ/כֶם֙ שָׁ֔ם פָּנִ֖ים אֶל פָּנִֽים
verses.translit: vhb'ty 'tkhm 'l mdbr h'mym vnshptty 'tkhm shm pnym 'l pnym
verses.translation: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁפַּ֨טְתִּי֙ אֶת אֲב֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/מִדְבַּ֖ר אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כֵּ֚ן אִשָּׁפֵ֣ט אִתְּ/כֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: kh'shr nshptty 't 'bvtykhm bmdbr 'rts mtsrym khn 'shpt 'tkhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/הַעֲבַרְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑בֶט וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/מָסֹ֥רֶת הַ/בְּרִֽית
verses.translit: vh'brty 'tkhm tcht hshbt vhb'ty 'tkhm bmsrt hbryt
verses.translation: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:

verses.original: וּ/בָרוֹתִ֣י מִ/כֶּ֗ם הַ/מֹּרְדִ֤ים וְ/הַ/פּֽוֹשְׁעִים֙ בִּ֔/י מֵ/אֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵי/הֶם֙ אוֹצִ֣יא אוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/אֶל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יָב֑וֹא וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vbrvty mkhm hmrdym vhpvsh'ym by m'rts mgvryhm 'vtsy' 'vtm v'l 'dmt yshr'l l' ybv' vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֨ם בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה אִ֤ישׁ גִּלּוּלָי/ו֙ לְכ֣וּ עֲבֹ֔דוּ וְ/אַחַ֕ר אִם אֵינְ/כֶ֖ם שֹׁמְעִ֣ים אֵלָ֑/י וְ/אֶת שֵׁ֤ם קָדְשִׁ/י֙ לֹ֣א תְחַלְּלוּ ע֔וֹד בְּ/מַתְּנֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם וּ/בְ/גִלּוּלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tm byt yshr'l khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'ysh glvlyv lkhv 'bdv v'chr 'm 'ynkhm shm'ym 'ly v't shm qdshy l' tchllv 'vd bmtnvtykhm vbglvlykhm
verses.translation: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD ; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also , if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ/הַר קָדְשִׁ֞/י בְּ/הַ֣ר מְר֣וֹם יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה שָׁ֣ם יַעַבְדֻ֜/נִי כָּל בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כֻּלֹּ֖/ה בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ שָׁ֣ם אֶרְצֵ֔/ם וְ/שָׁ֞ם אֶדְר֣וֹשׁ אֶת תְּרוּמֹֽתֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/אֶת רֵאשִׁ֛ית מַשְׂאוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּ/כָל קָדְשֵׁי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy bhr qdshy bhr mrvm yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh shm y'bdny khl byt yshr'l khlh b'rts shm 'rtsm vshm 'drvsh 't trvmtykhm v't r'shyt msh'vtykhm bkhl qdshykhm
verses.translation: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD , there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

verses.original: בְּ/רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹחַ֮ אֶרְצֶ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶם֒ בְּ/הוֹצִיאִ֤/י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מִן הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים וְ/קִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם מִן הָ֣/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפֹצֹתֶ֖ם בָּ֑/ם וְ/נִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֥י בָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/עֵינֵ֥י הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: brych nychch 'rtsh 'tkhm bhvtsy'y 'tkhm mn h'mym vqbtsty 'tkhm mn h'rtsvt 'shr nptstm bm vnqdshty bkhm l'yny hgvym
verses.translation: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.

verses.original: וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בַּ/הֲבִיאִ֥/י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֶל אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתִי֙ אֶת יָדִ֔/י לָ/תֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖/הּ לַ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh bhby'y 'tkhm 'l 'dmt yshr'l 'l h'rts 'shr nsh'ty 't ydy ltt 'vth l'bvtykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall know that I am the LORD , when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.

verses.original: וּ/זְכַרְתֶּם שָׁ֗ם אֶת דַּרְכֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל עֲלִיל֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִטְמֵאתֶ֖ם בָּ֑/ם וּ/נְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/כָל רָעוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶֽם
verses.translit: vzkhrtm shm 't drkhykhm v't khl 'lylvtykhm 'shr ntm'tm bm vnqttm bpnykhm bkhl r'vtykhm 'shr 'shytm
verses.translation: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.

verses.original: וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בַּ/עֲשׂוֹתִ֥/י אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑/י לֹא֩ כְ/דַרְכֵי/כֶ֨ם הָ/רָעִ֜ים וְ/כַ/עֲלִילֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֤ם הַ/נִּשְׁחָתוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh b'shvty 'tkhm lm'n shmy l' khdrkhykhm hr'ym vkh'lylvtykhm hnshchtvt byt yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall know that I am the LORD , when I have wrought with you for my name’s sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD .
Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;

And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD ; Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
Then said I, Ah Lord GOD ! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ תֵּימָ֔נָ/ה וְ/הַטֵּ֖ף אֶל דָּר֑וֹם וְ/הִנָּבֵ֛א אֶל יַ֥עַר הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה נֶֽגֶב
verses.translit: bn 'dm shym pnykh drkh tymnh vhtf 'l drvm vhnb' 'l y'r hshdh ngb
verses.translation: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,

verses.original: וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְ/יַ֣עַר הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֡ה הִנְ/נִ֣י מַֽצִּית בְּ/ךָ֣ אֵ֡שׁ וְ/אָכְלָ֣ה בְ/ךָ֣ כָל עֵֽץ לַח֩ וְ/כָל עֵ֨ץ יָבֵ֤שׁ לֹֽא תִכְבֶּה֙ לַהֶ֣בֶת שַׁלְהֶ֔בֶת וְ/נִצְרְבוּ בָ֥/הּ כָּל פָּנִ֖ים מִ/נֶּ֥גֶב צָפֽוֹנָ/ה
verses.translit: v'mrt ly'r hngb shm' dbr yhvh khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny mtsyt bkh 'sh v'khlh bkh khl 'ts lch vkhl 'ts ybsh l' tkhbh lhbt shlhbt vntsrbv bh khl pnym mngb tspvnh
verses.translation: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

verses.original: וְ/רָאוּ֙ כָּל בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בִּֽעַרְתִּ֑י/הָ לֹ֖א תִּכְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: vr'v khl bshr khy 'ny yhvh b'rtyh l' tkhbh
verses.translation: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֕ר אֲהָ֖הּ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה הֵ֚מָּה אֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֔/י הֲ/לֹ֛א מְמַשֵּׁ֥ל מְשָׁלִ֖ים הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh hmh 'mrym ly hl' mmshl mshlym hv'
verses.translation: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/הַטֵּ֖ף אֶל מִקְדָּשִׁ֑ים וְ/הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bn 'dm shym pnykh 'l yrvshlm vhtf 'l mqdshym vhnb' 'l 'dmt yshr'l
verses.translation: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֞ לְ/אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֣י אֵלַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/הוֹצֵאתִ֥י חַרְבִּ֖/י מִ/תַּעְרָ֑/הּ וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֵּ֖/ךְ צַדִּ֥יק וְ/רָשָֽׁע
verses.translit: v'mrt l'dmt yshr'l khh 'mr yhvh hnny 'lykh vhvts'ty chrby mt'rh vhkhrty mmkh tsdyq vrsh'
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: יַ֛עַן אֲשֶׁר הִכְרַ֥תִּי מִמֵּ֖/ךְ צַדִּ֣יק וְ/רָשָׁ֑ע לָ֠/כֵן תֵּצֵ֨א חַרְבִּ֧/י מִ/תַּעְרָ֛/הּ אֶל כָּל בָּשָׂ֖ר מִ/נֶּ֥גֶב צָפֽוֹן
verses.translit: y'n 'shr hkhrty mmkh tsdyq vrsh' lkhn tts' chrby mt'rh 'l khl bshr mngb tspvn
verses.translation: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD ; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:

verses.original: וְ/יָֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הוֹצֵ֥אתִי חַרְבִּ֖/י מִ/תַּעְרָ֑/הּ לֹ֥א תָשׁ֖וּב עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vyd'v khl bshr khy 'ny yhvh hvts'ty chrby mt'rh l' tshvb 'vd
verses.translation: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֥ה בֶן אָדָ֖ם הֵֽאָנַ֑ח בְּ/שִׁבְר֤וֹן מָתְנַ֨יִם֙ וּ/בִ/מְרִיר֔וּת תֵּֽאָנַ֖ח לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm h'nch bshbrvn mtnym vbmryrvt t'nch l'ynyhm
verses.translation: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ כִּֽי יֹאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ עַל מָ֖ה אַתָּ֣ה נֶאֱנָ֑ח וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֡ אֶל שְׁמוּעָ֣ה כִֽי בָאָ֡ה וְ/נָמֵ֣ס כָּל לֵב֩ וְ/רָפ֨וּ כָל יָדַ֜יִם וְ/כִהֲתָ֣ה כָל ר֗וּחַ וְ/כָל בִּרְכַּ֨יִם֙ תֵּלַ֣כְנָה מַּ֔יִם הִנֵּ֤ה בָאָה֙ וְ/נִֽהְיָ֔תָה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vhyh khy y'mrv 'lykh 'l mh 'th n'nch v'mrt 'l shmv'h khy b'h vnms khl lb vrpv khl ydym vkhhth khl rvch vkhl brkhym tlkhnh mym hnh b'h vnhyth n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more , saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵא֙ וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֑/י אֱמֹ֕ר חֶ֥רֶב חֶ֛רֶב הוּחַ֖דָּה וְ/גַם מְרוּטָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'dm hnb' v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny 'mr chrb chrb hvchdh vgm mrvth
verses.translation: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן טְבֹ֤חַ טֶ֨בַח֙ הוּחַ֔דָּה לְמַעַן הֱיֵה לָ֥/הּ בָּ֖רָק מֹרָ֑טָּה א֣וֹ נָשִׂ֔ישׂ שֵׁ֥בֶט בְּנִ֖/י מֹאֶ֥סֶת כָּל עֵֽץ
verses.translit: lm'n tbch tbch hvchdh lm'n hyh lh brq mrth 'v nshysh shbt bny m'st khl 'ts
verses.translation: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛/הּ לְ/מָרְטָ֖ה לִ/תְפֹּ֣שׂ בַּ/כָּ֑ף הִֽיא הוּחַ֤דָּה חֶ֨רֶב֙ וְ/הִ֣יא מֹרָ֔טָּה לָ/תֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖/הּ בְּ/יַד הוֹרֵֽג
verses.translit: vytn 'th lmrth ltpsh bkhf hy' hvchdh chrb vhy' mrth ltt 'vth byd hvrg
verses.translation: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.

verses.original: זְעַ֤ק וְ/הֵילֵל֙ בֶּן אָדָ֔ם כִּי הִיא֙ הָיתָ֣ה בְ/עַמִּ֔/י הִ֖יא בְּ/כָל נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מְגוּרֵ֤י אֶל חֶ֨רֶב֙ הָי֣וּ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י לָ/כֵ֖ן סְפֹ֥ק אֶל יָרֵֽךְ
verses.translit: z'q vhyll bn 'dm khy hy' hyth b'my hy' bkhl nshy'y yshr'l mgvry 'l chrb hyv 't 'my lkhn spq 'l yrkh
verses.translation: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said it .

verses.original: כִּ֣י בֹ֔חַן וּ/מָ֕ה אִם גַּם שֵׁ֥בֶט מֹאֶ֖סֶת לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: khy bchn vmh 'm gm shbt m'st l' yhyh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם הִנָּבֵ֕א וְ/הַ֖ךְ כַּ֣ף אֶל כָּ֑ף וְ/תִכָּפֵ֞ל חֶ֤רֶב שְׁלִישִׁ֨תָ/ה֙ חֶ֣רֶב חֲלָלִ֔ים הִ֗יא חֶ֚רֶב חָלָ֣ל הַ/גָּד֔וֹל הַ/חֹדֶ֖רֶת לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm hnb' vhkh khf 'l khf vtkhpl chrb shlyshth chrb chllym hy' chrb chll hgdvl hchdrt lhm
verses.translation: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן לָ/מ֣וּג לֵ֗ב וְ/הַרְבֵּה֙ הַ/מִּכְשֹׁלִ֔ים עַ֚ל כָּל שַׁ֣עֲרֵי/הֶ֔ם נָתַ֖תִּי אִבְחַת חָ֑רֶב אָ֛ח עֲשׂוּיָ֥ה לְ/בָרָ֖ק מְעֻטָּ֥ה לְ/טָֽבַח
verses.translit: lm'n lmvg lb vhrbh hmkhshlym 'l khl sh'ryhm ntty 'bcht chrb 'ch 'shvyh lbrq m'th ltbch
verses.translation: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.

verses.original: הִתְאַחֲדִ֥י הֵימִ֖נִי הָשִׂ֣ימִי הַשְׂמִ֑ילִי אָ֖נָה פָּנַ֥יִ/ךְ מֻעָדֽוֹת
verses.translit: ht'chdy hymny hshymy hshmyly 'nh pnykh m'dvt
verses.translation: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִ֗י אַכֶּ֤ה כַפִּ/י֙ אֶל כַּפִּ֔/י וַ/הֲנִחֹתִ֖י חֲמָתִ֑/י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: vgm 'ny 'khh khpy 'l khpy vhnchty chmty 'ny yhvh dbrty
verses.translation: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֨ה בֶן אָדָ֜ם שִׂים לְ/ךָ֣ שְׁנַ֣יִם דְּרָכִ֗ים לָ/בוֹא֙ חֶ֣רֶב מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ אֶחָ֖ד יֵצְא֣וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/יָ֣ד בָּרֵ֔א בְּ/רֹ֥אשׁ דֶּֽרֶךְ עִ֖יר בָּרֵֽא
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm shym lkh shnym drkhym lbv' chrb mlkh bbl m'rts 'chd yts'v shnyhm vyd br' br'sh drkh 'yr br'
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say , that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ תָּשִׂ֔ים לָ/ב֣וֹא חֶ֔רֶב אֵ֖ת רַבַּ֣ת בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֑וֹן וְ/אֶת יְהוּדָ֥ה בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּצוּרָֽה
verses.translit: drkh tshym lbv' chrb 't rbt bny 'mvn v't yhvdh byrvshlm btsvrh
verses.translation: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,

verses.original: כִּֽי עָמַ֨ד מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל אֶל אֵ֣ם הַ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ בְּ/רֹ֛אשׁ שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/דְּרָכִ֖ים לִ/קְסָם קָ֑סֶם קִלְקַ֤ל בַּֽ/חִצִּים֙ שָׁאַ֣ל בַּ/תְּרָפִ֔ים רָאָ֖ה בַּ/כָּבֵֽד
verses.translit: khy 'md mlkh bbl 'l 'm hdrkh br'sh shny hdrkhym lqsm qsm qlql bchtsym sh'l btrpym r'h bkhbd
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.

verses.original: בִּֽ/ימִינ֞/וֹ הָיָ֣ה הַ/קֶּ֣סֶם יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לָ/שׂ֤וּם כָּרִים֙ לִ/פְתֹּ֤חַ פֶּה֙ בְּ/רֶ֔צַח לְ/הָרִ֥ים ק֖וֹל בִּ/תְרוּעָ֑ה לָ/שׂ֤וּם כָּרִים֙ עַל שְׁעָרִ֔ים לִ/שְׁפֹּ֥ךְ סֹלְלָ֖ה לִ/בְנ֥וֹת דָּיֵֽק
verses.translit: bymynv hyh hqsm yrvshlm lshvm khrym lptch ph brtsch lhrym qvl btrv'h lshvm khrym 'l sh'rym lshpkh sllh lbnvt dyq
verses.translation: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more , until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him .

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה לָ/הֶ֤ם כ/קסום כִּ/קְסָם שָׁוְא֙ בְּ/עֵ֣ינֵי/הֶ֔ם שְׁבֻעֵ֥י שְׁבֻע֖וֹת לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/הֽוּא מַזְכִּ֥יר עָוֺ֖ן לְ/הִתָּפֵֽשׂ
verses.translit: vhyh lhm khqsvm khqsm shv' b'ynyhm shb'y shb'vt lhm vhv' mzkhyr 'vn lhtpsh
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ יַ֗עַן הַזְכַּרְ/כֶם֙ עֲוֺ֣נְ/כֶ֔ם בְּ/הִגָּל֣וֹת פִּשְׁעֵי/כֶ֗ם לְ/הֵֽרָאוֹת֙ חַטֹּ֣אותֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/כֹ֖ל עֲלִילֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם יַ֚עַן הִזָּ֣כֶרְ/כֶ֔ם בַּ/כַּ֖ף תִּתָּפֵֽשׂוּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n hzkhrkhm 'vnkhm bhglvt psh'ykhm lhr'vt cht'vtykhm bkhl 'lylvtykhm y'n hzkhrkhm bkhf ttpshv
verses.translation: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ חָלָ֣ל רָשָׁ֔ע נְשִׂ֖יא יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣א יוֹמ֔/וֹ בְּ/עֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן קֵֽץ
verses.translit: v'th chll rsh' nshy' yshr'l 'shr b' yvmv b't 'vn qts
verses.translation: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הָסִיר֙ הַ/מִּצְנֶ֔פֶת וְ/הָרִ֖ים הָֽ/עֲטָרָ֑ה זֹ֣את לֹא זֹ֔את הַ/שָּׁפָ֣לָה הַגְבֵּ֔הַ וְ/הַ/גָּבֹ֖הַ הַשְׁפִּֽיל
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hsyr hmtsnpt vhrym h'trh z't l' z't hshplh hgbh vhgbh hshpyl
verses.translation: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.

verses.original: עַוָּ֥ה עַוָּ֖ה עַוָּ֣ה אֲשִׂימֶ֑/נָּה גַּם זֹאת֙ לֹ֣א הָיָ֔ה עַד בֹּ֛א אֲשֶׁר ל֥/וֹ הַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/נְתַתִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'vh 'vh 'vh 'shymnh gm z't l' hyh 'd b' 'shr lv hmshpt vnttyv
verses.translation: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the LORD have spoken it .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם הֲ/תִשְׁפֹּ֥ט הֲ/תִשְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת עִ֣יר הַ/דָּמִ֑ים וְ/ה֣וֹדַעְתָּ֔/הּ אֵ֖ת כָּל תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm htshpt htshpt 't 'yr hdmym vhvd'th 't khl tv'bvtyh
verses.translation: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה עִ֣יר שֹׁפֶ֥כֶת דָּ֛ם בְּ/תוֹכָ֖/הּ לָ/ב֣וֹא עִתָּ֑/הּ וְ/עָשְׂתָ֧ה גִלּוּלִ֛ים עָלֶ֖י/הָ לְ/טָמְאָֽה
verses.translit: v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'yr shpkht dm btvkhh lbv' 'th v'shth glvlym 'lyh ltm'h
verses.translation: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD , The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.

verses.original: בְּ/דָמֵ֨/ךְ אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַ֜כְתְּ אָשַׁ֗מְתְּ וּ/בְ/גִלּוּלַ֤יִ/ךְ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂית֙ טָמֵ֔את וַ/תַּקְרִ֣יבִי יָמַ֔יִ/ךְ וַ/תָּב֖וֹא עַד שְׁנוֹתָ֑יִ/ךְ עַל כֵּ֗ן נְתַתִּ֤י/ךְ חֶרְפָּה֙ לַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/קַלָּסָ֖ה לְ/כָל הָ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: bdmkh 'shr shpkht 'shmt vbglvlykh 'shr 'shyt tm't vtqryby ymykh vtbv' 'd shnvtykh 'l khn nttykh chrph lgvym vqlsh lkhl h'rtsvt
verses.translation: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.

verses.original: הַ/קְּרֹב֛וֹת וְ/הָ/רְחֹק֥וֹת מִמֵּ֖/ךְ יִתְקַלְּסוּ בָ֑/ךְ טְמֵאַ֣ת הַ/שֵּׁ֔ם רַבַּ֖ת הַ/מְּהוּמָֽה
verses.translit: hqrbvt vhrchqvt mmkh ytqlsv bkh tm't hshm rbt hmhvmh
verses.translation: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֥ישׁ לִ/זְרֹע֖/וֹ הָ֣יוּ בָ֑/ךְ לְמַ֖עַן שְׁפָךְ דָּֽם
verses.translit: hnh nshy'y yshr'l 'ysh lzr'v hyv bkh lm'n shpkh dm
verses.translation: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.

verses.original: אָ֤ב וָ/אֵם֙ הֵקַ֣לּוּ בָ֔/ךְ לַ/גֵּ֛ר עָשׂ֥וּ בַ/עֹ֖שֶׁק בְּ/תוֹכֵ֑/ךְ יָת֥וֹם וְ/אַלְמָנָ֖ה ה֥וֹנוּ בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'b v'm hqlv bkh lgr 'shv b'shq btvkhkh ytvm v'lmnh hvnv bkh
verses.translation: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

verses.original: קָדָשַׁ֖/י בָּזִ֑ית וְ/אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖/י חִלָּֽלְתְּ
verses.translit: qdshy bzyt v't shbtty chllt
verses.translation: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י רָכִ֛יל הָ֥יוּ בָ֖/ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ דָּ֑ם וְ/אֶל הֶֽ/הָרִים֙ אָ֣כְלוּ בָ֔/ךְ זִמָּ֖ה עָשׂ֥וּ בְ/תוֹכֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'nshy rkhyl hyv bkh lm'n shpkh dm v'l hhrym 'khlv bkh zmh 'shv btvkhkh
verses.translation: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

verses.original: עֶרְוַת אָ֖ב גִּלָּה בָ֑/ךְ טְמֵאַ֥ת הַ/נִּדָּ֖ה עִנּוּ בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'rvt 'b glh bkh tm't hndh 'nv bkh
verses.translation: In thee have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֗/הוּ עָשָׂה֙ תּֽוֹעֵבָ֔ה וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶת כַּלָּת֖/וֹ טִמֵּ֣א בְ/זִמָּ֑ה וְ/אִ֛ישׁ אֶת אֲחֹת֥/וֹ בַת אָבִ֖י/ו עִנָּה בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'ysh 't 'sht r'hv 'shh tv'bh v'ysh 't khltv tm' bzmh v'ysh 't 'chtv bt 'byv 'nh bkh
verses.translation: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

verses.original: שֹׁ֥חַד לָֽקְחוּ בָ֖/ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ דָּ֑ם נֶ֧שֶׁךְ וְ/תַרְבִּ֣ית לָקַ֗חַתְּ וַ/תְּבַצְּעִ֤י רֵעַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בַּ/עֹ֔שֶׁק וְ/אֹתִ֣/י שָׁכַ֔חַתְּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: shchd lqchv bkh lm'n shpkh dm nshkh vtrbyt lqcht vtbts'y r'ykh b'shq v'ty shkhcht n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֙ הִכֵּ֣יתִי כַפִּ֔/י אֶל בִּצְעֵ֖/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית וְ/עַ֨ל דָּמֵ֔/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ בְּ/תוֹכֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhnh hkhyty khpy 'l bts'kh 'shr 'shyt v'l dmkh 'shr hyv btvkhkh
verses.translation: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

verses.original: הֲ/יַעֲמֹ֤ד לִבֵּ/ךְ֙ אִם תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יָדַ֔יִ/ךְ לַ/יָּמִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה אוֹתָ֑/ךְ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְ/עָשִֽׂיתִי
verses.translit: hy'md lbkh 'm tchzqnh ydykh lymym 'shr 'ny 'shh 'vtkh 'ny yhvh dbrty v'shyty
verses.translation: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken it , and will do it .

verses.original: וַ/הֲפִיצוֹתִ֤י אוֹתָ/ךְ֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/זֵרִיתִ֖י/ךְ בָּ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת וַ/הֲתִמֹּתִ֥י טֻמְאָתֵ֖/ךְ מִמֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhpytsvty 'vtkh bgvym vzrytykh b'rtsvt vhtmty tm'tkh mmkh
verses.translation: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

verses.original: וְ/נִחַ֥לְתְּ בָּ֖/ךְ לְ/עֵינֵ֣י גוֹיִ֑ם וְ/יָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnchlt bkh l'yny gvym vyd't khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הָיוּ לִ֥/י בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ל/סוג לְ/סִ֑יג כֻּלָּ֡/ם נְ֠חֹשֶׁת וּ/בְדִ֨יל וּ/בַרְזֶ֤ל וְ/עוֹפֶ֨רֶת֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר סִגִ֥ים כֶּ֖סֶף הָיֽוּ
verses.translit: bn 'dm hyv ly byt yshr'l lsvg lsyg khlm nchsht vbdyl vbrzl v'vprt btvkh khvr sgym khsf hyv
verses.translation: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֛עַן הֱי֥וֹת כֻּלְּ/כֶ֖ם לְ/סִגִ֑ים לָ/כֵן֙ הִנְ/נִ֣י קֹבֵ֣ץ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֶל תּ֖וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n hyvt khlkhm lsgym lkhn hnny qbts 'tkhm 'l tvkh yrvshlm
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

verses.original: קְבֻ֣צַת כֶּ֡סֶף וּ֠/נְחֹשֶׁת וּ/בַרְזֶ֨ל וְ/עוֹפֶ֤רֶת וּ/בְדִיל֙ אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר לָ/פַֽחַת עָלָ֥י/ו אֵ֖שׁ לְ/הַנְתִּ֑יךְ כֵּ֤ן אֶקְבֹּץ֙ בְּ/אַפִּ֣/י וּ/בַ/חֲמָתִ֔/י וְ/הִנַּחְתִּ֥י וְ/הִתַּכְתִּ֖י אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: qbtst khsf vnchsht vbrzl v'vprt vbdyl 'l tvkh khvr lpcht 'lyv 'sh lhntykh khn 'qbts b'py vbchmty vhnchty vhtkhty 'tkhm
verses.translation: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there , and melt you.

verses.original: וְ/כִנַּסְתִּ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/נָפַחְתִּ֥י עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּ/אֵ֣שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֑/י וְ/נִתַּכְתֶּ֖ם בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vkhnsty 'tkhm vnpchty 'lykhm b'sh 'brty vntkhtm btvkhh
verses.translation: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

verses.original: כְּ/הִתּ֥וּךְ כֶּ֨סֶף֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר כֵּ֖ן תֻּתְּכ֣וּ בְ/תוֹכָ֑/הּ וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שָׁפַ֥כְתִּי חֲמָתִ֖/י עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khhtvkh khsf btvkh khvr khn ttkhv btvkhh vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh shpkhty chmty 'lykhm
verses.translation: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם אֱמָר לָ֕/הּ אַ֣תְּ אֶ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א מְטֹהָרָ֖ה הִ֑יא לֹ֥א גֻשְׁמָ֖/הּ בְּ/י֥וֹם זָֽעַם
verses.translit: bn 'dm 'mr lh 't 'rts l' mthrh hy' l' gshmh byvm z'm
verses.translation: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

verses.original: קֶ֤שֶׁר נְבִיאֶ֨י/הָ֙ בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/הּ כַּ/אֲרִ֥י שׁוֹאֵ֖ג טֹ֣רֵֽף טָ֑רֶף נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָכָ֗לוּ חֹ֤סֶן וִ/יקָר֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ אַלְמְנוֹתֶ֖י/הָ הִרְבּ֥וּ בְ/תוֹכָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: qshr nby'yh btvkhh kh'ry shv'g trf trf npsh 'khlv chsn vyqr yqchv 'lmnvtyh hrbv btvkhh
verses.translation: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.

verses.original: כֹּהֲנֶ֜י/הָ חָמְס֣וּ תוֹרָתִ/י֮ וַ/יְחַלְּל֣וּ קָדָשַׁ/י֒ בֵּֽין קֹ֤דֶשׁ לְ/חֹל֙ לֹ֣א הִבְדִּ֔ילוּ וּ/בֵין הַ/טָּמֵ֥א לְ/טָה֖וֹר לֹ֣א הוֹדִ֑יעוּ וּ/מִ/שַׁבְּתוֹתַ/י֙ הֶעְלִ֣ימוּ עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֔ם וָ/אֵחַ֖ל בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khhnyh chmsv tvrty vychllv qdshy byn qdsh lchl l' hbdylv vbyn htm' lthvr l' hvdy'v vmshbtvty h'lymv 'ynyhm v'chl btvkhm
verses.translation: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

verses.original: שָׂרֶ֣י/הָ בְ/קִרְבָּ֔/הּ כִּ/זְאֵבִ֖ים טֹ֣רְפֵי טָ֑רֶף לִ/שְׁפָּךְ דָּם֙ לְ/אַבֵּ֣ד נְפָשׁ֔וֹת לְמַ֖עַן בְּצֹ֥עַ בָּֽצַע
verses.translit: shryh bqrbh khz'bym trpy trf lshpkh dm l'bd npshvt lm'n bts' bts'
verses.translation: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

verses.original: וּ/נְבִיאֶ֗י/הָ טָח֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ תָּפֵ֔ל חֹזִ֣ים שָׁ֔וְא וְ/קֹסְמִ֥ים לָ/הֶ֖ם כָּזָ֑ב אֹמְרִ֗ים כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א דִבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vnby'yh tchv lhm tpl chzym shv' vqsmym lhm khzb 'mrym khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vyhvh l' dbr
verses.translation: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter , seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD , when the LORD hath not spoken.

verses.original: עַ֤ם הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ עָ֣שְׁקוּ עֹ֔שֶׁק וְ/גָזְל֖וּ גָּזֵ֑ל וְ/עָנִ֤י וְ/אֶבְיוֹן֙ הוֹנ֔וּ וְ/אֶת הַ/גֵּ֥ר עָשְׁק֖וּ בְּ/לֹ֥א מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: 'm h'rts 'shqv 'shq vgzlv gzl v'ny v'byvn hvnv v't hgr 'shqv bl' mshpt
verses.translation: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.

verses.original: וָ/אֲבַקֵּ֣שׁ מֵ/הֶ֡ם אִ֣ישׁ גֹּֽדֵר גָּדֵר֩ וְ/עֹמֵ֨ד בַּ/פֶּ֧רֶץ לְ/פָנַ֛/י בְּעַ֥ד הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/בִלְתִּ֣י שַׁחֲתָ֑/הּ וְ/לֹ֖א מָצָֽאתִי
verses.translit: v'bqsh mhm 'ysh gdr gdr v'md bprts lpny b'd h'rts lblty shchth vl' mts'ty
verses.translation: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ זַעְמִ֔/י בְּ/אֵ֥שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֖/י כִּלִּיתִ֑י/ם דַּרְכָּ/ם֙ בְּ/רֹאשָׁ֣/ם נָתַ֔תִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִֽה
verses.translit: v'shpkh 'lyhm z'my b'sh 'brty khlytym drkhm br'shm ntty n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֑ם שְׁתַּ֣יִם נָשִׁ֔ים בְּנ֥וֹת אֵם אַחַ֖ת הָיֽוּ
verses.translit: bn 'dm shtym nshym bnvt 'm 'cht hyv
verses.translation: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

verses.original: וַ/תִּזְנֶ֣ינָה בְ/מִצְרַ֔יִם בִּ/נְעוּרֵי/הֶ֖ן זָנ֑וּ שָׁ֚מָּ/ה מֹעֲכ֣וּ שְׁדֵי/הֶ֔ן וְ/שָׁ֣ם עִשּׂ֔וּ דַּדֵּ֖י בְּתוּלֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vtznynh bmtsrym bn'vryhn znv shmh m'khv shdyhn vshm 'shv ddy btvlyhn
verses.translation: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמוֹתָ֗/ן אָהֳלָ֤ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָה֙ וְ/אָהֳלִיבָ֣ה אֲחוֹתָ֔/הּ וַ/תִּֽהְיֶ֣ינָה לִ֔/י וַ/תֵּלַ֖דְנָה בָּנִ֣ים וּ/בָנ֑וֹת וּ/שְׁמוֹתָ֕/ן שֹׁמְר֣וֹן אָהֳלָ֔ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָהֳלִיבָֽה
verses.translit: vshmvtn 'hlh hgdvlh v'hlybh 'chvth vthyynh ly vtldnh bnym vbnvt vshmvtn shmrvn 'hlh vyrvshlm 'hlybh
verses.translation: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.

verses.original: וַ/תִּ֥זֶן אָהֳלָ֖ה תַּחְתָּ֑/י וַ/תַּעְגַּב֙ עַֽל מְאַהֲבֶ֔י/הָ אֶל אַשּׁ֖וּר קְרוֹבִֽים
verses.translit: vtzn 'hlh tchty vt'gb 'l m'hbyh 'l 'shvr qrvbym
verses.translation: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,

verses.original: לְבֻשֵׁ֤י תְכֵ֨לֶת֙ פַּח֣וֹת וּ/סְגָנִ֔ים בַּח֥וּרֵי חֶ֖מֶד כֻּלָּ֑/ם פָּרָשִׁ֕ים רֹכְבֵ֖י סוּסִֽים
verses.translit: lbshy tkhlt pchvt vsgnym bchvry chmd khlm prshym rkhby svsym
verses.translation: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתֵּ֤ן תַּזְנוּתֶ֨י/הָ֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם מִבְחַ֥ר בְּנֵֽי אַשּׁ֖וּר כֻּלָּ֑/ם וּ/בְ/כֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר עָֽגְבָ֛ה בְּ/כָל גִּלּוּלֵי/הֶ֖ם נִטְמָֽאָה
verses.translit: vttn tznvtyh 'lyhm mbchr bny 'shvr khlm vbkhl 'shr 'gbh bkhl glvlyhm ntm'h
verses.translation: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת תַּזְנוּתֶ֤י/הָ מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ לֹ֣א עָזָ֔בָה כִּ֤י אוֹתָ/הּ֙ שָׁכְב֣וּ בִ/נְעוּרֶ֔י/הָ וְ/הֵ֥מָּה עִשּׂ֖וּ דַּדֵּ֣י בְתוּלֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יִּשְׁפְּכ֥וּ תַזְנוּתָ֖/ם עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v't tznvtyh mmtsrym l' 'zbh khy 'vth shkhbv bn'vryh vhmh 'shv ddy btvlyh vyshpkhv tznvtm 'lyh
verses.translation: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֥ן נְתַתִּ֖י/הָ בְּ/יַד מְאַֽהֲבֶ֑י/הָ בְּ/יַד֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָגְבָ֖ה עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: lkhn nttyh byd m'hbyh byd bny 'shvr 'shr 'gbh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

verses.original: הֵמָּה֮ גִּלּ֣וּ עֶרְוָתָ/הּ֒ בָּנֶ֤י/הָ וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ לָקָ֔חוּ וְ/אוֹתָ֖/הּ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב הָרָ֑גוּ וַ/תְּהִי שֵׁם֙ לַ/נָּשִׁ֔ים וּ/שְׁפוּטִ֖ים עָ֥שׂוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hmh glv 'rvth bnyh vbnvtyh lqchv v'vth bchrb hrgv vthy shm lnshym vshpvtym 'shv bh
verses.translation: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא֙ אֲחוֹתָ֣/הּ אָהֳלִיבָ֔ה וַ/תַּשְׁחֵ֥ת עַגְבָתָ֖/הּ מִמֶּ֑/נָּה וְ/אֶת תַּ֨זְנוּתֶ֔י/הָ מִ/זְּנוּנֵ֖י אֲחוֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtr' 'chvth 'hlybh vtshcht 'gbth mmnh v't tznvtyh mznvny 'chvth
verses.translation: And when her sister Aholibah saw this , she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.

verses.original: אֶל בְּנֵי֩ אַשּׁ֨וּר עָגָ֜בָה פַּח֨וֹת וּ/סְגָנִ֤ים קְרֹבִים֙ לְבֻשֵׁ֣י מִכְל֔וֹל פָּרָשִׁ֖ים רֹכְבֵ֣י סוּסִ֑ים בַּח֥וּרֵי חֶ֖מֶד כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'l bny 'shvr 'gbh pchvt vsgnym qrbym lbshy mkhlvl prshym rkhby svsym bchvry chmd khlm
verses.translation: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֖רֶא כִּ֣י נִטְמָ֑אָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ אֶחָ֖ד לִ/שְׁתֵּי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: v'r' khy ntm'h drkh 'chd lshtyhn
verses.translation: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,

verses.original: וַ/תּ֖וֹסֶף אֶל תַּזְנוּתֶ֑י/הָ וַ/תֵּ֗רֶא אַנְשֵׁי֙ מְחֻקֶּ֣ה עַל הַ/קִּ֔יר צַלְמֵ֣י כשדיים כַשְׂדִּ֔ים חֲקֻקִ֖ים בַּ/שָּׁשַֽׁר
verses.translit: vtvsf 'l tznvtyh vtr' 'nshy mchqh 'l hqyr tslmy khshdyym khshdym chqqym bshshr
verses.translation: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,

verses.original: חֲגוֹרֵ֨י אֵז֜וֹר בְּ/מָתְנֵי/הֶ֗ם סְרוּחֵ֤י טְבוּלִים֙ בְּ/רָ֣אשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם מַרְאֵ֥ה שָׁלִשִׁ֖ים כֻּלָּ֑/ם דְּמ֤וּת בְּנֵֽי בָבֶל֙ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֶ֖רֶץ מוֹלַדְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: chgvry 'zvr bmtnyhm srvchy tbvlym br'shyhm mr'h shlshym khlm dmvt bny bbl khshdym 'rts mvldtm
verses.translation: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:

verses.original: ו/תעגב וַ/תַּעְגְּבָ֥/ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַרְאֵ֣ה עֵינֶ֑י/הָ וַ/תִּשְׁלַ֧ח מַלְאָכִ֛ים אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם כַּשְׂדִּֽימָ/ה
verses.translit: vt'gb vt'gbh 'lyhm lmr'h 'ynyh vtshlch ml'khym 'lyhm khshdymh
verses.translation: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ אֵלֶ֤י/הָ בְנֵֽי בָבֶל֙ לְ/מִשְׁכַּ֣ב דֹּדִ֔ים וַ/יְטַמְּא֥וּ אוֹתָ֖/הּ בְּ/תַזְנוּתָ֑/ם וַ/תִּ֨טְמָא בָ֔/ם וַ/תֵּ֥קַע נַפְשָׁ֖/הּ מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lyh bny bbl lmshkhb ddym vytm'v 'vth btznvtm vttm' bm vtq' npshh mhm
verses.translation: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

verses.original: וַ/תְּגַל֙ תַּזְנוּתֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תְּגַ֖ל אֶת עֶרְוָתָ֑/הּ וַ/תֵּ֤קַע נַפְשִׁ/י֙ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/הָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖/י מֵ/עַ֥ל אֲחוֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtgl tznvtyh vtgl 't 'rvth vtq' npshy m'lyh kh'shr nq'h npshy m'l 'chvth
verses.translation: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.

verses.original: וַ/תַּרְבֶּ֖ה אֶת תַּזְנוּתֶ֑י/הָ לִ/זְכֹּר֙ אֶת יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרֶ֔י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר זָנְתָ֖ה בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vtrbh 't tznvtyh lzkhr 't ymy n'vryh 'shr znth b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַֽ/תַּעְגְּבָ֔/ה עַ֖ל פִּֽלַגְשֵׁי/הֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּשַׂר חֲמוֹרִים֙ בְּשָׂרָ֔/ם וְ/זִרְמַ֥ת סוּסִ֖ים זִרְמָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vt'gbh 'l plgshyhm 'shr bshr chmvrym bshrm vzrmt svsym zrmtm
verses.translation: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

verses.original: וַֽ/תִּפְקְדִ֔י אֵ֖ת זִמַּ֣ת נְעוּרָ֑יִ/ךְ בַּ/עְשׂ֤וֹת מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ דַּדַּ֔יִ/ךְ לְמַ֖עַן שְׁדֵ֥י נְעוּרָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vtpqdy 't zmt n'vrykh b'shvt mmtsrym ddykh lm'n shdy n'vrykh
verses.translation: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן אָהֳלִיבָ֗ה כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ הִנְ/נִ֨י מֵעִ֤יר אֶת מְאַהֲבַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשֵׁ֖/ךְ מֵ/הֶ֑ם וַ/הֲבֵאתִ֥י/ם עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: lkhn 'hlybh khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny m'yr 't m'hbykh 'lykh 't 'shr nq'h npshkh mhm vhb'tym 'lykh msbyb
verses.translation: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י בָבֶ֣ל וְ/כָל כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים פְּק֤וֹד וְ/שׁ֨וֹעַ֙ וְ/ק֔וֹעַ כָּל בְּנֵ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר אוֹתָ֑/ם בַּח֨וּרֵי חֶ֜מֶד פַּח֤וֹת וּ/סְגָנִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔/ם שָֽׁלִשִׁים֙ וּ/קְרוּאִ֔ים רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִ֖ים כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: bny bbl vkhl khshdym pqvd vshv' vqv' khl bny 'shvr 'vtm bchvry chmd pchvt vsgnym khlm shlshym vqrv'ym rkhby svsym khlm
verses.translation: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֣אוּ עָלַ֡יִ/ךְ הֹ֠צֶן רֶ֤כֶב וְ/גַלְגַּל֙ וּ/בִ/קְהַ֣ל עַמִּ֔ים צִנָּ֤ה וּ/מָגֵן֙ וְ/קוֹבַ֔ע יָשִׂ֥ימוּ עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ סָבִ֑יב וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י לִ/פְנֵי/הֶם֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּ/שְׁפָט֖וּ/ךְ בְּ/מִשְׁפְּטֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vb'v 'lykh htsn rkhb vglgl vbqhl 'mym tsnh vmgn vqvb' yshymv 'lykh sbyb vntty lpnyhm mshpt vshptvkh bmshptyhm
verses.translation: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י קִנְאָתִ֜/י בָּ֗/ךְ וְ/עָשׂ֤וּ אוֹתָ/ךְ֙ בְּ/חֵמָ֔ה אַפֵּ֤/ךְ וְ/אָזְנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ יָסִ֔ירוּ וְ/אַחֲרִיתֵ֖/ךְ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב תִּפּ֑וֹל הֵ֗מָּה בָּנַ֤יִ/ךְ וּ/בְנוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ וְ/אַחֲרִיתֵ֖/ךְ תֵּאָכֵ֥ל בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vntty qn'ty bkh v'shv 'vtkh bchmh 'pkh v'znykh ysyrv v'chrytkh bchrb tpvl hmh bnykh vbnvtykh yqchv v'chrytkh t'khl b'sh
verses.translation: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

verses.original: וְ/הִפְשִׁיט֖וּ/ךְ אֶת בְּגָדָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/לָקְח֖וּ כְּלֵ֥י תִפְאַרְתֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhpshytvkh 't bgdykh vlqchv khly tp'rtkh
verses.translation: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּ֤י זִמָּתֵ/ךְ֙ מִמֵּ֔/ךְ וְ/אֶת זְנוּתֵ֖/ךְ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/לֹֽא תִשְׂאִ֤י עֵינַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֥א תִזְכְּרִי עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vhshbty zmtkh mmkh v't znvtkh m'rts mtsrym vl' tsh'y 'ynykh 'lyhm vmtsrym l' tzkhry 'vd
verses.translation: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִי֙ נֹֽתְנָ֔/ךְ בְּ/יַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את בְּ/יַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשֵׁ֖/ךְ מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny ntnkh byd 'shr shn't byd 'shr nq'h npshkh mhm
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:

verses.original: וְ/עָשׂ֨וּ אוֹתָ֜/ךְ בְּ/שִׂנְאָ֗ה וְ/לָקְחוּ֙ כָּל יְגִיעֵ֔/ךְ וַ/עֲזָב֖וּ/ךְ עֵירֹ֣ם וְ/עֶרְיָ֑ה וְ/נִגְלָה֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת זְנוּנַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/זִמָּתֵ֖/ךְ וְ/תַזְנוּתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'shv 'vtkh bshn'h vlqchv khl ygy'kh v'zbvkh 'yrm v'ryh vnglh 'rvt znvnykh vzmtkh vtznvtykh
verses.translation: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

verses.original: עָשֹׂ֥ה אֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑/ךְ בִּ/זְנוֹתֵ/ךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר נִטְמֵ֖את בְּ/גִלּוּלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'shh 'lh lkh bznvtkh 'chry gvym 'l 'shr ntm't bglvlyhm
verses.translation: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.

verses.original: בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ אֲחוֹתֵ֖/ךְ הָלָ֑כְתְּ וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י כוֹסָ֖/הּ בְּ/יָדֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: bdrkh 'chvtkh hlkht vntty khvsh bydkh
verses.translation: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֔ה כּ֤וֹס אֲחוֹתֵ/ךְ֙ תִּשְׁתִּ֔י הָ/עֲמֻקָּ֖ה וְ/הָ/רְחָבָ֑ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לִ/צְחֹ֛ק וּ/לְ/לַ֖עַג מִרְבָּ֥ה לְ/הָכִֽיל
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh khvs 'chvtkh tshty h'mqh vhrchbh thyh ltschq vll'g mrbh lhkhyl
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Thou shalt drink of thy sister’s cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

verses.original: שִׁכָּר֥וֹן וְ/יָג֖וֹן תִּמָּלֵ֑אִי כּ֚וֹס שַׁמָּ֣ה וּ/שְׁמָמָ֔ה כּ֖וֹס אֲחוֹתֵ֥/ךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: shkhrvn vygvn tml'y khvs shmh vshmmh khvs 'chvtkh shmrvn
verses.translation: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁתִ֨ית אוֹתָ֜/הּ וּ/מָצִ֗ית וְ/אֶת חֲרָשֶׂ֛י/הָ תְּגָרֵ֖מִי וְ/שָׁדַ֣יִ/ךְ תְּנַתֵּ֑קִי כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vshtyt 'vth vmtsyt v't chrshyh tgrmy vshdykh tntqy khy 'ny dbrty n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it , saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן שָׁכַ֣חַתְּ אוֹתִ֔/י וַ/תַּשְׁלִ֥יכִי אוֹתִ֖/י אַחֲרֵ֣י גַוֵּ֑/ךְ וְ/גַם אַ֛תְּ שְׂאִ֥י זִמָּתֵ֖/ךְ וְ/אֶת תַּזְנוּתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n shkhcht 'vty vtshlykhy 'vty 'chry gvkh vgm 't sh'y zmtkh v't tznvtykh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הֲ/תִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶֽת אָהֳלָ֖ה וְ/אֶת אָהֳלִיבָ֑ה וְ/הַגֵּ֣ד לָ/הֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת תוֹעֲבוֹתֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly bn 'dm htshpvt 't 'hlh v't 'hlybh vhgd lhn 't tv'bvtyhn
verses.translation: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;

verses.original: כִּ֣י נִאֵ֗פוּ וְ/דָם֙ בִּֽ/ידֵי/הֶ֔ן וְ/אֶת גִּלּֽוּלֵי/הֶ֖ן נִאֵ֑פוּ וְ/גַ֤ם אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָֽלְדוּ לִ֔/י הֶעֱבִ֥ירוּ לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/אָכְלָֽה
verses.translit: khy n'pv vdm bydyhn v't glvlyhn n'pv vgm 't bnyhn 'shr yldv ly h'byrv lhm l'khlh
verses.translation: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire , to devour them .

verses.original: ע֥וֹד זֹ֖את עָ֣שׂוּ לִ֑/י טִמְּא֤וּ אֶת מִקְדָּשִׁ/י֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא וְ/אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖/י חִלֵּֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'vd z't 'shv ly tm'v 't mqdshy byvm hhv' v't shbtvty chllv
verses.translation: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/שַׁחֲטָ֤/ם אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/גִלּ֣וּלֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל מִקְדָּשִׁ֛/י בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא לְ/חַלְּל֑/וֹ וְ/הִנֵּה כֹ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ בֵּיתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vbshchtm 't bnyhm lglvlyhm vyb'v 'l mqdshy byvm hhv' lchllv vhnh khh 'shv btvkh byty
verses.translation: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.

verses.original: וְ/אַ֗ף כִּ֤י תִשְׁלַ֨חְנָה֙ לַֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים בָּאִ֖ים מִ/מֶּרְחָ֑ק אֲשֶׁ֨ר מַלְאָ֜ךְ שָׁל֤וּחַ אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/הִנֵּה בָ֔אוּ לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָחַ֛צְתְּ כָּחַ֥לְתְּ עֵינַ֖יִ/ךְ וְ/עָ֥דִית עֶֽדִי
verses.translit: v'f khy tshlchnh l'nshym b'ym mmrchq 'shr ml'kh shlvch 'lyhm vhnh b'v l'shr rchtst khchlt 'ynykh v'dyt 'dy
verses.translation: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,

verses.original: וְ/יָשַׁבְתְּ֙ עַל מִטָּ֣ה כְבוּדָּ֔ה וְ/שֻׁלְחָ֥ן עָר֖וּךְ לְ/פָנֶ֑י/הָ וּ/קְטָרְתִּ֥/י וְ/שַׁמְנִ֖/י שַׂ֥מְתְּ עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyshbt 'l mth khbvdh vshlchn 'rvkh lpnyh vqtrty vshmny shmt 'lyh
verses.translation: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.

verses.original: וְ/ק֣וֹל הָמוֹן֮ שָׁלֵ֣ו בָ/הּ֒ וְ/אֶל אֲנָשִׁים֙ מֵ/רֹ֣ב אָדָ֔ם מוּבָאִ֥ים סובאים סָבָאִ֖ים מִ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ צְמִידִים֙ אֶל יְדֵי/הֶ֔ן וַ/עֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת עַל רָאשֵׁי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vqvl hmvn shlv bh v'l 'nshym mrb 'dm mvb'ym svb'ym sb'ym mmdbr vytnv tsmydym 'l ydyhn v'trt tp'rt 'l r'shyhn
verses.translation: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֕ר לַ/בָּלָ֖ה נִֽאוּפִ֑ים עת עַתָּ֛ה יזנה יִזְנ֥וּ תַזְנוּתֶ֖/הָ וָ/הִֽיא
verses.translit: v'mr lblh n'vpym 't 'th yznh yznv tznvth vhy'
verses.translation: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them ?

verses.original: וַ/יָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֔י/הָ כְּ/ב֖וֹא אֶל אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן בָּ֗אוּ אֶֽל אָֽהֳלָה֙ וְ/אֶל אָ֣הֳלִיבָ֔ה אִשֹּׁ֖ת הַ/זִּמָּֽה
verses.translit: vybv' 'lyh khbv' 'l 'shh zvnh khn b'v 'l 'hlh v'l 'hlybh 'sht hzmh
verses.translation: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים צַדִּיקִ֗ם הֵ֚מָּה יִשְׁפְּט֣וּ אֽוֹתְ/הֶ֔ם מִשְׁפַּט֙ נֹֽאֲפ֔וֹת וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֖ט שֹׁפְכ֣וֹת דָּ֑ם כִּ֤י נֹֽאֲפֹת֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְ/דָ֖ם בִּֽ/ידֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: v'nshym tsdyqm hmh yshptv 'vthm mshpt n'pvt vmshpt shpkhvt dm khy n'pt hnh vdm bydyhn
verses.translation: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה הַעֲלֵ֤ה עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ קָהָ֔ל וְ/נָתֹ֥ן אֶתְ/הֶ֖ן לְ/זַעֲוָ֥ה וְ/לָ/בַֽז
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh h'lh 'lyhm qhl vntn 'thn lz'vh vlbz
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.

verses.original: וְ/רָגְמ֨וּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֥ן אֶ֨בֶן֙ קָהָ֔ל וּ/בָרֵ֥א אוֹתְ/הֶ֖ן בְּ/חַרְבוֹתָ֑/ם בְּנֵי/הֶ֤ם וּ/בְנֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ יַהֲרֹ֔גוּ וּ/בָתֵּי/הֶ֖ן בָּ/אֵ֥שׁ יִשְׂרֹֽפוּ
verses.translit: vrgmv 'lyhn 'bn qhl vbr' 'vthn bchrbvtm bnyhm vbnvtyhm yhrgv vbtyhn b'sh yshrpv
verses.translation: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י זִמָּ֖ה מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/נִֽוַּסְּרוּ֙ כָּל הַ/נָּשִׁ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה כְּ/זִמַּתְ/כֶֽנָה
verses.translit: vhshbty zmh mn h'rts vnvsrv khl hnshym vl' t'shynh khzmtkhnh
verses.translation: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

verses.original: וְ/נָתְנ֤וּ זִמַּתְ/כֶ֨נָה֙ עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ן וַ/חֲטָאֵ֥י גִלּוּלֵי/כֶ֖ן תִּשֶּׂ֑אינָה וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vntnv zmtkhnh 'lykhn vcht'y glvlykhn tsh'ynh vyd'tm khy 'ny 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ דְבַר יְהוָ֨ה אֵלַ֜/י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֤ה הַ/תְּשִׁיעִית֙ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/עֲשִׂירִ֔י בֶּ/עָשׂ֥וֹר לַ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly bshnh htshy'yt bchdsh h'shyry b'shvr lchdsh l'mr
verses.translation: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם כתוב כְּתָב לְ/ךָ֙ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם הַ/יּ֔וֹם אֶת עֶ֖צֶם הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה סָמַ֤ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ אֶל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּ/עֶ֖צֶם הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: bn 'dm khtvb khtb lkh 't shm hyvm 't 'tsm hyvm hzh smkh mlkh bbl 'l yrvshlm b'tsm hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.

verses.original: וּ/מְשֹׁ֤ל אֶל בֵּית הַ/מֶּ֨רִי֙ מָשָׁ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה שְׁפֹ֤ת הַ/סִּיר֙ שְׁפֹ֔ת וְ/גַם יְצֹ֥ק בּ֖/וֹ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vmshl 'l byt hmry mshl v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh shpt hsyr shpt vgm ytsq bv mym
verses.translation: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:

verses.original: אֱסֹ֤ף נְתָחֶ֨י/הָ֙ אֵלֶ֔י/הָ כָּל נֵ֥תַח ט֖וֹב יָרֵ֣ךְ וְ/כָתֵ֑ף מִבְחַ֥ר עֲצָמִ֖ים מַלֵּֽא
verses.translit: 'sf ntchyh 'lyh khl ntch tvb yrkh vkhtf mbchr 'tsmym ml'
verses.translation: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.

verses.original: מִבְחַ֤ר הַ/צֹּאן֙ לָק֔וֹחַ וְ/גַ֛ם דּ֥וּר הָ/עֲצָמִ֖ים תַּחְתֶּ֑י/הָ רַתַּ֣ח רְתָחֶ֔י/הָ גַּם בָּשְׁל֥וּ עֲצָמֶ֖י/הָ בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: mbchr hts'n lqvch vgm dvr h'tsmym tchtyh rtch rtchyh gm bshlv 'tsmyh btvkhh
verses.translation: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה אוֹי֮ עִ֣יר הַ/דָּמִים֒ סִ֚יר אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֶלְאָתָ֣/ה בָ֔/הּ וְ/חֶ֨לְאָתָ֔/הּ לֹ֥א יָצְאָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑/נָּה לִ/נְתָחֶ֤י/הָ לִ/נְתָחֶ֨י/הָ֙ הוֹצִיאָ֔/הּ לֹא נָפַ֥ל עָלֶ֖י/הָ גּוֹרָֽל
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'vy 'yr hdmym syr 'shr chl'th bh vchl'th l' yts'h mmnh lntchyh lntchyh hvtsy'h l' npl 'lyh gvrl
verses.translation: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.

verses.original: כִּ֤י דָמָ/הּ֙ בְּ/תוֹכָ֣/הּ הָיָ֔ה עַל צְחִ֥יחַ סֶ֖לַע שָׂמָ֑תְ/הוּ לֹ֤א שְׁפָכַ֨תְ/הוּ֙ עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לְ/כַסּ֥וֹת עָלָ֖י/ו עָפָֽר
verses.translit: khy dmh btvkhh hyh 'l tschych sl' shmthv l' shpkhthv 'l h'rts lkhsvt 'lyv 'pr
verses.translation: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;

verses.original: לְ/הַעֲל֤וֹת חֵמָה֙ לִ/נְקֹ֣ם נָקָ֔ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת דָּמָ֖/הּ עַל צְחִ֣יחַ סָ֑לַע לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י הִכָּסֽוֹת
verses.translit: lh'lvt chmh lnqm nqm ntty 't dmh 'l tschych sl' lblty hkhsvt
verses.translation: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה א֖וֹי עִ֣יר הַ/דָּמִ֑ים גַּם אֲנִ֖י אַגְדִּ֥יל הַ/מְּדוּרָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'vy 'yr hdmym gm 'ny 'gdyl hmdvrh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

verses.original: הַרְבֵּ֤ה הָ/עֵצִים֙ הַדְלֵ֣ק הָ/אֵ֔שׁ הָתֵ֖ם הַ/בָּשָׂ֑ר וְ/הַרְקַח֙ הַ/מֶּרְקָחָ֔ה וְ/הָ/עֲצָמ֖וֹת יֵחָֽרוּ
verses.translit: hrbh h'tsym hdlq h'sh htm hbshr vhrqch hmrqchh vh'tsmvt ychrv
verses.translation: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.

verses.original: וְ/הַעֲמִידֶ֥/הָ עַל גֶּחָלֶ֖י/הָ רֵקָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן תֵּחַ֜ם וְ/חָ֣רָה נְחֻשְׁתָּ֗/הּ וְ/נִתְּכָ֤ה בְ/תוֹכָ/הּ֙ טֻמְאָתָ֔/הּ תִּתֻּ֖ם חֶלְאָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vh'mydh 'l gchlyh rqh lm'n tchm vchrh nchshth vntkhh btvkhh tm'th ttm chl'th
verses.translation: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.

verses.original: תְּאֻנִ֖ים הֶלְאָ֑ת וְ/לֹֽא תֵצֵ֤א מִמֶּ֨/נָּה֙ רַבַּ֣ת חֶלְאָתָ֔/הּ בְּ/אֵ֖שׁ חֶלְאָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: t'nym hl't vl' tts' mmnh rbt chl'th b'sh chl'th
verses.translation: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.

verses.original: בְּ/טֻמְאָתֵ֖/ךְ זִמָּ֑ה יַ֤עַן טִֽהַרְתִּי/ךְ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א טָהַ֔רְתְּ מִ/טֻּמְאָתֵ/ךְ֙ לֹ֣א תִטְהֲרִי ע֔וֹד עַד הֲנִיחִ֥/י אֶת חֲמָתִ֖/י בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: btm'tkh zmh y'n thrtykh vl' thrt mtm'tkh l' tthry 'vd 'd hnychy 't chmty bkh
verses.translation: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.

verses.original: אֲנִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ בָּאָ֣ה וְ/עָשִׂ֔יתִי לֹֽא אֶפְרַ֥ע וְ/לֹא אָח֖וּס וְ/לֹ֣א אֶנָּחֵ֑ם כִּ/דְרָכַ֤יִ/ךְ וְ/כַ/עֲלִילוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ שְׁפָט֔וּ/ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִֽה
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh dbrty b'h v'shyty l' 'pr' vl' 'chvs vl' 'nchm khdrkhykh vkh'lylvtykh shptvkh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: I the LORD have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Also the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הִנְ/נִ֨י לֹקֵ֧חַ מִמְּ/ךָ֛ אֶת מַחְמַ֥ד עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/מַגֵּפָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֤א תִסְפֹּד֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּ֔ה וְ/ל֥וֹא תָב֖וֹא דִּמְעָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bn 'dm hnny lqch mmkh 't mchmd 'ynykh bmgph vl' tspd vl' tbkhh vlv' tbv' dm'tkh
verses.translation: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

verses.original: הֵאָנֵ֣ק דֹּ֗ם מֵתִים֙ אֵ֣בֶל לֹֽא תַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה פְאֵֽרְ/ךָ֙ חֲב֣וֹשׁ עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/נְעָלֶ֖י/ךָ תָּשִׂ֣ים בְּ/רַגְלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/לֹ֤א תַעְטֶה֙ עַל שָׂפָ֔ם וְ/לֶ֥חֶם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: h'nq dm mtym 'bl l' t'shh p'rkh chbvsh 'lykh vn'lykh tshym brglykh vl' t'th 'l shpm vlchm 'nshym l' t'khl
verses.translation: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.

verses.original: וָ/אֲדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל הָ/עָם֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/תָּ֥מָת אִשְׁתִּ֖/י בָּ/עָ֑רֶב וָ/אַ֥עַשׂ בַּ/בֹּ֖קֶר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צֻוֵּֽיתִי
verses.translit: v'dbr 'l h'm bbqr vtmt 'shty b'rb v''sh bbqr kh'shr tsvyty
verses.translation: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלַ֖/י הָ/עָ֑ם הֲ/לֹֽא תַגִּ֥יד לָ֨/נוּ֙ מָה אֵ֣לֶּה לָּ֔/נוּ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ly h'm hl' tgyd lnv mh 'lh lnv khy 'th 'shh
verses.translation: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so ?

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם דְּבַ֨ר יְהוָ֔ה הָיָ֥ה אֵלַ֖/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'mr 'lyhm dbr yhvh hyh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ הִנְ/נִ֨י מְחַלֵּ֤ל אֶת מִקְדָּשִׁ/י֙ גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּ/כֶ֔ם מַחְמַ֥ד עֵֽינֵי/כֶ֖ם וּ/מַחְמַ֣ל נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֑ם וּ/בְנֵי/כֶ֧ם וּ/בְנֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתֶּ֖ם בַּ/חֶ֥רֶב יִפֹּֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'mr lbyt yshr'l khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny mchll 't mqdshy g'vn 'zkhm mchmd 'ynykhm vmchml npshkhm vbnykhm vbnvtykhm 'shr 'zbtm bchrb yplv
verses.translation: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.

verses.original: וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי עַל שָׂפָם֙ לֹ֣א תַעְט֔וּ וְ/לֶ֥חֶם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: v'shytm kh'shr 'shyty 'l shpm l' t'tv vlchm 'nshym l' t'khlv
verses.translation: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.

verses.original: וּ/פְאֵרֵ/כֶ֣ם עַל רָאשֵׁי/כֶ֗ם וְ/נַֽעֲלֵי/כֶם֙ בְּ/רַגְלֵי/כֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תִסְפְּד֖וּ וְ/לֹ֣א תִבְכּ֑וּ וּ/נְמַקֹּתֶם֙ בַּ/עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/נְהַמְתֶּ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ אֶל אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vp'rkhm 'l r'shykhm vn'lykhm brglykhm l' tspdv vl' tbkhv vnmqtm b'vntykhm vnhmtm 'ysh 'l 'chyv
verses.translation: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה יְחֶזְקֵ֤אל לָ/כֶם֙ לְ/מוֹפֵ֔ת כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ בְּ/בֹאָ֕/הּ וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vhyh ychzq'l lkhm lmvpt khkhl 'shr 'shh t'shv bb'h vyd'tm khy 'ny 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם הֲ/ל֗וֹא בְּ/י֨וֹם קַחְתִּ֤/י מֵ/הֶם֙ אֶת מָ֣עוּזָּ֔/ם מְשׂ֖וֹשׂ תִּפְאַרְתָּ֑/ם אֶת מַחְמַ֤ד עֵֽינֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/אֶת מַשָּׂ֣א נַפְשָׁ֔/ם בְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/בְנוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm hlv' byvm qchty mhm 't m'vzm mshvsh tp'rtm 't mchmd 'ynyhm v't msh' npshm bnyhm vbnvtyhm
verses.translation: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יָב֥וֹא הַ/פָּלִ֖יט אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ לְ/הַשְׁמָע֖וּת אָזְנָֽיִם
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ybv' hplyt 'lykh lhshm'vt 'znym
verses.translation: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִפָּ֤תַח פִּ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת הַ/פָּלִ֔יט וּ/תְדַבֵּ֕ר וְ/לֹ֥א תֵֽאָלֵ֖ם ע֑וֹד וְ/הָיִ֤יתָ לָ/הֶם֙ לְ/מוֹפֵ֔ת וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yptch pykh 't hplyt vtdbr vl' t'lm 'vd vhyyt lhm lmvpt vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְ/הִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: bn 'dm shym pnykh 'l bny 'mvn vhnb' 'lyhm
verses.translation: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

verses.original: וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֡ה יַעַן֩ אָמְרֵ֨/ךְ הֶאָ֜ח אֶל מִקְדָּשִׁ֣/י כִֽי נִחָ֗ל וְ/אֶל אַדְמַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּ֣י נָשַׁ֔מָּה וְ/אֶל בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ֥י הָלְכ֖וּ בַּ/גּוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: v'mrt lbny 'mvn shm'v dbr 'dny yhvh khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'mrkh h'ch 'l mqdshy khy nchl v'l 'dmt yshr'l khy nshmh v'l byt yhvdh khy hlkhv bgvlh
verses.translation: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD ; Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֡ן הִנְ/נִי֩ נֹתְנָ֨/ךְ לִ/בְנֵי קֶ֜דֶם לְ/מֽוֹרָשָׁ֗ה וְ/יִשְּׁב֤וּ טִירֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ בָּ֔/ךְ וְ/נָ֥תְנוּ בָ֖/ךְ מִשְׁכְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם הֵ֚מָּה יֹאכְל֣וּ פִרְיֵ֔/ךְ וְ/הֵ֖מָּה יִשְׁתּ֥וּ חֲלָבֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lkhn hnny ntnkh lbny qdm lmvrshh vyshbv tyrvtyhm bkh vntnv bkh mshkhnyhm hmh y'khlv prykh vhmh yshtv chlbkh
verses.translation: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת רַבָּה֙ לִ/נְוֵ֣ה גְמַלִּ֔ים וְ/אֶת בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְ/מִרְבַּץ צֹ֑אן וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vntty 't rbh lnvh gmlym v't bny 'mvn lmrbts ts'n vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן מַחְאֲ/ךָ֣ יָ֔ד וְ/רַקְעֲ/ךָ֖ בְּ/רָ֑גֶל וַ/תִּשְׂמַ֤ח בְּ/כָל שָֽׁאטְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/נֶ֔פֶשׁ אֶל אַדְמַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n mch'kh yd vrq'kh brgl vtshmch bkhl sh'tkh bnpsh 'l 'dmt yshr'l
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֡ן הִנְ/נִי֩ נָטִ֨יתִי אֶת יָדִ֜/י עָלֶ֗י/ךָ וּ/נְתַתִּ֤י/ךָֽ ל/בג לְ/בַז֙ לַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ מִן הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים וְ/הַאֲבַדְתִּ֖י/ךָ מִן הָ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת אַשְׁמִ֣ידְ/ךָ֔ וְ/יָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn hnny ntyty 't ydy 'lykh vnttykh lbg lbz lgvym vhkhrtykh mn h'mym vh'bdtykh mn h'rtsvt 'shmydkh vyd't khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֗עַן אֲמֹ֤ר מוֹאָב֙ וְ/שֵׂעִ֔יר הִנֵּ֥ה כְּ/כָֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'mr mv'b vsh'yr hnh khkhl hgvym byt yhvdh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֩ הִנְ/נִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת כֶּ֤תֶף מוֹאָב֙ מֵ/הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים מֵֽ/עָרָ֖י/ו מִ/קָּצֵ֑/הוּ צְבִ֗י אֶ֚רֶץ בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁימֹ֔ת בַּ֥עַל מְע֖וֹן ו/קריתמ/ה וְ/קִרְיָתָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: lkhn hnny ptch 't khtf mv'b mh'rym m'ryv mqtshv tsby 'rts byt hyshymt b'l m'vn vqrytmh vqrytymh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵי קֶ֨דֶם֙ עַל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/הָ לְ/מֽוֹרָשָׁ֑ה לְמַ֛עַן לֹֽא תִזָּכֵ֥ר בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֖וֹן בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: lbny qdm 'l bny 'mvn vnttyh lmvrshh lm'n l' tzkhr bny 'mvn bgvym
verses.translation: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/מוֹאָ֖ב אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה שְׁפָטִ֑ים וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vbmv'b ''shh shptym vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֱד֛וֹם בִּ/נְקֹ֥ם נָקָ֖ם לְ/בֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יֶּאְשְׁמ֥וּ אָשׁ֖וֹם וְ/נִקְּמ֥וּ בָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'shvt 'dvm bnqm nqm lbyt yhvdh vy'shmv 'shvm vnqmv bhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וְ/נָטִ֤תִי יָדִ/י֙ עַל אֱד֔וֹם וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖/נָּה אָדָ֣ם וּ/בְהֵמָ֑ה וּ/נְתַתִּ֤י/הָ חָרְבָּה֙ מִ/תֵּימָ֔ן וּ/דְדָ֖נֶ/ה בַּ/חֶ֥רֶב יִפֹּֽלוּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vntty ydy 'l 'dvm vhkhrty mmnh 'dm vbhmh vnttyh chrbh mtymn vddnh bchrb yplv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י אֶת נִקְמָתִ֜/י בֶּ/אֱד֗וֹם בְּ/יַד֙ עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/עָשׂ֣וּ בֶ/אֱד֔וֹם כְּ/אַפִּ֖/י וְ/כַ/חֲמָתִ֑/י וְ/יָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת נִקְמָתִ֔/י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vntty 't nqmty b'dvm byd 'my yshr'l v'shv b'dvm kh'py vkhchmty vyd'v 't nqmty n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֛עַן עֲשׂ֥וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בִּ/נְקָמָ֑ה וַ/יִּנָּקְמ֤וּ נָקָם֙ בִּ/שְׁאָ֣ט בְּ/נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְ/מַשְׁחִ֖ית אֵיבַ֥ת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'shvt plshtym bnqmh vynqmv nqm bsh't bnpsh lmshchyt 'ybt 'vlm
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֨י נוֹטֶ֤ה יָדִ/י֙ עַל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֖י אֶת כְּרֵתִ֑ים וְ/הַ֣אֲבַדְתִּ֔י אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֖ית ח֥וֹף הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny nvth ydy 'l plshtym vhkhrty 't khrtym vh'bdty 't sh'ryt chvf hym
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתִי בָ/ם֙ נְקָמ֣וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת בְּ/תוֹכְח֖וֹת חֵמָ֑ה וְ/יָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/תִתִּ֥/י אֶת נִקְמָתִ֖/י בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'shyty bm nqmvt gdlvt btvkhchvt chmh vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh btty 't nqmty bm
verses.translation: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י בְּ/עַשְׁתֵּֽי עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy b'shty 'shrh shnh b'chd lchdsh hyh dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם יַ֠עַן אֲשֶׁר אָ֨מְרָה צֹּ֤ר עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ הֶאָ֔ח נִשְׁבְּרָ֛ה דַּלְת֥וֹת הָ/עַמִּ֖ים נָסֵ֣בָּה אֵלָ֑/י אִמָּלְאָ֖ה הָחֳרָֽבָה
verses.translit: bn 'dm y'n 'shr 'mrh tsr 'l yrvshlm h'ch nshbrh dltvt h'mym nsbh 'ly 'ml'h hchrbh
verses.translation: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֥י עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ צֹ֑ר וְ/הַעֲלֵיתִ֤י עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים כְּ/הַעֲל֥וֹת הַ/יָּ֖ם לְ/גַלָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh tsr vh'lyty 'lykh gvym rbym khh'lvt hym lglyv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁחֲת֞וּ חֹמ֣וֹת צֹ֗ר וְ/הָֽרְסוּ֙ מִגְדָּלֶ֔י/הָ וְ/סִֽחֵיתִ֥י עֲפָרָ֖/הּ מִמֶּ֑/נָּה וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י אוֹתָ֖/הּ לִ/צְחִ֥יחַ סָֽלַע
verses.translit: vshchtv chmvt tsr vhrsv mgdlyh vschyty 'prh mmnh vntty 'vth ltschych sl'
verses.translation: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.

verses.original: מִשְׁטַ֨ח חֲרָמִ֤ים תִּֽהְיֶה֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/יָּ֔ם כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לְ/בַ֖ז לַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: mshtch chrmym thyh btvkh hym khy 'ny dbrty n'm 'dny yhvh vhyth lbz lgvym
verses.translation: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it , saith the Lord GOD : and it shall become a spoil to the nations.

verses.original: וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב תֵּהָרַ֑גְנָה וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vbnvtyh 'shr bshdh bchrb thrgnh vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֧י מֵבִ֣יא אֶל צֹ֗ר נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל מִ/צָּפ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ מְלָכִ֑ים בְּ/ס֛וּס וּ/בְ/רֶ֥כֶב וּ/בְ/פָרָשִׁ֖ים וְ/קָהָ֥ל וְ/עַם רָֽב
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny mby' 'l tsr nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl mtspvn mlkh mlkhym bsvs vbrkhb vbprshym vqhl v'm rb
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.

verses.original: בְּנוֹתַ֥יִ/ךְ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֑ג וְ/נָתַ֨ן עָלַ֜יִ/ךְ דָּיֵ֗ק וְ/שָׁפַ֤ךְ עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ סֹֽלְלָ֔ה וְ/הֵקִ֥ים עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ צִנָּֽה
verses.translit: bnvtykh bshdh bchrb yhrg vntn 'lykh dyq vshpkh 'lykh sllh vhqym 'lykh tsnh
verses.translation: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.

verses.original: וּ/מְחִ֣י קָֽבָלּ֔/וֹ יִתֵּ֖ן בְּ/חֹֽמוֹתָ֑יִ/ךְ וּ/מִ֨גְדְּלֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ יִתֹּ֖ץ בְּ/חַרְבוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmchy qblv ytn bchmvtykh vmgdltykh ytts bchrbvtyv
verses.translation: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

verses.original: מִ/שִּׁפְעַ֥ת סוּסָ֖י/ו יְכַסֵּ֣/ךְ אֲבָקָ֑/ם מִ/קּוֹל֩ פָּרַ֨שׁ וְ/גַלְגַּ֜ל וָ/רֶ֗כֶב תִּרְעַ֨שְׁנָה֙ חֽוֹמוֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ בְּ/בֹא/וֹ֙ בִּ/שְׁעָרַ֔יִ/ךְ כִּ/מְבוֹאֵ֖י עִ֥יר מְבֻקָּעָֽה
verses.translit: mshp't svsyv ykhskh 'bqm mqvl prsh vglgl vrkhb tr'shnh chvmvtykh bb'v bsh'rykh khmbv'y 'yr mbq'h
verses.translation: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

verses.original: בְּ/פַרְס֣וֹת סוּסָ֔י/ו יִרְמֹ֖ס אֶת כָּל חֽוּצוֹתָ֑יִ/ךְ עַמֵּ/ךְ֙ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֔ג וּ/מַצְּב֥וֹת עֻזֵּ֖/ךְ לָ/אָ֥רֶץ תֵּרֵֽד
verses.translit: bprsvt svsyv yrms 't khl chvtsvtykh 'mkh bchrb yhrg vmtsbvt 'zkh l'rts trd
verses.translation: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁלְל֣וּ חֵילֵ֗/ךְ וּ/בָֽזְזוּ֙ רְכֻלָּתֵ֔/ךְ וְ/הָֽרְסוּ֙ חוֹמוֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ וּ/בָתֵּ֥י חֶמְדָּתֵ֖/ךְ יִתֹּ֑צוּ וַ/אֲבָנַ֤יִ/ךְ וְ/עֵצַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וַֽ/עֲפָרֵ֔/ךְ בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ מַ֖יִם יָשִֽׂימוּ
verses.translit: vshllv chylkh vbzzv rkhltkh vhrsv chvmvtykh vbty chmdtkh yttsv v'bnykh v'tsykh v'prkh btvkh mym yshymv
verses.translation: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
