verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּ֖י הֲמ֣וֹן שִׁירָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/ק֣וֹל כִּנּוֹרַ֔יִ/ךְ לֹ֥א יִשָּׁמַ֖ע עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vhshbty hmvn shyrykh vqvl khnvrykh l' yshm' 'vd
verses.translation: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

verses.original: וּ/נְתַתִּ֞י/ךְ לִ/צְחִ֣יחַ סֶ֗לַע מִשְׁטַ֤ח חֲרָמִים֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבָּנֶ֖ה ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vnttykh ltschych sl' mshtch chrmym thyh l' tbnh 'vd khy 'ny yhvh dbrty n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken it , saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה לְ/צ֑וֹר הֲ/לֹ֣א מִ/קּ֣וֹל מַפַּלְתֵּ֗/ךְ בֶּ/אֱנֹ֨ק חָלָ֜ל בֵּ/הָ֤רֵֽג הֶ֨רֶג֙ בְּ/תוֹכֵ֔/ךְ יִרְעֲשׁ֖וּ הָ/אִיִּֽים
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh ltsvr hl' mqvl mpltkh b'nq chll bhrg hrg btvkhkh yr'shv h'yym
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

verses.original: וְֽ/יָרְד֞וּ מֵ/עַ֣ל כִּסְאוֹתָ֗/ם כֹּ֚ל נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַ/יָּ֔ם וְ/הֵסִ֨ירוּ֙ אֶת מְעִ֣ילֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י רִקְמָתָ֖/ם יִפְשֹׁ֑טוּ חֲרָד֤וֹת יִלְבָּ֨שׁוּ֙ עַל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ וְ/חָֽרְדוּ֙ לִ/רְגָעִ֔ים וְ/שָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyrdv m'l khs'vtm khl nshy'y hym vhsyrv 't m'ylyhm v't bgdy rqmtm ypshtv chrdvt ylbshv 'l h'rts yshbv vchrdv lrg'ym vshmmv 'lykh
verses.translation: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.

verses.original: וְ/נָשְׂא֨וּ עָלַ֤יִ/ךְ קִינָה֙ וְ/אָ֣מְרוּ לָ֔/ךְ אֵ֣יךְ אָבַ֔דְתְּ נוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מִ/יַּמִּ֑ים הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/הֻלָּ֗לָה אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה חֲזָקָ֤ה בַ/יָּם֙ הִ֣יא וְ/יֹשְׁבֶ֔י/הָ אֲשֶׁר נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖/ם לְ/כָל יוֹשְׁבֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vnsh'v 'lykh qynh v'mrv lkh 'ykh 'bdt nvshbt mymym h'yr hhllh 'shr hyth chzqh bym hy' vyshbyh 'shr ntnv chtytm lkhl yvshbyh
verses.translation: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ יֶחְרְד֣וּ הָֽ/אִיִּ֔ן י֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֵּ֑/ךְ וְ/נִבְהֲל֛וּ הָ/אִיִּ֥ים אֲשֶׁר בַּ/יָּ֖ם מִ/צֵּאתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'th ychrdv h'yn yvm mpltkh vnbhlv h'yym 'shr bym mts'tkh
verses.translation: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה בְּ/תִתִּ֤/י אֹתָ/ךְ֙ עִ֣יר נֶחֱרֶ֔בֶת כֶּ/עָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא נוֹשָׁ֑בוּ בְּ/הַעֲל֤וֹת עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אֶת תְּה֔וֹם וְ/כִסּ֖וּ/ךְ הַ/מַּ֥יִם הָ/רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh btty 'tkh 'yr nchrbt kh'rym 'shr l' nvshbv bh'lvt 'lykh 't thvm vkhsvkh hmym hrbym
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;

verses.original: וְ/הוֹרַדְתִּי/ךְ֩ אֶת י֨וֹרְדֵי ב֜וֹר אֶל עַ֣ם עוֹלָ֗ם וְ֠/הוֹשַׁבְתִּי/ךְ בְּ/אֶ֨רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֜וֹת כָּ/חֳרָב֤וֹת מֵֽ/עוֹלָם֙ אֶת י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֔וֹר לְמַ֖עַן לֹ֣א תֵשֵׁ֑בִי וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י צְבִ֖י בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: vhvrdtykh 't yvrdy bvr 'l 'm 'vlm vhvshbtykh b'rts tchtyvt khchrbvt m'vlm 't yvrdy bvr lm'n l' tshby vntty tsby b'rts chyym
verses.translation: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

verses.original: בַּלָּה֥וֹת אֶתְּנֵ֖/ךְ וְ/אֵינֵ֑/ךְ וּֽ/תְבֻקְשִׁ֗י וְ/לֹֽא תִמָּצְאִ֥י עוֹד֙ לְ/עוֹלָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִֽה
verses.translit: blhvt 'tnkh v'ynkh vtbqshy vl' tmts'y 'vd l'vlm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם שָׂ֥א עַל צֹ֖ר קִינָֽה
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm sh' 'l tsr qynh
verses.translation: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ לְ/צ֗וֹר ה/ישבתי הַ/יֹּשֶׁ֨בֶת֙ עַל מְבוֹאֹ֣ת יָ֔ם רֹכֶ֨לֶת֙ הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים אֶל אִיִּ֖ים רַבִּ֑ים כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה צ֕וֹר אַ֣תְּ אָמַ֔רְתְּ אֲנִ֖י כְּלִ֥ילַת יֹֽפִי
verses.translit: v'mrt ltsvr hyshbty hyshbt 'l mbv't ym rkhlt h'mym 'l 'yym rbym khh 'mr 'dny yhvh tsvr 't 'mrt 'ny khlylt ypy
verses.translation: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.

verses.original: בְּ/לֵ֥ב יַמִּ֖ים גְּבוּלָ֑יִ/ךְ בֹּנַ֕יִ/ךְ כָּלְל֖וּ יָפְיֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: blb ymym gbvlykh bnykh khllv ypykh
verses.translation: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

verses.original: בְּרוֹשִׁ֤ים מִ/שְּׂנִיר֙ בָּ֣נוּ לָ֔/ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל לֻֽחֹתָ֑יִם אֶ֤רֶז מִ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ לָקָ֔חוּ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת תֹּ֖רֶן עָלָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: brvshym mshnyr bnv lkh 't khl lchtym 'rz mlbnvn lqchv l'shvt trn 'lykh
verses.translation: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

verses.original: אַלּוֹנִים֙ מִ/בָּ֔שָׁן עָשׂ֖וּ מִשּׁוֹטָ֑יִ/ךְ קַרְשֵׁ֤/ךְ עָֽשׂוּ שֵׁן֙ בַּת אֲשֻׁרִ֔ים מֵ/אִיֵּ֖י כתים כִּתִּיִּֽים
verses.translit: 'lvnym mbshn 'shv mshvtykh qrshkh 'shv shn bt 'shrym m'yy khtym khtyym
verses.translation: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.

verses.original: שֵׁשׁ בְּ/רִקְמָ֤ה מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ הָיָ֣ה מִפְרָשֵׂ֔/ךְ לִ/הְי֥וֹת לָ֖/ךְ לְ/נֵ֑ס תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן מֵ/אִיֵּ֥י אֱלִישָׁ֖ה הָיָ֥ה מְכַסֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: shsh brqmh mmtsrym hyh mprshkh lhyvt lkh lns tkhlt v'rgmn m'yy 'lyshh hyh mkhskh
verses.translation: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.

verses.original: יֹשְׁבֵ֤י צִידוֹן֙ וְ/אַרְוַ֔ד הָי֥וּ שָׁטִ֖ים לָ֑/ךְ חֲכָמַ֤יִ/ךְ צוֹר֙ הָ֣יוּ בָ֔/ךְ הֵ֖מָּה חֹבְלָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: yshby tsydvn v'rvd hyv shtym lkh chkhmykh tsvr hyv bkh hmh chblykh
verses.translation: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men , O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.

verses.original: זִקְנֵ֨י גְבַ֤ל וַ/חֲכָמֶ֨י/הָ֙ הָ֣יוּ בָ֔/ךְ מַחֲזִיקֵ֖י בִּדְקֵ֑/ךְ כָּל אֳנִיּ֨וֹת הַ/יָּ֤ם וּ/מַלָּֽחֵי/הֶם֙ הָ֣יוּ בָ֔/ךְ לַ/עֲרֹ֖ב מַעֲרָבֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: zqny gbl vchkhmyh hyv bkh mchzyqy bdqkh khl 'nyvt hym vmlchyhm hyv bkh l'rb m'rbkh
verses.translation: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.

verses.original: פָּרַ֨ס וְ/ל֤וּד וּ/פוּט֙ הָי֣וּ בְ/חֵילֵ֔/ךְ אַנְשֵׁ֖י מִלְחַמְתֵּ֑/ךְ מָגֵ֤ן וְ/כוֹבַע֙ תִּלּוּ בָ֔/ךְ הֵ֖מָּה נָתְנ֥וּ הֲדָרֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: prs vlvd vpvt hyv bchylkh 'nshy mlchmtkh mgn vkhvb' tlv bkh hmh ntnv hdrkh
verses.translation: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י אַרְוַ֣ד וְ/חֵילֵ֗ךְ עַל חוֹמוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְ/גַ֨מָּדִ֔ים בְּ/מִגְדְּלוֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ הָי֑וּ שִׁלְטֵי/הֶ֞ם תִּלּ֤וּ עַל חוֹמוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ סָבִ֔יב הֵ֖מָּה כָּלְל֥וּ יָפְיֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: bny 'rvd vchylkh 'l chvmvtykh sbyb vgmdym bmgdlvtykh hyv shltyhm tlv 'l chvmvtykh sbyb hmh khllv ypykh
verses.translation: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.

verses.original: תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ סֹחַרְתֵּ֖/ךְ מֵ/רֹ֣ב כָּל ה֑וֹן בְּ/כֶ֤סֶף בַּרְזֶל֙ בְּדִ֣יל וְ/עוֹפֶ֔רֶת נָתְנ֖וּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: trshysh schrtkh mrb khl hvn bkhsf brzl bdyl v'vprt ntnv 'zbvnykh
verses.translation: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.

verses.original: יָוָ֤ן תֻּבַל֙ וָ/מֶ֔שֶׁךְ הֵ֖מָּה רֹֽכְלָ֑יִ/ךְ בְּ/נֶ֤פֶשׁ אָדָם֙ וּ/כְלֵ֣י נְחֹ֔שֶׁת נָתְנ֖וּ מַעֲרָבֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: yvn tbl vmshkh hmh rkhlykh bnpsh 'dm vkhly nchsht ntnv m'rbkh
verses.translation: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.

verses.original: מִ/בֵּ֖ית תּוֹגַרְמָ֑ה סוּסִ֤ים וּ/פָֽרָשִׁים֙ וּ/פְרָדִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: mbyt tvgrmh svsym vprshym vprdym ntnv 'zbvnykh
verses.translation: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י דְדָן֙ רֹֽכְלַ֔יִ/ךְ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים סְחֹרַ֣ת יָדֵ֑/ךְ קַרְנ֥וֹת שֵׁן֙ ו/הובנים וְ/הָבְנִ֔ים הֵשִׁ֖יבוּ אֶשְׁכָּרֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: bny ddn rkhlykh 'yym rbym schrt ydkh qrnvt shn vhvbnym vhbnym hshybv 'shkhrkh
verses.translation: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.

verses.original: אֲרָ֥ם סֹחַרְתֵּ֖/ךְ מֵ/רֹ֣ב מַעֲשָׂ֑יִ/ךְ בְּ֠/נֹפֶךְ אַרְגָּמָ֨ן וְ/רִקְמָ֤ה וּ/בוּץ֙ וְ/רָאמֹ֣ת וְ/כַדְכֹּ֔ד נָתְנ֖וּ בְּ/עִזְבוֹנָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'rm schrtkh mrb m'shykh bnpkh 'rgmn vrqmh vbvts vr'mt vkhdkhd ntnv b'zbvnykh
verses.translation: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.

verses.original: יְהוּדָה֙ וְ/אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵ֖מָּה רֹכְלָ֑יִ/ךְ בְּ/חִטֵּ֣י מִ֠נִּית וּ/פַנַּ֨ג וּ/דְבַ֤שׁ וָ/שֶׁ֨מֶן֙ וָ/צֹ֔רִי נָתְנ֖וּ מַעֲרָבֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: yhvdh v'rts yshr'l hmh rkhlykh bchty mnyt vpng vdbsh vshmn vtsry ntnv m'rbkh
verses.translation: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

verses.original: דַּמֶּ֧שֶׂק סֹחַרְתֵּ֛/ךְ בְּ/רֹ֥ב מַעֲשַׂ֖יִ/ךְ מֵ/רֹ֣ב כָּל ה֑וֹן בְּ/יֵ֥ין חֶלְבּ֖וֹן וְ/צֶ֥מֶר צָֽחַר
verses.translit: dmshq schrtkh brb m'shykh mrb khl hvn byyn chlbvn vtsmr tschr
verses.translation: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

verses.original: וְדָ֤ן וְ/יָוָן֙ מְ/אוּזָּ֔ל בְּ/עִזְבוֹנַ֖יִ/ךְ נָתָ֑נּוּ בַּרְזֶ֤ל עָשׁוֹת֙ קִדָּ֣ה וְ/קָנֶ֔ה בְּ/מַעֲרָבֵ֖/ךְ הָיָֽה
verses.translit: vdn vyvn m'vzl b'zbvnykh ntnv brzl 'shvt qdh vqnh bm'rbkh hyh
verses.translation: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.

verses.original: דְּדָן֙ רֹֽכַלְתֵּ֔/ךְ בְ/בִגְדֵי חֹ֖פֶשׁ לְ/רִכְבָּֽה
verses.translit: ddn rkhltkh bbgdy chpsh lrkhbh
verses.translation: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

verses.original: עֲרַב֙ וְ/כָל נְשִׂיאֵ֣י קֵדָ֔ר הֵ֖מָּה סֹחֲרֵ֣י יָדֵ֑/ךְ בְּ/כָרִ֤ים וְ/אֵילִים֙ וְ/עַתּוּדִ֔ים בָּ֖/ם סֹחֲרָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'rb vkhl nshy'y qdr hmh schry ydkh bkhrym v'ylym v'tvdym bm schrykh
verses.translation: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.

verses.original: רֹכְלֵ֤י שְׁבָא֙ וְ/רַעְמָ֔ה הֵ֖מָּה רֹכְלָ֑יִ/ךְ בְּ/רֹ֨אשׁ כָּל בֹּ֜שֶׂם וּ/בְ/כָל אֶ֤בֶן יְקָרָה֙ וְ/זָהָ֔ב נָתְנ֖וּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: rkhly shb' vr'mh hmh rkhlykh br'sh khl bshm vbkhl 'bn yqrh vzhb ntnv 'zbvnykh
verses.translation: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

verses.original: חָרָ֤ן וְ/כַנֵּה֙ וָ/עֶ֔דֶן רֹכְלֵ֖י שְׁבָ֑א אַשּׁ֖וּר כִּלְמַ֥ד רֹכַלְתֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: chrn vkhnh v'dn rkhly shb' 'shvr khlmd rkhltkh
verses.translation: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה רֹכְלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בְּ/מַכְלֻלִ֔ים בִּ/גְלוֹמֵי֙ תְּכֵ֣לֶת וְ/רִקְמָ֔ה וּ/בְ/גִנְזֵ֖י בְּרֹמִ֑ים בַּ/חֲבָלִ֧ים חֲבֻשִׁ֛ים וַ/אֲרֻזִ֖ים בְּ/מַרְכֻלְתֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hmh rkhlykh bmkhllym bglvmy tkhlt vrqmh vbgnzy brmym bchblym chbshym v'rzym bmrkhltkh
verses.translation: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things , in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

verses.original: אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֔ישׁ שָׁרוֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ מַעֲרָבֵ֑/ךְ וַ/תִּמָּלְאִ֧י וַֽ/תִּכְבְּדִ֛י מְאֹ֖ד בְּ/לֵ֥ב יַמִּֽים
verses.translit: 'nyvt trshysh shrvtykh m'rbkh vtml'y vtkhbdy m'd blb ymym
verses.translation: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.

verses.original: בְּ/מַ֤יִם רַבִּים֙ הֱבִיא֔וּ/ךְ הַ/שָּׁטִ֖ים אֹתָ֑/ךְ ר֚וּחַ הַ/קָּדִ֔ים שְׁבָרֵ֖/ךְ בְּ/לֵ֥ב יַמִּֽים
verses.translit: bmym rbym hby'vkh hshtym 'tkh rvch hqdym shbrkh blb ymym
verses.translation: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.

verses.original: הוֹנֵ/ךְ֙ וְ/עִזְבוֹנַ֔יִ/ךְ מַעֲרָבֵ֕/ךְ מַלָּחַ֖יִ/ךְ וְ/חֹבְלָ֑יִ/ךְ מַחֲזִיקֵ֣י בִדְקֵ֣/ך וְֽ/עֹרְבֵ֣י מַ֠עֲרָבֵ/ךְ וְ/כָל אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִלְחַמְתֵּ֜/ךְ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֗/ךְ וּ/בְ/כָל קְהָלֵ/ךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/תוֹכֵ֔/ךְ יִפְּלוּ֙ בְּ/לֵ֣ב יַמִּ֔ים בְּ/י֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hvnkh v'zbvnykh m'rbkh mlchykh vchblykh mchzyqy bdqkh v'rby m'rbkh vkhl 'nshy mlchmtkh 'shr bkh vbkhl qhlkh 'shr btvkhkh yplv blb ymym byvm mpltkh
verses.translation: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

verses.original: לְ/ק֖וֹל זַעֲקַ֣ת חֹבְלָ֑יִ/ךְ יִרְעֲשׁ֖וּ מִגְרֹשֽׁוֹת
verses.translit: lqvl z'qt chblykh yr'shv mgrshvt
verses.translation: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.

verses.original: וְֽ/יָרְד֞וּ מֵ/אָנִיּֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ל תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י מָשׁ֔וֹט מַלָּחִ֕ים כֹּ֖ל חֹבְלֵ֣י הַ/יָּ֑ם אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ יַעֲמֹֽדוּ
verses.translit: vyrdv m'nyvtyhm khl tpshy mshvt mlchym khl chbly hym 'l h'rts y'mdv
verses.translation: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁמִ֤יעוּ עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בְּ/קוֹלָ֔/ם וְ/יִזְעֲק֖וּ מָרָ֑ה וְ/יַעֲל֤וּ עָֽפָר֙ עַל רָ֣אשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם בָּ/אֵ֖פֶר יִתְפַּלָּֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: vhshmy'v 'lykh bqvlm vyz'qv mrh vy'lv 'pr 'l r'shyhm b'pr ytplshv
verses.translation: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֤יחוּ אֵלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְ/חָגְר֖וּ שַׂקִּ֑ים וּ/בָכ֥וּ אֵלַ֛יִ/ךְ בְּ/מַר נֶ֖פֶשׁ מִסְפֵּ֥ד מָֽר
verses.translit: vhqrychv 'lykh qrchh vchgrv shqym vbkhv 'lykh bmr npsh mspd mr
verses.translation: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.

verses.original: וְ/נָשְׂא֨וּ אֵלַ֤יִ/ךְ בְּ/נִי/הֶם֙ קִינָ֔ה וְ/קוֹנְנ֖וּ עָלָ֑יִ/ךְ מִ֣י כְ/צ֔וֹר כְּ/דֻמָ֖ה בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vnsh'v 'lykh bnyhm qynh vqvnnv 'lykh my khtsvr khdmh btvkh hym
verses.translation: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying , What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?

verses.original: בְּ/צֵ֤את עִזְבוֹנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ מִ/יַּמִּ֔ים הִשְׂבַּ֖עַתְּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים בְּ/רֹ֤ב הוֹנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וּ/מַ֣עֲרָבַ֔יִ/ךְ הֶעֱשַׁ֖רְתְּ מַלְכֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: bts't 'zbvnykh mymym hshb't 'mym rbym brb hvnykh vm'rbykh h'shrt mlkhy 'rts
verses.translation: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

verses.original: עֵ֛ת נִשְׁבֶּ֥רֶת מִ/יַּמִּ֖ים בְּ/מַֽעֲמַקֵּי מָ֑יִם מַעֲרָבֵ֥/ךְ וְ/כָל קְהָלֵ֖/ךְ בְּ/תוֹכֵ֥/ךְ נָפָֽלוּ
verses.translit: 't nshbrt mymym bm'mqy mym m'rbkh vkhl qhlkh btvkhkh nplv
verses.translation: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אִיִּ֔ים שָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלָ֑יִ/ךְ וּ/מַלְכֵי/הֶם֙ שָׂ֣עֲרוּ שַׂ֔עַר רָעֲמ֖וּ פָּנִֽים
verses.translit: khl yshby h'yym shmmv 'lykh vmlkhyhm sh'rv sh'r r'mv pnym
verses.translation: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.

verses.original: סֹֽחֲרִים֙ בָּ֣/עַמִּ֔ים שָׁרְק֖וּ עָלָ֑יִ/ךְ בַּלָּה֣וֹת הָיִ֔ית וְ/אֵינֵ֖/ךְ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: schrym b'mym shrqv 'lykh blhvt hyyt v'ynkh 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֡ם אֱמֹר֩ לִ/נְגִ֨יד צֹ֜ר כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה יַ֣עַן גָּבַ֤הּ לִבְּ/ךָ֙ וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ל אָ֔נִי מוֹשַׁ֧ב אֱלֹהִ֛ים יָשַׁ֖בְתִּי בְּ/לֵ֣ב יַמִּ֑ים וְ/אַתָּ֤ה אָדָם֙ וְֽ/לֹא אֵ֔ל וַ/תִּתֵּ֥ן לִבְּ/ךָ֖ כְּ/לֵ֥ב אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: bn 'dm 'mr lngyd tsr khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n gbh lbkh vt'mr 'l 'ny mvshb 'lhym yshbty blb ymym v'th 'dm vl' 'l vttn lbkh khlb 'lhym
verses.translation: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה חָכָ֛ם אַתָּ֖ה מ/דנאל מִ/דָּֽנִיֵּ֑אל כָּל סָת֖וּם לֹ֥א עֲמָמֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: hnh chkhm 'th mdn'l mdny'l khl stvm l' 'mmvkh
verses.translation: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:

verses.original: בְּ/חָכְמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ וּ/בִ/תְבוּנָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ עָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּ/ךָ֖ חָ֑יִל וַ/תַּ֛עַשׂ זָהָ֥ב וָ/כֶ֖סֶף בְּ/אוֹצְרוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: bchkhmtkh vbtbvntkh 'shyt lkh chyl vt'sh zhb vkhsf b'vtsrvtykh
verses.translation: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:

verses.translit: brb chkhmtkh brkhltkh hrbyt chylkh vygbh lbbkh bchylkh
verses.translation: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֛עַן תִּתְּ/ךָ֥ אֶת לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ כְּ/לֵ֥ב אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n ttkh 't lbbkh khlb 'lhym
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן הִנְ/נִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ זָרִ֔ים עָרִיצֵ֖י גּוֹיִ֑ם וְ/הֵרִ֤יקוּ חַרְבוֹתָ/ם֙ עַל יְפִ֣י חָכְמָתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/חִלְּל֖וּ יִפְעָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lkhn hnny mby' 'lykh zrym 'rytsy gvym vhryqv chrbvtm 'l ypy chkhmtkh vchllv yp'tkh
verses.translation: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.

verses.original: לַ/שַּׁ֖חַת יֽוֹרִד֑וּ/ךָ וָ/מַ֛תָּה מְמוֹתֵ֥י חָלָ֖ל בְּ/לֵ֥ב יַמִּֽים
verses.translit: lshcht yvrdvkh vmth mmvty chll blb ymym
verses.translation: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.

verses.original: הֶ/אָמֹ֤ר תֹּאמַר֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אָ֔נִי לִ/פְנֵ֖י הֹֽרְגֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אַתָּ֥ה אָדָ֛ם וְ/לֹא אֵ֖ל בְּ/יַ֥ד מְחַלְלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: h'mr t'mr 'lhym 'ny lpny hrgkh v'th 'dm vl' 'l byd mchllykh
verses.translation: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.

verses.original: מוֹתֵ֧י עֲרֵלִ֛ים תָּמ֖וּת בְּ/יַד זָרִ֑ים כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: mvty 'rlym tmvt byd zrym khy 'ny dbrty n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it , saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שָׂ֥א קִינָ֖ה עַל מֶ֣לֶךְ צ֑וֹר וְ/אָמַ֣רְתָּ לּ֗/וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה אַתָּה֙ חוֹתֵ֣ם תָּכְנִ֔ית מָלֵ֥א חָכְמָ֖ה וּ/כְלִ֥יל יֹֽפִי
verses.translit: bn 'dm sh' qynh 'l mlkh tsvr v'mrt lv khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'th chvtm tkhnyt ml' chkhmh vkhlyl ypy
verses.translation: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

verses.original: בְּ/עֵ֨דֶן גַּן אֱלֹהִ֜ים הָיִ֗יתָ כָּל אֶ֨בֶן יְקָרָ֤ה מְסֻכָתֶ֨/ךָ֙ אֹ֣דֶם פִּטְדָ֞ה וְ/יָהֲלֹ֗ם תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֨הַם֙ וְ/יָ֣שְׁפֵ֔ה סַפִּ֣יר נֹ֔פֶךְ וּ/בָרְקַ֖ת וְ/זָהָ֑ב מְלֶ֨אכֶת תֻּפֶּ֤י/ךָ וּ/נְקָבֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בָּ֔/ךְ בְּ/י֥וֹם הִבָּרַאֲ/ךָ֖ כּוֹנָֽנוּ
verses.translit: b'dn gn 'lhym hyyt khl 'bn yqrh mskhtkh 'dm ptdh vyhlm trshysh shhm vyshph spyr npkh vbrqt vzhb ml'kht tpykh vnqbykh bkh byvm hbr'kh khvnnv
verses.translation: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.

verses.original: אַ֨תְּ כְּר֔וּב מִמְשַׁ֖ח הַ/סּוֹכֵ֑ךְ וּ/נְתַתִּ֗י/ךָ בְּ/הַ֨ר קֹ֤דֶשׁ אֱלֹהִים֙ הָיִ֔יתָ בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ אַבְנֵי אֵ֖שׁ הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ
verses.translit: 't khrvb mmshch hsvkhkh vnttykh bhr qdsh 'lhym hyyt btvkh 'bny 'sh hthlkht
verses.translation: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

verses.original: תָּמִ֤ים אַתָּה֙ בִּ/דְרָכֶ֔י/ךָ מִ/יּ֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָ֑/ךְ עַד נִמְצָ֥א עַוְלָ֖תָ/ה בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: tmym 'th bdrkhykh myvm hbr'kh 'd nmts' 'vlth bkh
verses.translation: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.

verses.original: בְּ/רֹ֣ב רְכֻלָּתְ/ךָ֗ מָל֧וּ תוֹכְ/ךָ֛ חָמָ֖ס וַֽ/תֶּחֱטָ֑א וָ/אֶחַלֶּלְ/ךָ֩ מֵ/הַ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֤ים וָֽ/אַבֶּדְ/ךָ֙ כְּר֣וּב הַ/סֹּכֵ֔ךְ מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ אַבְנֵי אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: brb rkhltkh mlv tvkhkh chms vtcht' v'chllkh mhr 'lhym v'bdkh khrvb hskhkh mtvkh 'bny 'sh
verses.translation: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

verses.original: גָּבַ֤הּ לִבְּ/ךָ֙ בְּ/יָפְיֶ֔/ךָ שִׁחַ֥תָּ חָכְמָתְ/ךָ֖ עַל יִפְעָתֶ֑/ךָ עַל אֶ֣רֶץ הִשְׁלַכְתִּ֗י/ךָ לִ/פְנֵ֧י מְלָכִ֛ים נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לְ/רַ֥אֲוָה בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: gbh lbkh bypykh shcht chkhmtkh 'l yp'tkh 'l 'rts hshlkhtykh lpny mlkhym nttykh lr'vh bkh
verses.translation: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

verses.original: מֵ/רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֶ֗י/ךָ בְּ/עֶ֨וֶל֙ רְכֻלָּ֣תְ/ךָ֔ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑י/ךָ וָֽ/אוֹצִא אֵ֤שׁ מִ/תּֽוֹכְ/ךָ֙ הִ֣יא אֲכָלַ֔תְ/ךָ וָ/אֶתֶּנְ/ךָ֤ לְ/אֵ֨פֶר֙ עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל רֹאֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: mrb 'vnykh b'vl rkhltkh chllt mqdshykh v'vts' 'sh mtvkhkh hy' 'khltkh v'tnkh l'pr 'l h'rts l'yny khl r'ykh
verses.translation: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

verses.original: כָּל יוֹדְעֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בָּֽ/עַמִּ֔ים שָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלֶ֑י/ךָ בַּלָּה֣וֹת הָיִ֔יתָ וְ/אֵינְ/ךָ֖ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khl yvd'ykh b'mym shmmv 'lykh blhvt hyyt v'ynkh 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ אֶל צִיד֑וֹן וְ/הִנָּבֵ֖א עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: bn 'dm shym pnykh 'l tsydvn vhnb' 'lyh
verses.translation: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֤י עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ צִיד֔וֹן וְ/נִכְבַּדְתִּ֖י בְּ/תוֹכֵ֑/ךְ וְֽ/יָדְע֞וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בַּ/עֲשׂ֥וֹתִ/י בָ֛/הּ שְׁפָטִ֖ים וְ/נִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh tsydvn vnkhbdty btvkhkh vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh b'shvty bh shptym vnqdshty bh
verses.translation: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the LORD , when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּי בָ֞/הּ דֶּ֤בֶר וָ/דָם֙ בְּ/ח֣וּצוֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/נִפְלַ֤ל חָלָל֙ בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/הּ בְּ/חֶ֥רֶב עָלֶ֖י/הָ מִ/סָּבִ֑יב וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshlchty bh dbr vdm bchvtsvtyh vnpll chll btvkhh bchrb 'lyh msbyb vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל סִלּ֤וֹן מַמְאִיר֙ וְ/ק֣וֹץ מַכְאִ֔ב מִ/כֹּל֙ סְבִ֣יבֹתָ֔/ם הַ/שָּׁאטִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/יָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vl' yhyh 'vd lbyt yshr'l slvn mm'yr vqvts mkh'b mkhl sbybtm hsh'tym 'vtm vyd'v khy 'ny 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord GOD .

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ בְּ/קַבְּצִ֣/י אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִן הָֽ/עַמִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפֹ֣צוּ בָ֔/ם וְ/נִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָ֖/ם לְ/עֵינֵ֣י הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וְ/יָֽשְׁבוּ֙ עַל אַדְמָתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְ/עַבְדִּ֥/י לְ/יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh bqbtsy 't byt yshr'l mn h'mym 'shr nptsv bm vnqdshty bm l'yny hgvym vyshbv 'l 'dmtm 'shr ntty l'bdy ly'qb
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.

verses.original: וְ/יָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶי/הָ֮ לָ/בֶטַח֒ וּ/בָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְ/נָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְ/יָשְׁב֖וּ לָ/בֶ֑טַח בַּ/עֲשׂוֹתִ֣/י שְׁפָטִ֗ים בְּ/כֹ֨ל הַ/שָּׁאטִ֤ים אֹתָ/ם֙ מִ/סְּבִ֣יבוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/יָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshbv 'lyh lbtch vbnv btym vnt'v khrmym vyshbv lbtch b'shvty shptym bkhl hsh'tym 'tm msbybvtm vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.

verses.original: בַּ/שָּׁנָה֙ הָ/עֲשִׂירִ֔ית בָּ/עֲשִׂרִ֕י בִּ/שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: bshnh h'shyryt b'shry bshnym 'shr lchdsh hyh dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: In the tenth year, in the tenth month , in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֣ים פָּנֶ֔י/ךָ עַל פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הִנָּבֵ֣א עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/עַל מִצְרַ֖יִם כֻּלָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: bn 'dm shym pnykh 'l pr'h mlkh mtsrym vhnb' 'lyv v'l mtsrym khlh
verses.translation: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֜ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְ/נִ֤י עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם הַ/תַּנִּים֙ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל הָ/רֹבֵ֖ץ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ יְאֹרָ֑י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛ר לִ֥/י יְאֹרִ֖/י וַ/אֲנִ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽ/נִי
verses.translit: dbr v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh pr'h mlkh mtsrym htnym hgdvl hrbts btvkh y'ryv 'shr 'mr ly y'ry v'ny 'shytny
verses.translation: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י חחיים חַחִים֙ בִּ/לְחָיֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הִדְבַּקְתִּ֥י דְגַת יְאֹרֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/קַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הַעֲלִיתִ֨י/ךָ֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ יְאֹרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל דְּגַ֣ת יְאֹרֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/קַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶ֖י/ךָ תִּדְבָּֽק
verses.translit: vntty chchyym chchym blchyykh vhdbqty dgt y'rykh bqshqshtykh vh'lytykh mtvkh y'rykh v't khl dgt y'rykh bqshqshtykh tdbq
verses.translation: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.

verses.original: וּ/נְטַשְׁתִּ֣י/ךָ הַ/מִּדְבָּ֗רָ/ה אוֹתְ/ךָ֙ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל דְּגַ֣ת יְאֹרֶ֔י/ךָ עַל פְּנֵ֤י הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ תִּפּ֔וֹל לֹ֥א תֵאָסֵ֖ף וְ/לֹ֣א תִקָּבֵ֑ץ לְ/חַיַּ֥ת הָ/אָ֛רֶץ וּ/לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם נְתַתִּ֥י/ךָ לְ/אָכְלָֽה
verses.translit: vntshtykh hmdbrh 'vtkh v't khl dgt y'rykh 'l pny hshdh tpvl l' t'sf vl' tqbts lchyt h'rts vl'vf hshmym nttykh l'khlh
verses.translation: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.

verses.original: וְ/יָֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה יַ֧עַן הֱיוֹתָ֛/ם מִשְׁעֶ֥נֶת קָנֶ֖ה לְ/בֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyd'v khl yshby mtsrym khy 'ny yhvh y'n hyvtm msh'nt qnh lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the LORD , because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

verses.original: בְּ/תָפְשָׂ֨/ם בְּ/ךָ֤ ב/כפ/ך בַ/כַּף֙ תֵּר֔וֹץ וּ/בָקַעְתָּ֥ לָ/הֶ֖ם כָּל כָּתֵ֑ף וּ/בְ/הִֽשָּׁעֲנָ֤/ם עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ תִּשָּׁבֵ֔ר וְ/הַעֲמַדְתָּ֥ לָ/הֶ֖ם כָּל מָתְנָֽיִם
verses.translit: btpshm bkh bkhpkh bkhf trvts vbq't lhm khl khtf vbhsh'nm 'lykh tshbr vh'mdt lhm khl mtnym
verses.translation: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ חָ֑רֶב וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֵּ֖/ךְ אָדָ֥ם וּ/בְהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny mby' 'lykh chrb vhkhrty mmkh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לִ/שְׁמָמָ֣ה וְ/חָרְבָּ֔ה וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה יַ֧עַן אָמַ֛ר יְאֹ֥ר לִ֖/י וַ/אֲנִ֥י עָשִֽׂיתִי
verses.translit: vhyth 'rts mtsrym lshmmh vchrbh vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh y'n 'mr y'r ly v'ny 'shyty
verses.translation: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the LORD : because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it .

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן הִנְ/נִ֥י אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/אֶל יְאֹרֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/נָתַתִּ֞י אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם לְ/חָרְבוֹת֙ חֹ֣רֶב שְׁמָמָ֔ה מִ/מִּגְדֹּ֥ל סְוֵנֵ֖ה וְ/עַד גְּב֥וּל כּֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: lkhn hnny 'lykh v'l y'rykh vntty 't 'rts mtsrym lchrbvt chrb shmmh mmgdl svnh v'd gbvl khvsh
verses.translation: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.

verses.original: לֹ֤א תַעֲבָר בָּ/הּ֙ רֶ֣גֶל אָדָ֔ם וְ/רֶ֥גֶל בְּהֵמָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲבָר בָּ֑/הּ וְ/לֹ֥א תֵשֵׁ֖ב אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: l' t'br bh rgl 'dm vrgl bhmh l' t'br bh vl' tshb 'rb'ym shnh
verses.translation: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י אֶת אֶרֶץ֩ מִצְרַ֨יִם שְׁמָמָ֜ה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ אֲרָצ֣וֹת נְשַׁמּ֗וֹת וְ/עָרֶ֨י/הָ֙ בְּ/ת֨וֹךְ עָרִ֤ים מָֽחֳרָבוֹת֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣יןָ שְׁמָמָ֔ה אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/הֲפִצֹתִ֤י אֶת מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְֽ/זֵרִיתִ֖י/ם בָּ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vntty 't 'rts mtsrym shmmh btvkh 'rtsvt nshmvt v'ryh btvkh 'rym mchrbvt thyyn shmmh 'rb'ym shnh vhptsty 't mtsrym bgvym vzrytym b'rtsvt
verses.translation: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה מִ/קֵּ֞ץ אַרְבָּעִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֣ץ אֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם מִן הָ/עַמִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁר נָפֹ֥צוּ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh mqts 'rb'ym shnh 'qbts 't mtsrym mn h'mym 'shr nptsv shmh
verses.translation: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD ; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת שְׁב֣וּת מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/הֲשִׁבֹתִ֤י אֹתָ/ם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פַּתְר֔וֹס עַל אֶ֖רֶץ מְכֽוּרָתָ֑/ם וְ/הָ֥יוּ שָׁ֖ם מַמְלָכָ֥ה שְׁפָלָֽה
verses.translit: vshbty 't shbvt mtsrym vhshbty 'tm 'rts ptrvs 'l 'rts mkhvrtm vhyv shm mmlkhh shplh
verses.translation: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

verses.original: מִן הַ/מַּמְלָכוֹת֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה שְׁפָלָ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא תִתְנַשֵּׂ֥א ע֖וֹד עַל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וְ/הִ֨מְעַטְתִּ֔י/ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י רְד֥וֹת בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: mn hmmlkhvt thyh shplh vl' ttnsh' 'vd 'l hgvym vhm'ttym lblty rdvt bgvym
verses.translation: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה עוֹד֩ לְ/בֵ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְ/מִבְטָח֙ מַזְכִּ֣יר עָוֺ֔ן בִּ/פְנוֹתָ֖/ם אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/יָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vl' yhyh 'vd lbyt yshr'l lmbtch mzkhyr 'vn bpnvtm 'chryhm vyd'v khy 'ny 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָ/שֶׁ֨בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בָּֽ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy b'shrym vshb' shnh br'shvn b'chd lchdsh hyh dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month , in the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּ֠בֶל הֶעֱבִ֨יד אֶת חֵיל֜/וֹ עֲבֹדָ֤ה גְדֹלָה֙ אֶל צֹ֔ר כָּל רֹ֣אשׁ מֻקְרָ֔ח וְ/כָל כָּתֵ֖ף מְרוּטָ֑ה וְ֠/שָׂכָר לֹא הָ֨יָה ל֤/וֹ וּ/לְ/חֵיל/וֹ֙ מִ/צֹּ֔ר עַל הָ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר עָבַ֥ד עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: bn 'dm nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl h'byd 't chylv 'bdh gdlh 'l tsr khl r'sh mqrch vkhl khtf mrvth vshkhr l' hyh lv vlchylv mtsr 'l h'bdh 'shr 'bd 'lyh
verses.translation: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן לִ/נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/נָשָׂ֨א הֲמֹנָ֜/הּ וְ/שָׁלַ֤ל שְׁלָלָ/הּ֙ וּ/בָזַ֣ז בִּזָּ֔/הּ וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה שָׂכָ֖ר לְ/חֵילֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny ntn lnbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl 't 'rts mtsrym vnsh' hmnh vshll shllh vbzz bzh vhyth shkhr lchylv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

verses.original: פְּעֻלָּת/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁר עָ֣בַד בָּ֔/הּ נָתַ֥תִּי ל֖/וֹ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁר֙ עָ֣שׂוּ לִ֔/י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: p'ltv 'shr 'bd bh ntty lv 't 'rts mtsrym 'shr 'shv ly n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא אַצְמִ֤יחַ קֶ֨רֶן֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/לְ/ךָ֛ אֶתֵּ֥ן פִּתְחֽוֹן פֶּ֖ה בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' 'tsmych qrn lbyt yshr'l vlkh 'tn ptchvn ph btvkhm vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵא֙ וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה הֵילִ֖ילוּ הָ֥הּ לַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: bn 'dm hnb' v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hylylv hh lyvm
verses.translation: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!

verses.original: כִּֽי קָר֣וֹב י֔וֹם וְ/קָר֥וֹב י֖וֹם לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה י֣וֹם עָנָ֔ן עֵ֥ת גּוֹיִ֖ם יִֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: khy qrvb yvm vqrvb yvm lyhvh yvm 'nn 't gvym yhyh
verses.translation: For the day is near, even the day of the LORD is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.

verses.original: וּ/בָאָ֥ה חֶ֨רֶב֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה חַלְחָלָה֙ בְּ/כ֔וּשׁ בִּ/נְפֹ֥ל חָלָ֖ל בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/לָקְח֣וּ הֲמוֹנָ֔/הּ וְ/נֶהֶרְס֖וּ יְסוֹדֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vb'h chrb bmtsrym vhyth chlchlh bkhvsh bnpl chll bmtsrym vlqchv hmvnh vnhrsv ysvdtyh
verses.translation: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

verses.original: כּ֣וּשׁ וּ/פ֤וּט וְ/לוּד֙ וְ/כָל הָ/עֶ֣רֶב וְ/כ֔וּב וּ/בְנֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/בְּרִ֑ית אִתָּ֖/ם בַּ/חֶ֥רֶב יִפֹּֽלוּ
verses.translit: khvsh vpvt vlvd vkhl h'rb vkhvb vbny 'rts hbryt 'tm bchrb yplv
verses.translation: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נָֽפְלוּ֙ סֹמְכֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/יָרַ֖ד גְּא֣וֹן עֻזָּ֑/הּ מִ/מִּגְדֹּ֣ל סְוֵנֵ֗ה בַּ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ יִפְּלוּ בָ֔/הּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh vnplv smkhy mtsrym vyrd g'vn 'zh mmgdl svnh bchrb yplv bh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/נָשַׁ֕מּוּ בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ אֲרָצ֣וֹת נְשַׁמּ֑וֹת וְ/עָרָ֕י/ו בְּ/תוֹךְ עָרִ֥ים נַחֲרָב֖וֹת תִּֽהְיֶֽינָה
verses.translit: vnshmv btvkh 'rtsvt nshmvt v'ryv btvkh 'rym nchrbvt thyynh
verses.translation: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/תִתִּ/י אֵ֣שׁ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/נִשְׁבְּר֖וּ כָּל עֹזְרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh btty 'sh bmtsrym vnshbrv khl 'zryh
verses.translation: And they shall know that I am the LORD , when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יֵצְא֨וּ מַלְאָכִ֤ים מִ/לְּ/פָנַ/י֙ בַּ/צִּ֔ים לְ/הַחֲרִ֖יד אֶת כּ֣וּשׁ בֶּ֑טַח וְ/הָיְתָ֨ה חַלְחָלָ֤ה בָ/הֶם֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י הִנֵּ֖ה בָּאָֽה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yts'v ml'khym mlpny btsym lhchryd 't khvsh btch vhyth chlchlh bhm byvm mtsrym khy hnh b'h
verses.translation: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ אֶת הֲמ֣וֹן מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/יַ֖ד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vhshbty 't hmvn mtsrym byd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

verses.original: ה֠וּא וְ/עַמּ֤/וֹ אִתּ/וֹ֙ עָרִיצֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם מֽוּבָאִ֖ים לְ/שַׁחֵ֣ת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הֵרִ֤יקוּ חַרְבוֹתָ/ם֙ עַל מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/מָלְא֥וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ חָלָֽל
verses.translit: hv' v'mv 'tv 'rytsy gvym mvb'ym lshcht h'rts vhryqv chrbvtm 'l mtsrym vml'v 't h'rts chll
verses.translation: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י יְאֹרִים֙ חָֽרָבָ֔ה וּ/מָכַרְתִּ֥י אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בְּ/יַד רָעִ֑ים וַ/הֲשִׁמֹּתִ֞י אֶ֤רֶץ וּ/מְלֹאָ/הּ֙ בְּ/יַד זָרִ֔ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: vntty y'rym chrbh vmkhrty 't h'rts byd r'ym vhshmty 'rts vml'h byd zrym 'ny yhvh dbrty
verses.translation: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken it .

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה וְ/הַאֲבַדְתִּ֨י גִלּוּלִ֜ים וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּ֤י אֱלִילִים֙ מִ/נֹּ֔ף וְ/נָשִׂ֥יא מֵ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה ע֑וֹד וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י יִרְאָ֖ה בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vh'bdty glvlym vhshbty 'lylym mnf vnshy' m'rts mtsrym l' yhyh 'vd vntty yr'h b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/הֲשִׁמֹּתִי֙ אֶת פַּתְר֔וֹס וְ/נָתַ֥תִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּ/צֹ֑עַן וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתִי שְׁפָטִ֖ים בְּ/נֹֽא
verses.translit: vhshmty 't ptrvs vntty 'sh bts'n v'shyty shptym bn'
verses.translation: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁפַכְתִּ֣י חֲמָתִ֔/י עַל סִ֖ין מָע֣וֹז מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֖י אֶת הֲמ֥וֹן נֹֽא
verses.translit: vshpkhty chmty 'l syn m'vz mtsrym vhkhrty 't hmvn n'
verses.translation: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם ח֤וּל תחיל תָּחוּל֙ סִ֔ין וְ/נֹ֖א תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְ/הִבָּקֵ֑עַ וְ/נֹ֖ף צָרֵ֥י יוֹמָֽם
verses.translit: vntty 'sh bmtsrym chvl tchyl tchvl syn vn' thyh lhbq' vnf tsry yvmm
verses.translation: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.

verses.original: בַּח֥וּרֵי אָ֛וֶן וּ/פִי בֶ֖סֶת בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ וְ/הֵ֖נָּה בַּ/שְּׁבִ֥י תֵלַֽכְנָה
verses.translit: bchvry 'vn vpy bst bchrb yplv vhnh bshby tlkhnh
verses.translation: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.

verses.original: וּ/בִֽ/תְחַפְנְחֵס֙ חָשַׂ֣ךְ הַ/יּ֔וֹם בְּ/שִׁבְרִ/י שָׁם֙ אֶת מֹט֣וֹת מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/נִשְׁבַּת בָּ֖/הּ גְּא֣וֹן עֻזָּ֑/הּ הִ֚יא עָנָ֣ן יְכַסֶּ֔/נָּה וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֖י/הָ בַּ/שְּׁבִ֥י תֵלַֽכְנָה
verses.translit: vbtchpnchs chshkh hyvm bshbry shm 't mtvt mtsrym vnshbt bh g'vn 'zh hy' 'nn ykhsnh vbnvtyh bshby tlkhnh
verses.translation: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתִי שְׁפָטִ֖ים בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'shyty shptym bmtsrym vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/אַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בָּֽ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּ/שִׁבְעָ֣ה לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy b'cht 'shrh shnh br'shvn bshb'h lchdsh hyh dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month , in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם אֶת זְר֛וֹעַ פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם שָׁבָ֑רְתִּי וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא חֻ֠בְּשָׁה לָ/תֵ֨ת רְפֻא֜וֹת לָ/שׂ֥וּם חִתּ֛וּל לְ/חָבְשָׁ֥/הּ לְ/חָזְקָ֖/הּ לִ/תְפֹּ֥שׂ בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: bn 'dm 't zrv' pr'h mlkh mtsrym shbrty vhnh l' chbshh ltt rp'vt lshvm chtvl lchbshh lchzqh ltpsh bchrb
verses.translation: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה הִנְ/נִי֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/שָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת זְרֹ֣עֹתָ֔י/ו אֶת הַ/חֲזָקָ֖ה וְ/אֶת הַ/נִּשְׁבָּ֑רֶת וְ/הִפַּלְתִּ֥י אֶת הַ/חֶ֖רֶב מִ/יָּדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'l pr'h mlkh mtsrym vshbrty 't zr'tyv 't hchzqh v't hnshbrt vhplty 't hchrb mydv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

verses.original: וַ/הֲפִצוֹתִ֥י אֶת מִצְרַ֖יִם בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וְ/זֵרִיתִ֖/ם בָּ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhptsvty 't mtsrym bgvym vzrytm b'rtsvt
verses.translation: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

verses.original: וְ/חִזַּקְתִּ֗י אֶת זְרֹעוֹת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י אֶת חַרְבִּ֖/י בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת זְרֹע֣וֹת פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/נָאַ֛ק נַאֲק֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vchzqty 't zr'vt mlkh bbl vntty 't chrby bydv vshbrty 't zr'vt pr'h vn'q n'qvt chll lpnyv
verses.translation: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man .

verses.original: וְ/הַחֲזַקְתִּ֗י אֶת זְרֹעוֹת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וּ/זְרֹע֥וֹת פַּרְעֹ֖ה תִּפֹּ֑לְנָה וְֽ/יָדְע֞וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בְּ/תִתִּ֤/י חַרְבִּ/י֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/נָטָ֥ה אוֹתָ֖/הּ אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhchzqty 't zr'vt mlkh bbl vzr'vt pr'h tplnh vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh btty chrby byd mlkh bbl vnth 'vth 'l 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am the LORD , when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/הֲפִצוֹתִ֤י אֶת מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/זֵרִיתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖/ם בָּ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhptsvty 't mtsrym bgvym vzryty 'vtm b'rtsvt vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/אַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בַּ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֖י בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy b'cht 'shrh shnh bshlyshy b'chd lchdsh hyh dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month , in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם אֱמֹ֛ר אֶל פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/אֶל הֲמוֹנ֑/וֹ אֶל מִ֖י דָּמִ֥יתָ בְ/גָדְלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bn 'dm 'mr 'l pr'h mlkh mtsrym v'l hmvnv 'l my dmyt bgdlkh
verses.translation: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אַשּׁ֜וּר אֶ֣רֶז בַּ/לְּבָנ֗וֹן יְפֵ֥ה עָנָ֛ף וְ/חֹ֥רֶשׁ מֵצַ֖ל וּ/גְבַ֣הּ קוֹמָ֑ה וּ/בֵ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֔ים הָיְתָ֖ה צַמַּרְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnh 'shvr 'rz blbnvn yph 'nf vchrsh mtsl vgbh qvmh vbyn 'btym hyth tsmrtv
verses.translation: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

verses.original: מַ֣יִם גִּדְּל֔וּ/הוּ תְּה֖וֹם רֹֽמְמָ֑תְ/הוּ אֶת נַהֲרֹתֶ֗י/הָ הֹלֵךְ֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת מַטָּעָ֔/הּ וְ/אֶת תְּעָלֹתֶ֣י/הָ שִׁלְחָ֔ה אֶ֖ל כָּל עֲצֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: mym gdlvhv thvm rmmthv 't nhrtyh hlkh sbybvt mt'h v't t'ltyh shlchh 'l khl 'tsy hshdh
verses.translation: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֙ גָּבְהָ֣א קֹמָת֔/וֹ מִ/כֹּ֖ל עֲצֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וַ/תִּרְבֶּ֨ינָה סַֽרְעַפֹּתָ֜י/ו וַ/תֶּאֱרַ֧כְנָה פארת/ו פֹארֹתָ֛י/ו מִ/מַּ֥יִם רַבִּ֖ים בְּ/שַׁלְּחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l khn gbh' qmtv mkhl 'tsy hshdh vtrbynh sr'ptyv vt'rkhnh p'rtv p'rtyv mmym rbym bshlchv
verses.translation: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.

verses.original: בִּ/סְעַפֹּתָ֤י/ו קִֽנְנוּ֙ כָּל ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/תַ֤חַת פֹּֽארֹתָי/ו֙ יָֽלְד֔וּ כֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וּ/בְ/צִלּ/וֹ֙ יֵֽשְׁב֔וּ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיִ֥ם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: bs'ptyv qnnv khl 'vf hshmym vtcht p'rtyv yldv khl chyt hshdh vbtslv yshbv khl gvym rbym
verses.translation: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

verses.original: וַ/יְּיִ֣ף בְּ/גָדְל֔/וֹ בְּ/אֹ֖רֶךְ דָּֽלִיּוֹתָ֑י/ו כִּֽי הָיָ֥ה שָׁרְשׁ֖/וֹ אֶל מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vyyf bgdlv b'rkh dlyvtyv khy hyh shrshv 'l mym rbym
verses.translation: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.

verses.original: אֲרָזִ֣ים לֹֽא עֲמָמֻ/הוּ֮ בְּ/גַן אֱלֹהִים֒ בְּרוֹשִׁ֗ים לֹ֤א דָמוּ֙ אֶל סְעַפֹּתָ֔י/ו וְ/עַרְמֹנִ֥ים לֹֽא הָי֖וּ כְּ/פֹֽארֹתָ֑י/ו כָּל עֵץ֙ בְּ/גַן אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא דָמָ֥ה אֵלָ֖י/ו בְּ/יָפְיֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'rzym l' 'mmhv bgn 'lhym brvshym l' dmv 'l s'ptyv v'rmnym l' hyv khp'rtyv khl 'ts bgn 'lhym l' dmh 'lyv bypyv
verses.translation: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.

verses.original: יָפֶ֣ה עֲשִׂיתִ֔י/ו בְּ/רֹ֖ב דָּֽלִיּוֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יְקַנְאֻ֨/הוּ֙ כָּל עֲצֵי עֵ֔דֶן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/גַ֥ן הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: yph 'shytyv brb dlyvtyv vyqn'hv khl 'tsy 'dn 'shr bgn h'lhym
verses.translation: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּבַ֖הְתָּ בְּ/קוֹמָ֑ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן צַמַּרְתּ/וֹ֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ין עֲבוֹתִ֔ים וְ/רָ֥ם לְבָב֖/וֹ בְּ/גָבְהֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'shr gbht bqvmh vytn tsmrtv 'l byn 'bvtym vrm lbbv bgbhv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

verses.original: וְ/אֶ֨תְּנֵ֔/הוּ בְּ/יַ֖ד אֵ֣יל גּוֹיִ֑ם עָשׂ֤וֹ יַֽעֲשֶׂה֙ ל֔/וֹ כְּ/רִשְׁע֖/וֹ גֵּרַשְׁתִּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: v'tnhv byd 'yl gvym 'shv y'shh lv khrsh'v grshthv
verses.translation: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרְתֻ֧/הוּ זָרִ֛ים עָרִיצֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם וַֽ/יִּטְּשֻׁ֑/הוּ אֶל הֶ֠/הָרִים וּ/בְ/כָל גֵּ֨אָי֜וֹת נָפְל֣וּ דָלִיּוֹתָ֗י/ו וַ/תִּשָּׁבַ֤רְנָה פֹֽארֹתָי/ו֙ בְּ/כֹל֙ אֲפִיקֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יֵּרְד֧וּ מִ/צִּלּ֛/וֹ כָּל עַמֵּ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וַֽ/יִּטְּשֻֽׁ/הוּ
verses.translit: vykhrthv zrym 'rytsy gvym vytshhv 'l hhrym vbkhl g'yvt nplv dlyvtyv vtshbrnh p'rtyv bkhl 'pyqy h'rts vyrdv mtslv khl 'my h'rts vytshhv
verses.translation: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

verses.original: עַל מַפַּלְתּ֥/וֹ יִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ כָּל ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/אֶל פֹּארֹתָ֣י/ו הָי֔וּ כֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: 'l mpltv yshkhnv khl 'vf hshmym v'l p'rtyv hyv khl chyt hshdh
verses.translation: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:

verses.original: לְמַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ לֹא יִגְבְּה֨וּ בְ/קוֹמָתָ֜/ם כָּל עֲצֵי מַ֗יִם וְ/לֹֽא יִתְּנ֤וּ אֶת צַמַּרְתָּ/ם֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֔ים וְ/לֹֽא יַעַמְד֧וּ אֵלֵי/הֶ֛ם בְּ/גָבְהָ֖/ם כָּל שֹׁ֣תֵי מָ֑יִם כִּֽי כֻלָּ/ם֩ נִתְּנ֨וּ לַ/מָּ֜וֶת אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֗ית בְּ/ת֛וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָ֖ם אֶל י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
verses.translit: lm'n 'shr l' ygbhv bqvmtm khl 'tsy mym vl' ytnv 't tsmrtm 'l byn 'btym vl' y'mdv 'lyhm bgbhm khl shty mym khy khlm ntnv lmvt 'l 'rts tchtyt btvkh bny 'dm 'l yvrdy bvr
verses.translation: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה בְּ/י֨וֹם רִדְתּ֤/וֹ שְׁא֨וֹלָ/ה֙ הֶאֱבַ֜לְתִּי כִּסֵּ֤תִי עָלָי/ו֙ אֶת תְּה֔וֹם וָֽ/אֶמְנַע֙ נַהֲרוֹתֶ֔י/הָ וַ/יִּכָּלְא֖וּ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וָ/אַקְדִּ֤ר עָלָי/ו֙ לְבָנ֔וֹן וְ/כָל עֲצֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה עָלָ֥י/ו עֻלְפֶּֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh byvm rdtv sh'vlh h'blty khsty 'lyv 't thvm v'mn' nhrvtyh vykhl'v mym rbym v'qdr 'lyv lbnvn vkhl 'tsy hshdh 'lyv 'lph
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

verses.original: מִ/קּ֤וֹל מַפַּלְתּ/וֹ֙ הִרְעַ֣שְׁתִּי גוֹיִ֔ם בְּ/הוֹרִדִ֥/י אֹת֛/וֹ שְׁא֖וֹלָ/ה אֶת י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר וַ/יִּנָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ בְּ/אֶ֤רֶץ תַּחְתִּית֙ כָּל עֲצֵי עֵ֔דֶן מִבְחַ֥ר וְ/טוֹב לְבָנ֖וֹן כָּל שֹׁ֥תֵי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: mqvl mpltv hr'shty gvym bhvrdy 'tv sh'vlh 't yvrdy bvr vynchmv b'rts tchtyt khl 'tsy 'dn mbchr vtvb lbnvn khl shty mym
verses.translation: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

verses.original: גַּם הֵ֗ם אִתּ֛/וֹ יָרְד֥וּ שְׁא֖וֹלָ/ה אֶל חַלְלֵי חָ֑רֶב וּ/זְרֹע֛/וֹ יָשְׁב֥וּ בְ/צִלּ֖/וֹ בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: gm hm 'tv yrdv sh'vlh 'l chlly chrb vzr'v yshbv btslv btvkh gvym
verses.translation: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.

verses.original: אֶל מִ֨י דָמִ֥יתָ כָּ֛כָה בְּ/כָב֥וֹד וּ/בְ/גֹ֖דֶל בַּ/עֲצֵי עֵ֑דֶן וְ/הוּרַדְתָּ֨ אֶת עֲצֵי עֵ֜דֶן אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֗ית בְּ/ת֨וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֤ים תִּשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת חַלְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב ה֤וּא פַרְעֹה֙ וְ/כָל הֲמוֹנֹ֔/ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: 'l my dmyt khkhh bkhbvd vbgdl b'tsy 'dn vhvrdt 't 'tsy 'dn 'l 'rts tchtyt btvkh 'rlym tshkhb 't chlly chrb hv' pr'h vkhl hmvnh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בִּ/שְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה בִּ/שְׁנֵי עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy bshty 'shrh shnh bshny 'shr chdsh b'chd lchdsh hyh dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם שָׂ֤א קִינָה֙ עַל פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔י/ו כְּפִ֥יר גּוֹיִ֖ם נִדְמֵ֑יתָ וְ/אַתָּה֙ כַּ/תַּנִּ֣ים בַּ/יַּמִּ֔ים וַ/תָּ֣גַח בְּ/נַהֲרוֹתֶ֗י/ךָ וַ/תִּדְלַח מַ֨יִם֙ בְּ/רַגְלֶ֔י/ךָ וַ/תִּרְפֹּ֖ס נַהֲרוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: bn 'dm sh' qynh 'l pr'h mlkh mtsrym v'mrt 'lyv khpyr gvym ndmyt v'th khtnym bymym vtgch bnhrvtykh vtdlch mym brglykh vtrps nhrvtm
verses.translation: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וּ/פָרַשְׂתִּ֤י עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת רִשְׁתִּ֔/י בִּ/קְהַ֖ל עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ/הֶעֱל֖וּ/ךָ בְּ/חֶרְמִֽ/י
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vprshty 'lykh 't rshty bqhl 'mym rbym vh'lvkh bchrmy
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

verses.original: וּ/נְטַשְׁתִּ֣י/ךָ בָ/אָ֔רֶץ עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה אֲטִילֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הִשְׁכַּנְתִּ֤י עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ כָּל ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/הִשְׂבַּעְתִּ֥י מִמְּ/ךָ֖ חַיַּ֥ת כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vntshtykh b'rts 'l pny hshdh 'tylkh vhshkhnty 'lykh khl 'vf hshmym vhshb'ty mmkh chyt khl h'rts
verses.translation: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י אֶת בְּשָׂרְ/ךָ֖ עַל הֶֽ/הָרִ֑ים וּ/מִלֵּאתִ֥י הַ/גֵּאָי֖וֹת רָמוּתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vntty 't bshrkh 'l hhrym vml'ty hg'yvt rmvtkh
verses.translation: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁקֵיתִ֨י אֶ֧רֶץ צָפָתְ/ךָ֛ מִ/דָּמְ/ךָ֖ אֶל הֶֽ/הָרִ֑ים וַ/אֲפִקִ֖ים יִמָּלְא֥וּ/ן מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: vhshqyty 'rts tsptkh mdmkh 'l hhrym v'pqym yml'vn mmkh
verses.translation: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.

verses.original: וְ/כִסֵּיתִ֤י בְ/כַבּֽוֹתְ/ךָ֙ שָׁמַ֔יִם וְ/הִקְדַּרְתִּ֖י אֶת כֹּֽכְבֵי/הֶ֑ם שֶׁ֚מֶשׁ בֶּ/עָנָ֣ן אֲכַסֶּ֔/נּוּ וְ/יָרֵ֖חַ לֹא יָאִ֥יר אוֹרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhsyty bkhbvtkh shmym vhqdrty 't khkhbyhm shmsh b'nn 'khsnv vyrch l' y'yr 'vrv
verses.translation: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

verses.original: כָּל מְא֤וֹרֵי אוֹר֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם אַקְדִּירֵ֖/ם עָלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/נָתַ֤תִּי חֹ֨שֶׁךְ֙ עַֽל אַרְצְ/ךָ֔ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: khl m'vry 'vr bshmym 'qdyrm 'lykh vntty chshkh 'l 'rtskh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/הִ֨כְעַסְתִּ֔י לֵ֖ב עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים בַּ/הֲבִיאִ֤/י שִׁבְרְ/ךָ֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם עַל אֲרָצ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יְדַעְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhkh'sty lb 'mym rbym bhby'y shbrkh bgvym 'l 'rtsvt 'shr l' yd'tm
verses.translation: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

verses.original: וַ/הֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֨י עָלֶ֜י/ךָ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וּ/מַלְכֵי/הֶם֙ יִשְׂעֲר֤וּ עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ שַׂ֔עַר בְּ/עוֹפְפִ֥/י חַרְבִּ֖/י עַל פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/חָרְד֤וּ לִ/רְגָעִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ בְּ/י֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhshmvty 'lykh 'mym rbym vmlkhyhm ysh'rv 'lykh sh'r b'vppy chrby 'l pnyhm vchrdv lrg'ym 'ysh lnpshv byvm mpltkh
verses.translation: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה חֶ֥רֶב מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל תְּבוֹאֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh chrb mlkh bbl tbv'kh
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

verses.original: בְּ/חַרְב֤וֹת גִּבּוֹרִים֙ אַפִּ֣יל הֲמוֹנֶ֔/ךָ עָרִיצֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑/ם וְ/שָֽׁדְדוּ֙ אֶת גְּא֣וֹן מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/נִשְׁמַ֖ד כָּל הֲמוֹנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: bchrbvt gbvrym 'pyl hmvnkh 'rytsy gvym khlm vshddv 't g'vn mtsrym vnshmd khl hmvnh
verses.translation: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽאֲבַדְתִּי֙ אֶת כָּל בְּהֶמְתָּ֔/הּ מֵ/עַ֖ל מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ/לֹ֨א תִדְלָחֵ֤/ם רֶֽגֶל אָדָם֙ ע֔וֹד וּ/פַרְס֥וֹת בְּהֵמָ֖ה לֹ֥א תִדְלָחֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vh'bdty 't khl bhmth m'l mym rbym vl' tdlchm rgl 'dm 'vd vprsvt bhmh l' tdlchm
verses.translation: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

verses.original: אָ֚ז אַשְׁקִ֣יעַ מֵֽימֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/נַהֲרוֹתָ֖/ם כַּ/שֶּׁ֣מֶן אוֹלִ֑יךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: 'z 'shqy' mymyhm vnhrvtm khshmn 'vlykh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: בְּ/תִתִּ/י֩ אֶת אֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּ/נְשַׁמָּ֗ה אֶ֚רֶץ מִ/מְּלֹאָ֔/הּ בְּ/הַכּוֹתִ֖/י אֶת כָּל י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָ֑/הּ וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: btty 't 'rts mtsrym shmmh vnshmh 'rts mml'h bhkhvty 't khl yvshby bh vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: קִינָ֥ה הִיא֙ וְ/ק֣וֹנְנ֔וּ/הָ בְּנ֥וֹת הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם תְּקוֹנֵ֣נָּה אוֹתָ֑/הּ עַל מִצְרַ֤יִם וְ/עַל כָּל הֲמוֹנָ/הּ֙ תְּקוֹנֵ֣נָּה אוֹתָ֔/הּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: qynh hy' vqvnnvh bnvt hgvym tqvnnh 'vth 'l mtsrym v'l khl hmvnh tqvnnh 'vth n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בִּ/שְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy bshty 'shrh shnh bchmshh 'shr lchdsh hyh dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם נְהֵ֛ה עַל הֲמ֥וֹן מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/הוֹרִדֵ֑/הוּ א֠וֹתָ/הּ וּ/בְנ֨וֹת גּוֹיִ֧ם אַדִּרִ֛ם אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֖וֹת אֶת י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
verses.translit: bn 'dm nhh 'l hmvn mtsrym vhvrdhv 'vth vbnvt gvym 'drm 'l 'rts tchtyvt 't yvrdy bvr
verses.translation: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

verses.original: מִ/מִּ֖י נָעָ֑מְתָּ רְדָ֥/ה וְ/הָשְׁכְּבָ֖/ה אֶת עֲרֵלִֽים
verses.translit: mmy n'mt rdh vhshkhbh 't 'rlym
verses.translation: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

verses.original: בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ חַלְלֵי חֶ֖רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ חֶ֣רֶב נִתָּ֔נָה מָשְׁכ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖/הּ וְ/כָל הֲמוֹנֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: btvkh chlly chrb yplv chrb ntnh mshkhv 'vth vkhl hmvnyh
verses.translation: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.

verses.original: יְדַבְּרוּ ל֞/וֹ אֵלֵ֧י גִבּוֹרִ֛ים מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ שְׁא֖וֹל אֶת עֹֽזְרָ֑י/ו יָֽרְד֛וּ שָׁכְב֥וּ הָ/עֲרֵלִ֖ים חַלְלֵי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: ydbrv lv 'ly gbvrym mtvkh sh'vl 't 'zryv yrdv shkhbv h'rlym chlly chrb
verses.translation: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם אַשּׁוּר֙ וְ/כָל קְהָלָ֔/הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖י/ו קִבְרֹתָ֑י/ו כֻּלָּ֣/ם חֲלָלִ֔ים הַ/נֹּפְלִ֖ים בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: shm 'shvr vkhl qhlh sbybvtyv qbrtyv khlm chllym hnplym bchrb
verses.translation: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִתְּנ֤וּ קִבְרֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ בְּ/יַרְכְּתֵי ב֔וֹר וַ/יְהִ֣י קְהָלָ֔/הּ סְבִיב֖וֹת קְבֻרָתָ֑/הּ כֻּלָּ֤/ם חֲלָלִים֙ נֹפְלִ֣ים בַּ/חֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁר נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּ֖ית בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: 'shr ntnv qbrtyh byrkhty bvr vyhy qhlh sbybvt qbrth khlm chllym nplym bchrb 'shr ntnv chtyt b'rts chyym
verses.translation: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם עֵילָם֙ וְ/כָל הֲמוֹנָ֔/הּ סְבִיב֖וֹת קְבֻרָתָ֑/הּ כֻּלָּ֣/ם חֲלָלִים֩ הַ/נֹּפְלִ֨ים בַּ/חֶ֜רֶב אֲֽשֶׁר יָרְד֥וּ עֲרֵלִ֣ים אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתְנ֤וּ חִתִּיתָ/ם֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ כְלִמָּתָ֖/ם אֶת י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
verses.translit: shm 'ylm vkhl hmvnh sbybvt qbrth khlm chllym hnplym bchrb 'shr yrdv 'rlym 'l 'rts tchtyvt 'shr ntnv chtytm b'rts chyym vysh'v khlmtm 't yvrdy bvr
verses.translation: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

verses.original: בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ חֲ֠לָלִים נָתְנ֨וּ מִשְׁכָּ֥ב לָ/הּ֙ בְּ/כָל הֲמוֹנָ֔/הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖י/ו קִבְרֹתֶ֑/הָ כֻּלָּ֣/ם עֲרֵלִ֣ים חַלְלֵי חֶ֡רֶב כִּֽי נִתַּ֨ן חִתִּיתָ֜/ם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֗ים וַ/יִּשְׂא֤וּ כְלִמָּתָ/ם֙ אֶת י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֔וֹר בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ חֲלָלִ֖ים נִתָּֽן
verses.translit: btvkh chllym ntnv mshkhb lh bkhl hmvnh sbybvtyv qbrth khlm 'rlym chlly chrb khy ntn chtytm b'rts chyym vysh'v khlmtm 't yvrdy bvr btvkh chllym ntn
verses.translation: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם מֶ֤שֶׁךְ תֻּבַל֙ וְ/כָל הֲמוֹנָ֔/הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖י/ו קִבְרוֹתֶ֑י/הָ כֻּלָּ֤/ם עֲרֵלִים֙ מְחֻ֣לְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב כִּֽי נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖/ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: shm mshkh tbl vkhl hmvnh sbybvtyv qbrvtyh khlm 'rlym mchlly chrb khy ntnv chtytm b'rts chyym
verses.translation: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ אֶת גִּבּוֹרִ֔ים נֹפְלִ֖ים מֵ/עֲרֵלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָרְדֽוּ שְׁא֣וֹל בִּ/כְלֵֽי מִלְחַמְתָּ/ם֩ וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת חַרְבוֹתָ֜/ם תַּ֣חַת רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֗ם וַ/תְּהִ֤י עֲוֺֽנֹתָ/ם֙ עַל עַצְמוֹתָ֔/ם כִּֽי חִתִּ֥ית גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: vl' yshkhbv 't gbvrym nplym m'rlym 'shr yrdv sh'vl bkhly mlchmtm vytnv 't chrbvtm tcht r'shyhm vthy 'vntm 'l 'tsmvtm khy chtyt gbvrym b'rts chyym
verses.translation: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֗ה בְּ/ת֧וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֛ים תִּשָּׁבַ֥ר וְ/תִשְׁכַּ֖ב אֶת חַלְלֵי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'th btvkh 'rlym tshbr vtshkhb 't chlly chrb
verses.translation: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּ/ה אֱד֗וֹם מְלָכֶ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/כָל נְשִׂיאֶ֔י/הָ אֲשֶׁר נִתְּנ֥וּ בִ/גְבוּרָתָ֖/ם אֶת חַלְלֵי חָ֑רֶב הֵ֛מָּה אֶת עֲרֵלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֖בוּ וְ/אֶת יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר
verses.translit: shmh 'dvm mlkhyh vkhl nshy'yh 'shr ntnv bgbvrtm 't chlly chrb hmh 't 'rlym yshkhbv v't yrdy bvr
verses.translation: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּ/ה נְסִיכֵ֥י צָפ֛וֹן כֻּלָּ֖/ם וְ/כָל צִֽדֹנִ֑י אֲשֶׁר יָרְד֣וּ אֶת חֲלָלִ֗ים בְּ/חִתִּיתָ֤/ם מִ/גְבֽוּרָתָ/ם֙ בּוֹשִׁ֔ים וַ/יִּשְׁכְּב֤וּ עֲרֵלִים֙ אֶת חַלְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ כְלִמָּתָ֖/ם אֶת י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
verses.translit: shmh nsykhy tspvn khlm vkhl tsdny 'shr yrdv 't chllym bchtytm mgbvrtm bvshym vyshkhbv 'rlym 't chlly chrb vysh'v khlmtm 't yvrdy bvr
verses.translation: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

verses.original: אוֹתָ/ם֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְ/נִחַ֖ם עַל כָּל המונ/ה הֲמוֹנ֑/וֹ חַלְלֵי חֶ֨רֶב֙ פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְ/כָל חֵיל֔/וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: 'vtm yr'h pr'h vnchm 'l khl hmvnh hmvnv chlly chrb pr'h vkhl chylv n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: כִּֽי נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת חתית/ו חִתִּיתִ֖/י בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֑ים וְ/הֻשְׁכַּב֩ בְּ/ת֨וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֜ים אֶת חַלְלֵי חֶ֗רֶב פַּרְעֹה֙ וְ/כָל הֲמוֹנֹ֔/ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: khy ntty 't chtytv chtyty b'rts chyym vhshkhb btvkh 'rlym 't chlly chrb pr'h vkhl hmvnh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶל בְּנֵֽי עַמְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אֶ֕רֶץ כִּֽי אָבִ֥יא עָלֶ֖י/הָ חָ֑רֶב וְ/לָקְח֨וּ עַם הָ/אָ֜רֶץ אִ֤ישׁ אֶחָד֙ מִ/קְצֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/נָתְנ֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/צֹפֶֽה
verses.translit: bn 'dm dbr 'l bny 'mkh v'mrt 'lyhm 'rts khy 'by' 'lyh chrb vlqchv 'm h'rts 'ysh 'chd mqtsyhm vntnv 'tv lhm ltsph
verses.translation: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֥ה אֶת הַ/חֶ֖רֶב בָּאָ֣ה עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/תָקַ֥ע בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֖ר וְ/הִזְהִ֥יר אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vr'h 't hchrb b'h 'l h'rts vtq' bshvpr vhzhyr 't h'm
verses.translation: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַ֨ע הַ/שֹּׁמֵ֜עַ אֶת ק֤וֹל הַ/שּׁוֹפָר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א נִזְהָ֔ר וַ/תָּ֥בוֹא חֶ֖רֶב וַ/תִּקָּחֵ֑/הוּ דָּמ֥/וֹ בְ/רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ יִֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vshm' hshm' 't qvl hshvpr vl' nzhr vtbv' chrb vtqchhv dmv br'shv yhyh
verses.translation: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

verses.original: אֵת֩ ק֨וֹל הַ/שּׁוֹפָ֤ר שָׁמַע֙ וְ/לֹ֣א נִזְהָ֔ר דָּמ֖/וֹ בּ֣/וֹ יִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְ/ה֥וּא נִזְהָ֖ר נַפְשׁ֥/וֹ מִלֵּֽט
verses.translit: 't qvl hshvpr shm' vl' nzhr dmv bv yhyh vhv' nzhr npshv mlt
verses.translation: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.

verses.original: וְ֠/הַ/צֹּפֶה כִּֽי יִרְאֶ֨ה אֶת הַ/חֶ֜רֶב בָּאָ֗ה וְ/לֹֽא תָקַ֤ע בַּ/שּׁוֹפָר֙ וְ/הָ/עָ֣ם לֹֽא נִזְהָ֔ר וַ/תָּב֣וֹא חֶ֔רֶב וַ/תִּקַּ֥ח מֵ/הֶ֖ם נָ֑פֶשׁ ה֚וּא בַּ/עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ נִלְקָ֔ח וְ/דָמ֖/וֹ מִ/יַּֽד הַ/צֹּפֶ֥ה אֶדְרֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: vhtsph khy yr'h 't hchrb b'h vl' tq' bshvpr vh'm l' nzhr vtbv' chrb vtqch mhm npsh hv' b'vnv nlqch vdmv myd htsph 'drsh
verses.translation: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם צֹפֶ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֤ מִ/פִּ/י֙ דָּבָ֔ר וְ/הִזְהַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm tsph nttykh lbyt yshr'l vshm't mpy dbr vhzhrt 'tm mmny
verses.translation: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.

verses.original: בְּ/אָמְרִ֣/י לָ/רָשָׁ֗ע רָשָׁע֙ מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת וְ/לֹ֣א דִבַּ֔רְתָּ לְ/הַזְהִ֥יר רָשָׁ֖ע מִ/דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ ה֤וּא רָשָׁע֙ בַּ/עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְ/דָמ֖/וֹ מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֥ אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ
verses.translit: b'mry lrsh' rsh' mvt tmvt vl' dbrt lhzhyr rsh' mdrkhv hv' rsh' b'vnv ymvt vdmv mydkh 'bqsh
verses.translation: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man , thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

verses.original: וְ֠/אַתָּה כִּֽי הִזְהַ֨רְתָּ רָשָׁ֤ע מִ/דַּרְכּ/וֹ֙ לָ/שׁ֣וּב מִמֶּ֔/נָּה וְ/לֹא שָׁ֖ב מִ/דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ ה֚וּא בַּ/עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְ/אַתָּ֖ה נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ
verses.translit: v'th khy hzhrt rsh' mdrkhv lshvb mmnh vl' shb mdrkhv hv' b'vnv ymvt v'th npshkh htslt
verses.translation: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם אֱמֹר֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֵּ֤ן אֲמַרְתֶּם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כִּֽי פְשָׁעֵ֥י/נוּ וְ/חַטֹּאתֵ֖י/נוּ עָלֵ֑י/נוּ וּ/בָ֛/ם אֲנַ֥חְנוּ נְמַקִּ֖ים וְ/אֵ֥יךְ נִֽחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm 'mr 'l byt yshr'l khn 'mrtm l'mr khy psh'ynv vcht'tynv 'lynv vbm 'nchnv nmqym v'ykh nchyh
verses.translation: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?

verses.original: אֱמֹ֨ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם חַי אָ֣נִי נְאֻ֣ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה אִם אֶחְפֹּץ֙ בְּ/מ֣וֹת הָ/רָשָׁ֔ע כִּ֣י אִם בְּ/שׁ֥וּב רָשָׁ֛ע מִ/דַּרְכּ֖/וֹ וְ/חָיָ֑ה שׁ֣וּבוּ שׁ֜וּבוּ מִ/דַּרְכֵי/כֶ֧ם הָ/רָעִ֛ים וְ/לָ֥/מָּה תָמ֖וּתוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'mr 'lyhm chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm 'chpts bmvt hrsh' khy 'm bshvb rsh' mdrkhv vchyh shvbv shvbv mdrkhykhm hr'ym vlmh tmvtv byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD , I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל בְּנֵֽי עַמְּ/ךָ֙ צִדְקַ֣ת הַ/צַּדִּ֗יק לֹ֤א תַצִּילֶ֨/נּוּ֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם פִּשְׁע֔/וֹ וְ/רִשְׁעַ֤ת הָֽ/רָשָׁע֙ לֹֽא יִכָּ֣שֶׁל בָּ֔/הּ בְּ/י֖וֹם שׁוּב֣/וֹ מֵֽ/רִשְׁע֑/וֹ וְ/צַדִּ֗יק לֹ֥א יוּכַ֛ל לִֽ/חְי֥וֹת בָּ֖/הּ בְּ/י֥וֹם חֲטֹאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm 'mr 'l bny 'mkh tsdqt htsdyq l' ttsylnv byvm psh'v vrsh't hrsh' l' ykhshl bh byvm shvbv mrsh'v vtsdyq l' yvkhl lchyvt bh byvm cht'tv
verses.translation: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth.

verses.original: בְּ/אָמְרִ֤/י לַ/צַּדִּיק֙ חָיֹ֣ה יִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְ/הֽוּא בָטַ֥ח עַל צִדְקָת֖/וֹ וְ/עָ֣שָׂה עָ֑וֶל כָּל צדקת/ו צִדְקֹתָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א תִזָּכַ֔רְנָה וּ/בְ/עַוְל֥/וֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה בּ֥/וֹ יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: b'mry ltsdyq chyh ychyh vhv' btch 'l tsdqtv v'shh 'vl khl tsdqtv tsdqtyv l' tzkhrnh vb'vlv 'shr 'shh bv ymvt
verses.translation: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/אָמְרִ֥/י לָֽ/רָשָׁ֖ע מ֣וֹת תָּמ֑וּת וְ/שָׁב֙ מֵֽ/חַטָּאת֔/וֹ וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: vb'mry lrsh' mvt tmvt vshb mcht'tv v'shh mshpt vtsdqh
verses.translation: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

verses.original: חֲבֹ֨ל יָשִׁ֤יב רָשָׁע֙ גְּזֵלָ֣ה יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם בְּ/חֻקּ֤וֹת הַֽ/חַיִּים֙ הָלַ֔ךְ לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י עֲשׂ֣וֹת עָ֑וֶל חָי֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת
