verses.translit: chbl yshyb rsh' gzlh yshlm bchqvt hchyym hlkh lblty 'shvt 'vl chyv ychyh l' ymvt
verses.translation: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

verses.original: כָּל חטאת/ו חַטֹּאתָי/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א לֹ֥א תִזָּכַ֖רְנָה ל֑/וֹ מִשְׁפָּ֧ט וּ/צְדָקָ֛ה עָשָׂ֖ה חָי֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: khl cht'tv cht'tyv 'shr cht' l' tzkhrnh lv mshpt vtsdqh 'shh chyv ychyh
verses.translation: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

verses.original: וְ/אָמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמְּ/ךָ֔ לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑/י וְ/הֵ֖מָּה דַּרְכָּ֥/ם לֹֽא יִתָּכֵֽן
verses.translit: v'mrv bny 'mkh l' ytkhn drkh 'dny vhmh drkhm l' ytkhn
verses.translation: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

verses.original: בְּ/שׁוּב צַדִּ֥יק מִ/צִּדְקָת֖/וֹ וְ/עָ֣שָׂה עָ֑וֶל וּ/מֵ֖ת בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: bshvb tsdyq mtsdqtv v'shh 'vl vmt bhm
verses.translation: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/שׁ֤וּב רָשָׁע֙ מֵֽ/רִשְׁעָת֔/וֹ וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/צְדָקָ֑ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם ה֥וּא יִֽחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vbshvb rsh' mrsh'tv v'shh mshpt vtsdqh 'lyhm hv' ychyh
verses.translation: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑/י אִ֧ישׁ כִּ/דְרָכָ֛י/ו אֶשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'mrtm l' ytkhn drkh 'dny 'ysh khdrkhyv 'shpvt 'tkhm byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י בִּ/שְׁתֵּ֧י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֗ה בָּ/עֲשִׂרִ֛י בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה לַ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ לְ/גָלוּתֵ֑/נוּ בָּא אֵלַ֨/י הַ/פָּלִ֧יט מִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם לֵ/אמֹ֖ר הֻכְּתָ֥ה הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyhy bshty 'shrh shnh b'shry bchmshh lchdsh lglvtnv b' 'ly hplyt myrvshlm l'mr hkhth h'yr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month , in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

verses.original: וְ/יַד יְהוָה֩ הָיְתָ֨ה אֵלַ֜/י בָּ/עֶ֗רֶב לִ/פְנֵי֙ בּ֣וֹא הַ/פָּלִ֔יט וַ/יִּפְתַּ֣ח אֶת פִּ֔/י עַד בּ֥וֹא אֵלַ֖/י בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר וַ/יִּפָּ֣תַח פִּ֔/י וְ/לֹ֥א נֶאֱלַ֖מְתִּי עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vyd yhvh hyth 'ly b'rb lpny bv' hplyt vyptch 't py 'd bv' 'ly bbqr vyptch py vl' n'lmty 'vd
verses.translation: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם יֹ֠שְׁבֵי הֶ/חֳרָב֨וֹת הָ/אֵ֜לֶּה עַל אַדְמַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹמְרִ֣ים לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אֶחָד֙ הָיָ֣ה אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַ/יִּירַ֖שׁ אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/אֲנַ֣חְנוּ רַבִּ֔ים לָ֛/נוּ נִתְּנָ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/מוֹרָשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bn 'dm yshby hchrbvt h'lh 'l 'dmt yshr'l 'mrym l'mr 'chd hyh 'brhm vyyrsh 't h'rts v'nchnv rbym lnv ntnh h'rts lmvrshh
verses.translation: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֩ אֱמֹ֨ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה עַל הַ/דָּ֧ם תֹּאכֵ֛לוּ וְ/עֵינֵ/כֶ֛ם תִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶל גִּלּוּלֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/דָ֣ם תִּשְׁפֹּ֑כוּ וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ תִּירָֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'l hdm t'khlv v'ynkhm tsh'v 'l glvlykhm vdm tshpkhv vh'rts tyrshv
verses.translation: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

verses.original: עֲמַדְתֶּ֤ם עַֽל חַרְבְּ/כֶם֙ עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ן תּוֹעֵבָ֔ה וְ/אִ֛ישׁ אֶת אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖/הוּ טִמֵּאתֶ֑ם וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ תִּירָֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: 'mdtm 'l chrbkhm 'shytn tv'bh v'ysh 't 'sht r'hv tm'tm vh'rts tyrshv
verses.translation: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour’s wife: and shall ye possess the land?

verses.original: כֹּֽה תֹאמַ֨ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֜ם כֹּה אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֮ חַי אָנִי֒ אִם לֹ֞א אֲשֶׁ֤ר בֶּֽ/חֳרָבוֹת֙ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וַֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה לַ/חַיָּ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖י/ו לְ/אָכְל֑/וֹ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר בַּ/מְּצָד֥וֹת וּ/בַ/מְּעָר֖וֹת בַּ/דֶּ֥בֶר יָמֽוּתוּ
verses.translit: khh t'mr 'lhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh chy 'ny 'm l' 'shr bchrbvt bchrb yplv v'shr 'l pny hshdh lchyh nttyv l'khlv v'shr bmtsdvt vbm'rvt bdbr ymvtv
verses.translation: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּ/מְשַׁמָּ֔ה וְ/נִשְׁבַּ֖ת גְּא֣וֹן עֻזָּ֑/הּ וְ/שָֽׁמְמ֛וּ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אֵ֥ין עוֹבֵֽר
verses.translit: vntty 't h'rts shmmh vmshmh vnshbt g'vn 'zh vshmmv hry yshr'l m'yn 'vbr
verses.translation: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/תִתִּ֤/י אֶת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּ/מְשַׁמָּ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל תּוֹעֲבֹתָ֖/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh btty 't h'rts shmmh vmshmh 'l khl tv'btm 'shr 'shv
verses.translation: Then shall they know that I am the LORD , when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם בְּנֵ֣י עַמְּ/ךָ֗ הַ/נִּדְבָּרִ֤ים בְּ/ךָ֙ אֵ֣צֶל הַ/קִּיר֔וֹת וּ/בְ/פִתְחֵ֖י הַ/בָּתִּ֑ים וְ/דִבֶּר חַ֣ד אֶת אַחַ֗ד אִ֤ישׁ אֶת אָחִי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בֹּֽאוּ נָ֣א וְ/שִׁמְע֔וּ מָ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר הַ/יּוֹצֵ֖א מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm bny 'mkh hndbrym bkh 'tsl hqyrvt vbptchy hbtym vdbr chd 't 'chd 'ysh 't 'chyv l'mr b'v n' vshm'v mh hdbr hyvts' m't yhvh
verses.translation: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/יָב֣וֹאוּ אֵ֠לֶי/ךָ כִּ/מְבוֹא עָ֞ם וְ/יֵשְׁב֤וּ לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ עַמִּ֔/י וְ/שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת דְּבָרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אוֹתָ֖/ם לֹ֣א יַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ כִּֽי עֲגָבִ֤ים בְּ/פִי/הֶם֙ הֵ֣מָּה עֹשִׂ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֥י בִצְעָ֖/ם לִבָּ֥/ם הֹלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vybv'v 'lykh khmbv' 'm vyshbv lpnykh 'my vshm'v 't dbrykh v'vtm l' y'shv khy 'gbym bpyhm hmh 'shym 'chry bts'm lbm hlkh
verses.translation: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.

verses.original: וְ/הִנְּ/ךָ֤ לָ/הֶם֙ כְּ/שִׁ֣יר עֲגָבִ֔ים יְפֵ֥ה ק֖וֹל וּ/מֵטִ֣ב נַגֵּ֑ן וְ/שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת דְּבָרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/עֹשִׂ֥ים אֵינָ֖/ם אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhnkh lhm khshyr 'gbym yph qvl vmtb ngn vshm'v 't dbrykh v'shym 'ynm 'vtm
verses.translation: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/בֹאָ֑/הּ הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֔ה וְ/יָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י נָבִ֖יא הָיָ֥ה בְ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbb'h hnh b'h vyd'v khy nby' hyh btvkhm
verses.translation: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל רוֹעֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנָּבֵ֣א וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֩ אֲלֵי/הֶ֨ם לָ/רֹעִ֜ים כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה ה֤וֹי רֹעֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ רֹעִ֣ים אוֹתָ֔/ם הֲ/ל֣וֹא הַ/צֹּ֔אן יִרְע֖וּ הָ/רֹעִֽים
verses.translit: bn 'dm hnb' 'l rv'y yshr'l hnb' v'mrt 'lyhm lr'ym khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hvy r'y yshr'l 'shr hyv r'ym 'vtm hlv' hts'n yr'v hr'ym
verses.translation: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

verses.original: אֶת הַ/חֵ֤לֶב תֹּאכֵ֨לוּ֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/צֶּ֣מֶר תִּלְבָּ֔שׁוּ הַ/בְּרִיאָ֖ה תִּזְבָּ֑חוּ הַ/צֹּ֖אן לֹ֥א תִרְעֽוּ
verses.translit: 't hchlb t'khlv v't htsmr tlbshv hbry'h tzbchv hts'n l' tr'v
verses.translation: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.

verses.original: אֶֽת הַ/נַּחְלוֹת֩ לֹ֨א חִזַּקְתֶּ֜ם וְ/אֶת הַ/חוֹלָ֣ה לֹֽא רִפֵּאתֶ֗ם וְ/לַ/נִּשְׁבֶּ֨רֶת֙ לֹ֣א חֲבַשְׁתֶּ֔ם וְ/אֶת הַ/נִּדַּ֨חַת֙ לֹ֣א הֲשֵׁבֹתֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת הָ/אֹבֶ֖דֶת לֹ֣א בִקַּשְׁתֶּ֑ם וּ/בְ/חָזְקָ֛ה רְדִיתֶ֥ם אֹתָ֖/ם וּ/בְ/פָֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: 't hnchlvt l' chzqtm v't hchvlh l' rp'tm vlnshbrt l' chbshtm v't hndcht l' hshbtm v't h'bdt l' bqshtm vbchzqh rdytm 'tm vbprkh
verses.translation: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.

verses.original: וַ/תְּפוּצֶ֖ינָה מִ/בְּלִ֣י רֹעֶ֑ה וַ/תִּהְיֶ֧ינָה לְ/אָכְלָ֛ה לְ/כָל חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה וַ/תְּפוּצֶֽינָה
verses.translit: vtpvtsynh mbly r'h vthyynh l'khlh lkhl chyt hshdh vtpvtsynh
verses.translation: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

verses.original: יִשְׁגּ֤וּ צֹאנִ/י֙ בְּ/כָל הֶ֣/הָרִ֔ים וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל גִּבְעָ֣ה רָמָ֑ה וְ/עַ֨ל כָּל פְּנֵ֤י הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ נָפֹ֣צוּ צֹאנִ֔/י וְ/אֵ֥ין דּוֹרֵ֖שׁ וְ/אֵ֥ין מְבַקֵּֽשׁ
verses.translit: yshgv ts'ny bkhl hhrym v'l khl gb'h rmh v'l khl pny h'rts nptsv ts'ny v'yn dvrsh v'yn mbqsh
verses.translation: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them .

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן רֹעִ֔ים שִׁמְע֖וּ אֶת דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn r'ym shm'v 't dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD ;

verses.original: חַי אָ֜נִי נְאֻ֣ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה אִם לֹ֣א יַ֣עַן הֱיֽוֹת צֹאנִ֣/י לָ/בַ֡ז וַ/תִּֽהְיֶינָה֩ צֹאנִ֨/י לְ/אָכְלָ֜ה לְ/כָל חַיַּ֤ת הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ין רֹעֶ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא דָרְשׁ֥וּ רֹעַ֖/י אֶת צֹאנִ֑/י וַ/יִּרְע֤וּ הָֽ/רֹעִים֙ אוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/אֶת צֹאנִ֖/י לֹ֥א רָעֽוּ
verses.translit: chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm l' y'n hyvt ts'ny lbz vthyynh ts'ny l'khlh lkhl chyt hshdh m'yn r'h vl' drshv r'y 't ts'ny vyr'v hr'ym 'vtm v't ts'ny l' r'v
verses.translation: As I live, saith the Lord GOD , surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ הָֽ/רֹעִ֔ים שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn hr'ym shm'v dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD ;

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְ/נִ֨י אֶֽל הָ/רֹעִ֜ים וְֽ/דָרַשְׁתִּ֧י אֶת צֹאנִ֣/י מִ/יָּדָ֗/ם וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּי/ם֙ מֵ/רְע֣וֹת צֹ֔אן וְ/לֹא יִרְע֥וּ ע֛וֹד הָ/רֹעִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/הִצַּלְתִּ֤י צֹאנִ/י֙ מִ/פִּי/הֶ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא תִהְיֶ֥יןָ לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/אָכְלָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'l hr'ym vdrshty 't ts'ny mydm vhshbtym mr'vt ts'n vl' yr'v 'vd hr'ym 'vtm vhtslty ts'ny mpyhm vl' thyyn lhm l'khlh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְ/נִי אָ֕נִי וְ/דָרַשְׁתִּ֥י אֶת צֹאנִ֖/י וּ/בִקַּרְתִּֽי/ם
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'ny vdrshty 't ts'ny vbqrtym
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

verses.original: כְּ/בַקָּרַת֩ רֹעֶ֨ה עֶדְר֜/וֹ בְּ/יוֹם הֱיוֹת֤/וֹ בְ/תוֹךְ צֹאנ/וֹ֙ נִפְרָשׁ֔וֹת כֵּ֖ן אֲבַקֵּ֣ר אֶת צֹאנִ֑/י וְ/הִצַּלְתִּ֣י אֶתְ/הֶ֗ם מִ/כָּל הַ/מְּקוֹמֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפֹ֣צוּ שָׁ֔ם בְּ/י֥וֹם עָנָ֖ן וַ/עֲרָפֶֽל
verses.translit: khbqrt r'h 'drv byvm hyvtv btvkh ts'nv nprshvt khn 'bqr 't ts'ny vhtslty 'thm mkhl hmqvmt 'shr nptsv shm byvm 'nn v'rpl
verses.translation: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹצֵאתִ֣י/ם מִן הָ/עַמִּ֗ים וְ/קִבַּצְתִּי/ם֙ מִן הָ֣/אֲרָצ֔וֹת וַ/הֲבִיאֹתִ֖י/ם אֶל אַדְמָתָ֑/ם וּ/רְעִיתִי/ם֙ אֶל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ/אֲפִיקִ֕ים וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhvts'tym mn h'mym vqbtstym mn h'rtsvt vhby'tym 'l 'dmtm vr'ytym 'l hry yshr'l b'pyqym vbkhl mvshby h'rts
verses.translation: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

verses.original: בְּ/מִרְעֶה טּוֹב֙ אֶרְעֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔/ם וּ/בְ/הָרֵ֥י מְרֽוֹם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶ֣ה נְוֵ/הֶ֑ם שָׁ֤ם תִּרְבַּ֨צְנָה֙ בְּ/נָ֣וֶה טּ֔וֹב וּ/מִרְעֶ֥ה שָׁמֵ֛ן תִּרְעֶ֖ינָה אֶל הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bmr'h tvb 'r'h 'tm vbhry mrvm yshr'l yhyh nvhm shm trbtsnh bnvh tvb vmr'h shmn tr'ynh 'l hry yshr'l
verses.translation: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

verses.original: אֲנִ֨י אֶרְעֶ֤ה צֹאנִ/י֙ וַ/אֲנִ֣י אַרְבִּיצֵ֔/ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: 'ny 'r'h ts'ny v'ny 'rbytsm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: אֶת הָ/אֹבֶ֤דֶת אֲבַקֵּשׁ֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/נִּדַּ֣חַת אָשִׁ֔יב וְ/לַ/נִּשְׁבֶּ֣רֶת אֶחֱבֹ֔שׁ וְ/אֶת הַ/חוֹלָ֖ה אֲחַזֵּ֑ק וְ/אֶת הַ/שְּׁמֵנָ֧ה וְ/אֶת הַ/חֲזָקָ֛ה אַשְׁמִ֖יד אֶרְעֶ֥/נָּה בְ/מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: 't h'bdt 'bqsh v't hndcht 'shyb vlnshbrt 'chbsh v't hchvlh 'chzq v't hshmnh v't hchzqh 'shmyd 'r'nh bmshpt
verses.translation: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֵּ֣נָה צֹאנִ֔/י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְ/נִ֤י שֹׁפֵט֙ בֵּֽין שֶׂ֣ה לָ/שֶׂ֔ה לָ/אֵילִ֖ים וְ/לָ/עַתּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: v'tnh ts'ny khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny shpt byn shh lshh l'ylym vl'tvdym
verses.translation: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.

verses.original: הַ/מְעַ֣ט מִ/כֶּ֗ם הַ/מִּרְעֶ֤ה הַ/טּוֹב֙ תִּרְע֔וּ וְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ מִרְעֵי/כֶ֔ם תִּרְמְס֖וּ בְּ/רַגְלֵי/כֶ֑ם וּ/מִשְׁקַע מַ֣יִם תִּשְׁתּ֔וּ וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/נּ֣וֹתָרִ֔ים בְּ/רַגְלֵי/כֶ֖ם תִּרְפֹּשֽׂוּ/ן
verses.translit: hm't mkhm hmr'h htvb tr'v vytr mr'ykhm trmsv brglykhm vmshq' mym tshtv v't hnvtrym brglykhm trpshvn
verses.translation: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

verses.original: וְ/צֹאנִ֑/י מִרְמַ֤ס רַגְלֵי/כֶם֙ תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה וּ/מִרְפַּ֥שׂ רַגְלֵי/כֶ֖ם תִּשְׁתֶּֽינָה
verses.translit: vts'ny mrms rglykhm tr'ynh vmrpsh rglykhm tshtynh
verses.translation: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם הִנְ/נִי אָ֕נִי וְ/שָֽׁפַטְתִּי֙ בֵּֽין שֶׂ֣ה בִרְיָ֔ה וּ/בֵ֥ין שֶׂ֖ה רָזָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'lyhm hnny 'ny vshptty byn shh bryh vbyn shh rzh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.

verses.original: יַ֗עַן בְּ/צַ֤ד וּ/בְ/כָתֵף֙ תֶּהְדֹּ֔פוּ וּ/בְ/קַרְנֵי/כֶ֥ם תְּנַגְּח֖וּ כָּל הַ/נַּחְל֑וֹת עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֲפִיצוֹתֶ֛ם אוֹתָ֖/נָה אֶל הַ/חֽוּצָ/ה
verses.translit: y'n btsd vbkhtf thdpv vbqrnykhm tngchv khl hnchlvt 'd 'shr hpytsvtm 'vtnh 'l hchvtsh
verses.translation: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

verses.original: וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י לְ/צֹאנִ֔/י וְ/לֹֽא תִהְיֶ֥ינָה ע֖וֹד לָ/בַ֑ז וְ/שָׁ֣פַטְתִּ֔י בֵּ֥ין שֶׂ֖ה לָ/שֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vhvsh'ty lts'ny vl' thyynh 'vd lbz vshptty byn shh lshh
verses.translation: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֨י עֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם רֹעֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ וְ/רָעָ֣ה אֶתְ/הֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת עַבְדִּ֣/י דָוִ֑יד ה֚וּא יִרְעֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔/ם וְ/הֽוּא יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ן לְ/רֹעֶֽה
verses.translit: vhqmty 'lyhm r'h 'chd vr'h 'thn 't 'bdy dvyd hv' yr'h 'tm vhv' yhyh lhn lr'h
verses.translation: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים וְ/עַבְדִּ֥/י דָוִ֖ד נָשִׂ֣יא בְ/תוֹכָ֑/ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: v'ny yhvh 'hyh lhm l'lhym v'bdy dvd nshy' btvkhm 'ny yhvh dbrty
verses.translation: And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken it .

verses.original: וְ/כָרַתִּ֤י לָ/הֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית שָׁל֔וֹם וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י חַיָּֽה רָעָ֖ה מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/יָשְׁב֤וּ בַ/מִּדְבָּר֙ לָ/בֶ֔טַח וְ/יָשְׁנ֖וּ בַּ/יְּעָרִֽים
verses.translit: vkhrty lhm bryt shlvm vhshbty chyh r'h mn h'rts vyshbv bmdbr lbtch vyshnv by'rym
verses.translation: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י אוֹתָ֛/ם וּ/סְבִיב֥וֹת גִּבְעָתִ֖/י בְּרָכָ֑ה וְ/הוֹרַדְתִּ֤י הַ/גֶּ֨שֶׁם֙ בְּ/עִתּ֔/וֹ גִּשְׁמֵ֥י בְרָכָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vntty 'vtm vsbybvt gb'ty brkhh vhvrdty hgshm b'tv gshmy brkhh yhyv
verses.translation: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַן֩ עֵ֨ץ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֜ה אֶת פִּרְי֗/וֹ וְ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ תִּתֵּ֣ן יְבוּלָ֔/הּ וְ/הָי֥וּ עַל אַדְמָתָ֖/ם לָ/בֶ֑טַח וְֽ/יָדְע֞וּ כִּי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בְּ/שִׁבְרִ/י֙ אֶת מֹט֣וֹת עֻלָּ֔/ם וְ/הִ֨צַּלְתִּ֔י/ם מִ/יַּ֖ד הָ/עֹבְדִ֥ים בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vntn 'ts hshdh 't pryv vh'rts ttn ybvlh vhyv 'l 'dmtm lbtch vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh bshbry 't mtvt 'lm vhtsltym myd h'bdym bhm
verses.translation: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the LORD , when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יִהְי֨וּ ע֥וֹד בַּז֙ לַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/חַיַּ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לֹ֣א תֹאכְלֵ֑/ם וְ/יָשְׁב֥וּ לָ/בֶ֖טַח וְ/אֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד
verses.translit: vl' yhyv 'vd bz lgvym vchyt h'rts l' t'khlm vyshbv lbtch v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֥י לָ/הֶ֛ם מַטָּ֖ע לְ/שֵׁ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא יִהְי֨וּ ע֜וֹד אֲסֻפֵ֤י רָעָב֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/לֹֽא יִשְׂא֥וּ ע֖וֹד כְּלִמַּ֥ת הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vhqmty lhm mt' lshm vl' yhyv 'vd 'spy r'b b'rts vl' ysh'v 'vd khlmt hgvym
verses.translation: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם אִתָּ֑/ם וְ/הֵ֗מָּה עַמִּ/י֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm 'tm vhmh 'my byt yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/אַתֵּ֥ן צֹאנִ֛/י צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖/י אָדָ֣ם אַתֶּ֑ם אֲנִי֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: v'tn ts'ny ts'n mr'yty 'dm 'tm 'ny 'lhykhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ עַל הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֑יר וְ/הִנָּבֵ֖א עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: bn 'dm shym pnykh 'l hr sh'yr vhnb' 'lyv
verses.translation: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֣רְתָּ לּ֗/וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֥י אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ הַר שֵׂעִ֑יר וְ/נָטִ֤יתִי יָדִ/י֙ עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ שְׁמָמָ֥ה וּ/מְשַׁמָּֽה
verses.translit: v'mrt lv khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh hr sh'yr vntyty ydy 'lykh vnttykh shmmh vmshmh
verses.translation: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.

verses.original: עָרֶ֨י/ךָ֙ חָרְבָּ֣ה אָשִׂ֔ים וְ/אַתָּ֖ה שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְ/יָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'rykh chrbh 'shym v'th shmmh thyh vyd't khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: יַ֗עַן הֱי֤וֹת לְ/ךָ֙ אֵיבַ֣ת עוֹלָ֔ם וַ/תַּגֵּ֥ר אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל יְדֵי חָ֑רֶב בְּ/עֵ֣ת אֵידָ֔/ם בְּ/עֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן קֵֽץ
verses.translit: y'n hyvt lkh 'ybt 'vlm vtgr 't bny yshr'l 'l ydy chrb b't 'ydm b't 'vn qts
verses.translation: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן חַי אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה כִּֽי לְ/דָ֥ם אֶעֶשְׂ/ךָ֖ וְ/דָ֣ם יִרְדֲּפֶ֑/ךָ אִם לֹ֥א דָ֛ם שָׂנֵ֖אתָ וְ/דָ֥ם יִרְדֲּפֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lkhn chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh khy ldm ''shkh vdm yrdpkh 'm l' dm shn't vdm yrdpkh
verses.translation: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD , I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.

verses.original: וְ/נָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר לְ/שִֽׁמְמָ֖ה וּ/שְׁמָמָ֑ה וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ עֹבֵ֥ר וָ/שָֽׁב
verses.translit: vntty 't hr sh'yr lshmmh vshmmh vhkhrty mmnv 'br vshb
verses.translation: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.

verses.original: וּ/מִלֵּאתִ֥י אֶת הָרָ֖י/ו חֲלָלָ֑י/ו גִּבְעוֹתֶ֤י/ךָ וְ/גֵאוֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/כָל אֲפִיקֶ֔י/ךָ חַלְלֵי חֶ֖רֶב יִפְּל֥וּ בָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vml'ty 't hryv chllyv gb'vtykh vg'vtykh vkhl 'pyqykh chlly chrb yplv bhm
verses.translation: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

verses.original: שִֽׁמְמ֤וֹת עוֹלָם֙ אֶתֶּנְ/ךָ֔ וְ/עָרֶ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א תישבנה תָשֹׁ֑בְנָה וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shmmvt 'vlm 'tnkh v'rykh l' tyshbnh tshbnh vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: יַ֣עַן אֲ֠מָרְ/ךָ אֶת שְׁנֵ֨י הַ/גּוֹיִ֜ם וְ/אֶת שְׁתֵּ֧י הָ/אֲרָצ֛וֹת לִ֥/י תִהְיֶ֖ינָה וִֽ/ירַשְׁנ֑וּ/הָ וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה שָׁ֥ם הָיָֽה
verses.translit: y'n 'mrkh 't shny hgvym v't shty h'rtsvt ly thyynh vyrshnvh vyhvh shm hyh
verses.translation: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there: was there

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן חַי אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ וְ/עָשִׂ֗יתִי כְּ/אַפְּ/ךָ֙ וּ/כְ/קִנְאָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתָה מִ/שִּׂנְאָתֶ֖י/ךָ בָּ֑/ם וְ/נוֹדַ֥עְתִּי בָ֖/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶשְׁפְּטֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lkhn chy 'ny n'm 'dny yhvh v'shyty kh'pkh vkhqn'tkh 'shr 'shyth mshn'tykh bm vnvd'ty bm kh'shr 'shptkh
verses.translation: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD , I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.

verses.original: וְֽ/יָדַעְתָּ֮ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי אֶת כָּל נָאָֽצוֹתֶ֗י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛רְתָּ עַל הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֣ר שממה שָׁמֵ֑מוּ לָ֥/נוּ נִתְּנ֖וּ לְ/אָכְלָֽה
verses.translit: vyd't khy 'ny yhvh shm'ty 't khl n'tsvtykh 'shr 'mrt 'l hry yshr'l l'mr shmmh shmmv lnv ntnv l'khlh
verses.translation: And thou shalt know that I am the LORD , and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.

verses.original: וַ/תַּגְדִּ֤ילוּ עָלַ/י֙ בְּ/פִי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הַעְתַּרְתֶּ֥ם עָלַ֖/י דִּבְרֵי/כֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: vtgdylv 'ly bpykhm vh'trtm 'ly dbrykhm 'ny shm'ty
verses.translation: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them .

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה כִּ/שְׂמֹ֨חַ֙ כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֖ה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh khshmch khl h'rts shmmh ''shh lkh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

verses.original: כְּ/שִׂמְחָ֨תְ/ךָ֜ לְ/נַחְלַ֧ת בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמֵ֖מָה כֵּ֣ן אֶעֱשֶׂה לָּ֑/ךְ שְׁמָמָ֨ה תִֽהְיֶ֤ה הַר שֵׂעִיר֙ וְ/כָל אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֔/הּ וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khshmchtkh lnchlt byt yshr'l 'l 'shr shmmh khn ''shh lkh shmmh thyh hr sh'yr vkhl 'dvm khlh vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm hnb' 'l hry yshr'l v'mrt hry yshr'l shm'v dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD :

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן אָמַ֧ר הָ/אוֹיֵ֛ב עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם הֶאָ֑ח וּ/בָמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם לְ/מֽוֹרָשָׁ֖ה הָ֥יְתָה לָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'mr h'vyb 'lykhm h'ch vbmvt 'vlm lmvrshh hyth lnv
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֣עַן בְּ/יַ֡עַן שַׁמּוֹת֩ וְ/שָׁאֹ֨ף אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם מִ/סָּבִ֗יב לִֽ/הְיוֹתְ/כֶ֤ם מֽוֹרָשָׁה֙ לִ/שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וַ/תֵּֽעֲל֛וּ עַל שְׂפַ֥ת לָשׁ֖וֹן וְ/דִבַּת עָֽם
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n by'n shmvt vsh'f 'tkhm msbyb lhyvtkhm mvrshh lsh'ryt hgvym vt'lv 'l shpt lshvn vdbt 'm
verses.translation: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְ֠הוִה לֶ/הָרִ֨ים וְ/לַ/גְּבָע֜וֹת לָ/אֲפִיקִ֣ים וְ/לַ/גֵּאָי֗וֹת וְ/לֶ/חֳרָב֤וֹת הַ/שֹּֽׁמְמוֹת֙ וְ/לֶ/עָרִ֣ים הַ/נֶּעֱזָב֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ לְ/בַז֙ וּ/לְ/לַ֔עַג לִ/שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: lkhn hry yshr'l shm'v dbr 'dny yhvh khh 'mr 'dny yhvh lhrym vlgb'vt l'pyqym vlg'yvt vlchrbvt hshmmvt vl'rym hn'zbvt 'shr hyv lbz vll'g lsh'ryt hgvym 'shr msbyb
verses.translation: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD ; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ אִם לֹ֠א בְּ/אֵ֨שׁ קִנְאָתִ֥/י דִבַּ֛רְתִּי עַל שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם וְ/עַל אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֑/א אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנֽוּ אֶת אַרְצִ֣/י לָ֠/הֶם לְ/מ֨וֹרָשָׁ֜ה בְּ/שִׂמְחַ֤ת כָּל לֵבָב֙ בִּ/שְׁאָ֣ט נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַ֥עַן מִגְרָשָׁ֖/הּ לָ/בַֽז
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'm l' b'sh qn'ty dbrty 'l sh'ryt hgvym v'l 'dvm khl' 'shr ntnv 't 'rtsy lhm lmvrshh bshmcht khl lbb bsh't npsh lm'n mgrshh lbz
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֕ן הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֡ לֶ/הָרִ֣ים וְ֠/לַ/גְּבָעוֹת לָ/אֲפִיקִ֨ים וְ/לַ/גֵּאָי֜וֹת כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְ/נִ֨י בְ/קִנְאָתִ֤/י וּ/בַ/חֲמָתִ/י֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי יַ֛עַן כְּלִמַּ֥ת גּוֹיִ֖ם נְשָׂאתֶֽם
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' 'l 'dmt yshr'l v'mrt lhrym vlgb'vt l'pyqym vlg'yvt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny bqn'ty vbchmty dbrty y'n khlmt gvym nsh'tm
verses.translation: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת יָדִ֑/י אִם לֹ֤א הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ/כֶ֣ם מִ/סָּבִ֔יב הֵ֖מָּה כְּלִמָּתָ֥/ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'ny nsh'ty 't ydy 'm l' hgvym 'shr lkhm msbyb hmh khlmtm ysh'v
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֞ם הָרֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַנְפְּ/כֶ֣ם תִּתֵּ֔נוּ וּ/פֶרְיְ/כֶ֥ם תִּשְׂא֖וּ לְ/עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י קֵרְב֖וּ לָ/בֽוֹא
verses.translit: v'tm hry yshr'l 'npkhm ttnv vprykhm tsh'v l'my yshr'l khy qrbv lbv'
verses.translation: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.

verses.original: כִּ֖י הִנְ/נִ֣י אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וּ/פָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נֶעֱבַדְתֶּ֖ם וְ/נִזְרַעְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: khy hnny 'lykhm vpnyty 'lykhm vn'bdtm vnzr'tm
verses.translation: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:

verses.original: וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִ֤י עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ אָדָ֔ם כָּל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּ֑/ה וְ/נֹֽשְׁבוּ֙ הֶֽ/עָרִ֔ים וְ/הֶ/חֳרָב֖וֹת תִּבָּנֶֽינָה
verses.translit: vhrbyty 'lykhm 'dm khl byt yshr'l khlh vnshbv h'rym vhchrbvt tbnynh
verses.translation: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:

verses.original: וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִ֧י עֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם אָדָ֥ם וּ/בְהֵמָ֖ה וְ/רָב֣וּ וּ/פָר֑וּ וְ/הוֹשַׁבְתִּ֨י אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם כְּ/קַדְמֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/הֵטִֽבֹתִי֙ מֵ/רִאשֹׁ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhrbyty 'lykhm 'dm vbhmh vrbv vprv vhvshbty 'tkhm khqdmvtykhm vhtbty mr'shtykhm vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הוֹלַכְתִּי֩ עֲלֵי/כֶ֨ם אָדָ֜ם אֶת עַמִּ֤/י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽ/ירֵשׁ֔וּ/ךָ וְ/הָיִ֥יתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/נַחֲלָ֑ה וְ/לֹא תוֹסִ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְ/שַׁכְּלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhvlkhty 'lykhm 'dm 't 'my yshr'l vyrshvkh vhyyt lhm lnchlh vl' tvsf 'vd lshkhlm
verses.translation: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men .

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן אֹמְרִ֣ים לָ/כֶ֔ם אֹכֶ֥לֶת אָדָ֖ם אתי אָ֑תְּ וּ/מְשַׁכֶּ֥לֶת גוי/ך גּוֹיַ֖יִ/ךְ הָיִֽית
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'mrym lkhm 'khlt 'dm 'ty 't vmshkhlt gvykh gvyykh hyyt
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן אָדָם֙ לֹא תֹ֣אכְלִי ע֔וֹד ו/גוי/ך וְ/גוֹיַ֖יִ/ךְ לֹ֣א תכשלי תְשַׁכְּלִי ע֑וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: lkhn 'dm l' t'khly 'vd vgvykh vgvyykh l' tkhshly tshkhly 'vd n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/לֹא אַשְׁמִ֨יעַ אֵלַ֤יִ/ךְ עוֹד֙ כְּלִמַּ֣ת הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/חֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖ים לֹ֣א תִשְׂאִי ע֑וֹד ו/גוי/ך וְ/גוֹיַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ לֹא תַכְשִׁ֣לִי ע֔וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vl' 'shmy' 'lykh 'vd khlmt hgvym vchrpt 'mym l' tsh'y 'vd vgvykh vgvyykh l' tkhshly 'vd n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים עַל אַדְמָתָ֔/ם וַ/יְטַמְּא֣וּ אוֹתָ֔/הּ בְּ/דַרְכָּ֖/ם וּ/בַ/עֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑/ם כְּ/טֻמְאַת֙ הַ/נִּדָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַרְכָּ֖/ם לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: bn 'dm byt yshr'l yshbym 'l 'dmtm vytm'v 'vth bdrkhm vb'lylvtm khtm't hndh hyth drkhm lpny
verses.translation: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִ/י֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם עַל הַ/דָּ֖ם אֲשֶׁר שָׁפְכ֣וּ עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וּ/בְ/גִלּוּלֵי/הֶ֖ם טִמְּאֽוּ/הָ
verses.translit: v'shpkh chmty 'lyhm 'l hdm 'shr shpkhv 'l h'rts vbglvlyhm tm'vh
verses.translation: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:

verses.original: וָ/אָפִ֤יץ אֹתָ/ם֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וַ/יִּזָּר֖וּ בָּ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת כְּ/דַרְכָּ֥/ם וְ/כַ/עֲלִילוֹתָ֖/ם שְׁפַטְתִּֽי/ם
verses.translit: v'pyts 'tm bgvym vyzrv b'rtsvt khdrkhm vkh'lylvtm shpttym
verses.translation: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּב֗וֹא אֶל הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וַֽ/יְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑/י בֶּ/אֱמֹ֤ר לָ/הֶם֙ עַם יְהוָ֣ה אֵ֔לֶּה וּ/מֵ/אַרְצ֖/וֹ יָצָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vybv' 'l hgvym 'shr b'v shm vychllv 't shm qdshy b'mr lhm 'm yhvh 'lh vm'rtsv yts'v
verses.translation: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the LORD , and are gone forth out of his land.

verses.original: וָ/אֶחְמֹ֖ל עַל שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑/י אֲשֶׁ֤ר חִלְּל֨וּ/הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥אוּ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: v'chml 'l shm qdshy 'shr chllvhv byt yshr'l bgvym 'shr b'v shmh
verses.translation: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר לְ/בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְ/כֶ֛ם אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י אִם לְ/שֵׁם קָדְשִׁ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֔ם בַּ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥אתֶם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr lbyt yshr'l khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l' lm'nkhm 'ny 'shh byt yshr'l khy 'm lshm qdshy 'shr chlltm bgvym 'shr b'tm shm
verses.translation: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name’s sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.

verses.original: וְ/קִדַּשְׁתִּ֞י אֶת שְׁמִ֣/י הַ/גָּד֗וֹל הַֽ/מְחֻלָּל֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֖ם בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם וְ/יָדְע֨וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֜ם כִּי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה בְּ/הִקָּדְשִׁ֥/י בָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vqdshty 't shmy hgdvl hmchll bgvym 'shr chlltm btvkhm vyd'v hgvym khy 'ny yhvh n'm 'dny yhvh bhqdshy bkhm l'ynyhm
verses.translation: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD , saith the Lord GOD , when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מִן הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/קִבַּצְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/כָּל הָ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֶל אַדְמַתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vlqchty 'tkhm mn hgvym vqbtsty 'tkhm mkhl h'rtsvt vhb'ty 'tkhm 'l 'dmtkhm
verses.translation: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.

verses.original: וְ/זָרַקְתִּ֧י עֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם מַ֥יִם טְהוֹרִ֖ים וּ/טְהַרְתֶּ֑ם מִ/כֹּ֧ל טֻמְאוֹתֵי/כֶ֛ם וּ/מִ/כָּל גִּלּ֥וּלֵי/כֶ֖ם אֲטַהֵ֥ר אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vzrqty 'lykhm mym thvrym vthrtm mkhl tm'vtykhm vmkhl glvlykhm 'thr 'tkhm
verses.translation: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י לָ/כֶם֙ לֵ֣ב חָדָ֔שׁ וְ/ר֥וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֑ם וַ/הֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י אֶת לֵ֤ב הָ/אֶ֨בֶן֙ מִ/בְּשַׂרְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vntty lkhm lb chdsh vrvch chdshh 'tn bqrbkhm vhsrty 't lb h'bn mbshrkhm vntty lkhm lb bshr
verses.translation: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת רוּחִ֖/י אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/עָשִׂ֗יתִי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר בְּ/חֻקַּ/י֙ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ וּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֥/י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶֽם
verses.translit: v't rvchy 'tn bqrbkhm v'shyty 't 'shr bchqy tlkhv vmshpty tshmrv v'shytm
verses.translation: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them .

verses.original: וִ/ישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַ/אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם וִ/הְיִ֤יתֶם לִ/י֙ לְ/עָ֔ם וְ/אָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyshbtm b'rts 'shr ntty l'btykhm vhyytm ly l'm v'nkhy 'hyh lkhm l'lhym
verses.translation: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם מִ/כֹּ֖ל טֻמְאֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/קָרָ֤אתִי אֶל הַ/דָּגָן֙ וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֹת֔/וֹ וְ/לֹא אֶתֵּ֥ן עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם רָעָֽב
verses.translit: vhvsh'ty 'tkhm mkhl tm'vtykhm vqr'ty 'l hdgn vhrbyty 'tv vl' 'tn 'lykhm r'b
verses.translation: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.

verses.original: וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִי֙ אֶת פְּרִ֣י הָ/עֵ֔ץ וּ/תְנוּבַ֖ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א תִקְח֥וּ ע֛וֹד חֶרְפַּ֥ת רָעָ֖ב בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vhrbyty 't pry h'ts vtnvbt hshdh lm'n 'shr l' tqchv 'vd chrpt r'b bgvym
verses.translation: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.

verses.original: וּ/זְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת דַּרְכֵי/כֶ֣ם הָ/רָעִ֔ים וּ/מַעַלְלֵי/כֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא טוֹבִ֑ים וּ/נְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם עַ֚ל עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/עַ֖ל תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vzkhrtm 't drkhykhm hr'ym vm'llykhm 'shr l' tvbym vnqttm bpnykhm 'l 'vntykhm v'l tv'bvtykhm
verses.translation: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

verses.original: לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְ/כֶ֣ם אֲנִֽי עֹשֶׂ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה יִוָּדַ֖ע לָ/כֶ֑ם בּ֧וֹשׁוּ וְ/הִכָּלְמ֛וּ מִ/דַּרְכֵי/כֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: l' lm'nkhm 'ny 'shh n'm 'dny yhvh yvd' lkhm bvshv vhkhlmv mdrkhykhm byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Not for your sakes do I this , saith the Lord GOD , be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה בְּ/יוֹם֙ טַהֲרִ֣/י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם מִ/כֹּ֖ל עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הֽוֹשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים וְ/נִבְנ֖וּ הֶ/חֳרָבֽוֹת
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh byvm thry 'tkhm mkhl 'vnvtykhm vhvshbty 't h'rym vnbnv hchrbvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/נְּשַׁמָּ֖ה תֵּֽעָבֵ֑ד תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיְתָ֣ה שְׁמָמָ֔ה לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל עוֹבֵֽר
verses.translit: vh'rts hnshmh t'bd tcht 'shr hyth shmmh l'yny khl 'vbr
verses.translation: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.

verses.original: וְ/אָמְר֗וּ הָ/אָ֤רֶץ הַלֵּ֨זוּ֙ הַ/נְּשַׁמָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֖ה כְּ/גַן עֵ֑דֶן וְ/הֶ/עָרִ֧ים הֶ/חֳרֵב֛וֹת וְ/הַֽ/נְשַׁמּ֥וֹת וְ/הַ/נֶּהֱרָס֖וֹת בְּצוּר֥וֹת יָשָֽׁבוּ
verses.translit: v'mrv h'rts hlzv hnshmh hyth khgn 'dn vh'rym hchrbvt vhnshmvt vhnhrsvt btsvrvt yshbv
verses.translation: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֣וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽשָּׁאֲרוּ֮ סְבִיבוֹתֵי/כֶם֒ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בָּנִ֨יתִי֙ הַ/נֶּ֣הֱרָס֔וֹת נָטַ֖עְתִּי הַ/נְּשַׁמָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְ/עָשִֽׂיתִי
verses.translit: vyd'v hgvym 'shr ysh'rv sbybvtykhm khy 'ny yhvh bnyty hnhrsvt nt'ty hnshmh 'ny yhvh dbrty v'shyty
verses.translation: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken it , and I will do it .

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה ע֗וֹד זֹ֛את אִדָּרֵ֥שׁ לְ/בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ/הֶ֑ם אַרְבֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֛/ם כַּ/צֹּ֖אן אָדָֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'vd z't 'drsh lbyt yshr'l l'shvt lhm 'rbh 'tm khts'n 'dm
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

verses.original: כְּ/צֹ֣אן קָֽדָשִׁ֗ים כְּ/צֹ֤אן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בְּ/מ֣וֹעֲדֶ֔י/הָ כֵּ֤ן תִּהְיֶ֨ינָה֙ הֶ/עָרִ֣ים הֶ/חֳרֵב֔וֹת מְלֵא֖וֹת צֹ֣אן אָדָ֑ם וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khts'n qdshym khts'n yrvshlm bmv'dyh khn thyynh h'rym hchrbvt ml'vt ts'n 'dm vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: הָיְתָ֣ה עָלַ/י֮ יַד יְהוָה֒ וַ/יּוֹצִאֵ֤/נִי בְ/ר֨וּחַ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יְנִיחֵ֖/נִי בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/בִּקְעָ֑ה וְ/הִ֖יא מְלֵאָ֥ה עֲצָמֽוֹת
verses.translit: hyth 'ly yd yhvh vyvts'ny brvch yhvh vynychny btvkh hbq'h vhy' ml'h 'tsmvt
verses.translation: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD , and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱבִירַ֥/נִי עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה רַבּ֤וֹת מְאֹד֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/בִּקְעָ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה יְבֵשׁ֥וֹת מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vh'byrny 'lyhm sbyb sbyb vhnh rbvt m'd 'l pny hbq'h vhnh ybshvt m'd
verses.translation: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הֲ/תִחְיֶ֖ינָה הָ/עֲצָמ֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וָ/אֹמַ֕ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm htchyynh h'tsmvt h'lh v'mr 'dny yhvh 'th yd't
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD , thou knowest.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל הָ/עֲצָמ֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם הָ/עֲצָמוֹת֙ הַ/יְבֵשׁ֔וֹת שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hnb' 'l h'tsmvt h'lh v'mrt 'lyhm h'tsmvt hybshvt shm'v dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה לָ/עֲצָמ֖וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא בָ/כֶ֛ם ר֖וּחַ וִ/חְיִיתֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l'tsmvt h'lh hnh 'ny mby' bkhm rvch vchyytm
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּי֩ עֲלֵי/כֶ֨ם גִּדִ֜ים וְֽ/הַעֲלֵתִ֧י עֲלֵי/כֶ֣ם בָּשָׂ֗ר וְ/קָרַמְתִּ֤י עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ ע֔וֹר וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י בָ/כֶ֛ם ר֖וּחַ וִ/חְיִיתֶ֑ם וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vntty 'lykhm gdym vh'lty 'lykhm bshr vqrmty 'lykhm 'vr vntty bkhm rvch vchyytm vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/נִבֵּ֖אתִי כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צֻוֵּ֑יתִי וַֽ/יְהִי ק֤וֹל כְּ/הִנָּֽבְאִ/י֙ וְ/הִנֵּה רַ֔עַשׁ וַ/תִּקְרְב֣וּ עֲצָמ֔וֹת עֶ֖צֶם אֶל עַצְמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vnb'ty kh'shr tsvyty vyhy qvl khhnb'y vhnh r'sh vtqrbv 'tsmvt 'tsm 'l 'tsmv
verses.translation: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

verses.original: וְ/רָאִ֜יתִי וְ/הִנֵּֽה עֲלֵי/הֶ֤ם גִּדִים֙ וּ/בָשָׂ֣ר עָלָ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרַ֧ם עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם ע֖וֹר מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/ר֖וּחַ אֵ֥ין בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vr'yty vhnh 'lyhm gdym vbshr 'lh vyqrm 'lyhm 'vr mlm'lh vrvch 'yn bhm
verses.translation: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל הָ/ר֑וּחַ הִנָּבֵ֣א בֶן אָ֠דָם וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֨ אֶל הָ/ר֜וּחַ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה מֵ/אַרְבַּ֤ע רוּחוֹת֙ בֹּ֣אִי הָ/ר֔וּחַ וּ/פְחִ֛י בַּ/הֲרוּגִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/יִֽחְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hnb' 'l hrvch hnb' bn 'dm v'mrt 'l hrvch khh 'mr 'dny yhvh m'rb' rvchvt b'y hrvch vpchy bhrvgym h'lh vychyv
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

verses.original: וְ/הִנַּבֵּ֖אתִי כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑/נִי וַ/תָּבוֹא֩ בָ/הֶ֨ם הָ/ר֜וּחַ וַ/יִּֽחְי֗וּ וַ/יַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ עַל רַגְלֵי/הֶ֔ם חַ֖יִל גָּד֥וֹל מְאֹד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vhnb'ty kh'shr tsvny vtbv' bhm hrvch vychyv vy'mdv 'l rglyhm chyl gdvl m'd m'd
verses.translation: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ אֵלַ/י֒ בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הָ/עֲצָמ֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה כָּל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵ֑מָּה הִנֵּ֣ה אֹמְרִ֗ים יָבְשׁ֧וּ עַצְמוֹתֵ֛י/נוּ וְ/אָבְדָ֥ה תִקְוָתֵ֖/נוּ נִגְזַ֥רְנוּ לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm h'tsmvt h'lh khl byt yshr'l hmh hnh 'mrym ybshv 'tsmvtynv v'bdh tqvtnv ngzrnv lnv
verses.translation: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֩ הִנָּבֵ֨א וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֜ אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת קִבְרֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/הַעֲלֵיתִ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם מִ/קִּבְרוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑/י וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֶל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'ny ptch 't qbrvtykhm vh'lyty 'tkhm mqbrvtykhm 'my vhb'ty 'tkhm 'l 'dmt yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

verses.original: וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/פִתְחִ֣/י אֶת קִבְרֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם וּ/בְ/הַעֲלוֹתִ֥/י אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם מִ/קִּבְרוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh bptchy 't qbrvtykhm vbh'lvty 'tkhm mqbrvtykhm 'my
verses.translation: And ye shall know that I am the LORD , when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י רוּחִ֤/י בָ/כֶם֙ וִ/חְיִיתֶ֔ם וְ/הִנַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם עַל אַדְמַתְ/כֶ֑ם וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֞ם כִּי אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתִי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vntty rvchy bkhm vchyytm vhnchty 'tkhm 'l 'dmtkhm vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh dbrty v'shyty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it , and performed it , saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם קַח לְ/ךָ֙ עֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וּ/כְתֹ֤ב עָלָי/ו֙ לִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חבר/ו חֲבֵרָ֑י/ו וּ/לְקַח֙ עֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וּ/כְת֣וֹב עָלָ֗י/ו לְ/יוֹסֵף֙ עֵ֣ץ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/כָל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חבר/ו חֲבֵרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm qch lkh 'ts 'chd vkhtb 'lyv lyhvdh vlbny yshr'l chbrv chbryv vlqch 'ts 'chd vkhtvb 'lyv lyvsf 'ts 'prym vkhl byt yshr'l chbrv chbryv
verses.translation: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions:

verses.original: וְ/קָרַ֨ב אֹתָ֜/ם אֶחָ֧ד אֶל אֶחָ֛ד לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/עֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֑ד וְ/הָי֥וּ לַ/אֲחָדִ֖ים בְּ/יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vqrb 'tm 'chd 'l 'chd lkh l'ts 'chd vhyv l'chdym bydkh
verses.translation: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.

verses.original: וְ/כַֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ יֹאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ בְּנֵ֥י עַמְּ/ךָ֖ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הֲ/לֽוֹא תַגִּ֥יד לָ֖/נוּ מָה אֵ֥לֶּה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vkh'shr y'mrv 'lykh bny 'mkh l'mr hlv' tgyd lnv mh 'lh lkh
verses.translation: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י לֹקֵ֜חַ אֶת עֵ֤ץ יוֹסֵף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יַד אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חבר/ו חֲבֵרָ֑י/ו וְ/נָתַתִּי֩ אוֹתָ֨/ם עָלָ֜י/ו אֶת עֵ֣ץ יְהוּדָ֗ה וַֽ/עֲשִׂיתִ/ם֙ לְ/עֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וְ/הָי֥וּ אֶחָ֖ד בְּ/יָדִֽ/י
verses.translit: dbr 'lhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'ny lqch 't 'ts yvsf 'shr byd 'prym vshbty yshr'l chbrv chbryv vntty 'vtm 'lyv 't 'ts yhvdh v'shytm l'ts 'chd vhyv 'chd bydy
verses.translation: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֨וּ הָ/עֵצִ֜ים אֲֽשֶׁר תִּכְתֹּ֧ב עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם בְּ/יָדְ/ךָ֖ לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyv h'tsym 'shr tkhtb 'lyhm bydkh l'ynyhm
verses.translation: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.

verses.original: וְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֤י לֹקֵ֨חַ֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/בֵּ֥ין הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽלְכוּ שָׁ֑ם וְ/קִבַּצְתִּ֤י אֹתָ/ם֙ מִ/סָּבִ֔יב וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖/ם אֶל אַדְמָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vdbr 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'ny lqch 't bny yshr'l mbyn hgvym 'shr hlkhv shm vqbtsty 'tm msbyb vhb'ty 'vtm 'l 'dmtm
verses.translation: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֹ֠תָ/ם לְ/ג֨וֹי אֶחָ֤ד בָּ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ בְּ/הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/מֶ֧לֶךְ אֶחָ֛ד יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לְ/כֻלָּ֖/ם לְ/מֶ֑לֶךְ וְ/לֹ֤א יהיה יִֽהְיוּ עוֹד֙ לִ/שְׁנֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם וְ/לֹ֨א יֵחָ֥צוּ ע֛וֹד לִ/שְׁתֵּ֥י מַמְלָכ֖וֹת עֽוֹד
verses.translit: v'shyty 'tm lgvy 'chd b'rts bhry yshr'l vmlkh 'chd yhyh lkhlm lmlkh vl' yhyh yhyv 'vd lshny gvym vl' ychtsv 'vd lshty mmlkhvt 'vd
verses.translation: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֧א יִֽטַמְּא֣וּ ע֗וֹד בְּ/גִלּֽוּלֵי/הֶם֙ וּ/בְ/שִׁקּ֣וּצֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל פִּשְׁעֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֗/ם מִ/כֹּ֤ל מוֹשְׁבֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטְא֣וּ בָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/טִהַרְתִּ֤י אוֹתָ/ם֙ וְ/הָיוּ לִ֣/י לְ/עָ֔ם וַ/אֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vl' ytm'v 'vd bglvlyhm vbshqvtsyhm vbkhl psh'yhm vhvsh'ty 'tm mkhl mvshbtyhm 'shr cht'v bhm vthrty 'vtm vhyv ly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.original: וְ/עַבְדִּ֤/י דָוִד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/רוֹעֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לְ/כֻלָּ֑/ם וּ/בְ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֣/י יֵלֵ֔כוּ וְ/חֻקֹּתַ֥/י יִשְׁמְר֖וּ וְ/עָשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'bdy dvd mlkh 'lyhm vrv'h 'chd yhyh lkhlm vbmshpty ylkhv vchqty yshmrv v'shv 'vtm
verses.translation: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

verses.original: וְ/יָשְׁב֣וּ עַל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַ֨תִּי֙ לְ/עַבְדִּ֣/י לְ/יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָֽשְׁבוּ בָ֖/הּ אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/יָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶ֡י/הָ הֵ֠מָּה וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֞ם וּ/בְנֵ֤י בְנֵי/הֶם֙ עַד עוֹלָ֔ם וְ/דָוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔/י נָשִׂ֥יא לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vyshbv 'l h'rts 'shr ntty l'bdy ly'qb 'shr yshbv bh 'bvtykhm vyshbv 'lyh hmh vbnyhm vbny bnyhm 'd 'vlm vdvd 'bdy nshy' lhm l'vlm
verses.translation: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children’s children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.

verses.original: וְ/כָרַתִּ֤י לָ/הֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית שָׁל֔וֹם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם יִהְיֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֑/ם וּ/נְתַתִּי/ם֙ וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֧י אֶת מִקְדָּשִׁ֛/י בְּ/תוֹכָ֖/ם לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vkhrty lhm bryt shlvm bryt 'vlm yhyh 'vtm vnttym vhrbyty 'vtm vntty 't mqdshy btvkhm l'vlm
verses.translation: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה מִשְׁכָּנִ/י֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הָיִ֥יתִי לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֑ים וְ/הֵ֖מָּה יִֽהְיוּ לִ֥/י לְ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh mshkhny 'lyhm vhyyty lhm l'lhym vhmh yhyv ly l'm
verses.translation: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

verses.original: וְ/יָֽדְעוּ֙ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בִּ/הְי֧וֹת מִקְדָּשִׁ֛/י בְּ/תוֹכָ֖/ם לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vyd'v hgvym khy 'ny yhvh mqdsh 't yshr'l bhyvt mqdshy btvkhm l'vlm
verses.translation: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶל גּוֹג֙ אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/מָּג֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֣שֶׁךְ וְ/תֻבָ֑ל וְ/הִנָּבֵ֖א עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: bn 'dm shym pnykh 'l gvg 'rts hmgvg nshy' r'sh mshkh vtbl vhnb' 'lyv
verses.translation: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

verses.original: וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְ/נִ֤י אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְ/תֻבָֽל
verses.translit: v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh gvg nshy' r'sh mshkh vtbl
verses.translation: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

verses.original: וְ/שׁ֣וֹבַבְתִּ֔י/ךָ וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י חַחִ֖ים בִּ/לְחָיֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הוֹצֵאתִי֩ אוֹתְ/ךָ֨ וְ/אֶת כָּל חֵילֶ֜/ךָ סוּסִ֣ים וּ/פָרָשִׁ֗ים לְבֻשֵׁ֤י מִכְלוֹל֙ כֻּלָּ֔/ם קָהָ֥ל רָב֙ צִנָּ֣ה וּ/מָגֵ֔ן תֹּפְשֵׂ֥י חֲרָב֖וֹת כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshvbbtykh vntty chchym blchyykh vhvts'ty 'vtkh v't khl chylkh svsym vprshym lbshy mkhlvl khlm qhl rb tsnh vmgn tpshy chrbvt khlm
verses.translation: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:

verses.original: פָּרַ֛ס כּ֥וּשׁ וּ/פ֖וּט אִתָּ֑/ם כֻּלָּ֖/ם מָגֵ֥ן וְ/כוֹבָֽע
verses.translit: prs khvsh vpvt 'tm khlm mgn vkhvb'
verses.translation: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:

verses.original: גֹּ֚מֶר וְ/כָל אֲגַפֶּ֔י/הָ בֵּ֚ית תּֽוֹגַרְמָ֔ה יַרְכְּתֵ֥י צָפ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲגַפָּ֑י/ו עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: gmr vkhl 'gpyh byt tvgrmh yrkhty tspvn v't khl 'gpyv 'mym rbym 'tkh
verses.translation: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.

verses.original: הִכֹּן֙ וְ/הָכֵ֣ן לְ/ךָ֔ אַתָּ֕ה וְ/כָל קְהָלֶ֖/ךָ הַ/נִּקְהָלִ֣ים עָלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הָיִ֥יתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/מִשְׁמָֽר
verses.translit: hkhn vhkhn lkh 'th vkhl qhlkh hnqhlym 'lykh vhyyt lhm lmshmr
verses.translation: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

verses.original: מִ/יָּמִ֣ים רַבִּים֮ תִּפָּקֵד֒ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֨ית הַ/שָּׁנִ֜ים תָּב֣וֹא אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ מְשׁוֹבֶ֣בֶת מֵ/חֶ֗רֶב מְקֻבֶּ֨צֶת֙ מֵ/עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים עַ֚ל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר הָי֥וּ לְ/חָרְבָּ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד וְ/הִיא֙ מֵ/עַמִּ֣ים הוּצָ֔אָה וְ/יָשְׁב֥וּ לָ/בֶ֖טַח כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: mymym rbym tpqd b'chryt hshnym tbv' 'l 'rts mshvbbt mchrb mqbtst m'mym rbym 'l hry yshr'l 'shr hyv lchrbh tmyd vhy' m'mym hvts'h vyshbv lbtch khlm
verses.translation: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.

verses.original: וְ/עָלִ֨יתָ֙ כַּ/שֹּׁאָ֣ה תָב֔וֹא כֶּ/עָנָ֛ן לְ/כַסּ֥וֹת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה אַתָּה֙ וְ/כָל אֲגַפֶּ֔י/ךָ וְ/עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אוֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'lyt khsh'h tbv' kh'nn lkhsvt h'rts thyh 'th vkhl 'gpykh v'mym rbym 'vtkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יַעֲל֤וּ דְבָרִים֙ עַל לְבָבֶ֔/ךָ וְ/חָשַׁבְתָּ֖ מַחֲשֶׁ֥בֶת רָעָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vhyh byvm hhv' y'lv dbrym 'l lbbkh vchshbt mchshbt r'h
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ אֶֽעֱלֶה֙ עַל אֶ֣רֶץ פְּרָז֔וֹת אָבוֹא֙ הַ/שֹּׁ֣קְטִ֔ים יֹשְׁבֵ֖י לָ/בֶ֑טַח כֻּלָּ֗/ם יֹֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּ/אֵ֣ין חוֹמָ֔ה וּ/בְרִ֥יחַ וּ/דְלָתַ֖יִם אֵ֥ין לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mrt ''lh 'l 'rts przvt 'bv' hshqtym yshby lbtch khlm yshbym b'yn chvmh vbrych vdltym 'yn lhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

verses.original: לִ/שְׁלֹ֥ל שָׁלָ֖ל וְ/לָ/בֹ֣ז בַּ֑ז לְ/הָשִׁ֨יב יָדְ/ךָ֜ עַל חֳרָב֣וֹת נוֹשָׁבֹ֗ת וְ/אֶל עַם֙ מְאֻסָּ֣ף מִ/גּוֹיִ֔ם עֹשֶׂה֙ מִקְנֶ֣ה וְ/קִנְיָ֔ן יֹשְׁבֵ֖י עַל טַבּ֥וּר הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lshll shll vlbz bz lhshyb ydkh 'l chrbvt nvshbt v'l 'm m'sf mgvym 'shh mqnh vqnyn yshby 'l tbvr h'rts
verses.translation: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.

verses.original: שְׁבָ֡א וּ֠/דְדָן וְ/סֹחֲרֵ֨י תַרְשִׁ֤ישׁ וְ/כָל כְּפִרֶ֨י/הָ֙ יֹאמְר֣וּ לְ/ךָ֔ הֲ/לִ/שְׁלֹ֤ל שָׁלָל֙ אַתָּ֣ה בָ֔א הֲ/לָ/בֹ֥ז בַּ֖ז הִקְהַ֣לְתָּ קְהָלֶ֑/ךָ לָ/שֵׂ֣את כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֗ב לָ/קַ֨חַת֙ מִקְנֶ֣ה וְ/קִנְיָ֔ן לִ/שְׁלֹ֖ל שָׁלָ֥ל גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: shb' vddn vschry trshysh vkhl khpryh y'mrv lkh hlshll shll 'th b' hlbz bz hqhlt qhlkh lsh't khsf vzhb lqcht mqnh vqnyn lshll shll gdvl
verses.translation: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א בֶן אָדָ֔ם וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ לְ/ג֔וֹג כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה הֲ/ל֣וֹא בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא בְּ/שֶׁ֨בֶת עַמִּ֧/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לָ/בֶ֖טַח תֵּדָֽע
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' bn 'dm v'mrt lgvg khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hlv' byvm hhv' bshbt 'my yshr'l lbtch td'
verses.translation: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it ?

verses.original: וּ/בָ֤אתָ מִ/מְּקֽוֹמְ/ךָ֙ מִ/יַּרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֔וֹן אַתָּ֕ה וְ/עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אִתָּ֑/ךְ רֹכְבֵ֤י סוּסִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔/ם קָהָ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל וְ/חַ֥יִל רָֽב
verses.translit: vb't mmqvmkh myrkhty tspvn 'th v'mym rbym 'tkh rkhby svsym khlm qhl gdvl vchyl rb
verses.translation: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:

verses.original: וְ/עָלִ֨יתָ֙ עַל עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֶּֽ/עָנָ֖ן לְ/כַסּ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֨ית הַ/יָּמִ֜ים תִּֽהְיֶ֗ה וַ/הֲבִאוֹתִ֨י/ךָ֙ עַל אַרְצִ֔/י לְמַעַן֩ דַּ֨עַת הַ/גּוֹיִ֜ם אֹתִ֗/י בְּ/הִקָּדְשִׁ֥/י בְ/ךָ֛ לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֖ם גּֽוֹג
verses.translit: v'lyt 'l 'my yshr'l kh'nn lkhsvt h'rts b'chryt hymym thyh vhb'vtykh 'l 'rtsy lm'n d't hgvym 'ty bhqdshy bkh l'ynyhm gvg
verses.translation: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הַֽ/אַתָּה ה֨וּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֜רְתִּי בְּ/יָמִ֣ים קַדְמוֹנִ֗ים בְּ/יַד֙ עֲבָדַ/י֙ נְבִיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַֽ/נִּבְּאִ֛ים בַּ/יָּמִ֥ים הָ/הֵ֖ם שָׁנִ֑ים לְ/הָבִ֥יא אֹתְ/ךָ֖ עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh h'th hv' 'shr dbrty bymym qdmvnym byd 'bdy nby'y yshr'l hnb'ym bymym hhm shnym lhby' 'tkh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them?

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא בְּ/י֨וֹם בּ֥וֹא גוֹג֙ עַל אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה תַּעֲלֶ֥ה חֲמָתִ֖/י בְּ/אַפִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' byvm bv' gvg 'l 'dmt yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh t'lh chmty b'py
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD , that my fury shall come up in my face.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/קִנְאָתִ֥/י בְ/אֵשׁ עֶבְרָתִ֖/י דִּבַּ֑רְתִּי אִם לֹ֣א בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ רַ֣עַשׁ גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vbqn'ty b'sh 'brty dbrty 'm l' byvm hhv' yhyh r'sh gdvl 'l 'dmt yshr'l
verses.translation: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

verses.original: וְ/רָעֲשׁ֣וּ מִ/פָּנַ֡/י דְּגֵ֣י הַ/יָּם֩ וְ/ע֨וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם וְ/חַיַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה וְ/כָל הָ/רֶ֨מֶשׂ֙ הָ/רֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה וְ/כֹל֙ הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה וְ/נֶהֶרְס֣וּ הֶ/הָרִ֗ים וְ/נָֽפְלוּ֙ הַ/מַּדְרֵג֔וֹת וְ/כָל חוֹמָ֖ה לָ/אָ֥רֶץ תִּפּֽוֹל
verses.translit: vr'shv mpny dgy hym v'vf hshmym vchyt hshdh vkhl hrmsh hrmsh 'l h'dmh vkhl h'dm 'shr 'l pny h'dmh vnhrsv hhrym vnplv hmdrgvt vkhl chvmh l'rts tpvl
verses.translation: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

verses.original: וְ/קָרָ֨אתִי עָלָ֤י/ו לְ/כָל הָרַ/י֙ חֶ֔רֶב נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה חֶ֥רֶב אִ֖ישׁ בְּ/אָחִ֥י/ו תִּֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vqr'ty 'lyv lkhl hry chrb n'm 'dny yhvh chrb 'ysh b'chyv thyh
verses.translation: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD : every man’s sword shall be against his brother.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֥י אִתּ֖/וֹ בְּ/דֶ֣בֶר וּ/בְ/דָ֑ם וְ/גֶ֣שֶׁם שׁוֹטֵף֩ וְ/אַבְנֵ֨י אֶלְגָּבִ֜ישׁ אֵ֣שׁ וְ/גָפְרִ֗ית אַמְטִ֤יר עָלָי/ו֙ וְ/עַל אֲגַפָּ֔י/ו וְ/עַל עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vnshptty 'tv bdbr vbdm vgshm shvtf v'bny 'lgbysh 'sh vgpryt 'mtyr 'lyv v'l 'gpyv v'l 'mym rbym 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

verses.original: וְ/הִתְגַּדִּלְתִּי֙ וְ/הִתְקַדִּשְׁתִּ֔י וְ/נ֣וֹדַעְתִּ֔י לְ/עֵינֵ֖י גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhtgdlty vhtqdshty vnvd'ty l'yny gvym rbym vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֤ה בֶן אָדָם֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א עַל גּ֔וֹג וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְ/נִ֤י אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְ/תֻבָֽל
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm hnb' 'l gvg v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh gvg nshy' r'sh mshkh vtbl
verses.translation: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

verses.original: וְ/שֹׁבַבְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/שִׁשֵּׁאתִ֔י/ךָ וְ/הַעֲלִיתִ֖י/ךָ מִ/יַּרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן וַ/הֲבִאוֹתִ֖/ךָ עַל הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vshbbtykh vshsh'tykh vh'lytykh myrkhty tspvn vhb'vtkh 'l hry yshr'l
verses.translation: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:

verses.original: וְ/הִכֵּיתִ֥י קַשְׁתְּ/ךָ֖ מִ/יַּ֣ד שְׂמֹאולֶ֑/ךָ וְ/חִצֶּ֕י/ךָ מִ/יַּ֥ד יְמִינְ/ךָ֖ אַפִּֽיל
verses.translit: vhkhyty qshtkh myd shm'vlkh vchtsykh myd ymynkh 'pyl
verses.translation: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.

verses.original: עַל הָרֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּפּ֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְ/כָל אֲגַפֶּ֔י/ךָ וְ/עַמִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֑/ךְ לְ/עֵ֨יט צִפּ֧וֹר כָּל כָּנָ֛ף וְ/חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה נְתַתִּ֥י/ךָ לְ/אָכְלָֽה
verses.translit: 'l hry yshr'l tpvl 'th vkhl 'gpykh v'mym 'shr 'tkh l'yt tspvr khl khnf vchyt hshdh nttykh l'khlh
verses.translation: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.

verses.original: עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה תִּפּ֑וֹל כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: 'l pny hshdh tpvl khy 'ny dbrty n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it , saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵ֣שׁ בְּ/מָג֔וֹג וּ/בְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/אִיִּ֖ים לָ/בֶ֑טַח וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh bmgvg vbyshby h'yym lbtch vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אֶת שֵׁ֨ם קָדְשִׁ֜/י אוֹדִ֗יעַ בְּ/תוֹךְ֙ עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לֹֽא אַחֵ֥ל אֶת שֵׁם קָדְשִׁ֖/י ע֑וֹד וְ/יָדְע֤וּ הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ כִּי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קָד֖וֹשׁ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v't shm qdshy 'vdy' btvkh 'my yshr'l vl' 'chl 't shm qdshy 'vd vyd'v hgvym khy 'ny yhvh qdvsh byshr'l
verses.translation: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD , the Holy One in Israel.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה בָאָה֙ וְ/נִֽהְיָ֔תָה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה ה֥וּא הַ/יּ֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: hnh b'h vnhyth n'm 'dny yhvh hv' hyvm 'shr dbrty
verses.translation: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord GOD ; this is the day whereof I have spoken.

verses.original: וְֽ/יָצְא֞וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּ/בִעֲר֡וּ וְ֠/הִשִּׂיקוּ בְּ/נֶ֨שֶׁק וּ/מָגֵ֤ן וְ/צִנָּה֙ בְּ/קֶ֣שֶׁת וּ/בְ/חִצִּ֔ים וּ/בְ/מַקֵּ֥ל יָ֖ד וּ/בְ/רֹ֑מַח וּ/בִעֲר֥וּ בָ/הֶ֛ם אֵ֖שׁ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vyts'v yshby 'ry yshr'l vb'rv vhshyqv bnshq vmgn vtsnh bqsht vbchtsym vbmql yd vbrmch vb'rv bhm 'sh shb' shnym
verses.translation: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יִשְׂא֨וּ עֵצִ֜ים מִן הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה וְ/לֹ֤א יַחְטְבוּ֙ מִן הַ/יְּעָרִ֔ים כִּ֥י בַ/נֶּ֖שֶׁק יְבַֽעֲרוּ אֵ֑שׁ וְ/שָׁלְל֣וּ אֶת שֹׁלְלֵי/הֶ֗ם וּ/בָֽזְזוּ֙ אֶת בֹּ֣זְזֵי/הֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vl' ysh'v 'tsym mn hshdh vl' ychtbv mn hy'rym khy bnshq yb'rv 'sh vshllv 't shllyhm vbzzv 't bzzyhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֡וּא אֶתֵּ֣ן לְ/גוֹג֩ מְקֽוֹם שָׁ֨ם קֶ֜בֶר בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גֵּ֤י הָ/עֹֽבְרִים֙ קִדְמַ֣ת הַ/יָּ֔ם וְ/חֹסֶ֥מֶת הִ֖יא אֶת הָ/עֹֽבְרִ֑ים וְ/קָ֣בְרוּ שָׁ֗ם אֶת גּוֹג֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל הֲמוֹנֹ֔/ה וְ/קָ֣רְא֔וּ גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' 'tn lgvg mqvm shm qbr byshr'l gy h'brym qdmt hym vchsmt hy' 't h'brym vqbrv shm 't gvg v't khl hmvnh vqr'v gy' hmvn gvg
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamon-gog.

verses.original: וּ/קְבָרוּ/ם֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמַ֖עַן טַהֵ֣ר אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ שִׁבְעָ֖ה חֳדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vqbrvm byt yshr'l lm'n thr 't h'rts shb'h chdshym
verses.translation: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.

verses.original: וְ/קָֽבְרוּ֙ כָּל עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הָיָ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/שֵׁ֑ם י֚וֹם הִכָּ֣בְדִ֔/י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vqbrv khl 'm h'rts vhyh lhm lshm yvm hkhbdy n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֨י תָמִ֤יד יַבְדִּ֨ילוּ֙ עֹבְרִ֣ים בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ מְקַבְּרִ֣ים אֶת הָ/עֹבְרִ֗ים אֶת הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/טַֽהֲרָ֑/הּ מִ/קְצֵ֥ה שִׁבְעָֽה חֳדָשִׁ֖ים יַחְקֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: v'nshy tmyd ybdylv 'brym b'rts mqbrym 't h'brym 't hnvtrym 'l pny h'rts lthrh mqtsh shb'h chdshym ychqrv
verses.translation: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.

verses.original: וְ/עָבְר֤וּ הָ/עֹֽבְרִים֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/רָאָה֙ עֶ֣צֶם אָדָ֔ם וּ/בָנָ֥ה אֶצְל֖/וֹ צִיּ֑וּן עַ֣ד קָבְר֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ הַֽ/מְקַבְּרִ֔ים אֶל גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג
verses.translit: v'brv h'brym b'rts vr'h 'tsm 'dm vbnh 'tslv tsyvn 'd qbrv 'tv hmqbrym 'l gy' hmvn gvg
verses.translation: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֥ם שֶׁם עִ֛יר הֲמוֹנָ֖ה וְ/טִהֲר֥וּ הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vgm shm 'yr hmvnh vthrv h'rts
verses.translation: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֨ה בֶן אָדָ֜ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה אֱמֹר֩ לְ/צִפּ֨וֹר כָּל כָּנָ֜ף וּ/לְ/כֹ֣ל חַיַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה הִקָּבְצ֤וּ וָ/בֹ֨אוּ֙ הֵאָסְפ֣וּ מִ/סָּבִ֔יב עַל זִבְחִ֗/י אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י זֹבֵ֤חַ לָ/כֶם֙ זֶ֣בַח גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וּ/שְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּֽם
verses.translit: v'th bn 'dm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'mr ltspvr khl khnf vlkhl chyt hshdh hqbtsv vb'v h'spv msbyb 'l zbchy 'shr 'ny zbch lkhm zbch gdvl 'l hry yshr'l v'khltm bshr vshtytm dm
verses.translation: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD ; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.

verses.original: בְּשַׂ֤ר גִּבּוֹרִים֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וְ/דַם נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ תִּשְׁתּ֑וּ אֵילִ֨ים כָּרִ֤ים וְ/עַתּוּדִים֙ פָּרִ֔ים מְרִיאֵ֥י בָשָׁ֖ן כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: bshr gbvrym t'khlv vdm nshy'y h'rts tshtv 'ylym khrym v'tvdym prym mry'y bshn khlm
verses.translation: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

verses.original: וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּם חֵ֣לֶב לְ/שָׂבְעָ֔ה וּ/שְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּ֖ם לְ/שִׁכָּר֑וֹן מִ/זִּבְחִ֖/י אֲשֶׁר זָבַ֥חְתִּי לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'khltm chlb lshb'h vshtytm dm lshkhrvn mzbchy 'shr zbchty lkhm
verses.translation: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

verses.original: וּ/שְׂבַעְתֶּ֤ם עַל שֻׁלְחָנִ/י֙ ס֣וּס וָ/רֶ֔כֶב גִּבּ֖וֹר וְ/כָל אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vshb'tm 'l shlchny svs vrkhb gbvr vkhl 'ysh mlchmh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י אֶת כְּבוֹדִ֖/י בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וְ/רָא֣וּ כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם אֶת מִשְׁפָּטִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְ/אֶת יָדִ֖/י אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֥מְתִּי בָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vntty 't khbvdy bgvym vr'v khl hgvym 't mshpty 'shr 'shyty v't ydy 'shr shmty bhm
verses.translation: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.

verses.original: וְ/יָֽדְעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֑ם מִן הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא וָ/הָֽלְאָה
verses.translit: vyd'v byt yshr'l khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm mn hyvm hhv' vhl'h
verses.translation: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God from that day and forward.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֣וּ הַ֠/גּוֹיִם כִּ֣י בַ/עֲוֺנָ֞/ם גָּל֣וּ בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ בִ֔/י וָ/אַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖/י מֵ/הֶ֑ם וָֽ/אֶתְּנֵ/ם֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד צָרֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ בַ/חֶ֖רֶב כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyd'v hgvym khy b'vnm glv byt yshr'l 'l 'shr m'lv by v'str pny mhm v'tnm byd tsryhm vyplv bchrb khlm
verses.translation: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.

verses.original: כְּ/טֻמְאָתָ֥/ם וּ/כְ/פִשְׁעֵי/הֶ֖ם עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֹתָ֑/ם וָ/אַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖/י מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khtm'tm vkhpsh'yhm 'shyty 'tm v'str pny mhm
verses.translation: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה עַתָּ֗ה אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת שבית שְׁב֣וּת יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/רִֽחַמְתִּ֖י כָּל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/קִנֵּאתִ֖י לְ/שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'th 'shyb 't shbyt shbvt y'qb vrchmty khl byt yshr'l vqn'ty lshm qdshy
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;

verses.original: וְ/נָשׂוּ֙ אֶת כְּלִמָּתָ֔/ם וְ/אֶת כָּל מַעֲלָ֖/ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲלוּ בִ֑/י בְּ/שִׁבְתָּ֧/ם עַל אַדְמָתָ֛/ם לָ/בֶ֖טַח וְ/אֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד
verses.translit: vnshv 't khlmtm v't khl m'lm 'shr m'lv by bshbtm 'l 'dmtm lbtch v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.
