verses.original: בְּ/שׁוֹבְבִ֤/י אוֹתָ/ם֙ מִן הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים וְ/קִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔/ם מֵֽ/אַרְצ֖וֹת אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/נִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי בָ֔/ם לְ/עֵינֵ֖י הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: bshvbby 'vtm mn h'mym vqbtsty 'tm m'rtsvt 'ybyhm vnqdshty bm l'yny hgvym rbym
verses.translation: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם בְּ/הַגְלוֹתִ֤/י אֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/כִנַּסְתִּ֖י/ם עַל אַדְמָתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹֽא אוֹתִ֥יר ע֛וֹד מֵ/הֶ֖ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm bhglvty 'tm 'l hgvym vkhnstym 'l 'dmtm vl' 'vtyr 'vd mhm shm
verses.translation: Then shall they know that I am the LORD their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא אַסְתִּ֥יר ע֛וֹד פָּנַ֖/י מֵ/הֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁפַ֤כְתִּי אֶת רוּחִ/י֙ עַל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vl' 'styr 'vd pny mhm 'shr shpkhty 't rvchy 'l byt yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְ/חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנָ֣ה לְ֠/גָלוּתֵ/נוּ בְּ/רֹ֨אשׁ הַ/שָּׁנָ֜ה בֶּ/עָשׂ֣וֹר לַ/חֹ֗דֶשׁ בְּ/אַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה אַחַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכְּתָ֖ה הָ/עִ֑יר בְּ/עֶ֣צֶם הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה עָלַ/י֙ יַד יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֹתִ֖/י שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: b'shrym vchmsh shnh lglvtnv br'sh hshnh b'shvr lchdsh b'rb' 'shrh shnh 'chr 'shr hkhth h'yr b'tsm hyvm hzh hyth 'ly yd yhvh vyb' 'ty shmh
verses.translation: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and brought me thither.

verses.original: בְּ/מַרְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֔ים הֱבִיאַ֖/נִי אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יְנִיחֵ֗/נִי אֶל הַ֤ר גָּבֹ֨הַּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְ/עָלָ֥י/ו כְּ/מִבְנֵה עִ֖יר מִ/נֶּֽגֶב
verses.translit: bmr'vt 'lhym hby'ny 'l 'rts yshr'l vynychny 'l hr gbh m'd v'lyv khmbnh 'yr mngb
verses.translation: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֨יא אוֹתִ֜/י שָׁ֗מָּ/ה וְ/הִנֵּה אִישׁ֙ מַרְאֵ֨/הוּ֙ כְּ/מַרְאֵ֣ה נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וּ/פְתִיל פִּשְׁתִּ֥ים בְּ/יָד֖/וֹ וּ/קְנֵ֣ה הַ/מִּדָּ֑ה וְ/ה֥וּא עֹמֵ֖ד בַּ/שָּֽׁעַר
verses.translit: vyby' 'vty shmh vhnh 'ysh mr'hv khmr'h nchsht vptyl pshtym bydv vqnh hmdh vhv' 'md bsh'r
verses.translation: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר אֵלַ֜/י הָ/אִ֗ישׁ בֶּן אָדָ֡ם רְאֵ֣ה בְ/עֵינֶי/ךָ֩ וּ/בְ/אָזְנֶ֨י/ךָ שְּׁמָ֜ע וְ/שִׂ֣ים לִבְּ/ךָ֗ לְ/כֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֔/ךְ כִּ֛י לְמַ֥עַן הַרְאוֹתְ/כָ֖ה הֻבָ֣אתָה הֵ֑נָּה הַגֵּ֛ד אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לְ/בֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vydbr 'ly h'ysh bn 'dm r'h b'ynykh vb'znykh shm' vshym lbkh lkhl 'shr 'ny mr'h 'vtkh khy lm'n hr'vtkhh hb'th hnh hgd 't khl 'shr 'th r'h lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה חוֹמָ֛ה מִ/ח֥וּץ לַ/בַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב וּ/בְ/יַ֨ד הָ/אִ֜ישׁ קְנֵ֣ה הַ/מִּדָּ֗ה שֵׁשׁ אַמּ֤וֹת בָּֽ/אַמָּה֙ וָ/טֹ֔פַח וַ/יָּ֜מָד אֶת רֹ֤חַב הַ/בִּנְיָן֙ קָנֶ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד וְ/קוֹמָ֖ה קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vhnh chvmh mchvts lbyt sbyb sbyb vbyd h'ysh qnh hmdh shsh 'mvt b'mh vtpch vymd 't rchb hbnyn qnh 'chd vqvmh qnh 'chd
verses.translation: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

verses.original: וַ/יָּב֗וֹא אֶל שַׁ֨עַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָי/ו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִ֔ימָ/ה וַ/יַּ֖עַל ב/מעלות/ו בְּ/מַֽעֲלוֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֣מָד אֶת סַ֣ף הַ/שַּׁ֗עַר קָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וְ/אֵת֙ סַ֣ף אֶחָ֔ד קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד רֹֽחַב
verses.translit: vybv' 'l sh'r 'shr pnyv drkh hqdymh vy'l bm'lvtv bm'lvtyv vymd 't sf hsh'r qnh 'chd rchb v't sf 'chd qnh 'chd rchb
verses.translation: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/תָּ֗א קָנֶ֨ה אֶחָ֥ד אֹ֨רֶךְ֙ וְ/קָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וּ/בֵ֥ין הַ/תָּאִ֖ים חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְ/סַ֣ף הַ֠/שַּׁעַר מֵ/אֵ֨צֶל אוּלָ֥ם הַ/שַּׁ֛עַר מֵֽ/הַ/בַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vht' qnh 'chd 'rkh vqnh 'chd rchb vbyn ht'ym chmsh 'mvt vsf hsh'r m'tsl 'vlm hsh'r mhbyt qnh 'chd
verses.translation: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֜מָד אֶת אֻלָ֥ם הַ/שַּׁ֛עַר מֵ/הַ/בַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vymd 't 'lm hsh'r mhbyt qnh 'chd
verses.translation: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֜מָד אֶת אֻלָ֤ם הַ/שַּׁ֨עַר֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה אַמּ֔וֹת ו/איל/ו וְ/אֵילָ֖י/ו שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְ/אֻלָ֥ם הַ/שַּׁ֖עַר מֵ/הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vymd 't 'lm hsh'r shmnh 'mvt v'ylv v'ylyv shtym 'mvt v'lm hsh'r mhbyt
verses.translation: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.

verses.original: וְ/תָאֵ֨י הַ/שַּׁ֜עַר דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִ֗ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה מִ/פֹּה֙ וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מִ/פֹּ֔ה מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לִ/שְׁלָשְׁתָּ֑/ם וּ/מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָ/אֵילִ֖ם מִ/פֹּ֥ה וּ/מִ/פּֽוֹ
verses.translit: vt'y hsh'r drkh hqdym shlshh mph vshlshh mph mdh 'cht lshlshtm vmdh 'cht l'ylm mph vmpv
verses.translation: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛מָד אֶת רֹ֥חַב פֶּֽתַח הַ/שַּׁ֖עַר עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֑וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר שְׁל֥וֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה אַמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vymd 't rchb ptch hsh'r 'shr 'mvt 'rkh hsh'r shlvsh 'shrh 'mvt
verses.translation: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.

verses.original: וּ/גְב֞וּל לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/תָּאוֹת֙ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְ/אַמָּה אַחַ֥ת גְּב֖וּל מִ/פֹּ֑ה וְ/הַ/תָּ֕א שֵׁשׁ אַמּ֣וֹת מִ/פּ֔וֹ וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִ/פּֽוֹ
verses.translit: vgbvl lpny ht'vt 'mh 'cht v'mh 'cht gbvl mph vht' shsh 'mvt mpv vshsh 'mvt mpv
verses.translation: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side , and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָד אֶת הַ/שַּׁ֗עַר מִ/גַּ֤ג הַ/תָּא֙ לְ/גַגּ֔/וֹ רֹ֕חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/חָמֵ֖שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת פֶּ֖תַח נֶ֥גֶד פָּֽתַח
verses.translit: vymd 't hsh'r mgg ht' lggv rchb 'shrym vchmsh 'mvt ptch ngd ptch
verses.translation: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת אֵילִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְ/אֶל אֵיל֙ הֶֽ/חָצֵ֔ר הַ/שַּׁ֖עַר סָבִ֥יב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vy'sh 't 'ylym shshym 'mh v'l 'yl hchtsr hsh'r sbyb sbyb
verses.translation: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֗ל פְּנֵי֙ הַ/שַּׁ֣עַר ה/יאתון הָֽ/אִית֔וֹן עַל לִ/פְנֵ֕י אֻלָ֥ם הַ/שַּׁ֖עַר הַ/פְּנִימִ֑י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: v'l pny hsh'r hy'tvn h'ytvn 'l lpny 'lm hsh'r hpnymy chmshym 'mh
verses.translation: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.

verses.original: וְ/חַלֹּנ֣וֹת אֲטֻמ֣וֹת אֶֽל הַ/תָּאִ֡ים וְ/אֶל֩ אֵלֵי/הֵ֨מָה לִ/פְנִ֤ימָה לַ/שַּׁ֨עַר֙ סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֔יב וְ/כֵ֖ן לָ/אֵֽלַמּ֑וֹת וְ/חַלּוֹנ֞וֹת סָבִ֤יב סָבִיב֙ לִ/פְנִ֔ימָה וְ/אֶל אַ֖יִל תִּמֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vchlnvt 'tmvt 'l ht'ym v'l 'lyhmh lpnymh lsh'r sbyb sbyb vkhn l'lmvt vchlvnvt sbyb sbyb lpnymh v'l 'yl tmrym
verses.translation: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִיאֵ֗/נִי אֶל הֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ הַ/חִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה לְשָׁכוֹת֙ וְ/רִֽצְפָ֔ה עָשׂ֥וּי לֶ/חָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים לְשָׁכ֖וֹת אֶל הָ/רִֽצְפָֽה
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'l hchtsr hchytsvnh vhnh lshkhvt vrtsph 'shvy lchtsr sbyb sbyb shlshym lshkhvt 'l hrtsph
verses.translation: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/רִֽצְפָה֙ אֶל כֶּ֣תֶף הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֔ים לְ/עֻמַּ֖ת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֑ים הָ/רִֽצְפָ֖ה הַ/תַּחְתּוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vhrtsph 'l khtf hsh'rym l'mt 'rkh hsh'rym hrtsph htchtvnh
verses.translation: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָד רֹ֡חַב מִ/לִּ/פְנֵי֩ הַ/שַּׁ֨עַר הַ/תַּחְתּ֜וֹנָ/ה לִ/פְנֵ֨י הֶ/חָצֵ֧ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֛י מִ/ח֖וּץ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה הַ/קָּדִ֖ים וְ/הַ/צָּפֽוֹן
verses.translit: vymd rchb mlpny hsh'r htchtvnh lpny hchtsr hpnymy mchvts m'h 'mh hqdym vhtspvn
verses.translation: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שַּׁ֗עַר אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָי/ו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֔וֹן לֶ/חָצֵ֖ר הַ/חִֽיצוֹנָ֑ה מָדַ֥ד אָרְכּ֖/וֹ וְ/רָחְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhsh'r 'shr pnyv drkh htspvn lchtsr hchytsvnh mdd 'rkhv vrchbv
verses.translation: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.

verses.original: ו/תא/ו וְ/תָאָ֗י/ו שְׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה מִ/פּוֹ֙ וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מִ/פּ֔וֹ ו/איל/ו וְ/אֵילָ֤י/ו ו/אלמ/ו וְ/אֵֽלַמָּי/ו֙ הָיָ֔ה כְּ/מִדַּ֖ת הַ/שַּׁ֣עַר הָ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔/וֹ וְ/רֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים בָּ/אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vt'v vt'yv shlvshh mpv vshlshh mpv v'ylv v'ylyv v'lmv v'lmyv hyh khmdt hsh'r hr'shvn chmshym 'mh 'rkhv vrchb chmsh v'shrym b'mh
verses.translation: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

verses.original: ו/חלונ/ו וְ/חַלּוֹנָ֤י/ו ו/אלמ/ו וְ/אֵֽלַמָּי/ו֙ ו/תמר/ו וְ/תִ֣מֹרָ֔י/ו כְּ/מִדַּ֣ת הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖י/ו דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִ֑ים וּ/בְ/מַעֲל֥וֹת שֶׁ֨בַע֙ יַֽעֲלוּ ב֔/וֹ ו/אילמ/ו וְ/אֵֽילַמָּ֖י/ו לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vchlvnv vchlvnyv v'lmv v'lmyv vtmrv vtmryv khmdt hsh'r 'shr pnyv drkh hqdym vbm'lvt shb' y'lv bv v'ylmv v'ylmyv lpnyhm
verses.translation: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁ֨עַר֙ לֶ/חָצֵ֣ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֔י נֶ֣גֶד הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר לַ/צָּפ֖וֹן וְ/לַ/קָּדִ֑ים וַ/יָּ֧מָד מִ/שַּׁ֛עַר אֶל שַׁ֖עַר מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vsh'r lchtsr hpnymy ngd hsh'r ltspvn vlqdym vymd msh'r 'l sh'r m'h 'mh
verses.translation: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹלִכֵ֨/נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/דָּר֔וֹם וְ/הִנֵּה שַׁ֖עַר דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/דָּר֑וֹם וּ/מָדַ֤ד איל/ו אֵילָי/ו֙ ו/אילמ/ו וְ/אֵ֣ילַמָּ֔י/ו כַּ/מִּדּ֖וֹת הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyvlkhny drkh hdrvm vhnh sh'r drkh hdrvm vmdd 'ylv 'ylyv v'ylmv v'ylmyv khmdvt h'lh
verses.translation: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.

verses.original: וְ/חַלּוֹנִ֨ים ל֤/וֹ ו/ל/אילמ/ו וּ/לְ/אֵֽילַמָּי/ו֙ סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֔יב כְּ/הַ/חֲלֹּנ֖וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְ/רֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vchlvnym lv vl'ylmv vl'ylmyv sbyb sbyb khhchlnvt h'lh chmshym 'mh 'rkh vrchb chmsh v'shrym 'mh
verses.translation: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

verses.original: וּ/מַעֲל֤וֹת שִׁבְעָה֙ עלות/ו עֹֽלוֹתָ֔י/ו ו/אלמ/ו וְ/אֵֽלַמָּ֖י/ו לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/תִמֹרִ֣ים ל֗/וֹ אֶחָ֥ד מִ/פּ֛וֹ וְ/אֶחָ֥ד מִ/פּ֖וֹ אֶל איל/ו אֵילָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vm'lvt shb'h 'lvtv 'lvtyv v'lmv v'lmyv lpnyhm vtmrym lv 'chd mpv v'chd mpv 'l 'ylv 'ylyv
verses.translation: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁ֛עַר לֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/דָּר֑וֹם וַ/יָּ֨מָד מִ/שַּׁ֧עַר אֶל הַ/שַּׁ֛עַר דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/דָּר֖וֹם מֵאָ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vsh'r lchtsr hpnymy drkh hdrvm vymd msh'r 'l hsh'r drkh hdrvm m'h 'mvt
verses.translation: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִיאֵ֛/נִי אֶל חָצֵ֥ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֖י בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר הַ/דָּר֑וֹם וַ/יָּ֨מָד֙ אֶת הַ/שַּׁ֣עַר הַ/דָּר֔וֹם כַּ/מִּדּ֖וֹת הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'l chtsr hpnymy bsh'r hdrvm vymd 't hsh'r hdrvm khmdvt h'lh
verses.translation: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

verses.original: ו/תא/ו וְ/תָאָ֞י/ו ו/איל/ו וְ/אֵילָ֤י/ו ו/אלמ/ו וְ/אֵֽלַמָּי/ו֙ כַּ/מִּדּ֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וְ/חַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֛/וֹ ו/ל/אלמ/ו וּ/לְ/אֵלַמָּ֖י/ו סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְ/רֹ֕חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/חָמֵ֖שׁ אַמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vt'v vt'yv v'ylv v'ylyv v'lmv v'lmyv khmdvt h'lh vchlvnvt lv vl'lmv vl'lmyv sbyb sbyb chmshym 'mh 'rkh vrchb 'shrym vchmsh 'mvt
verses.translation: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

verses.original: וְ/אֵֽלַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב אֹ֗רֶךְ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אַמָּ֔ה וְ/רֹ֖חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'lmvt sbyb sbyb 'rkh chmsh v'shrym 'mh vrchb chmsh 'mvt
verses.translation: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

verses.original: וְ/אֵלַמָּ֗/ו אֶל חָצֵר֙ הַ/חִ֣צוֹנָ֔ה וְ/תִמֹרִ֖ים אֶל איל/ו אֵילָ֑י/ו וּ/מַעֲל֥וֹת שְׁמוֹנֶ֖ה מעל/ו מַעֲלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'lmv 'l chtsr hchtsvnh vtmrym 'l 'ylv 'ylyv vm'lvt shmvnh m'lv m'lyv
verses.translation: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִיאֵ֛/נִי אֶל הֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִ֑ים וַ/יָּ֣מָד אֶת הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר כַּ/מִּדּ֖וֹת הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'l hchtsr hpnymy drkh hqdym vymd 't hsh'r khmdvt h'lh
verses.translation: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.

verses.original: ו/תא/ו וְ/תָאָ֞י/ו ו/אל/ו וְ/אֵלָ֤י/ו ו/אלמ/ו וְ/אֵֽלַמָּי/ו֙ כַּ/מִּדּ֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וְ/חַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֛/וֹ ו/ל/אלמ/ו וּ/לְ/אֵלַמָּ֖י/ו סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְ/רֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vt'v vt'yv v'lv v'lyv v'lmv v'lmyv khmdvt h'lh vchlvnvt lv vl'lmv vl'lmyv sbyb sbyb 'rkh chmshym 'mh vrchb chmsh v'shrym 'mh
verses.translation: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

verses.original: ו/אלמ/ו וְ/אֵלַמָּ֗י/ו לֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ הַ/חִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְ/תִמֹרִ֥ים אֶל אל/ו אֵלָ֖י/ו מִ/פּ֣וֹ וּ/מִ/פּ֑וֹ וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מַעֲל֖וֹת מעל/ו מַעֲלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'lmv v'lmyv lchtsr hchytsvnh vtmrym 'l 'lv 'lyv mpv vmpv vshmnh m'lvt m'lv m'lyv
verses.translation: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִיאֵ֖/נִי אֶל שַׁ֣עַר הַ/צָּפ֑וֹן וּ/מָדַ֖ד כַּ/מִּדּ֥וֹת הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'l sh'r htspvn vmdd khmdvt h'lh
verses.translation: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;

verses.original: תא/ו תָּאָי/ו֙ אל/ו אֵלָ֣י/ו ו/אלמ/ו וְ/אֵֽלַמָּ֔י/ו וְ/חַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֖/וֹ סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְ/רֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: t'v t'yv 'lv 'lyv v'lmv v'lmyv vchlvnvt lv sbyb sbyb 'rkh chmshym 'mh vrchb chmsh v'shrym 'mh
verses.translation: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

verses.original: ו/איל/ו וְ/אֵילָ֗י/ו לֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ הַ/חִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְ/תִמֹרִ֥ים אֶל איל/ו אֵילָ֖י/ו מִ/פּ֣וֹ וּ/מִ/פּ֑וֹ וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מַעֲל֖וֹת מעל/ו מַעֲלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'ylv v'ylyv lchtsr hchytsvnh vtmrym 'l 'ylv 'ylyv mpv vmpv vshmnh m'lvt m'lv m'lyv
verses.translation: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

verses.original: וְ/לִשְׁכָּ֣ה וּ/פִתְחָ֔/הּ בְּ/אֵילִ֖ים הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֑ים שָׁ֖ם יָדִ֥יחוּ אֶת הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vlshkhh vptchh b'ylym hsh'rym shm ydychv 't h'lh
verses.translation: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/אֻלָ֣ם הַ/שַּׁ֗עַר שְׁנַ֤יִם שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֙ מִ/פּ֔וֹ וּ/שְׁנַ֥יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת מִ/פֹּ֑ה לִ/שְׁח֤וֹט אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ הָ/עוֹלָ֔ה וְ/הַ/חַטָּ֖את וְ/הָ/אָשָֽׁם
verses.translit: vb'lm hsh'r shnym shlchnvt mpv vshnym shlchnvt mph lshchvt 'lyhm h'vlh vhcht't vh'shm
verses.translation: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל הַ/כָּתֵ֣ף מִ/ח֗וּצָ/ה לָ/עוֹלֶה֙ לְ/פֶ֨תַח֙ הַ/שַּׁ֣עַר הַ/צָּפ֔וֹנָ/ה שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֑וֹת וְ/אֶל הַ/כָּתֵ֣ף הָ/אַחֶ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ לְ/אֻלָ֣ם הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'l hkhtf mchvtsh l'vlh lptch hsh'r htspvnh shnym shlchnvt v'l hkhtf h'chrt 'shr l'lm hsh'r shnym shlchnvt
verses.translation: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.

verses.original: אַרְבָּעָ֨ה שֻׁלְחָנ֜וֹת מִ/פֹּ֗ה וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֧ה שֻׁלְחָנ֛וֹת מִ/פֹּ֖ה לְ/כֶ֣תֶף הַ/שָּׁ֑עַר שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת אֲלֵי/הֶ֥ם יִשְׁחָֽטוּ
verses.translit: 'rb'h shlchnvt mph v'rb'h shlchnvt mph lkhtf hsh'r shmvnh shlchnvt 'lyhm yshchtv
verses.translation: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices .

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעָה֩ שֻׁלְחָנ֨וֹת לָ/עוֹלָ֜ה אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֗ית אֹרֶךְ֩ אַמָּ֨ה אַחַ֤ת וָ/חֵ֨צִי֙ וְ/רֹ֨חַב אַמָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וָ/חֵ֔צִי וְ/גֹ֖בַהּ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם וְ/יַנִּ֤יחוּ אֶת הַ/כֵּלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחֲט֧וּ אֶת הָ/עוֹלָ֛ה בָּ֖/ם וְ/הַ/זָּֽבַח
verses.translit: v'rb'h shlchnvt l'vlh 'bny gzyt 'rkh 'mh 'cht vchtsy vrchb 'mh 'cht vchtsy vgbh 'mh 'cht 'lyhm vynychv 't hkhlym 'shr yshchtv 't h'vlh bm vhzbch
verses.translation: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽ/שְׁפַתַּ֗יִם טֹ֧פַח אֶחָ֛ד מוּכָנִ֥ים בַּ/בַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב וְ/אֶל הַ/שֻּׁלְחָנ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֥ר הַ/קָּרְבָֽן
verses.translit: vhshptym tpch 'chd mvkhnym bbyt sbyb sbyb v'l hshlchnvt bshr hqrbn
verses.translation: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/חוּצָ/ה֩ לַ/שַּׁ֨עַר הַ/פְּנִימִ֜י לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת שָׁרִ֗ים בֶּ/חָצֵ֤ר הַ/פְּנִימִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֗ר אֶל כֶּ֨תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַ/צָּפ֔וֹן וּ/פְנֵי/הֶ֖ם דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/דָּר֑וֹם אֶחָ֗ד אֶל כֶּ֨תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַ/קָּדִ֔ים פְּנֵ֖י דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/צָּפֹֽן
verses.translit: vmchvtsh lsh'r hpnymy lshkhvt shrym bchtsr hpnymy 'shr 'l khtf sh'r htspvn vpnyhm drkh hdrvm 'chd 'l khtf sh'r hqdym pny drkh htspn
verses.translation: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָ֑/י זֹ֣ה הַ/לִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֨י/הָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/דָּר֔וֹם לַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vydbr 'ly zh hlshkhh 'shr pnyh drkh hdrvm lkhhnym shmry mshmrt hbyt
verses.translation: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֨י/הָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֔וֹן לַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ הֵ֣מָּה בְנֵֽי צָד֗וֹק הַ/קְּרֵבִ֧ים מִ/בְּנֵֽי לֵוִ֛י אֶל יְהוָ֖ה לְ/שָׁרְתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhlshkhh 'shr pnyh drkh htspvn lkhhnym shmry mshmrt hmzbch hmh bny tsdvq hqrbym mbny lvy 'l yhvh lshrtv
verses.translation: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨מָד אֶת הֶ/חָצֵ֜ר אֹ֣רֶךְ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֗ה וְ/רֹ֛חַב מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה מְרֻבָּ֑עַת וְ/הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vymd 't hchtsr 'rkh m'h 'mh vrchb m'h 'mh mrb't vhmzbch lpny hbyt
verses.translation: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִאֵ/נִי֮ אֶל אֻלָ֣ם הַ/בַּיִת֒ וַ/יָּ֨מָד֙ אֵ֣ל אֻלָ֔ם חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִ/פֹּ֔ה וְ/חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִ/פֹּ֑ה וְ/רֹ֣חַב הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר שָׁלֹ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִ/פּ֔וֹ וְ/שָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִ/פּֽוֹ
verses.translit: vyb'ny 'l 'lm hbyt vymd 'l 'lm chmsh 'mvt mph vchmsh 'mvt mph vrchb hsh'r shlsh 'mvt mpv vshlsh 'mvt mpv
verses.translation: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הָ/אֻלָ֞ם עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְ/רֹ֨חַב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה וּ/בַֽ/מַּעֲל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲל֖וּ אֵלָ֑י/ו וְ/עַמֻּדִים֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֵילִ֔ים אֶחָ֥ד מִ/פֹּ֖ה וְ/אֶחָ֥ד מִ/פֹּֽה
verses.translit: 'rkh h'lm 'shrym 'mh vrchb 'shty 'shrh 'mh vbm'lvt 'shr y'lv 'lyv v'mdym 'l h'ylym 'chd mph v'chd mph
verses.translation: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִיאֵ֖/נִי אֶל הַ/הֵיכָ֑ל וַ/יָּ֣מָד אֶת הָ/אֵילִ֗ים שֵׁשׁ אַמּ֨וֹת רֹ֧חַב מִ/פּ֛וֹ וְ/שֵׁשׁ אַמּֽוֹת רֹ֥חַב מִ/פּ֖וֹ רֹ֥חַב הָ/אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'l hhykhl vymd 't h'ylym shsh 'mvt rchb mpv vshsh 'mvt rchb mpv rchb h'hl
verses.translation: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/רֹ֣חַב הַ/פֶּתַח֮ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּוֹת֒ וְ/כִתְפ֣וֹת הַ/פֶּ֔תַח חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִ/פּ֔וֹ וְ/חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִ/פּ֑וֹ וַ/יָּ֤מָד אָרְכּ/וֹ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְ/רֹ֖חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vrchb hptch 'shr 'mvt vkhtpvt hptch chmsh 'mvt mpv vchmsh 'mvt mpv vymd 'rkhv 'rb'ym 'mh vrchb 'shrym 'mh
verses.translation: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֣א לִ/פְנִ֔ימָה וַ/יָּ֥מָד אֵֽיל הַ/פֶּ֖תַח שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְ/הַ/פֶּ֨תַח֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת וְ/רֹ֥חַב הַ/פֶּ֖תַח שֶׁ֥בַע אַמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vb' lpnymh vymd 'yl hptch shtym 'mvt vhptch shsh 'mvt vrchb hptch shb' 'mvt
verses.translation: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨מָד אֶת אָרְכּ֜/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְ/רֹ֛חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה אֶל פְּנֵ֣י הַֽ/הֵיכָ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י זֶ֖ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vymd 't 'rkhv 'shrym 'mh vrchb 'shrym 'mh 'l pny hhykhl vy'mr 'ly zh qdsh hqdshym
verses.translation: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥מָד קִֽיר הַ/בַּ֖יִת שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְ/רֹ֣חַב הַ/צֵּלָע֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אַמּ֜וֹת סָבִ֧יב סָבִ֛יב לַ/בַּ֖יִת סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vymd qyr hbyt shsh 'mvt vrchb htsl' 'rb' 'mvt sbyb sbyb lbyt sbyb
verses.translation: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/צְּלָעוֹת֩ צֵלָ֨ע אֶל צֵלָ֜ע שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים פְּעָמִ֗ים וּ֠/בָאוֹת בַּ/קִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר לַ/בַּ֧יִת לַ/צְּלָע֛וֹת סָבִ֥יב סָבִ֖יב לִ/הְי֣וֹת אֲחוּזִ֑ים וְ/לֹֽא יִהְי֥וּ אֲחוּזִ֖ים בְּ/קִ֥יר הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vhtsl'vt tsl' 'l tsl' shlvsh vshlshym p'mym vb'vt bqyr 'shr lbyt ltsl'vt sbyb sbyb lhyvt 'chvzym vl' yhyv 'chvzym bqyr hbyt
verses.translation: And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.

verses.original: וְֽ/רָחֲבָ֡ה וְֽ/נָסְבָה֩ לְ/מַ֨עְלָ/ה לְ/מַ֜עְלָ/ה לַ/צְּלָע֗וֹת כִּ֣י מֽוּסַב הַ֠/בַּיִת לְ/מַ֨עְלָ/ה לְ/מַ֜עְלָ/ה סָבִ֤יב סָבִיב֙ לַ/בַּ֔יִת עַל כֵּ֥ן רֹֽחַב לַ/בַּ֖יִת לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/כֵ֧ן הַ/תַּחְתּוֹנָ֛ה יַעֲלֶ֥ה עַל הָ/עֶלְיוֹנָ֖ה לַ/תִּיכוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vrchbh vnsbh lm'lh lm'lh ltsl'vt khy mvsb hbyt lm'lh lm'lh sbyb sbyb lbyt 'l khn rchb lbyt lm'lh vkhn htchtvnh y'lh 'l h'lyvnh ltykhvnh
verses.translation: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.

verses.original: וְ/רָאִ֧יתִי לַ/בַּ֛יִת גֹּ֖בַהּ סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב מיסדות מוּסְד֤וֹת הַ/צְּלָעוֹת֙ מְל֣וֹ הַ/קָּנֶ֔ה שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת אַצִּֽילָה
verses.translit: vr'yty lbyt gbh sbyb sbyb mysdvt mvsdvt htsl'vt mlv hqnh shsh 'mvt 'tsylh
verses.translation: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.

verses.original: רֹ֣חַב הַ/קִּ֧יר אֲֽשֶׁר לַ/צֵּלָ֛ע אֶל הַ/ח֖וּץ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר מֻנָּ֔ח בֵּ֥ית צְלָע֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: rchb hqyr 'shr ltsl' 'l hchvts chmsh 'mvt v'shr mnch byt tsl'vt 'shr lbyt
verses.translation: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.

verses.original: וּ/בֵ֨ין הַ/לְּשָׁכ֜וֹת רֹ֣חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֛ה סָבִ֥יב לַ/בַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vbyn hlshkhvt rchb 'shrym 'mh sbyb lbyt sbyb sbyb
verses.translation: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

verses.original: וּ/פֶ֤תַח הַ/צֵּלָע֙ לַ/מֻּנָּ֔ח פֶּ֤תַח אֶחָד֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֔וֹן וּ/פֶ֥תַח אֶחָ֖ד לַ/דָּר֑וֹם וְ/רֹ֨חַב֙ מְק֣וֹם הַ/מֻּנָּ֔ח חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֥יב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vptch htsl' lmnch ptch 'chd drkh htspvn vptch 'chd ldrvm vrchb mqvm hmnch chmsh 'mvt sbyb sbyb
verses.translation: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בִּנְיָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ אֶל פְּנֵ֨י הַ/גִּזְרָ֜ה פְּאַ֣ת דֶּֽרֶךְ הַ/יָּ֗ם רֹ֚חַב שִׁבְעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְ/קִ֧יר הַ/בִּנְיָ֛ן חָֽמֵשׁ אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֖חַב סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב וְ/אָרְכּ֖/וֹ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vhbnyn 'shr 'l pny hgzrh p't drkh hym rchb shb'ym 'mh vqyr hbnyn chmsh 'mvt rchb sbyb sbyb v'rkhv tsh'ym 'mh
verses.translation: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.

verses.original: וּ/מָדַ֣ד אֶת הַ/בַּ֔יִת אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְ/הַ/גִּזְרָ֤ה וְ/הַ/בִּנְיָה֙ וְ/קִ֣ירוֹתֶ֔י/הָ אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vmdd 't hbyt 'rkh m'h 'mh vhgzrh vhbnyh vqyrvtyh 'rkh m'h 'mh
verses.translation: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;

verses.original: וְ/רֹחַב֩ פְּנֵ֨י הַ/בַּ֧יִת וְ/הַ/גִּזְרָ֛ה לַ/קָּדִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vrchb pny hbyt vhgzrh lqdym m'h 'mh
verses.translation: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.

verses.original: וּ/מָדַ֣ד אֹֽרֶךְ הַ֠/בִּנְיָן אֶל פְּנֵ֨י הַ/גִּזְרָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל אַחֲרֶ֧י/הָ ו/אתוקי/הא וְ/אַתִּיקֶ֛י/הָא מִ/פּ֥וֹ וּ/מִ/פּ֖וֹ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְ/הַֽ/הֵיכָל֙ הַ/פְּנִימִ֔י וְ/אֻֽלַמֵּ֖י הֶ/חָצֵֽר
verses.translit: vmdd 'rkh hbnyn 'l pny hgzrh 'shr 'l 'chryh v'tvqyh' v'tyqyh' mpv vmpv m'h 'mh vhhykhl hpnymy v'lmy hchtsr
verses.translation: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;

verses.original: הַ/סִּפִּ֡ים וְ/הַ/חַלּוֹנִ֣ים הָ֠/אֲטֻמוֹת וְ/הָ/אַתִּיקִ֤ים סָבִיב֙ לִ/שְׁלָשְׁתָּ֔/ם נֶ֧גֶד הַ/סַּ֛ף שְׂחִ֥יף עֵ֖ץ סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב וְ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ עַד הַֽ/חַלֹּנ֔וֹת וְ/הַֽ/חַלֹּנ֖וֹת מְכֻסּֽוֹת
verses.translit: hspym vhchlvnym h'tmvt vh'tyqym sbyb lshlshtm ngd hsf shchyf 'ts sbyb sbyb vh'rts 'd hchlnvt vhchlnvt mkhsvt
verses.translation: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;

verses.original: עַל מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/פֶּ֡תַח וְ/עַד הַ/בַּיִת֩ הַ/פְּנִימִ֨י וְ/לַ/ח֜וּץ וְ/אֶל כָּל הַ/קִּ֨יר סָבִ֧יב סָבִ֛יב בַּ/פְּנִימִ֥י וּ/בַ/חִיצ֖וֹן מִדּֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'l m'l hptch v'd hbyt hpnymy vlchvts v'l khl hqyr sbyb sbyb bpnymy vbchytsvn mdvt
verses.translation: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.

verses.original: וְ/עָשׂ֥וּי כְּרוּבִ֖ים וְ/תִֽמֹרִ֑ים וְ/תִֽמֹרָה֙ בֵּין כְּר֣וּב לִ/כְר֔וּב וּ/שְׁנַ֥יִם פָּנִ֖ים לַ/כְּרֽוּב
verses.translit: v'shvy khrvbym vtmrym vtmrh byn khrvb lkhrvb vshnym pnym lkhrvb
verses.translation: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;

verses.original: וּ/פְנֵ֨י אָדָ֤ם אֶל הַ/תִּֽמֹרָה֙ מִ/פּ֔וֹ וּ/פְנֵֽי כְפִ֥יר אֶל הַ/תִּֽמֹרָ֖ה מִ/פּ֑וֹ עָשׂ֥וּי אֶל כָּל הַ/בַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vpny 'dm 'l htmrh mpv vpny khpyr 'l htmrh mpv 'shvy 'l khl hbyt sbyb sbyb
verses.translation: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.

verses.original: מֵ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ עַד מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/פֶּ֔תַח הַ/כְּרוּבִ֥ים וְ/הַ/תִּֽמֹרִ֖ים עֲשׂוּיִ֑ם וְ/קִ֖יר הַׄ/הֵׄיׄכָֽׄלׄ
verses.translit: mh'rts 'd m'l hptch hkhrvbym vhtmrym 'shvym vqyr hhykhl
verses.translation: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.

verses.original: הַֽ/הֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּזַ֣ת רְבֻעָ֑ה וּ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ הַ/מַּרְאֶ֖ה כַּ/מַּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: hhykhl mzvzt rb'h vpny hqdsh hmr'h khmr'h
verses.translation: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other .

verses.original: הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֡חַ עֵ֣ץ שָׁלוֹשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת גָּבֹ֜הַּ וְ/אָרְכּ֣/וֹ שְׁתַּֽיִם אַמּ֗וֹת וּ/מִקְצֹֽעוֹתָי/ו֙ ל֔/וֹ וְ/אָרְכּ֥/וֹ וְ/קִֽירֹתָ֖י/ו עֵ֑ץ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלַ֔/י זֶ֚ה הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hmzbch 'ts shlvsh 'mvt gbh v'rkhv shtym 'mvt vmqts'vtyv lv v'rkhv vqyrtyv 'ts vydbr 'ly zh hshlchn 'shr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתַּ֧יִם דְּלָת֛וֹת לַֽ/הֵיכָ֖ל וְ/לַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vshtym dltvt lhykhl vlqdsh
verses.translation: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתַּ֥יִם דְּלָת֖וֹת לַ/דְּלָת֑וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם מוּסַבּ֣וֹת דְּלָת֔וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם לְ/דֶ֣לֶת אֶחָ֔ת וּ/שְׁתֵּ֥י דְלָת֖וֹת לָ/אַחֶֽרֶת
verses.translit: vshtym dltvt ldltvt shtym mvsbvt dltvt shtym ldlt 'cht vshty dltvt l'chrt
verses.translation: And the doors had two leaves apiece , two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door .

verses.original: וַ/עֲשׂוּיָ֨ה אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ן אֶל דַּלְת֤וֹת הַֽ/הֵיכָל֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְ/תִֽמֹרִ֔ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשׂוּיִ֖ם לַ/קִּיר֑וֹת וְ/עָ֥ב עֵ֛ץ אֶל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אוּלָ֖ם מֵ/הַ/חֽוּץ
verses.translit: v'shvyh 'lyhn 'l dltvt hhykhl khrvbym vtmrym kh'shr 'shvym lqyrvt v'b 'ts 'l pny h'vlm mhchvts
verses.translation: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.

verses.original: וְ/חַלּוֹנִ֨ים אֲטֻמ֤וֹת וְ/תִֽמֹרִים֙ מִ/פּ֣וֹ וּ/מִ/פּ֔וֹ אֶל כִּתְפ֖וֹת הָֽ/אוּלָ֑ם וְ/צַלְע֥וֹת הַ/בַּ֖יִת וְ/הָ/עֻבִּֽים
verses.translit: vchlvnym 'tmvt vtmrym mpv vmpv 'l khtpvt h'vlm vtsl'vt hbyt vh'bym
verses.translation: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִאֵ֗/נִי אֶל הֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ הַ/חִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֑וֹן וַ/יְבִאֵ֣/נִי אֶל הַ/לִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נֶ֧גֶד הַ/גִּזְרָ֛ה וַ/אֲשֶֽׁר נֶ֥גֶד הַ/בִּנְיָ֖ן אֶל הַ/צָּפֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyvts'ny 'l hchtsr hchytsvnh hdrkh drkh htspvn vyb'ny 'l hlshkhh 'shr ngd hgzrh v'shr ngd hbnyn 'l htspvn
verses.translation: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.

verses.original: אֶל פְּנֵי אֹ֨רֶךְ֙ אַמּ֣וֹת הַ/מֵּאָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח הַ/צָּפ֑וֹן וְ/הָ/רֹ֖חַב חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'l pny 'rkh 'mvt hm'h ptch htspvn vhrchb chmshym 'mvt
verses.translation: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.

verses.original: נֶ֣גֶד הָֽ/עֶשְׂרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֶ/חָצֵ֣ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֔י וְ/נֶ֣גֶד רִֽצְפָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֶ/חָצֵ֣ר הַ/חִֽיצוֹנָ֑ה אַתִּ֥יק אֶל פְּנֵֽי אַתִּ֖יק בַּ/שְּׁלִשִֽׁים
verses.translit: ngd h'shrym 'shr lchtsr hpnymy vngd rtsph 'shr lchtsr hchytsvnh 'tyq 'l pny 'tyq bshlshym
verses.translation: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories .

verses.original: וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֨י הַ/לְּשָׁכ֜וֹת מַהֲלַךְ֩ עֶ֨שֶׂר אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֨חַב֙ אֶל הַ/פְּנִימִ֔ית דֶּ֖רֶךְ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּ/פִתְחֵי/הֶ֖ם לַ/צָּפֽוֹן
verses.translit: vlpny hlshkhvt mhlkh 'shr 'mvt rchb 'l hpnymyt drkh 'mh 'cht vptchyhm ltspvn
verses.translation: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לְּשָׁכ֥וֹת הָ/עֶלְיוֹנֹ֖ת קְצֻר֑וֹת כִּֽי יוֹכְל֨וּ אַתִּיקִ֜ים מֵ/הֵ֗נָה מֵֽ/הַ/תַּחְתֹּנ֛וֹת וּ/מֵ/הַ/תִּֽכֹנ֖וֹת בִּנְיָֽן
verses.translit: vhlshkhvt h'lyvnt qtsrvt khy yvkhlv 'tyqym mhnh mhtchtnvt vmhtkhnvt bnyn
verses.translation: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְשֻׁלָּשׁוֹת֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְ/אֵ֤ין לָ/הֶן֙ עַמּוּדִ֔ים כְּ/עַמּוּדֵ֖י הַ/חֲצֵר֑וֹת עַל כֵּ֣ן נֶאֱצַ֗ל מֵ/הַ/תַּחְתּוֹנ֛וֹת וּ/מֵ/הַ/תִּֽיכֹנ֖וֹת מֵ/הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy mshlshvt hnh v'yn lhn 'mvdym kh'mvdy hchtsrvt 'l khn n'tsl mhtchtvnvt vmhtykhnvt mh'rts
verses.translation: For they were in three stories , but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

verses.original: וְ/גָדֵ֤ר אֲשֶׁר לַ/חוּץ֙ לְ/עֻמַּ֣ת הַ/לְּשָׁכ֔וֹת דֶּ֛רֶךְ הֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/חִֽצוֹנָ֖ה אֶל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/לְּשָׁכ֑וֹת אָרְכּ֖/וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vgdr 'shr lchvts l'mt hlshkhvt drkh hchtsr hchtsvnh 'l pny hlshkhvt 'rkhv chmshym 'mh
verses.translation: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֹ֣רֶךְ הַ/לְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/חִֽצוֹנָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/הֵיכָ֖ל מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: khy 'rkh hlshkhvt 'shr lchtsr hchtsvnh chmshym 'mh vhnh 'l pny hhykhl m'h 'mh
verses.translation: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.

verses.original: ו/מ/תחת/ה לשכות וּ/מִ/תַּ֖חַת הַ/לְּשָׁכ֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה ה/מבוא הַ/מֵּבִיא֙ מֵֽ/הַ/קָּדִ֔ים בְּ/בֹא֣/וֹ לָ/הֵ֔נָּה מֵֽ/הֶ/חָצֵ֖ר הַ/חִצֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vmtchth lshkhvt vmtcht hlshkhvt h'lh hmbv' hmby' mhqdym bb'v lhnh mhchtsr hchtsnh
verses.translation: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.

verses.original: בְּ/רֹ֣חַב גֶּ֣דֶר הֶ/חָצֵ֗ר דֶּ֧רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִ֛ים אֶל פְּנֵ֧י הַ/גִּזְרָ֛ה וְ/אֶל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/בִּנְיָ֖ן לְשָׁכֽוֹת
verses.translit: brchb gdr hchtsr drkh hqdym 'l pny hgzrh v'l pny hbnyn lshkhvt
verses.translation: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

verses.original: וְ/דֶ֨רֶךְ֙ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם כְּ/מַרְאֵ֣ה הַ/לְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֔וֹן כְּ/אָרְכָּ֖/ן כֵּ֣ן רָחְבָּ֑/ן וְ/כֹל֙ מוֹצָ֣אֵי/הֶ֔ן וּ/כְ/מִשְׁפְּטֵי/הֶ֖ן וּ/כְ/פִתְחֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vdrkh lpnyhm khmr'h hlshkhvt 'shr drkh htspvn kh'rkhn khn rchbn vkhl mvts'yhn vkhmshptyhn vkhptchyhn
verses.translation: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/פִתְחֵ֣י הַ/לְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/דָּר֔וֹם פֶּ֖תַח בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ דָּ֑רֶךְ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בִּ/פְנֵי֙ הַ/גְּדֶ֣רֶת הֲגִינָ֔ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִ֖ים בְּ/בוֹאָֽ/ן
verses.translit: vkhptchy hlshkhvt 'shr drkh hdrvm ptch br'sh drkh drkh bpny hgdrt hgynh drkh hqdym bbv'n
verses.translation: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י לִֽשְׁכ֨וֹת הַ/צָּפ֜וֹן לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַ/דָּרוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/גִּזְרָה֒ הֵ֣נָּה לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַ/קֹּ֗דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֹאכְלוּ שָׁ֧ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר קְרוֹבִ֥ים לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה קָדְשֵׁ֣י הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים שָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֣יחוּ קָדְשֵׁ֣י הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְ/הַ/מִּנְחָה֙ וְ/הַ/חַטָּ֣את וְ/הָ/אָשָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י הַ/מָּק֖וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly lshkhvt htspvn lshkhvt hdrvm 'shr 'l pny hgzrh hnh lshkhvt hqdsh 'shr y'khlv shm hkhhnym 'shr qrvbym lyhvh qdshy hqdshym shm ynychv qdshy hqdshym vhmnchh vhcht't vh'shm khy hmqvm qdsh
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

verses.original: בְּ/בֹאָ֣/ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְ/לֹֽא יֵצְא֤וּ מֵ/הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֶל הֶ/חָצֵ֣ר הַ/חִיצוֹנָ֔ה וְ/שָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֧יחוּ בִגְדֵי/הֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְת֥וּ בָ/הֶ֖ן כִּֽי קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑נָּה ילבשו וְ/לָבְשׁוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְ/קָרְב֖וּ אֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: bb'm hkhhnym vl' yts'v mhqdsh 'l hchtsr hchytsvnh vshm ynychv bgdyhm 'shr yshrtv bhn khy qdsh hnh ylbshv vlbshv bgdym 'chrym vqrbv 'l 'shr l'm
verses.translation: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.

verses.original: וְ/כִלָּ֗ה אֶת מִדּוֹת֙ הַ/בַּ֣יִת הַ/פְּנִימִ֔י וְ/הוֹצִיאַ֨/נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖י/ו דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִ֑ים וּ/מְדָד֖/וֹ סָבִ֥יב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vkhlh 't mdvt hbyt hpnymy vhvtsy'ny drkh hsh'r 'shr pnyv drkh hqdym vmddv sbyb sbyb
verses.translation: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.

verses.original: מָדַ֛ד ר֥וּחַ הַ/קָּדִ֖ים בִּ/קְנֵ֣ה הַ/מִּדָּ֑ה חֲמֵשׁ אמות מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֛ים בִּ/קְנֵ֥ה הַ/מִּדָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: mdd rvch hqdym bqnh hmdh chmsh 'mvt m'vt qnym bqnh hmdh sbyb
verses.translation: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

verses.original: מָדַ֖ד ר֣וּחַ הַ/צָּפ֑וֹן חֲמֵשׁ מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֛ים בִּ/קְנֵ֥ה הַ/מִּדָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: mdd rvch htspvn chmsh m'vt qnym bqnh hmdh sbyb
verses.translation: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

verses.original: אֵ֛ת ר֥וּחַ הַ/דָּר֖וֹם מָדָ֑ד חֲמֵשׁ מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֖ים בִּ/קְנֵ֥ה הַ/מִּדָּֽה
verses.translit: 't rvch hdrvm mdd chmsh m'vt qnym bqnh hmdh
verses.translation: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

verses.original: סָבַ֖ב אֶל ר֣וּחַ הַ/יָּ֑ם מָדַ֛ד חֲמֵשׁ מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֖ים בִּ/קְנֵ֥ה הַ/מִּדָּֽה
verses.translit: sbb 'l rvch hym mdd chmsh m'vt qnym bqnh hmdh
verses.translation: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

verses.original: לְ/אַרְבַּ֨ע רוּח֜וֹת מְדָד֗/וֹ ח֤וֹמָה ל/וֹ֙ סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֔יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְ/רֹ֖חַב חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת לְ/הַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לְ/חֹֽל
verses.translit: l'rb' rvchvt mddv chvmh lv sbyb sbyb 'rkh chmsh m'vt vrchb chmsh m'vt lhbdyl byn hqdsh lchl
verses.translation: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹלִכֵ֖/נִי אֶל הַ/שָּׁ֑עַר שַׁ֕עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פֹּנֶ֖ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִֽים
verses.translit: vyvlkhny 'l hsh'r sh'r 'shr pnh drkh hqdym
verses.translation: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֗ה כְּבוֹד֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ֖א מִ/דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִ֑ים וְ/קוֹל֗/וֹ כְּ/קוֹל֙ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ הֵאִ֥ירָה מִ/כְּבֹדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhnh khbvd 'lhy yshr'l b' mdrkh hqdym vqvlv khqvl mym rbym vh'rts h'yrh mkhbdv
verses.translation: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/מַרְאֵ֨ה הַ/מַּרְאֶ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֗יתִי כַּ/מַּרְאֶ֤ה אֲשֶׁר רָאִ֨יתִי֙ בְּ/בֹאִ/י֙ לְ/שַׁחֵ֣ת אֶת הָ/עִ֔יר וּ/מַרְא֕וֹת כַּ/מַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי אֶל נְהַר כְּבָ֑ר וָ/אֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל פָּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vkhmr'h hmr'h 'shr r'yty khmr'h 'shr r'yty bb'y lshcht 't h'yr vmr'vt khmr'h 'shr r'yty 'l nhr khbr v'pl 'l pny
verses.translation: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

verses.original: וּ/כְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה בָּ֣א אֶל הַ/בָּ֑יִת דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖י/ו דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/קָּדִֽים
verses.translit: vkhbvd yhvh b' 'l hbyt drkh sh'r 'shr pnyv drkh hqdym
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשָּׂאֵ֣/נִי ר֔וּחַ וַ/תְּבִיאֵ֕/נִי אֶל הֶֽ/חָצֵ֖ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֑י וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vtsh'ny rvch vtby'ny 'l hchtsr hpnymy vhnh ml' khbvd yhvh hbyt
verses.translation: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֛ע מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖/י מֵ/הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/אִ֕ישׁ הָיָ֥ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֶצְלִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'shm' mdbr 'ly mhbyt v'ysh hyh 'md 'tsly
verses.translation: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י בֶּן אָדָם֙ אֶת מְק֣וֹם כִּסְאִ֗/י וְ/אֶת מְקוֹם֙ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלַ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֶשְׁכָּן שָׁ֛ם בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/לֹ֣א יְטַמְּא֣וּ ע֣וֹד בֵּֽית יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֞/י הֵ֤מָּה וּ/מַלְכֵי/הֶם֙ בִּ/זְנוּתָ֔/ם וּ/בְ/פִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵי/הֶ֖ם בָּמוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm 't mqvm khs'y v't mqvm khpvt rgly 'shr 'shkhn shm btvkh bny yshr'l l'vlm vl' ytm'v 'vd byt yshr'l shm qdshy hmh vmlkhyhm bznvtm vbpgry mlkhyhm bmvtm
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.

verses.original: בְּ/תִתָּ֨/ם סִפָּ֜/ם אֶת סִפִּ֗/י וּ/מְזֽוּזָתָ/ם֙ אֵ֣צֶל מְזוּזָתִ֔/י וְ/הַ/קִּ֖יר בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵֽינֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/טִמְּא֣וּ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֗/י בְּ/תֽוֹעֲבוֹתָ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֔וּ וָ/אֲכַ֥ל אֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/אַפִּֽ/י
verses.translit: bttm spm 't spy vmzvztm 'tsl mzvzty vhqyr byny vbynyhm vtm'v 't shm qdshy btv'bvtm 'shr 'shv v'khl 'tm b'py
verses.translation: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.

verses.original: עַתָּ֞ה יְרַחֲק֧וּ אֶת זְנוּתָ֛/ם וּ/פִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵי/הֶ֖ם מִמֶּ֑/נִּי וְ/שָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְ/תוֹכָ֖/ם לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: 'th yrchqv 't znvtm vpgry mlkhyhm mmny vshkhnty btvkhm l'vlm
verses.translation: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם הַגֵּ֤ד אֶת בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת הַ/בַּ֔יִת וְ/יִכָּלְמ֖וּ מֵ/עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם וּ/מָדְד֖וּ אֶת תָּכְנִֽית
verses.translit: 'th bn 'dm hgd 't byt yshr'l 't hbyt vykhlmv m'vnvtyhm vmddv 't tkhnyt
verses.translation: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

verses.original: וְ/אִֽם נִכְלְמ֞וּ מִ/כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֗וּ צוּרַ֣ת הַ/בַּ֡יִת וּ/תְכוּנָת֡/וֹ וּ/מוֹצָאָ֡י/ו וּ/מוֹבָאָ֣י/ו וְֽ/כָל צֽוּרֹתָ֡/ו וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל חֻקֹּתָי/ו֩ וְ/כָל צורת/י צ֨וּרֹתָ֤י/ו וְ/כָל תורת/ו תּוֹרֹתָי/ו֙ הוֹדַ֣ע אוֹתָ֔/ם וּ/כְתֹ֖ב לְ/עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/יִשְׁמְר֞וּ אֶת כָּל צוּרָת֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת כָּל חֻקֹּתָ֖י/ו וְ/עָשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'm nkhlmv mkhl 'shr 'shv tsvrt hbyt vtkhvntv vmvts'yv vmvb'yv vkhl tsvrtv v't khl chqtyv vkhl tsvrty tsvrtyv vkhl tvrtv tvrtyv hvd' 'vtm vkhtb l'ynyhm vyshmrv 't khl tsvrtv v't khl chqtyv v'shv 'vtm
verses.translation: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.

verses.original: זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַ/בָּ֑יִת עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ֠/הָר כָּל גְּבֻל֞/וֹ סָבִ֤יב סָבִיב֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֔ים הִנֵּה זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: z't tvrt hbyt 'l r'sh hhr khl gblv sbyb sbyb qdsh qdshym hnh z't tvrt hbyt
verses.translation: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה מִדּ֤וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ בָּֽ/אַמּ֔וֹת אַמָּ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה וָ/טֹ֑פַח וְ/חֵ֨יק הָ/אַמָּ֜ה וְ/אַמָּה רֹ֗חַב וּ/גְבוּלָ֨/הּ אֶל שְׂפָתָ֤/הּ סָבִיב֙ זֶ֣רֶת הָ/אֶחָ֔ד וְ/זֶ֖ה גַּ֥ב הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: v'lh mdvt hmzbch b'mvt 'mh 'mh vtpch vchyq h'mh v'mh rchb vgbvlh 'l shpth sbyb zrt h'chd vzh gb hmzbch
verses.translation: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/חֵ֨יק הָ/אָ֜רֶץ עַד הָ/עֲזָרָ֤ה הַ/תַּחְתּוֹנָה֙ שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֔וֹת וְ/רֹ֖חַב אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּ/מֵ/הֳ/עֲזָרָ֨ה הַ/קְּטַנָּ֜ה עַד הָ/עֲזָרָ֤ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָה֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת וְ/רֹ֖חַב הָ/אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vmchyq h'rts 'd h'zrh htchtvnh shtym 'mvt vrchb 'mh 'cht vmh'zrh hqtnh 'd h'zrh hgdvlh 'rb' 'mvt vrchb h'mh
verses.translation: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽ/הַרְאֵ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֑וֹת וּ/מֵ/הָ/אֲרִאֵ֣יל וּ/לְ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה הַ/קְּרָנ֖וֹת אַרְבַּֽע
verses.translit: vhhr'l 'rb' 'mvt vmh'r'yl vlm'lh hqrnvt 'rb'
verses.translation: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.

verses.original: ו/ה/אראיל וְ/הָ/אֲרִיאֵ֗ל שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ בִּ/שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה רֹ֑חַב רָב֕וּעַ אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥עַת רְבָעָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vh'r'yl vh'ry'l shtym 'shrh 'rkh bshtym 'shrh rchb rbv' 'l 'rb't rb'yv
verses.translation: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עֲזָרָ֞ה אַרְבַּ֧ע עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֹ֗רֶךְ בְּ/אַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ רֹ֔חַב אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣עַת רְבָעֶ֑י/הָ וְ/הַ/גְּבוּל סָבִ֨יב אוֹתָ֜/הּ חֲצִ֣י הָ/אַמָּ֗ה וְ/הַֽ/חֵיק לָ֤/הּ אַמָּה֙ סָבִ֔יב וּ/מַעֲלֹתֵ֖/הוּ פְּנ֥וֹת קָדִֽים
verses.translit: vh'zrh 'rb' 'shrh 'rkh b'rb' 'shrh rchb 'l 'rb't rb'yh vhgbvl sbyb 'vth chtsy h'mh vhchyq lh 'mh sbyb vm'lthv pnvt qdym
verses.translation: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י בֶּן אָדָם֙ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה אֵ֚לֶּה חֻקּ֣וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּ/י֖וֹם הֵעָֽשׂוֹת֑/וֹ לְ/הַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָי/ו֙ עוֹלָ֔ה וְ/לִ/זְרֹ֥ק עָלָ֖י/ו דָּֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn 'dm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'lh chqvt hmzbch byvm h'shvtv lh'lvt 'lyv 'vlh vlzrq 'lyv dm
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD ; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֣ה אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַ/לְוִיִּ֡ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵם֩ מִ/זֶּ֨רַע צָד֜וֹק הַ/קְּרֹבִ֣ים אֵלַ֗/י נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה לְ/שָֽׁרְתֵ֑/נִי פַּ֥ר בֶּן בָּקָ֖ר לְ/חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: vntth 'l hkhhnym hlvym 'shr hm mzr' tsdvq hqrbym 'ly n'm 'dny yhvh lshrtny pr bn bqr lcht't
verses.translation: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD , a young bullock for a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֣ מִ/דָּמ֗/וֹ וְ/נָ֨תַתָּ֜ה עַל אַרְבַּ֤ע קַרְנֹתָי/ו֙ וְ/אֶל אַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הָ/עֲזָרָ֔ה וְ/אֶֽל הַ/גְּב֖וּל סָבִ֑יב וְ/חִטֵּאתָ֥ אוֹת֖/וֹ וְ/כִפַּרְתָּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vlqcht mdmv vntth 'l 'rb' qrntyv v'l 'rb' pnvt h'zrh v'l hgbvl sbyb vcht't 'vtv vkhprthv
verses.translation: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.

verses.original: וְ/לָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הַ/פָּ֣ר הַֽ/חַטָּ֑את וּ/שְׂרָפ/וֹ֙ בְּ/מִפְקַ֣ד הַ/בַּ֔יִת מִ/ח֖וּץ לַ/מִּקְדָּֽשׁ
verses.translit: vlqcht 't hpr hcht't vshrpv bmpqd hbyt mchvts lmqdsh
verses.translation: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י תַּקְרִ֛יב שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים תָּמִ֖ים לְ/חַטָּ֑את וְ/חִטְּאוּ֙ אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר חִטְּא֖וּ בַּ/פָּֽר
verses.translit: vbyvm hshny tqryb sh'yr 'zym tmym lcht't vcht'v 't hmzbch kh'shr cht'v bpr
verses.translation: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.

verses.original: בְּ/כַלּוֹתְ/ךָ֖ מֵֽ/חַטֵּ֑א תַּקְרִיב֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן בָּקָ֣ר תָּמִ֔ים וְ/אַ֥יִל מִן הַ/צֹּ֖אן תָּמִֽים
verses.translit: bkhlvtkh mcht' tqryb pr bn bqr tmym v'yl mn hts'n tmym
verses.translation: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it , thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתָּ֖/ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הִשְׁלִ֨יכוּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֤ים עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ מֶ֔לַח וְ/הֶעֱל֥וּ אוֹתָ֛/ם עֹלָ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqrbtm lpny yhvh vhshlykhv hkhhnym 'lyhm mlch vh'lv 'vtm 'lh lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt offer them before the LORD , and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה שְׂעִיר חַטָּ֖את לַ/יּ֑וֹם וּ/פַ֧ר בֶּן בָּקָ֛ר וְ/אַ֥יִל מִן הַ/צֹּ֖אן תְּמִימִ֥ים יַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: shb't ymym t'shh sh'yr cht't lyvm vpr bn bqr v'yl mn hts'n tmymym y'shv
verses.translation: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יְכַפְּרוּ֙ אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְ/טִֽהֲר֖וּ אֹת֑/וֹ וּ/מִלְא֖וּ יד/ו יָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: shb't ymym ykhprv 't hmzbch vthrv 'tv vml'v ydv ydyv
verses.translation: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

verses.original: וִֽ/יכַלּ֖וּ אֶת הַ/יָּמִ֑ים וְ/הָיָה֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֜י וָ/הָ֗לְאָה יַעֲשׂ֨וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֤ים עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ אֶת עוֹלֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/אֶת שַׁלְמֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/רָצִ֣אתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִֽה
verses.translit: vykhlv 't hymym vhyh byvm hshmyny vhl'h y'shv hkhhnym 'l hmzbch 't 'vlvtykhm v't shlmykhm vrts'ty 'tkhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שֶׁב אֹתִ֗/י דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֤עַר הַ/מִּקְדָּשׁ֙ הַֽ/חִיצ֔וֹן הַ/פֹּנֶ֖ה קָדִ֑ים וְ/ה֖וּא סָגֽוּר
verses.translit: vyshb 'ty drkh sh'r hmqdsh hchytsvn hpnh qdym vhv' sgvr
verses.translation: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜/י יְהוָ֗ה הַ/שַּׁ֣עַר הַ/זֶּה֩ סָג֨וּר יִהְיֶ֜ה לֹ֣א יִפָּתֵ֗חַ וְ/אִישׁ֙ לֹא יָ֣בֹא ב֔/וֹ כִּ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣א ב֑/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֖ה סָגֽוּר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly yhvh hsh'r hzh sgvr yhyh l' yptch v'ysh l' yb' bv khy yhvh 'lhy yshr'l b' bv vhyh sgvr
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD , the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

verses.original: אֶֽת הַ/נָּשִׂ֗יא נָ֥שִׂיא ה֛וּא יֵֽשֶׁב בּ֥/וֹ לֶ/אֱכָול לֶ֖חֶם לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ אֻלָ֤ם הַ/שַּׁ֨עַר֙ יָב֔וֹא וּ/מִ/דַּרְכּ֖/וֹ יֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: 't hnshy' nshy' hv' yshb bv l'khvl lchm lpny yhvh mdrkh 'lm hsh'r ybv' vmdrkhv yts'
verses.translation: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD ; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִיאֵ֜/נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ שַׁ֣עַר הַ/צָּפוֹן֮ אֶל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/בַּיִת֒ וָ/אֵ֕רֶא וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וָ/אֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל פָּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyby'ny drkh sh'r htspvn 'l pny hbyt v'r' vhnh ml' khbvd yhvh 't byt yhvh v'pl 'l pny
verses.translation: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD : and I fell upon my face.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜/י יְהֹוָ֗ה בֶּן אָדָ֡ם שִׂ֣ים לִבְּ/ךָ֩ וּ/רְאֵ֨ה בְ/עֵינֶ֜י/ךָ וּ/בְ/אָזְנֶ֣י/ךָ שְּׁמָ֗ע אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֹתָ֔/ךְ לְ/כָל חֻקּ֥וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה וּ/לְ/כָל תורת/ו תּֽוֹרֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֤ לִבְּ/ךָ֙ לִ/מְב֣וֹא הַ/בַּ֔יִת בְּ/כֹ֖ל מוֹצָאֵ֥י הַ/מִּקְדָּֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly yhvh bn 'dm shym lbkh vr'h b'ynykh vb'znykh shm' 't khl 'shr 'ny mdbr 'tkh lkhl chqvt byt yhvh vlkhl tvrtv tvrtyv vshmt lbkh lmbv' hbyt bkhl mvts'y hmqdsh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD , and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֤ אֶל מֶ֨רִי֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה רַב לָ/כֶ֛ם מִֽ/כָּל תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'mrt 'l mry 'l byt yshr'l khh 'mr 'dny yhvh rb lkhm mkhl tv'bvtykhm byt yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

verses.original: בַּ/הֲבִיאֲ/כֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי נֵכָ֗ר עַרְלֵי לֵב֙ וְ/עַרְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֔ר לִ/הְי֥וֹת בְּ/מִקְדָּשִׁ֖/י לְ/חַלְּל֣/וֹ אֶת בֵּיתִ֑/י בְּ/הַקְרִֽיבְ/כֶ֤ם אֶת לַחְמִ/י֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָ/דָ֔ם וַ/יָּפֵ֨רוּ֙ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֔/י אֶ֖ל כָּל תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: bhby'khm bny nkhr 'rly lb v'rly bshr lhyvt bmqdshy lchllv 't byty bhqrybkhm 't lchmy chlb vdm vyprv 't bryty 'l khl tv'bvtykhm
verses.translation: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת קָדָשָׁ֑/י וַ/תְּשִׂימ֗וּ/ן לְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֧י מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֛/י בְּ/מִקְדָּשִׁ֖/י לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' shmrtm mshmrt qdshy vtshymvn lshmry mshmrty bmqdshy lkhm
verses.translation: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ כָּל בֶּן נֵכָ֗ר עֶ֤רֶל לֵב֙ וְ/עֶ֣רֶל בָּשָׂ֔ר לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל מִקְדָּשִׁ֑/י לְ/כָל בֶּן נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֕ר בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh khl bn nkhr 'rl lb v'rl bshr l' ybv' 'l mqdshy lkhl bn nkhr 'shr btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽחֲקוּ֙ מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י בִּ/תְע֤וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּע֣וּ מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י אַחֲרֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/נָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy 'm hlvym 'shr rchqv m'ly bt'vt yshr'l 'shr t'v m'ly 'chry glvlyhm vnsh'v 'vnm
verses.translation: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֤וּ בְ/מִקְדָּשִׁ/י֙ מְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים פְּקֻדּוֹת֙ אֶל שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֔יִת וּֽ/מְשָׁרְתִ֖ים אֶת הַ/בָּ֑יִת הֵ֠מָּה יִשְׁחֲט֨וּ אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֤ה וְ/אֶת הַ/זֶּ֨בַח֙ לָ/עָ֔ם וְ/הֵ֛מָּה יַעַמְד֥וּ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/שָֽׁרְתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyv bmqdshy mshrtym pqdvt 'l sh'ry hbyt vmshrtym 't hbyt hmh yshchtv 't h'lh v't hzbch l'm vhmh y'mdv lpnyhm lshrtm
verses.translation: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשָׁרְת֤וּ אוֹתָ/ם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י גִלּֽוּלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/מִכְשׁ֣וֹל עָוֺ֑ן עַל כֵּן֩ נָשָׂ֨אתִי יָדִ֜/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וְ/נָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: y'n 'shr yshrtv 'vtm lpny glvlyhm vhyv lbyt yshr'l lmkhshvl 'vn 'l khn nsh'ty ydy 'lyhm n'm 'dny yhvh vnsh'v 'vnm
verses.translation: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord GOD , and they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יִגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלַ/י֙ לְ/כַהֵ֣ן לִ֔/י וְ/לָ/גֶ֨שֶׁת֙ עַל כָּל קָ֣דָשַׁ֔/י אֶל קָדְשֵׁ֖י הַ/קְּדָשִׁ֑ים וְ/נָֽשְׂאוּ֙ כְּלִמָּתָ֔/ם וְ/תוֹעֲבוֹתָ֖/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vl' ygshv 'ly lkhhn ly vlgsht 'l khl qdshy 'l qdshy hqdshym vnsh'v khlmtm vtv'bvtm 'shr 'shv
verses.translation: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔/ם שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַ/בָּ֑יִת לְ/כֹל֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔/וֹ וּ/לְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vntty 'vtm shmry mshmrt hbyt lkhl 'bdtv vlkhl 'shr y'shh bv
verses.translation: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם בְּנֵ֣י צָד֗וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁמְר֜וּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת מִקְדָּשִׁ/י֙ בִּ/תְע֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י הֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֵלַ֖/י לְ/שָֽׁרְתֵ֑/נִי וְ/עָמְד֣וּ לְ/פָנַ֗/י לְ/הַקְרִ֥יב לִ/י֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָ/דָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vhkhhnym hlvym bny tsdvq 'shr shmrv 't mshmrt mqdshy bt'vt bny yshr'l m'ly hmh yqrbv 'ly lshrtny v'mdv lpny lhqryb ly chlb vdm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD :

verses.original: הֵ֜מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל מִקְדָּשִׁ֗/י וְ/הֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֶל שֻׁלְחָנִ֖/י לְ/שָׁרְתֵ֑/נִי וְ/שָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: hmh yb'v 'l mqdshy vhmh yqrbv 'l shlchny lshrtny vshmrv 't mshmrty
verses.translation: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה בְּ/בוֹאָ/ם֙ אֶֽל שַׁעֲרֵי֙ הֶ/חָצֵ֣ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֔ית בִּגְדֵ֥י פִשְׁתִּ֖ים יִלְבָּ֑שׁוּ וְ/לֹֽא יַעֲלֶ֤ה עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ צֶ֔מֶר בְּ/שָֽׁרְתָ֗/ם בְּ/שַׁעֲרֵ֛י הֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֖ית וָ/בָֽיְתָ/ה
verses.translit: vhyh bbv'm 'l sh'ry hchtsr hpnymyt bgdy pshtym ylbshv vl' y'lh 'lyhm tsmr bshrtm bsh'ry hchtsr hpnymyt vbyth
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

verses.original: פַּאֲרֵ֤י פִשְׁתִּים֙ יִהְי֣וּ עַל רֹאשָׁ֔/ם וּ/מִכְנְסֵ֣י פִשְׁתִּ֔ים יִהְי֖וּ עַל מָתְנֵי/הֶ֑ם לֹ֥א יַחְגְּר֖וּ בַּ/יָּֽזַע
verses.translit: p'ry pshtym yhyv 'l r'shm vmkhnsy pshtym yhyv 'l mtnyhm l' ychgrv byz'
verses.translation: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.

verses.original: וּ֠/בְ/צֵאתָ/ם אֶל הֶ/חָצֵ֨ר הַ/חִיצוֹנָ֜ה אֶל הֶ/חָצֵ֣ר הַ/חִיצוֹנָה֮ אֶל הָ/עָם֒ יִפְשְׁט֣וּ אֶת בִּגְדֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר הֵ֨מָּה֙ מְשָׁרְתִ֣ם בָּ֔/ם וְ/הִנִּ֥יחוּ אוֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/לִֽשְׁכֹ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְ/לָֽבְשׁוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְ/לֹֽא יְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם בְּ/בִגְדֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vbts'tm 'l hchtsr hchytsvnh 'l hchtsr hchytsvnh 'l h'm ypshtv 't bgdyhm 'shr hmh mshrtm bm vhnychv 'vtm blshkht hqdsh vlbshv bgdym 'chrym vl' yqdshv 't h'm bbgdyhm
verses.translation: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.

verses.original: וְ/רֹאשָׁ/ם֙ לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֔חוּ וּ/פֶ֖רַע לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑חוּ כָּס֥וֹם יִכְסְמ֖וּ אֶת רָאשֵׁי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vr'shm l' yglchv vpr' l' yshlchv khsvm ykhsmv 't r'shyhm
verses.translation: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.

verses.original: וְ/יַ֥יִן לֹֽא יִשְׁתּ֖וּ כָּל כֹּהֵ֑ן בְּ/בוֹאָ֖/ם אֶל הֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/פְּנִימִֽית
verses.translit: vyyn l' yshtv khl khhn bbv'm 'l hchtsr hpnymyt
verses.translation: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.

verses.original: וְ/אַלְמָנָה֙ וּ/גְרוּשָׁ֔ה לֹֽא יִקְח֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/נָשִׁ֑ים כִּ֣י אִם בְּתוּלֹ֗ת מִ/זֶּ֨רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/הָֽ/אַלְמָנָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה אַלְמָנָ֔ה מִ/כֹּהֵ֖ן יִקָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: v'lmnh vgrvshh l' yqchv lhm lnshym khy 'm btvlt mzr' byt yshr'l vh'lmnh 'shr thyh 'lmnh mkhhn yqchv
verses.translation: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עַמִּ֣/י יוֹר֔וּ בֵּ֥ין קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְ/חֹ֑ל וּ/בֵין טָמֵ֥א לְ/טָה֖וֹר יוֹדִעֻֽ/ם
verses.translit: v't 'my yvrv byn qdsh lchl vbyn tm' lthvr yvd'm
verses.translation: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

verses.original: וְ/עַל רִ֗יב הֵ֚מָּה יַעַמְד֣וּ ל/שפט לְ/מִשְׁפָּ֔ט בְּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י ו/שפט/הו יִשְׁפְּט֑וּ/הוּ וְ/אֶת תּוֹרֹתַ֤/י וְ/אֶת חֻקֹּתַ/י֙ בְּ/כָל מוֹעֲדַ֣/י יִשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וְ/אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖/י יְקַדֵּֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: v'l ryb hmh y'mdv lshpt lmshpt bmshpty vshpthv yshptvhv v't tvrty v't chqty bkhl mv'dy yshmrv v't shbtvty yqdshv
verses.translation: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל מֵ֣ת אָדָ֔ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא לְ/טָמְאָ֑ה כִּ֣י אִם לְ/אָ֡ב וּ֠/לְ/אֵם וּ/לְ/בֵ֨ן וּ/לְ/בַ֜ת לְ/אָ֗ח וּ/לְ/אָח֛וֹת אֲשֶֽׁר לֹא הָיְתָ֥ה לְ/אִ֖ישׁ יִטַּמָּֽאוּ
verses.translit: v'l mt 'dm l' ybv' ltm'h khy 'm l'b vl'm vlbn vlbt l'ch vl'chvt 'shr l' hyth l'ysh ytm'v
verses.translation: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵ֖י טָֽהֳרָת֑/וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים יִסְפְּרוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'chry thrtv shb't ymym ysprv lv
verses.translation: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/יוֹם֩ בֹּא֨/וֹ אֶל הַ/קֹּ֜דֶשׁ אֶל הֶ/חָצֵ֤ר הַ/פְּנִימִית֙ לְ/שָׁרֵ֣ת בַּ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ יַקְרִ֖יב חַטָּאת֑/וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vbyvm b'v 'l hqdsh 'l hchtsr hpnymyt lshrt bqdsh yqryb cht'tv n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ לְֽ/נַחֲלָ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נַֽחֲלָתָ֑/ם וַ/אֲחֻזָּ֗ה לֹֽא תִתְּנ֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲנִ֖י אֲחֻזָּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyth lhm lnchlh 'ny nchltm v'chzh l' ttnv lhm byshr'l 'ny 'chztm
verses.translation: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.

verses.original: הַ/מִּנְחָה֙ וְ/הַ/חַטָּ֣את וְ/הָ/אָשָׁ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה יֹֽאכְל֑וּ/ם וְ/כָל חֵ֥רֶם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָ/הֶ֥ם יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: hmnchh vhcht't vh'shm hmh y'khlvm vkhl chrm byshr'l lhm yhyh
verses.translation: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.

verses.original: וְ/רֵאשִׁית֩ כָּל בִּכּ֨וּרֵי כֹ֜ל וְ/כָל תְּר֣וּמַת כֹּ֗ל מִ/כֹּל֙ תְּרוּמ֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים יִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְ/רֵאשִׁ֤ית עֲרִסֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ תִּתְּנ֣וּ לַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן לְ/הָנִ֥יחַ בְּרָכָ֖ה אֶל בֵּיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vr'shyt khl bkhvry khl vkhl trvmt khl mkhl trvmvtykhm lkhhnym yhyh vr'shyt 'rsvtykhm ttnv lkhhn lhnych brkhh 'l bytkh
verses.translation: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things , and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest’s: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.

verses.original: כָּל נְבֵלָה֙ וּ/טְרֵפָ֔ה מִן הָ/ע֖וֹף וּ/מִן הַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה לֹ֥א יֹאכְל֖וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: khl nblh vtrph mn h'vf vmn hbhmh l' y'khlv hkhhnym
verses.translation: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הַפִּֽילְ/כֶ֨ם אֶת הָ/אָ֜רֶץ בְּ/נַחֲלָ֗ה תָּרִימוּ֩ תְרוּמָ֨ה לַ/יהוָ֥ה קֹדֶשׁ֮ מִן הָ/אָרֶץ֒ אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְ/רֹ֖חַב עֲשָׂ֣רָה אָ֑לֶף קֹדֶשׁ ה֥וּא בְ/כָל גְּבוּלָ֖/הּ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vbhpylkhm 't h'rts bnchlh trymv trvmh lyhvh qdsh mn h'rts 'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf 'rkh vrchb 'shrh 'lf qdsh hv' bkhl gbvlh sbyb
verses.translation: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD , an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds , and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.

verses.original: יִהְיֶ֤ה מִ/זֶּה֙ אֶל הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת בַּ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת מְרֻבָּ֣ע סָבִ֑יב וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה מִגְרָ֥שׁ ל֖/וֹ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: yhyh mzh 'l hqdsh chmsh m'vt bchmsh m'vt mrb' sbyb vchmshym 'mh mgrsh lv sbyb
verses.translation: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length , with five hundred in breadth , square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/מִּדָּ֤ה הַ/זֹּאת֙ תָּמ֔וֹד אֹ֗רֶךְ חמש חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְ/רֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּ/בֽ/וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה הַ/מִּקְדָּ֖שׁ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vmn hmdh hz't tmvd 'rkh chmsh chmshh v'shrym 'lf vrchb 'shrt 'lpym vbv yhyh hmqdsh qdsh qdshym
verses.translation: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place .

verses.original: קֹ֣דֶשׁ מִן הָ/אָ֜רֶץ ה֗וּא לַ/כֹּ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֤י הַ/מִּקְדָּשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה הַ/קְּרֵבִ֖ים לְ/שָׁרֵ֣ת אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֨ה לָ/הֶ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ לְ/בָ֣תִּ֔ים וּ/מִקְדָּ֖שׁ לַ/מִּקְדָּֽשׁ
verses.translit: qdsh mn h'rts hv' lkhhnym mshrty hmqdsh yhyh hqrbym lshrt 't yhvh vhyh lhm mqvm lbtym vmqdsh lmqdsh
verses.translation: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD : and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.

verses.original: וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וַ/עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רֹ֑חַב יהיה וְֽ/הָיָ֡ה לַ/לְוִיִּם֩ מְשָׁרְתֵ֨י הַ/בַּ֧יִת לָ/הֶ֛ם לַ/אֲחֻזָּ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים לְשָׁכֹֽת
verses.translit: vchmshh v'shrym 'lf 'rkh v'shrt 'lpym rchb yhyh vhyh llvym mshrty hbyt lhm l'chzh 'shrym lshkht
verses.translation: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֻזַּ֨ת הָ/עִ֜יר תִּתְּנ֗וּ חֲמֵ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ רֹ֔חַב וְ/אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף לְ/עֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְ/כָל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: v'chzt h'yr ttnv chmsht 'lpym rchb v'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf l'mt trvmt hqdsh lkhl byt yshr'l yhyh
verses.translation: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/לַ/נָּשִׂ֡יא מִ/זֶּ֣ה וּ/מִ/זֶּה֩ לִ/תְרוּמַ֨ת הַ/קֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְ/לַ/אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָ/עִ֗יר אֶל פְּנֵ֤י תְרֽוּמַת הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ וְ/אֶל פְּנֵי֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָ/עִ֔יר מִ/פְּאַת יָ֣ם יָ֔מָּ/ה וּ/מִ/פְּאַת קֵ֖דְמָ/ה קָדִ֑ימָ/ה וְ/אֹ֗רֶךְ לְ/עֻמּוֹת֙ אַחַ֣ד הַ/חֲלָקִ֔ים מִ/גְּב֥וּל יָ֖ם אֶל גְּב֥וּל קָדִֽימָ/ה
verses.translit: vlnshy' mzh vmzh ltrvmt hqdsh vl'chzt h'yr 'l pny trvmt hqdsh v'l pny 'chzt h'yr mp't ym ymh vmp't qdmh qdymh v'rkh l'mvt 'chd hchlqym mgbvl ym 'l gbvl qdymh
verses.translation: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion , and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion , and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.

verses.original: לָ/אָ֛רֶץ יִֽהְיֶה לּ֥/וֹ לַֽ/אֲחֻזָּ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹא יוֹנ֨וּ ע֤וֹד נְשִׂיאַ/י֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י וְ/הָ/אָ֛רֶץ יִתְּנ֥וּ לְ/בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/שִׁבְטֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: l'rts yhyh lv l'chzh byshr'l vl' yvnv 'vd nshy'y 't 'my vh'rts ytnv lbyt yshr'l lshbtyhm
verses.translation: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה רַב לָ/כֶם֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חָמָ֤ס וָ/שֹׁד֙ הָסִ֔ירוּ וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה עֲשׂ֑וּ הָרִ֤ימוּ גְרֻשֹֽׁתֵי/כֶם֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל עַמִּ֔/י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh rb lkhm nshy'y yshr'l chms vshd hsyrv vmshpt vtsdqh 'shv hrymv grshtykhm m'l 'my n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: מֹֽאזְנֵי צֶ֧דֶק וְ/אֵֽיפַת צֶ֛דֶק וּ/בַת צֶ֖דֶק יְהִ֥י לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: m'zny tsdq v'ypt tsdq vbt tsdq yhy lkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

verses.original: הָ/אֵיפָ֣ה וְ/הַ/בַּ֗ת תֹּ֤כֶן אֶחָד֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה לָ/שֵׂ֕את מַעְשַׂ֥ר הַ/חֹ֖מֶר הַ/בָּ֑ת וַ/עֲשִׂירִ֤ת הַ/חֹ֨מֶר֙ הָֽ/אֵיפָ֔ה אֶל הַ/חֹ֖מֶר יִהְיֶ֥ה מַתְכֻּנְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: h'yph vhbt tkhn 'chd yhyh lsh't m'shr hchmr hbt v'shyrt hchmr h'yph 'l hchmr yhyh mtkhntv
verses.translation: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שֶּׁ֖קֶל עֶשְׂרִ֣ים גֵּרָ֑ה עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שְׁקָלִ֜ים חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֗ים עֲשָׂרָ֤ה וַ/חֲמִשָּׁה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶל הַ/מָּנֶ֖ה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhshql 'shrym grh 'shrym shqlym chmshh v'shrym shqlym 'shrh vchmshh shql hmnh yhyh lkhm
verses.translation: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

verses.original: זֹ֥את הַ/תְּרוּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּרִ֑ימוּ שִׁשִּׁ֤ית הָֽ/אֵיפָה֙ מֵ/חֹ֣מֶר הַֽ/חִטִּ֔ים וְ/שִׁשִּׁיתֶם֙ הָֽ/אֵיפָ֔ה מֵ/חֹ֖מֶר הַ/שְּׂעֹרִֽים
verses.translit: z't htrvmh 'shr trymv shshyt h'yph mchmr hchtym vshshytm h'yph mchmr hsh'rym
verses.translation: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:

verses.original: וְ/חֹ֨ק הַ/שֶּׁ֜מֶן הַ/בַּ֣ת הַ/שֶּׁ֗מֶן מַעְשַׂ֤ר הַ/בַּת֙ מִן הַ/כֹּ֔ר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַ/בַּתִּ֖ים חֹ֑מֶר כִּֽי עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַ/בַּתִּ֖ים חֹֽמֶר
verses.translit: vchq hshmn hbt hshmn m'shr hbt mn hkhr 'shrt hbtym chmr khy 'shrt hbtym chmr
verses.translation: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:

verses.original: וְ/שֶׂה אַחַ֨ת מִן הַ/צֹּ֤אן מִן הַ/מָּאתַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מַּשְׁקֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/מִנְחָ֖ה וּ/לְ/עוֹלָ֣ה וְ/לִ/שְׁלָמִ֑ים לְ/כַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vshh 'cht mn hts'n mn hm'tym mmshqh yshr'l lmnchh vl'vlh vlshlmym lkhpr 'lyhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל הָ/עָ֣ם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ יִהְי֖וּ אֶל הַ/תְּרוּמָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֑את לַ/נָּשִׂ֖יא בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khl h'm h'rts yhyv 'l htrvmh hz't lnshy' byshr'l
verses.translation: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
