verses.original: וְ/עַֽל הַ/נָּשִׂ֣יא יִהְיֶ֗ה הָ/עוֹל֣וֹת וְ/הַ/מִּנְחָה֮ וְ/הַ/נֵּסֶךְ֒ בַּ/חַגִּ֤ים וּ/בֶ/חֳדָשִׁים֙ וּ/בַ/שַּׁבָּת֔וֹת בְּ/כָֽל מוֹעֲדֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֽוּא יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֶת הַ/חַטָּ֣את וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֗ה וְ/אֶת הָֽ/עוֹלָה֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֔ים לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר בְּעַ֥ד בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'l hnshy' yhyh h'vlvt vhmnchh vhnskh bchgym vbchdshym vbshbtvt bkhl mv'dy byt yshr'l hv' y'shh 't hcht't v't hmnchh v't h'vlh v't hshlmym lkhpr b'd byt yshr'l
verses.translation: And it shall be the prince’s part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ בָּֽ/רִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ תִּקַּ֥ח פַּר בֶּן בָּקָ֖ר תָּמִ֑ים וְ/חִטֵּאתָ֖ אֶת הַ/מִּקְדָּֽשׁ
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh br'shvn b'chd lchdsh tqch pr bn bqr tmym vcht't 't hmqdsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; In the first month , in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֨ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן מִ/דַּ֣ם הַ/חַטָּ֗את וְ/נָתַן֙ אֶל מְזוּזַ֣ת הַ/בַּ֔יִת וְ/אֶל אַרְבַּ֛ע פִּנּ֥וֹת הָ/עֲזָרָ֖ה לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/עַ֨ל מְזוּזַ֔ת שַׁ֖עַר הֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/פְּנִימִֽית
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdm hcht't vntn 'l mzvzt hbyt v'l 'rb' pnvt h'zrh lmzbch v'l mzvzt sh'r hchtsr hpnymyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.

verses.original: וְ/כֵ֤ן תַּֽעֲשֶׂה֙ בְּ/שִׁבְעָ֣ה בַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ מֵ/אִ֥ישׁ שֹׁגֶ֖ה וּ/מִ/פֶּ֑תִי וְ/כִפַּרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vkhn t'shh bshb'h bchdsh m'ysh shgh vmpty vkhprtm 't hbyt
verses.translation: And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.

verses.original: בָּ֠/רִאשׁוֹן בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם הַ/פָּ֑סַח חָ֕ג שְׁבֻע֣וֹת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל
verses.translit: br'shvn b'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh yhyh lkhm hpsch chg shb'vt ymym mtsvt y'khl
verses.translation: In the first month , in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה הַ/נָּשִׂיא֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא בַּעֲד֕/וֹ וּ/בְעַ֖ד כָּל עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ פַּ֖ר חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: v'shh hnshy' byvm hhv' b'dv vb'd khl 'm h'rts pr cht't
verses.translation: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁבְעַ֨ת יְמֵֽי הֶ/חָ֜ג יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה עוֹלָ֣ה לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת פָּ֠רִים וְ/שִׁבְעַ֨ת אֵילִ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ לַ/יּ֔וֹם שִׁבְעַ֖ת הַ/יָּמִ֑ים וְ/חַטָּ֕את שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים לַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vshb't ymy hchg y'shh 'vlh lyhvh shb't prym vshb't 'ylym tmymm lyvm shb't hymym vcht't sh'yr 'zym lyvm
verses.translation: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD , seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָ֗ה אֵיפָ֥ה לַ/פָּ֛ר וְ/אֵיפָ֥ה לָ/אַ֖יִל יַֽעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָ/אֵיפָֽה
verses.translit: vmnchh 'yph lpr v'yph l'yl y'shh vshmn hyn l'yph
verses.translation: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.

verses.original: בַּ/שְּׁבִיעִ֡י בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֤וֹם לַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בֶּ/חָ֔ג יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָ/אֵ֖לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַ/יָּמִ֑ים כַּֽ/חַטָּאת֙ כָּ/עֹלָ֔ה וְ/כַ/מִּנְחָ֖ה וְ/כַ/שָּֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: bshby'y bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh bchg y'shh kh'lh shb't hymym khcht't kh'lh vkhmnchh vkhshmn
verses.translation: In the seventh month , in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִה֒ שַׁ֜עַר הֶ/חָצֵ֤ר הַ/פְּנִימִית֙ הַ/פֹּנֶ֣ה קָדִ֔ים יִהְיֶ֣ה סָג֔וּר שֵׁ֖שֶׁת יְמֵ֣י הַֽ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה וּ/בְ/י֤וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּת֙ יִפָּתֵ֔חַ וּ/בְ/י֥וֹם הַ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ יִפָּתֵֽחַ
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh sh'r hchtsr hpnymyt hpnh qdym yhyh sgvr shsht ymy hm'shh vbyvm hshbt yptch vbyvm hchdsh yptch
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֣א הַ/נָּשִׂ֡יא דֶּרֶךְ֩ אוּלָ֨ם הַ/שַּׁ֜עַר מִ/ח֗וּץ וְ/עָמַד֙ עַל מְזוּזַ֣ת הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר וְ/עָשׂ֣וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים אֶת עֽוֹלָת/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת שְׁלָמָ֔י/ו וְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוָ֛ה עַל מִפְתַּ֥ן הַ/שַּׁ֖עַר וְ/יָצָ֑א וְ/הַ/שַּׁ֥עַר לֹֽא יִסָּגֵ֖ר עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vb' hnshy' drkh 'vlm hsh'r mchvts v'md 'l mzvzt hsh'r v'shv hkhhnym 't 'vltv v't shlmyv vhshtchvh 'l mptn hsh'r vyts' vhsh'r l' ysgr 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ עַם הָ/אָ֗רֶץ פֶּ֚תַח הַ/שַּׁ֣עַר הַ/ה֔וּא בַּ/שַּׁבָּת֖וֹת וּ/בֶ/חֳדָשִׁ֑ים לִ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhshtchvv 'm h'rts ptch hsh'r hhv' bshbtvt vbchdshym lpny yhvh
verses.translation: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֣/עֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִ֥ב הַ/נָּשִׂ֖יא לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֗ת שִׁשָּׁ֧ה כְבָשִׂ֛ים תְּמִימִ֖ם וְ/אַ֥יִל תָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vh'lh 'shr yqrb hnshy' lyhvh byvm hshbt shshh khbshym tmymm v'yl tmym
verses.translation: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָה֙ אֵיפָ֣ה לָ/אַ֔יִל וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֥ים מִנְחָ֖ה מַתַּ֣ת יָד֑/וֹ וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָ/אֵיפָֽה
verses.translit: vmnchh 'yph l'yl vlkhbshym mnchh mtt ydv vshmn hyn l'yph
verses.translation: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/י֣וֹם הַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ פַּ֥ר בֶּן בָּקָ֖ר תְּמִימִ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֧שֶׁת כְּבָשִׂ֛ם וָ/אַ֖יִל תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vbyvm hchdsh pr bn bqr tmymm vshsht khbshm v'yl tmymm yhyv
verses.translation: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.

verses.original: וְ/אֵיפָ֨ה לַ/פָּ֜ר וְ/אֵיפָ֤ה לָ/אַ֨יִל֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה וְ/לַ֨/כְּבָשִׂ֔ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָד֑/וֹ וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָ/אֵיפָֽה
verses.translit: v'yph lpr v'yph l'yl y'shh mnchh vlkhbshym kh'shr tshyg ydv vshmn hyn l'yph
verses.translation: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/ב֖וֹא הַ/נָּשִׂ֑יא דֶּ֣רֶךְ אוּלָ֤ם הַ/שַּׁ֨עַר֙ יָב֔וֹא וּ/בְ/דַרְכּ֖/וֹ יֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: vbbv' hnshy' drkh 'vlm hsh'r ybv' vbdrkhv yts'
verses.translation: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/ב֨וֹא עַם הָ/אָ֜רֶץ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֮ בַּ/מּֽוֹעֲדִים֒ הַ/בָּ֡א דֶּרֶךְ שַׁ֨עַר צָפ֜וֹן לְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֗ת יֵצֵא֙ דֶּרֶךְ שַׁ֣עַר נֶ֔גֶב וְ/הַ/בָּא֙ דֶּרֶךְ שַׁ֣עַר נֶ֔גֶב יֵצֵ֖א דֶּרֶךְ שַׁ֣עַר צָפ֑וֹנָ/ה לֹ֣א יָשׁ֗וּב דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַ/שַּׁ֨עַר֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣א ב֔/וֹ כִּ֥י נִכְח֖/וֹ יצאו יֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: vbbv' 'm h'rts lpny yhvh bmv'dym hb' drkh sh'r tspvn lhshtchvt yts' drkh sh'r ngb vhb' drkh sh'r ngb yts' drkh sh'r tspvnh l' yshvb drkh hsh'r 'shr b' bv khy nkhchv yts'v yts'
verses.translation: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.

verses.original: וְֽ/הַ/נָּשִׂ֑יא בְּ/תוֹכָ֤/ם בְּ/בוֹאָ/ם֙ יָב֔וֹא וּ/בְ/צֵאתָ֖/ם יֵצֵֽאוּ
verses.translit: vhnshy' btvkhm bbv'm ybv' vbts'tm yts'v
verses.translation: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חַגִּ֣ים וּ/בַ/מּוֹעֲדִ֗ים תִּהְיֶ֤ה הַ/מִּנְחָה֙ אֵיפָ֤ה לַ/פָּר֙ וְ/אֵיפָ֣ה לָ/אַ֔יִל וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֖ים מַתַּ֣ת יָד֑/וֹ וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָ/אֵיפָֽה
verses.translit: vbchgym vbmv'dym thyh hmnchh 'yph lpr v'yph l'yl vlkhbshym mtt ydv vshmn hyn l'yph
verses.translation: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יַעֲשֶׂה֩ הַ/נָּשִׂ֨יא נְדָבָ֜ה עוֹלָ֣ה אֽוֹ שְׁלָמִים֮ נְדָבָ֣ה לַֽ/יהוָה֒ וּ/פָ֣תַֽח ל֗/וֹ אֶת הַ/שַּׁ֨עַר֙ הַ/פֹּנֶ֣ה קָדִ֔ים וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה אֶת עֹֽלָת/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת שְׁלָמָ֔י/ו כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת וְ/יָצָ֛א וְ/סָגַ֥ר אֶת הַ/שַּׁ֖עַר אַחֲרֵ֥י צֵאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhy y'shh hnshy' ndbh 'vlh 'v shlmym ndbh lyhvh vptch lv 't hsh'r hpnh qdym v'shh 't 'ltv v't shlmyv kh'shr y'shh byvm hshbt vyts' vsgr 't hsh'r 'chry ts'tv
verses.translation: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD , one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.

verses.original: וְ/כֶ֨בֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָת֜/וֹ תָּמִ֗ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עוֹלָ֛ה לַ/יּ֖וֹם לַֽ/יהֹוָ֑ה בַּ/בֹּ֥קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֖קֶר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhbsh bn shntv tmym t'shh 'vlh lyvm lyhvh bbqr bbqr t'shh 'tv
verses.translation: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָה֩ תַעֲשֶׂ֨ה עָלָ֜י/ו בַּ/בֹּ֤קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ שִׁשִּׁ֣ית הָֽ/אֵיפָ֔ה וְ/שֶׁ֛מֶן שְׁלִישִׁ֥ית הַ/הִ֖ין לָ/רֹ֣ס אֶת הַ/סֹּ֑לֶת מִנְחָה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה חֻקּ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: vmnchh t'shh 'lyv bbqr bbqr shshyt h'yph vshmn shlyshyt hhyn lrs 't hslt mnchh lyhvh chqvt 'vlm tmyd
verses.translation: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD .

verses.original: ו/עשו יַעֲשׂ֨וּ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֧בֶשׂ וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֛ה וְ/אֶת הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר עוֹלַ֖ת תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: v'shv y'shv 't hkhbsh v't hmnchh v't hshmn bbqr bbqr 'vlt tmyd
verses.translation: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה כִּֽי יִתֵּ֨ן הַ/נָּשִׂ֤יא מַתָּנָה֙ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ מִ/בָּנָ֔י/ו נַחֲלָת֥/וֹ הִ֖יא לְ/בָנָ֣י/ו תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה אֲחֻזָּתָ֥/ם הִ֖יא בְּ/נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh khy ytn hnshy' mtnh l'ysh mbnyv nchltv hy' lbnyv thyh 'chztm hy' bnchlh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons’; it shall be their possession by inheritance.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִתֵּ֨ן מַתָּנָ֜ה מִ/נַּחֲלָת֗/וֹ לְ/אַחַד֙ מֵֽ/עֲבָדָ֔י/ו וְ/הָ֤יְתָה לּ/וֹ֙ עַד שְׁנַ֣ת הַ/דְּר֔וֹר וְ/שָׁבַ֖ת לַ/נָּשִׂ֑יא אַ֚ךְ נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ בָּנָ֖י/ו לָ/הֶ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vkhy ytn mtnh mnchltv l'chd m'bdyv vhyth lv 'd shnt hdrvr vshbt lnshy' 'kh nchltv bnyv lhm thyh
verses.translation: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons’ for them.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יִקַּ֨ח הַ/נָּשִׂ֜יא מִ/נַּחֲלַ֣ת הָ/עָ֗ם לְ/הֽוֹנֹתָ/ם֙ מֵ/אֲחֻזָּתָ֔/ם מֵ/אֲחֻזָּת֖/וֹ יַנְחִ֣ל אֶת בָּנָ֑י/ו לְמַ֨עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יָפֻ֣צוּ עַמִּ֔/י אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/אֲחֻזָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' yqch hnshy' mnchlt h'm lhvntm m'chztm m'chztv ynchl 't bnyv lm'n 'shr l' yptsv 'my 'ysh m'chztv
verses.translation: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִיאֵ֣/נִי בַ/מָּבוֹא֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל כֶּ֣תֶף הַ/שַּׁעַר֒ אֶל הַ/לִּשְׁכ֤וֹת הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֶל הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַ/פֹּנ֖וֹת צָפ֑וֹנָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּה שָׁ֣ם מָק֔וֹם ב/ירכת/ם בַּ/יַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyby'ny bmbv' 'shr 'l khtf hsh'r 'l hlshkhvt hqdsh 'l hkhhnym hpnvt tspvnh vhnh shm mqvm byrkhtm byrkhtym ymh
verses.translation: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י זֶ֣ה הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְבַשְּׁלוּ שָׁם֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אֶת הָ/אָשָׁ֖ם וְ/אֶת הַ/חַטָּ֑את אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֹאפוּ֙ אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י הוֹצִ֛יא אֶל הֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/חִֽיצוֹנָ֖ה לְ/קַדֵּ֥שׁ אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly zh hmqvm 'shr ybshlv shm hkhhnym 't h'shm v't hcht't 'shr y'pv 't hmnchh lblty hvtsy' 'l hchtsr hchytsvnh lqdsh 't h'm
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִיאֵ֗/נִי אֶל הֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ הַ/חִ֣יצֹנָ֔ה וַ/יַּ֣עֲבִירֵ֔/נִי אֶל אַרְבַּ֖עַת מִקְצוֹעֵ֣י הֶ/חָצֵ֑ר וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה חָצֵר֙ בְּ/מִקְצֹ֣עַ הֶ/חָצֵ֔ר חָצֵ֖ר בְּ/מִקְצֹ֥עַ הֶ/חָצֵֽר
verses.translit: vyvtsy'ny 'l hchtsr hchytsnh vy'byrny 'l 'rb't mqtsv'y hchtsr vhnh chtsr bmqts' hchtsr chtsr bmqts' hchtsr
verses.translation: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

verses.original: בְּ/אַרְבַּ֜עַת מִקְצֹע֤וֹת הֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ חֲצֵר֣וֹת קְטֻר֔וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֣ים אֹ֔רֶךְ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים רֹ֑חַב מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֖/ם מְׄהֻׄקְׄצָׄעֽׄוֹׄתׄ
verses.translit: b'rb't mqts'vt hchtsr chtsrvt qtrvt 'rb'ym 'rkh vshlshym rchb mdh 'cht l'rb'tm mhqts'vt
verses.translation: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.

verses.original: וְ/ט֨וּר סָבִ֥יב בָּ/הֶ֛ם סָבִ֖יב לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֑/ם וּ/מְבַשְּׁל֣וֹת עָשׂ֔וּי מִ/תַּ֥חַת הַ/טִּיר֖וֹת סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vtvr sbyb bhm sbyb l'rb'tm vmbshlvt 'shvy mtcht htyrvt sbyb
verses.translation: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י אֵ֚לֶּה בֵּ֣ית הַֽ/מְבַשְּׁלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְבַשְּׁלוּ שָׁ֛ם מְשָׁרְתֵ֥י הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֶת זֶ֥בַח הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'lh byt hmbshlym 'shr ybshlv shm mshrty hbyt 't zbch h'm
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.

verses.original: וַ/יְשִׁבֵ/נִי֮ אֶל פֶּ֣תַח הַ/בַּיִת֒ וְ/הִנֵּה מַ֣יִם יֹצְאִ֗ים מִ/תַּ֨חַת מִפְתַּ֤ן הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ קָדִ֔ימָ/ה כִּֽי פְנֵ֥י הַ/בַּ֖יִת קָדִ֑ים וְ/הַ/מַּ֣יִם יֹרְדִ֗ים מִ/תַּ֜חַת מִ/כֶּ֤תֶף הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית מִ/נֶּ֖גֶב לַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vyshbny 'l ptch hbyt vhnh mym yts'ym mtcht mptn hbyt qdymh khy pny hbyt qdym vhmym yrdym mtcht mkhtf hbyt hymnyt mngb lmzbch
verses.translation: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִאֵ/נִי֮ דֶּֽרֶךְ שַׁ֣עַר צָפוֹנָ/ה֒ וַ/יְסִבֵּ֨/נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ ח֔וּץ אֶל שַׁ֣עַר הַ/ח֔וּץ דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַ/פּוֹנֶ֣ה קָדִ֑ים וְ/הִנֵּה מַ֣יִם מְפַכִּ֔ים מִן הַ/כָּתֵ֖ף הַ/יְמָנִֽית
verses.translit: vyvts'ny drkh sh'r tspvnh vysbny drkh chvts 'l sh'r hchvts drkh hpvnh qdym vhnh mym mpkhym mn hkhtf hymnyt
verses.translation: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.

verses.original: בְּ/צֵאת הָ/אִ֥ישׁ קָדִ֖ים וְ/קָ֣ו בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וַ/יָּ֤מָד אֶ֨לֶף֙ בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה וַ/יַּעֲבִרֵ֥/נִי בַ/מַּ֖יִם מֵ֥י אָפְסָֽיִם
verses.translit: bts't h'ysh qdym vqv bydv vymd 'lf b'mh vy'brny bmym my 'psym
verses.translation: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָד אֶ֔לֶף וַ/יַּעֲבִרֵ֥/נִי בַ/מַּ֖יִם מַ֣יִם בִּרְכָּ֑יִם וַ/יָּ֣מָד אֶ֔לֶף וַ/יַּעֲבִרֵ֖/נִי מֵ֥י מָתְנָֽיִם
verses.translit: vymd 'lf vy'brny bmym mym brkhym vymd 'lf vy'brny my mtnym
verses.translation: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָד אֶ֔לֶף נַ֕חַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא אוּכַ֖ל לַ/עֲבֹ֑ר כִּֽי גָא֤וּ הַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ מֵ֣י שָׂ֔חוּ נַ֖חַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יֵעָבֵֽר
verses.translit: vymd 'lf nchl 'shr l' 'vkhl l'br khy g'v hmym my shchv nchl 'shr l' y'br
verses.translation: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֖/י הֲ/רָאִ֣יתָ בֶן אָדָ֑ם וַ/יּוֹלִכֵ֥/נִי וַ/יְשִׁבֵ֖/נִי שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/נָּֽחַל
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hr'yt bn 'dm vyvlkhny vyshbny shpt hnchl
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this ? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.

verses.original: בְּ/שׁוּבֵ֕/נִי וְ/הִנֵּה֙ אֶל שְׂפַ֣ת הַ/נַּ֔חַל עֵ֖ץ רַ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד מִ/זֶּ֖ה וּ/מִ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: bshvbny vhnh 'l shpt hnchl 'ts rb m'd mzh vmzh
verses.translation: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י הַ/מַּ֤יִם הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ יוֹצְאִ֗ים אֶל הַ/גְּלִילָה֙ הַ/קַּדְמוֹנָ֔ה וְ/יָרְד֖וּ עַל הָֽ/עֲרָבָ֑ה וּ/בָ֣אוּ הַ/יָּ֔מָּ/ה אֶל הַ/יָּ֥מָּ/ה הַ/מּֽוּצָאִ֖ים ו/נרפאו וְ/נִרְפּ֥וּ הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hmym h'lh yvts'ym 'l hglylh hqdmvnh vyrdv 'l h'rbh vb'v hymh 'l hymh hmvts'ym vnrp'v vnrpv hmym
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה כָל נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֣ה אֲֽשֶׁר יִשְׁרֹ֡ץ אֶ֣ל כָּל אֲשֶׁר֩ יָב֨וֹא שָׁ֤ם נַחֲלַ֨יִם֙ יִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה הַ/דָּגָ֖ה רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד כִּי֩ בָ֨אוּ שָׁ֜מָּ/ה הַ/מַּ֣יִם הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה וְ/יֵרָֽפְאוּ֙ וָ/חָ֔י כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יָ֥בוֹא שָׁ֖מָּ/ה הַ/נָּֽחַל
verses.translit: vhyh khl npsh chyh 'shr yshrts 'l khl 'shr ybv' shm nchlym ychyh vhyh hdgh rbh m'd khy b'v shmh hmym h'lh vyrp'v vchy khl 'shr ybv' shmh hnchl
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ יעמדו עָמְד֨וּ עָלָ֜י/ו דַּוָּגִ֗ים מֵ/עֵ֥ין גֶּ֨דִי֙ וְ/עַד עֵ֣ין עֶגְלַ֔יִם מִשְׁט֥וֹחַ לַֽ/חֲרָמִ֖ים יִהְי֑וּ לְ/מִינָ/ה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה דְגָתָ֔/ם כִּ/דְגַ֛ת הַ/יָּ֥ם הַ/גָּד֖וֹל רַבָּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vhyh y'mdv 'mdv 'lyv dvgym m'yn gdy v'd 'yn 'glym mshtvch lchrmym yhyv lmynh thyh dgtm khdgt hym hgdvl rbh m'd
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.

verses.original: בצאת/ו בִּצֹּאתָ֧י/ו וּ/גְבָאָ֛י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יֵרָפְא֖וּ לְ/מֶ֥לַח נִתָּֽנוּ
verses.translit: bts'tv bts'tyv vgb'yv vl' yrp'v lmlch ntnv
verses.translation: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

verses.original: וְ/עַל הַ/נַּ֣חַל יַעֲלֶ֣ה עַל שְׂפָת֣/וֹ מִ/זֶּ֣ה וּ/מִ/זֶּ֣ה כָּל עֵֽץ מַ֠אֲכָל לֹא יִבּ֨וֹל עָלֵ֜/הוּ וְ/לֹֽא יִתֹּ֣ם פִּרְי֗/וֹ לָֽ/חֳדָשָׁי/ו֙ יְבַכֵּ֔ר כִּ֣י מֵימָ֔י/ו מִן הַ/מִּקְדָּ֖שׁ הֵ֣מָּה יֽוֹצְאִ֑ים ו/היו וְ/הָיָ֤ה פִרְי/וֹ֙ לְ/מַֽאֲכָ֔ל וְ/עָלֵ֖/הוּ לִ/תְרוּפָֽה
verses.translit: v'l hnchl y'lh 'l shptv mzh vmzh khl 'ts m'khl l' ybvl 'lhv vl' ytm pryv lchdshyv ybkhr khy mymyv mn hmqdsh hmh yvts'ym vhyv vhyh pryv lm'khl v'lhv ltrvph
verses.translation: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה גֵּ֤ה גְבוּל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתְנַחֲל֣וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לִ/שְׁנֵ֥י עָשָׂ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יוֹסֵ֖ף חֲבָלִֽים
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh gh gbvl 'shr ttnchlv 't h'rts lshny 'shr shbty yshr'l yvsf chblym
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.

verses.original: וּ/נְחַלְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתָ/הּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ כְּ/אָחִ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתִי֙ אֶת יָדִ֔/י לְ/תִתָּ֖/הּ לַ/אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/נָ֨פְלָ֜ה הָ/אָ֧רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֛את לָ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: vnchltm 'vth 'ysh kh'chyv 'shr nsh'ty 't ydy ltth l'btykhm vnplh h'rts hz't lkhm bnchlh
verses.translation: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֖ה גְּב֣וּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לִ/פְאַ֨ת צָפ֜וֹנָ/ה מִן הַ/יָּ֧ם הַ/גָּד֛וֹל הַ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֶתְלֹ֖ן לְב֥וֹא צְדָֽדָ/ה
verses.translit: vzh gbvl h'rts lp't tspvnh mn hym hgdvl hdrkh chtln lbv' tsddh
verses.translation: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;

verses.original: חֲמָ֤ת בֵּר֨וֹתָה֙ סִבְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁר֙ בֵּין גְּב֣וּל דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וּ/בֵ֖ין גְּב֣וּל חֲמָ֑ת חָצֵר֙ הַתִּיכ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶל גְּב֥וּל חַוְרָֽן
verses.translit: chmt brvth sbrym 'shr byn gbvl dmshq vbyn gbvl chmt chtsr htykhvn 'shr 'l gbvl chvrn
verses.translation: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה גְב֜וּל מִן הַ/יָּ֗ם חֲצַ֤ר עֵינוֹן֙ גְּב֣וּל דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְ/צָפ֥וֹן צָפ֖וֹנָ/ה וּ/גְב֣וּל חֲמָ֑ת וְ/אֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת צָפֽוֹן
verses.translit: vhyh gbvl mn hym chtsr 'ynvn gbvl dmshq vtspvn tspvnh vgbvl chmt v't p't tspvn
verses.translation: And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.

verses.original: וּ/פְאַ֣ת קָדִ֡ים מִ/בֵּ֣ין חַוְרָ֣ן וּ/מִ/בֵּין דַּמֶּשֶׂק֩ וּ/מִ/בֵּ֨ין הַ/גִּלְעָ֜ד וּ/מִ/בֵּ֨ין אֶ֤רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן מִ/גְּב֛וּל עַל הַ/יָּ֥ם הַ/קַּדְמוֹנִ֖י תָּמֹ֑דּוּ וְ/אֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת קָדִֽימָ/ה
verses.translit: vp't qdym mbyn chvrn vmbyn dmshq vmbyn hgl'd vmbyn 'rts yshr'l hyrdn mgbvl 'l hym hqdmvny tmdv v't p't qdymh
verses.translation: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.

verses.original: וּ/פְאַת֙ נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֔נָ/ה מִ/תָּמָ֗ר עַד מֵי֙ מְרִיב֣וֹת קָדֵ֔שׁ נַחֲלָ֖ה אֶל הַ/יָּ֣ם הַ/גָּד֑וֹל וְ/אֵ֥ת פְּאַת תֵּימָ֖נָ/ה נֶֽגְבָּ/ה
verses.translit: vp't ngb tymnh mtmr 'd my mrybvt qdsh nchlh 'l hym hgdvl v't p't tymnh ngbh
verses.translation: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.

verses.original: וּ/פְאַת יָם֙ הַ/יָּ֣ם הַ/גָּד֔וֹל מִ/גְּב֕וּל עַד נֹ֖כַח לְב֣וֹא חֲמָ֑ת זֹ֖את פְּאַת יָֽם
verses.translit: vp't ym hym hgdvl mgbvl 'd nkhch lbv' chmt z't p't ym
verses.translation: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.

verses.original: וְ/חִלַּקְתֶּ֞ם אֶת הָ/אָ֧רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֛את לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vchlqtm 't h'rts hz't lkhm lshbty yshr'l
verses.translation: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה תַּפִּ֣לוּ אוֹתָ/הּ֮ בְּ/נַחֲלָה֒ לָ/כֶ֗ם וּ/לְ/הַ/גֵּרִים֙ הַ/גָּרִ֣ים בְּ/תוֹכְ/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הוֹלִ֥דוּ בָנִ֖ים בְּ/תֽוֹכְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָי֣וּ לָ/כֶ֗ם כְּ/אֶזְרָח֙ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִתְּ/כֶם֙ יִפְּל֣וּ בְ/נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhyh tplv 'vth bnchlh lkhm vlhgrym hgrym btvkhkhm 'shr hvldv bnym btvkhkhm vhyv lkhm kh'zrch bbny yshr'l 'tkhm yplv bnchlh btvkh shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַ/שֵּׁ֔בֶט אֲשֶׁר גָּ֥ר הַ/גֵּ֖ר אִתּ֑/וֹ שָׁ֚ם תִּתְּנ֣וּ נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vhyh bshbt 'shr gr hgr 'tv shm ttnv nchltv n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הַ/שְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִ/קְצֵ֣ה צָפ֡וֹנָ/ה אֶל יַ֣ד דֶּֽרֶךְ חֶתְלֹ֣ן לְֽבוֹא חֲמָ֡ת חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָן֩ גְּב֨וּל דַּמֶּ֤שֶׂק צָפ֨וֹנָ/ה֙ אֶל יַ֣ד חֲמָ֔ת וְ/הָיוּ ל֧/וֹ פְאַת קָדִ֛ים הַ/יָּ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt hshbtym mqtsh tspvnh 'l yd drkh chtln lbv' chmt chtsr 'ynn gbvl dmshq tspvnh 'l yd chmt vhyv lv p't qdym hym dn 'chd
verses.translation: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל דָּ֗ן מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה אָשֵׁ֥ר אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl dn mp't qdym 'd p't ymh 'shr 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל אָשֵׁ֗ר מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָ/ה וְ/עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה נַפְתָּלִ֥י אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl 'shr mp't qdymh v'd p't ymh nptly 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל נַפְתָּלִ֗י מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָ/ה עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl nptly mp't qdmh 'd p't ymh mnshh 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָ/ה עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl mnshh mp't qdmh 'd p't ymh 'prym 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל אֶפְרַ֗יִם מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים וְ/עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה רְאוּבֵ֥ן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl 'prym mp't qdym v'd p't ymh r'vbn 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל רְאוּבֵ֗ן מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה יְהוּדָ֥ה אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl r'vbn mp't qdym 'd p't ymh yhvdh 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.

verses.original: וְ/עַל֙ גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֔ה מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֖ים עַד פְּאַת יָ֑מָּ/ה תִּהְיֶ֣ה הַ/תְּרוּמָ֣ה אֲֽשֶׁר תָּרִ֡ימוּ חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֹ֗חַב וְ/אֹ֜רֶךְ כְּ/אַחַ֤ד הַ/חֲלָקִים֙ מִ/פְּאַ֤ת קָדִ֨ימָ/ה֙ עַד פְּאַת יָ֔מָּ/ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה הַ/מִּקְדָּ֖שׁ בְּ/תוֹכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'l gbvl yhvdh mp't qdym 'd p't ymh thyh htrvmh 'shr trymv chmshh v'shrym 'lf rchb v'rkh kh'chd hchlqym mp't qdymh 'd p't ymh vhyh hmqdsh btvkhv
verses.translation: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.

verses.original: הַ/תְּרוּמָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּרִ֖ימוּ לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְ/רֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: htrvmh 'shr trymv lyhvh 'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf vrchb 'shrt 'lpym
verses.translation: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.

verses.original: וּ֠/לְ/אֵ֜לֶּה תִּהְיֶ֣ה תְרֽוּמַת הַ/קֹּדֶשׁ֮ לַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֒ צָפ֜וֹנָ/ה חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֗לֶף וְ/יָ֨מָּ/ה֙ רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְ/קָדִ֗ימָ/ה רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְ/נֶ֕גְבָּ/ה אֹ֕רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וְ/הָיָ֥ה מִקְדַּשׁ יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/תוֹכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl'lh thyh trvmt hqdsh lkhhnym tspvnh chmshh v'shrym 'lf vymh rchb 'shrt 'lpym vqdymh rchb 'shrt 'lpym vngbh 'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf vhyh mqdsh yhvh btvkhv
verses.translation: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length , and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.

verses.original: לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַֽ/מְקֻדָּשׁ֙ מִ/בְּנֵ֣י צָד֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמְר֖וּ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֑/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא תָע֗וּ בִּ/תְעוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּ הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: lkhhnym hmqdsh mbny tsdvq 'shr shmrv mshmrty 'shr l' t'v bt'vt bny yshr'l kh'shr t'v hlvym
verses.translation: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֨ה לָ/הֶ֧ם תְּרוּמִיָּ֛ה מִ/תְּרוּמַ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל גְּב֖וּל הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vhyth lhm trvmyh mtrvmt h'rts qdsh qdshym 'l gbvl hlvym
verses.translation: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם לְ/עֻמַּת֙ גְּב֣וּל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֔ים חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְ/רֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים כָּל אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְ/רֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: vhlvym l'mt gbvl hkhhnym chmshh v'shrym 'lf 'rkh vrchb 'shrt 'lpym khl 'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf vrchb 'shrt 'lpym
verses.translation: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יִמְכְּר֣וּ מִמֶּ֗/נּוּ וְ/לֹ֥א יָמֵ֛ר וְ/לֹ֥א יעבור יַעֲבִ֖יר רֵאשִׁ֣ית הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּי קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vl' ymkhrv mmnv vl' ymr vl' y'bvr y'byr r'shyt h'rts khy qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/חֲמֵ֨שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֜ים הַ/נּוֹתָ֣ר בָּ/רֹ֗חַב עַל פְּנֵ֨י חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף חֹֽל ה֣וּא לָ/עִ֔יר לְ/מוֹשָׁ֖ב וּ/לְ/מִגְרָ֑שׁ וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה הָ/עִ֖יר ב/תוכ/ה בְּ/תוֹכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vchmsht 'lpym hnvtr brchb 'l pny chmshh v'shrym 'lf chl hv' l'yr lmvshb vlmgrsh vhyth h'yr btvkhh btvkhv
verses.translation: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.

verses.original: וְ/אֵלֶּה֮ מִדּוֹתֶי/הָ֒ פְּאַ֣ת צָפ֗וֹן חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְ/אַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּ/פְאַת נֶ֕גֶב חֲמֵ֥שׁ חמש מֵא֖וֹת וְ/אַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּ/מִ/פְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ים חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְ/אַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּ/פְאַת יָ֕מָּ/ה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְ/אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: v'lh mdvtyh p't tspvn chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym vp't ngb chmsh chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym vmp't qdym chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym vp't ymh chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym
verses.translation: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה מִגְרָשׁ֮ לָ/עִיר֒ צָפ֨וֹנָ/ה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּ/מָאתַ֔יִם וְ/נֶ֖גְבָּ/ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּ/מָאתָ֑יִם וְ/קָדִ֨ימָ/ה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּ/מָאתַ֔יִם וְ/יָ֖מָּ/ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhyh mgrsh l'yr tspvnh chmshym vm'tym vngbh chmshym vm'tym vqdymh chmshym vm'tym vymh chmshym vm'tym
verses.translation: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נּוֹתָ֨ר בָּ/אֹ֜רֶךְ לְ/עֻמַּ֣ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֗דֶשׁ עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים קָדִ֨ימָ/ה֙ וַ/עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ יָ֔מָּ/ה וְ/הָיָ֕ה לְ/עֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה תבואת/ה תְבֽוּאָת/וֹ֙ לְ/לֶ֔חֶם לְ/עֹבְדֵ֖י הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vhnvtr b'rkh l'mt trvmt hqdsh 'shrt 'lpym qdymh v'shrt 'lpym ymh vhyh l'mt trvmt hqdsh vhyth tbv'th tbv'tv llchm l'bdy h'yr
verses.translation: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עֹבֵ֖ד הָ/עִ֑יר יַעַבְד֕וּ/הוּ מִ/כֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vh'bd h'yr y'bdvhv mkhl shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/תְּרוּמָ֗ה חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף רְבִיעִ֗ית תָּרִ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֶל אֲחֻזַּ֖ת הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: khl htrvmh chmshh v'shrym 'lf bchmshh v'shrym 'lf rby'yt trymv 't trvmt hqdsh 'l 'chzt h'yr
verses.translation: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נּוֹתָ֣ר לַ/נָּשִׂ֣יא מִ/זֶּ֣ה וּ/מִ/זֶּ֣ה לִ/תְרֽוּמַת הַ/קֹּ֣דֶשׁ וְ/לַ/אֲחֻזַּ֪ת הָ/עִ֟יר אֶל פְּנֵ֣י חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֥לֶף תְּרוּמָה֮ עַד גְּב֣וּל קָדִימָ/ה֒ וְ/יָ֗מָּ/ה עַל פְּ֠נֵי חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ עַל גְּב֣וּל יָ֔מָּ/ה לְ/עֻמַּ֥ת חֲלָקִ֖ים לַ/נָּשִׂ֑יא וְ/הָֽיְתָה֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּ/מִקְדַּ֥שׁ הַ/בַּ֖יִת ב/תוכ/ה בְּ/תוֹכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhnvtr lnshy' mzh vmzh ltrvmt hqdsh vl'chzt h'yr 'l pny chmshh v'shrym 'lf trvmh 'd gbvl qdymh vymh 'l pny chmshh v'shrym 'lf 'l gbvl ymh l'mt chlqym lnshy' vhyth trvmt hqdsh vmqdsh hbyt btvkhh btvkhv
verses.translation: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/אֲחֻזַּ֤ת הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ וּ/מֵ/אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָ/עִ֔יר בְּ/ת֛וֹךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַ/נָּשִׂ֖יא יִֽהְיֶ֑ה בֵּ֣ין גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֗ה וּ/בֵין֙ גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֔ן לַ/נָּשִׂ֖יא יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vm'chzt hlvym vm'chzt h'yr btvkh 'shr lnshy' yhyh byn gbvl yhvdh vbyn gbvl bnymn lnshy' yhyh
verses.translation: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֖תֶר הַ/שְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָ/ה עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה בִּנְיָמִ֥ן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vytr hshbtym mp't qdymh 'd p't ymh bnymn 'chd
verses.translation: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion .

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֗ן מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָ/ה עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה שִׁמְע֥וֹן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl bnymn mp't qdymh 'd p't ymh shm'vn 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion .

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל שִׁמְע֗וֹן מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָ/ה עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה יִשָׂשכָ֥ר אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl shm'vn mp't qdymh 'd p't ymh yshshkhr 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion .

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל יִשָׂשכָ֗ר מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָ/ה עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה זְבוּלֻ֥ן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl yshshkhr mp't qdymh 'd p't ymh zbvln 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion .

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל גְּב֣וּל זְבוּלֻ֗ן מִ/פְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָ/ה עַד פְּאַת יָ֖מָּ/ה גָּ֥ד אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l gbvl zbvln mp't qdmh 'd p't ymh gd 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion .

verses.original: וְ/עַל֙ גְּב֣וּל גָּ֔ד אֶל פְּאַ֖ת נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֑נָ/ה וְ/הָיָ֨ה גְב֜וּל מִ/תָּמָ֗ר מֵ֚י מְרִיבַ֣ת קָדֵ֔שׁ נַחֲלָ֖ה עַל הַ/יָּ֥ם הַ/גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: v'l gbvl gd 'l p't ngb tymnh vhyh gbvl mtmr my mrybt qdsh nchlh 'l hym hgdvl
verses.translation: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.

verses.original: זֹ֥את הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר תַּפִּ֥ילוּ מִֽ/נַּחֲלָ֖ה לְ/שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֔/ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: z't h'rts 'shr tpylv mnchlh lshbty yshr'l v'lh mchlqvtm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their portions, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה תּוֹצְאֹ֣ת הָ/עִ֑יר מִ/פְּאַ֣ת צָפ֔וֹן חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וְ/אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים מִדָּֽה
verses.translit: v'lh tvts't h'yr mp't tspvn chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym mdh
verses.translation: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָ/עִ֗יר עַל שְׁמוֹת֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁעָרִ֥ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָ/ה שַׁ֣עַר רְאוּבֵ֞ן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יְהוּדָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר לֵוִ֖י אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vsh'ry h'yr 'l shmvt shbty yshr'l sh'rym shlvshh tspvnh sh'r r'vbn 'chd sh'r yhvdh 'chd sh'r lvy 'chd
verses.translation: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל פְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ימָ/ה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְ/אַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּ/שְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וְ/שַׁ֨עַר יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר בִּנְיָמִן֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר דָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'l p't qdymh chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym vsh'rym shlshh vsh'r yvsf 'chd sh'r bnymn 'chd sh'r dn 'chd
verses.translation: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.

verses.original: וּ/פְאַת נֶ֗גְבָּ/ה חֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֜וֹת וְ/אַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מִדָּ֔ה וּ/שְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר שִׁמְע֞וֹן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יִשָּׂשכָר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר זְבוּלֻ֖ן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vp't ngbh chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym mdh vsh'rym shlshh sh'r shm'vn 'chd sh'r yshshkhr 'chd sh'r zbvln 'chd
verses.translation: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.

verses.original: פְּאַת יָ֗מָּ/ה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְ/אַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים שַֽׁעֲרֵי/הֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר גָּ֞ד אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר אָשֵׁר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר נַפְתָּלִ֖י אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: p't ymh chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym sh'ryhm shlshh sh'r gd 'chd sh'r 'shr 'chd sh'r nptly 'chd
verses.translation: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.

verses.original: סָבִ֕יב שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וְ/שֵׁם הָ/עִ֥יר מִ/יּ֖וֹם יְהוָ֥ה שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: sbyb shmnh 'shr 'lf vshm h'yr myvm yhvh shmh
verses.translation: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be , The LORD is there. …: Heb. Jehovah-shammah

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹשׁ לְ/מַלְכ֖וּת יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה בָּ֣א נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַ/יָּ֥צַר עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: bshnt shlvsh lmlkhvt yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh b' nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl yrvshlm vytsr 'lyh
verses.translation: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּן֩ אֲדֹנָ֨/י בְּ/יָד֜/וֹ אֶת יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה וּ/מִ/קְצָת֙ כְּלֵ֣י בֵית הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יְבִיאֵ֥/ם אֶֽרֶץ שִׁנְעָ֖ר בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו וְ/אֶת הַ/כֵּלִ֣ים הֵבִ֔יא בֵּ֖ית אוֹצַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vytn 'dny bydv 't yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh vmqtst khly byt h'lhym vyby'm 'rts shn'r byt 'lhyv v't hkhlym hby' byt 'vtsr 'lhyv
verses.translation: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לְ/אַשְׁפְּנַ֖ז רַ֣ב סָרִיסָ֑י/ו לְ/הָבִ֞יא מִ/בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וּ/מִ/זֶּ֥רַע הַ/מְּלוּכָ֖ה וּ/מִן הַֽ/פַּרְתְּמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh l'shpnz rb srysyv lhby' mbny yshr'l vmzr' hmlvkhh vmn hprtmym
verses.translation: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes;

verses.original: יְלָדִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין בָּ/הֶ֣ם כָּל מאום מוּם֩ וְ/טוֹבֵ֨י מַרְאֶ֜ה וּ/מַשְׂכִּילִ֣ים בְּ/כָל חָכְמָ֗ה וְ/יֹ֤דְעֵי דַ֨עַת֙ וּ/מְבִינֵ֣י מַדָּ֔ע וַ/אֲשֶׁר֙ כֹּ֣חַ בָּ/הֶ֔ם לַ/עֲמֹ֖ד בְּ/הֵיכַ֣ל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וּֽ/לֲ/לַמְּדָ֥/ם סֵ֖פֶר וּ/לְשׁ֥וֹן כַּשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: yldym 'shr 'yn bhm khl m'vm mvm vtvby mr'h vmshkhylym bkhl chkhmh vyd'y d't vmbyny md' v'shr khch bhm l'md bhykhl hmlkh vllmdm spr vlshvn khshdym
verses.translation: Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַן֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ דְּבַר י֣וֹם בְּ/יוֹמ֗/וֹ מִ/פַּת בַּ֤ג הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וּ/מִ/יֵּ֣ין מִשְׁתָּ֔י/ו וּֽ/לְ/גַדְּלָ֖/ם שָׁנִ֣ים שָׁל֑וֹשׁ וּ/מִ֨/קְצָתָ֔/ם יַֽעַמְד֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vymn lhm hmlkh dbr yvm byvmv mpt bg hmlkh vmyyn mshtyv vlgdlm shnym shlvsh vmqtstm y'mdv lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king’s meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י בָ/הֶ֖ם מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה דָּנִיֵּ֣אל חֲנַנְיָ֔ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֖ל וַ/עֲזַרְיָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bhm mbny yhvdh dny'l chnnyh mysh'l v'zryh
verses.translation: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧שֶׂם לָ/הֶ֛ם שַׂ֥ר הַ/סָּרִיסִ֖ים שֵׁמ֑וֹת וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם לְ/דָֽנִיֵּ֜אל בֵּ֣לְטְשַׁאצַּ֗ר וְ/לַֽ/חֲנַנְיָה֙ שַׁדְרַ֔ךְ וּ/לְ/מִֽישָׁאֵ֣ל מֵישַׁ֔ךְ וְ/לַ/עֲזַרְיָ֖ה עֲבֵ֥ד נְגֽוֹ
verses.translit: vyshm lhm shr hsrysym shmvt vyshm ldny'l bltsh'tsr vlchnnyh shdrkh vlmysh'l myshkh vl'zryh 'bd ngv
verses.translation: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abed-nego.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם דָּנִיֵּאל֙ עַל לִבּ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יִתְגָּאַ֛ל בְּ/פַתְבַּ֥ג הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וּ/בְ/יֵ֣ין מִשְׁתָּ֑י/ו וַ/יְבַקֵּשׁ֙ מִ/שַּׂ֣ר הַ/סָּרִיסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א יִתְגָּאָֽל
verses.translit: vyshm dny'l 'l lbv 'shr l' ytg'l bptbg hmlkh vbyyn mshtyv vybqsh mshr hsrysym 'shr l' ytg'l
verses.translation: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת דָּ֣נִיֵּ֔אל לְ/חֶ֖סֶד וּֽ/לְ/רַחֲמִ֑ים לִ/פְנֵ֖י שַׂ֥ר הַ/סָּרִיסִֽים
verses.translit: vytn h'lhym 't dny'l lchsd vlrchmym lpny shr hsrysym
verses.translation: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר שַׂ֤ר הַ/סָּרִיסִים֙ לְ/דָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל יָרֵ֤א אֲנִי֙ אֶת אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִנָּ֔ה אֶת מַאֲכַלְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת מִשְׁתֵּי/כֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֡ר לָ/מָּה֩ יִרְאֶ֨ה אֶת פְּנֵי/כֶ֜ם זֹֽעֲפִ֗ים מִן הַ/יְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כְּ/גִֽילְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/חִיַּבְתֶּ֥ם אֶת רֹאשִׁ֖/י לַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr shr hsrysym ldny'l yr' 'ny 't 'dny hmlkh 'shr mnh 't m'khlkhm v't mshtykhm 'shr lmh yr'h 't pnykhm z'pym mn hyldym 'shr khgylkhm vchybtm 't r'shy lmlkh
verses.translation: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר דָּנִיֵּ֖אל אֶל הַ/מֶּלְצַ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִנָּה֙ שַׂ֣ר הַ/סָּֽרִיסִ֔ים עַל דָּנִיֵּ֣אל חֲנַנְיָ֔ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֖ל וַ/עֲזַרְיָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dny'l 'l hmltsr 'shr mnh shr hsrysym 'l dny'l chnnyh mysh'l v'zryh
verses.translation: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

verses.original: נַס נָ֥א אֶת עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ יָמִ֣ים עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וְ/יִתְּנוּ לָ֜/נוּ מִן הַ/זֵּרֹעִ֛ים וְ/נֹאכְלָ֖ה וּ/מַ֥יִם וְ/נִשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: ns n' 't 'bdykh ymym 'shrh vytnv lnv mn hzr'ym vn'khlh vmym vnshth
verses.translation: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.

verses.original: וְ/יֵרָא֤וּ לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מַרְאֵ֔י/נוּ וּ/מַרְאֵה֙ הַ/יְלָדִ֔ים הָ/אֹ֣כְלִ֔ים אֵ֖ת פַּתְבַּ֣ג הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְאֵ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה עִם עֲבָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyr'v lpnykh mr'ynv vmr'h hyldym h'khlym 't ptbg hmlkh vkh'shr tr'h 'shh 'm 'bdykh
verses.translation: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king’s meat: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע לָ/הֶ֖ם לַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יְנַסֵּ֖/ם יָמִ֥ים עֲשָׂרָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' lhm ldbr hzh vynsm ymym 'shrh
verses.translation: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/קְצָת֙ יָמִ֣ים עֲשָׂרָ֔ה נִרְאָ֤ה מַרְאֵי/הֶם֙ ט֔וֹב וּ/בְרִיאֵ֖י בָּשָׂ֑ר מִן כָּל הַ/יְלָדִ֔ים הָ/אֹ֣כְלִ֔ים אֵ֖ת פַּתְבַּ֥ג הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vmqtst ymym 'shrh nr'h mr'yhm tvb vbry'y bshr mn khl hyldym h'khlym 't ptbg hmlkh
verses.translation: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king’s meat.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י הַ/מֶּלְצַ֗ר נֹשֵׂא֙ אֶת פַּתְבָּגָ֔/ם וְ/יֵ֖ין מִשְׁתֵּי/הֶ֑ם וְ/נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/הֶ֖ם זֵרְעֹנִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy hmltsr nsh' 't ptbgm vyyn mshtyhm vntn lhm zr'nym
verses.translation: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יְלָדִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אַרְבַּעְתָּ֔/ם נָתַ֨ן לָ/הֶ֧ם הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים מַדָּ֥ע וְ/הַשְׂכֵּ֖ל בְּ/כָל סֵ֣פֶר וְ/חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/דָנִיֵּ֣אל הֵבִ֔ין בְּ/כָל חָז֖וֹן וַ/חֲלֹמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhyldym h'lh 'rb'tm ntn lhm h'lhym md' vhshkhl bkhl spr vchkhmh vdny'l hbyn bkhl chzvn vchlmvt
verses.translation: As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מִ/קְצָת֙ הַ/יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר אָמַ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לַ/הֲבִיאָ֑/ם וַ/יְבִיאֵ/ם֙ שַׂ֣ר הַ/סָּרִיסִ֔ים לִ/פְנֵ֖י נְבֻכַדְנֶצַּֽר
verses.translit: vlmqtst hymym 'shr 'mr hmlkh lhby'm vyby'm shr hsrysym lpny nbkhdntsr
verses.translation: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתָּ/ם֮ הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֒ וְ/לֹ֤א נִמְצָא֙ מִ/כֻּלָּ֔/ם כְּ/דָנִיֵּ֣אל חֲנַנְיָ֔ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֖ל וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֑ה וַ/יַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vydbr 'tm hmlkh vl' nmts' mkhlm khdny'l chnnyh mysh'l v'zryh vy'mdv lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֗ל דְּבַר֙ חָכְמַ֣ת בִּינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר בִּקֵּ֥שׁ מֵ/הֶ֖ם הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַֽ/יִּמְצָאֵ֞/ם עֶ֣שֶׂר יָד֗וֹת עַ֤ל כָּל הַֽ/חַרְטֻמִּים֙ הָֽ/אַשָּׁפִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/כָל מַלְכוּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhl dbr chkhmt bynh 'shr bqsh mhm hmlkh vymts'm 'shr ydvt 'l khl hchrtmym h'shpym 'shr bkhl mlkhvtv
verses.translation: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל עַד שְׁנַ֥ת אַחַ֖ת לְ/כ֥וֹרֶשׁ הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhy dny'l 'd shnt 'cht lkhvrsh hmlkh
verses.translation: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֗יִם לְ/מַלְכוּת֙ נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּ֔ר חָלַ֥ם נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר חֲלֹמ֑וֹת וַ/תִּתְפָּ֣עֶם רוּח֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁנָת֖/וֹ נִהְיְתָ֥ה עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vbshnt shtym lmlkhvt nbkhdntsr chlm nbkhdntsr chlmvt vttp'm rvchv vshntv nhyth 'lyv
verses.translation: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ לִ/קְרֹ֨א לַֽ/חַרְטֻמִּ֜ים וְ/לָֽ/אַשָּׁפִ֗ים וְ/לַֽ/מְכַשְּׁפִים֙ וְ/לַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים לְ/הַגִּ֥יד לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חֲלֹמֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּבֹ֕אוּ וַ/יַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lqr' lchrtmym vl'shpym vlmkhshpym vlkhshdym lhgyd lmlkh chlmtyv vyb'v vy'mdv lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר לָ/הֶ֛ם הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חֲל֣וֹם חָלָ֑מְתִּי וַ/תִּפָּ֣עֶם רוּחִ֔/י לָ/דַ֖עַת אֶֽת הַ/חֲלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm hmlkh chlvm chlmty vtp'm rvchy ld't 't hchlvm
verses.translation: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֧וּ הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֛ים לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲרָמִ֑ית מַלְכָּ/א֙ לְ/עָלְמִ֣ין חֱיִ֔י אֱמַ֥ר חֶלְמָ֛/א ל/עבדי/ך לְ/עַבְדָ֖/ךְ וּ/פִשְׁרָ֥/א נְחַוֵּֽא
verses.translit: vydbrv hkhshdym lmlkh 'rmyt mlkh' l'lmyn chyy 'mr chlm' l'bdykh l'bdkh vpshr' nchv'
verses.translation: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּ/א֙ וְ/אָמַ֣ר ל/כשדי/א לְ/כַשְׂדָּאֵ֔/י מִלְּתָ֖/א מִנִּ֣/י אַזְדָּ֑א הֵ֣ן לָ֤א תְהֽוֹדְעוּנַּ֨/נִי֙ חֶלְמָ֣/א וּ/פִשְׁרֵ֔/הּ הַדָּמִין֙ תִּתְעַבְד֔וּן וּ/בָתֵּי/כ֖וֹן נְוָלִ֥י יִתְּשָׂמֽוּן
verses.translit: 'nh mlkh' v'mr lkhshdy' lkhshd'y mlt' mny 'zd' hn l' thvd'vnny chlm' vpshrh hdmyn tt'bdvn vbtykhvn nvly ytshmvn
verses.translation: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֨ן חֶלְמָ֤/א וּ/פִשְׁרֵ/הּ֙ תְּֽהַחֲוֺ֔ן מַתְּנָ֤ן וּ/נְבִזְבָּה֙ וִ/יקָ֣ר שַׂגִּ֔יא תְּקַבְּל֖וּן מִן קֳדָמָ֑/י לָהֵ֕ן חֶלְמָ֥/א וּ/פִשְׁרֵ֖/הּ הַחֲוֺֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vhn chlm' vpshrh thchvn mtnn vnbzbh vyqr shgy' tqblvn mn qdmy lhn chlm' vpshrh hchvny
verses.translation: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.

verses.original: עֲנ֥וֹ תִנְיָנ֖וּת וְ/אָמְרִ֑ין מַלְכָּ֕/א חֶלְמָ֛/א יֵאמַ֥ר לְ/עַבְד֖וֹ/הִי וּ/פִשְׁרָ֥/ה נְהַחֲוֵֽה
verses.translit: 'nv tnynvt v'mryn mlkh' chlm' y'mr l'bdvhy vpshrh nhchvh
verses.translation: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּ/א֙ וְ/אָמַ֔ר מִן יַצִּיב֙ יָדַ֣ע אֲנָ֔ה דִּ֥י עִדָּנָ֖/א אַנְתּ֣וּן זָבְנִ֑ין כָּ/ל קֳבֵל֙ דִּ֣י חֲזֵית֔וֹן דִּ֥י אַזְדָּ֖א מִנִּ֥/י מִלְּתָֽ/א
verses.translit: 'nh mlkh' v'mr mn ytsyb yd' 'nh dy 'dn' 'ntvn zbnyn khl qbl dy chzytvn dy 'zd' mny mlt'
verses.translation: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.

verses.original: דִּ֣י הֵן חֶלְמָ/א֩ לָ֨א תְהֽוֹדְעֻנַּ֜/נִי חֲדָה הִ֣יא דָֽתְ/כ֗וֹן וּ/מִלָּ֨ה כִדְבָ֤ה וּ/שְׁחִיתָה֙ הזמנתון הִזְדְּמִנְתּוּן֙ לְ/מֵאמַ֣ר קָֽדָמַ֔/י עַ֛ד דִּ֥י עִדָּנָ֖/א יִשְׁתַּנֵּ֑א לָהֵ֗ן חֶלְמָ/א֙ אֱמַ֣רוּ לִ֔/י וְֽ/אִנְדַּ֕ע דִּ֥י פִשְׁרֵ֖/הּ תְּהַחֲוֻנַּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: dy hn chlm' l' thvd'nny chdh hy' dtkhvn vmlh khdbh vshchyth hzmntvn hzdmntvn lm'mr qdmy 'd dy 'dn' yshtn' lhn chlm' 'mrv ly v'nd' dy pshrh thchvnny
verses.translation: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, there is but one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.

verses.original: עֲנ֨וֹ כשדי/א כַשְׂדָּאֵ֤/י קֳדָם מַלְכָּ/א֙ וְ/אָ֣מְרִ֔ין לָֽא אִיתַ֤י אֲנָשׁ֙ עַל יַבֶּשְׁתָּ֔/א דִּ֚י מִלַּ֣ת מַלְכָּ֔/א יוּכַ֖ל לְ/הַחֲוָיָ֑ה כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֚י כָּל מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ רַ֣ב וְ/שַׁלִּ֔יט מִלָּ֤ה כִ/דְנָה֙ לָ֣א שְׁאֵ֔ל לְ/כָל חַרְטֹּ֖ם וְ/אָשַׁ֥ף וְ/כַשְׂדָּֽי
verses.translit: 'nv khshdy' khshd'y qdm mlkh' v'mryn l' 'yty 'nsh 'l ybsht' dy mlt mlkh' yvkhl lhchvyh khl qbl dy khl mlkh rb vshlyt mlh khdnh l' sh'l lkhl chrtm v'shf vkhshdy
verses.translation: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king’s matter: therefore there is no king, lord, nor ruler, that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.

verses.original: וּ/מִלְּתָ֨/א דִֽי מַלְכָּ֤/ה שָׁאֵל֙ יַקִּירָ֔ה וְ/אָחֳרָן֙ לָ֣א אִיתַ֔י דִּ֥י יְחַוִּנַּ֖/הּ קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֑/א לָהֵ֣ן אֱלָהִ֔ין דִּ֚י מְדָ֣רְ/ה֔וֹן עִם בִּשְׂרָ֖/א לָ֥א אִיתֽוֹ/הִי
verses.translit: vmlt' dy mlkhh sh'l yqyrh v'chrn l' 'yty dy ychvnh qdm mlkh' lhn 'lhyn dy mdrhvn 'm bshr' l' 'ytvhy
verses.translation: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֔ה מַלְכָּ֕/א בְּנַ֖ס וּ/קְצַ֣ף שַׂגִּ֑יא וַ/אֲמַר֙ לְ/ה֣וֹבָדָ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל חַכִּימֵ֥י בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: khl qbl dnh mlkh' bns vqtsf shgy' v'mr lhvbdh lkhl chkhymy bbl
verses.translation: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/דָתָ֣/א נֶפְקַ֔ת וְ/חַכִּֽימַיָּ֖/א מִֽתְקַטְּלִ֑ין וּ/בְע֛וֹ דָּנִיֵּ֥אל וְ/חַבְר֖וֹ/הִי לְ/הִתְקְטָלָֽה
verses.translit: vdt' npqt vchkhymy' mtqtlyn vb'v dny'l vchbrvhy lhtqtlh
verses.translation: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֣יִן דָּנִיֵּ֗אל הֲתִיב֙ עֵטָ֣א וּ/טְעֵ֔ם לְ/אַרְי֕וֹךְ רַב טַבָּחַיָּ֖/א דִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֑/א דִּ֚י נְפַ֣ק לְ/קַטָּלָ֔ה לְ/חַכִּימֵ֖י בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: b'dyn dny'l htyb 't' vt'm l'ryvkh rb tbchy' dy mlkh' dy npq lqtlh lchkhymy bbl
verses.translation: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon:

verses.original: עָנֵ֣ה וְ/אָמַ֗ר לְ/אַרְיוֹךְ֙ שַׁלִּיטָ֣/א דִֽי מַלְכָּ֔/א עַל מָ֥ה דָתָ֛/א מְהַחְצְפָ֖ה מִן קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֑/א אֱדַ֣יִן מִלְּתָ֔/א הוֹדַ֥ע אַרְי֖וֹךְ לְ/דָנִיֵּֽאל
verses.translit: 'nh v'mr l'ryvkh shlyt' dy mlkh' 'l mh dt' mhchtsph mn qdm mlkh' 'dyn mlt' hvd' 'ryvkh ldny'l
verses.translation: He answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

verses.original: וְ/דָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל עַ֖ל וּ/בְעָ֣ה מִן מַלְכָּ֑/א דִּ֚י זְמָ֣ן יִנְתֵּן לֵ֔/הּ וּ/פִשְׁרָ֖/א לְ/הַֽחֲוָיָ֥ה לְ/מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vdny'l 'l vb'h mn mlkh' dy zmn yntn lh vpshr' lhchvyh lmlkh'
verses.translation: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.

verses.original: אֱדַ֥יִן דָּֽנִיֵּ֖אל לְ/בַיְתֵ֣/הּ אֲזַ֑ל וְ֠/לַ/חֲנַנְיָה מִֽישָׁאֵ֧ל וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֛ה חַבְר֖וֹ/הִי מִלְּתָ֥/א הוֹדַֽע
verses.translit: 'dyn dny'l lbyth 'zl vlchnnyh mysh'l v'zryh chbrvhy mlt' hvd'
verses.translation: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

verses.original: וְ/רַחֲמִ֗ין לְ/מִבְעֵא֙ מִן קֳדָם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔/א עַל רָזָ֖/ה דְּנָ֑ה דִּ֣י לָ֤א יְהֹֽבְדוּן֙ דָּנִיֵּ֣אל וְ/חַבְר֔וֹ/הִי עִם שְׁאָ֖ר חַכִּימֵ֥י בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: vrchmyn lmb'' mn qdm 'lh shmy' 'l rzh dnh dy l' yhbdvn dny'l vchbrvhy 'm sh'r chkhymy bbl
verses.translation: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן לְ/דָנִיֵּ֛אל בְּ/חֶזְוָ֥/א דִֽי לֵילְיָ֖/א רָזָ֣/ה גֲלִ֑י אֱדַ֨יִן֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל בָּרִ֖ךְ לֶ/אֱלָ֥הּ שְׁמַיָּֽ/א
verses.translit: 'dyn ldny'l bchzv' dy lyly' rzh gly 'dyn dny'l brkh l'lh shmy'
verses.translation: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ וְ/אָמַ֔ר לֶהֱוֵ֨א שְׁמֵ֤/הּ דִּֽי אֱלָהָ/א֙ מְבָרַ֔ךְ מִן עָלְמָ֖/א וְ/עַ֣ד עָלְמָ֑/א דִּ֧י חָכְמְתָ֛/א וּ/גְבוּרְתָ֖/א דִּ֥י לֵֽ/הּ הִֽיא
verses.translit: 'nh dny'l v'mr lhv' shmh dy 'lh' mbrkh mn 'lm' v'd 'lm' dy chkhmt' vgbvrt' dy lh hy'
verses.translation: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:

verses.original: וְ֠/הוּא מְהַשְׁנֵ֤א עִדָּנַיָּ/א֙ וְ/זִמְנַיָּ֔/א מְהַעְדֵּ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין וּ/מְהָקֵ֣ים מַלְכִ֑ין יָהֵ֤ב חָכְמְתָ/א֙ לְ/חַכִּימִ֔ין וּ/מַנְדְּעָ֖/א לְ/יָדְעֵ֥י בִינָֽה
verses.translit: vhv' mhshn' 'dny' vzmny' mh'dh mlkhyn vmhqym mlkhyn yhb chkhmt' lchkhymyn vmnd'' lyd'y bynh
verses.translation: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

verses.original: ה֛וּא גָּלֵ֥א עַמִּיקָתָ֖/א וּ/מְסַתְּרָתָ֑/א יָדַע֙ מָ֣ה בַ/חֲשׁוֹכָ֔/א ו/נהיר/א וּ/נְהוֹרָ֖/א עִמֵּ֥/הּ שְׁרֵֽא
verses.translit: hv' gl' 'myqt' vmstrt' yd' mh bchshvkh' vnhyr' vnhvr' 'mh shr'
verses.translation: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.

verses.original: לָ֣/ךְ אֱלָ֣הּ אֲבָהָתִ֗/י מְהוֹדֵ֤א וּ/מְשַׁבַּח֙ אֲנָ֔ה דִּ֧י חָכְמְתָ֛/א וּ/גְבוּרְתָ֖/א יְהַ֣בְתְּ לִ֑/י וּ/כְעַ֤ן הֽוֹדַעְתַּ֨/נִי֙ דִּֽי בְעֵ֣ינָא מִנָּ֔/ךְ דִּֽי מִלַּ֥ת מַלְכָּ֖/א הוֹדַעְתֶּֽ/נָא
verses.translit: lkh 'lh 'bhty mhvd' vmshbch 'nh dy chkhmt' vgbvrt' yhbt ly vkh'n hvd'tny dy b'yn' mnkh dy mlt mlkh' hvd'tn'
verses.translation: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast now made known unto us the king’s matter.

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֗ה דָּֽנִיֵּאל֙ עַ֣ל עַל אַרְי֔וֹךְ דִּ֚י מַנִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֔/א לְ/הוֹבָדָ֖ה לְ/חַכִּימֵ֣י בָבֶ֑ל אֲזַ֣ל וְ/כֵ֣ן אֲמַר לֵ֗/הּ לְ/חַכִּימֵ֤י בָבֶל֙ אַל תְּהוֹבֵ֔ד הַעֵ֨לְ/נִי֙ קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֔/א וּ/פִשְׁרָ֖/א לְ/מַלְכָּ֥/א אֲחַוֵּֽא
verses.translit: khl qbl dnh dny'l 'l 'l 'ryvkh dy mny mlkh' lhvbdh lchkhymy bbl 'zl vkhn 'mr lh lchkhymy bbl 'l thvbd h'lny qdm mlkh' vpshr' lmlkh' 'chv'
verses.translation: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.

verses.original: אֱדַ֤יִן אַרְיוֹךְ֙ בְּ/הִתְבְּהָלָ֔ה הַנְעֵ֥ל לְ/דָנִיֵּ֖אל קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֑/א וְ/כֵ֣ן אֲמַר לֵ֗/הּ דִּֽי הַשְׁכַּ֤חַת גְּבַר֙ מִן בְּנֵ֤י גָֽלוּתָ/א֙ דִּ֣י יְה֔וּד דִּ֥י פִשְׁרָ֖/א לְ/מַלְכָּ֥/א יְהוֹדַֽע
verses.translit: 'dyn 'ryvkh bhtbhlh hn'l ldny'l qdm mlkh' vkhn 'mr lh dy hshkhcht gbr mn bny glvt' dy yhvd dy pshr' lmlkh' yhvd'
verses.translation: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּ/א֙ וְ/אָמַ֣ר לְ/דָנִיֵּ֔אל דִּ֥י שְׁמֵ֖/הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר ה/איתי/ך הַֽ/אִיתָ֣/ךְ כָּהֵ֗ל לְ/הוֹדָעֻתַ֛/נִי חֶלְמָ֥/א דִֽי חֲזֵ֖ית וּ/פִשְׁרֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'nh mlkh' v'mr ldny'l dy shmh bltsh'tsr h'ytykh h'ytkh khhl lhvd'tny chlm' dy chzyt vpshrh
verses.translation: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?

verses.original: עָנֵ֧ה דָנִיֵּ֛אל קֳדָ֥ם מַלְכָּ֖/א וְ/אָמַ֑ר רָזָ/ה֙ דִּֽי מַלְכָּ֣/א שָׁאֵ֔ל לָ֧א חַכִּימִ֣ין אָֽשְׁפִ֗ין חַרְטֻמִּין֙ גָּזְרִ֔ין יָכְלִ֖ין לְ/הַֽחֲוָיָ֥ה לְ/מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: 'nh dny'l qdm mlkh' v'mr rzh dy mlkh' sh'l l' chkhymyn 'shpyn chrtmyn gzryn ykhlyn lhchvyh lmlkh'
verses.translation: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men , the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;

verses.original: בְּרַ֡ם אִיתַ֞י אֱלָ֤הּ בִּ/שְׁמַיָּ/א֙ גָּלֵ֣א רָזִ֔ין וְ/הוֹדַ֗ע לְ/מַלְכָּ/א֙ נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֔ר מָ֛ה דִּ֥י לֶהֱוֵ֖א בְּ/אַחֲרִ֣ית יוֹמַיָּ֑/א חֶלְמָ֨/ךְ וְ/חֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשָׁ֛/ךְ עַֽל מִשְׁכְּבָ֖/ךְ דְּנָ֥ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: brm 'yty 'lh bshmy' gl' rzyn vhvd' lmlkh' nbvkhdntsr mh dy lhv' b'chryt yvmy' chlmkh vchzvy r'shkh 'l mshkhbkh dnh hv'
verses.translation: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;

verses.original: אַ֣נְתְּה מַלְכָּ֗/א רַעְיוֹנָ/ךְ֙ עַל מִשְׁכְּבָ֣/ךְ סְלִ֔קוּ מָ֛ה דִּ֥י לֶהֱוֵ֖א אַחֲרֵ֣י דְנָ֑ה וְ/גָלֵ֧א רָזַיָּ֛/א הוֹדְעָ֖/ךְ מָה דִ֥י לֶהֱוֵֽא
verses.translit: 'nth mlkh' r'yvnkh 'l mshkhbkh slqv mh dy lhv' 'chry dnh vgl' rzy' hvd'kh mh dy lhv'
verses.translation: As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנָ֗ה לָ֤א בְ/חָכְמָה֙ דִּֽי אִיתַ֥י בִּ/י֙ מִן כָּל חַיַּיָּ֔/א רָזָ֥/א דְנָ֖ה גֱּלִ֣י לִ֑/י לָהֵ֗ן עַל דִּבְרַת֙ דִּ֤י פִשְׁרָ/א֙ לְ/מַלְכָּ֣/א יְהוֹדְע֔וּן וְ/רַעְיוֹנֵ֥י לִבְבָ֖/ךְ תִּנְדַּֽע
verses.translit: v'nh l' bchkhmh dy 'yty by mn khl chyy' rz' dnh gly ly lhn 'l dbrt dy pshr' lmlkh' yhvd'vn vr'yvny lbbkh tnd'
verses.translation: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.

verses.original: אַ֣נְתְּה מַלְכָּ֗/א חָזֵ֤ה הֲוַ֨יְתָ֙ וַ/אֲל֨וּ צְלֵ֥ם חַד֙ שַׂגִּ֔יא צַלְמָ֨/א דִּכֵּ֥ן רַ֛ב וְ/זִיוֵ֥/הּ יַתִּ֖יר קָאֵ֣ם לְ/קָבְלָ֑/ךְ וְ/רֵוֵ֖/הּ דְּחִֽיל
verses.translit: 'nth mlkh' chzh hvyt v'lv tslm chd shgy' tslm' dkhn rb vzyvh ytyr q'm lqblkh vrvh dchyl
verses.translation: Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof was terrible.

verses.original: ה֣וּא צַלְמָ֗/א רֵאשֵׁ/הּ֙ דִּֽי דְהַ֣ב טָ֔ב חֲד֥וֹ/הִי וּ/דְרָע֖וֹ/הִי דִּ֣י כְסַ֑ף מְע֥וֹ/הִי וְ/יַרְכָתֵ֖/הּ דִּ֥י נְחָֽשׁ
verses.translit: hv' tslm' r'shh dy dhb tb chdvhy vdr'vhy dy khsf m'vhy vyrkhth dy nchsh
verses.translation: This image’s head was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,

verses.original: שָׁק֖וֹ/הִי דִּ֣י פַרְזֶ֑ל רַגְל֕וֹ/הִי מנ/הון מִנְּ/הֵין֙ דִּ֣י פַרְזֶ֔ל ו/מנ/הון וּ/מִנְּ/הֵ֖ין דִּ֥י חֲסַֽף
verses.translit: shqvhy dy przl rglvhy mnhvn mnhyn dy przl vmnhvn vmnhyn dy chsf
verses.translation: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוַ֗יְתָ עַ֠ד דִּ֣י הִתְגְּזֶ֤רֶת אֶ֨בֶן֙ דִּי לָ֣א בִ/ידַ֔יִן וּ/מְחָ֤ת לְ/צַלְמָ/א֙ עַל רַגְל֔וֹ/הִי דִּ֥י פַרְזְלָ֖/א וְ/חַסְפָּ֑/א וְ/הַדֵּ֖קֶת הִמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: chzh hvyt 'd dy htgzrt 'bn dy l' bydyn vmcht ltslm' 'l rglvhy dy przl' vchsp' vhdqt hmvn
verses.translation: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֣יִן דָּ֣קוּ כַ/חֲדָ֡ה פַּרְזְלָ/א֩ חַסְפָּ֨/א נְחָשָׁ֜/א כַּסְפָּ֣/א וְ/דַהֲבָ֗/א וַ/הֲווֹ֙ כְּ/ע֣וּר מִן אִדְּרֵי קַ֔יִט וּ/נְשָׂ֤א הִמּוֹן֙ רוּחָ֔/א וְ/כָל אֲתַ֖ר לָא הִשְׁתֲּכַ֣ח לְ/ה֑וֹן וְ/אַבְנָ֣/א דִּֽי מְחָ֣ת לְ/צַלְמָ֗/א הֲוָ֛ת לְ/ט֥וּר רַ֖ב וּ/מְלָ֥ת כָּל אַרְעָֽ/א
verses.translit: b'dyn dqv khchdh przl' chsp' nchsh' khsp' vdhb' vhvv kh'vr mn 'dry qyt vnsh' hmvn rvch' vkhl 'tr l' hshtkhch lhvn v'bn' dy mcht ltslm' hvt ltvr rb vmlt khl 'r''
verses.translation: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.

verses.original: דְּנָ֣ה חֶלְמָ֔/א וּ/פִשְׁרֵ֖/הּ נֵאמַ֥ר קֳדָם מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: dnh chlm' vpshrh n'mr qdm mlkh'
verses.translation: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.

verses.original: אַ֣נְתְּה מַלְכָּ֔/א מֶ֖לֶךְ מַלְכַיָּ֑/א דִּ֚י אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔/א מַלְכוּתָ֥/א חִסְנָ֛/א וְ/תָקְפָּ֥/א וִֽ/יקָרָ֖/א יְהַב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'nth mlkh' mlkh mlkhy' dy 'lh shmy' mlkhvt' chsn' vtqp' vyqr' yhb lkh
verses.translation: Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל דִּ֣י דארין דָֽיְרִ֣ין בְּֽנֵי אֲ֠נָשָׁ/א חֵיוַ֨ת בָּרָ֤/א וְ/עוֹף שְׁמַיָּ/א֙ יְהַ֣ב בִּ/ידָ֔/ךְ וְ/הַשְׁלְטָ֖/ךְ בְּ/כָלְּ/ה֑וֹן אַנְתְּה ה֔וּא רֵאשָׁ֖/ה דִּ֥י דַהֲבָֽ/א
verses.translit: vbkhl dy d'ryn dyryn bny 'nsh' chyvt br' v'vf shmy' yhb bydkh vhshltkh bkhlhvn 'nth hv' r'shh dy dhb'
verses.translation: And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou art this head of gold.

verses.original: וּ/בָתְרָ֗/ךְ תְּק֛וּם מַלְכ֥וּ אָחֳרִ֖י ארע/א אֲרַע מִנָּ֑/ךְ וּ/מַלְכ֨וּ תליתיא תְלִיתָאָ֤ה אָחֳרִי֙ דִּ֣י נְחָשָׁ֔/א דִּ֥י תִשְׁלַ֖ט בְּ/כָל אַרְעָֽ/א
verses.translit: vbtrkh tqvm mlkhv 'chry 'r'' 'r' mnkh vmlkhv tlyty' tlyt'h 'chry dy nchsh' dy tshlt bkhl 'r''
verses.translation: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְכוּ֙ רביעיה רְבִ֣יעָאָ֔ה תֶּהֱוֵ֥א תַקִּיפָ֖ה כְּ/פַרְזְלָ֑/א כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֤י פַרְזְלָ/א֙ מְהַדֵּ֤ק וְ/חָשֵׁל֙ כֹּ֔לָּ/א וּֽ/כְ/פַרְזְלָ֛/א דִּֽי מְרָעַ֥ע כָּל אִלֵּ֖ין תַּדִּ֥ק וְ/תֵרֹֽעַ
verses.translit: vmlkhv rby'yh rby''h thv' tqyph khprzl' khl qbl dy przl' mhdq vchshl khl' vkhprzl' dy mr'' khl 'lyn tdq vtr'
verses.translation: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

verses.original: וְ/דִֽי חֲזַ֜יְתָה רַגְלַיָּ֣/א וְ/אֶצְבְּעָתָ֗/א מנ/הון מִנְּ/הֵ֞ן חֲסַ֤ף דִּֽי פֶחָר֙ ו/מנ/הון וּ/מִנְּ/הֵ֣ין פַּרְזֶ֔ל מַלְכ֤וּ פְלִיגָה֙ תֶּהֱוֵ֔ה וּ/מִן נִצְבְּתָ֥/א דִ֥י פַרְזְלָ֖/א לֶֽהֱוֵא בַ֑/הּ כָּ/ל קֳבֵל֙ דִּ֣י חֲזַ֔יְתָה פַּ֨רְזְלָ֔/א מְעָרַ֖ב בַּ/חֲסַ֥ף טִינָֽ/א
verses.translit: vdy chzyth rgly' v'tsb't' mnhvn mnhn chsf dy pchr vmnhvn vmnhyn przl mlkhv plygh thvh vmn ntsbt' dy przl' lhv' bh khl qbl dy chzyth przl' m'rb bchsf tyn'
verses.translation: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.

verses.original: וְ/אֶצְבְּעָת֙ רַגְלַיָּ֔/א מנ/הון מִנְּ/הֵ֥ין פַּרְזֶ֖ל ו/מנ/הון וּ/מִנְּ/הֵ֣ין חֲסַ֑ף מִן קְצָ֤ת מַלְכוּתָ/א֙ תֶּהֱוֵ֣ה תַקִּיפָ֔ה וּ/מִנַּ֖/הּ תֶּהֱוֵ֥ה תְבִירָֽה
verses.translit: v'tsb't rgly' mnhvn mnhyn przl vmnhvn vmnhyn chsf mn qtst mlkhvt' thvh tqyph vmnh thvh tbyrh
verses.translation: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.

verses.original: די וְ/דִ֣י חֲזַ֗יְתָ פַּרְזְלָ/א֙ מְעָרַב֙ בַּ/חֲסַ֣ף טִינָ֔/א מִתְעָרְבִ֤ין לֶהֱוֺן֙ בִּ/זְרַ֣ע אֲנָשָׁ֔/א וְ/לָֽא לֶהֱוֺ֥ן דָּבְקִ֖ין דְּנָ֣ה עִם דְּנָ֑ה הֵֽא כְ/דִ֣י פַרְזְלָ֔/א לָ֥א מִתְעָרַ֖ב עִם חַסְפָּֽ/א
verses.translit: dy vdy chzyt przl' m'rb bchsf tyn' mt'rbyn lhvn bzr' 'nsh' vl' lhvn dbqyn dnh 'm dnh h' khdy przl' l' mt'rb 'm chsp'
verses.translation: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/יוֹמֵי/ה֞וֹן דִּ֧י מַלְכַיָּ֣/א אִנּ֗וּן יְקִים֩ אֱלָ֨הּ שְׁמַיָּ֤/א מַלְכוּ֙ דִּ֤י לְ/עָלְמִין֙ לָ֣א תִתְחַבַּ֔ל וּ/מַ֨לְכוּתָ֔/ה לְ/עַ֥ם אָחֳרָ֖ן לָ֣א תִשְׁתְּבִ֑ק תַּדִּ֤ק וְ/תָסֵיף֙ כָּל אִלֵּ֣ין מַלְכְוָתָ֔/א וְ/הִ֖יא תְּק֥וּם לְ/עָלְמַיָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vbyvmyhvn dy mlkhy' 'nvn yqym 'lh shmy' mlkhv dy l'lmyn l' ttchbl vmlkhvth l'm 'chrn l' tshtbq tdq vtsyf khl 'lyn mlkhvt' vhy' tqvm l'lmy'
verses.translation: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֣ל דִּֽי חֲזַ֡יְתָ דִּ֣י מִ/טּוּרָ/א֩ אִתְגְּזֶ֨רֶת אֶ֜בֶן דִּי לָ֣א בִ/ידַ֗יִן וְ֠/הַדֶּקֶת פַּרְזְלָ֨/א נְחָשָׁ֤/א חַסְפָּ/א֙ כַּסְפָּ֣/א וְ/דַהֲבָ֔/א אֱלָ֥הּ רַב֙ הוֹדַ֣ע לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/א מָ֛ה דִּ֥י לֶהֱוֵ֖א אַחֲרֵ֣י דְנָ֑ה וְ/יַצִּ֥יב חֶלְמָ֖/א וּ/מְהֵימַ֥ן פִּשְׁרֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khl qbl dy chzyt dy mtvr' 'tgzrt 'bn dy l' bydyn vhdqt przl' nchsh' chsp' khsp' vdhb' 'lh rb hvd' lmlkh' mh dy lhv' 'chry dnh vytsyb chlm' vmhymn pshrh
verses.translation: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.

verses.original: בֵּ֠/אדַיִן מַלְכָּ֤/א נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ נְפַ֣ל עַל אַנְפּ֔וֹ/הִי וּ/לְ/דָנִיֵּ֖אל סְגִ֑ד וּ/מִנְחָה֙ וְ/נִ֣יחֹחִ֔ין אֲמַ֖ר לְ/נַסָּ֥כָה לֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' nbvkhdntsr npl 'l 'npvhy vldny'l sgd vmnchh vnychchyn 'mr lnskhh lh
verses.translation: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.

verses.original: עָנֵה֩ מַלְכָּ֨/א לְ/דָנִיֵּ֜אל וְ/אָמַ֗ר מִן קְשֹׁט֙ דִּ֣י אֱלָהֲ/כ֗וֹן ה֣וּא אֱלָ֧הּ אֱלָהִ֛ין וּ/מָרֵ֥א מַלְכִ֖ין וְ/גָלֵ֣ה רָזִ֑ין דִּ֣י יְכֵ֔לְתָּ לְ/מִגְלֵ֖א רָזָ֥/ה דְנָֽה
verses.translit: 'nh mlkh' ldny'l v'mr mn qsht dy 'lhkhvn hv' 'lh 'lhyn vmr' mlkhyn vglh rzyn dy ykhlt lmgl' rzh dnh
verses.translation: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is , that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן מַלְכָּ֜/א לְ/דָנִיֵּ֣אל רַבִּ֗י וּ/מַתְּנָ֨ן רַבְרְבָ֤ן שַׂגִּיאָן֙ יְהַב לֵ֔/הּ וְ/הַ֨שְׁלְטֵ֔/הּ עַ֖ל כָּל מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֑ל וְ/רַב סִגְנִ֔ין עַ֖ל כָּל חַכִּימֵ֥י בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: 'dyn mlkh' ldny'l rby vmtnn rbrbn shgy'n yhb lh vhshlth 'l khl mdynt bbl vrb sgnyn 'l khl chkhymy bbl
verses.translation: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/דָנִיֵּאל֙ בְּעָ֣א מִן מַלְכָּ֔/א וּ/מַנִּ֗י עַ֤ל עֲבִֽידְתָּ/א֙ דִּ֚י מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֔ל לְ/שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ וְ/דָנִיֵּ֖אל בִּ/תְרַ֥ע מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vdny'l b'' mn mlkh' vmny 'l 'bydt' dy mdynt bbl lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv vdny'l btr' mlkh'
verses.translation: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in the gate of the king.

verses.original: נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗/א עֲבַד֙ צְלֵ֣ם דִּֽי דְהַ֔ב רוּמֵ/הּ֙ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁתִּ֔ין פְּתָיֵ֖/הּ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁ֑ת אֲקִימֵ/הּ֙ בְּ/בִקְעַ֣ת דּוּרָ֔א בִּ/מְדִינַ֖ת בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: nbvkhdntsr mlkh' 'bd tslm dy dhb rvmh 'myn shtyn ptyh 'myn sht 'qymh bbq't dvr' bmdynt bbl
verses.translation: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

verses.original: וּ/נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֡/א שְׁלַ֡ח לְ/מִכְנַ֣שׁ לַֽ/אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֡/א סִגְנַיָּ֣/א וּֽ/פַחֲוָתָ֡/א אֲדַרְגָּזְרַיָּ/א֩ גְדָ֨בְרַיָּ֤/א דְּתָבְרַיָּ/א֙ תִּפְתָּיֵ֔/א וְ/כֹ֖ל שִׁלְטֹנֵ֣י מְדִֽינָתָ֑/א לְ/מֵתֵא֙ לַ/חֲנֻכַּ֣ת צַלְמָ֔/א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vnbvkhdntsr mlkh' shlch lmkhnsh l'chshdrpny' sgny' vpchvt' 'drgzry' gdbry' dtbry' tpty' vkhl shltny mdynt' lmt' lchnkht tslm' dy hqym nbvkhdntsr mlkh'
verses.translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֡יִן מִֽתְכַּנְּשִׁ֡ין אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֡/א סִגְנַיָּ֣/א וּֽ/פַחֲוָתָ֡/א אֲדַרְגָּזְרַיָּ֣/א גְדָבְרַיָּ/א֩ דְּתָ֨בְרַיָּ֜/א תִּפְתָּיֵ֗/א וְ/כֹל֙ שִׁלְטֹנֵ֣י מְדִֽינָתָ֔/א לַ/חֲנֻכַּ֣ת צַלְמָ֔/א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֑/א ו/קאמין וְ/קָֽיְמִין֙ לָ/קֳבֵ֣ל צַלְמָ֔/א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּֽר
verses.translit: b'dyn mtkhnshyn 'chshdrpny' sgny' vpchvt' 'drgzry' gdbry' dtbry' tpty' vkhl shltny mdynt' lchnkht tslm' dy hqym nbvkhdntsr mlkh' vq'myn vqymyn lqbl tslm' dy hqym nbvkhdntsr
verses.translation: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

verses.original: וְ/כָרוֹזָ֖/א קָרֵ֣א בְ/חָ֑יִל לְ/כ֤וֹן אָֽמְרִין֙ עַֽמְמַיָּ֔/א אֻמַּיָּ֖/א וְ/לִשָּׁנַיָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vkhrvz' qr' bchyl lkhvn 'mryn 'mmy' 'my' vlshny'
verses.translation: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,

verses.original: בְּ/עִדָּנָ֡/א דִּֽי תִשְׁמְע֡וּן קָ֣ל קַרְנָ֣/א מַ֠שְׁרוֹקִיתָ/א קיתרוס קַתְר֨וֹס סַבְּכָ֤א פְּסַנְתֵּרִין֙ סוּמְפֹּ֣נְיָ֔ה וְ/כֹ֖ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֑/א תִּפְּל֤וּן וְ/תִסְגְּדוּן֙ לְ/צֶ֣לֶם דַּהֲבָ֔/א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: b'dn' dy tshm'vn ql qrn' mshrvqyt' qytrvs qtrvs sbkh' psntryn svmpnyh vkhl zny zmr' tplvn vtsgdvn ltslm dhb' dy hqym nbvkhdntsr mlkh'
verses.translation: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:

verses.original: וּ/מַן דִּי לָ֥א יִפֵּ֖ל וְ/יִסְגֻּ֑ד בַּ/הּ שַׁעֲתָ֣/א יִתְרְמֵ֔א לְ/גֽוֹא אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖/א יָקִֽדְתָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vmn dy l' ypl vysgd bh sh't' ytrm' lgv' 'tvn nvr' yqdt'
verses.translation: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֡ה בֵּ/הּ זִמְנָ֡/א כְּ/דִ֣י שָֽׁמְעִ֣ין כָּֽל עַמְמַיָּ֡/א קָ֣ל קַרְנָ/א֩ מַשְׁר֨וֹקִיתָ֜/א קיתרס קַתְר֤וֹס שַׂבְּכָא֙ פְּסַנְטֵרִ֔ין וְ/כֹ֖ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֑/א נָֽפְלִ֨ין כָּֽל עַֽמְמַיָּ֜/א אֻמַיָּ֣/א וְ/לִשָּׁנַיָּ֗/א סָֽגְדִין֙ לְ/צֶ֣לֶם דַּהֲבָ֔/א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: khl qbl dnh bh zmn' khdy shm'yn khl 'mmy' ql qrn' mshrvqyt' qytrs qtrvs shbkh' psntryn vkhl zny zmr' nplyn khl 'mmy' 'my' vlshny' sgdyn ltslm dhb' dy hqym nbvkhdntsr mlkh'
verses.translation: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֤ל דְּנָה֙ בֵּ/הּ זִמְנָ֔/א קְרִ֖בוּ גֻּבְרִ֣ין כַּשְׂדָּאִ֑ין וַ/אֲכַ֥לוּ קַרְצֵי/ה֖וֹן דִּ֥י יְהוּדָיֵֽ/א
