verses.translit: khl qbl dnh bh zmn' qrbv gbryn khshd'yn v'khlv qrtsyhvn dy yhvdy'
verses.translation: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Jews.

verses.original: עֲנוֹ֙ וְ/אָ֣מְרִ֔ין לִ/נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מַלְכָּ֑/א מַלְכָּ֖/א לְ/עָלְמִ֥ין חֱיִֽי
verses.translit: 'nv v'mryn lnbvkhdntsr mlkh' mlkh' l'lmyn chyy
verses.translation: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.

verses.original: אנתה אַ֣נְתְּ מַלְכָּ/א֮ שָׂ֣מְתָּ טְּעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כָל אֱנָ֡שׁ דִּֽי יִשְׁמַ֡ע קָ֣ל קַרְנָ֣/א מַ֠שְׁרֹקִיתָ/א קיתרס קַתְר֨וֹס שַׂבְּכָ֤א פְסַנְתֵּרִין֙ ו/סיפניה וְ/סוּפֹּ֣נְיָ֔ה וְ/כֹ֖ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֑/א יִפֵּ֥ל וְ/יִסְגֻּ֖ד לְ/צֶ֥לֶם דַּהֲבָֽ/א
verses.translit: 'nth 'nt mlkh' shmt t'm dy khl 'nsh dy yshm' ql qrn' mshrqyt' qytrs qtrvs shbkh' psntryn vsypnyh vsvpnyh vkhl zny zmr' ypl vysgd ltslm dhb'
verses.translation: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:

verses.original: וּ/מַן דִּי לָ֥א יִפֵּ֖ל וְ/יִסְגֻּ֑ד יִתְרְמֵ֕א לְ/גֽוֹא אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖/א יָקִֽדְתָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vmn dy l' ypl vysgd ytrm' lgv' 'tvn nvr' yqdt'
verses.translation: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

verses.original: אִיתַ֞י גֻּבְרִ֣ין יְהוּדָאיִ֗ן דִּֽי מַנִּ֤יתָ יָתְ/הוֹן֙ עַל עֲבִידַת֙ מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֔ל שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ גֻּבְרַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֗ךְ לָא שָׂ֨מֽוּ עלי/ך עֲלָ֤/ךְ מַלְכָּ/א֙ טְעֵ֔ם ל/אלהי/ך לֵֽ/אלָהָ/ךְ֙ לָ֣א פָלְחִ֔ין וּ/לְ/צֶ֧לֶם דַּהֲבָ֛/א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ימְתָּ לָ֥א סָגְדִֽין
verses.translit: 'yty gbryn yhvd'yn dy mnyt ythvn 'l 'bydt mdynt bbl shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv gbry' 'lkh l' shmv 'lykh 'lkh mlkh' t'm l'lhykh l'lhkh l' plchyn vltslm dhb' dy hqymt l' sgdyn
verses.translation: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֤יִן נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ בִּ/רְגַ֣ז וַ/חֲמָ֔ה אֲמַר֙ לְ/הַיְתָיָ֔ה לְ/שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ בֵּ/אדַ֨יִן֙ גֻּבְרַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֔ךְ הֵיתָ֖יוּ קֳדָ֥ם מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: b'dyn nbvkhdntsr brgz vchmh 'mr lhytyh lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv b'dyn gbry' 'lkh hytyv qdm mlkh'
verses.translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then they brought these men before the king.

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּר֙ וְ/אָמַ֣ר לְ/ה֔וֹן הַ/צְדָּ֕א שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ לֵֽ/אלָהַ֗/י לָ֤א אִֽיתֵי/כוֹן֙ פָּֽלְחִ֔ין וּ/לְ/צֶ֧לֶם דַּהֲבָ֛/א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ימֶת לָ֥א סָֽגְדִֽין
verses.translit: 'nh nbkhdntsr v'mr lhvn htsd' shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv l'lhy l' 'ytykhvn plchyn vltslm dhb' dy hqymt l' sgdyn
verses.translation: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?

verses.original: כְּעַ֞ן הֵ֧ן אִֽיתֵי/כ֣וֹן עֲתִידִ֗ין דִּ֣י בְ/עִדָּנָ֡/א דִּֽי תִשְׁמְע֡וּן קָ֣ל קַרְנָ֣/א מַשְׁרוֹקִיתָ֣/א קיתרס קַתְר֣וֹס שַׂבְּכָ֡א פְּסַנְתֵּרִין֩ וְ/סוּמְפֹּ֨נְיָ֜ה וְ/כֹ֣ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֗/א תִּפְּל֣וּן וְ/תִסְגְּדוּן֮ לְ/צַלְמָ֣/א דִֽי עַבְדֵת֒ וְ/הֵן֙ לָ֣א תִסְגְּד֔וּן בַּ/הּ שַׁעֲתָ֣/ה תִתְרְמ֔וֹן לְ/גֽוֹא אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖/א יָקִֽדְתָּ֑/א וּ/מַן ה֣וּא אֱלָ֔הּ דֵּ֥י יְשֵֽׁיזְבִנְ/כ֖וֹן מִן יְדָֽ/י
verses.translit: kh'n hn 'ytykhvn 'tydyn dy b'dn' dy tshm'vn ql qrn' mshrvqyt' qytrs qtrvs shbkh' psntryn vsvmpnyh vkhl zny zmr' tplvn vtsgdvn ltslm' dy 'bdt vhn l' tsgdvn bh sh'th ttrmvn lgv' 'tvn nvr' yqdt' vmn hv' 'lh dy yshyzbnkhvn mn ydy
verses.translation: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?

verses.original: עֲנ֗וֹ שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹ וְ/אָמְרִ֖ין לְ/מַלְכָּ֑/א נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֔ר לָֽא חַשְׁחִ֨ין אֲנַ֧חְנָה עַל דְּנָ֛ה פִּתְגָ֖ם לַ/הֲתָבוּתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'nv shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv v'mryn lmlkh' nbvkhdntsr l' chshchyn 'nchnh 'l dnh ptgm lhtbvtkh
verses.translation: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer thee in this matter.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן אִיתַ֗י אֱלָהַ֨/נָא֙ דִּֽי אֲנַ֣חְנָא פָֽלְחִ֔ין יָכִ֖ל לְ/שֵׁיזָבוּתַ֑/נָא מִן אַתּ֨וּן נוּרָ֧/א יָקִֽדְתָּ֛/א וּ/מִן יְדָ֥/ךְ מַלְכָּ֖/א יְשֵׁיזִֽב
verses.translit: hn 'yty 'lhn' dy 'nchn' plchyn ykhl lshyzbvtn' mn 'tvn nvr' yqdt' vmn ydkh mlkh' yshyzb
verses.translation: If it be so , our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֣ן לָ֔א יְדִ֥יעַ לֶהֱוֵא לָ֖/ךְ מַלְכָּ֑/א דִּ֤י ל/אלהי/ך לֵֽ/אלָהָ/ךְ֙ לָא איתי/נא אִיתַ֣/נָא פָֽלְחִ֔ין וּ/לְ/צֶ֧לֶם דַּהֲבָ֛/א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ימְתָּ לָ֥א נִסְגֻּֽד
verses.translit: vhn l' ydy' lhv' lkh mlkh' dy l'lhykh l'lhkh l' 'ytyn' 'ytn' plchyn vltslm dhb' dy hqymt l' nsgd
verses.translation: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֨יִן נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֜ר הִתְמְלִ֣י חֱמָ֗א וּ/צְלֵ֤ם אַנְפּ֨וֹ/הִי֙ אשתנו אֶשְׁתַּנִּ֔י עַל שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ עָנֵ֤ה וְ/אָמַר֙ לְ/מֵזֵ֣א לְ/אַתּוּנָ֔/א חַ֨ד שִׁבְעָ֔ה עַ֛ל דִּ֥י חֲזֵ֖ה לְ/מֵזְיֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: b'dyn nbvkhdntsr htmly chm' vtslm 'npvhy 'shtnv 'shtny 'l shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv 'nh v'mr lmz' l'tvn' chd shb'h 'l dy chzh lmzyh
verses.translation: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/גֻבְרִ֤ין גִּבָּֽרֵי חַ֨יִל֙ דִּ֣י בְ/חַיְלֵ֔/הּ אֲמַר֙ לְ/כַפָּתָ֔ה לְ/שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ לְ/מִרְמֵ֕א לְ/אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖/א יָקִֽדְתָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vlgbryn gbry chyl dy bchylh 'mr lkhpth lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv lmrm' l'tvn nvr' yqdt'
verses.translation: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֜יִן גֻּבְרַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֗ךְ כְּפִ֨תוּ֙ בְּ/סַרְבָּלֵי/הוֹן֙ פטישי/הון פַּטְּשֵׁי/ה֔וֹן וְ/כַרְבְּלָתְ/ה֖וֹן וּ/לְבֻשֵׁי/ה֑וֹן וּ/רְמִ֕יו לְ/גֽוֹא אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖/א יָקִֽדְתָּֽ/א
verses.translit: b'dyn gbry' 'lkh khptv bsrblyhvn ptyshyhvn ptshyhvn vkhrblthvn vlbshyhvn vrmyv lgv' 'tvn nvr' yqdt'
verses.translation: Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֗ה מִן דִּ֞י מִלַּ֤ת מַלְכָּ/א֙ מַחְצְפָ֔ה וְ/אַתּוּנָ֖/א אֵזֵ֣ה יַתִּ֑ירָא גֻּבְרַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֗ךְ דִּ֤י הַסִּ֨קוּ֙ לְ/שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹ קַטִּ֣ל הִמּ֔וֹן שְׁבִיבָ֖/א דִּ֥י נוּרָֽ/א
verses.translit: khl qbl dnh mn dy mlt mlkh' mchtsph v'tvn' 'zh ytyr' gbry' 'lkh dy hsqv lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv qtl hmvn shbyb' dy nvr'
verses.translation: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.

verses.original: וְ/גֻבְרַיָּ֤/א אִלֵּךְ֙ תְּלָ֣תֵּ/ה֔וֹן שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ נְפַ֛לוּ לְ/גֽוֹא אַתּוּן נוּרָ֥/א יָֽקִדְתָּ֖/א מְכַפְּתִֽין
verses.translit: vgbry' 'lkh tlthvn shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv nplv lgv' 'tvn nvr' yqdt' mkhptyn
verses.translation: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן֙ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֔/א תְּוַ֖הּ וְ/קָ֣ם בְּ/הִתְבְּהָלָ֑ה עָנֵ֨ה וְ/אָמַ֜ר לְ/הַדָּֽבְר֗וֹ/הִי הֲ/לָא֩ גֻבְרִ֨ין תְּלָתָ֜א רְמֵ֤ינָא לְ/גוֹא נוּרָ/א֙ מְכַפְּתִ֔ין עָנַ֤יִן וְ/אָמְרִין֙ לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/א יַצִּיבָ֖א מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: 'dyn nbvkhdntsr mlkh' tvh vqm bhtbhlh 'nh v'mr lhdbrvhy hl' gbryn tlt' rmyn' lgv' nvr' mkhptyn 'nyn v'mryn lmlkh' ytsyb' mlkh'
verses.translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, and spake, and said unto his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.

verses.original: עָנֵ֣ה וְ/אָמַ֗ר הָֽא אֲנָ֨ה חָזֵ֜ה גֻּבְרִ֣ין אַרְבְּעָ֗ה שְׁרַ֨יִן֙ מַהְלְכִ֣ין בְּ/גֽוֹא נוּרָ֔/א וַ/חֲבָ֖ל לָא אִיתַ֣י בְּ/ה֑וֹן וְ/רֵוֵ/הּ֙ דִּ֣י רביעי/א רְֽבִיעָ/אָ֔ה דָּמֵ֖ה לְ/בַר אֱלָהִֽין
verses.translit: 'nh v'mr h' 'nh chzh gbryn 'rb'h shryn mhlkhyn bgv' nvr' vchbl l' 'yty bhvn vrvh dy rby'y' rby''h dmh lbr 'lhyn
verses.translation: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֜יִן קְרֵ֣ב נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר לִ/תְרַע֮ אַתּ֣וּן נוּרָ֣/א יָקִֽדְתָּ/א֒ עָנֵ֣ה וְ/אָמַ֗ר שַׁדְרַ֨ךְ מֵישַׁ֧ךְ וַ/עֲבֵד נְג֛וֹ עַבְד֛וֹ/הִי דִּֽי אֱלָהָ֥/א עלי/א עִלָּאָ֖/ה פֻּ֣קוּ וֶ/אֱת֑וֹ בֵּ/אדַ֣יִן נָֽפְקִ֗ין שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֛ךְ וַ/עֲבֵ֥ד נְג֖וֹ מִן גּ֥וֹא נוּרָֽ/א
verses.translit: b'dyn qrb nbvkhdntsr ltr' 'tvn nvr' yqdt' 'nh v'mr shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv 'bdvhy dy 'lh' 'ly' 'l'h pqv v'tv b'dyn npqyn shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv mn gv' nvr'
verses.translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come hither . Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth of the midst of the fire.

verses.original: וּ֠/מִֽתְכַּנְּשִׁין אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֞/א סִגְנַיָּ֣/א וּ/פַחֲוָתָ/א֮ וְ/הַדָּבְרֵ֣י מַלְכָּ/א֒ חָזַ֣יִן לְ/גֻבְרַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֡ךְ דִּי֩ לָֽא שְׁלֵ֨ט נוּרָ֜/א בְּ/גֶשְׁמְ/ה֗וֹן וּ/שְׂעַ֤ר רֵֽאשְׁ/הוֹן֙ לָ֣א הִתְחָרַ֔ךְ וְ/סָרְבָּלֵי/ה֖וֹן לָ֣א שְׁנ֑וֹ וְ/רֵ֣יחַ נ֔וּר לָ֥א עֲדָ֖ת בְּ/הֽוֹן
verses.translit: vmtkhnshyn 'chshdrpny' sgny' vpchvt' vhdbry mlkh' chzyn lgbry' 'lkh dy l' shlt nvr' bgshmhvn vsh'r r'shhvn l' htchrkh vsrblyhvn l' shnv vrych nvr l' 'dt bhvn
verses.translation: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king’s counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.

verses.original: עָנֵ֨ה נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֜ר וְ/אָמַ֗ר בְּרִ֤יךְ אֱלָהֲ/הוֹן֙ דִּֽי שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹ דִּֽי שְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאֲכֵ/הּ֙ וְ/שֵׁיזִ֣ב לְ/עַבְד֔וֹ/הִי דִּ֥י הִתְרְחִ֖צוּ עֲל֑וֹ/הִי וּ/מִלַּ֤ת מַלְכָּ/א֙ שַׁנִּ֔יו וִ/יהַ֣בוּ גשמי/הון גֶשְׁמְ/ה֗וֹן דִּ֠י לָֽא יִפְלְח֤וּן וְ/לָֽא יִסְגְּדוּן֙ לְ/כָל אֱלָ֔הּ לָהֵ֖ן לֵ/אלָֽהֲ/הֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'nh nbvkhdntsr v'mr brykh 'lhhvn dy shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv dy shlch ml'khh vshyzb l'bdvhy dy htrchtsv 'lvhy vmlt mlkh' shnyv vyhbv gshmyhvn gshmhvn dy l' yplchvn vl' ysgdvn lkhl 'lh lhn l'lhhvn
verses.translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/נִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּי֩ כָל עַ֨ם אֻמָּ֜ה וְ/לִשָּׁ֗ן דִּֽי יֵאמַ֤ר שלה שָׁלוּ֙ עַ֣ל אֱלָהֲ/ה֗וֹן דִּֽי שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַ/עֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹא הַדָּמִ֣ין יִתְעֲבֵ֔ד וּ/בַיְתֵ֖/הּ נְוָלִ֣י יִשְׁתַּוֵּ֑ה כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֣י לָ֤א אִיתַי֙ אֱלָ֣ה אָחֳרָ֔ן דִּֽי יִכֻּ֥ל לְ/הַצָּלָ֖ה כִּ/דְנָֽה
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm dy khl 'm 'mh vlshn dy y'mr shlh shlv 'l 'lhhvn dy shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv' hdmyn yt'bd vbyth nvly yshtvh khl qbl dy l' 'yty 'lh 'chrn dy ykhl lhtslh khdnh
verses.translation: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֣יִן מַלְכָּ֗/א הַצְלַ֛ח לְ/שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֛ךְ וַ/עֲבֵ֥ד נְג֖וֹ בִּ/מְדִינַ֥ת בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' htslch lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv bmdynt bbl
verses.translation: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.

verses.original: אֲנָ֣ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר שְׁלֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּ/בֵיתִ֔/י וְ/רַעְנַ֖ן בְּ/הֵיכְלִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'nh nbvkhdntsr shlh hvyt bbyty vr'nn bhykhly
verses.translation: Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

verses.original: חֵ֥לֶם חֲזֵ֖ית וִֽ/ידַחֲלִנַּ֑/נִי וְ/הַרְהֹרִין֙ עַֽל מִשְׁכְּבִ֔/י וְ/חֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖/י יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: chlm chzyt vydchlnny vhrhryn 'l mshkhby vchzvy r'shy ybhlnny
verses.translation: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me.

verses.original: וּ/מִנִּ/י֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְ/הַנְעָלָ֣ה קָֽדָמַ֔/י לְ/כֹ֖ל חַכִּימֵ֣י בָבֶ֑ל דִּֽי פְשַׁ֥ר חֶלְמָ֖/א יְהֽוֹדְעֻנַּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm lhn'lh qdmy lkhl chkhymy bbl dy pshr chlm' yhvd'nny
verses.translation: How great are his signs! and how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֣יִן עללין עָלִּ֗ין חַרְטֻמַיָּ/א֙ אָֽשְׁפַיָּ֔/א כשדי/א כַּשְׂדָּאֵ֖/י וְ/גָזְרַיָּ֑/א וְ/חֶלְמָ֗/א אָמַ֤ר אֲנָה֙ קֳדָ֣מֵי/ה֔וֹן וּ/פִשְׁרֵ֖/הּ לָא מְהוֹדְעִ֥ין לִֽ/י
verses.translit: b'dyn 'llyn 'lyn chrtmy' 'shpy' khshdy' khshd'y vgzry' vchlm' 'mr 'nh qdmyhvn vpshrh l' mhvd'yn ly
verses.translation: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace:

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ד אָחֳרֵ֡ין עַל֩ קָֽדָמַ֨/י דָּנִיֵּ֜אל דִּֽי שְׁמֵ֤/הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר֙ כְּ/שֻׁ֣ם אֱלָהִ֔/י וְ/דִ֛י רֽוּחַ אֱלָהִ֥ין קַדִּישִׁ֖ין בֵּ֑/הּ וְ/חֶלְמָ֖/א קָֽדָמ֥וֹ/הִי אַמְרֵֽת
verses.translit: v'd 'chryn 'l qdmy dny'l dy shmh bltsh'tsr khshm 'lhy vdy rvch 'lhyn qdyshyn bh vchlm' qdmvhy 'mrt
verses.translation: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

verses.original: בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר֮ רַ֣ב חַרְטֻמַיָּ/א֒ דִּ֣י אֲנָ֣ה יִדְעֵ֗ת דִּ֠י ר֣וּחַ אֱלָהִ֤ין קַדִּישִׁין֙ בָּ֔/ךְ וְ/כָל רָ֖ז לָא אָנֵ֣ס לָ֑/ךְ חֶזְוֵ֨י חֶלְמִ֧/י דִֽי חֲזֵ֛ית וּ/פִשְׁרֵ֖/הּ אֱמַֽר
verses.translit: bltsh'tsr rb chrtmy' dy 'nh yd't dy rvch 'lhyn qdyshyn bkh vkhl rz l' 'ns lkh chzvy chlmy dy chzyt vpshrh 'mr
verses.translation: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.

verses.original: וְ/חֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖/י עַֽל מִשְׁכְּבִ֑/י חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית וַ/אֲל֥וּ אִילָ֛ן בְּ/ג֥וֹא אַרְעָ֖/א וְ/רוּמֵ֥/הּ שַׂגִּֽיא
verses.translit: vchzvy r'shy 'l mshkhby chzh hvyt v'lv 'yln bgv' 'r'' vrvmh shgy'
verses.translation: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.

verses.original: רְבָ֥ה אִֽילָנָ֖/א וּ/תְקִ֑ף וְ/רוּמֵ/הּ֙ יִמְטֵ֣א לִ/שְׁמַיָּ֔/א וַ/חֲזוֹתֵ֖/הּ לְ/ס֥וֹף כָּל אַרְעָֽ/א
verses.translit: rbh 'yln' vtqf vrvmh ymt' lshmy' vchzvth lsvf khl 'r''
verses.translation: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, saying ,

verses.original: עָפְיֵ֤/הּ שַׁפִּיר֙ וְ/אִנְבֵּ֣/הּ שַׂגִּ֔יא וּ/מָז֨וֹן לְ/כֹ֖לָּ/א בֵ֑/הּ תְּחֹת֜וֹ/הִי תַּטְלֵ֣ל חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָ֗/א וּ/בְ/עַנְפ֨וֹ/הִי֙ ידרון יְדוּרָן֙ צִפֲּרֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔/א וּ/מִנֵּ֖/הּ יִתְּזִ֥ין כָּל בִּשְׂרָֽ/א
verses.translit: 'pyh shpyr v'nbh shgy' vmzvn lkhl' bh tchtvhy ttll chyvt br' vb'npvhy ydrvn ydvrn tspry shmy' vmnh ytzyn khl bshr'
verses.translation: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee, and no secret troubleth thee, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.

verses.original: חָזֵ֥ה הֲוֵ֛ית בְּ/חֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖/י עַֽל מִשְׁכְּבִ֑/י וַ/אֲלוּ֙ עִ֣יר וְ/קַדִּ֔ישׁ מִן שְׁמַיָּ֖/א נָחִֽת
verses.translit: chzh hvyt bchzvy r'shy 'l mshkhby v'lv 'yr vqdysh mn shmy' ncht
verses.translation: Thus were the visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof was great.

verses.original: קָרֵ֨א בְ/חַ֜יִל וְ/כֵ֣ן אָמַ֗ר גֹּ֤דּוּ אִֽילָנָ/א֙ וְ/קַצִּ֣צוּ עַנְפ֔וֹ/הִי אַתַּ֥רוּ עָפְיֵ֖/הּ וּ/בַדַּ֣רוּ אִנְבֵּ֑/הּ תְּנֻ֤ד חֵֽיוְתָ/א֙ מִן תַּחְתּ֔וֹ/הִי וְ/צִפְּרַיָּ֖/א מִן עַנְפֽוֹ/הִי
verses.translit: qr' bchyl vkhn 'mr gdv 'yln' vqtstsv 'npvhy 'trv 'pyh vbdrv 'nbh tnd chyvt' mn tchtvhy vtspry' mn 'npvhy
verses.translation: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:

verses.original: בְּרַ֨ם עִקַּ֤ר שָׁרְשׁ֨וֹ/הִי֙ בְּ/אַרְעָ֣/א שְׁבֻ֔קוּ וּ/בֶֽ/אֱסוּר֙ דִּֽי פַרְזֶ֣ל וּ/נְחָ֔שׁ בְּ/דִתְאָ֖/א דִּ֣י בָרָ֑/א וּ/בְ/טַ֤ל שְׁמַיָּ/א֙ יִצְטַבַּ֔ע וְ/עִם חֵיוְתָ֥/א חֲלָקֵ֖/הּ בַּ/עֲשַׂ֥ב אַרְעָֽ/א
verses.translit: brm 'qr shrshvhy b'r'' shbqv vb'svr dy przl vnchsh bdt'' dy br' vbtl shmy' ytstb' v'm chyvt' chlqh b'shb 'r''
verses.translation: The leaves thereof were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.

verses.original: לִבְבֵ/הּ֙ מִן אנוש/א אֲנָשָׁ֣/א יְשַׁנּ֔וֹן וּ/לְבַ֥ב חֵיוָ֖ה יִתְיְהִ֣ב לֵ֑/הּ וְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֥וּן עֲלֽוֹ/הִי
verses.translit: lbbh mn 'nvsh' 'nsh' yshnvn vlbb chyvh ytyhb lh vshb'h 'dnyn ychlpvn 'lvhy
verses.translation: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;

verses.original: בִּ/גְזֵרַ֤ת עִירִין֙ פִּתְגָמָ֔/א וּ/מֵאמַ֥ר קַדִּישִׁ֖ין שְׁאֵֽלְתָ֑/א עַד דִּבְרַ֡ת דִּ֣י יִנְדְּע֣וּן חַ֠יַּיָּ/א דִּֽי שַׁלִּ֨יט עלי/א עִלָּאָ֜/ה בְּ/מַלְכ֣וּת אנוש/א אֲנָשָׁ֗/א וּ/לְ/מַן דִּ֤י יִצְבֵּא֙ יִתְּנִנַּ֔/הּ וּ/שְׁפַ֥ל אֲנָשִׁ֖ים יְקִ֥ים עלי/ה עֲלַֽ/הּ
verses.translit: bgzrt 'yryn ptgm' vm'mr qdyshyn sh'lt' 'd dbrt dy ynd'vn chyy' dy shlyt 'ly' 'l'h bmlkhvt 'nvsh' 'nsh' vlmn dy ytsb' ytnnh vshpl 'nshym yqym 'lyh 'lh
verses.translation: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:

verses.original: דְּנָה֙ חֶלְמָ֣/א חֲזֵ֔ית אֲנָ֖ה מַלְכָּ֣/א נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֑ר ו/אנתה וְ/אַ֨נְתְּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֜ר פִּשְׁרֵ֣/א אֱמַ֗ר כָּ/ל קֳבֵל֙ דִּ֣י כָּל חַכִּימֵ֣י מַלְכוּתִ֗/י לָֽא יָכְלִ֤ין פִּשְׁרָ/א֙ לְ/הוֹדָ֣עֻתַ֔/נִי ו/אנתה וְ/אַ֣נְתְּ כָּהֵ֔ל דִּ֛י רֽוּחַ אֱלָהִ֥ין קַדִּישִׁ֖ין בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: dnh chlm' chzyt 'nh mlkh' nbvkhdntsr v'nth v'nt bltsh'tsr pshr' 'mr khl qbl dy khl chkhymy mlkhvty l' ykhlyn pshr' lhvd'tny v'nth v'nt khhl dy rvch 'lhyn qdyshyn bkh
verses.translation: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן דָּֽנִיֵּ֜אל דִּֽי שְׁמֵ֣/הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֗ר אֶשְׁתּוֹמַם֙ כְּ/שָׁעָ֣ה חֲדָ֔ה וְ/רַעְיֹנֹ֖/הִי יְבַהֲלֻנֵּ֑/הּ עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜/א וְ/אָמַ֗ר בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר֙ חֶלְמָ֤/א וּ/פִשְׁרֵ/א֙ אַֽל יְבַהֲלָ֔/ךְ עָנֵ֤ה בֵלְטְשַׁאצַּר֙ וְ/אָמַ֔ר מרא/י מָרִ֕/י חֶלְמָ֥/א ל/שנאי/ך לְ/שָֽׂנְאָ֖/ךְ וּ/פִשְׁרֵ֥/הּ ל/ערי/ך לְ/עָרָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'dyn dny'l dy shmh bltsh'tsr 'shtvmm khsh'h chdh vr'ynhy ybhlnh 'nh mlkh' v'mr bltsh'tsr chlm' vpshr' 'l ybhlkh 'nh bltsh'tsr v'mr mr'y mry chlm' lshn'ykh lshn'kh vpshrh l'rykh l'rkh
verses.translation: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let a beast’s heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.

verses.original: אִֽילָנָ/א֙ דִּ֣י חֲזַ֔יְתָ דִּ֥י רְבָ֖ה וּ/תְקִ֑ף וְ/רוּמֵ/הּ֙ יִמְטֵ֣א לִ/שְׁמַיָּ֔/א וַ/חֲזוֹתֵ֖/הּ לְ/כָל אַרְעָֽ/א
verses.translit: 'yln' dy chzyt dy rbh vtqf vrvmh ymt' lshmy' vchzvth lkhl 'r''
verses.translation: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.

verses.original: וְ/עָפְיֵ֤/הּ שַׁפִּיר֙ וְ/אִנְבֵּ֣/הּ שַׂגִּ֔יא וּ/מָז֨וֹן לְ/כֹ֖לָּ/א בֵ֑/הּ תְּחֹת֗וֹ/הִי תְּדוּר֙ חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָ֔/א וּ/בְ/עַנְפ֕וֹ/הִי יִשְׁכְּנָ֖ן צִפֲּרֵ֥י שְׁמַיָּֽ/א
verses.translit: v'pyh shpyr v'nbh shgy' vmzvn lkhl' bh tchtvhy tdvr chyvt br' vb'npvhy yshkhnn tspry shmy'
verses.translation: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but thou art able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee.

verses.original: אנתה אַנְתְּ ה֣וּא מַלְכָּ֔/א דִּ֥י רְבַ֖ית וּ/תְקֵ֑פְתְּ וּ/רְבוּתָ֤/ךְ רְבָת֙ וּ/מְטָ֣ת לִ/שְׁמַיָּ֔/א וְ/שָׁלְטָנָ֖/ךְ לְ/ס֥וֹף אַרְעָֽ/א
verses.translit: 'nth 'nt hv' mlkh' dy rbyt vtqpt vrbvtkh rbt vmtt lshmy' vshltnkh lsvf 'r''
verses.translation: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.

verses.original: וְ/דִ֣י חֲזָ֣ה מַלְכָּ֡/א עִ֣יר וְ/קַדִּ֣ישׁ נָחִ֣ת מִן שְׁמַיָּ֡/א וְ/אָמַר֩ גֹּ֨דּוּ אִֽילָנָ֜/א וְ/חַבְּל֗וּ/הִי בְּרַ֨ם עִקַּ֤ר שָׁרְשׁ֨וֹ/הִי֙ בְּ/אַרְעָ֣/א שְׁבֻ֔קוּ וּ/בֶ/אֱסוּר֙ דִּֽי פַרְזֶ֣ל וּ/נְחָ֔שׁ בְּ/דִתְאָ֖/א דִּ֣י בָרָ֑/א וּ/בְ/טַ֧ל שְׁמַיָּ֣/א יִצְטַבַּ֗ע וְ/עִם חֵיוַ֤ת בָּרָ/א֙ חֲלָקֵ֔/הּ עַ֛ד דִּֽי שִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֥וּן עֲלֽוֹ/הִי
verses.translit: vdy chzh mlkh' 'yr vqdysh ncht mn shmy' v'mr gdv 'yln' vchblvhy brm 'qr shrshvhy b'r'' shbqv vb'svr dy przl vnchsh bdt'' dy br' vbtl shmy' ytstb' v'm chyvt br' chlqh 'd dy shb'h 'dnyn ychlpvn 'lvhy
verses.translation: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;

verses.original: דְּנָ֥ה פִשְׁרָ֖/א מַלְכָּ֑/א וּ/גְזֵרַ֤ת עלי/א עִלָּאָ/ה֙ הִ֔יא דִּ֥י מְטָ֖ת עַל מרא/י מָרִ֥/י מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: dnh pshr' mlkh' vgzrt 'ly' 'l'h hy' dy mtt 'l mr'y mry mlkh'
verses.translation: Whose leaves were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:

verses.original: וְ/לָ֣/ךְ טָֽרְדִ֣ין מִן אֲנָשָׁ֡/א וְ/עִם חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָ/א֩ לֶהֱוֵ֨ה מְדֹרָ֜/ךְ וְ/עִשְׂבָּ֥/א כְ/תוֹרִ֣ין לָ֣/ךְ יְטַֽעֲמ֗וּן וּ/מִ/טַּ֤ל שְׁמַיָּ/א֙ לָ֣/ךְ מְצַבְּעִ֔ין וְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֣וּן עֲלָ֑/יךְ עַ֣ד דִּֽי תִנְדַּ֗ע דִּֽי שַׁלִּ֤יט עִלָּיָ/א֙ בְּ/מַלְכ֣וּת אֲנָשָׁ֔/א וּ/לְ/מַן דִּ֥י יִצְבֵּ֖א יִתְּנִנַּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vlkh trdyn mn 'nsh' v'm chyvt br' lhvh mdrkh v'shb' khtvryn lkh yt'mvn vmtl shmy' lkh mtsb'yn vshb'h 'dnyn ychlpvn 'lykh 'd dy tnd' dy shlyt 'ly' bmlkhvt 'nsh' vlmn dy ytsb' ytnnh
verses.translation: It is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/דִ֣י אֲמַ֗רוּ לְ/מִשְׁבַּ֞ק עִקַּ֤ר שָׁרְשׁ֨וֹ/הִי֙ דִּ֣י אִֽילָנָ֔/א מַלְכוּתָ֖/ךְ לָ֣/ךְ קַיָּמָ֑ה מִן דִּ֣י תִנְדַּ֔ע דִּ֥י שַׁלִּטִ֖ן שְׁמַיָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vdy 'mrv lmshbq 'qr shrshvhy dy 'yln' mlkhvtkh lkh qymh mn dy tnd' dy shltn shmy'
verses.translation: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him;

verses.original: לָהֵ֣ן מַלְכָּ֗/א מִלְכִּ/י֙ יִשְׁפַּ֣ר עלי/ך עֲלָ֔/ךְ ו/חטי/ך וַ/חֲטָאָ/ךְ֙ בְּ/צִדְקָ֣ה פְרֻ֔ק וַ/עֲוָיָתָ֖/ךְ בְּ/מִחַ֣ן עֲנָ֑יִן הֵ֛ן תֶּהֱוֵ֥א אַרְכָ֖ה לִ/שְׁלֵוְתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lhn mlkh' mlkhy yshpr 'lykh 'lkh vchtykh vcht'kh btsdqh prq v'vytkh bmchn 'nyn hn thv' 'rkhh lshlvtkh
verses.translation: This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:

verses.original: כֹּ֣לָּ/א מְּטָ֔א עַל נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: khl' mt' 'l nbvkhdntsr mlkh'
verses.translation: That they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.

verses.original: לִ/קְצָ֥ת יַרְחִ֖ין תְּרֵֽי עֲשַׂ֑ר עַל הֵיכַ֧ל מַלְכוּתָ֛/א דִּ֥י בָבֶ֖ל מְהַלֵּ֥ךְ הֲוָֽה
verses.translit: lqtst yrchyn try 'shr 'l hykhl mlkhvt' dy bbl mhlkh hvh
verses.translation: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּ/א֙ וְ/אָמַ֔ר הֲ/לָ֥א דָא הִ֖יא בָּבֶ֣ל רַבְּתָ֑/א דִּֽי אֲנָ֤ה בֱנַיְתַ/הּ֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית מַלְכ֔וּ בִּ/תְקַ֥ף חִסְנִ֖/י וְ/לִ/יקָ֥ר הַדְרִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'nh mlkh' v'mr hl' d' hy' bbl rbt' dy 'nh bnyth lbyt mlkhv btqf chsny vlyqr hdry
verses.translation: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.

verses.original: ע֗וֹד מִלְּתָ/א֙ בְּ/פֻ֣ם מַלְכָּ֔/א קָ֖ל מִן שְׁמַיָּ֣/א נְפַ֑ל לָ֤/ךְ אָֽמְרִין֙ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֔/א מַלְכוּתָ֖/ה עֲדָ֥ת מִנָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'vd mlt' bpm mlkh' ql mn shmy' npl lkh 'mryn nbvkhdntsr mlkh' mlkhvth 'dt mnkh
verses.translation: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.original: וּ/מִן אֲנָשָׁ/א֩ לָ֨/ךְ טָֽרְדִ֜ין וְֽ/עִם חֵיוַ֧ת בָּרָ֣/א מְדֹרָ֗/ךְ עִשְׂבָּ֤/א כְ/תוֹרִין֙ לָ֣/ךְ יְטַעֲמ֔וּן וְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֣וּן עלי/ך עֲלָ֑/ךְ עַ֣ד דִּֽי תִנְדַּ֗ע דִּֽי שַׁלִּ֤יט עִלָּיָ/א֙ בְּ/מַלְכ֣וּת אֲנָשָׁ֔/א וּ/לְ/מַן דִּ֥י יִצְבֵּ֖א יִתְּנִנַּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vmn 'nsh' lkh trdyn v'm chyvt br' mdrkh 'shb' khtvryn lkh yt'mvn vshb'h 'dnyn ychlpvn 'lykh 'lkh 'd dy tnd' dy shlyt 'ly' bmlkhvt 'nsh' vlmn dy ytsb' ytnnh
verses.translation: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

verses.original: בַּ/הּ שַׁעֲתָ֗/א מִלְּתָ/א֮ סָ֣פַת עַל נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר֒ וּ/מִן אֲנָשָׁ֣/א טְרִ֔יד וְ/עִשְׂבָּ֤/א כְ/תוֹרִין֙ יֵאכֻ֔ל וּ/מִ/טַּ֥ל שְׁמַיָּ֖/א גִּשְׁמֵ֣/הּ יִצְטַבַּ֑ע עַ֣ד דִּ֥י שַׂעְרֵ֛/הּ כְּ/נִשְׁרִ֥ין רְבָ֖ה וְ/טִפְר֥וֹ/הִי כְ/צִפְּרִֽין
verses.translit: bh sh't' mlt' spt 'l nbvkhdntsr vmn 'nsh' tryd v'shb' khtvryn y'khl vmtl shmy' gshmh ytstb' 'd dy sh'rh khnshryn rbh vtprvhy khtspryn
verses.translation: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?

verses.original: וְ/לִ/קְצָ֣ת יֽוֹמַיָּ/ה֩ אֲנָ֨ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֜ר עַיְנַ֣/י לִ/שְׁמַיָּ֣/א נִטְלֵ֗ת וּ/מַנְדְּעִ/י֙ עֲלַ֣/י יְת֔וּב ו/ל/עלי/א וּ/לְ/עִלָּאָ/ה֙ בָּרְכֵ֔ת וּ/לְ/חַ֥י עָלְמָ֖/א שַׁבְּחֵ֣ת וְ/הַדְּרֵ֑ת דִּ֤י שָׁלְטָנֵ/הּ֙ שָׁלְטָ֣ן עָלַ֔ם וּ/מַלְכוּתֵ֖/הּ עִם דָּ֥ר וְ/דָֽר
verses.translit: vlqtst yvmyh 'nh nbvkhdntsr 'yny lshmy' ntlt vmnd'y 'ly ytvb vl'ly' vl'l'h brkht vlchy 'lm' shbcht vhdrt dy shltnh shltn 'lm vmlkhvth 'm dr vdr
verses.translation: While the word was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, saying , O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.

verses.original: וְ/כָל דארי דָּיְרֵ֤י אַרְעָ/א֙ כְּ/לָ֣ה חֲשִׁיבִ֔ין וּֽ/כְ/מִצְבְּיֵ֗/הּ עָבֵד֙ בְּ/חֵ֣יל שְׁמַיָּ֔/א ו/דארי וְ/דָיְרֵ֖י אַרְעָ֑/א וְ/לָ֤א אִיתַי֙ דִּֽי יְמַחֵ֣א בִ/ידֵ֔/הּ וְ/יֵ֥אמַר לֵ֖/הּ מָ֥ה עֲבַֽדְתְּ
verses.translit: vkhl d'ry dyry 'r'' khlh chshybyn vkhmtsbyh 'bd bchyl shmy' vd'ry vdyry 'r'' vl' 'yty dy ymch' bydh vy'mr lh mh 'bdt
verses.translation: And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.

verses.original: בֵּ/הּ זִמְנָ֞/א מַנְדְּעִ֣/י יְת֣וּב עֲלַ֗/י וְ/לִ/יקַ֨ר מַלְכוּתִ֜/י הַדְרִ֤/י וְ/זִוִ/י֙ יְת֣וּב עֲלַ֔/י וְ/לִ֕/י הַדָּֽבְרַ֥/י וְ/רַבְרְבָנַ֖/י יְבַע֑וֹן וְ/עַל מַלְכוּתִ֣/י הָתְקְנַ֔ת וּ/רְב֥וּ יַתִּירָ֖ה ה֥וּסְפַת לִֽ/י
verses.translit: bh zmn' mnd'y ytvb 'ly vlyqr mlkhvty hdry vzvy ytvb 'ly vly hdbry vrbrbny yb'vn v'l mlkhvty htqnt vrbv ytyrh hvspt ly
verses.translation: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles’ feathers , and his nails like birds’ claws .

verses.original: כְּעַ֞ן אֲנָ֣ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר מְשַׁבַּ֨ח וּ/מְרוֹמֵ֤ם וּ/מְהַדַּר֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ שְׁמַיָּ֔/א דִּ֤י כָל מַעֲבָד֨וֹ/הִי֙ קְשֹׁ֔ט וְ/אֹרְחָתֵ֖/הּ דִּ֑ין וְ/דִי֙ מַהְלְכִ֣ין בְּ/גֵוָ֔ה יָכִ֖ל לְ/הַשְׁפָּלָֽה
verses.translit: kh'n 'nh nbvkhdntsr mshbch vmrvmm vmhdr lmlkh shmy' dy khl m'bdvhy qsht v'rchth dyn vdy mhlkhyn bgvh ykhl lhshplh
verses.translation: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom is from generation to generation:

And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?

At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.
Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.

verses.original: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗/א עֲבַד֙ לְחֶ֣ם רַ֔ב לְ/רַבְרְבָנ֖וֹ/הִי אֲלַ֑ף וְ/לָ/קֳבֵ֥ל אַלְפָּ֖/א חַמְרָ֥/א שָׁתֵֽה
verses.translit: blsh'tsr mlkh' 'bd lchm rb lrbrbnvhy 'lf vlqbl 'lp' chmr' shth
verses.translation: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

verses.original: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֞ר אֲמַ֣ר בִּ/טְעֵ֣ם חַמְרָ֗/א לְ/הַיְתָיָה֙ לְ/מָאנֵי֙ דַּהֲבָ֣/א וְ/כַסְפָּ֔/א דִּ֤י הַנְפֵּק֙ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר אֲב֔/וּהִי מִן הֵיכְלָ֖/א דִּ֣י בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְ/יִשְׁתּ֣וֹן בְּ/ה֗וֹן מַלְכָּ/א֙ וְ/רַבְרְבָנ֔וֹ/הִי שֵׁגְלָתֵ֖/הּ וּ/לְחֵנָתֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: blsh'tsr 'mr bt'm chmr' lhytyh lm'ny dhb' vkhsp' dy hnpq nbvkhdntsr 'bvhy mn hykhl' dy byrvshlm vyshtvn bhvn mlkh' vrbrbnvhy shglth vlchnth
verses.translation: Belshazzar, whiles he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink therein.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֗יִן הַיְתִיו֙ מָאנֵ֣י דַהֲבָ֔/א דִּ֣י הַנְפִּ֗קוּ מִן הֵֽיכְלָ֛/א דִּֽי בֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖/א דִּ֣י בִ/ירֽוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְ/אִשְׁתִּ֣יו בְּ/ה֗וֹן מַלְכָּ/א֙ וְ/רַבְרְבָנ֔וֹ/הִי שֵׁגְלָתֵ֖/הּ וּ/לְחֵנָתֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: b'dyn hytyv m'ny dhb' dy hnpqv mn hykhl' dy byt 'lh' dy byrvshlm v'shtyv bhvn mlkh' vrbrbnvhy shglth vlchnth
verses.translation: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.

verses.original: אִשְׁתִּ֖יו חַמְרָ֑/א וְ֠/שַׁבַּחוּ לֵֽ/אלָהֵ֞י דַּהֲבָ֧/א וְ/כַסְפָּ֛/א נְחָשָׁ֥/א פַרְזְלָ֖/א אָעָ֥/א וְ/אַבְנָֽ/א
verses.translit: 'shtyv chmr' vshbchv l'lhy dhb' vkhsp' nchsh' przl' ''' v'bn'
verses.translation: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

verses.original: בַּ/הּ שַׁעֲתָ֗/ה נפקו נְפַ֨קָה֙ אֶצְבְּעָן֙ דִּ֣י יַד אֱנָ֔שׁ וְ/כָֽתְבָן֙ לָ/קֳבֵ֣ל נֶבְרַשְׁתָּ֔/א עַל גִּירָ֕/א דִּֽי כְתַ֥ל הֵיכְלָ֖/א דִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֑/א וּ/מַלְכָּ֣/א חָזֵ֔ה פַּ֥ס יְדָ֖/ה דִּ֥י כָתְבָֽה
verses.translit: bh sh'th npqv npqh 'tsb'n dy yd 'nsh vkhtbn lqbl nbrsht' 'l gyr' dy khtl hykhl' dy mlkh' vmlkh' chzh ps ydh dy khtbh
verses.translation: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

verses.original: אֱדַ֤יִן מַלְכָּ/א֙ זִיוֺ֣/הִי שְׁנ֔וֹ/הִי וְ/רַעיֹנֹ֖/הִי יְבַהֲלוּנֵּ֑/הּ וְ/קִטְרֵ֤י חַרְצֵ/הּ֙ מִשְׁתָּרַ֔יִן וְ/אַ֨רְכֻבָּתֵ֔/הּ דָּ֥א לְ/דָ֖א נָֽקְשָֽׁן
verses.translit: 'dyn mlkh' zyvhy shnvhy vr'ynhy ybhlvnh vqtry chrtsh mshtryn v'rkhbth d' ld' nqshn
verses.translation: Then the king’s countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.

verses.original: קָרֵ֤א מַלְכָּ/א֙ בְּ/חַ֔יִל לְ/הֶֽעָלָה֙ לְ/אָ֣שְׁפַיָּ֔/א כשדי/א כַּשְׂדָּאֵ֖/י וְ/גָזְרַיָּ֑/א עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜/א וְ/אָמַ֣ר לְ/חַכִּימֵ֣י בָבֶ֗ל דִּ֣י כָל אֱ֠נָשׁ דִּֽי יִקְרֵ֞ה כְּתָבָ֣/ה דְנָ֗ה וּ/פִשְׁרֵ/הּ֙ יְחַוִּנַּ֔/נִי אַרְגְּוָנָ֣/א יִלְבַּ֗שׁ ו/המונכ/א וְ/הַֽמְנִיכָ֤/א דִֽי דַהֲבָ/א֙ עַֽל צַוְּארֵ֔/הּ וְ/תַלְתִּ֥י בְ/מַלְכוּתָ֖/א יִשְׁלַֽט
verses.translit: qr' mlkh' bchyl lh'lh l'shpy' khshdy' khshd'y vgzry' 'nh mlkh' v'mr lchkhymy bbl dy khl 'nsh dy yqrh khtbh dnh vpshrh ychvnny 'rgvn' ylbsh vhmvnkh' vhmnykh' dy dhb' 'l tsv'rh vtlty bmlkhvt' yshlt
verses.translation: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. And the king spake, and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן֙ עללין עָֽלִּ֔ין כֹּ֖ל חַכִּימֵ֣י מַלְכָּ֑/א וְ/לָֽא כָהֲלִ֤ין כְּתָבָ/א֙ לְ/מִקְרֵ֔א ו/פשר/א וּ/פִשְׁרֵ֖/הּ לְ/הוֹדָעָ֥ה לְ/מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: 'dyn 'llyn 'lyn khl chkhymy mlkh' vl' khhlyn khtb' lmqr' vpshr' vpshrh lhvd'h lmlkh'
verses.translation: Then came in all the king’s wise men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן מַלְכָּ֤/א בֵלְשַׁאצַּר֙ שַׂגִּ֣יא מִתְבָּהַ֔ל וְ/זִיוֺ֖/הִי שָׁנַ֣יִן עֲל֑וֹ/הִי וְ/רַבְרְבָנ֖וֹ/הִי מִֽשְׁתַּבְּשִֽׁין
verses.translit: 'dyn mlkh' blsh'tsr shgy' mtbhl vzyvhy shnyn 'lvhy vrbrbnvhy mshtbshyn
verses.translation: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.

verses.original: מַלְכְּתָ֕/א לָ/קֳבֵ֨ל מִלֵּ֤י מַלְכָּ/א֙ וְ/רַבְרְבָנ֔וֹ/הִי לְ/בֵ֥ית מִשְׁתְּיָ֖/א עללת עַלַּ֑ת עֲנָ֨ת מַלְכְּתָ֜/א וַ/אֲמֶ֗רֶת מַלְכָּ/א֙ לְ/עָלְמִ֣ין חֱיִ֔י אַֽל יְבַהֲלוּ/ךְ֙ רַעְיוֹנָ֔/ךְ וְ/זִיוָ֖י/ךְ אַל יִשְׁתַּנּֽוֹ
verses.translit: mlkht' lqbl mly mlkh' vrbrbnvhy lbyt mshty' 'llt 'lt 'nt mlkht' v'mrt mlkh' l'lmyn chyy 'l ybhlvkh r'yvnkh vzyvykh 'l yshtnv
verses.translation: Now the queen, by reason of the words of the king and his lords, came into the banquet house: and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble thee, nor let thy countenance be changed:

verses.original: אִיתַ֨י גְּבַ֜ר בְּ/מַלְכוּתָ֗/ךְ דִּ֠י ר֣וּחַ אֱלָהִ֣ין קַדִּישִׁין֮ בֵּ/הּ֒ וּ/בְ/יוֹמֵ֣י אֲב֗/וּךְ נַהִיר֧וּ וְ/שָׂכְלְתָנ֛וּ וְ/חָכְמָ֥ה כְּ/חָכְמַת אֱלָהִ֖ין הִשְׁתְּכַ֣חַת בֵּ֑/הּ וּ/מַלְכָּ֤/א נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּר֙ אֲב֔/וּךְ רַ֧ב חַרְטֻמִּ֣ין אָֽשְׁפִ֗ין כַּשְׂדָּאִין֙ גָּזְרִ֔ין הֲקִימֵ֖/הּ אֲב֥/וּךְ מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: 'yty gbr bmlkhvtkh dy rvch 'lhyn qdyshyn bh vbyvmy 'bvkh nhyrv vshkhltnv vchkhmh khchkhmt 'lhyn hshtkhcht bh vmlkh' nbkhdntsr 'bvkh rb chrtmyn 'shpyn khshd'yn gzryn hqymh 'bvkh mlkh'
verses.translation: There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king, I say , thy father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֡ל דִּ֣י ר֣וּחַ יַתִּירָ֡ה וּ/מַנְדַּ֡ע וְ/שָׂכְלְתָנ֡וּ מְפַשַּׁ֣ר חֶלְמִין֩ וַֽ/אַֽחֲוָיַ֨ת אֲחִידָ֜ן וּ/מְשָׁרֵ֣א קִטְרִ֗ין הִשְׁתְּכַ֤חַת בֵּ/הּ֙ בְּ/דָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל דִּֽי מַלְכָּ֥/א שָׂם שְׁמֵ֖/הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר כְּעַ֛ן דָּנִיֵּ֥אל יִתְקְרֵ֖י וּ/פִשְׁרָ֥/ה יְהַֽחֲוֵֽה
verses.translit: khl qbl dy rvch ytyrh vmnd' vshkhltnv mpshr chlmyn v'chvyt 'chydn vmshr' qtryn hshtkhcht bh bdny'l dy mlkh' shm shmh bltsh'tsr kh'n dny'l ytqry vpshrh yhchvh
verses.translation: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֨יִן֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל הֻעַ֖ל קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֑/א עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜/א וְ/אָמַ֣ר לְ/דָנִיֵּ֗אל אנתה אַנְתְּ ה֤וּא דָנִיֵּאל֙ דִּֽי מִן בְּנֵ֤י גָלוּתָ/א֙ דִּ֣י יְה֔וּד דִּ֥י הַיְתִ֛י מַלְכָּ֥/א אַ֖בִ/י מִן יְהֽוּד
verses.translit: b'dyn dny'l h'l qdm mlkh' 'nh mlkh' v'mr ldny'l 'nth 'nt hv' dny'l dy mn bny glvt' dy yhvd dy hyty mlkh' 'by mn yhvd
verses.translation: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. And the king spake and said unto Daniel, Art thou that Daniel, which art of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?

verses.original: וְ/שִׁמְעֵ֣ת עלי/ך עֲלָ֔/ךְ דִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ אֱלָהִ֖ין בָּ֑/ךְ וְ/נַהִיר֧וּ וְ/שָׂכְלְתָנ֛וּ וְ/חָכְמָ֥ה יַתִּירָ֖ה הִשְׁתְּכַ֥חַת בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vshm't 'lykh 'lkh dy rvch 'lhyn bkh vnhyrv vshkhltnv vchkhmh ytyrh hshtkhcht bkh
verses.translation: I have even heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods is in thee, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee.

verses.original: וּ/כְעַ֞ן הֻעַ֣לּוּ קָֽדָמַ֗/י חַכִּֽימַיָּ/א֙ אָֽשְׁפַיָּ֔/א דִּֽי כְתָבָ֤/ה דְנָה֙ יִקְר֔וֹן וּ/פִשְׁרֵ֖/הּ לְ/הוֹדָעֻתַ֑/נִי וְ/לָֽא כָהֲלִ֥ין פְּשַֽׁר מִלְּתָ֖/א לְ/הַחֲוָיָֽה
verses.translit: vkh'n h'lv qdmy chkhymy' 'shpy' dy khtbh dnh yqrvn vpshrh lhvd'tny vl' khhlyn pshr mlt' lhchvyh
verses.translation: And now the wise men , the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:

verses.original: וַ/אֲנָה֙ שִׁמְעֵ֣ת עלי/ך עֲלָ֔/ךְ דִּֽי תוכל תִיכּ֥וּל פִּשְׁרִ֛ין לְ/מִפְשַׁ֖ר וְ/קִטְרִ֣ין לְ/מִשְׁרֵ֑א כְּעַ֡ן הֵן֩ תוכל תִּכ֨וּל כְּתָבָ֜/א לְ/מִקְרֵ֗א וּ/פִשְׁרֵ/הּ֙ לְ/הוֹדָ֣עֻתַ֔/נִי אַרְגְּוָנָ֣/א תִלְבַּ֗שׁ ו/המונכ/א וְ/הַֽמְנִיכָ֤/א דִֽי דַהֲבָ/א֙ עַֽל צַוְּארָ֔/ךְ וְ/תַלְתָּ֥א בְ/מַלְכוּתָ֖/א תִּשְׁלַֽט
verses.translit: v'nh shm't 'lykh 'lkh dy tvkhl tykhvl pshryn lmpshr vqtryn lmshr' kh'n hn tvkhl tkhvl khtb' lmqr' vpshrh lhvd'tny 'rgvn' tlbsh vhmvnkh' vhmnykh' dy dhb' 'l tsv'rkh vtlt' bmlkhvt' tshlt
verses.translation: And I have heard of thee, that thou canst make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, thou shalt be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֜יִן עָנֵ֣ה דָנִיֵּ֗אל וְ/אָמַר֙ קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֔/א מַתְּנָתָ/ךְ֙ לָ֣/ךְ לֶֽהֶוְיָ֔ן וּ/נְבָ֥זְבְּיָתָ֖/ךְ לְ/אָחֳרָ֣ן הַ֑ב בְּרַ֗ם כְּתָבָ/א֙ אֶקְרֵ֣א לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/א וּ/פִשְׁרָ֖/א אֲהוֹדְעִנֵּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: b'dyn 'nh dny'l v'mr qdm mlkh' mtntkh lkh lhvyn vnbzbytkh l'chrn hb brm khtb' 'qr' lmlkh' vpshr' 'hvd'nh
verses.translation: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another; yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

verses.original: אנתה אַ֖נְתְּ מַלְכָּ֑/א אֱלָהָ/א֙ עלי/א עִלָּאָ֔/ה מַלְכוּתָ֤/א וּ/רְבוּתָ/א֙ וִ/יקָרָ֣/א וְ/הַדְרָ֔/ה יְהַ֖ב לִ/נְבֻכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר אֲבֽ/וּךְ
verses.translit: 'nth 'nt mlkh' 'lh' 'ly' 'l'h mlkhvt' vrbvt' vyqr' vhdrh yhb lnbkhdntsr 'bvkh
verses.translation: O thou king, the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:

verses.original: וּ/מִן רְבוּתָ/א֙ דִּ֣י יְהַב לֵ֔/הּ כֹּ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗/א אֻמַיָּ/א֙ וְ/לִשָּׁ֣נַיָּ֔/א הֲו֛וֹ זאעין זָיְעִ֥ין וְ/דָחֲלִ֖ין מִן קֳדָמ֑וֹ/הִי דִּֽי הֲוָ֨ה צָבֵ֜א הֲוָ֣א קָטֵ֗ל וְ/דִֽי הֲוָ֤ה צָבֵא֙ הֲוָ֣ה מַחֵ֔א וְ/דִֽי הֲוָ֤ה צָבֵא֙ הֲוָ֣ה מָרִ֔ים וְ/דִֽי הֲוָ֥ה צָבֵ֖א הֲוָ֥ה מַשְׁפִּֽיל
verses.translit: vmn rbvt' dy yhb lh khl 'mmy' 'my' vlshny' hvv z''yn zy'yn vdchlyn mn qdmvhy dy hvh tsb' hv' qtl vdy hvh tsb' hvh mch' vdy hvh tsb' hvh mrym vdy hvh tsb' hvh mshpyl
verses.translation: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/דִי֙ רִ֣ם לִבְבֵ֔/הּ וְ/רוּחֵ֖/הּ תִּֽקְפַ֣ת לַ/הֲזָדָ֑ה הָנְחַת֙ מִן כָּרְסֵ֣א מַלְכוּתֵ֔/הּ וִֽ/יקָרָ֖/ה הֶעְדִּ֥יוּ מִנֵּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vkhdy rm lbbh vrvchh tqpt lhzdh hncht mn khrs' mlkhvth vyqrh h'dyv mnh
verses.translation: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵי֩ אֲנָשָׁ֨/א טְרִ֜יד וְ/לִבְבֵ֣/הּ עִם חֵיוְתָ֣/א שוי שַׁוִּ֗יְו וְ/עִם עֲרָֽדַיָּ/א֙ מְדוֹרֵ֔/הּ עִשְׂבָּ֤/א כְ/תוֹרִין֙ יְטַ֣עֲמוּנֵּ֔/הּ וּ/מִ/טַּ֥ל שְׁמַיָּ֖/א גִּשְׁמֵ֣/הּ יִצְטַבַּ֑ע עַ֣ד דִּֽי יְדַ֗ע דִּֽי שַׁלִּ֞יט אֱלָהָ֤/א עלי/א עִלָּאָ/ה֙ בְּ/מַלְכ֣וּת אֲנָשָׁ֔/א וּ/לְ/מַן דִּ֥י יִצְבֵּ֖ה יְהָקֵ֥ים עלי/ה עֲלַֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vmn bny 'nsh' tryd vlbbh 'm chyvt' shvy shvyv v'm 'rdy' mdvrh 'shb' khtvryn yt'mvnh vmtl shmy' gshmh ytstb' 'd dy yd' dy shlyt 'lh' 'ly' 'l'h bmlkhvt 'nsh' vlmn dy ytsbh yhqym 'lyh 'lh
verses.translation: And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling was with the wild asses: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men, and that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will.

verses.original: ו/אנתה וְ/אַ֤נְתְּ בְּרֵ/הּ֙ בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֔ר לָ֥א הַשְׁפֵּ֖לְתְּ לִבְבָ֑/ךְ כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֕ל דִּ֥י כָל דְּנָ֖ה יְדַֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: v'nth v'nt brh blsh'tsr l' hshplt lbbkh khl qbl dy khl dnh yd't
verses.translation: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל מָרֵֽא שְׁמַיָּ֣/א הִתְרוֹמַ֡מְתָּ וּ/לְ/מָֽאנַיָּ֨/א דִֽי בַיְתֵ֜/הּ הַיְתִ֣יו קדמי/ך קָֽדָמָ֗/ךְ ו/אנתה וְ/אַ֨נְתְּ ו/רברבני/ך וְ/רַבְרְבָנָ֜/ךְ שֵֽׁגְלָתָ֣/ךְ וּ/לְחֵנָתָ/ךְ֮ חַמְרָ/א֮ שָׁתַ֣יִן בְּ/הוֹן֒ וְ/לֵֽ/אלָהֵ֣י כַסְפָּֽ/א וְ֠/דַהֲבָ/א נְחָשָׁ֨/א פַרְזְלָ֜/א אָעָ֣/א וְ/אַבְנָ֗/א דִּ֠י לָֽא חָזַ֧יִן וְ/לָא שָׁמְעִ֛ין וְ/לָ֥א יָדְעִ֖ין שַׁבַּ֑חְתָּ וְ/לֵֽ/אלָהָ֞/א דִּֽי נִשְׁמְתָ֥/ךְ בִּ/ידֵ֛/הּ וְ/כָל אֹרְחָתָ֥/ךְ לֵ֖/הּ לָ֥א הַדַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: v'l mr' shmy' htrvmmt vlm'ny' dy byth hytyv qdmykh qdmkh v'nth v'nt vrbrbnykh vrbrbnkh shgltkh vlchntkh chmr' shtyn bhvn vl'lhy khsp' vdhb' nchsh' przl' ''' v'bn' dy l' chzyn vl' shm'yn vl' yd'yn shbcht vl'lh' dy nshmtkh bydh vkhl 'rchtkh lh l' hdrt
verses.translation: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath is , and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֨יִן֙ מִן קֳדָמ֔וֹ/הִי שְׁלִ֖יַחַ פַּסָּ֣/א דִֽי יְדָ֑/א וּ/כְתָבָ֥/א דְנָ֖ה רְשִֽׁים
verses.translit: b'dyn mn qdmvhy shlych ps' dy yd' vkhtb' dnh rshym
verses.translation: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.

verses.original: וּ/דְנָ֥ה כְתָבָ֖/א דִּ֣י רְשִׁ֑ים מְנֵ֥א מְנֵ֖א תְּקֵ֥ל וּ/פַרְסִֽין
verses.translit: vdnh khtb' dy rshym mn' mn' tql vprsyn
verses.translation: And this is the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

verses.original: דְּנָ֖ה פְּשַֽׁר מִלְּתָ֑/א מְנֵ֕א מְנָֽה אֱלָהָ֥/א מַלְכוּתָ֖/ךְ וְ/הַשְׁלְמַֽ/הּ
verses.translit: dnh pshr mlt' mn' mnh 'lh' mlkhvtkh vhshlmh
verses.translation: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it.

verses.original: תְּקֵ֑ל תְּקִ֥ילְתָּה בְ/מֹֽאזַנְיָ֖/א וְ/הִשְׁתְּכַ֥חַתְּ חַסִּֽיר
verses.translit: tql tqylth bm'zny' vhshtkhcht chsyr
verses.translation: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.

verses.original: פְּרֵ֑ס פְּרִיסַת֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔/ךְ וִ/יהִיבַ֖ת לְ/מָדַ֥י וּ/פָרָֽס
verses.translit: prs pryst mlkhvtkh vyhybt lmdy vprs
verses.translation: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֣יִן אֲמַ֣ר בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֗ר וְ/הַלְבִּ֤ישׁוּ לְ/דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ אַרְגְּוָנָ֔/א ו/המונכ/א וְ/הַֽמְנִיכָ֥/א דִֽי דַהֲבָ֖/א עַֽל צַוְּארֵ֑/הּ וְ/הַכְרִ֣זֽוּ עֲל֔וֹ/הִי דִּֽי לֶהֱוֵ֥א שַׁלִּ֛יט תַּלְתָּ֖א בְּ/מַלְכוּתָֽ/א
verses.translit: b'dyn 'mr blsh'tsr vhlbyshv ldny'l 'rgvn' vhmvnkh' vhmnykh' dy dhb' 'l tsv'rh vhkhrzv 'lvhy dy lhv' shlyt tlt' bmlkhvt'
verses.translation: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.original: בֵּ֚/הּ בְּ/לֵ֣ילְיָ֔/א קְטִ֕יל בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֖ר מַלְכָּ֥/א כשדי/א כַשְׂדָּאָֽ/ה
verses.translit: bh blyly' qtyl bl'shtsr mlkh' khshdy' khshd'h
verses.translation: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.
And Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.

verses.original: וְ/דָרְיָ֨וֶשׁ֙ מָֽדָיָ֔/א קַבֵּ֖ל מַלְכוּתָ֑/א כְּ/בַ֥ר שְׁנִ֖ין שִׁתִּ֥ין וְ/תַרְתֵּֽין
verses.translit: vdryvsh mdy' qbl mlkhvt' khbr shnyn shtyn vtrtyn
verses.translation: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;

verses.original: שְׁפַר֙ קֳדָ֣ם דָּרְיָ֔וֶשׁ וַ/הֲקִים֙ עַל מַלְכוּתָ֔/א לַ/אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֖/א מְאָ֣ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֑ין דִּ֥י לֶהֱוֺ֖ן בְּ/כָל מַלְכוּתָֽ/א
verses.translit: shpr qdm dryvsh vhqym 'l mlkhvt' l'chshdrpny' m'h v'shryn dy lhvn bkhl mlkhvt'
verses.translation: And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.

verses.original: וְ/עֵ֤לָּא מִנְּ/הוֹן֙ סָרְכִ֣ין תְּלָתָ֔א דִּ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל חַֽד מִנְּ/ה֑וֹן דִּֽי לֶהֱוֺ֞ן אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֗ין יָהֲבִ֤ין לְ/הוֹן֙ טַעְמָ֔/א וּ/מַלְכָּ֖/א לָֽא לֶהֱוֵ֥א נָזִֽק
verses.translit: v'l' mnhvn srkhyn tlt' dy dny'l chd mnhvn dy lhvn 'chshdrpny' 'lyn yhbyn lhvn t'm' vmlkh' l' lhv' nzq
verses.translation: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן֙ דָּנִיֵּ֣אל דְּנָ֔ה הֲוָ֣א מִתְנַצַּ֔ח עַל סָרְכַיָּ֖/א וַ/אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֑/א כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ יַתִּירָא֙ בֵּ֔/הּ וּ/מַלְכָּ֣/א עֲשִׁ֔ית לַ/הֲקָמוּתֵ֖/הּ עַל כָּל מַלְכוּתָֽ/א
verses.translit: 'dyn dny'l dnh hv' mtntsch 'l srkhy' v'chshdrpny' khl qbl dy rvch ytyr' bh vmlkh' 'shyt lhqmvth 'l khl mlkhvt'
verses.translation: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן סָֽרְכַיָּ֜/א וַ/אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֗/א הֲו֨וֹ בָעַ֧יִן עִלָּ֛ה לְ/הַשְׁכָּחָ֥ה לְ/דָנִיֵּ֖אל מִ/צַּ֣ד מַלְכוּתָ֑/א וְ/כָל עִלָּ֨ה וּ/שְׁחִיתָ֜ה לָא יָכְלִ֣ין לְ/הַשְׁכָּחָ֗ה כָּ/ל קֳבֵל֙ דִּֽי מְהֵימַ֣ן ה֔וּא וְ/כָל שָׁלוּ֙ וּ/שְׁחִיתָ֔ה לָ֥א הִשְׁתְּכַ֖חַת עֲלֽוֹ/הִי
verses.translit: 'dyn srkhy' v'chshdrpny' hvv b'yn 'lh lhshkhchh ldny'l mtsd mlkhvt' vkhl 'lh vshchyth l' ykhlyn lhshkhchh khl qbl dy mhymn hv' vkhl shlv vshchyth l' hshtkhcht 'lvhy
verses.translation: Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find it against him concerning the law of his God.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּ֤/א אִלֵּךְ֙ אָֽמְרִ֔ין דִּ֣י לָ֧א נְהַשְׁכַּ֛ח לְ/דָנִיֵּ֥אל דְּנָ֖ה כָּל עִלָּ֑א לָהֵ֕ן הַשְׁכַּ֥חְנָֽה עֲל֖וֹ/הִי בְּ/דָ֥ת אֱלָהֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'dyn gbry' 'lkh 'mryn dy l' nhshkhch ldny'l dnh khl 'l' lhn hshkhchnh 'lvhy bdt 'lhh
verses.translation: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן סָרְכַיָּ֤/א וַ/אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ/א֙ אִלֵּ֔ן הַרְגִּ֖שׁוּ עַל מַלְכָּ֑/א וְ/כֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לֵ֔/הּ דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖/א לְ/עָלְמִ֥ין חֱיִֽי
verses.translit: 'dyn srkhy' v'chshdrpny' 'ln hrgshv 'l mlkh' vkhn 'mryn lh dryvsh mlkh' l'lmyn chyy
verses.translation: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

verses.original: אִתְיָעַ֜טוּ כֹּ֣ל סָרְכֵ֣י מַלְכוּתָ֗/א סִגְנַיָּ֤/א וַֽ/אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ/א֙ הַדָּֽבְרַיָּ֣/א וּ/פַחֲוָתָ֔/א לְ/קַיָּמָ֤ה קְיָם֙ מַלְכָּ֔/א וּ/לְ/תַקָּפָ֖ה אֱסָ֑ר דִּ֣י כָל דִּֽי יִבְעֵ֣ה בָ֠עוּ מִן כָּל אֱלָ֨הּ וֶֽ/אֱנָ֜שׁ עַד יוֹמִ֣ין תְּלָתִ֗ין לָהֵן֙ מִנָּ֣/ךְ מַלְכָּ֔/א יִתְרְמֵ֕א לְ/גֹ֖ב אַרְיָוָתָֽ/א
verses.translit: 'ty'tv khl srkhy mlkhvt' sgny' v'chshdrpny' hdbry' vpchvt' lqymh qym mlkh' vltqph 'sr dy khl dy yb'h b'v mn khl 'lh v'nsh 'd yvmyn tltyn lhn mnkh mlkh' ytrm' lgb 'ryvt'
verses.translation: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

verses.original: כְּעַ֣ן מַלְכָּ֔/א תְּקִ֥ים אֱסָרָ֖/א וְ/תִרְשֻׁ֣ם כְּתָבָ֑/א דִּ֣י לָ֧א לְ/הַשְׁנָיָ֛ה כְּ/דָת מָדַ֥י וּ/פָרַ֖ס דִּי לָ֥א תֶעְדֵּֽא
verses.translit: kh'n mlkh' tqym 'sr' vtrshm khtb' dy l' lhshnyh khdt mdy vprs dy l' t'd'
verses.translation: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֖ל דְּנָ֑ה מַלְכָּ/א֙ דָּֽרְיָ֔וֶשׁ רְשַׁ֥ם כְּתָבָ֖/א וֶ/אֱסָרָֽ/א
verses.translit: khl qbl dnh mlkh' dryvsh rshm khtb' v'sr'
verses.translation: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.

verses.original: וְ֠/דָנִיֵּאל כְּ/דִ֨י יְדַ֜ע דִּֽי רְשִׁ֤ים כְּתָבָ/א֙ עַ֣ל לְ/בַיְתֵ֔/הּ וְ/כַוִּ֨ין פְּתִיחָ֥ן לֵ/הּ֙ בְּ/עִלִּיתֵ֔/הּ נֶ֖גֶד יְרוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְ/זִמְנִין֩ תְּלָתָ֨ה בְ/יוֹמָ֜/א ה֣וּא בָּרֵ֣ךְ עַל בִּרְכ֗וֹ/הִי וּ/מְצַלֵּ֤א וּ/מוֹדֵא֙ קֳדָ֣ם אֱלָהֵ֔/הּ כָּ/ל קֳבֵל֙ דִּֽי הֲוָ֣א עָבֵ֔ד מִן קַדְמַ֖ת דְּנָֽה
verses.translit: vdny'l khdy yd' dy rshym khtb' 'l lbyth vkhvyn ptychn lh b'lyth ngd yrvshlm vzmnyn tlth byvm' hv' brkh 'l brkhvhy vmtsl' vmvd' qdm 'lhh khl qbl dy hv' 'bd mn qdmt dnh
verses.translation: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּ֤/א אִלֵּךְ֙ הַרְגִּ֔שׁוּ וְ/הַשְׁכַּ֖חוּ לְ/דָנִיֵּ֑אל בָּעֵ֥א וּ/מִתְחַנַּ֖ן קֳדָ֥ם אֱלָהֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'dyn gbry' 'lkh hrgshv vhshkhchv ldny'l b'' vmtchnn qdm 'lhh
verses.translation: Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king’s decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

verses.original: בֵּ֠/אדַיִן קְרִ֨יבוּ וְ/אָמְרִ֥ין קֳדָם מַלְכָּ/א֮ עַל אֱסָ֣ר מַלְכָּ/א֒ הֲ/לָ֧א אֱסָ֣ר רְשַׁ֗מְתָּ דִּ֣י כָל אֱנָ֡שׁ דִּֽי יִבְעֵה֩ מִן כָּל אֱלָ֨הּ וֶֽ/אֱנָ֜שׁ עַד יוֹמִ֣ין תְּלָתִ֗ין לָהֵן֙ מִנָּ֣/ךְ מַלְכָּ֔/א יִתְרְמֵ֕א לְ/ג֖וֹב אַרְיָותָ֑/א עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜/א וְ/אָמַ֗ר יַצִּיבָ֧א מִלְּתָ֛/א כְּ/דָת מָדַ֥י וּ/פָרַ֖ס דִּי לָ֥א תֶעְדֵּֽא
verses.translit: b'dyn qrybv v'mryn qdm mlkh' 'l 'sr mlkh' hl' 'sr rshmt dy khl 'nsh dy yb'h mn khl 'lh v'nsh 'd yvmyn tltyn lhn mnkh mlkh' ytrm' lgvb 'ryvt' 'nh mlkh' v'mr ytsyb' mlt' khdt mdy vprs dy l' t'd'
verses.translation: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.

verses.original: בֵּ֠/אדַיִן עֲנ֣וֹ וְ/אָמְרִין֮ קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ/א֒ דִּ֣י דָנִיֵּ֡אל דִּי֩ מִן בְּנֵ֨י גָלוּתָ֜/א דִּ֣י יְה֗וּד לָא שָׂ֨ם עלי/ך עֲלָ֤/ךְ מַלְכָּ/א֙ טְעֵ֔ם וְ/עַל אֱסָרָ֖/א דִּ֣י רְשַׁ֑מְתָּ וְ/זִמְנִ֤ין תְּלָתָה֙ בְּ/יוֹמָ֔/א בָּעֵ֖א בָּעוּתֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: b'dyn 'nv v'mryn qdm mlkh' dy dny'l dy mn bny glvt' dy yhvd l' shm 'lykh 'lkh mlkh' t'm v'l 'sr' dy rshmt vzmnyn tlth byvm' b'' b'vth
verses.translation: Then the king, when he heard these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן מַלְכָּ֜/א כְּ/דִ֧י מִלְּתָ֣/א שְׁמַ֗ע שַׂגִּיא֙ בְּאֵ֣שׁ עֲל֔וֹ/הִי וְ/עַ֧ל דָּנִיֵּ֛אל שָׂ֥ם בָּ֖ל לְ/שֵׁיזָבוּתֵ֑/הּ וְ/עַד֙ מֶֽעָלֵ֣י שִׁמְשָׁ֔/א הֲוָ֥א מִשְׁתַּדַּ֖ר לְ/הַצָּלוּתֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'dyn mlkh' khdy mlt' shm' shgy' b'sh 'lvhy v'l dny'l shm bl lshyzbvth v'd m'ly shmsh' hv' mshtdr lhtslvth
verses.translation: Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians is , That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֨יִן֙ גֻּבְרַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֔ךְ הַרְגִּ֖שׁוּ עַל מַלְכָּ֑/א וְ/אָמְרִ֣ין לְ/מַלְכָּ֗/א דַּ֤ע מַלְכָּ/א֙ דִּֽי דָת֙ לְ/מָדַ֣י וּ/פָרַ֔ס דִּֽי כָל אֱסָ֥ר וּ/קְיָ֛ם דִּֽי מַלְכָּ֥/א יְהָקֵ֖ים לָ֥א לְ/הַשְׁנָיָֽה
verses.translit: b'dyn gbry' 'lkh hrgshv 'l mlkh' v'mryn lmlkh' d' mlkh' dy dt lmdy vprs dy khl 'sr vqym dy mlkh' yhqym l' lhshnyh
verses.translation: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֜יִן מַלְכָּ֣/א אֲמַ֗ר וְ/הַיְתִיו֙ לְ/דָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל וּ/רְמ֕וֹ לְ/גֻבָּ֖/א דִּ֣י אַרְיָוָתָ֑/א עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּ/א֙ וְ/אָמַ֣ר לְ/דָנִיֵּ֔אל אֱלָהָ֗/ךְ דִּ֣י אנתה אַ֤נְתְּ פָּֽלַֽח לֵ/הּ֙ בִּ/תְדִירָ֔/א ה֖וּא יְשֵׁיזְבִנָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' 'mr vhytyv ldny'l vrmv lgb' dy 'ryvt' 'nh mlkh' v'mr ldny'l 'lhkh dy 'nth 'nt plch lh btdyr' hv' yshyzbnkh
verses.translation: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.

verses.original: וְ/הֵיתָ֨יִת֙ אֶ֣בֶן חֲדָ֔ה וְ/שֻׂמַ֖ת עַל פֻּ֣ם גֻּבָּ֑/א וְ/חַתְמַ֨/הּ מַלְכָּ֜/א בְּ/עִזְקְתֵ֗/הּ וּ/בְ/עִזְקָת֙ רַבְרְבָנ֔וֹ/הִי דִּ֛י לָא תִשְׁנֵ֥א צְב֖וּ בְּ/דָנִיֵּֽאל
verses.translit: vhytyt 'bn chdh vshmt 'l pm gb' vchtmh mlkh' b'zqth vb'zqt rbrbnvhy dy l' tshn' tsbv bdny'l
verses.translation: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן אֲזַ֨ל מַלְכָּ֤/א לְ/הֵֽיכְלֵ/הּ֙ וּ/בָ֣ת טְוָ֔ת וְ/דַחֲוָ֖ן לָא הַנְעֵ֣ל קָֽדָמ֑וֹ/הִי וְ/שִׁנְתֵּ֖/הּ נַדַּ֥ת עֲלֽוֹ/הִי
verses.translit: 'dyn 'zl mlkh' lhykhlh vbt tvt vdchvn l' hn'l qdmvhy vshnth ndt 'lvhy
verses.translation: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֣יִן מַלְכָּ֔/א בִּ/שְׁפַּרְפָּרָ֖/א יְק֣וּם בְּ/נָגְהָ֑/א וּ/בְ/הִ֨תְבְּהָלָ֔ה לְ/גֻבָּ֥/א דִֽי אַרְיָוָתָ֖/א אֲזַֽל
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' bshprpr' yqvm bngh' vbhtbhlh lgb' dy 'ryvt' 'zl
verses.translation: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?

verses.original: וּ/כְ/מִקְרְבֵ֣/הּ לְ/גֻבָּ֔/א לְ/דָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל בְּ/קָ֥ל עֲצִ֖יב זְעִ֑ק עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜/א וְ/אָמַ֣ר לְ/דָנִיֵּ֗אל דָּֽנִיֵּאל֙ עֲבֵד֙ אֱלָהָ֣/א חַיָּ֔/א אֱלָהָ֗/ךְ דִּ֣י אנתה אַ֤נְתְּ פָּֽלַֽח לֵ/הּ֙ בִּ/תְדִירָ֔/א הַ/יְכִ֥ל לְ/שֵׁיזָבוּתָ֖/ךְ מִן אַרְיָוָתָֽ/א
verses.translit: vkhmqrbh lgb' ldny'l bql 'tsyb z'q 'nh mlkh' v'mr ldny'l dny'l 'bd 'lh' chy' 'lhkh dy 'nth 'nt plch lh btdyr' hykhl lshyzbvtkh mn 'ryvt'
verses.translation: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן֙ דָּנִיֶּ֔אל עִם מַלְכָּ֖/א מַלִּ֑ל מַלְכָּ֖/א לְ/עָלְמִ֥ין חֱיִֽי
verses.translit: 'dyn dny'l 'm mlkh' mll mlkh' l'lmyn chyy
verses.translation: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions’ mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.

verses.original: אֱלָהִ֞/י שְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאֲכֵ֗/הּ וּֽ/סֲגַ֛ר פֻּ֥ם אַרְיָוָתָ֖/א וְ/לָ֣א חַבְּל֑וּ/נִי כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֤י קָֽדָמ֨וֹ/הִי֙ זָכוּ֙ הִשְׁתְּכַ֣חַת לִ֔/י וְ/אַ֤ף קדמי/ך קָֽדָמָ/ךְ֙ מַלְכָּ֔/א חֲבוּלָ֖ה לָ֥א עַבְדֵֽת
verses.translit: 'lhy shlch ml'khh vsgr pm 'ryvt' vl' chblvny khl qbl dy qdmvhy zkhv hshtkhcht ly v'f qdmykh qdmkh mlkh' chbvlh l' 'bdt
verses.translation: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֣יִן מַלְכָּ֗/א שַׂגִּיא֙ טְאֵ֣ב עֲל֔וֹ/הִי וּ/לְ/דָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל אֲמַ֖ר לְ/הַנְסָקָ֣ה מִן גֻּבָּ֑/א וְ/הֻסַּ֨ק דָּנִיֵּ֜אל מִן גֻּבָּ֗/א וְ/כָל חֲבָל֙ לָא הִשְׁתְּכַ֣ח בֵּ֔/הּ דִּ֖י הֵימִ֥ן בֵּ/אלָהֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' shgy' t'b 'lvhy vldny'l 'mr lhnsqh mn gb' vhsq dny'l mn gb' vkhl chbl l' hshtkhch bh dy hymn b'lhh
verses.translation: And the king commanded, and they brought those men which had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den.

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗/א וְ/הַיְתִ֞יו גֻּבְרַיָּ֤/א אִלֵּךְ֙ דִּֽי אֲכַ֤לוּ קַרְצ֨וֹ/הִי֙ דִּ֣י דָֽנִיֵּ֔אל וּ/לְ/גֹ֤ב אַרְיָוָתָ/א֙ רְמ֔וֹ אִנּ֖וּן בְּנֵי/ה֣וֹן וּ/נְשֵׁי/ה֑וֹן וְ/לָֽא מְט֞וֹ לְ/אַרְעִ֣ית גֻּבָּ֗/א עַ֠ד דִּֽי שְׁלִ֤טֽוּ בְ/הוֹן֙ אַרְיָ֣וָתָ֔/א וְ/כָל גַּרְמֵי/ה֖וֹן הַדִּֽקוּ
verses.translit: v'mr mlkh' vhytyv gbry' 'lkh dy 'khlv qrtsvhy dy dny'l vlgb 'ryvt' rmv 'nvn bnyhvn vnshyhvn vl' mtv l'r'yt gb' 'd dy shltv bhvn 'ryvt' vkhl grmyhvn hdqv
verses.translation: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֜יִן דָּרְיָ֣וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗/א כְּ֠תַב לְֽ/כָל עַֽמְמַיָּ֞/א אֻמַיָּ֧/א וְ/לִשָּׁנַיָּ֛/א דִּֽי דארין דָיְרִ֥ין בְּ/כָל אַרְעָ֖/א שְׁלָמְ/כ֥וֹן יִשְׂגֵּֽא
verses.translit: b'dyn dryvsh mlkh' khtb lkhl 'mmy' 'my' vlshny' dy d'ryn dyryn bkhl 'r'' shlmkhvn yshg'
verses.translation: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even unto the end.

verses.original: מִן קֳדָמַ/י֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י בְּ/כָל שָׁלְטָ֣ן מַלְכוּתִ֗/י לֶהֱוֺ֤ן זאעין זָיְעִין֙ וְ/דָ֣חֲלִ֔ין מִן קֳדָ֖ם אֱלָהֵ֣/הּ דִּי דָֽנִיֵּ֑אל דִּי ה֣וּא אֱלָהָ֣/א חַיָּ֗/א וְ/קַיָּם֙ לְ/עָ֣לְמִ֔ין וּ/מַלְכוּתֵ/הּ֙ דִּֽי לָ֣א תִתְחַבַּ֔ל וְ/שָׁלְטָנֵ֖/הּ עַד סוֹפָֽ/א
verses.translit: mn qdmy shym t'm dy bkhl shltn mlkhvty lhvn z''yn zy'yn vdchlyn mn qdm 'lhh dy dny'l dy hv' 'lh' chy' vqym l'lmyn vmlkhvth dy l' ttchbl vshltnh 'd svp'
verses.translation: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.

verses.original: מְשֵׁיזִ֣ב וּ/מַצִּ֗ל וְ/עָבֵד֙ אָתִ֣ין וְ/תִמְהִ֔ין בִּ/שְׁמַיָּ֖/א וּ/בְ/אַרְעָ֑/א דִּ֚י שֵׁיזִ֣יב לְ/דָֽנִיֵּ֔אל מִן יַ֖ד אַרְיָוָתָֽ/א
verses.translit: mshyzb vmtsl v'bd 'tyn vtmhyn bshmy' vb'r'' dy shyzyb ldny'l mn yd 'ryvt'
verses.translation: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֗ה לְ/בֵלְאשַׁצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל דָּנִיֵּאל֙ חֵ֣לֶם חֲזָ֔ה וְ/חֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשֵׁ֖/הּ עַֽל מִשְׁכְּבֵ֑/הּ בֵּ/אדַ֨יִן֙ חֶלְמָ֣/א כְתַ֔ב רֵ֥אשׁ מִלִּ֖ין אֲמַֽר
verses.translit: bshnt chdh lbl'shtsr mlkh bbl dny'l chlm chzh vchzvy r'shh 'l mshkhbh b'dyn chlm' khtb r'sh mlyn 'mr
verses.translation: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, and told the sum of the matters.

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה דָנִיֵּאל֙ וְ/אָמַ֔ר חָזֵ֥ה הֲוֵ֛ית בְּ/חֶזְוִ֖/י עִם לֵֽילְיָ֑/א וַ/אֲר֗וּ אַרְבַּע֙ רוּחֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔/א מְגִיחָ֖ן לְ/יַמָּ֥/א רַבָּֽ/א
verses.translit: 'nh dny'l v'mr chzh hvyt bchzvy 'm lyly' v'rv 'rb' rvchy shmy' mgychn lym' rb'
verses.translation: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבַּ֤ע חֵיוָן֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן סָלְקָ֖ן מִן יַמָּ֑/א שָׁנְיָ֖ן דָּ֥א מִן דָּֽא
verses.translit: v'rb' chyvn rbrbn slqn mn ym' shnyn d' mn d'
verses.translation: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.

verses.original: קַדְמָיְתָ֣/א כְ/אַרְיֵ֔ה וְ/גַפִּ֥ין דִּֽי נְשַׁ֖ר לַ֑/הּ חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּי מְּרִ֨יטוּ גַפַּ֜י/הּ וּ/נְטִ֣ילַת מִן אַרְעָ֗/א וְ/עַל רַגְלַ֨יִן֙ כֶּ/אֱנָ֣שׁ הֳקִימַ֔ת וּ/לְבַ֥ב אֱנָ֖שׁ יְהִ֥יב לַֽ/הּ
verses.translit: qdmyt' kh'ryh vgpyn dy nshr lh chzh hvyt 'd dy mrytv gpyh vntylt mn 'r'' v'l rglyn kh'nsh hqymt vlbb 'nsh yhyb lh
verses.translation: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.

verses.original: וַ/אֲר֣וּ חֵיוָה֩ אָחֳרִ֨י תִנְיָנָ֜ה דָּמְיָ֣ה לְ/דֹ֗ב וְ/לִ/שְׂטַר חַד֙ הֳקִמַ֔ת וּ/תְלָ֥ת עִלְעִ֛ין בְּ/פֻמַּ֖/הּ בֵּ֣ין שני/ה שִׁנַּ֑/הּ וְ/כֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לַ֔/הּ ק֥וּמִֽי אֲכֻ֖לִי בְּשַׂ֥ר שַׂגִּֽיא
verses.translit: v'rv chyvh 'chry tnynh dmyh ldb vlshtr chd hqmt vtlt 'l'yn bpmh byn shnyh shnh vkhn 'mryn lh qvmy 'khly bshr shgy'
verses.translation: And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.

verses.original: בָּאתַ֨ר דְּנָ֜ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית וַ/אֲר֤וּ אָֽחֳרִי֙ כִּ/נְמַ֔ר וְ/לַ֨/הּ גַּפִּ֥ין אַרְבַּ֛ע דִּי ע֖וֹף עַל גבי/ה גַּבַּ֑/הּ וְ/אַרְבְּעָ֤ה רֵאשִׁין֙ לְ/חֵ֣יוְתָ֔/א וְ/שָׁלְטָ֖ן יְהִ֥יב לַֽ/הּ
verses.translit: b'tr dnh chzh hvyt v'rv 'chry khnmr vlh gpyn 'rb' dy 'vf 'l gbyh gbh v'rb'h r'shyn lchyvt' vshltn yhyb lh
verses.translation: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

verses.original: בָּאתַ֣ר דְּנָה֩ חָזֵ֨ה הֲוֵ֜ית בְּ/חֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֗/א וַ/אֲר֣וּ חֵיוָ֣ה רביעיה רְֽבִיעָאָ֡ה דְּחִילָה֩ וְ/אֵֽימְתָנִ֨י וְ/תַקִּיפָ֜א יַתִּ֗ירָא וְ/שִׁנַּ֨יִן דִּֽי פַרְזֶ֥ל לַ/הּ֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן אָֽכְלָ֣ה וּ/מַדֱּקָ֔ה וּ/שְׁאָרָ֖/א ב/רגלי/ה בְּ/רַגְלַ֣/הּ רָפְסָ֑ה וְ/הִ֣יא מְשַׁנְּיָ֗ה מִן כָּל חֵֽיוָתָ/א֙ דִּ֣י קָֽדָמַ֔י/הּ וְ/קַרְנַ֥יִן עֲשַׂ֖ר לַֽ/הּ
verses.translit: b'tr dnh chzh hvyt bchzvy lyly' v'rv chyvh rby'yh rby''h dchylh v'ymtny vtqyp' ytyr' vshnyn dy przl lh rbrbn 'khlh vmdqh vsh'r' brglyh brglh rpsh vhy' mshnyh mn khl chyvt' dy qdmyh vqrnyn 'shr lh
verses.translation: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.

verses.original: מִשְׂתַּכַּ֨ל הֲוֵ֜ית בְּ/קַרְנַיָּ֗/א וַ֠/אֲלוּ קֶ֣רֶן אָחֳרִ֤י זְעֵירָה֙ סִלְקָ֣ת ביני/הון בֵּֽינֵי/הֵ֔ן וּ/תְלָ֗ת מִן קַרְנַיָּ/א֙ קַדְמָ֣יָתָ֔/א אתעקרו אֶתְעֲקַ֖רָה מִן קדמי/ה קֳדָמַ֑/הּ וַ/אֲל֨וּ עַיְנִ֜ין כְּ/עַיְנֵ֤י אֲנָשָׁ/א֙ בְּ/קַרְנָ/א דָ֔א וּ/פֻ֖ם מְמַלִּ֥ל רַבְרְבָֽן
verses.translit: mshtkhl hvyt bqrny' v'lv qrn 'chry z'yrh slqt bynyhvn bynyhn vtlt mn qrny' qdmyt' 't'qrv 't'qrh mn qdmyh qdmh v'lv 'ynyn kh'yny 'nsh' bqrn' d' vpm mmll rbrbn
verses.translation: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית עַ֣ד דִּ֤י כָרְסָוָן֙ רְמִ֔יו וְ/עַתִּ֥יק יוֹמִ֖ין יְתִ֑ב לְבוּשֵׁ֣/הּ כִּ/תְלַ֣ג חִוָּ֗ר וּ/שְׂעַ֤ר רֵאשֵׁ/הּ֙ כַּ/עֲמַ֣ר נְקֵ֔א כָּרְסְיֵ/הּ֙ שְׁבִיבִ֣ין דִּי נ֔וּר גַּלְגִּלּ֖וֹ/הִי נ֥וּר דָּלִֽק
verses.translit: chzh hvyt 'd dy khrsvn rmyv v'tyq yvmyn ytb lbvshh khtlg chvr vsh'r r'shh kh'mr nq' khrsyh shbybyn dy nvr glglvhy nvr dlq
verses.translation: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.

verses.original: נְהַ֣ר דִּי נ֗וּר נָגֵ֤ד וְ/נָפֵק֙ מִן קֳדָמ֔וֹ/הִי אֶ֤לֶף אלפים אַלְפִין֙ יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵּ֔/הּ וְ/רִבּ֥וֹ רבון רִבְבָ֖ן קָֽדָמ֣וֹ/הִי יְקוּמ֑וּן דִּינָ֥/א יְתִ֖ב וְ/סִפְרִ֥ין פְּתִֽיחוּ
verses.translit: nhr dy nvr ngd vnpq mn qdmvhy 'lf 'lpym 'lpyn yshmshvnh vrbv rbvn rbbn qdmvhy yqvmvn dyn' ytb vspryn ptychv
verses.translation: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית בֵּ/אדַ֗יִן מִן קָל֙ מִלַּיָּ֣/א רַבְרְבָתָ֔/א דִּ֥י קַרְנָ֖/א מְמַלֱּלָ֑ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּ֨י קְטִילַ֤ת חֵֽיוְתָ/א֙ וְ/הוּבַ֣ד גִּשְׁמַ֔/הּ וִ/יהִיבַ֖ת לִ/יקֵדַ֥ת אֶשָּֽׁא
verses.translit: chzh hvyt b'dyn mn ql mly' rbrbt' dy qrn' mmllh chzh hvyt 'd dy qtylt chyvt' vhvbd gshmh vyhybt lyqdt 'sh'
verses.translation: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאָר֙ חֵֽיוָתָ֔/א הֶעְדִּ֖יו שָׁלְטָנְ/ה֑וֹן וְ/אַרְכָ֧ה בְ/חַיִּ֛ין יְהִ֥יבַת לְ/ה֖וֹן עַד זְמַ֥ן וְ/עִדָּֽן
verses.translit: vsh'r chyvt' h'dyv shltnhvn v'rkhh bchyyn yhybt lhvn 'd zmn v'dn
verses.translation: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.

verses.original: חָזֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּ/חֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֔/א וַ/אֲרוּ֙ עִם עֲנָנֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔/א כְּ/בַ֥ר אֱנָ֖שׁ אָתֵ֣ה הֲוָ֑ה וְ/עַד עַתִּ֤יק יֽוֹמַיָּ/א֙ מְטָ֔ה וּ/קְדָמ֖וֹ/הִי הַקְרְבֽוּ/הִי
verses.translit: chzh hvyt bchzvy lyly' v'rv 'm 'nny shmy' khbr 'nsh 'th hvh v'd 'tyq yvmy' mth vqdmvhy hqrbvhy
verses.translation: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

verses.original: וְ/לֵ֨/הּ יְהִ֤יב שָׁלְטָן֙ וִ/יקָ֣ר וּ/מַלְכ֔וּ וְ/כֹ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗/א אֻמַיָּ֛/א וְ/לִשָּׁנַיָּ֖/א לֵ֣/הּ יִפְלְח֑וּן שָׁלְטָנֵ֞/הּ שָׁלְטָ֤ן עָלַם֙ דִּֽי לָ֣א יֶעְדֵּ֔ה וּ/מַלְכוּתֵ֖/הּ דִּי לָ֥א תִתְחַבַּֽל
verses.translit: vlh yhyb shltn vyqr vmlkhv vkhl 'mmy' 'my' vlshny' lh yplchvn shltnh shltn 'lm dy l' y'dh vmlkhvth dy l' ttchbl
verses.translation: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

verses.original: אֶתְכְּרִיַּ֥ת רוּחִ֛/י אֲנָ֥ה דָנִיֵּ֖אל בְּ/ג֣וֹא נִדְנֶ֑ה וְ/חֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖/י יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'tkhryt rvchy 'nh dny'l bgv' ndnh vchzvy r'shy ybhlnny
verses.translation: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

verses.original: קִרְבֵ֗ת עַל חַד֙ מִן קָ֣אֲמַיָּ֔/א וְ/יַצִּיבָ֥א אֶבְעֵֽא מִנֵּ֖/הּ עַֽל כָּל דְּנָ֑ה וַ/אֲמַר לִ֕/י וּ/פְשַׁ֥ר מִלַּיָּ֖/א יְהוֹדְעִנַּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: qrbt 'l chd mn q'my' vytsyb' 'b'' mnh 'l khl dnh v'mr ly vpshr mly' yhvd'nny
verses.translation: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

verses.original: אִלֵּין֙ חֵיוָתָ֣/א רַבְרְבָתָ֔/א דִּ֥י אִנִּ֖ין אַרְבַּ֑ע אַרְבְּעָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקוּמ֥וּן מִן אַרְעָֽ/א
verses.translit: 'lyn chyvt' rbrbt' dy 'nyn 'rb' 'rb'h mlkhyn yqvmvn mn 'r''
verses.translation: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.

verses.original: וִֽ/יקַבְּלוּן֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔/א קַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְ/יַחְסְנ֤וּן מַלְכוּתָ/א֙ עַֽד עָ֣לְמָ֔/א וְ/עַ֖ד עָלַ֥ם עָלְמַיָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vyqblvn mlkhvt' qdyshy 'lyvnyn vychsnvn mlkhvt' 'd 'lm' v'd 'lm 'lmy'
verses.translation: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן צְבִית֙ לְ/יַצָּבָ֔א עַל חֵֽיוְתָ/א֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔/א דִּֽי הֲוָ֥ת שָֽׁנְיָ֖ה מִן כל/הון כָּלְּ/הֵ֑ין דְּחִילָ֣ה יַתִּ֗ירָה שני/ה שִׁנַּ֤/הּ דִּֽי פַרְזֶל֙ וְ/טִפְרַ֣י/הּ דִּֽי נְחָ֔שׁ אָֽכְלָ֣ה מַדֲּקָ֔ה וּ/שְׁאָרָ֖/א בְּ/רַגְלַ֥י/הּ רָֽפְסָֽה
verses.translit: 'dyn tsbyt lytsb' 'l chyvt' rby'yt' dy hvt shnyh mn khlhvn khlhyn dchylh ytyrh shnyh shnh dy przl vtpryh dy nchsh 'khlh mdqh vsh'r' brglyh rpsh
verses.translation: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;

verses.original: וְ/עַל קַרְנַיָּ֤/א עֲשַׂר֙ דִּ֣י בְ/רֵאשַׁ֔/הּ וְ/אָחֳרִי֙ דִּ֣י סִלְקַ֔ת ו/נפלו וּ/נְפַ֥לָה מִן קדמי/ה קֳדָמַ֖/הּ תְּלָ֑ת וְ/קַרְנָ֨/א דִכֵּ֜ן וְ/עַיְנִ֣ין לַ֗/הּ וְ/פֻם֙ מְמַלִּ֣ל רַבְרְבָ֔ן וְ/חֶזְוַ֖/הּ רַ֥ב מִן חַבְרָתַֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'l qrny' 'shr dy br'shh v'chry dy slqt vnplv vnplh mn qdmyh qdmh tlt vqrn' dkhn v'ynyn lh vpm mmll rbrbn vchzvh rb mn chbrth
verses.translation: And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית וְ/קַרְנָ֣/א דִכֵּ֔ן עָבְדָ֥ה קְרָ֖ב עִם קַדִּישִׁ֑ין וְ/יָכְלָ֖ה לְ/הֽוֹן
verses.translit: chzh hvyt vqrn' dkhn 'bdh qrb 'm qdyshyn vykhlh lhvn
verses.translation: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;

verses.original: עַ֣ד דִּֽי אֲתָ֗ה עַתִּיק֙ יֽוֹמַיָּ֔/א וְ/דִינָ֣/א יְהִ֔ב לְ/קַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְ/זִמְנָ֣/א מְטָ֔ה וּ/מַלְכוּתָ֖/א הֶחֱסִ֥נוּ קַדִּישִֽׁין
verses.translit: 'd dy 'th 'tyq yvmy' vdyn' yhb lqdyshy 'lyvnyn vzmn' mth vmlkhvt' hchsnv qdyshyn
verses.translation: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

verses.original: כֵּן֮ אֲמַר֒ חֵֽיוְתָ/א֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔/א מַלְכ֤וּ רביעי/א רְבִיעָ/אָה֙ תֶּהֱוֵ֣א בְ/אַרְעָ֔/א דִּ֥י תִשְׁנֵ֖א מִן כָּל מַלְכְוָתָ֑/א וְ/תֵאכֻל֙ כָּל אַרְעָ֔/א וּ/תְדוּשִׁנַּ֖/הּ וְ/תַדְּקִנַּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khn 'mr chyvt' rby'yt' mlkhv rby'y' rby''h thv' b'r'' dy tshn' mn khl mlkhvt' vt'khl khl 'r'' vtdvshnh vtdqnh
verses.translation: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

verses.original: וְ/קַרְנַיָּ֣/א עֲשַׂ֔ר מִנַּ/הּ֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔/ה עַשְׂרָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקֻמ֑וּן וְ/אָחֳרָ֞ן יְק֣וּם אַחֲרֵי/ה֗וֹן וְ/ה֤וּא יִשְׁנֵא֙ מִן קַדְמָיֵ֔/א וּ/תְלָתָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְהַשְׁפִּֽל
verses.translit: vqrny' 'shr mnh mlkhvth 'shrh mlkhyn yqmvn v'chrn yqvm 'chryhvn vhv' yshn' mn qdmy' vtlth mlkhyn yhshpl
verses.translation: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.

verses.original: וּ/מִלִּ֗ין לְ/צַ֤ד עלי/א עִלָּאָ/ה֙ יְמַלִּ֔ל וּ/לְ/קַדִּישֵׁ֥י עֶלְיוֹנִ֖ין יְבַלֵּ֑א וְ/יִסְבַּ֗ר לְ/הַשְׁנָיָה֙ זִמְנִ֣ין וְ/דָ֔ת וְ/יִתְיַהֲב֣וּן בִּ/ידֵ֔/הּ עַד עִדָּ֥ן וְ/עִדָּנִ֖ין וּ/פְלַ֥ג עִדָּֽן
verses.translit: vmlyn ltsd 'ly' 'l'h ymll vlqdyshy 'lyvnyn ybl' vysbr lhshnyh zmnyn vdt vytyhbvn bydh 'd 'dn v'dnyn vplg 'dn
verses.translation: And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.

verses.original: וְ/דִינָ֖/א יִתִּ֑ב וְ/שָׁלְטָנֵ֣/הּ יְהַעְדּ֔וֹן לְ/הַשְׁמָדָ֥ה וּ/לְ/הוֹבָדָ֖ה עַד סוֹפָֽ/א
verses.translit: vdyn' ytb vshltnh yh'dvn lhshmdh vlhvbdh 'd svp'
verses.translation: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְכוּתָ֨/ה וְ/שָׁלְטָנָ֜/א וּ/רְבוּתָ֗/א דִּ֚י מַלְכְוָת֙ תְּח֣וֹת כָּל שְׁמַיָּ֔/א יְהִיבַ֕ת לְ/עַ֖ם קַדִּישֵׁ֣י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין מַלְכוּתֵ/הּ֙ מַלְכ֣וּת עָלַ֔ם וְ/כֹל֙ שָׁלְטָ֣נַיָּ֔/א לֵ֥/הּ יִפְלְח֖וּן וְ/יִֽשְׁתַּמְּעֽוּן
verses.translit: vmlkhvth vshltn' vrbvt' dy mlkhvt tchvt khl shmy' yhybt l'm qdyshy 'lyvnyn mlkhvth mlkhvt 'lm vkhl shltny' lh yplchvn vyshtm'vn
verses.translation: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

verses.original: עַד כָּ֖ה סוֹפָ֣/א דִֽי מִלְּתָ֑/א אֲנָ֨ה דָֽנִיֵּ֜אל שַׂגִּ֣יא רַעְיוֹנַ֣/י יְבַהֲלֻנַּ֗/נִי וְ/זִיוַ/י֙ יִשְׁתַּנּ֣וֹן עֲלַ֔/י וּ/מִלְּתָ֖/א בְּ/לִבִּ֥/י נִטְרֵֽת
verses.translit: 'd khh svp' dy mlt' 'nh dny'l shgy' r'yvny ybhlnny vzyvy yshtnvn 'ly vmlt' blby ntrt
verses.translation: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹשׁ לְ/מַלְכ֖וּת בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ חָז֞וֹן נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַ/י֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל אַחֲרֵ֛י הַ/נִּרְאָ֥ה אֵלַ֖/י בַּ/תְּחִלָּֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shlvsh lmlkhvt bl'shtsr hmlkh chzvn nr'h 'ly 'ny dny'l 'chry hnr'h 'ly btchlh
verses.translation: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶרְאֶה֮ בֶּ/חָזוֹן֒ וַ/יְהִי֙ בִּ/רְאֹתִ֔/י וַ/אֲנִי֙ בְּ/שׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַ/בִּירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵילָ֣ם הַ/מְּדִינָ֑ה וָ/אֶרְאֶה֙ בֶּֽ/חָז֔וֹן וַ/אֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי עַל אוּבַ֥ל אוּלָֽי
verses.translit: v'r'h bchzvn vyhy br'ty v'ny bshvshn hbyrh 'shr b'ylm hmdynh v'r'h bchzvn v'ny hyyty 'l 'vbl 'vly
verses.translation: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַ/י֙ וָ/אֶרְאֶ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֗ד עֹמֵ֛ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/אֻבָ֖ל וְ/ל֣/וֹ קְרָנָ֑יִם וְ/הַ/קְּרָנַ֣יִם גְּבֹה֗וֹת וְ/הָ/אַחַת֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה מִן הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔ית וְ/הַ֨/גְּבֹהָ֔ה עֹלָ֖ה בָּ/אַחֲרֹנָֽה
verses.translit: v'sh' 'yny v'r'h vhnh 'yl 'chd 'md lpny h'bl vlv qrnym vhqrnym gbhvt vh'cht gbhh mn hshnyt vhgbhh 'lh b'chrnh
verses.translation: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת הָ/אַ֡יִל מְנַגֵּחַ֩ יָ֨מָּ/ה וְ/צָפ֜וֹנָ/ה וָ/נֶ֗גְבָּ/ה וְ/כָל חַיּוֹת֙ לֹֽא יַֽעַמְד֣וּ לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֥ין מַצִּ֖יל מִ/יָּד֑/וֹ וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה כִ/רְצֹנ֖/וֹ וְ/הִגְדִּֽיל
verses.translit: r'yty 't h'yl mngch ymh vtspvnh vngbh vkhl chyvt l' y'mdv lpnyv v'yn mtsyl mydv v'shh khrtsnv vhgdyl
verses.translation: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י הָיִ֣יתִי מֵבִ֗ין וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה צְפִיר הָֽ/עִזִּים֙ בָּ֤א מִן הַֽ/מַּעֲרָב֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י כָל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/אֵ֥ין נוֹגֵ֖עַ בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הַ֨/צָּפִ֔יר קֶ֥רֶן חָז֖וּת בֵּ֥ין עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'ny hyyty mbyn vhnh tspyr h'zym b' mn hm'rb 'l pny khl h'rts v'yn nvg' b'rts vhtspyr qrn chzvt byn 'ynyv
verses.translation: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗א עַד הָ/אַ֨יִל֙ בַּ֣עַל הַ/קְּרָנַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתִי עֹמֵ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָ/אֻבָ֑ל וַ/יָּ֥רָץ אֵלָ֖י/ו בַּ/חֲמַ֥ת כֹּחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb' 'd h'yl b'l hqrnym 'shr r'yty 'md lpny h'bl vyrts 'lyv bchmt khchv
verses.translation: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.

verses.original: וּ/רְאִיתִ֞י/ו מַגִּ֣יעַ אֵ֣צֶל הָ/אַ֗יִל וַ/יִּתְמַרְמַ֤ר אֵלָי/ו֙ וַ/יַּ֣ךְ אֶת הָ/אַ֔יִל וַ/יְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת שְׁתֵּ֣י קְרָנָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה כֹ֛חַ בָּ/אַ֖יִל לַ/עֲמֹ֣ד לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤/הוּ אַ֨רְצָ/ה֙ וַֽ/יִּרְמְסֵ֔/הוּ וְ/לֹא הָיָ֥ה מַצִּ֛יל לָ/אַ֖יִל מִ/יָּדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vr'ytyv mgy' 'tsl h'yl vytmrmr 'lyv vykh 't h'yl vyshbr 't shty qrnyv vl' hyh khch b'yl l'md lpnyv vyshlykhhv 'rtsh vyrmshv vl' hyh mtsyl l'yl mydv
verses.translation: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

verses.original: וּ/צְפִ֥יר הָ/עִזִּ֖ים הִגְדִּ֣יל עַד מְאֹ֑ד וּ/כְ/עָצְמ֗/וֹ נִשְׁבְּרָה֙ הַ/קֶּ֣רֶן הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֔ה וַֽ/תַּעֲלֶ֜נָה חָז֤וּת אַרְבַּע֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔י/הָ לְ/אַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֥וֹת הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
