verses.translit: vtspyr h'zym hgdyl 'd m'd vkh'tsmv nshbrh hqrn hgdvlh vt'lnh chzvt 'rb' tchtyh l'rb' rvchvt hshmym
verses.translation: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הָ/אַחַ֣ת מֵ/הֶ֔ם יָצָ֥א קֶֽרֶן אַחַ֖ת מִ/צְּעִירָ֑ה וַ/תִּגְדַּל יֶ֛תֶר אֶל הַ/נֶּ֥גֶב וְ/אֶל הַ/מִּזְרָ֖ח וְ/אֶל הַ/צֶּֽבִי
verses.translit: vmn h'cht mhm yts' qrn 'cht mts'yrh vtgdl ytr 'l hngb v'l hmzrch v'l htsby
verses.translation: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land .

verses.original: וַ/תִּגְדַּ֖ל עַד צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַ/תַּפֵּ֥ל אַ֛רְצָ/ה מִן הַ/צָּבָ֥א וּ/מִן הַ/כּוֹכָבִ֖ים וַֽ/תִּרְמְסֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vtgdl 'd tsb' hshmym vtpl 'rtsh mn htsb' vmn hkhvkhbym vtrmsm
verses.translation: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֥ד שַֽׂר הַ/צָּבָ֖א הִגְדִּ֑יל וּ/מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ הרים הוּרַ֣ם הַ/תָּמִ֔יד וְ/הֻשְׁלַ֖ךְ מְכ֥וֹן מִקְדָּשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'd shr htsb' hgdyl vmmnv hrym hvrm htmyd vhshlkh mkhvn mqdshv
verses.translation: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

verses.original: וְ/צָבָ֛א תִּנָּתֵ֥ן עַל הַ/תָּמִ֖יד בְּ/פָ֑שַׁע וְ/תַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ אֱמֶת֙ אַ֔רְצָ/ה וְ/עָשְׂתָ֖ה וְ/הִצְלִֽיחָה
verses.translit: vtsb' tntn 'l htmyd bpsh' vtshlkh 'mt 'rtsh v'shth vhtslychh
verses.translation: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁמְעָ֥/ה אֶֽחָד קָד֖וֹשׁ מְדַבֵּ֑ר וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אֶחָ֨ד קָד֜וֹשׁ לַ/פַּֽלְמוֹנִ֣י הַֽ/מְדַבֵּ֗ר עַד מָתַ֞י הֶ/חָז֤וֹן הַ/תָּמִיד֙ וְ/הַ/פֶּ֣שַׁע שֹׁמֵ֔ם תֵּ֛ת וְ/קֹ֥דֶשׁ וְ/צָבָ֖א מִרְמָֽס
verses.translit: v'shm'h 'chd qdvsh mdbr vy'mr 'chd qdvsh lplmvny hmdbr 'd mty hchzvn htmyd vhpsh' shmm tt vqdsh vtsb' mrms
verses.translation: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice , and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י עַ֚ד עֶ֣רֶב בֹּ֔קֶר אַלְפַּ֖יִם וּ/שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וְ/נִצְדַּ֖ק קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'd 'rb bqr 'lpym vshlsh m'vt vntsdq qdsh
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ/רְאֹתִ֛/י אֲנִ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל אֶת הֶ/חָז֑וֹן וָ/אֲבַקְשָׁ֣/ה בִינָ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד לְ/נֶגְדִּ֖/י כְּ/מַרְאֵה גָֽבֶר
verses.translit: vyhy br'ty 'ny dny'l 't hchzvn v'bqshh bynh vhnh 'md lngdy khmr'h gbr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹל אָדָ֖ם בֵּ֣ין אוּלָ֑י וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר גַּבְרִיאֵ֕ל הָבֵ֥ן לְ/הַלָּ֖ז אֶת הַ/מַּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: v'shm' qvl 'dm byn 'vly vyqr' vy'mr gbry'l hbn lhlz 't hmr'h
verses.translation: And I heard a man’s voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֵ֣צֶל עָמְדִ֔/י וּ/בְ/בֹא֣/וֹ נִבְעַ֔תִּי וָ/אֶפְּלָ֖/ה עַל פָּנָ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַ/י֙ הָבֵ֣ן בֶּן אָדָ֔ם כִּ֖י לְ/עֶת קֵ֥ץ הֶ/חָזֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyb' 'tsl 'mdy vbb'v nb'ty v'plh 'l pny vy'mr 'ly hbn bn 'dm khy l't qts hchzvn
verses.translation: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/דַבְּר֣/וֹ עִמִּ֔/י נִרְדַּ֥מְתִּי עַל פָּנַ֖/י אָ֑רְצָ/ה וַ/יִּ֨גַּע בִּ֔/י וַ/יַּֽעֲמִידֵ֖/נִי עַל עָמְדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vbdbrv 'my nrdmty 'l pny 'rtsh vyg' by vy'mydny 'l 'mdy
verses.translation: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הִנְ/נִ֣י מוֹדִֽיעֲ/ךָ֔ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּ/אַחֲרִ֣ית הַ/זָּ֑עַם כִּ֖י לְ/מוֹעֵ֥ד קֵֽץ
verses.translit: vy'mr hnny mvdy'kh 't 'shr yhyh b'chryt hz'm khy lmv'd qts
verses.translation: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be .

verses.original: הָ/אַ֥יִל אֲשֶׁר רָאִ֖יתָ בַּ֣עַל הַ/קְּרָנָ֑יִם מַלְכֵ֖י מָדַ֥י וּ/פָרָֽס
verses.translit: h'yl 'shr r'yt b'l hqrnym mlkhy mdy vprs
verses.translation: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/צָּפִ֥יר הַ/שָּׂעִ֖יר מֶ֣לֶךְ יָוָ֑ן וְ/הַ/קֶּ֤רֶן הַ/גְּדוֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּין עֵינָ֔י/ו ה֖וּא הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ הָ/רִאשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vhtspyr hsh'yr mlkh yvn vhqrn hgdvlh 'shr byn 'ynyv hv' hmlkh hr'shvn
verses.translation: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/נִּשְׁבֶּ֔רֶת וַ/תַּֽעֲמֹ֥דְנָה אַרְבַּ֖ע תַּחְתֶּ֑י/הָ אַרְבַּ֧ע מַלְכֻי֛וֹת מִ/גּ֥וֹי יַעֲמֹ֖דְנָה וְ/לֹ֥א בְ/כֹחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhnshbrt vt'mdnh 'rb' tchtyh 'rb' mlkhyvt mgvy y'mdnh vl' bkhchv
verses.translation: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/אַחֲרִית֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔/ם כְּ/הָתֵ֖ם הַ/פֹּשְׁעִ֑ים יַעֲמֹ֛ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עַז פָּנִ֖ים וּ/מֵבִ֥ין חִידֽוֹת
verses.translit: vb'chryt mlkhvtm khhtm hpsh'ym y'md mlkh 'z pnym vmbyn chydvt
verses.translation: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

verses.original: וְ/עָצַ֤ם כֹּח/וֹ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א בְ/כֹח֔/וֹ וְ/נִפְלָא֥וֹת יַשְׁחִ֖ית וְ/הִצְלִ֣יחַ וְ/עָשָׂ֑ה וְ/הִשְׁחִ֥ית עֲצוּמִ֖ים וְ/עַם קְדֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: v'tsm khchv vl' bkhchv vnpl'vt yshchyt vhtslych v'shh vhshchyt 'tsvmym v'm qdshym
verses.translation: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

verses.original: וְ/עַל שִׂכְל֗/וֹ וְ/הִצְלִ֤יחַ מִרְמָה֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וּ/בִ/לְבָב֣/וֹ יַגְדִּ֔יל וּ/בְ/שַׁלְוָ֖ה יַשְׁחִ֣ית רַבִּ֑ים וְ/עַ֤ל שַׂר שָׂרִים֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וּ/בְ/אֶ֥פֶס יָ֖ד יִשָּׁבֵֽר
verses.translit: v'l shkhlv vhtslych mrmh bydv vblbbv ygdyl vbshlvh yshchyt rbym v'l shr shrym y'md vb'ps yd yshbr
verses.translation: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

verses.original: וּ/מַרְאֵ֨ה הָ/עֶ֧רֶב וְ/הַ/בֹּ֛קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱמַ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת ה֑וּא וְ/אַתָּה֙ סְתֹ֣ם הֶֽ/חָז֔וֹן כִּ֖י לְ/יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vmr'h h'rb vhbqr 'shr n'mr 'mt hv' v'th stm hchzvn khy lymym rbym
verses.translation: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֗אל נִהְיֵ֤יתִי וְ/נֶֽחֱלֵ֨יתִי֙ יָמִ֔ים וָ/אָק֕וּם וָ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה אֶת מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וָ/אֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם עַל הַ/מַּרְאֶ֖ה וְ/אֵ֥ין מֵבִֽין
verses.translit: v'ny dny'l nhyyty vnchlyty ymym v'qvm v''shh 't ml'kht hmlkh v'shtvmm 'l hmr'h v'yn mbyn
verses.translation: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it .

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְ/דָרְיָ֛וֶשׁ בֶּן אֲחַשְׁוֵר֖וֹשׁ מִ/זֶּ֣רַע מָדָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָמְלַ֔ךְ עַ֖ל מַלְכ֥וּת כַּשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: bshnt 'cht ldryvsh bn 'chshvrvsh mzr' mdy 'shr hmlkh 'l mlkhvt khshdym
verses.translation: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֤ת אַחַת֙ לְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ אֲנִי֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל בִּינֹ֖תִי בַּ/סְּפָרִ֑ים מִסְפַּ֣ר הַ/שָּׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יִרְמִיָ֣ה הַ/נָּבִ֔יא לְ/מַלֹּ֛אות לְ/חָרְב֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt 'cht lmlkhv 'ny dny'l bynty bsprym mspr hshnym 'shr hyh dbr yhvh 'l yrmyh hnby' lml'vt lchrbvt yrvshlm shb'ym shnh
verses.translation: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתְּנָ֣/ה אֶת פָּנַ֗/י אֶל אֲדֹנָ/י֙ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְ/בַקֵּ֥שׁ תְּפִלָּ֖ה וְ/תַחֲנוּנִ֑ים בְּ/צ֖וֹם וְ/שַׂ֥ק וָ/אֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: v'tnh 't pny 'l 'dny h'lhym lbqsh tplh vtchnvnym btsvm vshq v'pr
verses.translation: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶתְפַּֽלְלָ֛/ה לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖/י וָ/אֶתְוַדֶּ֑ה וָ/אֹֽמְרָ֗/ה אָנָּ֤א אֲדֹנָ/י֙ הָ/אֵ֤ל הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ וְ/הַ/נּוֹרָ֔א שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַ/בְּרִית֙ וְֽ/הַ/חֶ֔סֶד לְ/אֹהֲבָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'tpllh lyhvh 'lhy v'tvdh v'mrh 'n' 'dny h'l hgdvl vhnvr' shmr hbryt vhchsd l'hbyv vlshmry mtsvtyv
verses.translation: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;

verses.original: חָטָ֥אנוּ וְ/עָוִ֖ינוּ ו/הרשענו הִרְשַׁ֣עְנוּ וּ/מָרָ֑דְנוּ וְ/ס֥וֹר מִ/מִּצְוֺתֶ֖/ךָ וּ/מִ/מִּשְׁפָּטֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: cht'nv v'vynv vhrsh'nv hrsh'nv vmrdnv vsvr mmtsvtkh vmmshptykh
verses.translation: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ֙ אֶל עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבְּרוּ֙ בְּ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֔ אֶל מְלָכֵ֥י/נוּ שָׂרֵ֖י/נוּ וַ/אֲבֹתֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/אֶ֖ל כָּל עַ֥ם הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vl' shm'nv 'l 'bdykh hnby'ym 'shr dbrv bshmkh 'l mlkhynv shrynv v'btynv v'l khl 'm h'rts
verses.translation: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

verses.original: לְ/ךָ֤ אֲדֹנָ/י֙ הַ/צְּדָקָ֔ה וְ/לָ֛/נוּ בֹּ֥שֶׁת הַ/פָּנִ֖ים כַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה לְ/אִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/לְ/יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּֽ/לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֞ל הַ/קְּרֹבִ֣ים וְ/הָ/רְחֹקִ֗ים בְּ/כָל הָֽ/אֲרָצוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִדַּחְתָּ֣/ם שָׁ֔ם בְּ/מַעֲלָ֖/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָֽעֲלוּ בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lkh 'dny htsdqh vlnv bsht hpnym khyvm hzh l'ysh yhvdh vlyvshby yrvshlm vlkhl yshr'l hqrbym vhrchqym bkhl h'rtsvt 'shr hdchtm shm bm'lm 'shr m'lv bkh
verses.translation: O Lord, righteousness belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה לָ֚/נוּ בֹּ֣שֶׁת הַ/פָּנִ֔ים לִ/מְלָכֵ֥י/נוּ לְ/שָׂרֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/לַ/אֲבֹתֵ֑י/נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: yhvh lnv bsht hpnym lmlkhynv lshrynv vl'btynv 'shr cht'nv lkh
verses.translation: O Lord, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.

verses.original: לַֽ/אדֹנָ֣/י אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ הָ/רַחֲמִ֖ים וְ/הַ/סְּלִח֑וֹת כִּ֥י מָרַ֖דְנוּ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'dny 'lhynv hrchmym vhslchvt khy mrdnv bv
verses.translation: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ לָ/לֶ֤כֶת בְּ/תֽוֹרֹתָי/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣ן לְ/פָנֵ֔י/נוּ בְּ/יַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥י/ו הַ/נְּבִיאִֽים
verses.translit: vl' shm'nv bqvl yhvh 'lhynv llkht btvrtyv 'shr ntn lpnynv byd 'bdyv hnby'ym
verses.translation: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עָֽבְרוּ֙ אֶת תּ֣וֹרָתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/ס֕וֹר לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּ/קֹלֶ֑/ךָ וַ/תִּתַּ֨ךְ עָלֵ֜י/נוּ הָ/אָלָ֣ה וְ/הַ/שְּׁבֻעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר כְּתוּבָה֙ בְּ/תוֹרַת֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l 'brv 't tvrtkh vsvr lblty shmv' bqlkh vttkh 'lynv h'lh vhshb'h 'shr khtvbh btvrt mshh 'bd h'lhym khy cht'nv lv
verses.translation: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֜קֶם אֶת דברי/ו דְּבָר֣/וֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלֵ֗י/נוּ וְ/עַ֤ל שֹֽׁפְטֵ֨י/נוּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁפָט֔וּ/נוּ לְ/הָבִ֥יא עָלֵ֖י/נוּ רָעָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא נֶעֶשְׂתָ֗ה תַּ֚חַת כָּל הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֖ה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyqm 't dbryv dbrv 'shr dbr 'lynv v'l shptynv 'shr shptvnv lhby' 'lynv r'h gdlh 'shr l' n'shth tcht khl hshmym kh'shr n'shth byrvshlm
verses.translation: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּתוּב֙ בְּ/תוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את בָּ֣אָה עָלֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/לֹֽא חִלִּ֜ינוּ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ לָ/שׁוּב֙ מֵֽ/עֲוֺנֵ֔/נוּ וּ/לְ/הַשְׂכִּ֖יל בַּ/אֲמִתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: kh'shr khtvb btvrt mshh 't khl hr'h hz't b'h 'lynv vl' chlynv 't pny yhvh 'lhynv lshvb m'vnnv vlhshkhyl b'mtkh
verses.translation: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁקֹ֤ד יְהוָה֙ עַל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה וַ/יְבִיאֶ֖/הָ עָלֵ֑י/נוּ כִּֽי צַדִּ֞יק יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ עַל כָּל מַֽעֲשָׂי/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּ/קֹלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshqd yhvh 'l hr'h vyby'h 'lynv khy tsdyq yhvh 'lhynv 'l khl m'shyv 'shr 'shh vl' shm'nv bqlv
verses.translation: Therefore hath the LORD watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣/י אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ הוֹצֵ֨אתָ אֶֽת עַמְּ/ךָ֜ מֵ/אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בְּ/יָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה וַ/תַּֽעַשׂ לְ/ךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה חָטָ֖אנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ
verses.translit: v'th 'dny 'lhynv 'shr hvts't 't 'mkh m'rts mtsrym byd chzqh vt'sh lkh shm khyvm hzh cht'nv rsh'nv
verses.translation: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֗/י כְּ/כָל צִדְקֹתֶ֨/ךָ֙ יָֽשָׁב נָ֤א אַפְּ/ךָ֙ וַ/חֲמָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ מֵ/עִֽירְ/ךָ֥ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הַר קָדְשֶׁ֑/ךָ כִּ֤י בַ/חֲטָאֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וּ/בַ/עֲוֺנ֣וֹת אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֧ם וְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֛ לְ/חֶרְפָּ֖ה לְ/כָל סְבִיבֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: 'dny khkhl tsdqtkh yshb n' 'pkh vchmtkh m'yrkh yrvshlm hr qdshkh khy bcht'ynv vb'vnvt 'btynv yrvshlm v'mkh lchrph lkhl sbybtynv
verses.translation: O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה שְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ אֶל תְּפִלַּ֤ת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/אֶל תַּ֣חֲנוּנָ֔י/ו וְ/הָאֵ֣ר פָּנֶ֔י/ךָ עַל מִקְדָּשְׁ/ךָ֖ הַ/שָּׁמֵ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן אֲדֹנָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th shm' 'lhynv 'l tplt 'bdkh v'l tchnvnyv vh'r pnykh 'l mqdshkh hshmm lm'n 'dny
verses.translation: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

verses.original: הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥/י אָזְנְ/ךָ֮ וּֽ/שֲׁמָע֒ פקח/ה פְּקַ֣ח עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ וּ/רְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/הָ/עִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ עָלֶ֑י/הָ כִּ֣י לֹ֣א עַל צִדְקֹתֵ֗י/נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֨י/נוּ֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֖י עַל רַחֲמֶ֥י/ךָ הָ/רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: hth 'lhy 'znkh vshm' pqchh pqch 'ynykh vr'h shmmtynv vh'yr 'shr nqr' shmkh 'lyh khy l' 'l tsdqtynv 'nchnv mpylym tchnvnynv lpnykh khy 'l rchmykh hrbym
verses.translation: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֤/י שְׁמָ֨עָ/ה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י סְלָ֔חָ/ה אֲדֹנָ֛/י הַֽקֲשִׁ֥יבָ/ה וַ/עֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעֲנְ/ךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔/י כִּֽי שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל עִירְ/ךָ֖ וְ/עַל עַמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'dny shm'h 'dny slchh 'dny hqshybh v'shh 'l t'chr lm'nkh 'lhy khy shmkh nqr' 'l 'yrkh v'l 'mkh
verses.translation: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.

verses.original: וְ/ע֨וֹד אֲנִ֤י מְדַבֵּר֙ וּ/מִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל וּ/מִתְוַדֶּה֙ חַטָּאתִ֔/י וְ/חַטַּ֖את עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/מַפִּ֣יל תְּחִנָּתִ֗/י לִ/פְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔/י עַ֖ל הַר קֹ֥דֶשׁ אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'vd 'ny mdbr vmtpll vmtvdh cht'ty vcht't 'my yshr'l vmpyl tchnty lpny yhvh 'lhy 'l hr qdsh 'lhy
verses.translation: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;

verses.original: וְ/ע֛וֹד אֲנִ֥י מְדַבֵּ֖ר בַּ/תְּפִלָּ֑ה וְ/הָ/אִ֣ישׁ גַּבְרִיאֵ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ רָאִ֨יתִי בֶ/חָז֤וֹן בַּ/תְּחִלָּה֙ מֻעָ֣ף בִּ/יעָ֔ף נֹגֵ֣עַ אֵלַ֔/י כְּ/עֵ֖ת מִנְחַת עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'vd 'ny mdbr btplh vh'ysh gbry'l 'shr r'yty bchzvn btchlh m'f by'f ng' 'ly kh't mncht 'rb
verses.translation: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖בֶן וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמִּ֑/י וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר דָּנִיֵּ֕אל עַתָּ֥ה יָצָ֖אתִי לְ/הַשְׂכִּילְ/ךָ֥ בִינָֽה
verses.translit: vybn vydbr 'my vy'mr dny'l 'th yts'ty lhshkhylkh bynh
verses.translation: And he informed me , and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.

verses.original: בִּ/תְחִלַּ֨ת תַּחֲנוּנֶ֜י/ךָ יָצָ֣א דָבָ֗ר וַ/אֲנִי֙ בָּ֣אתִי לְ/הַגִּ֔יד כִּ֥י חֲמוּד֖וֹת אָ֑תָּה וּ/בִין֙ בַּ/דָּבָ֔ר וְ/הָבֵ֖ן בַּ/מַּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: btchlt tchnvnykh yts' dbr v'ny b'ty lhgyd khy chmvdvt 'th vbyn bdbr vhbn bmr'h
verses.translation: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew thee; for thou art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.

verses.original: שָׁבֻעִ֨ים שִׁבְעִ֜ים נֶחְתַּ֥ךְ עַֽל עַמְּ/ךָ֣ וְ/עַל עִ֣יר קָדְשֶׁ֗/ךָ לְ/כַלֵּ֨א הַ/פֶּ֜שַׁע ו/ל/חתם וּ/לְ/הָתֵ֤ם חטאות חַטָּאת֙ וּ/לְ/כַפֵּ֣ר עָוֺ֔ן וּ/לְ/הָבִ֖יא צֶ֣דֶק עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וְ/לַ/חְתֹּם֙ חָז֣וֹן וְ/נָבִ֔יא וְ/לִ/מְשֹׁ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: shb'ym shb'ym nchtkh 'l 'mkh v'l 'yr qdshkh lkhl' hpsh' vlchtm vlhtm cht'vt cht't vlkhpr 'vn vlhby' tsdq 'lmym vlchtm chzvn vnby' vlmshch qdsh qdshym
verses.translation: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

verses.original: וְ/תֵדַ֨ע וְ/תַשְׂכֵּ֜ל מִן מֹצָ֣א דָבָ֗ר לְ/הָשִׁיב֙ וְ/לִ/בְנ֤וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עַד מָשִׁ֣יחַ נָגִ֔יד שָׁבֻעִ֖ים שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְ/שָׁבֻעִ֞ים שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּ/שְׁנַ֗יִם תָּשׁוּב֙ וְ/נִבְנְתָה֙ רְח֣וֹב וְ/חָר֔וּץ וּ/בְ/צ֖וֹק הָ/עִתִּֽים
verses.translit: vtd' vtshkhl mn mts' dbr lhshyb vlbnvt yrvshlm 'd mshych ngyd shb'ym shb'h vshb'ym shshym vshnym tshvb vnbnth rchvb vchrvts vbtsvq h'tym
verses.translation: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵ֤י הַ/שָּׁבֻעִים֙ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּ/שְׁנַ֔יִם יִכָּרֵ֥ת מָשִׁ֖יחַ וְ/אֵ֣ין ל֑/וֹ וְ/הָ/עִ֨יר וְ/הַ/קֹּ֜דֶשׁ יַ֠שְׁחִית עַ֣ם נָגִ֤יד הַ/בָּא֙ וְ/קִצּ֣/וֹ בַ/שֶּׁ֔טֶף וְ/עַד֙ קֵ֣ץ מִלְחָמָ֔ה נֶחֱרֶ֖צֶת שֹׁמֵמֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'chry hshb'ym shshym vshnym ykhrt mshych v'yn lv vh'yr vhqdsh yshchyt 'm ngyd hb' vqtsv bshtf v'd qts mlchmh nchrtst shmmvt
verses.translation: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.

verses.original: וְ/הִגְבִּ֥יר בְּרִ֛ית לָ/רַבִּ֖ים שָׁב֣וּעַ אֶחָ֑ד וַ/חֲצִ֨י הַ/שָּׁב֜וּעַ יַשְׁבִּ֣ית זֶ֣בַח וּ/מִנְחָ֗ה וְ/עַ֨ל כְּנַ֤ף שִׁקּוּצִים֙ מְשֹׁמֵ֔ם וְ/עַד כָּלָה֙ וְ/נֶ֣חֱרָצָ֔ה תִּתַּ֖ךְ עַל שֹׁמֵֽם
verses.translit: vhgbyr bryt lrbym shbv' 'chd vchtsy hshbv' yshbyt zbch vmnchh v'l khnf shqvtsym mshmm v'd khlh vnchrtsh ttkh 'l shmm
verses.translation: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֗וֹשׁ לְ/כ֨וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס דָּבָר֙ נִגְלָ֣ה לְ/דָֽנִיֵּ֔אל אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר וֶ/אֱמֶ֤ת הַ/דָּבָר֙ וְ/צָבָ֣א גָד֔וֹל וּ/בִין֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֔ר וּ/בִ֥ינָה ל֖/וֹ בַּ/מַּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shlvsh lkhvrsh mlkh prs dbr nglh ldny'l 'shr nqr' shmv bltsh'tsr v'mt hdbr vtsb' gdvl vbyn 't hdbr vbynh lv bmr'h
verses.translation: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֖ים הָ/הֵ֑ם אֲנִ֤י דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ הָיִ֣יתִי מִתְאַבֵּ֔ל שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים
verses.translit: bymym hhm 'ny dny'l hyyty mt'bl shlshh shb'ym ymym
verses.translation: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם חֲמֻד֞וֹת לֹ֣א אָכַ֗לְתִּי וּ/בָשָׂ֥ר וָ/יַ֛יִן לֹא בָ֥א אֶל פִּ֖/י וְ/ס֣וֹךְ לֹא סָ֑כְתִּי עַד מְלֹ֕את שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים
verses.translit: lchm chmdvt l' 'khlty vbshr vyyn l' b' 'l py vsvkh l' skhty 'd ml't shlsht shb'ym ymym
verses.translation: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/י֛וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן וַ/אֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי עַ֣ל יַ֧ד הַ/נָּהָ֛ר הַ/גָּד֖וֹל ה֥וּא חִדָּֽקֶל
verses.translit: vbyvm 'shrym v'rb'h lchdsh hr'shvn v'ny hyyty 'l yd hnhr hgdvl hv' chdql
verses.translation: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;

verses.original: וָ/אֶשָּׂ֤א אֶת עֵינַ/י֙ וָ/אֵ֔רֶא וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה אִישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לָב֣וּשׁ בַּדִּ֑ים וּ/מָתְנָ֥י/ו חֲגֻרִ֖ים בְּ/כֶ֥תֶם אוּפָֽז
verses.translit: v'sh' 't 'yny v'r' vhnh 'ysh 'chd lbvsh bdym vmtnyv chgrym bkhtm 'vpz
verses.translation: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:

verses.original: וּ/גְוִיָּת֣/וֹ כְ/תַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ וּ/פָנָ֞י/ו כְּ/מַרְאֵ֤ה בָרָק֙ וְ/עֵינָי/ו֙ כְּ/לַפִּ֣ידֵי אֵ֔שׁ וּ/זְרֹֽעֹתָי/ו֙ וּ/מַרְגְּלֹתָ֔י/ו כְּ/עֵ֖ין נְחֹ֣שֶׁת קָלָ֑ל וְ/ק֥וֹל דְּבָרָ֖י/ו כְּ/ק֥וֹל הָמֽוֹן
verses.translit: vgvytv khtrshysh vpnyv khmr'h brq v'ynyv khlpydy 'sh vzr'tyv vmrgltyv kh'yn nchsht qll vqvl dbryv khqvl hmvn
verses.translation: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

verses.original: וְ/רָאִיתִי֩ אֲנִ֨י דָנִיֵּ֤אל לְ/בַדִּ/י֙ אֶת הַ/מַּרְאָ֔ה וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ עִמִּ֔/י לֹ֥א רָא֖וּ אֶת הַ/מַּרְאָ֑ה אֲבָ֗ל חֲרָדָ֤ה גְדֹלָה֙ נָפְלָ֣ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וַֽ/יִּבְרְח֖וּ בְּ/הֵחָבֵֽא
verses.translit: vr'yty 'ny dny'l lbdy 't hmr'h vh'nshym 'shr hyv 'my l' r'v 't hmr'h 'bl chrdh gdlh nplh 'lyhm vybrchv bhchb'
verses.translation: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְ/בַדִּ֔/י וָֽ/אֶרְאֶ֗ה אֶת הַ/מַּרְאָ֤ה הַ/גְּדֹלָה֙ הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/לֹ֥א נִשְׁאַר בִּ֖/י כֹּ֑ח וְ/הוֹדִ֗/י נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ עָלַ/י֙ לְ/מַשְׁחִ֔ית וְ/לֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ
verses.translit: v'ny nsh'rty lbdy v'r'h 't hmr'h hgdlh hz't vl' nsh'r by khch vhvdy nhpkh 'ly lmshchyt vl' 'tsrty khch
verses.translation: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֖ע אֶת ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֑י/ו וּ/כְ/שָׁמְעִ/י֙ אֶת ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֔י/ו וַ/אֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי נִרְדָּ֥ם עַל פָּנַ֖/י וּ/פָנַ֥/י אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: v'shm' 't qvl dbryv vkhshm'y 't qvl dbryv v'ny hyyty nrdm 'l pny vpny 'rtsh
verses.translation: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה יָ֖ד נָ֣גְעָה בִּ֑/י וַ/תְּנִיעֵ֥/נִי עַל בִּרְכַּ֖/י וְ/כַפּ֥וֹת יָדָֽ/י
verses.translit: vhnh yd ng'h by vtny'ny 'l brkhy vkhpvt ydy
verses.translation: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡/י דָּנִיֵּ֣אל אִישׁ חֲ֠מֻדוֹת הָבֵ֨ן בַּ/דְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר֩ אָנֹכִ֨י דֹבֵ֤ר אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וַ/עֲמֹ֣ד עַל עָמְדֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה שֻׁלַּ֣חְתִּי אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/בְ/דַבְּר֥/וֹ עִמִּ֛/י אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה עָמַ֥דְתִּי מַרְעִֽיד
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly dny'l 'ysh chmdvt hbn bdbrym 'shr 'nkhy dbr 'lykh v'md 'l 'mdkh khy 'th shlchty 'lykh vbdbrv 'my 't hdbr hzh 'mdty mr'yd
verses.translation: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ/י֮ אַל תִּירָ֣א דָנִיֵּאל֒ כִּ֣י מִן הַ/יּ֣וֹם הָ/רִאשׁ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תָּ אֶֽת לִבְּ/ךָ֛ לְ/הָבִ֧ין וּ/לְ/הִתְעַנּ֛וֹת לִ/פְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נִשְׁמְע֣וּ דְבָרֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/אֲנִי בָ֖אתִי בִּ/דְבָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'l tyr' dny'l khy mn hyvm hr'shvn 'shr ntt 't lbkh lhbyn vlht'nvt lpny 'lhykh nshm'v dbrykh v'ny b'ty bdbrykh
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂ֣ר מַלְכ֣וּת פָּרַ֗ס עֹמֵ֤ד לְ/נֶגְדִּ/י֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְ/אֶחָ֣ד י֔וֹם וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה מִֽיכָאֵ֗ל אַחַ֛ד הַ/שָּׂרִ֥ים הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים בָּ֣א לְ/עָזְרֵ֑/נִי וַ/אֲנִי֙ נוֹתַ֣רְתִּי שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖צֶל מַלְכֵ֥י פָרָֽס
verses.translit: vshr mlkhvt prs 'md lngdy 'shrym v'chd yvm vhnh mykh'l 'chd hshrym hr'shnym b' l'zrny v'ny nvtrty shm 'tsl mlkhy prs
verses.translation: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֨אתִי֙ לַ/הֲבִ֣ינְ/ךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָ֥ה לְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֖ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֣ית הַ/יָּמִ֑ים כִּי ע֥וֹד חָז֖וֹן לַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vb'ty lhbynkh 't 'shr yqrh l'mkh b'chryt hymym khy 'vd chzvn lymym
verses.translation: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/דַבְּר֣/וֹ עִמִּ֔/י כַּ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה נָתַ֧תִּי פָנַ֛/י אַ֖רְצָ/ה וְ/נֶאֱלָֽמְתִּי
verses.translit: vbdbrv 'my khdbrym h'lh ntty pny 'rtsh vn'lmty
verses.translation: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֗ה כִּ/דְמוּת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ עַל שְׂפָתָ֑/י וָ/אֶפְתַּח פִּ֗/י וָ/אֲדַבְּרָ/ה֙ וָ/אֹֽמְרָ/ה֙ אֶל הָ/עֹמֵ֣ד לְ/נֶגְדִּ֔/י אֲדֹנִ֗/י בַּ/מַּרְאָה֙ נֶהֶפְכ֤וּ צִירַ/י֙ עָלַ֔/י וְ/לֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ
verses.translit: vhnh khdmvt bny 'dm ng' 'l shpty v'ptch py v'dbrh v'mrh 'l h'md lngdy 'dny bmr'h nhpkhv tsyry 'ly vl' 'tsrty khch
verses.translation: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֣יךְ יוּכַ֗ל עֶ֤בֶד אֲדֹנִ/י֙ זֶ֔ה לְ/דַבֵּ֖ר עִם אֲדֹ֣נִ/י זֶ֑ה וַ/אֲנִ֤י מֵ/עַ֨תָּה֙ לֹֽא יַעֲמָד בִּ֣/י כֹ֔חַ וּ/נְשָׁמָ֖ה לֹ֥א נִשְׁאֲרָה בִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhykh yvkhl 'bd 'dny zh ldbr 'm 'dny zh v'ny m'th l' y'md by khch vnshmh l' nsh'rh by
verses.translation: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧סֶף וַ/יִּגַּע בִּ֛/י כְּ/מַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֖ם וַֽ/יְחַזְּקֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vysf vyg' by khmr'h 'dm vychzqny
verses.translation: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר אַל תִּירָ֧א אִישׁ חֲמֻד֛וֹת שָׁל֥וֹם לָ֖/ךְ חֲזַ֣ק וַ/חֲזָ֑ק וּֽ/בְ/דַבְּר֤/וֹ עִמִּ/י֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔קְתִּי וָ/אֹֽמְרָ֛/ה יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖/י כִּ֥י חִזַּקְתָּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l tyr' 'ysh chmdvt shlvm lkh chzq vchzq vbdbrv 'my htchzqty v'mrh ydbr 'dny khy chzqtny
verses.translation: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הֲ/יָדַ֨עְתָּ֙ לָ/מָּה בָּ֣אתִי אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/עַתָּ֣ה אָשׁ֔וּב לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם שַׂ֣ר פָּרָ֑ס וַ/אֲנִ֣י יוֹצֵ֔א וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה שַׂר יָוָ֖ן בָּֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr hyd't lmh b'ty 'lykh v'th 'shvb lhlchm 'm shr prs v'ny yvts' vhnh shr yvn b'
verses.translation: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.

verses.original: אֲבָל֙ אַגִּ֣יד לְ/ךָ֔ אֶת הָ/רָשׁ֥וּם בִּ/כְתָ֖ב אֱמֶ֑ת וְ/אֵ֨ין אֶחָ֜ד מִתְחַזֵּ֤ק עִמִּ/י֙ עַל אֵ֔לֶּה כִּ֥י אִם מִיכָאֵ֖ל שַׂרְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'bl 'gyd lkh 't hrshvm bkhtb 'mt v'yn 'chd mtchzq 'my 'l 'lh khy 'm mykh'l shrkhm
verses.translation: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִי֙ בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֔ת לְ/דָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַ/מָּדִ֑י עָמְדִ֛/י לְ/מַחֲזִ֥יק וּ/לְ/מָע֖וֹז לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'ny bshnt 'cht ldryvsh hmdy 'mdy lmchzyq vlm'vz lv
verses.translation: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה אֱמֶ֖ת אַגִּ֣יד לָ֑/ךְ הִנֵּה עוֹד֩ שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה מְלָכִ֜ים עֹמְדִ֣ים לְ/פָרַ֗ס וְ/הָֽ/רְבִיעִי֙ יַעֲשִׁ֤יר עֹֽשֶׁר גָּדוֹל֙ מִ/כֹּ֔ל וּ/כְ/חֶזְקָת֣/וֹ בְ/עָשְׁר֔/וֹ יָעִ֣יר הַ/כֹּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מַלְכ֥וּת יָוָֽן
verses.translit: v'th 'mt 'gyd lkh hnh 'vd shlshh mlkhym 'mdym lprs vhrby'y y'shyr 'shr gdvl mkhl vkhchzqtv b'shrv y'yr hkhl 't mlkhvt yvn
verses.translation: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.

verses.original: וְ/עָמַ֖ד מֶ֣לֶךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר וּ/מָשַׁל֙ מִמְשָׁ֣ל רַ֔ב וְ/עָשָׂ֖ה כִּ/רְצוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'md mlkh gbvr vmshl mmshl rb v'shh khrtsvnv
verses.translation: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/עָמְד/וֹ֙ תִּשָּׁבֵ֣ר מַלְכוּת֔/וֹ וְ/תֵחָ֕ץ לְ/אַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֣וֹת הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/לֹ֣א לְ/אַחֲרִית֗/וֹ וְ/לֹ֤א כְ/מָשְׁל/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָשָׁ֔ל כִּ֤י תִנָּתֵשׁ֙ מַלְכוּת֔/וֹ וְ/לַ/אֲחֵרִ֖ים מִ/לְּ/בַד אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vkh'mdv tshbr mlkhvtv vtchts l'rb' rvchvt hshmym vl' l'chrytv vl' khmshlv 'shr mshl khy tntsh mlkhvtv vl'chrym mlbd 'lh
verses.translation: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.

verses.original: וְ/יֶחֱזַ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/נֶּ֖גֶב וּ/מִן שָׂרָ֑י/ו וְ/יֶחֱזַ֤ק עָלָי/ו֙ וּ/מָשָׁ֔ל מִמְשָׁ֥ל רַ֖ב מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychzq mlkh hngb vmn shryv vychzq 'lyv vmshl mmshl rb mmshltv
verses.translation: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/קֵ֤ץ שָׁנִים֙ יִתְחַבָּ֔רוּ וּ/בַ֣ת מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/נֶּ֗גֶב תָּבוֹא֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֔וֹן לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת מֵישָׁרִ֑ים וְ/לֹֽא תַעְצֹ֞ר כּ֣וֹחַ הַ/זְּר֗וֹעַ וְ/לֹ֤א יַעֲמֹד֙ וּ/זְרֹע֔/וֹ וְ/תִנָּתֵ֨ן הִ֤יא וּ/מְבִיאֶ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/הַ/יֹּ֣לְדָ֔/הּ וּ/מַחֲזִקָ֖/הּ בָּ/עִתִּֽים
verses.translit: vlqts shnym ytchbrv vbt mlkh hngb tbv' 'l mlkh htspvn l'shvt myshrym vl' t'tsr khvch hzrv' vl' y'md vzr'v vtntn hy' vmby'yh vhyldh vmchzqh b'tym
verses.translation: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king’s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.

verses.original: וְ/עָמַ֛ד מִ/נֵּ֥צֶר שָׁרָשֶׁ֖י/הָ כַּנּ֑/וֹ וְ/יָבֹ֣א אֶל הַ/חַ֗יִל וְ/יָבֹא֙ בְּ/מָעוֹז֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֔וֹן וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה בָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/הֶחֱזִֽיק
verses.translit: v'md mntsr shrshyh khnv vyb' 'l hchyl vyb' bm'vz mlkh htspvn v'shh bhm vhchzyq
verses.translation: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אֱֽלֹהֵי/הֶ֡ם עִם נְסִֽכֵי/הֶם֩ עִם כְּלֵ֨י חֶמְדָּתָ֜/ם כֶּ֧סֶף וְ/זָהָ֛ב בַּ/שְּׁבִ֖י יָבִ֣א מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הוּא֙ שָׁנִ֣ים יַעֲמֹ֔ד מִ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ הַ/צָּפֽוֹן
verses.translit: vgm 'lhyhm 'm nskhyhm 'm khly chmdtm khsf vzhb bshby yb' mtsrym vhv' shnym y'md mmlkh htspvn
verses.translation: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֗א בְּ/מַלְכוּת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב וְ/שָׁ֖ב אֶל אַדְמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vb' bmlkhvt mlkh hngb vshb 'l 'dmtv
verses.translation: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.

verses.original: ו/בנ/ו וּ/בָנָ֣י/ו יִתְגָּר֗וּ וְ/אָסְפוּ֙ הֲמוֹן֙ חֲיָלִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וּ/בָ֥א ב֖וֹא וְ/שָׁטַ֣ף וְ/עָבָ֑ר וְ/יָשֹׁ֥ב ו/יתגרו וְ/יִתְגָּרֶ֖ה עַד מעז/ה מָעֻזּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbnv vbnyv ytgrv v'spv hmvn chylym rbym vb' bv' vshtf v'br vyshb vytgrv vytgrh 'd m'zh m'zv
verses.translation: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.

verses.original: וְ/יִתְמַרְמַר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב וְ/יָצָ֕א וְ/נִלְחַ֥ם עִמּ֖/וֹ עִם מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֑וֹן וְ/הֶעֱמִיד֙ הָמ֣וֹן רָ֔ב וְ/נִתַּ֥ן הֶ/הָמ֖וֹן בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytmrmr mlkh hngb vyts' vnlchm 'mv 'm mlkh htspvn vh'myd hmvn rb vntn hhmvn bydv
verses.translation: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

verses.original: וְ/נִשָּׂ֥א הֶ/הָמ֖וֹן ירום וְ/רָ֣ם לְבָב֑/וֹ וְ/הִפִּ֛יל רִבֹּא֖וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א יָעֽוֹז
verses.translit: vnsh' hhmvn yrvm vrm lbbv vhpyl rb'vt vl' y'vz
verses.translation: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it .

verses.original: וְ/שָׁב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֔וֹן וְ/הֶעֱמִ֣יד הָמ֔וֹן רַ֖ב מִן הָ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן וּ/לְ/קֵ֨ץ הָֽ/עִתִּ֤ים שָׁנִים֙ יָ֣בוֹא ב֔וֹא בְּ/חַ֥יִל גָּד֖וֹל וּ/בִ/רְכ֥וּשׁ רָֽב
verses.translit: vshb mlkh htspvn vh'myd hmvn rb mn hr'shvn vlqts h'tym shnym ybv' bv' bchyl gdvl vbrkhvsh rb
verses.translation: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.

verses.original: וּ/בָ/עִתִּ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם רַבִּ֥ים יַֽעַמְד֖וּ עַל מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/נֶּ֑גֶב וּ/בְנֵ֣י פָּרִיצֵ֣י עַמְּ/ךָ֗ יִֽנַּשְּׂא֛וּ לְ/הַעֲמִ֥יד חָז֖וֹן וְ/נִכְשָֽׁלוּ
verses.translit: vb'tym hhm rbym y'mdv 'l mlkh hngb vbny prytsy 'mkh ynsh'v lh'myd chzvn vnkhshlv
verses.translation: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

verses.original: וְ/יָבֹא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֔וֹן וְ/יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ סֽוֹלֲלָ֔ה וְ/לָכַ֖ד עִ֣יר מִבְצָר֑וֹת וּ/זְרֹע֤וֹת הַ/נֶּ֨גֶב֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ וְ/עַם֙ מִבְחָרָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַ/עֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: vyb' mlkh htspvn vyshpkh svllh vlkhd 'yr mbtsrvt vzr'vt hngb l' y'mdv v'm mbchryv v'yn khch l'md
verses.translation: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.

verses.original: וְ/יַ֨עַשׂ הַ/בָּ֤א אֵלָי/ו֙ כִּ/רְצוֹנ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵ֥ין עוֹמֵ֖ד לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וְ/יַעֲמֹ֥ד בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ הַ/צְּבִ֖י וְ/כָלָ֥ה בְ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh hb' 'lyv khrtsvnv v'yn 'vmd lpnyv vy'md b'rts htsby vkhlh bydv
verses.translation: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.

verses.original: וְ/יָשֵׂ֣ם פָּ֠נָי/ו לָ/ב֞וֹא בְּ/תֹ֧קֶף כָּל מַלְכוּת֛/וֹ וִ/ישָׁרִ֥ים עִמּ֖/וֹ וְ/עָשָׂ֑ה וּ/בַ֤ת הַ/נָּשִׁים֙ יִתֶּן ל֣/וֹ לְ/הַשְׁחִיתָ֔/הּ וְ/לֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד וְ/לֹא ל֥/וֹ תִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vyshm pnyv lbv' btqf khl mlkhvtv vyshrym 'mv v'shh vbt hnshym ytn lv lhshchyth vl' t'md vl' lv thyh
verses.translation: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side , neither be for him.

verses.original: ו/ישב וְ/יָשֵׂ֧ם פָּנָ֛י/ו לְ/אִיִּ֖ים וְ/לָכַ֣ד רַבִּ֑ים וְ/הִשְׁבִּ֨ית קָצִ֤ין חֶרְפָּת/וֹ֙ ל֔/וֹ בִּלְתִּ֥י חֶרְפָּת֖/וֹ יָשִׁ֥יב לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshb vyshm pnyv l'yym vlkhd rbym vhshbyt qtsyn chrptv lv blty chrptv yshyb lv
verses.translation: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.

verses.original: וְ/יָשֵׁ֣ב פָּנָ֔י/ו לְ/מָעוּזֵּ֖י אַרְצ֑/וֹ וְ/נִכְשַׁ֥ל וְ/נָפַ֖ל וְ/לֹ֥א יִמָּצֵֽא
verses.translit: vyshb pnyv lm'vzy 'rtsv vnkhshl vnpl vl' ymts'
verses.translation: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.

verses.original: וְ/עָמַ֧ד עַל כַּנּ֛/וֹ מַעֲבִ֥יר נוֹגֵ֖שׂ הֶ֣דֶר מַלְכ֑וּת וּ/בְ/יָמִ֤ים אֲחָדִים֙ יִשָּׁבֵ֔ר וְ/לֹ֥א בְ/אַפַּ֖יִם וְ/לֹ֥א בְ/מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: v'md 'l khnv m'byr nvgsh hdr mlkhvt vbymym 'chdym yshbr vl' b'pym vl' bmlchmh
verses.translation: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

verses.original: וְ/עָמַ֤ד עַל כַּנּ/וֹ֙ נִבְזֶ֔ה וְ/לֹא נָתְנ֥וּ עָלָ֖י/ו ה֣וֹד מַלְכ֑וּת וּ/בָ֣א בְ/שַׁלְוָ֔ה וְ/הֶחֱזִ֥יק מַלְכ֖וּת בַּ/חֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'md 'l khnv nbzh vl' ntnv 'lyv hvd mlkhvt vb' bshlvh vhchzyq mlkhvt bchlqlqvt
verses.translation: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

verses.original: וּ/זְרֹע֥וֹת הַ/שֶּׁ֛טֶף יִשָּׁטְפ֥וּ מִ/לְּ/פָנָ֖י/ו וְ/יִשָּׁבֵ֑רוּ וְ/גַ֖ם נְגִ֥יד בְּרִֽית
verses.translit: vzr'vt hshtf yshtpv mlpnyv vyshbrv vgm ngyd bryt
verses.translation: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הִֽתְחַבְּר֥וּת אֵלָ֖י/ו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִרְמָ֑ה וְ/עָלָ֥ה וְ/עָצַ֖ם בִּ/מְעַט גּֽוֹי
verses.translit: vmn htchbrvt 'lyv y'shh mrmh v'lh v'tsm bm't gvy
verses.translation: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.

verses.original: בְּ/שַׁלְוָ֞ה וּ/בְ/מִשְׁמַנֵּ֣י מְדִינָה֮ יָבוֹא֒ וְ/עָשָׂ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא עָשׂ֤וּ אֲבֹתָי/ו֙ וַ/אֲב֣וֹת אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו בִּזָּ֧ה וְ/שָׁלָ֛ל וּ/רְכ֖וּשׁ לָ/הֶ֣ם יִבְז֑וֹר וְ/עַ֧ל מִבְצָרִ֛ים יְחַשֵּׁ֥ב מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖י/ו וְ/עַד עֵֽת
verses.translit: bshlvh vbmshmny mdynh ybv' v'shh 'shr l' 'shv 'btyv v'bvt 'btyv bzh vshll vrkhvsh lhm ybzvr v'l mbtsrym ychshb mchshbtyv v'd 't
verses.translation: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea , and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.

verses.original: וְ/יָעֵר֩ כֹּח֨/וֹ וּ/לְבָב֜/וֹ עַל מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/נֶּגֶב֮ בְּ/חַ֣יִל גָּדוֹל֒ וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/נֶּ֗גֶב יִתְגָּרֶה֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה בְּ/חַֽיִל גָּד֥וֹל וְ/עָצ֖וּם עַד מְאֹ֑ד וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד כִּֽי יַחְשְׁב֥וּ עָלָ֖י/ו מַחֲשָׁבֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'r khchv vlbbv 'l mlkh hngb bchyl gdvl vmlkh hngb ytgrh lmlchmh bchyl gdvl v'tsvm 'd m'd vl' y'md khy ychshbv 'lyv mchshbvt
verses.translation: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.

verses.original: וְ/אֹכְלֵ֧י פַת בָּג֛/וֹ יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ/הוּ וְ/חֵיל֣/וֹ יִשְׁט֑וֹף וְ/נָפְל֖וּ חֲלָלִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: v'khly pt bgv yshbrvhv vchylv yshtvf vnplv chllym rbym
verses.translation: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁנֵי/הֶ֤ם הַ/מְּלָכִים֙ לְבָבָ֣/ם לְ/מֵרָ֔ע וְ/עַל שֻׁלְחָ֥ן אֶחָ֖ד כָּזָ֣ב יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְ/לֹ֣א תִצְלָ֔ח כִּי ע֥וֹד קֵ֖ץ לַ/מּוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vshnyhm hmlkhym lbbm lmr' v'l shlchn 'chd khzb ydbrv vl' ttslch khy 'vd qts lmv'd
verses.translation: And both these kings’ hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.

verses.original: וְ/יָשֹׁ֤ב אַרְצ/וֹ֙ בִּ/רְכ֣וּשׁ גָּד֔וֹל וּ/לְבָב֖/וֹ עַל בְּרִ֣ית קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְ/עָשָׂ֖ה וְ/שָׁ֥ב לְ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshb 'rtsv brkhvsh gdvl vlbbv 'l bryt qdsh v'shh vshb l'rtsv
verses.translation: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits , and return to his own land.

verses.original: לַ/מּוֹעֵ֥ד יָשׁ֖וּב וּ/בָ֣א בַ/נֶּ֑גֶב וְ/לֹֽא תִהְיֶ֥ה כָ/רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה וְ/כָ/אַחֲרֹנָֽה
verses.translit: lmv'd yshvb vb' bngb vl' thyh khr'shnh vkh'chrnh
verses.translation: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֨אוּ ב֜/וֹ צִיִּ֤ים כִּתִּים֙ וְ/נִכְאָ֔ה וְ/שָׁ֛ב וְ/זָעַ֥ם עַל בְּרִֽית ק֖וֹדֶשׁ וְ/עָשָׂ֑ה וְ/שָׁ֣ב וְ/יָבֵ֔ן עַל עֹזְבֵ֖י בְּרִ֥ית קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vb'v bv tsyym khtym vnkh'h vshb vz'm 'l bryt qvdsh v'shh vshb vybn 'l 'zby bryt qdsh
verses.translation: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.

verses.original: וּ/זְרֹעִ֖ים מִמֶּ֣/נּוּ יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וְ/חִלְּל֞וּ הַ/מִּקְדָּ֤שׁ הַ/מָּעוֹז֙ וְ/הֵסִ֣ירוּ הַ/תָּמִ֔יד וְ/נָתְנ֖וּ הַ/שִּׁקּ֥וּץ מְשׁוֹמֵֽם
verses.translit: vzr'ym mmnv y'mdv vchllv hmqdsh hm'vz vhsyrv htmyd vntnv hshqvts mshvmm
verses.translation: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice , and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.

verses.original: וּ/מַרְשִׁיעֵ֣י בְרִ֔ית יַחֲנִ֖יף בַּ/חֲלַקּ֑וֹת וְ/עַ֛ם יֹדְעֵ֥י אֱלֹהָ֖י/ו יַחֲזִ֥קוּ וְ/עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vmrshy'y bryt ychnyf bchlqvt v'm yd'y 'lhyv ychzqv v'shv
verses.translation: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits .

verses.original: וּ/מַשְׂכִּ֣ילֵי עָ֔ם יָבִ֖ינוּ לָֽ/רַבִּ֑ים וְ/נִכְשְׁל֞וּ בְּ/חֶ֧רֶב וּ/בְ/לֶהָבָ֛ה בִּ/שְׁבִ֥י וּ/בְ/בִזָּ֖ה יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vmshkhyly 'm ybynv lrbym vnkhshlv bchrb vblhbh bshby vbbzh ymym
verses.translation: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הִכָּ֣שְׁלָ֔/ם יֵעָזְר֖וּ עֵ֣זֶר מְעָ֑ט וְ/נִלְו֧וּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם רַבִּ֖ים בַּ/חֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbhkhshlm y'zrv 'zr m't vnlvv 'lyhm rbym bchlqlqvt
verses.translation: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/מַּשְׂכִּילִ֣ים יִכָּֽשְׁל֗וּ לִ/צְר֥וֹף בָּ/הֶ֛ם וּ/לְ/בָרֵ֥ר וְ/לַ/לְבֵּ֖ן עַד עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ כִּי ע֖וֹד לַ/מּוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vmn hmshkhylym ykhshlv ltsrvf bhm vlbrr vllbn 'd 't qts khy 'vd lmv'd
verses.translation: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֨ה כִ/רְצוֹנ֜/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וְ/יִתְרוֹמֵ֤ם וְ/יִתְגַּדֵּל֙ עַל כָּל אֵ֔ל וְ/עַל֙ אֵ֣ל אֵלִ֔ים יְדַבֵּ֖ר נִפְלָא֑וֹת וְ/הִצְלִ֨יחַ֙ עַד כָּ֣לָה זַ֔עַם כִּ֥י נֶחֱרָצָ֖ה נֶעֱשָֽׂתָה
verses.translit: v'shh khrtsvnv hmlkh vytrvmm vytgdl 'l khl 'l v'l 'l 'lym ydbr npl'vt vhtslych 'd khlh z'm khy nchrtsh n'shth
verses.translation: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.

verses.original: וְ/עַל אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א יָבִ֔ין וְ/עַל חֶמְדַּ֥ת נָשִׁ֛ים וְ/עַֽל כָּל אֱל֖וֹהַּ לֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין כִּ֥י עַל כֹּ֖ל יִתְגַּדָּֽל
verses.translit: v'l 'lhy 'btyv l' ybyn v'l chmdt nshym v'l khl 'lvh l' ybyn khy 'l khl ytgdl
verses.translation: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

verses.original: וְ/לֶ/אֱלֹ֨הַּ֙ מָֽעֻזִּ֔ים עַל כַּנּ֖/וֹ יְכַבֵּ֑ד וְ/לֶ/אֱל֜וֹהַּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא יְדָעֻ֣/הוּ אֲבֹתָ֗י/ו יְכַבֵּ֛ד בְּ/זָהָ֥ב וּ/בְ/כֶ֛סֶף וּ/בְ/אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה וּ/בַ/חֲמֻדֽוֹת
verses.translit: vl'lh m'zym 'l khnv ykhbd vl'lvh 'shr l' yd'hv 'btyv ykhbd bzhb vbkhsf vb'bn yqrh vbchmdvt
verses.translation: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֞ה לְ/מִבְצְרֵ֤י מָֽעֻזִּים֙ עִם אֱל֣וֹהַּ נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הכיר יַכִּ֖יר יַרְבֶּ֣ה כָב֑וֹד וְ/הִמְשִׁילָ/ם֙ בָּֽ/רַבִּ֔ים וַ/אֲדָמָ֖ה יְחַלֵּ֥ק בִּ/מְחִֽיר
verses.translit: v'shh lmbtsry m'zym 'm 'lvh nkhr 'shr hkhyr ykhyr yrbh khbvd vhmshylm brbym v'dmh ychlq bmchyr
verses.translation: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/עֵ֣ת קֵ֗ץ יִתְנַגַּ֤ח עִמּ/וֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב וְ/יִשְׂתָּעֵ֨ר עָלָ֜י/ו מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֗וֹן בְּ/רֶ֨כֶב֙ וּ/בְ/פָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וּ/בָ/אֳנִיּ֖וֹת רַבּ֑וֹת וּ/בָ֥א בַ/אֲרָצ֖וֹת וְ/שָׁטַ֥ף וְ/עָבָֽר
verses.translit: vb't qts ytngch 'mv mlkh hngb vysht'r 'lyv mlkh htspvn brkhb vbprshym vb'nyvt rbvt vb' b'rtsvt vshtf v'br
verses.translation: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.

verses.original: וּ/בָא֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/צְּבִ֔י וְ/רַבּ֖וֹת יִכָּשֵׁ֑לוּ וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ יִמָּלְט֣וּ מִ/יָּד֔/וֹ אֱד֣וֹם וּ/מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/רֵאשִׁ֖ית בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vb' b'rts htsby vrbvt ykhshlv v'lh ymltv mydv 'dvm vmv'b vr'shyt bny 'mvn
verses.translation: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׁלַ֥ח יָד֖/וֹ בַּ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת וְ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לִ/פְלֵיטָֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch ydv b'rtsvt v'rts mtsrym l' thyh lplyth
verses.translation: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

verses.original: וּ/מָשַׁ֗ל בְּ/מִכְמַנֵּי֙ הַ/זָּהָ֣ב וְ/הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל חֲמֻד֣וֹת מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/לֻבִ֥ים וְ/כֻשִׁ֖ים בְּ/מִצְעָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmshl bmkhmny hzhb vhkhsf vbkhl chmdvt mtsrym vlbym vkhshym bmts'dyv
verses.translation: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמֻע֣וֹת יְבַהֲלֻ֔/הוּ מִ/מִּזְרָ֖ח וּ/מִ/צָּפ֑וֹן וְ/יָצָא֙ בְּ/חֵמָ֣א גְדֹלָ֔ה לְ/הַשְׁמִ֥יד וּֽ/לְ/הַחֲרִ֖ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vshm'vt ybhlhv mmzrch vmtspvn vyts' bchm' gdlh lhshmyd vlhchrym rbym
verses.translation: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.

verses.original: וְ/יִטַּע֙ אָהֳלֶ֣י אַפַּדְנ֔/וֹ בֵּ֥ין יַמִּ֖ים לְ/הַר צְבִי קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּ/בָא֙ עַד קִצּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵ֥ין עוֹזֵ֖ר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyt' 'hly 'pdnv byn ymym lhr tsby qdsh vb' 'd qtsv v'yn 'vzr lv
verses.translation: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.

verses.original: וּ/בָ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִיא֩ יַעֲמֹ֨ד מִֽיכָאֵ֜ל הַ/שַּׂ֣ר הַ/גָּד֗וֹל הָ/עֹמֵד֮ עַל בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ/ךָ֒ וְ/הָיְתָה֙ עֵ֣ת צָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא נִהְיְתָה֙ מִֽ/הְי֣וֹת גּ֔וֹי עַ֖ד הָ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑יא וּ/בָ/עֵ֤ת הַ/הִיא֙ יִמָּלֵ֣ט עַמְּ/ךָ֔ כָּל הַ/נִּמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בַּ/סֵּֽפֶר
verses.translit: vb't hhy' y'md mykh'l hshr hgdvl h'md 'l bny 'mkh vhyth 't tsrh 'shr l' nhyth mhyvt gvy 'd h't hhy' vb't hhy' ymlt 'mkh khl hnmts' khtvb bspr
verses.translation: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

verses.original: וְ/רַבִּ֕ים מִ/יְּשֵׁנֵ֥י אַדְמַת עָפָ֖ר יָקִ֑יצוּ אֵ֚לֶּה לְ/חַיֵּ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה לַ/חֲרָפ֖וֹת לְ/דִרְא֥וֹן עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vrbym myshny 'dmt 'pr yqytsv 'lh lchyy 'vlm v'lh lchrpvt ldr'vn 'vlm
verses.translation: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/מַּשְׂכִּלִ֔ים יַזְהִ֖רוּ כְּ/זֹ֣הַר הָ/רָקִ֑יעַ וּ/מַצְדִּיקֵי֙ הָֽ/רַבִּ֔ים כַּ/כּוֹכָבִ֖ים לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: vhmshkhlym yzhrv khzhr hrqy' vmtsdyqy hrbym khkhvkhbym l'vlm v'd
verses.translation: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה דָֽנִיֵּ֗אל סְתֹ֧ם הַ/דְּבָרִ֛ים וַ/חֲתֹ֥ם הַ/סֵּ֖פֶר עַד עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ יְשֹׁטְט֥וּ רַבִּ֖ים וְ/תִרְבֶּ֥ה הַ/דָּֽעַת
verses.translit: v'th dny'l stm hdbrym vchtm hspr 'd 't qts yshttv rbym vtrbh hd't
verses.translation: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

verses.original: וְ/רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֹמְדִ֑ים אֶחָ֥ד הֵ֨נָּה֙ לִ/שְׂפַ֣ת הַ/יְאֹ֔ר וְ/אֶחָ֥ד הֵ֖נָּה לִ/שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יְאֹֽר
verses.translit: vr'yty 'ny dny'l vhnh shnym 'chrym 'mdym 'chd hnh lshpt hy'r v'chd hnh lshpt hy'r
verses.translation: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לָ/אִישׁ֙ לְב֣וּשׁ הַ/בַּדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִ/מַּ֖עַל לְ/מֵימֵ֣י הַ/יְאֹ֑ר עַד מָתַ֖י קֵ֥ץ הַ/פְּלָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr l'ysh lbvsh hbdym 'shr mm'l lmymy hy'r 'd mty qts hpl'vt
verses.translation: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֞ע אֶת הָ/אִ֣ישׁ לְב֣וּשׁ הַ/בַּדִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִ/מַּעַל֮ לְ/מֵימֵ֣י הַ/יְאֹר֒ וַ/יָּ֨רֶם יְמִינ֤/וֹ וּ/שְׂמֹאל/וֹ֙ אֶל הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֖ע בְּ/חֵ֣י הָ/עוֹלָ֑ם כִּי֩ לְ/מוֹעֵ֨ד מֽוֹעֲדִ֜ים וָ/חֵ֗צִי וּ/כְ/כַלּ֛וֹת נַפֵּ֥ץ יַד עַם קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּכְלֶ֥ינָה כָל אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: v'shm' 't h'ysh lbvsh hbdym 'shr mm'l lmymy hy'r vyrm ymynv vshm'lv 'l hshmym vyshb' bchy h'vlm khy lmv'd mv'dym vchtsy vkhkhlvt npts yd 'm qdsh tkhlynh khl 'lh
verses.translation: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי וְ/לֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין וָ/אֹ֣מְרָ֔/ה אֲדֹנִ֕/י מָ֥ה אַחֲרִ֖ית אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: v'ny shm'ty vl' 'byn v'mrh 'dny mh 'chryt 'lh
verses.translation: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things ?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ דָּנִיֵּ֑אל כִּֽי סְתֻמִ֧ים וַ/חֲתֻמִ֛ים הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים עַד עֵ֥ת קֵֽץ
verses.translit: vy'mr lkh dny'l khy stmym vchtmym hdbrym 'd 't qts
verses.translation: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.

verses.original: יִ֠תְבָּֽרֲרוּ וְ/יִֽתְלַבְּנ֤וּ וְ/יִצָּֽרְפוּ֙ רַבִּ֔ים וְ/הִרְשִׁ֣יעוּ רְשָׁעִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א יָבִ֖ינוּ כָּל רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְ/הַ/מַּשְׂכִּלִ֖ים יָבִֽינוּ
verses.translit: ytbrrv vytlbnv vytsrpv rbym vhrshy'v rsh'ym vl' ybynv khl rsh'ym vhmshkhlym ybynv
verses.translation: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/עֵת֙ הוּסַ֣ר הַ/תָּמִ֔יד וְ/לָ/תֵ֖ת שִׁקּ֣וּץ שֹׁמֵ֑ם יָמִ֕ים אֶ֖לֶף מָאתַ֥יִם וְ/תִשְׁעִֽים
verses.translit: vm't hvsr htmyd vltt shqvts shmm ymym 'lf m'tym vtsh'ym
verses.translation: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֥י הַֽ/מְחַכֶּ֖ה וְ/יַגִּ֑יעַ לְ/יָמִ֕ים אֶ֕לֶף שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: 'shry hmchkhh vygy' lymym 'lf shlsh m'vt shlshym vchmshh
verses.translation: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֖ה לֵ֣ךְ לַ/קֵּ֑ץ וְ/תָנ֛וּחַ וְ/תַעֲמֹ֥ד לְ/גֹרָלְ/ךָ֖ לְ/קֵ֥ץ הַ/יָּמִֽין
verses.translit: v'th lkh lqts vtnvch vt'md lgrlkh lqts hymyn
verses.translation: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.

verses.original: דְּבַר יְהוָ֣ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל הוֹשֵׁ֨עַ֙ בֶּן בְּאֵרִ֔י בִּ/ימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֥ה יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּ/בִ/ימֵ֛י יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: dbr yhvh 'shr hyh 'l hvsh' bn b'ry bymy 'zyh yvtm 'chz ychzqyh mlkhy yhvdh vbymy yrb'm bn yv'sh mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

verses.original: תְּחִלַּ֥ת דִּבֶּר יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/הוֹשֵׁ֑עַ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל הוֹשֵׁ֗עַ לֵ֣ךְ קַח לְ/ךָ֞ אֵ֤שֶׁת זְנוּנִים֙ וְ/יַלְדֵ֣י זְנוּנִ֔ים כִּֽי זָנֹ֤ה תִזְנֶה֙ הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מֵֽ/אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: tchlt dbr yhvh bhvsh' vy'mr yhvh 'l hvsh' lkh qch lkh 'sht znvnym vyldy znvnym khy znh tznh h'rts m'chry yhvh
verses.translation: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ וַ/יִּקַּ֔ח אֶת גֹּ֖מֶר בַּת דִּבְלָ֑יִם וַ/תַּ֥הַר וַ/תֵּֽלֶד ל֖/וֹ בֵּֽן
verses.translit: vylkh vyqch 't gmr bt dblym vthr vtld lv bn
verses.translation: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ יִזְרְעֶ֑אל כִּי ע֣וֹד מְעַ֗ט וּ/פָ֨קַדְתִּ֜י אֶת דְּמֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ עַל בֵּ֣ית יֵה֔וּא וְ/הִ֨שְׁבַּתִּ֔י מַמְלְכ֖וּת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyv qr' shmv yzr''l khy 'vd m't vpqdty 't dmy yzr''l 'l byt yhv' vhshbty mmlkhvt byt yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וְ/שָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת קֶ֣שֶׁת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/עֵ֖מֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' vshbrty 't qsht yshr'l b'mq yzr''l
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֤הַר עוֹד֙ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בַּ֔ת וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ קְרָ֥א שְׁמָ֖/הּ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אוֹסִ֜יף ע֗וֹד אֲרַחֵם֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי נָשֹׂ֥א אֶשָּׂ֖א לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vthr 'vd vtld bt vy'mr lv qr' shmh l' rchmh khy l' 'vsyf 'vd 'rchm 't byt yshr'l khy nsh' 'sh' lhm
verses.translation: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֲרַחֵ֔ם וְ/הֽוֹשַׁעְתִּ֖י/ם בַּ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/לֹ֣א אֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֗/ם בְּ/קֶ֤שֶׁת וּ/בְ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ וּ/בְ/מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּ/סוּסִ֖ים וּ/בְ/פָרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: v't byt yhvdh 'rchm vhvsh'tym byhvh 'lhyhm vl' 'vshy'm bqsht vbchrb vbmlchmh bsvsym vbprshym
verses.translation: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.

verses.original: וַ/תִּגְמֹ֖ל אֶת לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וַ/תַּ֖הַר וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן
verses.translit: vtgml 't l' rchmh vthr vtld bn
verses.translation: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֑י כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֔/י וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י לֹֽא אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr qr' shmv l' 'my khy 'tm l' 'my v'nkhy l' 'hyh lkhm
verses.translation: Then said God , Call his name Lo-ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God .

Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.
Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.

verses.original: וְֽ֠/הָיָה מִסְפַּ֤ר בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּ/ח֣וֹל הַ/יָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יִמַּ֖ד וְ/לֹ֣א יִסָּפֵ֑ר וְֽ֠/הָיָה בִּ/מְק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר יֵאָמֵ֤ר לָ/הֶם֙ לֹֽא עַמִּ֣/י אַתֶּ֔ם יֵאָמֵ֥ר לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אֵֽל חָֽי
verses.translit: vhyh mspr bny yshr'l khchvl hym 'shr l' ymd vl' yspr vhyh bmqvm 'shr y'mr lhm l' 'my 'tm y'mr lhm bny 'l chy
verses.translation: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.

verses.original: וְ֠/נִקְבְּצוּ בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֤ה וּ/בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְ/שָׂמ֥וּ לָ/הֶ֛ם רֹ֥אשׁ אֶחָ֖ד וְ/עָל֣וּ מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י גָד֖וֹל י֥וֹם יִזְרְעֶֽאל
verses.translit: vnqbtsv bny yhvdh vbny yshr'l ychdv vshmv lhm r'sh 'chd v'lv mn h'rts khy gdvl yvm yzr''l
verses.translation: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

verses.original: אִמְר֥וּ לַ/אֲחֵי/כֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑/י וְ/לַ/אֲחֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם רֻחָֽמָה
verses.translit: 'mrv l'chykhm 'my vl'chvtykhm rchmh
verses.translation: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.

verses.original: רִ֤יבוּ בְ/אִמְּ/כֶם֙ רִ֔יבוּ כִּֽי הִיא֙ לֹ֣א אִשְׁתִּ֔/י וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֣א אִישָׁ֑/הּ וְ/תָסֵ֤ר זְנוּנֶ֨י/הָ֙ מִ/פָּנֶ֔י/ה וְ/נַאֲפוּפֶ֖י/הָ מִ/בֵּ֥ין שָׁדֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: rybv b'mkhm rybv khy hy' l' 'shty v'nkhy l' 'yshh vtsr znvnyh mpnyh vn'pvpyh mbyn shdyh
verses.translation: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.

verses.translit: pn 'pshytnh 'rmh vhtsgtyh khyvm hvldh vshmtyh khmdbr vshth kh'rts tsyh vhmtyh btsm'
verses.translation: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בָּנֶ֖י/הָ לֹ֣א אֲרַחֵ֑ם כִּֽי בְנֵ֥י זְנוּנִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: v't bnyh l' 'rchm khy bny znvnym hmh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.

verses.original: כִּ֤י זָֽנְתָה֙ אִמָּ֔/ם הֹבִ֖ישָׁה הֽוֹרָתָ֑/ם כִּ֣י אָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֞ה אַחֲרֵ֤י מְאַהֲבַ/י֙ נֹתְנֵ֤י לַחְמִ/י֙ וּ/מֵימַ֔/י צַמְרִ֣/י וּ/פִשְׁתִּ֔/י שַׁמְנִ֖/י וְ/שִׁקּוּיָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy znth 'mm hbyshh hvrtm khy 'mrh 'lkhh 'chry m'hby ntny lchmy vmymy tsmry vpshty shmny vshqvyy
verses.translation: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן הִנְ/נִי שָׂ֥ךְ אֶת דַּרְכֵּ֖/ךְ בַּ/סִּירִ֑ים וְ/גָֽדַרְתִּי֙ אֶת גְּדֵרָ֔/הּ וּ/נְתִיבוֹתֶ֖י/הָ לֹ֥א תִמְצָֽא
verses.translit: lkhn hnny shkh 't drkhkh bsyrym vgdrty 't gdrh vntybvtyh l' tmts'
verses.translation: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.

verses.original: וְ/רִדְּפָ֤ה אֶת מְאַהֲבֶ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/לֹֽא תַשִּׂ֣יג אֹתָ֔/ם וּ/בִקְשָׁ֖תַ/ם וְ/לֹ֣א תִמְצָ֑א וְ/אָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֤ה וְ/אָשׁ֨וּבָה֙ אֶל אִישִׁ֣/י הָֽ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לִ֛/י אָ֖ז מֵ/עָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vrdph 't m'hbyh vl' tshyg 'tm vbqshtm vl' tmts' v'mrh 'lkhh v'shvbh 'l 'yshy hr'shvn khy tvb ly 'z m'th
verses.translation: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.

verses.original: וְ/הִיא֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְעָ֔ה כִּ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔/הּ הַ/דָּגָ֖ן וְ/הַ/תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/הַ/יִּצְהָ֑ר וְ/כֶ֨סֶף הִרְבֵּ֥יתִי לָ֛/הּ וְ/זָהָ֖ב עָשׂ֥וּ לַ/בָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vhy' l' yd'h khy 'nkhy ntty lh hdgn vhtyrvsh vhytshr vkhsf hrbyty lh vzhb 'shv lb'l
verses.translation: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן אָשׁ֔וּב וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֤י דְגָנִ/י֙ בְּ/עִתּ֔/וֹ וְ/תִירוֹשִׁ֖/י בְּ/מֽוֹעֲד֑/וֹ וְ/הִצַּלְתִּי֙ צַמְרִ֣/י וּ/פִשְׁתִּ֔/י לְ/כַסּ֖וֹת אֶת עֶרְוָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lkhn 'shvb vlqchty dgny b'tv vtyrvshy bmv'dv vhtslty tsmry vpshty lkhsvt 't 'rvth
verses.translation: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֛ה אֲגַלֶּ֥ה אֶת נַבְלֻתָ֖/הּ לְ/עֵינֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אִ֖ישׁ לֹֽא יַצִּילֶ֥/נָּה מִ/יָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th 'glh 't nblth l'yny m'hbyh v'ysh l' ytsylnh mydy
verses.translation: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

verses.translit: vhshbty khl mshvshh chgh chdshh vshbth vkhl mv'dh
verses.translation: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/הֲשִׁמֹּתִ֗י גַּפְנָ/הּ֙ וּ/תְאֵ֣נָתָ֔/הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמְרָ֗ה אֶתְנָ֥ה הֵ֨מָּה֙ לִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתְנוּ לִ֖/י מְאַֽהֲבָ֑/י וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֣י/ם לְ/יַ֔עַר וַ/אֲכָלָ֖תַ/ם חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vhshmty gpnh vt'nth 'shr 'mrh 'tnh hmh ly 'shr ntnv ly m'hby vshmtym ly'r v'khltm chyt hshdh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.

verses.original: וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֣י עָלֶ֗י/הָ אֶת יְמֵ֤י הַ/בְּעָלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּקְטִ֣יר לָ/הֶ֔ם וַ/תַּ֤עַד נִזְמָ/הּ֙ וְ/חֶלְיָתָ֔/הּ וַ/תֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֹתִ֥/י שָׁכְחָ֖ה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vpqdty 'lyh 't ymy hb'lym 'shr tqtyr lhm vt'd nzmh vchlyth vtlkh 'chry m'hbyh v'ty shkhchh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְפַתֶּ֔י/הָ וְ/הֹֽלַכְתִּ֖י/הָ הַ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/דִבַּרְתִּ֖י עַל לִבָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lkhn hnh 'nkhy mptyh vhlkhtyh hmdbr vdbrty 'l lbh
verses.translation: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD , that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֨תִּי לָ֤/הּ אֶת כְּרָמֶ֨י/הָ֙ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם וְ/אֶת עֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְ/פֶ֣תַח תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ/עָ֤נְתָה שָּׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ כִּ/ימֵ֣י נְעוּרֶ֔י/הָ וִּ/כְ/י֖וֹם עֲלֹתָ֥/הּ מֵ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vntty lh 't khrmyh mshm v't 'mq 'khvr lptch tqvh v'nth shmh khymy n'vryh vkhyvm 'lth m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה בַ/יּוֹם הַ/הוּא֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה תִּקְרְאִ֖י אִישִׁ֑/י וְ/לֹֽא תִקְרְאִי לִ֥/י ע֖וֹד בַּעְלִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tqr'y 'yshy vl' tqr'y ly 'vd b'ly
verses.translation: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.

verses.original: וַ/הֲסִרֹתִ֛י אֶת שְׁמ֥וֹת הַ/בְּעָלִ֖ים מִ/פִּ֑י/הָ וְ/לֹֽא יִזָּכְר֥וּ ע֖וֹד בִּ/שְׁמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhsrty 't shmvt hb'lym mpyh vl' yzkhrv 'vd bshmm
verses.translation: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

verses.original: וְ/כָרַתִּ֨י לָ/הֶ֤ם בְּרִית֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא עִם חַיַּ֤ת הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ וְ/עִם ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/רֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֑ה וְ/קֶ֨שֶׁת וְ/חֶ֤רֶב וּ/מִלְחָמָה֙ אֶשְׁבּ֣וֹר מִן הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הִשְׁכַּבְתִּ֖י/ם לָ/בֶֽטַח
verses.translit: vkhrty lhm bryt byvm hhv' 'm chyt hshdh v'm 'vf hshmym vrmsh h'dmh vqsht vchrb vmlchmh 'shbvr mn h'rts vhshkhbtym lbtch
verses.translation: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אֵרַשְׂתִּ֥י/ךְ לִ֖/י לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/אֵרַשְׂתִּ֥י/ךְ לִ/י֙ בְּ/צֶ֣דֶק וּ/בְ/מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּ/בְ/חֶ֖סֶד וּֽ/בְ/רַחֲמִֽים
verses.translit: v'rshtykh ly l'vlm v'rshtykh ly btsdq vbmshpt vbchsd vbrchmym
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD , I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;

verses.original: וְ/אֵרַשְׂתִּ֥י/ךְ לִ֖/י בֶּ/אֱמוּנָ֑ה וְ/יָדַ֖עַתְּ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'rshtykh ly b'mvnh vyd't 't yhvh
verses.translation: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא אֶֽעֱנֶה֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה אֶעֱנֶ֖ה אֶת הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/הֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ''nh n'm yhvh ''nh 't hshmym vhm y'nv 't h'rts
verses.translation: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י ע֚וֹד לֵ֣ךְ אֱֽהַב אִשָּׁ֔ה אֲהֻ֥בַת רֵ֖עַ וּ/מְנָאָ֑פֶת כְּ/אַהֲבַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/הֵ֗ם פֹּנִים֙ אֶל אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְ/אֹהֲבֵ֖י אֲשִׁישֵׁ֥י עֲנָבִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'vd lkh 'hb 'shh 'hbt r' vmn'pt kh'hbt yhvh 't bny yshr'l vhm pnym 'l 'lhym 'chrym v'hby 'shyshy 'nbym
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.

verses.original: וָ/אֶכְּרֶ֣/הָ לִּ֔/י בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ/חֹ֥מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֖ים וְ/לֵ֥תֶךְ שְׂעֹרִֽים
verses.translit: v'khrh ly bchmshh 'shr khsf vchmr sh'rym vltkh sh'rym
verses.translation: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֣ר אֵלֶ֗י/הָ יָמִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ תֵּ֣שְׁבִי לִ֔/י לֹ֣א תִזְנִ֔י וְ/לֹ֥א תִֽהְיִ֖י לְ/אִ֑ישׁ וְ/גַם אֲנִ֖י אֵלָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'mr 'lyh ymym rbym tshby ly l' tzny vl' thyy l'ysh vgm 'ny 'lykh
verses.translation: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֥ין מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין שָׂ֔ר וְ/אֵ֥ין זֶ֖בַח וְ/אֵ֣ין מַצֵּבָ֑ה וְ/אֵ֥ין אֵפ֖וֹד וּ/תְרָפִֽים
verses.translit: khy ymym rbym yshbv bny yshr'l 'yn mlkh v'yn shr v'yn zbch v'yn mtsbh v'yn 'pvd vtrpym
verses.translation: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:

verses.original: אַחַ֗ר יָשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/בִקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣ד מַלְכָּ֑/ם וּ/פָחֲד֧וּ אֶל יְהוָ֛ה וְ/אֶל טוּב֖/וֹ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֥ית הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: 'chr yshbv bny yshr'l vbqshv 't yhvh 'lhyhm v't dvd mlkhm vpchdv 'l yhvh v'l tvbv b'chryt hymym
verses.translation: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽ/יהוָה֙ עִם יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֠י אֵין אֱמֶ֧ת וְֽ/אֵין חֶ֛סֶד וְ/אֵֽין דַּ֥עַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: shm'v dbr yhvh bny yshr'l khy ryb lyhvh 'm yvshby h'rts khy 'yn 'mt v'yn chsd v'yn d't 'lhym b'rts
verses.translation: Hear the word of the LORD , ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.

verses.original: אָלֹ֣ה וְ/כַחֵ֔שׁ וְ/רָצֹ֥חַ וְ/גָנֹ֖ב וְ/נָאֹ֑ף פָּרָ֕צוּ וְ/דָמִ֥ים בְּ/דָמִ֖ים נָגָֽעוּ
verses.translit: 'lh vkhchsh vrtsch vgnb vn'f prtsv vdmym bdmym ng'v
verses.translation: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֣ן תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ וְ/אֻמְלַל֙ כָּל יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֔/הּ בְּ/חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה וּ/בְ/ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/גַם דְּגֵ֥י הַ/יָּ֖ם יֵאָסֵֽפוּ
verses.translit: 'l khn t'bl h'rts v'mll khl yvshb bh bchyt hshdh vb'vf hshmym vgm dgy hym y'spv
verses.translation: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ אִ֛ישׁ אַל יָרֵ֖ב וְ/אַל יוֹכַ֣ח אִ֑ישׁ וְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֖ כִּ/מְרִיבֵ֥י כֹהֵֽן
verses.translit: 'kh 'ysh 'l yrb v'l yvkhch 'ysh v'mkh khmryby khhn
verses.translation: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.

verses.original: וְ/כָשַׁלְתָּ֣ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/כָשַׁ֧ל גַּם נָבִ֛יא עִמְּ/ךָ֖ לָ֑יְלָה וְ/דָמִ֖יתִי אִמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vkhshlt hyvm vkhshl gm nby' 'mkh lylh vdmyty 'mkh
verses.translation: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.

verses.original: נִדְמ֥וּ עַמִּ֖/י מִ/בְּלִ֣י הַ/דָּ֑עַת כִּֽי אַתָּ֞ה הַ/דַּ֣עַת מָאַ֗סְתָּ וְ/אֶמְאָֽסְא/ךָ֙ מִ/כַּהֵ֣ן לִ֔/י וַ/תִּשְׁכַּח֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֶשְׁכַּ֥ח בָּנֶ֖י/ךָ גַּם אָֽנִי
verses.translit: ndmv 'my mbly hd't khy 'th hd't m'st v'm's'kh mkhhn ly vtshkhch tvrt 'lhykh 'shkhch bnykh gm 'ny
verses.translation: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.

verses.original: כְּ/רֻבָּ֖/ם כֵּ֣ן חָֽטְאוּ לִ֑/י כְּבוֹדָ֖/ם בְּ/קָל֥וֹן אָמִֽיר
verses.translit: khrbm khn cht'v ly khbvdm bqlvn 'myr
verses.translation: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.

verses.original: חַטַּ֥את עַמִּ֖/י יֹאכֵ֑לוּ וְ/אֶל עֲוֺנָ֖/ם יִשְׂא֥וּ נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: cht't 'my y'khlv v'l 'vnm ysh'v npshv
verses.translation: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֥ה כָ/עָ֖ם כַּ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֤י עָלָי/ו֙ דְּרָכָ֔י/ו וּ/מַעֲלָלָ֖י/ו אָשִׁ֥יב לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh kh'm khkhhn vpqdty 'lyv drkhyv vm'llyv 'shyb lv
verses.translation: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.

verses.original: וְ/אָֽכְלוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֔עוּ הִזְנ֖וּ וְ/לֹ֣א יִפְרֹ֑צוּ כִּֽי אֶת יְהוָ֥ה עָזְב֖וּ לִ/שְׁמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'khlv vl' yshb'v hznv vl' yprtsv khy 't yhvh 'zbv lshmr
verses.translation: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD .

verses.original: זְנ֛וּת וְ/יַ֥יִן וְ/תִיר֖וֹשׁ יִֽקַּֽח לֵֽב
verses.translit: znvt vyyn vtyrvsh yqch lb
verses.translation: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

verses.original: עַמִּ/י֙ בְּ/עֵצ֣/וֹ יִשְׁאָ֔ל וּ/מַקְל֖/וֹ יַגִּ֣יד ל֑/וֹ כִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ זְנוּנִים֙ הִתְעָ֔ה וַ/יִּזְנ֖וּ מִ/תַּ֥חַת אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'my b'tsv ysh'l vmqlv ygyd lv khy rvch znvnym ht'h vyznv mtcht 'lhyhm
verses.translation: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.

verses.original: עַל רָאשֵׁ֨י הֶ/הָרִ֜ים יְזַבֵּ֗חוּ וְ/עַל הַ/גְּבָעוֹת֙ יְקַטֵּ֔רוּ תַּ֣חַת אַלּ֧וֹן וְ/לִבְנֶ֛ה וְ/אֵלָ֖ה כִּ֣י ט֣וֹב צִלָּ֑/הּ עַל כֵּ֗ן תִּזְנֶ֨ינָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/כַלּוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם תְּנָאַֽפְנָה
verses.translit: 'l r'shy hhrym yzbchv v'l hgb'vt yqtrv tcht 'lvn vlbnh v'lh khy tvb tslh 'l khn tznynh bnvtykhm vkhlvtykhm tn'pnh
verses.translation: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.

verses.original: לֹֽא אֶפְק֨וֹד עַל בְּנוֹתֵי/כֶ֜ם כִּ֣י תִזְנֶ֗ינָה וְ/עַל כַּלּֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ כִּ֣י תְנָאַ֔פְנָה כִּי הֵם֙ עִם הַ/זֹּנ֣וֹת יְפָרֵ֔דוּ וְ/עִם הַ/קְּדֵשׁ֖וֹת יְזַבֵּ֑חוּ וְ/עָ֥ם לֹֽא יָבִ֖ין יִלָּבֵֽט
verses.translit: l' 'pqvd 'l bnvtykhm khy tznynh v'l khlvtykhm khy tn'pnh khy hm 'm hznvt yprdv v'm hqdshvt yzbchv v'm l' ybyn ylbt
verses.translation: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.

verses.original: אִם זֹנֶ֤ה אַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַל יֶאְשַׁ֖ם יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אַל תָּבֹ֣אוּ הַ/גִּלְגָּ֗ל וְ/אַֽל תַּעֲלוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן וְ/אַל תִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ חַי יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'm znh 'th yshr'l 'l y'shm yhvdh v'l tb'v hglgl v'l t'lv byt 'vn v'l tshb'v chy yhvh
verses.translation: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.

verses.original: כִּ֚י כְּ/פָרָ֣ה סֹֽרֵרָ֔ה סָרַ֖ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַתָּה֙ יִרְעֵ֣/ם יְהוָ֔ה כְּ/כֶ֖בֶשׂ בַּ/מֶּרְחָֽב
verses.translit: khy khprh srrh srr yshr'l 'th yr'm yhvh khkhbsh bmrchb
verses.translation: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.

verses.original: חֲב֧וּר עֲצַבִּ֛ים אֶפְרָ֖יִם הַֽנַּֽח לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: chbvr 'tsbym 'prym hnch lv
verses.translation: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.

verses.original: סָ֖ר סָבְאָ֑/ם הַזְנֵ֣ה הִזְנ֔וּ אָהֲב֥וּ הֵב֛וּ קָל֖וֹן מָגִנֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: sr sb'm hznh hznv 'hbv hbv qlvn mgnyh
