verses.translation: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.

verses.original: צָרַ֥ר ר֛וּחַ אוֹתָ֖/הּ בִּ/כְנָפֶ֑י/הָ וְ/יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ מִ/זִּבְחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: tsrr rvch 'vth bkhnpyh vybshv mzbchvtm
verses.translation: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ זֹ֨את הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְ/הַקְשִׁ֣יבוּ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּ/בֵ֤ית הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַאֲזִ֔ינוּ כִּ֥י לָ/כֶ֖ם הַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּֽי פַח֙ הֱיִיתֶ֣ם לְ/מִצְפָּ֔ה וְ/רֶ֖שֶׁת פְּרוּשָׂ֥ה עַל תָּבֽוֹר
verses.translit: shm'v z't hkhhnym vhqshybv byt yshr'l vbyt hmlkh h'zynv khy lkhm hmshpt khy pch hyytm lmtsph vrsht prvshh 'l tbvr
verses.translation: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁחֲטָ֥ה שֵׂטִ֖ים הֶעְמִ֑יקוּ וַ/אֲנִ֖י מוּסָ֥ר לְ/כֻלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshchth shtym h'myqv v'ny mvsr lkhlm
verses.translation: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹֽא נִכְחַ֣ד מִמֶּ֑/נִּי כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ הִזְנֵ֣יתָ אֶפְרַ֔יִם נִטְמָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'ny yd'ty 'prym vyshr'l l' nkhchd mmny khy 'th hznyt 'prym ntm' yshr'l
verses.translation: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִתְּנוּ֙ מַ֣עַלְלֵי/הֶ֔ם לָ/שׁ֖וּב אֶל אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ זְנוּנִים֙ בְּ/קִרְבָּ֔/ם וְ/אֶת יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ
verses.translit: l' ytnv m'llyhm lshvb 'l 'lhyhm khy rvch znvnym bqrbm v't yhvh l' yd'v
verses.translation: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/עָנָ֥ה גְאֽוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/פָנָ֑י/ו וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וְ/אֶפְרַ֗יִם יִכָּֽשְׁלוּ֙ בַּ/עֲוֺנָ֔/ם כָּשַׁ֥ל גַּם יְהוּדָ֖ה עִמָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'nh g'vn yshr'l bpnyv vyshr'l v'prym ykhshlv b'vnm khshl gm yhvdh 'mm
verses.translation: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.

verses.original: בְּ/צֹאנָ֣/ם וּ/בִ/בְקָרָ֗/ם יֵֽלְכ֛וּ לְ/בַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א יִמְצָ֑אוּ חָלַ֖ץ מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: bts'nm vbbqrm ylkhv lbqsh 't yhvh vl' ymts'v chlts mhm
verses.translation: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD ; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.

verses.original: בַּ/יהוָ֣ה בָּגָ֔דוּ כִּֽי בָנִ֥ים זָרִ֖ים יָלָ֑דוּ עַתָּ֛ה יֹאכְלֵ֥/ם חֹ֖דֶשׁ אֶת חֶלְקֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: byhvh bgdv khy bnym zrym yldv 'th y'khlm chdsh 't chlqyhm
verses.translation: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD : for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.

verses.original: תִּקְע֤וּ שׁוֹפָר֙ בַּ/גִּבְעָ֔ה חֲצֹצְרָ֖ה בָּ/רָמָ֑ה הָרִ֨יעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן אַחֲרֶ֖י/ךָ בִּנְיָמִֽין
verses.translit: tq'v shvpr bgb'h chtstsrh brmh hry'v byt 'vn 'chrykh bnymyn
verses.translation: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after thee, O Benjamin.

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה בְּ/י֖וֹם תּֽוֹכֵחָ֑ה בְּ/שִׁבְטֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הוֹדַ֖עְתִּי נֶאֱמָנָֽה
verses.translit: 'prym lshmh thyh byvm tvkhchh bshbty yshr'l hvd'ty n'mnh
verses.translation: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.

verses.original: הָיוּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כְּ/מַסִּיגֵ֖י גְּב֑וּל עֲלֵי/הֶ֕ם אֶשְׁפּ֥וֹךְ כַּ/מַּ֖יִם עֶבְרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: hyv shry yhvdh khmsygy gbvl 'lyhm 'shpvkh khmym 'brty
verses.translation: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.

verses.original: עָשׁ֥וּק אֶפְרַ֖יִם רְצ֣וּץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֣י הוֹאִ֔יל הָלַ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵי צָֽו
verses.translit: 'shvq 'prym rtsvts mshpt khy hv'yl hlkh 'chry tsv
verses.translation: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֥י כָ/עָ֖שׁ לְ/אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְ/כָ/רָקָ֖ב לְ/בֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: v'ny kh'sh l'prym vkhrqb lbyt yhvdh
verses.translation: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨רְא אֶפְרַ֜יִם אֶת חָלְי֗/וֹ וִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ אֶת מְזֹר֔/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ אֶל אַשּׁ֔וּר וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֖ח אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יָרֵ֑ב וְ/ה֗וּא לֹ֤א יוּכַל֙ לִ/רְפֹּ֣א לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא יִגְהֶ֥ה מִ/כֶּ֖ם מָזֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyr' 'prym 't chlyv vyhvdh 't mzrv vylkh 'prym 'l 'shvr vyshlch 'l mlkh yrb vhv' l' yvkhl lrp' lkhm vl' yghh mkhm mzvr
verses.translation: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֤י כַ/שַּׁ֨חַל֙ לְ/אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/כַ/כְּפִ֖יר לְ/בֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲנִ֨י אֲנִ֤י אֶטְרֹף֙ וְ/אֵלֵ֔ךְ אֶשָּׂ֖א וְ/אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל
verses.translit: khy 'nkhy khshchl l'prym vkhkhpyr lbyt yhvdh 'ny 'ny 'trf v'lkh 'sh' v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him .

verses.original: אֵלֵ֤ךְ אָשׁ֨וּבָה֙ אֶל מְקוֹמִ֔/י עַ֥ד אֲשֶֽׁר יֶאְשְׁמ֖וּ וּ/בִקְשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑/י בַּ/צַּ֥ר לָ/הֶ֖ם יְשַׁחֲרֻֽ/נְנִי
verses.translit: 'lkh 'shvbh 'l mqvmy 'd 'shr y'shmv vbqshv pny btsr lhm yshchrnny
verses.translation: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.

verses.original: לְכוּ֙ וְ/נָשׁ֣וּבָה אֶל יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י ה֥וּא טָרָ֖ף וְ/יִרְפָּאֵ֑/נוּ יַ֖ךְ וְ/יַחְבְּשֵֽׁ/נוּ
verses.translit: lkhv vnshvbh 'l yhvh khy hv' trf vyrp'nv ykh vychbshnv
verses.translation: Come, and let us return unto the LORD : for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.

verses.original: יְחַיֵּ֖/נוּ מִ/יֹּמָ֑יִם בַּ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקִמֵ֖/נוּ וְ/נִחְיֶ֥ה לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: ychynv mymym byvm hshlyshy yqmnv vnchyh lpnyv
verses.translation: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.

verses.original: וְ/נֵדְעָ֣ה נִרְדְּפָ֗ה לָ/דַ֨עַת֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כְּ/שַׁ֖חַר נָכ֣וֹן מֽוֹצָא֑/וֹ וְ/יָב֤וֹא כַ/גֶּ֨שֶׁם֙ לָ֔/נוּ כְּ/מַלְק֖וֹשׁ י֥וֹרֶה אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vnd'h nrdph ld't 't yhvh khshchr nkhvn mvts'v vybv' khgshm lnv khmlqvsh yvrh 'rts
verses.translation: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD : his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

verses.original: מָ֤ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לְּ/ךָ֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂה לְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/חַסְדְּ/כֶם֙ כַּֽ/עֲנַן בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/כַ/טַּ֖ל מַשְׁכִּ֥ים הֹלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: mh ''shh lkh 'prym mh ''shh lkh yhvdh vchsdkhm kh'nn bqr vkhtl mshkhym hlkh
verses.translation: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֗ן חָצַ֨בְתִּי֙ בַּ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים הֲרַגְתִּ֖י/ם בְּ/אִמְרֵי פִ֑/י וּ/מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖י/ךָ א֥וֹר יֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: 'l khn chtsbty bnby'ym hrgtym b'mry py vmshptykh 'vr yts'
verses.translation: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.

verses.original: כִּ֛י חֶ֥סֶד חָפַ֖צְתִּי וְ/לֹא זָ֑בַח וְ/דַ֥עַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵ/עֹלֽוֹת
verses.translit: khy chsd chptsty vl' zbch vd't 'lhym m'lvt
verses.translation: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֕מָּה כְּ/אָדָ֖ם עָבְר֣וּ בְרִ֑ית שָׁ֖ם בָּ֥גְדוּ בִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhmh kh'dm 'brv bryt shm bgdv by
verses.translation: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.

verses.original: גִּלְעָ֕ד קִרְיַ֖ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן עֲקֻבָּ֖ה מִ/דָּֽם
verses.translit: gl'd qryt p'ly 'vn 'qbh mdm
verses.translation: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/חַכֵּ֨י אִ֜ישׁ גְּדוּדִ֗ים חֶ֚בֶר כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים דֶּ֖רֶךְ יְרַצְּחוּ שֶׁ֑כְמָ/ה כִּ֥י זִמָּ֖ה עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vkhchkhy 'ysh gdvdym chbr khhnym drkh yrtschv shkhmh khy zmh 'shv
verses.translation: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.

verses.original: בְּ/בֵית֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאִ֖יתִי שעריריה שַׁעֲרֽוּרִיָּ֑ה שָׁ֚ם זְנ֣וּת לְ/אֶפְרַ֔יִם נִטְמָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bbyt yshr'l r'yty sh'ryryh sh'rvryh shm znvt l'prym ntm' yshr'l
verses.translation: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.

verses.original: גַּם יְהוּדָ֕ה שָׁ֥ת קָצִ֖יר לָ֑/ךְ בְּ/שׁוּבִ֖/י שְׁב֥וּת עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: gm yhvdh sht qtsyr lkh bshvby shbvt 'my
verses.translation: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.

verses.original: כְּ/רָפְאִ֣/י לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/נִגְלָ֞ה עֲוֺ֤ן אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ וְ/רָע֣וֹת שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן כִּ֥י פָעֲל֖וּ שָׁ֑קֶר וְ/גַנָּ֣ב יָב֔וֹא פָּשַׁ֥ט גְּד֖וּד בַּ/חֽוּץ
verses.translit: khrp'y lyshr'l vnglh 'vn 'prym vr'vt shmrvn khy p'lv shqr vgnb ybv' psht gdvd bchvts
verses.translation: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.

verses.original: וּ/בַל יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ לִ/לְבָבָ֔/ם כָּל רָעָתָ֖/ם זָכָ֑רְתִּי עַתָּה֙ סְבָב֣וּ/ם מַֽעַלְלֵי/הֶ֔ם נֶ֥גֶד פָּנַ֖/י הָיֽוּ
verses.translit: vbl y'mrv llbbm khl r'tm zkhrty 'th sbbvm m'llyhm ngd pny hyv
verses.translation: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.

verses.original: בְּ/רָעָתָ֖/ם יְשַׂמְּחוּ מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ/בְ/כַחֲשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם שָׂרִֽים
verses.translit: br'tm yshmchv mlkh vbkhchshyhm shrym
verses.translation: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ/ם֙ מְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים כְּמ֣וֹ תַנּ֔וּר בֹּעֵ֖רָה מֵֽ/אֹפֶ֑ה יִשְׁבּ֣וֹת מֵעִ֔יר מִ/לּ֥וּשׁ בָּצֵ֖ק עַד חֻמְצָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khlm mn'pym khmv tnvr b'rh m'ph yshbvt m'yr mlvsh btsq 'd chmtstv
verses.translation: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.

verses.original: י֣וֹם מַלְכֵּ֔/נוּ הֶחֱל֥וּ שָׂרִ֖ים חֲמַ֣ת מִ/יָּ֑יִן מָשַׁ֥ךְ יָד֖/וֹ אֶת לֹצְצִֽים
verses.translit: yvm mlkhnv hchlv shrym chmt myyn mshkh ydv 't ltstsym
verses.translation: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.

verses.original: כִּֽי קֵרְב֧וּ כַ/תַּנּ֛וּר לִבָּ֖/ם בְּ/אָרְבָּ֑/ם כָּל הַ/לַּ֨יְלָה֙ יָשֵׁ֣ן אֹֽפֵ/הֶ֔ם בֹּ֕קֶר ה֥וּא בֹעֵ֖ר כְּ/אֵ֥שׁ לֶהָבָֽה
verses.translit: khy qrbv khtnvr lbm b'rbm khl hlylh yshn 'phm bqr hv' b'r kh'sh lhbh
verses.translation: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤/ם יֵחַ֨מּוּ֙ כַּ/תַּנּ֔וּר וְ/אָכְל֖וּ אֶת שֹֽׁפְטֵי/הֶ֑ם כָּל מַלְכֵי/הֶ֣ם נָפָ֔לוּ אֵין קֹרֵ֥א בָ/הֶ֖ם אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: khlm ychmv khtnvr v'khlv 't shptyhm khl mlkhyhm nplv 'yn qr' bhm 'ly
verses.translation: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם בָּ/עַמִּ֖ים ה֣וּא יִתְבּוֹלָ֑ל אֶפְרַ֛יִם הָיָ֥ה עֻגָ֖ה בְּלִ֥י הֲפוּכָֽה
verses.translit: 'prym b'mym hv' ytbvll 'prym hyh 'gh bly hpvkhh
verses.translation: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

verses.original: אָכְל֤וּ זָרִים֙ כֹּח֔/וֹ וְ/ה֖וּא לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע גַּם שֵׂיבָה֙ זָ֣רְקָה בּ֔/וֹ וְ/ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יָדָֽע
verses.translit: 'khlv zrym khchv vhv' l' yd' gm shybh zrqh bv vhv' l' yd'
verses.translation: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.

verses.original: וְ/עָנָ֥ה גְאֽוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/פָנָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹֽא שָׁ֨בוּ֙ אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א בִקְשֻׁ֖/הוּ בְּ/כָל זֹֽאת
verses.translit: v'nh g'vn yshr'l bpnyv vl' shbv 'l yhvh 'lhyhm vl' bqshhv bkhl z't
verses.translation: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם כְּ/יוֹנָ֥ה פוֹתָ֖ה אֵ֣ין לֵ֑ב מִצְרַ֥יִם קָרָ֖אוּ אַשּׁ֥וּר הָלָֽכוּ
verses.translit: vyhy 'prym khyvnh pvth 'yn lb mtsrym qr'v 'shvr hlkhv
verses.translation: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵלֵ֗כוּ אֶפְר֤וֹשׂ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ רִשְׁתִּ֔/י כְּ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם אֽוֹרִידֵ֑/ם אַיְסִרֵ֕/ם כְּ/שֵׁ֖מַע לַ/עֲדָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: kh'shr ylkhv 'prvsh 'lyhm rshty kh'vf hshmym 'vrydm 'ysrm khshm' l'dtm
verses.translation: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.

verses.original: א֤וֹי לָ/הֶם֙ כִּֽי נָדְד֣וּ מִמֶּ֔/נִּי שֹׁ֥ד לָ/הֶ֖ם כִּֽי פָ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֑/י וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י אֶפְדֵּ֔/ם וְ/הֵ֕מָּה דִּבְּר֥וּ עָלַ֖/י כְּזָבִֽים
verses.translit: 'vy lhm khy nddv mmny shd lhm khy psh'v by v'nkhy 'pdm vhmh dbrv 'ly khzbym
verses.translation: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא זָעֲק֤וּ אֵלַ/י֙ בְּ/לִבָּ֔/ם כִּ֥י יְיֵלִ֖ילוּ עַל מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑/ם עַל דָּגָ֧ן וְ/תִיר֛וֹשׁ יִתְגּוֹרָ֖רוּ יָס֥וּרוּ בִֽ/י
verses.translit: vl' z'qv 'ly blbm khy yylylv 'l mshkhbvtm 'l dgn vtyrvsh ytgvrrv ysvrv by
verses.translation: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י יִסַּ֔רְתִּי חִזַּ֖קְתִּי זְרֽוֹעֹתָ֑/ם וְ/אֵלַ֖/י יְחַשְּׁבוּ רָֽע
verses.translit: v'ny ysrty chzqty zrv'tm v'ly ychshbv r'
verses.translation: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לֹ֣א עָ֗ל הָיוּ֙ כְּ/קֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּ֔ה יִפְּל֥וּ בַ/חֶ֛רֶב שָׂרֵי/הֶ֖ם מִ/זַּ֣עַם לְשׁוֹנָ֑/ם ז֥וֹ לַעְגָּ֖/ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: yshvbv l' 'l hyv khqsht rmyh yplv bchrb shryhm mz'm lshvnm zv l'gm b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.

verses.original: אֶל חִכְּ/ךָ֣ שֹׁפָ֔ר כַּ/נֶּ֖שֶׁר עַל בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה יַ֚עַן עָבְר֣וּ בְרִיתִ֔/י וְ/עַל תּוֹרָתִ֖/י פָּשָֽׁעוּ
verses.translit: 'l chkhkh shpr khnshr 'l byt yhvh y'n 'brv bryty v'l tvrty psh'v
verses.translation: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the LORD , because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.

verses.original: לִ֖/י יִזְעָ֑קוּ אֱלֹהַ֥/י יְֽדַעֲנ֖וּ/ךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: ly yz'qv 'lhy yd'nvkh yshr'l
verses.translation: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.

verses.original: זָנַ֥ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ט֑וֹב אוֹיֵ֖ב יִרְדְּֽפ/וֹ
verses.translit: znch yshr'l tvb 'vyb yrdpv
verses.translation: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.

verses.original: הֵ֤ם הִמְלִיכוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א מִמֶּ֔/נִּי הֵשִׂ֖ירוּ וְ/לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עְתִּי כַּסְפָּ֣/ם וּ/זְהָבָ֗/ם עָשׂ֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ עֲצַבִּ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן יִכָּרֵֽת
verses.translit: hm hmlykhv vl' mmny hshyrv vl' yd'ty khspm vzhbm 'shv lhm 'tsbym lm'n ykhrt
verses.translation: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

verses.original: זָנַח֙ עֶגְלֵ֣/ךְ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן חָרָ֥ה אַפִּ֖/י בָּ֑/ם עַד מָתַ֕י לֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ נִקָּיֹֽן
verses.translit: znch 'glkh shmrvn chrh 'py bm 'd mty l' yvkhlv nqyn
verses.translation: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/ה֔וּא חָרָ֣שׁ עָשָׂ֔/הוּ וְ/לֹ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים ה֑וּא כִּֽי שְׁבָבִ֣ים יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עֵ֖גֶל שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: khy myshr'l vhv' chrsh 'shhv vl' 'lhym hv' khy shbbym yhyh 'gl shmrvn
verses.translation: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

verses.original: כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ יִזְרָ֖עוּ וְ/סוּפָ֣תָ/ה יִקְצֹ֑רוּ קָמָ֣ה אֵֽין ל֗/וֹ צֶ֚מַח בְּלִ֣י יַֽעֲשֶׂה קֶּ֔מַח אוּלַ֣י יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה זָרִ֖ים יִבְלָעֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: khy rvch yzr'v vsvpth yqtsrv qmh 'yn lv tsmch bly y'shh qmch 'vly y'shh zrym ybl'hv
verses.translation: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.

verses.original: נִבְלַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַתָּה֙ הָי֣וּ בַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ/כְלִ֖י אֵֽין חֵ֥פֶץ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: nbl' yshr'l 'th hyv bgvym khkhly 'yn chpts bv
verses.translation: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.

verses.original: כִּֽי הֵ֨מָּה֙ עָל֣וּ אַשּׁ֔וּר פֶּ֖רֶא בּוֹדֵ֣ד ל֑/וֹ אֶפְרַ֖יִם הִתְנ֥וּ אֲהָבִֽים
verses.translit: khy hmh 'lv 'shvr pr' bvdd lv 'prym htnv 'hbym
verses.translation: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.

verses.original: גַּ֛ם כִּֽי יִתְנ֥וּ בַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם עַתָּ֣ה אֲקַבְּצֵ֑/ם וַ/יָּחֵ֣לּוּ מְּעָ֔ט מִ/מַּשָּׂ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ שָׂרִֽים
verses.translit: gm khy ytnv bgvym 'th 'qbtsm vychlv m't mmsh' mlkh shrym
verses.translation: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִרְבָּ֥ה אֶפְרַ֛יִם מִזְבְּחֹ֖ת לַ/חֲטֹ֑א הָיוּ ל֥/וֹ מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לַ/חֲטֹֽא
verses.translit: khy hrbh 'prym mzbcht lcht' hyv lv mzbchvt lcht'
verses.translation: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.

verses.original: אכתוב אֶ֨כְתָּב ל֔/וֹ רבו רֻבֵּ֖י תּֽוֹרָתִ֑/י כְּמוֹ זָ֖ר נֶחְשָֽׁבוּ
verses.translit: 'khtvb 'khtb lv rbv rby tvrty khmv zr nchshbv
verses.translation: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.

verses.original: זִבְחֵ֣י הַבְהָבַ֗/י יִזְבְּח֤וּ בָשָׂר֙ וַ/יֹּאכֵ֔לוּ יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א רָצָ֑/ם עַתָּ֞ה יִזְכֹּ֤ר עֲוֺנָ/ם֙ וְ/יִפְקֹ֣ד חַטֹּאותָ֔/ם הֵ֖מָּה מִצְרַ֥יִם יָשֽׁוּבוּ
verses.translit: zbchy hbhby yzbchv bshr vy'khlv yhvh l' rtsm 'th yzkhr 'vnm vypqd cht'vtm hmh mtsrym yshvbv
verses.translation: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת עֹשֵׂ֗/הוּ וַ/יִּ֨בֶן֙ הֵֽיכָל֔וֹת וִֽ/יהוּדָ֕ה הִרְבָּ֖ה עָרִ֣ים בְּצֻר֑וֹת וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵ֣שׁ בְּ/עָרָ֔י/ו וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyshkhch yshr'l 't 'shhv vybn hykhlvt vyhvdh hrbh 'rym btsrvt vshlchty 'sh b'ryv v'khlh 'rmntyh
verses.translation: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

verses.original: אַל תִּשְׂמַ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל גִּיל֙ כָּֽ/עַמִּ֔ים כִּ֥י זָנִ֖יתָ מֵ/עַ֣ל אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ אָהַ֣בְתָּ אֶתְנָ֔ן עַ֖ל כָּל גָּרְנ֥וֹת דָּגָֽן
verses.translit: 'l tshmch yshr'l 'l gyl kh'mym khy znyt m'l 'lhykh 'hbt 'tnn 'l khl grnvt dgn
verses.translation: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.

verses.original: גֹּ֥רֶן וָ/יֶ֖קֶב לֹ֣א יִרְעֵ֑/ם וְ/תִיר֖וֹשׁ יְכַ֥חֶשׁ בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: grn vyqb l' yr'm vtyrvsh ykhchsh bh
verses.translation: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.

verses.original: לֹ֥א יֵשְׁב֖וּ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוָ֑ה וְ/שָׁ֤ב אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/בְ/אַשּׁ֖וּר טָמֵ֥א יֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: l' yshbv b'rts yhvh vshb 'prym mtsrym vb'shvr tm' y'khlv
verses.translation: They shall not dwell in the LORD’s land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.

verses.original: לֹא יִסְּכ֨וּ לַ/יהוָ֥ה יַיִן֮ וְ/לֹ֣א יֶֽעֶרְבוּ ל/וֹ֒ זִבְחֵי/הֶ֗ם כְּ/לֶ֤חֶם אוֹנִים֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם כָּל אֹכְלָ֖י/ו יִטַמָּ֑אוּ כִּֽי לַחְמָ֣/ם לְ/נַפְשָׁ֔/ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: l' yskhv lyhvh yyn vl' y'rbv lv zbchyhm khlchm 'vnym lhm khl 'khlyv ytm'v khy lchmm lnpshm l' ybv' byt yhvh
verses.translation: They shall not offer wine offerings to the LORD , neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD .

verses.original: מַֽה תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ לְ/י֣וֹם מוֹעֵ֑ד וּ/לְ/י֖וֹם חַג יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mh t'shv lyvm mv'd vlyvm chg yhvh
verses.translation: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD ?

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֤ה הָֽלְכוּ֙ מִ/שֹּׁ֔ד מִצְרַ֥יִם תְּקַבְּצֵ֖/ם מֹ֣ף תְּקַבְּרֵ֑/ם מַחְמַ֣ד לְ/כַסְפָּ֗/ם קִמּוֹשׂ֙ יִֽירָשֵׁ֔/ם ח֖וֹחַ בְּ/אָהֳלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy hnh hlkhv mshd mtsrym tqbtsm mf tqbrm mchmd lkhspm qmvsh yyrshm chvch b'hlyhm
verses.translation: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.

verses.original: בָּ֣אוּ יְמֵ֣י הַ/פְּקֻדָּ֗ה בָּ֚אוּ יְמֵ֣י הַ/שִׁלֻּ֔ם יֵדְע֖וּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֱוִ֣יל הַ/נָּבִ֗יא מְשֻׁגָּע֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/ר֔וּחַ עַ֚ל רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנְ/ךָ֔ וְ/רַבָּ֖ה מַשְׂטֵמָֽה
verses.translit: b'v ymy hpqdh b'v ymy hshlm yd'v yshr'l 'vyl hnby' mshg' 'ysh hrvch 'l rb 'vnkh vrbh mshtmh
verses.translation: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.

verses.original: צֹפֶ֥ה אֶפְרַ֖יִם עִם אֱלֹהָ֑/י נָבִ֞יא פַּ֤ח יָקוֹשׁ֙ עַל כָּל דְּרָכָ֔י/ו מַשְׂטֵמָ֖ה בְּ/בֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: tsph 'prym 'm 'lhy nby' pch yqvsh 'l khl drkhyv mshtmh bbyt 'lhyv
verses.translation: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.

verses.original: הֶעְמִֽיקוּ שִׁחֵ֖תוּ כִּ/ימֵ֣י הַ/גִּבְעָ֑ה יִזְכּ֣וֹר עֲוֺנָ֔/ם יִפְק֖וֹד חַטֹּאותָֽ/ם
verses.translit: h'myqv shchtv khymy hgb'h yzkhvr 'vnm ypqvd cht'vtm
verses.translation: They have deeply corrupted themselves , as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

verses.original: כַּ/עֲנָבִ֣ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר מָצָ֨אתִי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ/בִכּוּרָ֤ה בִ/תְאֵנָה֙ בְּ/רֵ֣אשִׁיתָ֔/הּ רָאִ֖יתִי אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם הֵ֜מָּה בָּ֣אוּ בַֽעַל פְּע֗וֹר וַ/יִּנָּֽזְרוּ֙ לַ/בֹּ֔שֶׁת וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ שִׁקּוּצִ֖ים כְּ/אָהֳבָֽ/ם
verses.translit: kh'nbym bmdbr mts'ty yshr'l khbkhvrh bt'nh br'shyth r'yty 'bvtykhm hmh b'v b'l p'vr vynzrv lbsht vyhyv shqvtsym kh'hbm
verses.translation: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם כָּ/ע֖וֹף יִתְעוֹפֵ֣ף כְּבוֹדָ֑/ם מִ/לֵּדָ֥ה וּ/מִ/בֶּ֖טֶן וּ/מֵ/הֵרָיֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'prym kh'vf yt'vpf khbvdm mldh vmbtn vmhryvn
verses.translation: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם יְגַדְּלוּ֙ אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/שִׁכַּלְתִּ֖י/ם מֵֽ/אָדָ֑ם כִּֽי גַם א֥וֹי לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/שׂוּרִ֥/י מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'm ygdlv 't bnyhm vshkhltym m'dm khy gm 'vy lhm bshvry mhm
verses.translation: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֛יִם כַּ/אֲשֶׁר רָאִ֥יתִי לְ/צ֖וֹר שְׁתוּלָ֣ה בְ/נָוֶ֑ה וְ/אֶפְרַ֕יִם לְ/הוֹצִ֥יא אֶל הֹרֵ֖ג בָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'prym kh'shr r'yty ltsvr shtvlh bnvh v'prym lhvtsy' 'l hrg bnyv
verses.translation: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.

verses.original: תֵּן לָ/הֶ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה מַה תִּתֵּ֑ן תֵּן לָ/הֶם֙ רֶ֣חֶם מַשְׁכִּ֔יל וְ/שָׁדַ֖יִם צֹמְקִֽים
verses.translit: tn lhm yhvh mh ttn tn lhm rchm mshkhyl vshdym tsmqym
verses.translation: Give them, O LORD : what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

verses.original: כָּל רָעָתָ֤/ם בַּ/גִּלְגָּל֙ כִּֽי שָׁ֣ם שְׂנֵאתִ֔י/ם עַ֚ל רֹ֣עַ מַֽעַלְלֵי/הֶ֔ם מִ/בֵּיתִ֖/י אֲגָרְשֵׁ֑/ם לֹ֤א אוֹסֵף֙ אַהֲבָתָ֔/ם כָּל שָׂרֵי/הֶ֖ם סֹרְרִֽים
verses.translit: khl r'tm bglgl khy shm shn'tym 'l r' m'llyhm mbyty 'grshm l' 'vsf 'hbtm khl shryhm srrym
verses.translation: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.

verses.original: הֻכָּ֣ה אֶפְרַ֔יִם שָׁרְשָׁ֥/ם יָבֵ֖שׁ פְּרִ֣י בלי בַֽל יַעֲשׂ֑וּ/ן גַּ֚ם כִּ֣י יֵֽלֵד֔וּ/ן וְ/הֵמַתִּ֖י מַחֲמַדֵּ֥י בִטְנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hkhh 'prym shrshm ybsh pry bly bl y'shvn gm khy yldvn vhmty mchmdy btnm
verses.translation: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.

verses.original: יִמְאָסֵ֣/ם אֱלֹהַ֔/י כִּ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ ל֑/וֹ וְ/יִהְי֥וּ נֹדְדִ֖ים בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: ym'sm 'lhy khy l' shm'v lv vyhyv nddym bgvym
verses.translation: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

verses.original: גֶּ֤פֶן בּוֹקֵק֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל פְּרִ֖י יְשַׁוֶּה לּ֑/וֹ כְּ/רֹ֣ב לְ/פִרְי֗/וֹ הִרְבָּה֙ לַֽ/מִּזְבְּח֔וֹת כְּ/ט֣וֹב לְ/אַרְצ֔/וֹ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ מַצֵּבֽוֹת
verses.translit: gpn bvqq yshr'l pry yshvh lv khrb lpryv hrbh lmzbchvt khtvb l'rtsv hytybv mtsbvt
verses.translation: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.

verses.original: חָלַ֥ק לִבָּ֖/ם עַתָּ֣ה יֶאְשָׁ֑מוּ ה֚וּא יַעֲרֹ֣ף מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֔/ם יְשֹׁדֵ֖ד מַצֵּבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: chlq lbm 'th y'shmv hv' y'rf mzbchvtm yshdd mtsbvtm
verses.translation: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ לָ֑/נוּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָרֵ֨אנוּ֙ אֶת יְהֹוָ֔ה וְ/הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מַה יַּֽעֲשֶׂה לָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: khy 'th y'mrv 'yn mlkh lnv khy l' yr'nv 't yhvh vhmlkh mh y'shh lnv
verses.translation: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD ; what then should a king do to us?

verses.original: דִּבְּר֣וּ דְבָרִ֔ים אָל֥וֹת שָׁ֖וְא כָּרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֑ית וּ/פָרַ֤ח כָּ/רֹאשׁ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט עַ֖ל תַּלְמֵ֥י שָׂדָֽי
verses.translit: dbrv dbrym 'lvt shv' khrt bryt vprch khr'sh mshpt 'l tlmy shdy
verses.translation: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.

verses.original: לְ/עֶגְלוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן יָג֖וּרוּ שְׁכַ֣ן שֹֽׁמְר֑וֹן כִּי אָבַ֨ל עָלָ֜י/ו עַמּ֗/וֹ וּ/כְמָרָי/ו֙ עָלָ֣י/ו יָגִ֔ילוּ עַל כְּבוֹד֖/וֹ כִּֽי גָלָ֥ה מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: l'glvt byt 'vn ygvrv shkhn shmrvn khy 'bl 'lyv 'mv vkhmryv 'lyv ygylv 'l khbvdv khy glh mmnv
verses.translation: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.

verses.original: גַּם אוֹת/וֹ֙ לְ/אַשּׁ֣וּר יוּבָ֔ל מִנְחָ֖ה לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ יָרֵ֑ב בָּשְׁנָה֙ אֶפְרַ֣יִם יִקָּ֔ח וְ/יֵב֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/עֲצָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: gm 'vtv l'shvr yvbl mnchh lmlkh yrb bshnh 'prym yqch vybvsh yshr'l m'tstv
verses.translation: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

verses.original: נִדְמֶ֥ה שֹׁמְר֖וֹן מַלְכָּ֑/הּ כְּ/קֶ֖צֶף עַל פְּנֵי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: ndmh shmrvn mlkhh khqtsf 'l pny mym
verses.translation: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁמְד֞וּ בָּמ֣וֹת אָ֗וֶן חַטַּאת֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ק֣וֹץ וְ/דַרְדַּ֔ר יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/אָמְר֤וּ לֶֽ/הָרִים֙ כַּסּ֔וּ/נוּ וְ/לַ/גְּבָע֖וֹת נִפְל֥וּ עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vnshmdv bmvt 'vn cht't yshr'l qvts vdrdr y'lh 'l mzbchvtm v'mrv lhrym khsvnv vlgb'vt nplv 'lynv
verses.translation: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

verses.original: מִ/ימֵי֙ הַ/גִּבְעָ֔ה חָטָ֖אתָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שָׁ֣ם עָמָ֔דוּ לֹֽא תַשִּׂיגֵ֧/ם בַּ/גִּבְעָ֛ה מִלְחָמָ֖ה עַל בְּנֵ֥י עַֽלְוָֽה
verses.translit: mymy hgb'h cht't yshr'l shm 'mdv l' tshygm bgb'h mlchmh 'l bny 'lvh
verses.translation: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.

verses.original: בְּ/אַוָּתִ֖/י וְ/אֶסֳּרֵ֑/ם וְ/אֻסְּפ֤וּ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ עַמִּ֔ים בְּ/אָסְרָ֖/ם לִ/שְׁתֵּ֥י עינת/ם עוֹנֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: b'vty v'srm v'spv 'lyhm 'mym b'srm lshty 'yntm 'vntm
verses.translation: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.

verses.original: וְ/אֶפְרַ֜יִם עֶגְלָ֤ה מְלֻמָּדָה֙ אֹהַ֣בְתִּי לָ/ד֔וּשׁ וַ/אֲנִ֣י עָבַ֔רְתִּי עַל ט֖וּב צַוָּארָ֑/הּ אַרְכִּ֤יב אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ יַחֲר֣וֹשׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה יְשַׂדֶּד ל֖/וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: v'prym 'glh mlmdh 'hbty ldvsh v'ny 'brty 'l tvb tsv'rh 'rkhyb 'prym ychrvsh yhvdh yshdd lv y'qb
verses.translation: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.

verses.original: זִרְע֨וּ לָ/כֶ֤ם לִ/צְדָקָה֙ קִצְר֣וּ לְ/פִי חֶ֔סֶד נִ֥ירוּ לָ/כֶ֖ם נִ֑יר וְ/עֵת֙ לִ/דְר֣וֹשׁ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה עַד יָב֕וֹא וְ/יֹרֶ֥ה צֶ֖דֶק לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: zr'v lkhm ltsdqh qtsrv lpy chsd nyrv lkhm nyr v't ldrvsh 't yhvh 'd ybv' vyrh tsdq lkhm
verses.translation: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD , till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

verses.original: חֲרַשְׁתֶּם רֶ֛שַׁע עַוְלָ֥תָ/ה קְצַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲכַלְתֶּ֣ם פְּרִי כָ֑חַשׁ כִּֽי בָטַ֥חְתָּ בְ/דַרְכְּ/ךָ֖ בְּ/רֹ֥ב גִּבּוֹרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: chrshtm rsh' 'vlth qtsrtm 'khltm pry khchsh khy btcht bdrkhkh brb gbvrykh
verses.translation: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.

verses.original: וְ/קָ֣אם שָׁאוֹן֮ בְּ/עַמֶּ/ךָ֒ וְ/כָל מִבְצָרֶ֣י/ךָ יוּשַּׁ֔ד כְּ/שֹׁ֧ד שַֽׁלְמַ֛ן בֵּ֥ית אַֽרְבֵ֖אל בְּ/י֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה אֵ֥ם עַל בָּנִ֖ים רֻטָּֽשָׁה
verses.translit: vq'm sh'vn b'mkh vkhl mbtsrykh yvshd khshd shlmn byt 'rb'l byvm mlchmh 'm 'l bnym rtshh
verses.translation: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.

verses.original: כָּ֗כָה עָשָׂ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל מִ/פְּנֵ֖י רָעַ֣ת רָֽעַתְ/כֶ֑ם בַּ/שַּׁ֕חַר נִדְמֹ֥ה נִדְמָ֖ה מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khkhh 'shh lkhm byt 'l mpny r't r'tkhm bshchr ndmh ndmh mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.

verses.original: כִּ֛י נַ֥עַר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וָ/אֹהֲבֵ֑/הוּ וּ/מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם קָרָ֥אתִי לִ/בְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy n'r yshr'l v'hbhv vmmtsrym qr'ty lbny
verses.translation: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

verses.original: קָרְא֖וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם כֵּ֚ן הָלְכ֣וּ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם לַ/בְּעָלִ֣ים יְזַבֵּ֔חוּ וְ/לַ/פְּסִלִ֖ים יְקַטֵּרֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: qr'v lhm khn hlkhv mpnyhm lb'lym yzbchv vlpslym yqtrvn
verses.translation: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֤י תִרְגַּ֨לְתִּי֙ לְ/אֶפְרַ֔יִם קָחָ֖/ם עַל זְרֽוֹעֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ כִּ֥י רְפָאתִֽי/ם
verses.translit: v'nkhy trglty l'prym qchm 'l zrv'tyv vl' yd'v khy rp'tym
verses.translation: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.

verses.original: בְּ/חַבְלֵ֨י אָדָ֤ם אֶמְשְׁכֵ/ם֙ בַּ/עֲבֹת֣וֹת אַהֲבָ֔ה וָ/אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/הֶ֛ם כִּ/מְרִ֥ימֵי עֹ֖ל עַ֣ל לְחֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אַ֥ט אֵלָ֖י/ו אוֹכִֽיל
verses.translit: bchbly 'dm 'mshkhm b'btvt 'hbh v'hyh lhm khmrymy 'l 'l lchyhm v't 'lyv 'vkhyl
verses.translation: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/אַשּׁ֖וּר ה֣וּא מַלְכּ֑/וֹ כִּ֥י מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָ/שֽׁוּב
verses.translit: l' yshvb 'l 'rts mtsrym v'shvr hv' mlkhv khy m'nv lshvb
verses.translation: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.

verses.original: וְ/חָלָ֥ה חֶ֨רֶב֙ בְּ/עָרָ֔י/ו וְ/כִלְּתָ֥ה בַדָּ֖י/ו וְ/אָכָ֑לָה מִֽ/מֹּעֲצ֖וֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vchlh chrb b'ryv vkhlth bdyv v'khlh mm'tsvtyhm
verses.translation: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them , because of their own counsels.

verses.original: וְ/עַמִּ֥/י תְלוּאִ֖ים לִ/מְשֽׁוּבָתִ֑/י וְ/אֶל עַל֙ יִקְרָאֻ֔/הוּ יַ֖חַד לֹ֥א יְרוֹמֵם
verses.translit: v'my tlv'ym lmshvbty v'l 'l yqr'hv ychd l' yrvmm
verses.translation: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him .

verses.original: אֵ֞יךְ אֶתֶּנְ/ךָ֣ אֶפְרַ֗יִם אֲמַגֶּנְ/ךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֚יךְ אֶתֶּנְ/ךָ֣ כְ/אַדְמָ֔ה אֲשִֽׂימְ/ךָ֖ כִּ/צְבֹאיִ֑ם נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ עָלַ/י֙ לִבִּ֔/י יַ֖חַד נִכְמְר֥וּ נִחוּמָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'ykh 'tnkh 'prym 'mgnkh yshr'l 'ykh 'tnkh kh'dmh 'shymkh khtsb'ym nhpkh 'ly lby ychd nkhmrv nchvmy
verses.translation: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.

verses.original: לֹ֤א אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ חֲר֣וֹן אַפִּ֔/י לֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב לְ/שַׁחֵ֣ת אֶפְרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל אָֽנֹכִי֙ וְ/לֹא אִ֔ישׁ בְּ/קִרְבְּ/ךָ֣ קָד֔וֹשׁ וְ/לֹ֥א אָב֖וֹא בְּ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: l' ''shh chrvn 'py l' 'shvb lshcht 'prym khy 'l 'nkhy vl' 'ysh bqrbkh qdvsh vl' 'bv' b'yr
verses.translation: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה יֵלְכ֖וּ כְּ/אַרְיֵ֣ה יִשְׁאָ֑ג כִּֽי ה֣וּא יִשְׁאַ֔ג וְ/יֶחֶרְד֥וּ בָנִ֖ים מִ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: 'chry yhvh ylkhv kh'ryh ysh'g khy hv' ysh'g vychrdv bnym mym
verses.translation: They shall walk after the LORD : he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.

verses.original: יֶחֶרְד֤וּ כְ/צִפּוֹר֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וּ/כְ/יוֹנָ֖ה מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְ/הוֹשַׁבְתִּ֥י/ם עַל בָּתֵּי/הֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: ychrdv khtspvr mmtsrym vkhyvnh m'rts 'shvr vhvshbtym 'l btyhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD .
Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.

verses.original: סְבָבֻ֤/נִי בְ/כַ֨חַשׁ֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וּ/בְ/מִרְמָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וִֽ/יהוּדָ֗ה עֹ֥ד רָד֙ עִם אֵ֔ל וְ/עִם קְדוֹשִׁ֖ים נֶאֱמָֽן
verses.translit: sbbny bkhchsh 'prym vbmrmh byt yshr'l vyhvdh 'd rd 'm 'l v'm qdvshym n'mn
verses.translation: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֜יִם רֹעֶ֥ה ר֨וּחַ֙ וְ/רֹדֵ֣ף קָדִ֔ים כָּל הַ/יּ֕וֹם כָּזָ֥ב וָ/שֹׁ֖ד יַרְבֶּ֑ה וּ/בְרִית֙ עִם אַשּׁ֣וּר יִכְרֹ֔תוּ וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן לְ/מִצְרַ֥יִם יוּבָֽל
verses.translit: 'prym r'h rvch vrdf qdym khl hyvm khzb vshd yrbh vbryt 'm 'shvr ykhrtv vshmn lmtsrym yvbl
verses.translation: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

verses.original: וְ/רִ֥יב לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה עִם יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/לִ/פְקֹ֤ד עַֽל יַעֲקֹב֙ כִּ/דְרָכָ֔י/ו כְּ/מַעֲלָלָ֖י/ו יָשִׁ֥יב לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vryb lyhvh 'm yhvdh vlpqd 'l y'qb khdrkhyv khm'llyv yshyb lv
verses.translation: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:

verses.original: בַּ/בֶּ֖טֶן עָקַ֣ב אֶת אָחִ֑י/ו וּ/בְ/אוֹנ֖/וֹ שָׂרָ֥ה אֶת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: bbtn 'qb 't 'chyv vb'vnv shrh 't 'lhym
verses.translation: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Beth-el, and there he spake with us;

verses.original: וָ/יָּ֤שַׂר אֶל מַלְאָךְ֙ וַ/יֻּכָ֔ל בָּכָ֖ה וַ/יִּתְחַנֶּן ל֑/וֹ בֵּֽית אֵל֙ יִמְצָאֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/שָׁ֖ם יְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vyshr 'l ml'kh vykhl bkhh vytchnn lv byt 'l ymts'nv vshm ydbr 'mnv
verses.translation: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD is his memorial.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַ/צְּבָא֑וֹת יְהוָ֖ה זִכְרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhvh 'lhy htsb'vt yhvh zkhrv
verses.translation: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֖ה בֵּ/אלֹהֶ֣י/ךָ תָשׁ֑וּב חֶ֤סֶד וּ/מִשְׁפָּט֙ שְׁמֹ֔ר וְ/קַוֵּ֥ה אֶל אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: v'th b'lhykh tshvb chsd vmshpt shmr vqvh 'l 'lhykh tmyd
verses.translation: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.

verses.original: כְּנַ֗עַן בְּ/יָד֛/וֹ מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִרְמָ֖ה לַ/עֲשֹׁ֥ק אָהֵֽב
verses.translit: khn'n bydv m'zny mrmh l'shq 'hb
verses.translation: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶפְרַ֔יִם אַ֣ךְ עָשַׁ֔רְתִּי מָצָ֥אתִי א֖וֹן לִ֑/י כָּל יְגִיעַ֕/י לֹ֥א יִמְצְאוּ לִ֖/י עָוֺ֥ן אֲשֶׁר חֵֽטְא
verses.translit: vy'mr 'prym 'kh 'shrty mts'ty 'vn ly khl ygy'y l' ymts'v ly 'vn 'shr cht'
verses.translation: And I that am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עֹ֛ד אוֹשִֽׁיבְ/ךָ֥ בָ/אֳהָלִ֖ים כִּ/ימֵ֥י מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: v'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh m'rts mtsrym 'd 'vshybkh b'hlym khymy mv'd
verses.translation: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.

verses.original: וְ/דִבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ עַל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י חָז֣וֹן הִרְבֵּ֑יתִי וּ/בְ/יַ֥ד הַ/נְּבִיאִ֖ים אֲדַמֶּֽה
verses.translit: vdbrty 'l hnby'ym v'nkhy chzvn hrbyty vbyd hnby'ym 'dmh
verses.translation: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.

verses.original: אִם גִּלְעָ֥ד אָ֨וֶן֙ אַךְ שָׁ֣וְא הָי֔וּ בַּ/גִּלְגָּ֖ל שְׁוָרִ֣ים זִבֵּ֑חוּ גַּ֤ם מִזְבְּחוֹתָ/ם֙ כְּ/גַלִּ֔ים עַ֖ל תַּלְמֵ֥י שָׂדָֽי
verses.translit: 'm gl'd 'vn 'kh shv' hyv bglgl shvrym zbchv gm mzbchvtm khglym 'l tlmy shdy
verses.translation: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep .

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְרַ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׂדֵ֣ה אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וּ/בְ/אִשָּׁ֖ה שָׁמָֽר
verses.translit: vybrch y'qb shdh 'rm vy'bd yshr'l b'shh vb'shh shmr
verses.translation: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/נָבִ֕יא הֶעֱלָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וּ/בְ/נָבִ֖יא נִשְׁמָֽר
verses.translit: vbnby' h'lh yhvh 't yshr'l mmtsrym vbnby' nshmr
verses.translation: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.

verses.original: כְּ/דַבֵּ֤ר אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ רְתֵ֔ת נָשָׂ֥א ה֖וּא בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֶּאְשַׁ֥ם בַּ/בַּ֖עַל וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: khdbr 'prym rtt nsh' hv' byshr'l vy'shm bb'l vymt
verses.translation: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה יוֹסִ֣פוּ לַ/חֲטֹ֗א וַ/יַּעְשׂ֣וּ לָ/הֶם֩ מַסֵּכָ֨ה מִ/כַּסְפָּ֤/ם כִּ/תְבוּנָ/ם֙ עֲצַבִּ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חָרָשִׁ֖ים כֻּלֹּ֑/ה לָ/הֶם֙ הֵ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים זֹבְחֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם עֲגָלִ֖ים יִשָּׁקֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: v'th yvspv lcht' vy'shv lhm mskhh mkhspm khtbvnm 'tsbym m'shh chrshym khlh lhm hm 'mrym zbchy 'dm 'glym yshqvn
verses.translation: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן יִֽהְיוּ֙ כַּ/עֲנַן בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/כַ/טַּ֖ל מַשְׁכִּ֣ים הֹלֵ֑ךְ כְּ/מֹץ֙ יְסֹעֵ֣ר מִ/גֹּ֔רֶן וּ/כְ/עָשָׁ֖ן מֵ/אֲרֻבָּֽה
verses.translit: lkhn yhyv kh'nn bqr vkhtl mshkhym hlkh khmts ys'r mgrn vkh'shn m'rbh
verses.translation: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וֵ/אלֹהִ֤ים זֽוּלָתִ/י֙ לֹ֣א תֵדָ֔ע וּ/מוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אַ֖יִן בִּלְתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh m'rts mtsrym v'lhym zvlty l' td' vmvshy' 'yn blty
verses.translation: Yet I am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְדַעְתִּ֖י/ךָ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ תַּלְאֻבֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'ny yd'tykh bmdbr b'rts tl'bvt
verses.translation: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

verses.original: כְּ/מַרְעִיתָ/ם֙ וַ/יִּשְׂבָּ֔עוּ שָׂבְע֖וּ וַ/יָּ֣רָם לִבָּ֑/ם עַל כֵּ֖ן שְׁכֵחֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: khmr'ytm vyshb'v shb'v vyrm lbm 'l khn shkhchvny
verses.translation: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.

verses.original: וָ/אֱהִ֥י לָ/הֶ֖ם כְּמוֹ שָׁ֑חַל כְּ/נָמֵ֖ר עַל דֶּ֥רֶךְ אָשֽׁוּר
verses.translit: v'hy lhm khmv shchl khnmr 'l drkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:

verses.original: אֶפְגְּשֵׁ/ם֙ כְּ/דֹ֣ב שַׁכּ֔וּל וְ/אֶקְרַ֖ע סְג֣וֹר לִבָּ֑/ם וְ/אֹכְלֵ֥/ם שָׁם֙ כְּ/לָבִ֔יא חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה תְּבַקְּעֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'pgshm khdb shkhvl v'qr' sgvr lbm v'khlm shm khlby' chyt hshdh tbq'm
verses.translation: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps , and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.

verses.translit: shchtkh yshr'l khy by b'zrkh
verses.translation: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.

verses.original: אֱהִ֤י מַלְכְּ/ךָ֙ אֵפ֔וֹא וְ/יוֹשִֽׁיעֲ/ךָ֖ בְּ/כָל עָרֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/שֹׁ֣פְטֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ תְּנָ/ה לִּ֖/י מֶ֥לֶךְ וְ/שָׂרִֽים
verses.translit: 'hy mlkhkh 'pv' vyvshy'kh bkhl 'rykh vshptykh 'shr 'mrt tnh ly mlkh vshrym
verses.translation: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?

verses.translit: 'tn lkh mlkh b'py v'qch b'brty
verses.translation: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.

verses.original: צָרוּר֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אֶפְרָ֔יִם צְפוּנָ֖ה חַטָּאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tsrvr 'vn 'prym tspvnh cht'tv
verses.translation: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֥י יֽוֹלֵדָ֖ה יָבֹ֣אוּ ל֑/וֹ הוּא בֵן֙ לֹ֣א חָכָ֔ם כִּֽי עֵ֥ת לֹֽא יַעֲמֹ֖ד בְּ/מִשְׁבַּ֥ר בָּנִֽים
verses.translit: chbly yvldh yb'v lv hv' bn l' chkhm khy 't l' y'md bmshbr bnym
verses.translation: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.

verses.original: מִ/יַּ֤ד שְׁאוֹל֙ אֶפְדֵּ֔/ם מִ/מָּ֖וֶת אֶגְאָלֵ֑/ם אֱהִ֨י דְבָרֶי/ךָ֜ מָ֗וֶת אֱהִ֤י קָֽטָבְ/ךָ֙ שְׁא֔וֹל נֹ֖חַם יִסָּתֵ֥ר מֵ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: myd sh'vl 'pdm mmvt 'g'lm 'hy dbrykh mvt 'hy qtbkh sh'vl nchm ystr m'yny
verses.translation: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.

verses.original: כִּ֣י ה֔וּא בֵּ֥ן אַחִ֖ים יַפְרִ֑יא יָב֣וֹא קָדִים֩ ר֨וּחַ יְהוָ֜ה מִ/מִּדְבָּ֣ר עֹלֶ֗ה וְ/יֵב֤וֹשׁ מְקוֹר/וֹ֙ וְ/יֶחֱרַ֣ב מַעְיָנ֔/וֹ ה֣וּא יִשְׁסֶ֔ה אוֹצַ֖ר כָּל כְּלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה
verses.translit: khy hv' bn 'chym ypry' ybv' qdym rvch yhvh mmdbr 'lh vybvsh mqvrv vychrb m'ynv hv' yshsh 'vtsr khl khly chmdh
verses.translation: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
